MPs asked whether the UEFA should stop paying solidarity money to Russian clubs and whether Ukrainian clubs should receive the same support as others, given Russia's war against Ukraine. The government answered that UEFA is not a state body and sanctions compliance is UEFA's responsibility, that it will use informal channels and contact the KNVB, and that UEFA says it never refused Ukrainian clubs but bank blockages prevented payments.
The cabinet will use all available informal channels to bring its position on this matter to the fore and will also be in contact with the KNVB about it.
Het kabinet zal alle beschikbare informele kanalen aangrijpen om zijn standpunt in deze voor het voetlicht te brengen en hierover ook contact hebben met de KNVB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Ceder, Dassen, Van Baarle en Teunissen over dat Nederland moet meewerken aan overbrengen ambassadebewakers

Six MPs asked the ministers whether the Dutch state must help transport 42 Afghan embassy guards after a summary-judgment ruling that the state acted unlawfully by not evacuating them. The minister contests the ruling, says the guards were not state employees, has appealed on an urgent basis, and says the appeal court suspended enforcement pending its decision, so no further transport steps are being taken.
On 12 September the appeal court suspended the State's obligation to immediately implement the judgment until it has ruled on the appeal.
Het gerechtshof heeft op 12 september jl. de verplichting voor de Staat geschorst om per direct uitvoering te geven aan het vonnis totdat het hof in het hoger beroep over deze zaak heeft geoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘We hebben geen zin meer in politiek’

MP Boswijk asked the Justice Minister about the Jewish Police Network withdrawing from police network consultations because members feel pressured to account for Middle East events. The minister respects the decision, says the police leadership handles it, and states that Jews in the Netherlands are not responsible for Israeli politics.
Like the Chief of Police, I respect this choice made by the employees.
Ik respecteer net als de Korpschef deze keuze van de medewerkers.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de berichten ‘Wonen boven winkels komt niet van de grond: gemeentelijke eisen vaak hindernis’ en ‘Parkeernormen houden ombouwen lege verdiepingen boven winkels naar woningen te

The MP Boswijk asked the minister why around 50,000 empty upper floors above shops are not being converted into housing, and what barriers municipalities and owners face, including parking norms, fragmented ownership and lack of expertise. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to existing instruments (Transformatiefaciliteit, Versnellingsagenda, City Deal, Nationaal Transformatieloket, Expertteam Woningbouw) and says the government will keep supporting municipalities without committing to a new concrete step.
I consider tackling vacancy important to alleviate the housing shortage in the Netherlands.
Ik vind het aanpakken van leegstand van belang om de woningnood in Nederland te verlichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over het artikel Schaduwvloot onder valse vlag

Two MPs asked the government about reports that tankers in Russia's shadow fleet sail under flags of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and what the Kingdom will do to stop sanctions evasion. The minister answered that the Kingdom is working on the issue through maritime administrations, the Coast Guard and IMO, that Kustwacht has contacted sanctioned vessels, and that legal and operational options are being explored.
Preparations are being made to enable inspections at anchorages of ships under the non-existent ship registers of countries in the Kingdom.
Voorbereidingen worden getroffen om inspecties op ankerplaatsen mogelijk te maken van schepen onder de niet-bestaande scheepsregisters van landen in het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Boswijk over mantelzorg- en familiewoningen bij woonwagens en op kampjes

Two CDA MPs asked whether residents of caravans (woonwagens) and kampjes can use the planned permit-free rules for mantelzorg and familiewoningen, and about housing shortages for caravan dwellers. The minister confirmed the permit-free option excludes woonwagens for ruimtelijke reasons, except for existing structures, and said the housing programmes must address caravan residents' needs.
The permit-free options for using outbuildings for housing related to mantelzorg and familiewoningen indeed do not apply to woonwagens.
De vergunningvrije mogelijkheden om bijgebouwen te gebruiken voor de huisvesting in verband met mantelzorg- en familiewoningen geldt inderdaad niet voor woonwagens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Brandweer en veiligheidsregio's slaan alarm over bezuiniging op rampenbestrijding: 'Onbegrijpelijk in deze tijden''

The CDA MP Boswijk asked whether a 10 percent cut to the Brede Doeluitkering Rampenbestrijding (BDuR) for safety regions is responsible given geopolitical risks, and what its consequences would be for regional crisis capacity. The Minister answered that the cut follows from the coalition agreement, referred to a May 2025 letter with per-region impact figures, and said regional financial decisions will only become clear in autumn 2025, while committing to additional resilience funding without fully resolving the financing question.
The decision to cut specific grants by 10%, including the Brede Doeluitkering Rampenbestrijding (BDuR), follows from the coalition agreement.
Het besluit om 10% te bezuinigen op specifieke uitkeringen, waaronder de Brede Doeluitkering Rampenbestrijding (BDuR), vloeit voort uit het Hoofdlijnenakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk berichten dat Laos militairen naar Rusland stuurt voor hulp bij mijnenruiming

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Laos is sending military engineers to Russia's Kursk region for demining, and whether EU or Dutch demining aid had trained them, and what sanctions or reviews would follow. The minister said the reports are unconfirmed, described past EU and Dutch demining aid as civilian and not used for military structures, and saw no reason yet for review, sanctions or further diplomatic steps.
The reporting that Laos is sending soldiers to Russia at Moscow's request to help with demining has so far been confirmed neither by Laos nor by other sources.
De berichtgeving dat Laos op verzoek van Moskou militairen naar Rusland stuurt voor hulp bij mijnenruiming is tot op heden noch door Laos, noch door andere bronnen bevestigd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de berichten ‘Ov-beelden al gewist, onderzoeken naar Maccabi-supporters gestaakt’ en ‘Politie worstelde met 'wezenlijk andere vorm van geweld' tijdens Maccabi-rellen’

The CDA MP Boswijk asked the Justice Minister about reports that transit footage of the Maccabi riots was erased and that investigations into supporters were dropped, and about the police and Public Prosecution Service response. The Minister says the prosecution sent complaints to police on 14 November 2024, that the GVB camera footage had already been overwritten during a camera replacement the prosecution was not told about, that no relevant footage or open-source leads were found, and that camera retention is a matter for the independent GVB, so no minimum retention period is proposed.
The GVB is an independent company for which the national government is not the concession grantor.
Het GVB is een zelfstandig bedrijf ten aanzien waarvan de Rijksoverheid geen concessieverlener is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het met 3D printers maken van wapenonderdelen voor Oekraïne

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about Danish volunteers making weapon parts for Ukraine with 3D printers, whether Dutch civilians could contribute similarly, and whether a centralised 3D-printing programme should be set up. The government answered that producing weapon parts without recognition under the Weapons and Ammunition Act is a criminal offence, that only licensed manufacturers may produce such parts, that Defence sees no quick opportunity for a centralised programme, and that the Weapons Act is under revision.
Taking the initiative to print such a weapon or part without the required permit is therefore a criminal offence and is treated as such by the authorities.

Het initiatief nemen tot het afdrukken van een dergelijk wapen of onderdeel zonder de vereiste vergunning te hebben verkregen, leidt derhalve tot een strafbaar feit en wordt door de autoriteiten als zodanig aangemerkt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte, Boswijk, Dassen, Dobbe en Teunissen over het artikel 'Europese Unie stelt in gelekt rapport zèlf oorlogsmisdaden in Gaza vast, toch blijft het stil over sancties tegen Is

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a leaked EU report on alleged war crimes in Gaza and the lack of sanctions against Israel. The minister answered that the report does not itself draw the conclusions, but the government considers bombing civilian objects and starvation as methods of warfare violations of humanitarian law, has initiated an evaluation of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the Association Agreement, and supports suspending the trade part of the agreement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht ‘EU-ministers nemen geen maatregelen tegen Israël, houden opties op tafel’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister what the Netherlands pushed for at the 15 July EU Foreign Affairs Council on Israel, whether it proposed sanctions, what concrete humanitarian aid commitments were agreed with Israel, and what action follows if Israel fails to comply. The minister answered that the Netherlands backed implementation of the EU-Israel humanitarian access deal, announced national measures (ambassador summoned, two ministers declared persona non grata, support for trade measures and a third sanctions package), and listed the agreed access commitments, though the answer on the source of the truck figures was vague and did not address military operations.
As announced in the letter to the House of 28 July, the cabinet has decided to proceed to concrete measures.
Zoals aangekondigd in de Kamerbrief van 28 juli jl. heeft het kabinet besloten over te gaan tot concrete maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte en Boswijk over een lijst met mogelijke sanctiemaatregelen tegen Israël

MPs Piri, Paternotte and Boswijk asked the government about a list of possible sanctions against Israel leaked to the press, including whether arms and national boycott options were considered, whether the list would be shared with parliament, and why the military export reporting was delayed and which dual-use licences remain valid. The minister confirmed the list was shared with participants, refused to disclose the internal note citing cabinet unity and diplomatic interests, said the export reports were delayed by workload and published up to May 2025, and argued that a boycott of settlement goods is more effective at EU level.
The cabinet will not share the note prepared for the ministerial consultation with the House and invokes the protection of the unity of cabinet policy and the protection of diplomatic interests.

Het kabinet zal de opgestelde notitie voor het bewindspersonen overleg niet met de Kamer delen en beroept zich daarbij op de bescherming van de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid en de bescherming van diplomatieke belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Orkaan van haat treft Christenen voor Israël na video Tim Hofman: ‘Maar aantijgingen volstrekt onjuist’'

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether religious gatherings should be free from disruption, how banned demonstrations at a Christians for Israel event can be prevented, and how the government judges the protest, the police and local authorities' role, and the participants' safety. The minister agreed in principle that religious gatherings should proceed unhindered, described the mayor's power to ban demonstrations, but said assessing local handling is not for him and pointed to a forthcoming study on the legal framework.
It is the responsibility of local authorities, in particular the mayor, to facilitate demonstrations as much as possible and to intervene where necessary.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag, in het bijzonder de burgemeester om demonstraties zoveel mogelijk te faciliteren en waar nodig in te grijpen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Diederik van Dijk en Van Nispen over de berichten 'Gokgedupeerden’ willen hun geld terug van onlinecasino’s: maken ze een kans, ze drukten toch zelf op het knopje?' en 'Gokbedrijv

MPs Boswijk, Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether gambling operator Unibet, which operated illegally before licensing, should keep its Dutch licence while it withholds transaction data from players suing to recover losses, and whether the regulator should act. The State Secretary answered that licence decisions rest with the independent Kansspelautoriteit, that the Ksa will weigh conduct in future licence assessments, that the matter of data access is for the courts, and that the Netherlands supports the European Commission's infringement procedure against Malta over Bill 55.
It is not for me to decide on suspending or revoking a licence.
Het is niet aan mij is om te besluiten over het schorsen of intrekken van een vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de beveiliging van Joodse en Amerikaanse locaties

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch Jewish and American locations should receive extra security after France tightened protection amid the Iran-Israel conflict, and what measures were taken. The government answered that threat level is substantial, that measures are taken as needed based on current threat information, but declined to disclose specific measures for individual institutions for security reasons.
For security reasons, I never make public statements about measures taken to protect individual institutions or persons.
Vanwege veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik in het openbaar nooit uitspraken over maatregelen die worden getroffen ten behoeve van de veiligheid van individuele instellingen of personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het bericht dat Amerikaanse experts geheime communicatieapparatuur hebben aangetroffen in Chinese zonne-omvormers

MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk asked the ministers about a report that rogue communication devices were found in Chinese solar inverters, and about risks to the grid, AIVD's role, EU measures, inverter numbers in the Netherlands, detection controls and follow-up to a 2023 RDI report. The government answered that the report is based on anonymous sources and cannot be verified, outlined existing and forthcoming EU and Dutch cybersecurity rules enforced by the RDI, and described ongoing industrial and supervisory initiatives.
The cited article states that secret components have been installed in solar panel inverters, allowing China to switch inverters on and off remotely and change settings.
In het aangehaalde artikel staat dat er geheime componenten in omvormers voor zonnepanelen zijn aangebracht, waarmee China op afstand omvormers aan en uit kan schakelen en instellingen kan aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over de nieuwe EU strategie voor de Zwarte Zee regio

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked about the new EU Black Sea strategy and whether Dutch ports, notably Rotterdam, should build ties with Black Sea ports including Odessa, including on security and a Denmark-style partnership. The minister affirms the strategy's importance, says port cooperation is mainly for port companies and EU channels, and states willingness to facilitate exploratory talks, noting an exploratory meeting already took place and that Dutch support for Ukraine uses bilateral and multilateral channels.
It is further up to the port companies themselves to give shape to port cooperation, such as in the context of port development or pursuing green shipping corridors between ports.
Het is verder aan havenbedrijven zelf om invulling te geven aan havensamenwerking zoals in het kader van havenontwikkeling of inzet op green shipping corridors tussen havens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het tegengaan van buitenlandse beïnvloeding bij de verkiezingen

CDA MPs asked the ministers how Dutch elections can be protected against foreign online disinformation campaigns, including the risks, existing measures, the DSA, Sweden's psychological defence agency and a public awareness campaign. The minister answered that the government is taking coordinated measures, is preparing new powers and legal bases for later elections, and will commission studies, but noted that the new powers will not be introduced before the 2025 elections.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Boswijk, Van der Lee, Van der Burg en Dassen over Chinese spionage via diplomatieke posten

MPs from several parties asked whether US concerns about Chinese espionage linked to the large Chinese embassy in London also affect the Netherlands, including via financial infrastructure, internet hubs and diplomatic expansion, and whether the EU should adopt joint risk-analysis guidelines for diplomatic buildings. The government answered that it shares the concerns, points to existing measures such as DORA, the Wbni and the forthcoming Cbw, says no Chinese embassy expansion request is pending in the Netherlands and no increase in Chinese diplomats has occurred, and states it will raise China-related issues within the EU.
The cabinet makes no public statements about the investigations or working methods of the services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de onderzoeken of werkwijze van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Krul en Boswijk over het bericht “Wake-up call: Microsoft sluit e-mail ICC zonder pardon af”

Three CDA MPs asked whether Microsoft cut off the ICC prosecutor's email on US orders, what the government is doing to restore access and protect the court, and whether dependence on US digital services undermines democratic institutions. The minister declined to confirm the reported cut-off, condemned the sanctions, said talks with the US and business are ongoing, and stated that digital dependence is a policy issue being addressed through a planned digital autonomy vision rather than an acute threat to democracy.
It is not for the cabinet to confirm or deny reporting on the implementation of sanctions imposed by other states.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om berichtgeving over de implementatie van sancties die door andere staten zijn opgelegd te bevestigen of te ontkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de nieuwsberichten rondom de paasviering in Jeruzalem

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about restrictions on Christian and Muslim access to holy sites in Jerusalem, including Easter and Ramadan permit limits, and whether Dutch policy would defend the status quo and freedom of religion. The minister acknowledged the concerns, reaffirmed the status quo and freedom of religion as Dutch priorities, and said Nederland raises these issues bilaterally, with Jordan and in multilateral fora, while supporting the EU statement.
The cabinet considers it essential that believers have free and unhindered access to the holy sites in Jerusalem and that the status quo of the holy sites is respected.
Het kabinet acht het essentieel dat gelovigen vrije en onbelemmerde toegang hebben tot de heilige plaatsen in Jeruzalem en dat de status quo van de heilige plaatsen wordt gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah, van Nispen, Boswijk, Koops en Bruyning over het uitblijven van investeringen voor het gevangeniswezen

MPs asked the State Secretary whether the 2025 spring budget omitted funds for prisons, whether the 23 million euro withdrawal from DJI's equity amounts to a cut, and what the consequences are for staff, early release, unexecuted sentences and pardon requests. The State Secretary confirmed no extra funds were allocated, explained the withdrawal as a legal requirement used to cover other justice costs, and warned of a growing capacity shortfall of around 800 places by 2030, while answering the timing question late.
Without additional investments I cannot realise structural capacity expansions and many necessary renovations cannot be carried out.
Zonder aanvullende investeringen kan ik geen structurele capaciteitsuitbreidingen realiseren en kunnen veel van de noodzakelijke renovaties niet uitgevoerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe en Dassen over het bericht ‘Trump wil duizenden illegalen naar Guantánamo Bay sturen, ook Nederlanders’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA, SP and Volt asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch government knew of US plans to detain illegal immigrants, including Dutch nationals, at Guantánamo Bay without due process, whether it had contacted the US, whether consular assistance was given, and whether EU partners would press the US. The minister replied that the report appeared premature, that the US had no apparent plans to detain Dutch citizens there, and deferred the remaining questions to the answer to question 1 while promising a reply within the deadline.
There are also no indications that the United States intends to deport Dutch nationals via Guantánamo Bay.
Er zijn ook geen indicaties dat de Verenigde Staten voornemens is Nederlandse staatsburgers uit te zetten via Guantánamo Bay.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Dassen, Van der Burg, Paternotte en Piri over het bericht dat Nederland de Russische oorlogskas spekt en mogelijk spionnen binnenlaat

MPs asked the government whether it would press the EU for a full ban on Russian LNG and condensate imports, and act against vessels with Russian crews or ties that may carry Russian intelligence officers into Dutch ports. The minister answered that the EU lacks unanimity for an import ban, that the Commission's RePowerEU roadmap phases out Russian LNG by end-2027, that a national ban is opposed, and that Russian-flagged ships are already barred while sanctioned ships are refused and inspected, but declined to comment on intelligence use of crews.
The cabinet cannot make statements on whether Russia uses the crews of LNG and condensate tankers as cover for Russian intelligence officers.
Het kabinet kan geen uitspraken doen over of Rusland gebruik maakt van bemanning van LNG- en aardgascondensaattankers als dekmantel voor Russische inlichtingenofficieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Paternotte en Van der Burg over een Nederlands monument ter nagedachtenis aan de Holodomor

MPs asked whether the government would support a Dutch memorial to the Holodomor and attend the annual commemoration, citing Russian denial and the Kremlin's historical revisionism. The minister answered that Russian historical revisionism is opposed where it arises in international fora, that a memorial is not a core task of the ministry and would more likely be an initiative of the Ukrainian community via municipal decision, and that the ambassador in Kyiv represents the Netherlands at the commemoration.
Realising a memorial is not a core task of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Het realiseren van een monument is geen kerntaak van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg, Van Campen en Boswijk over het gevaar van Russische inmenging bij de aanstaande verkiezingen in Moldavië

MPs Van der Burg, Van Campen and Boswijk asked the Foreign Minister about Russian interference risks ahead of Moldova's September 2025 elections, including support measures, EU/NATO security cooperation, observation missions and sanctions. The minister answered that Russia's gas cut-off and broader interference are being countered through cyber, anti-corruption and media resilience aid, bilateral security cooperation and EU sanctions, and committed to keep Parliament informed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Dobbe, Hirsch, Bamenga en Paternotte over het bericht 'Pentagon chief scraps program from first Trump term to boost women in security'

MPs asked the Dutch government whether it would press the United States and other partners to uphold UN Women, Peace and Security resolutions and related treaties after the US scrapped its own WPS programme, and what Netherlands itself will do to fund and implement them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands raises these principles bilaterally and multilaterally, noted the US has not ratified CEDAW or the Arms Trade Treaty, and listed existing commitments including a small Syria grant and Defence gender-integration activities without committing to new funding.
The Netherlands speaks out in favour of implementing and complying with international agreements and treaties, both publicly and behind closed doors.
Nederland spreekt zich voor en achter gesloten deuren uit over het belang van implementatie en naleving van internationale afspraken en verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Werf en Boswijk over het samen met de Denen direct investeren in de Oekraïense defensie-industrie

MPs Paternotte, Van der Werf and Boswijk asked why the Netherlands did not join Denmark's mechanism for funding Ukrainian defence-industry investment, how much has been contracted, and how it ensures alignment with Ukraine's needs. The minister answered that the Dutch direct-procurement model gives the Netherlands control over the process, that over EUR 1.4 billion has been allocated, that contracts are still in negotiation with no amounts yet, and that answers to individual questions were not provided in time.
It is not yet possible to indicate which amounts are involved.
Het is nog niet mogelijk om aan te geven welke bedragen hiermee gemoeid zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Six Dijkstra en Boswijk over berichten op de sociale media, die uit Nederland komen en oproepen tot haat, geweld en moord in Syrië

MPs Omtzigt, Six Dijkstra and Boswijk asked whether police and the public prosecution service have adequate oversight of, and capacity to prosecute, social media calls from the Netherlands for hatred and violence against groups in Syria, and asked for case figures. The minister said the systems cannot show how often such posts occur or how many cases are investigated, asserted priority and capacity for prosecuting hate speech, and did not answer within the requested two weeks.

From the systems of the police and the Public Prosecution Service (OM) it unfortunately cannot be retrieved how often such statements and calls occur and how many reports, complaints or criminal investigations are carried out regarding such calls.

Uit de systemen van de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) kan helaas niet worden gehaald hoe vaak dergelijke uitingen en oproepen zich voordoen en hoeveel meldingen, aangiften of strafrechtelijke onderzoeken er worden gedaan naar dergelijke oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Groene boa’s willen gemakkelijker wapens krijgen: ‘Zonder zijn we vleugellam’’

Mp Boswijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about green enforcement officers (boa's) facing violence, PTSD, slow police response times and slow weapon-permit procedures. The minister said a broader review of the boa system will be sent to parliament around summer 2025, that weapon issuance requires careful assessment, and that the PTSD initiative response will follow before summer 2025.
Around summer 2025 the in-depth review of the boa system will be sent to your House.
Rond de zomer van 2025 zal de diepgaande beschouwing op het boa-bestel aan uw Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Boswijk en Kahraman over het bericht 'Nigeria: christenen in deelstaat Plateau keer op keer slachtoffer militante Fulani’s.'

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Foreign Minister about reported attacks on Christians in Nigeria's Plateau state by Fulani militants, including the government's response, the role of religion, EU and UN action, and the ECOWAS ruling against Kano blasphemy provisions. The minister answered that the violence stems from local land and resource conflicts, that the government is cautious about framing it by religion, and that it raises the issue bilaterally, in EU and UN settings, and through existing programmes, while committing only to a visit by the Human Rights Ambassador and noting the EU Special Envoy appointment is ongoing.
The cabinet does not know who instigated the violence or what exactly motivated them.
Het is bij het kabinet onbekend wie de aanstichters waren van het geweld en wat hen exact motiveerde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het bericht “Lokale wielrenners balen van afgelast NK wielrennen”

MPs Boswijk and Inge van Dijk asked whether sports events, including the NK wielrennen, are being cancelled due to police capacity shortages linked to the NATO summit, and about police deployment data and protocols for small events. The minister answered that local authorities decide on event permits, no national figures are kept, and no protocol is planned, while pointing to burgermotorverkeersregelaars as an alternative.
There is no overview of the number of sports events that cannot proceed due to a lack of police capacity.
Er is geen overzicht van het aantal sportevenementen dat niet kan doorgaan wegens een gebrek aan politiecapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen, Paternotte, Dobbe en Van Baarle over het bericht 'No humanitarian aid will enter Gaza, Israel defence Minister says'

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether she condemns Israel's blocking of humanitarian aid to Gaza, whether this constitutes collective punishment or a war crime, whether UN Resolution 2417 is being ignored, whether Israel violates the ICJ provisional measures, and whether she will push for EU sanctions. The minister condemns the blockade as contrary to international law, notes the legal framework and Dutch diplomatic steps, and says a review of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the EU-Israel Association Agreement has been requested, while stating that sanctions require EU unanimity.
The cabinet condemns the blocking of humanitarian aid and basic services such as electricity.
Het kabinet veroordeelt het blokkeren van humanitaire hulp en basisvoorzieningen zoals elektriciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte, Boswijk, Dobbe, Dassen, Van Baarle en Teunissen over de catastrofale humanitaire situatie in Gaza

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza, including whether Israel is starving the population, the risk of famine, the proposal for US-linked security firms to distribute aid, and what the government is doing. The minister answered that Israel's blockade violates international humanitarian law, that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Israel to lift it and has asked the EU to review Israel's compliance with the Association Agreement, but that it cannot deliver aid by sea or air without Israeli consent.
Pending this, the Netherlands will not agree to extending the EU-Israel Action Plan.
In afwachting hiervan zal Nederland niet instemmen met verlenging van het EU-Israël Actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over het leveren van gebruikte visnetten aan Oekraïne

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked whether the government would support and remove regulatory obstacles to collecting and exporting used fishing nets to Ukraine for drone protection. The minister replied that defence does not fund civilian initiatives but is open to facilitating transport if Ukraine's defence ministry states a need, and that EU waste rules and extended producer responsibility cannot be unilaterally changed, though nets that reach end-of-waste status may be exported.
The Ministry of Defence is nevertheless open to examining how a contribution could be facilitated, for example for the transport of used fishing nets.
Het Ministerie van Defensie staat evenwel open voor het onderzoeken op welke manier wel een bijdrage gefaciliteerd kan worden, bijvoorbeeld voor het transport van gebruikte visnetten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Boswijk over ‘Het traceren van militairen via fitness-apps

MPs Van der Werf and Boswijk asked whether Dutch soldiers can be traced via the Strava fitness app and what Defence is doing about the operational security risk. The government answers that the app is banned on defence devices, personnel receive cyber-awareness training and a handbook, a defence fitness app was introduced, and security protocols are reviewed as technology changes.
To mitigate this risk, the application in question, like comparable fitness applications, is not permitted on defence devices.
Om dit risico te mitigeren, is de betreffende applicatie, net als vergelijkbare fitness-applicaties, niet toegestaan op defensieapparaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de uitsluiting van het Afghaanse vrouwen voetbalelftal van de kwalificatie voor het WK door de Taliban

MPs Boswijk and Inge van Dijk asked whether the government would press FIFA to recognise and finance the Afghan women's football team excluded by the Taliban from World Cup qualifiers, and how it viewed the erosion of women's rights in Afghanistan. The government condemned the systematic repression of Afghan women, said it would not interfere in FIFA's decision-making, and noted that the timing of FIFA's plan for Afghan players was unknown.
However, the cabinet is not responsible for the decision-making or policy of FIFA.
Het kabinet gaat echter niet over de besluitvorming of het beleid van de FIFA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over pensioenfondsen en verzekeraars die bereid zijn geld te steken in de versterking van defensie

Two CDA MPs asked whether pension funds and insurers are willing to invest in defence but are waiting for a plan from The Hague, and why this takes so long. The government answers that Defence is talking with industry and investors, that financing is a shared responsibility, that investment decisions remain with financial institutions, and lists initiatives such as Defport, a financing table and planned measures, without giving a firm timetable.
Ultimately it remains up to banks, insurers, pension funds and other investors themselves to decide to what extent and how they want to invest in the defence industry.
Uiteindelijk blijft het aan banken, verzekeraars en pensioenfondsen en andere investeerders zelf om te bepalen in welke mate en op welke wijze zij willen investeren in de defensie-industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de gevolgen van bezuinigingen op het Mensenrechtenfonds

MP Boswijk asked the Foreign Minister whether budget cuts to the Human Rights Fund (MRF) would weaken Dutch human rights work, its information position and donor coordination, and how the IOB evaluation would be followed up. The minister answered that the MRF remains the main instrument, that 2025 cuts were partly reduced by EUR 500,000, that country coverage and themes will be narrowed in the 2026 redesign, and that a full country list cannot be published for security reasons.
A complete country list with allocations per post cannot be made public, given the sensitivity of the subject and the safety of the colleagues and implementing partners involved.
Een volledige landenlijst met toekenningen per post kan, gelet op de gevoeligheid van het onderwerp en de veiligheid van betrokken collega's en implementatiepartners, niet openbaar gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over de voorgenomen ontslagrondes bij UNHCR en IOM

MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk asked the minister about planned job cuts at UNHCR and IOM caused by US funding reductions, and about the impact on refugees and possible Dutch or EU responses. The minister confirmed the cuts and the US role as largest donor, gave 2024 Dutch contributions, expressed concern, but said the Netherlands cannot restore US funding, that it faces its own budget cuts, and that EU options are still being examined.
For 2025 these amounts are not yet known.
Voor 2025 zijn deze bedragen nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Dassen, Boswijk, Paternotte, Teunissen en Ceder over de aanhouding van de burgemeester van Istanbul

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the detention of Istanbul mayor Imamoglu and about a hundred others appears politically motivated, whether it should have consequences, and whether the Netherlands will raise it with Turkey and push for EU measures. The minister supports the EU statement calling for transparency and rule of law, says he raised concerns by phone with his Turkish counterpart and via the ambassador, and notes the EU has postponed thematic consultations with Turkey while it considers whether further measures are appropriate.
It is crucial that the legal process against mayor İmamoğlu and others takes place with transparency.
Het is cruciaal dat het juridische proces tegen burgemeester İmamoğlu en anderen in transparantie plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Wal, Van der Werf, Nordkamp, Dassen en Olger Van Dijk over de (dreigende) afhankelijkheid van de Nederlandse krijgsmacht van Starlink

MPs asked whether the Dutch armed forces risk dependence on Starlink, whether alternative European satellite systems exist for command, communication, positioning and ISR, and whether the Netherlands will invest in autonomous capacity. The minister replied that Defence is not dependent on Starlink, that it spreads suppliers and is building sovereign ISR and PNT capacity over time, but withheld details of specific systems and command systems on operational and national security grounds.
No statements are made about specific alternatives for Defence in connection with operational interests and national security.
Over specifieke alternatieven voor Defensie worden geen uitspraken gedaan in verband met operationele belangen en de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de noodzaak voor het opstellen van een Amerikastrategie

An MP from the CDA asks whether the government will draft a United States strategy like its China and Russia strategies, given strained relations with Washington over Ukraine and NATO. The minister replies that the US is a key ally, stresses continued constructive engagement and European burden-sharing, but declines to write a separate US strategy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Boswijk over de noodzaak om de onafhankelijkheid van de rechterlijke macht beter te waarborgen om onze democratische rechtsstaat weerbaarder te maken

MPs Sneller and Boswijk asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security how to better guarantee judicial independence, including the minister's role in appointing Council for the Judiciary members and court managers, the financing of the judiciary, and constitutionally anchoring the Council. The State Secretary answered that Dutch judicial independence is already safeguarded constitutionally and by law, that current safeguards are sufficient, and promised a letter by mid-2025 setting out possible reforms to appointments, financing and the Council's position.
In the letter announced in answer 1, to be sent by mid-2025, I intend to inform the House about the appointment procedures for court administrators.
In de in antwoord 1 genoemde, voor medio 2025 aangekondigde brief ben ik voornemens uw Kamer te informeren over de benoemingsprocedures van gerechtsbestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Boswijk, Van der Burg en Van der Lee over de geheime deportatie van 48 Oeigoeren naar China door de regering van Thailand

MPs from D66, CDA, VVD and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Foreign Minister about the reported secret deportation of Uyghurs from Thailand to China and what the Dutch government had done to prevent it. The minister confirmed the deportation, said Thailand breached non-refoulement, described diplomatic outreach to Thai and Chinese authorities and EU and UN statements, and said the Dutch embassy in Beijing would monitor the situation.

From the Dutch embassy in Bangkok, the Dutch Permanent Representation to the UN in Geneva and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in The Hague, active outreach was made to the Thai authorities up to the day of deportation.

Vanuit de Nederlandse ambassade in Bangkok, de Nederlandse Permanente Vertegenwoordiging bij de VN in Genève en vanuit het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken in Den Haag is actief outreach gedaan naar de Thaise autoriteiten tot op de dag van uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over de onrust na het dodelijke steekincident op 2 januari in Den Dolder

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked whether the 2017 promise that the Fivoor clinic would leave Den Dolder by 2025 would be honoured, and what options exist to relocate Fivoor or restore residents' sense of safety. The state secretaries answered that no formal promise on a departure date was made, that they lack the competence to order a relocation or an admission stop, and that they will explore use of Rijksvastgoed and continue talks with the municipality.
No formal commitment was made by the Minister for Legal Protection regarding the departure date of the Fivoor clinics from Den Dolder.
Er is door de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming geen formele toezegging gedaan over de vertrekdatum voor de klinieken voor de klinieken van Fivoor uit Den Dolder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Dobbe en Boswijk over het bericht 'Goudkoorts blokkeert de weg naar vrede in Sudan'

MPs Ceder, Dobbe and Boswijk asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about gold trade fuelling the Sudan conflict, arms diversion, Russian involvement, EU sanctions and humanitarian response. The ministers answered that the Netherlands shares the concerns, points to existing EU conflict-minerals and forced-labour rules, the CSDDD and arms embargoes, and says it is pushing for EU engagement, a contact group and humanitarian exemptions, without committing to new concrete measures on gold imports.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to act in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises on responsible business conduct.
Het kabinet verwacht dat Nederlandse bedrijven ondernemen in lijn met de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen inzake maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ceder, Van der Burg, Kahraman, Vermeer, Boswijk en Eerdmans over christenvervolging in de Democratische Republiek Congo

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the killing of 70 people in a church in the DR Congo, the role of the Special Envoy for Religion, EU terrorist listing of the ADF, foreign support for the ADF, and UN action. The minister condemned the attack, said the Envoy's involvement is not currently of added value, agreed to explore listing the ADF, and described Dutch and EU support for peace and UN human rights mechanisms.
I am willing to examine the possibilities of placing this group on the European terrorism sanctions list or the European ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctions list.
Ik ben bereid te onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om deze groep op de Europese terrorisme-sanctielijst of de Europese ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctielijst te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Boswijk over het artikel 'Rebels Backed by Rwanda Announce Capture of Key City in Eastern Congo'

MPs Bamenga and Boswijk asked about the M23 advance in eastern DRC, the humanitarian situation, Dutch and EU responses, and the EU-Rwanda critical minerals memorandum. The government answers that Dutch humanitarian funding continues, that Rwanda is being pressed bilaterally and in the EU to halt support for M23, and that the minerals MoU is under discussion for possible suspension.
Due to the confidentiality of this process, the cabinet cannot make further statements on this.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van dit proces kan het kabinet hier verder geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Agent stopt met social media om beleid politie: ‘Echt heel jammer’’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police social media rules, which tightened account requirements, should be relaxed so neighbourhood officers can keep their accounts and show their work. The Minister confirmed the 2024 update to account requirements, said police accounts must be recognisable, and declined to revise the policy, noting it supports the police leadership's approach.
I support this social media policy of the police leadership.
Ik ondersteun dit social mediabeleid van de korpsleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ME’ers zijn uitputting nabij verboden demonstraties – echt bijna op

An MP asked the Justice Minister about police (ME) exhaustion after banned demonstrations in Amsterdam, aftercare for officers, whether demonstrations should have been allowed under an emergency ordinance, and the impact on police capacity for the 2025 NAVO summit. The minister answered that the ME was deployed repeatedly, that aftercare is provided, that local authorities are responsible for permitting decisions, and that police capacity will be sufficient for the summit, with mutual assistance between units if local shortages arise.
It is up to the authorities to set priorities on this.
Het is aan het gezag om hierop te prioriteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Unibet geeft gokkers die via de rechter geld terugeisen geen inzage meer in transacties: ‘Dit is sabotage’’

MP Boswijk (CDA) asks the State Secretary about reports that Unibet denies losing gamblers access to their transaction records while they reclaim money through the courts, and whether the company's licence and consumer protection duties are adequate. The State Secretary answers that the AP and Ksa supervise compliance, that licence withdrawal is a last resort, that the civil dispute is for the courts, and that he has alerted the regulators and will keep discussing EU enforcement.
I have pointed the Ksa and AP to the case concerned.
Ik heb de Ksa en AP gewezen op de betreffende casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over het bericht dat westerse scheepseigenaren miljarden verdienden met de verkoop van olietankers aan de Russische schaduwvloot

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked the Foreign Minister how Western shipowners could profit billions from selling old tankers to Russia's shadow fleet, how many such ships are sanctioned, and whether sellers face liability. The minister called the sales worrying, said only 19 of the 230 ships are sanctioned, noted that proving sanctions evasion in advance is difficult, and referred enforcement to prosecutors while promising to press for further EU measures.
It is up to the relevant enforcement bodies to determine whether companies have carried out sufficient due diligence.
Het is aan de relevante handhavingsentiteiten om vast te stellen of bedrijven voldoende due-dilligence hebben uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over sollicitatiegegevens die met Google gedeeld worden

An MP asked whether job applications to the AIVD and MIVD via werkenvoornederland.nl leak identifying data to Google through Google Analytics, and about related privacy and US-law risks. The minister denied any sharing of applicant data, said GA4 is configured for anonymity, but largely deflected on alternatives, the AP investigation, and which foreign services use Google Analytics.
It is impossible that the identity of applicants to the AIVD or MIVD is shared via Google Analytics.
Het is onmogelijk dat de identiteit van sollicitanten bij de AIVD of MIVD via Google Analytics wordt gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Kahraman en Boswijk  over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2025 van Open Doors

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, Nieuw Sociaal Contract and CDA asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the Open Doors 2025 persecution ranking, covering Central Asia, Sub-Saharan Africa, Pakistan, Syria, Algeria and related issues. The minister answered that the government shares the concerns, raises religious freedom bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN, and commits to continued engagement, but declined to support an international UN inquiry into violence in Nigeria as unlikely to win broad support.
The cabinet currently considers it unlikely that there will be broad support for establishing a UN-mandated international commission of inquiry into religious violence in Nigeria.
Het kabinet acht het op dit moment onwaarschijnlijk dat er brede steun zal zijn voor het oprichten van een VN-gemandateerde internationale onderzoekscommissie voor religieus geweld in Nigeria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Eerdmans over het nieuws dat Russische geheim agenten met vissersschepen naar Nederland kunnen reizen

MPs asked whether the NVWA can fully inspect Russian fish imports, impose fines or seize cargo, and whether the government will push for a ban on Russian whitefish, sanctions on Norebo, restrictions on Russian crews and measures against financing of Russia via Dutch ports. The minister answered that inspections are risk-based within EU benchmarks, that the NVWA lacks powers over catch quotas, that no fines were issued, and that the government favours exploring a whitefish import ban while leaving options open and withholding details of its negotiating position.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch negotiating position, nor of the surprise effect necessary for sanctions to be effective, to go into more detail on the Dutch negotiating position.

Het is niet in het belang van de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie en van de voor de effectiviteit van sancties noodzakelijke verrassingseffect om in meer detail op de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie in te gaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Boswijk over de berichten 'Hypermoderne Tesla Cybertruck van rapper Kosso rijdt via omweg tóch op de Nederlandse weg' en 'Eerste legale Tesla Cybertruck in België rijdt rond: Ned

MPs Vedder and Boswijk asked whether Tesla Cybertrucks entering the Netherlands via loopholes (Albanian registration, Czech individual approval) pose road safety risks and what the government will do. The minister answered that the vehicle is registered abroad under the Vienna Convention, that the RDW has only a pending individual approval application for another Cybertruck, that enforcement tools exist but no new policy is planned, and that the government will push the European Commission to update individual approval rules.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and the RDW remain actively engaged in international forums where vehicle requirements affecting vehicle safety are further developed.

Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat en de RDW blijven actief in gesprek in internationale gremia waar voertuigeisen, die van invloed zijn op de voertuigveiligheid, verder worden ontwikkeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van den Burg, Teunissen, Ceder, Boswijk, Van der Lee en Kahraman over de acuut dreigende uitzetting van Oeigoeren in Thailand

Seven MPs asked the ministers about the imminent deportation of 48 Uyghurs held in Thailand to China and what the Netherlands was doing to prevent it. The Foreign Minister answered that the Netherlands has urged Thailand, bilaterally and within the EU, to respect non-refoulement and not deport the group, and is monitoring third-country resettlement options.
The Netherlands has made the urgent appeal to the Thai authorities, orally and in writing, both bilaterally and within the EU, not to extradite the 48 Uyghurs.

Nederland heeft op verschillende manieren, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk en zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband de dringende oproep aan de Thaise autoriteiten gedaan om de 48 Oeigoeren niet uit te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Omwonenden Rossum-Agelo langer in onzekerheid over mogelijk munitiedepot: “Kan maart worden’”

MP Boswijk asked the State Secretary for Defence about the consequences of explosion safety zones A, B and C around a large ammunition depot, the treatment of farmland and cultural-historical sites, how community impact is assessed, and how the national spatial programme process and stakeholder information will proceed. The State Secretary explained the zone restrictions in detail and described the planned assessment process, but gave largely procedural answers on farmland and location choice, leaving the final decision to the cabinet after consultation.
After administrative consultation between Defence and the provinces and municipalities in spring 2025, the cabinet will decide on the provisional preferred alternatives for the NPRD.
Na bestuurlijk overleg door Defensie met de provincies en gemeenten in het voorjaar van 2025 zal het kabinet een besluit nemen over de voorlopige voorkeursalternatieven voor het NPRD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Klaver en Boswijk over de voorgenomen krimp van EU-vertegenwoordigingen in het buitenland

MPs Paternotte, Klaver and Boswijk asked whether the planned Commission cut of EU delegation staff abroad, and the Dutch cuts, weaken EU diplomatic reach. The minister declined to comment on leaked documents, said the HR/VP decides on delegations, and said the Dutch cuts stay with specifics to be sent in spring.
For this reason, the cabinet does not wish to make substantive statements about the leaked document to which POLITICO refers.
Het kabinet wenst om die reden geen inhoudelijke uitspraken te doen over het gelekte document waarnaar POLITICO verwijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het dreigende tekort aan nieuwe commando’s

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Defence about a looming shortage of new special forces commandos, irregular outflow of experienced operators, a possible SOF allowance, and equipment procurement delays. The State Secretary answered that irregular outflow fell from 8.7% in 2022 to 2.3% in 2024, that the existing pay package is competitive, and that procurement processes already have designated contacts, though no structural SOF budget exists.
Apart from that, I continue to look at all options to limit irregular outflow and to work towards a well-staffed armed forces.
Los daarvan blijf ik naar alle opties kijken om irreguliere uitstroom te beperken en te werken aan een goed gevulde krijgsmacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de omzeiling van sancties tegen Rusland door net opgerichte bedrijven

MPs Boswijk and Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about sanctions evasion against Russia by newly founded small firms, as flagged by a CBS and University of Groningen study, and about due diligence and compliance obligations for exporters. The minister responded that evasion is a government priority, that the expanded anti-circumvention clause and best-efforts and due diligence duties apply, that enforcement data is not yet available, and that a letter on chip manufacturers' compliance was sent on 26 November 2024.
Countering sanctions circumvention is a priority for the cabinet.
Het tegengaan van sanctie-omzeiling is een prioriteit voor het kabinet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over het bericht dat scheepsbouwer Damen schepen opknapt die Russisch gas vervoeren

Two MPs from D66 and CDA asked ministers whether Dutch shipbuilder Damen's maintenance of Russian LNG-transport vessels breaches EU sanctions and how the government will tighten measures against Russian LNG imports. The ministers answered that sanctions prohibit servicing vessels linked to Russian entities unless they are used to evade sanctions, that enforcement follows signals of breaches, that the Netherlands pushes for an EU roadmap to phase out Russian gas and LNG, and that it will press for stronger measures in the next sanctions package, but they gave no case-specific details.

The cabinet cannot go into individual cases, but in general supplying parts and/or carrying out maintenance (technical assistance) to vessels of Russian persons and entities or vessels used in Russia is prohibited.

Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen, maar in zijn algemeenheid geldt dat het leveren van onderdelen en/of uitvoeren van onderhoud (technische bijstand) aan schepen van Russische personen en entiteiten of schepen die in Rusland gebruikt worden verboden is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over het bericht ‘Tientallen kanalen met sportwedtips op Telegram, kansspelautoriteit stelt onderzoek in’

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked about reports of dozens of Telegram channels selling sports betting tips aimed at young people, including whether influencer promotion falls under the gambling advertising ban and whether the Kansspelautoriteit investigation has concluded. The Secretary of State says the tips appear to be fraud rather than matchfixing or licensed gambling advertising, points to existing prevention and enforcement tools, says the regulator monitors these channels, and promises to inform parliament once the investigation results are known.
Once the results of the investigation are known, I will inform the House of Representatives.
Op het moment dat de resultaten bekend zijn, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Oplichting door nepagenten stijgt explosief, dit jaar al 3500 incidenten'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the rising number of fake-police-agent scams targeting elderly victims, prevention measures, victim reluctance to report, and whether purchasing lookalike police uniforms online can be stopped. The minister answered that prevention campaigns, a podcast and police reporting efforts are ongoing, that wearing a lookalike uniform to mislead can be punished under article 196 of the Criminal Code, but that buying such a uniform for fraud is not punishable as preparation, and that takedown requests and customs action against online sellers are being pursued.
Wearing a counterfeit uniform at, for example, carnival is not punishable in itself, but the above means that anyone who behaves as a police officer in a strongly resembling uniform can be punished.

Het dragen van een namaak-uniform bij bijvoorbeeld carnaval is op zichzelf niet strafbaar, maar bovenstaande betekent wel dat wie zich in een sterk gelijkend uniform als politieagent gedraagt wél kan worden bestraft
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de demonstratie waarbij de Kromhout Kazerne urenlang werd geblokkeerd

An MP asked the Defence and Interior ministers about a protest that blockaded the Kromhout barracks in Utrecht for hours, forcing cancellation of an NIDV defence-industry event, and whether the mayor and authorities should have intervened and whether restrictive rules are needed. The minister answered that the event was cancelled, that the mayor is responsible for public order and that a WODC study on demonstration law is underway, while stating that blanket bans on demonstrations at military sites are not possible under current law.
It is not possible to ban demonstrations in public spaces in advance as a standard measure.
Het is niet mogelijk om demonstraties op openbaar terrein vooraf standaard te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Boswijk over de politiecapaciteit voor de begeleiding van wielerwedstrijden

MPs Inge van Dijk and Boswijk asked about the status of a motion on keeping cycling races going, the timing of an Antea Group study on volunteer motorcycle traffic controllers, and the effect of reduced police capacity around the 2025 NATO summit. The Staatssecretaris replied that the study is finished and will be shared soon with a letter on how its findings will be followed up, that local mayors decide on permits, and that police cannot guarantee escort for races from January to August 2025 except possibly a limited selection.
The Antea Group study will be shared with your House as soon as possible.
Het onderzoek van Antea Group wordt zo spoedig mogelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de ontkoppeling van ontwikkelingshulp

An MP asked whether the decision to decouple development aid from economic growth was discussed with coalition parties, and about a past statement by an NSC financial spokesperson denying it was discussed with his faction. The minister answers that the cabinet chose not to adjust the ODA budget to the new BNI forecast, reporting the decision was communicated via the budget documents and a letter, and declines to pre-empt the spring 2025 review.
The cabinet chose not to update the ODA budget in the budget for the new GNI forecast in the CPB's Macro-Economic Outlook, in light of the overall government-wide problems.

Het kabinet heeft ervoor gekozen om in de begroting het ODA-budget niet te actualiseren voor de nieuwe BNI-raming in de Macro-Economische Verkenning (MEV) van het CPB, in het licht van de totale Rijksbrede problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Boswijk over de rechtszaak van Nederland tegen Afghanistan

MPs Piri and Boswijk asked for the written claim Netherlands, Australia, Canada and Germany filed against Afghanistan over violations of the Women's Convention, asked whether it affects asylum procedures for Afghan women, and asked about grant rates and the risks of tightened IND assessment criteria. The minister said the claim is at the negotiation stage and the strategy is confidential, that there is no legal link to asylum decisions which rest on the Afghanistan country report and individual assessment, and gave grant-rate figures (about 95% overall, 75% since July 2024 on small numbers).
The progress and strategy of the negotiations is confidential in the interest of the process.
De voortgang en strategie van de onderhandelingen is in het belang van het proces vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bezoek van de Secretaris-Generaal van de Verenigde Naties aan de top van de BRICS-landen

Parliamentarian Boswijk (CDA) asks why UN Secretary-General Guterres attended the BRICS summit in Kazan, Russia, and planned to meet Putin despite the ICC arrest warrant, and whether his attendance undermines the UN's relevance. Minister Veldkamp replies that the SG normally attends such summits, that the Netherlands and EU objected and preferred lower-level representation, that the UN should have justified the contact under its 2013 guidelines, and that the objection has been communicated to the SG.
The Netherlands, like the EU and other like-minded countries, clearly communicated this objection to the SG.
Dit bezwaar heeft Nederland, net als de EU en andere gelijkgezinden, duidelijk aan de SG kenbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over de massadeportatie van Krim-Tataren door de Sovjet-Unie in 1944 als genocide erkennen

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked whether the Netherlands will recognise the 1944 Soviet deportation of Crimean Tatars as genocide, citing Estonia's parliamentary recognition and other countries' positions. Minister Veldkamp answered that the government is cautious about labelling events genocide, that international courts and UN findings are leading, and that he will not ask the CAVV for further advice, though he acknowledges the suffering.
In light of the above, the Dutch government takes a cautious stance when qualifying certain events as genocide.
In het licht van het bovenstaande stelt de Nederlandse regering zich terughoudend op bij het kwalificeren van bepaalde gebeurtenissen als genocide.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Paternotte en Van der Burg over het bericht dat Nederlandse landbouwbedrijven die subsidie ontvangen om Oekraïne te helpen met de wederopbouw tegelijkertijd zakendoenin Rusland

MPs Boswijk, Paternotte and Van der Burg asked whether Dutch farm firms receiving Ukraine reconstruction subsidies also trade with Russia, and whether RVO checks this and should exclude such firms. The government says it does not comment on individual firms, that unsanctioned trade with Russia is not currently grounds for exclusion, and that it is studying adding such an exclusion to the Ukraine Partnership Facility subsidy scheme and considering further EU sanctions on agricultural goods.
In addition, the cabinet is examining whether unsanctioned trade with Russia can be added as a ground for exclusion from the subsidy scheme for the Ukraine Partnership Facility (UPF).
Daarnaast onderzoekt het kabinet of ongesanctioneerde handel met Rusland als uitsluitingsgrond toegevoegd kan worden aan de subsidieregeling voor de Ukraine Partnership Facility (UPF)
Antwoord op van de leden Boswijk en Paternotte over het bericht dat “stokoude, slecht verzekerde tankers met Russische olie meermaals per dag langs de Nederlandse kust varen”

MPs Boswijk and Paternotte asked about reports that old, poorly insured tankers carrying Russian oil pass the Dutch coast hundreds of times, raising pollution risk, possible sabotage use, liability, legal options, sanctions effectiveness and oil refining loopholes. The minister replied that the Netherlands cannot block such vessels in international waters and relies on port state control, IMO and IOPC Fund measures, EU sanctions listings and continued work on sanctions evasion, while giving only general answers on future sanctions proposals.
It is not in the interest of the negotiations or the Dutch negotiating position to go further into detail on concrete proposals.
7 Het is echter niet in het belang van de onderhandelingen en de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie om verder in detail te gaan over concrete voorstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk, Helder en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Honderden agenten met PTSS krijgen geen passende WIA-uitwerking door gebrek aan kennis over ziekte bij UWV’

MPs from CDA, BBB and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers whether UWV medical assessors lack knowledge of PTSD, leaving police officers without proper WIA benefits, and proposed a specialist desk and training. The minister denied a knowledge gap, said PTSD is covered by general medical knowledge and assessor re-registration, and offered no new training or desk beyond existing optional courses.
I do not recognise that picture.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Boswijk over het wegschrijven van verwijzingen naar genderbeleid en SRGR in antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen

MPs Dobbe and Boswijk asked whether the ministry's edits to earlier written answers, which removed or softened references to Dutch gender policy, SRGR and investment in women's rights, changed policy. The minister answers that the edits are textual only, that women's rights, gender equality and SRGR remain part of Dutch foreign policy priorities, and that development policy details will follow later.
The mentioned changes are textual and do not represent a change in policy.
De genoemde wijzigingen zijn tekstueel en houden geen wijziging van beleid in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer, Lahlah, Boswijk, Helder en Michon-Derkzen over de voorgenomen sluiting van het politiebureau in Wolvega

MPs from several parties ask the Minister of Justice and Security why the police plan to close the Wolvega station and replace it with a smaller police post, questioning the decision's basis, its effect on police presence, consultation with local government, and the link to coalition plans for more police presence in neighbourhoods. The Minister answers that station locations are a police responsibility, that the transformation follows a 2015 housing plan aimed at more mobile policing on the street, that no final location has been chosen, and that a new police post is planned by end 2025 with the municipality of Weststellingwerf.
Decisions on which police stations or posts are added, stay open or close are a responsibility of the police.
Keuzes over welke politiebureaus of posten die worden toegevoegd, geopend blijven of sluiten is een verantwoordelijkheid van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bamenga over de zorgwekkende humanitaire situatie in Zuid-Soedan

MPs Boswijk and Bamenga asked about the humanitarian crisis in South Sudan, donor conferences, resettlement of Sudanese refugees and Dutch contributions to peace efforts and budget cuts. The minister answered that Netherlands is a major humanitarian donor, that a separate donor conference is unlikely to yield substantial extra funds, that resettlement resumes under country-based policy, and that budget effects were already reported in the draft budget.
You were informed about the effects of the cuts from the Coalition Agreement in 2025 in the draft budget 2025.
Over de effecten van de bezuinigingen uit het Hoofdlijnenakkoord in 2025 bent u bij de ontwerpbegroting 2025 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk en Ceder over de interne communicatie en adviezen met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Asylum and Migration to send all internal communication and advice on the decision not to transfer Afghan guards to the Netherlands. The ministers respond that they partially meet the request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office.
We partially meet your request by providing the official advice drafted since the new cabinet took office regarding the transfer of Afghan guards.

Wij komen gedeeltelijk tegemoet aan uw verzoek door de ambtelijke adviezen te verstrekken die zijn opgesteld sinds het aantreden van het nieuwe kabinet met betrekking tot de overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Boswijk over de dreigende sluiting van het Walaardt Sacré Kamp in Huis ter Heide

MPs Piri and Boswijk asked whether the Walaardt Sacré Kamp asylum reception site in Huis ter Heide would close, where Afghan refugees and family members were housed, and about alternative housing, medical care and schooling. The minister answered that the site is being returned to Defence from September 2024, that residents were moved to other locations, and that Defence has repeatedly weighed extensions but needs the site for its own growing organisation.
Defence needs the barracks for its own growing organisation.
Defensie heeft de kazerne nodig voor de eigen groeiende organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht “Rusland zet onafhankelijke krant The Moscow Times op zwarte lijst”

MPs from several parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Asylum and Migration about Russia placing the independent Moscow Times on a blacklist and the risks to Russian journalists working for it. The minister confirmed awareness of the report and said that emergency visas are possible in exceptional cases within existing policy frameworks, reaffirming support for press freedom.
This entails that within existing policy frameworks, and carefully tested against the Visa Code, visas can in exceptional cases be issued where there are compelling or humanitarian reasons.

Daar hoort bij dat binnen de bestaande beleidskaders, en daarbij zorgvuldig getoetst aan de Visumcode, het in uitzonderlijke gevallen mogelijk is visa te verstrekken als daar zwaarwegende of humanitaire redenen voor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Kahraman, Paternotte, Dobbe, Van Campen en Ceder over het vredesproces tussen Armenië en Azerbeidzjan

MPs asked the government about the Armenia-Azerbaijan peace process, including the trilateral meeting in Washington, Azerbaijan's demand to amend Armenia's constitution, and what the Netherlands could do to speed up a deal. The minister said the government urges both sides toward a durable agreement based on mutual recognition of territorial integrity, declined to comment publicly on negotiating positions, and noted EUMA's de-escalating role and a mandate running to February 2025.
However, it is not in the interest of the negotiating parties to publicly address their negotiating positions in this answer.
Het is echter niet in het belang van de onderhandelende partijen om in deze beantwoording publiekelijk in te gaan op de onderhandelingsposities van de partijen bij de vredesbesprekingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk, Paternotte en Rooderkerk over de stijgende invoer van Russisch gas

MPs asked whether EU imports of Russian gas are rising, whether this creates dependence and vulnerability, whether cheap Russian gas undermines alternatives, and what measures the EU could take. The minister acknowledged a slight rise in early 2024 but said Russian shares have fallen sharply since 2021, outlined EU phase-out steps and Dutch proposals for a roadmap, while declining to provide a list of affected projects because the government lacks access to market parties' data.
Such an overview cannot be provided, because the Dutch government has no insight into the projects of market parties and their economic feasibility.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te geven, omdat de Nederlandse overheid geen inzage heeft in de projecten van marktpartijen en de economische haalbaarheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het onderzoek in hoeverre Chinese auto’s een veiligheidsrisico opleveren voor de nationale veiligheid

Boswijk (CDA) asked about the status of the motion requiring a national security analysis of Chinese electric vehicles, whether the Netherlands was present at a US meeting on Chinese software in cars, and whether the Netherlands and EU should adopt US restrictions. The government said the risk analysis has started with interdepartmental working groups and results are expected by year end, declined to discuss the confidential meeting, said US measures are not yet known and the Netherlands will make its own assessment, preferring EU-level action.
By the end of the year, the House will be informed about the first results of these working groups.
Voor het einde van het jaar zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de eerste resultaten van deze werkgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Als de politie alle Amsterdamse taxi’s aan de kant zet, dan heb je de grootste drugsvangst ooit’

MPs Krul and Boswijk asked the ministers about a report that police could seize large drug shipments if they stopped Amsterdam taxis, and about criminality in the taxi sector, vetting, enforcement and possible law changes. The minister answered that police do monitor taxi-linked crime through checks and investigations, that vetting and licensing rules apply, and that the sector's criminality will be addressed through partner-based measures and a review of the Wp2000 without committing to a specific legal change.
The Wp2000 is intended to safeguard the quality of taxi transport in the Netherlands.
De Wp2000 is bedoeld om de kwaliteit van het taxivervoer in Nederland te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bikker en Boswijk over gokverslavingen door illegale gokreclames en de negatieve rol die illegale gokbedrijven hierin spelen

MPs Van Nispen, Bikker and Boswijk asked about illegal targeting of online gambling ads at young people, Holland Casino's role, rising gambling addiction among youth and related suicide and poverty risks. The Secretary of State answered that the ad ban is strict and the Kansspelautoriteit enforces it, that Holland Casino made a human error and has taken structural measures, and that new play-limit rules take effect on 1 October 2024 while further research is planned.
The Gambling Authority (Ksa) supervises compliance with this and enforces where necessary.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) ziet toe op de naleving hiervan en handhaaft waar nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘dat de Nederlandse Kustwacht de sancties tegen Rusland niet uitvoert’

An MP asked whether the Dutch Coast Guard has for over a year refused to enforce new EU sanctions against Russia, whether this undermines the sanctions packages, and what capacity and enforcement steps are planned. The minister denies any refusal, explains that capacity limits led to prioritising packages 1 to 10 and interim arrangements for package 11, and outlines reorganisation, extra analysts and EU-level tools.
There is no question of the Coast Guard refusing.
Er is geen sprake van weigering door de Kustwacht.
Antwoord op het lid Boswijk over de Ukraine Recovery Conference en de Oekraïense State Emergency Services

Boswijk (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about the Netherlands joining a gender-responsive recovery alliance for Ukraine, and about support for Ukrainian State Emergency Services and their mostly female first responders. Minister Klever confirmed Dutch membership, described existing gender-focused funding, said non-military aid focuses on humanitarian relief and the economy, and committed EUR 10 million via WHO for mental health support that also benefits SESU work.
The Netherlands funds humanitarian organisations worldwide and also provides targeted support for humanitarian action specifically in Ukraine.
Nederland financiert humanitaire organisaties wereldwijd en geeft daarnaast gerichte steun voor humanitaire actie specifiek in Oekraïne
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de omstreden verkiezingsuitslag in Venezuela

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister which countries recognise opposition candidate González as winner of the disputed Venezuelan election, whether US claims of 'irrefutable evidence' are accepted, why the Netherlands and EU have not explicitly recognised the opposition win, and what sanctions or support are planned. Minister Veldkamp answered that many states use careful wording, that the Netherlands and EU avoid explicit recognition to support a negotiation process, and that new EU sanctions are not currently on the table.
At this moment, the introduction of additional European restrictive measures is not on the agenda.
Op dit moment is het instellen van aanvullende Europese restrictieve maatregelen niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Werf en Paternotte over het bericht dat producten van in Nederland gevestigde fabrikanten nog steeds worden aangetroffen in Russische wapens

MPs Boswijk, Van der Werf and Paternotte asked the government about reports that microchips from Dutch manufacturers such as NXP and Nexperia still appear in Russian weapons, and how this can happen despite sanctions. The minister confirms the scale of the problem, explains that diversion occurs through intermediaries in third countries, and outlines EU sanctions measures and Dutch enforcement efforts while withholding recent trade data for sensitivity reasons.
