Because of the sensitivity, the cabinet makes no public statements about its current information position on Russian imports of sanctioned goods.
Omwille van de gevoeligheid doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de huidige informatiepositie rondom Russische import van gesanctioneerde goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over de olieramp door een Houthi-aanval op olietanker Chios Lion

MPs Paternotte and Boswijk asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the potential environmental damage from a Houthi attack on the tanker Chios Lion, its effect on Operations Prosperity Guardian and Aspides, and whether the EU or Netherlands should send a cleanup vessel. The minister replied that the risk of damage was limited, no military obstruction exists, Aspides has no mandate for oil cleanup, and no EU contribution appears necessary.
Cleaning up an oil spill does not fall within the mandate of EU operation Aspides.
Het opruimen van een olievlek behoort niet tot het mandaat van EU-operatie Aspides.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht ‘Nederland stuurt toch minister naar Hongarije’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA, PvdD and Volt asked whether the government would send ministers to informal EU Council meetings in Hungary after PM Orbán's Moscow visit, and how this relates to EU sanctions and Hungary's presidency. Minister Veldkamp answered that the government condemned Orbán's visit, that Nederland does not undermine sanctions, and that after the Hoge Vertegenwoordiger moved the informal meetings to Brussels no ministerial delegation will go to Budapest.
The Netherlands is not undermining sanctions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de Nederlandse diplomatieke betrekkingen met Afghanistan

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would reopen an embassy in Afghanistan, whether it had explored joint presence with Germany, how diplomats are protected, and which countries are present and what the Doha process achieved. The minister answered that reopening is not currently opportune given security and political considerations, that the Taliban's inclusion must not imply recognition, and that the Netherlands was not invited to the third Doha conference and is disappointed civil society was excluded.
At this moment the cabinet does not consider it opportune to open a diplomatic representation on the ground.
Op dit moment acht het kabinet het niet opportuun om een diplomatieke vertegenwoordiging ter plekke te openen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Universiteit: anderhalf miljoen euro schade na studentenprotesten’

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Justice and Security Minister about damage and arrests following student protests at universities, and how damage can be recovered from individual rioters. The minister says damage at the University of Amsterdam is estimated at 1.5 million euros, arrests are only available for Amsterdam (about 200 people), snelrecht is used where possible, and recovery is possible via insurers, civil or criminal (victim joinder) routes, with a review of a national compensation fund ongoing.
It is not possible to provide reliable national figures on the number of people arrested or prosecuted following the riots at universities.
Het is niet mogelijk om betrouwbare landelijke cijfers te geven van het aantal aangehouden of vervolgde personen naar aanleiding van de rellen bij de universiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer, Lahlah, Boswijk en Helder over de sluiting van het politiebureau in Wolvega

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA and BBB asked the Minister of Justice about the planned closure of the Wolvega police station, its consistency with the coalition's commitment to visible policing, the reasons for closure, and talks with the municipality. The Minister answered that a smaller police post will replace it, the police decide closures in consultation with local authorities, and talks with the municipality are ongoing.
Decisions on which police stations or posts are added, remain open or close are a responsibility of the police.
Keuzes over welke politiebureaus of posten die worden toegevoegd, geopend blijven of sluiten is een verantwoordelijkheid van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht 'U.S. expected to sanction IDF unit for human rights violations in West Bank'

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister how she assesses the IDF Netzah Yehuda battalion, which the US planned to sanction over human rights abuses in the West Bank, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit. The minister called the reports very concerning, said Israel must prevent settler violence, and declined to follow the US measure, which she described as a Leahy Law restriction rather than a sanction, while pointing to EU settler sanctions the Netherlands supports.

Because the Netherlands only cooperates with Israel within the internationally recognised 1967 borders, the Netherlands has no relationship with the Netzah Yehuda battalion and there is no sanction in the sense of entry bans or asset freezes, the Netherlands does not follow the American example.

Omdat Nederland alleen met Israël binnen de internationaal erkende grenzen van 1967 samenwerkt, Nederland geen relatie met het Netzah Yehudabataljon heeft en er geen sprake is van een sanctie in de zin van inreisverboden of tegoedbevriezingen, volgt Nederland het Amerikaanse voorbeeld niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over luchtverdediging voor Oekraïne

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers about air defence for Ukraine, including a request to deliver more systems, the implementation of a bilateral security agreement, and whether the Netherlands would take the lead again and supply further Patriot systems. The government answered that it is coordinating a Patriot coalition, provides three launchers and a radar, has funded air defence initiatives, and is still examining the consequences of NATO capability targets for its own readiness and training before deciding on further support.
The Netherlands itself makes three launchers and a radar available; the other essential core components are supplied by an ally.
Nederland stelt zelf drie lanceerinstallaties en een radar beschikbaar, de overige benodigde kerncomponenten worden door een bondgenoot geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de mogelijkheden voor aanvullende leveringen van luchtafweersystemen aan Oekraïne

Boswijk (CDA) asks whether the government will seize the room NATO's Secretary General opened to dip below stockpile floors and deliver more Patriot systems to Ukraine, and whether it will push for more joint NATO exercises. Minister Ollongren answers that the Netherlands has led a coalition assembling a full Patriot system, contributing three launchers and a radar, backs expanding stockpiles and production, and that existing joint exercises already occur without freeing capabilities.
The Netherlands has taken the lead in bringing together an international coalition for the supply of additional Patriot capacity to Ukraine.
Nederland heeft het voortouw genomen om een internationale coalitie bijeen te brengen voor de levering van aanvullende Patriot capaciteit aan Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘luchtalarm verdwijnt eind volgend jaar en wordt vervangen door NL-Alert’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the air-raid siren system (WAS) is being replaced by NL-Alert, citing risks to coverage, cyber vulnerability and the warnings of regional safety boards. The minister answered that the WAS is end-of-life and costly, that NL-Alert has far wider reach, and that two studies are underway, with local tailoring offered for high-risk locations.
Partly in response to the Eerdmans motion, two studies have been commissioned.
Mede naar aanleiding van de motie Eerdmans zijn er twee onderzoeken uitgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Veldkamp en Paternotte over mogelijkheden om bevroren Russische tegoeden te gebruiken voor hulp aan Oekraïne

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Estonia's law enabling use of frozen Russian assets for Ukraine could serve as a basis in the Netherlands and the EU, and about the state of the Brekelmans motion and a possible 'Navalny Act'. The minister answered that Dutch sanctions law does not allow confiscation of private assets outside criminal proceedings, that no international consensus exists on using the underlying assets, and that the government remains ambitious in exploring options.
Without this criminal-law framework, confiscation on the basis of sanctions raises serious questions about safeguarding individual rights such as property rights.
Zonder dit strafrechtelijk kader roept het overgaan tot confiscatie op basis van sancties serieuze vragen op omtrent de waarborg van individuele rechten zoals het eigendomsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Veldkamp, Paternotte en Teunissen over de Tent of Nations in de buurt van Bethlehem

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the Tent of Nations peace farm near Bethlehem, including land registration delays, a road built on the family's land, restricted access, and whether the government will press Israeli authorities. The minister answered that the access restrictions and road works are illegal under international law and should stop, that the Dutch mission raises the matter regularly and will keep pressing, and that the case is typical of pressures on Palestinian farmers in Area C.
The Netherlands will continue to press on this.
Nederland zal hier op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het artikel ‘Russia plotting sabotage across Europe, intelligence agencies warn’

Two CDA MPs asked the government about warnings from European intelligence services of a growing Russian threat of violent sabotage, including to North Sea infrastructure, and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The government answered that it shares the concern, points to the North Sea infrastructure protection action plan and the national response framework, and says EU cooperation is being strengthened, while declining to detail the services' current knowledge of targets.
Given the statutory duty of secrecy, the working methods and current knowledge level of the services are not discussed publicly.
Gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding wordt er in het openbaar niet ingegaan op de werkwijze dan wel het actuele kennisniveau van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bamenga over de humanitaire crisis in Oost-Congo

Two MPs (Boswijk, CDA, and Bamenga, D66) asked the minister about the humanitarian crisis in eastern DRC, including the Rwandan role, aid, protection in displacement camps, diplomacy, and the EU Great Lakes envoy. The minister answered that the situation is very serious, outlined Dutch humanitarian funding, diplomatic efforts with Rwanda, DRC and the AU, and said the EU envoy appointment is near completion so no agenda item is needed at the Foreign Affairs Council.
In view of these developments, I do not consider it necessary for the Netherlands to put this on the agenda of the next Foreign Affairs Council.
Gezien de voorgenoemde ontwikkelingen acht ik het niet nodig dat Nederland dit tijdens de eerstvolgende Raad Buitenlandse Zaken agendeert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de prognose dat dit jaar een kwart van alle in Europa verkochte elektrische auto’s uit China afkomstig zullen zijn

An MP asks whether the government shares concerns about dependence on China for EVs, Chinese subsidies and market distortion, possible protective measures, Chinese access to driver data, and progress on China market access. The ministers state they share the concerns on strategic dependencies and support the EU anti-subsidy investigation, which may lead to provisional measures by 4 July 2024, but largely describe existing EU frameworks and general trade dialogue without committing to new national measures.
Het onderzoek is nog in volle gang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over het bericht 'Zijn rechtszaken over misbruik straks niet meer openbaar?'

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked whether victims of sexual offences, including minors, can have criminal hearings held behind closed doors, and whether the rules should be extended in light of a Belgian proposal. The minister confirmed judges may order closed-door hearings on request, that no figures exist on how often this is granted, and that existing rules suffice, so no change is planned.
Neither the Public Prosecution Service nor the judiciary has figures available on the number of granted requests.
Zowel bij het Openbaar Ministerie als bij de rechterlijke macht zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal toegewezen verzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht inzake toegenomen export van landbouwmachines en diervaccins naar Rusland

MP Boswijk asked whether rising Dutch exports of agricultural machinery and animal vaccines to Russia strengthen Russian food self-sufficiency and whether such goods could be sanctioned. The minister confirmed the export increase, called the self-sufficiency link plausible but uncertain, rejected food as a weapon, and said it weighs food-security effects of sanctions while refusing to disclose future sanctions options.
The cabinet does not provide information on possible future sanctions measures, as this would undermine the effectiveness of the sanctions instrument.
Het kabinet verstrekt geen informatie over mogelijke toekomstige sanctiemaatregelen, daar het de effectiviteit van het sanctie-instrument ondermijnt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de vervolging van enkele hulpverleners in Letland

MP Boswijk asked the Foreign Minister whether Latvian law blurs the line between aid workers and smugglers, exposing humanitarian helpers to prosecution, and what the status and handling of the Council of Europe Human Rights Commissioner's criticism is, plus support for two Dutch nationals prosecuted in Latvia. The minister answered that Latvian law has no special status for helpers, that the Dutch Criminal Code likewise does not separate them but humanitarian necessity can exclude punishment case by case, that the Commissioner's criticism was rejected by Latvia and its parliament adopted the amendments, and that consular assistance is being provided while the Netherlands does not interfere in foreign criminal proceedings.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs provides the two Dutch nationals with consular assistance.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken verleent de twee Nederlanders consulaire bijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bamenga over EU and Rwanda sign a Memorandum of Understanding on Sustainable Raw Materials Value Chains

MPs Boswijk and Bamenga asked the Minister about the EU-Rwanda Memorandum of Understanding on sustainable raw materials, including whether the Commission consulted member states, the scale of Rwanda's resources, and the timing given DRC-Rwanda tensions. The minister answered substantively on the MoU's content and rationale, acknowledged the DRC tensions, and promised a separate letter to the House on the situation in eastern Congo.
I recently committed to sending the House a letter on this matter.
Ik heb recent toegezegd uw Kamer daarover een Kamerbrief te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Tuinman, Boswijk, Dobbe, Van Oostenbruggen, Nordkamp en Dassen over vrouwen in de krijgsmacht

Seven MPs asked the state secretary about women's advancement, part-time service, childcare, uniforms, sexual misconduct, the frontline role of women and veterans' support in the armed forces. The answers describe incremental measures such as a new part-time leave variant, modular training, a new combat uniform system and a 2023 harassment report count, and state that operational experience is not a formal condition for promotion.
Participation in deployments is not a condition for promotion in rank.
Deelname aan uitzendingen is niet voorwaardelijk om door te groeien in rang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tuinman en Boswijk over het bericht 'Kajsa Ollongren: mooi als VDL Nedcar militaire voertuigen gaat produceren'

MPs Tuinman and Boswijk asked the Defence Minister about reports on converting the VDL Nedcar plant in Born to produce military vehicles, munitions and drones, and about related defence industry, NATO and budget questions. The minister answered that talks with VDL are ongoing but the plant is not currently suited to such production, that licence production and collaboration with industry are being explored, and that choices on force composition will be made by the next cabinet.
The cabinet will inform the House further about progress when that is possible.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer nader informeren over de voortgang wanneer dat mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Mutluer over de het bericht ‘dat bij de brandweer PTSS niet wordt herkend als beroepsziekte, in tegenstelling tot bij defensie en politie’

MPs Boswijk and Mutluer asked whether PTSS is recognised as an occupational disease for firefighters, unlike for defence and police, and about support, data and insurance. The minister answered that PTSS is not nationally recognised for firefighters because fire service employers are the 25 safety regions, that a national model scheme is being prepared, and that she will keep discussing the matter with the regions.
There is currently no good view of the number of firefighters with PTSS in the Netherlands.
Er is op dit moment geen goed zicht op het aantal brandweermensen met PTSS in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het onderzoek van de Groene Amsterdammer naar de illegale export van Nederlandse microchips naar Iran

An MP asked the government about a Groene Amsterdammer investigation into illegal export of Dutch microchips to Iran, including customs controls on Iranian trucks and parcels, company identity checks, export figures, and penalties. The minister replied that customs checks are risk-based, sanctions evasion is already punishable, the government will not raise maximum penalties now, and sanctions law modernisation will add administrative fines.
Sanctions evasion is unfortunately a well-known problem.
Sanctieomzeiling is helaas een bekend probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht dat er een gebrek is aan beschikbare afspraken voor het vernieuwen van een Nederlands paspoort in het buitenland

Boswijk (CDA) asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Dutch citizens abroad face months-long waits or no available slots to renew passports, and what the government will do. The minister acknowledged limited waiting times at some locations due to a passport peak, said appointments are generally available within weeks, and listed capacity increases and public information campaigns, without committing to new structural measures.
I do not recognise the picture that it would be impossible for Dutch nationals abroad to apply for a new passport.
Het beeld dat wordt geschetst dat het onmogelijk zou zijn voor Nederlanders in het buitenland om een nieuw paspoort aan te vragen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de kosten van afschalen van de steun aan Oekraïne

An MP asked the ministers whether the financial costs of withdrawing support from Ukraine, and the costs of a Russian victory, have been mapped, and whether the cabinet will communicate more actively about these risks. The ministers answered that support continues, that consequences are broader than financial, that scenario analyses are discussed with research institutes without being shared publicly, and that the cabinet already communicates about these risks.
For security reasons, the cabinet cannot publicly go into the details of these scenarios.
Het kabinet kan omwille van de veiligheid niet publiekelijk ingaan op details van deze scenario's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Boswijk, Kahraman en Ceder over het Open Doors rapport 2024 en het rapport 'Freedom of Thought' van het humanistisch verbond

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the Open Doors 2024 and Humanist Association 'Freedom of Thought' reports on religious persecution, including Christian persecution in Nigeria, the Sahel, China and Iraq, and whether policy or diplomacy should be tightened. The minister answered that the government shares the concerns, cites existing diplomatic, multilateral and development programmes, and largely points to existing policy without committing to new measures.

The cabinet recognises trends mentioned in the Open Doors report, including an increase in religiously motivated violence in the Sahel and repression of people because of their religion or belief in countries such as Nicaragua, China and India.

Het kabinet herkent trends zoals genoemd in het Open Doors rapport, waaronder toename van religieus gemotiveerd geweld in de Sahelregio en onderdrukking van mensen vanwege hun religie of levensovertuiging in onder andere Nicaragua, China en India.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Tuinman en Diederik van Dijk over de mogelijke oprichting van een eigen tankbataljon

MPs Boswijk, Tuinman and Diederik van Dijk asked the government about reviving a national tank battalion, its cost, its links with Germany and the timing of a Leopard 2A8 procurement decision. The government says a tank battalion is not funded and that the decision on it is left to the next cabinet, while giving substantive answers on cost structure, the German cooperation and technology, and withholding only the commercially confidential cost breakdown, which it supplies in a confidential annex.
This cost specification contains commercially confidential elements.
Deze kostenspecificatie bevat commercieel vertrouwelijke elementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Tuinman en Erkens over het artikel ‘NATO’s Vilnius summit: the consequences for the Allies’

MPs Boswijk, Tuinman and Erkens asked the Dutch government about NATO's New Force Model, its personnel implications for small allies and the Netherlands, and related lessons learned. The Minister answered that the personnel needs will only be clear once NATO details the force model, that Dutch constitutional tasks depend on improved personnel levels, and that the Netherlands contributes to lessons-learned work.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van den Brink over het bericht dat Europese voetbalclubs sinds het uitbreken van de oorlog in Oekraïne zo’n 40 miljoen euro aan transfer– en huursommen aan hun Russische tegenha

MPs Boswijk and Van den Brink asked whether European football clubs should be barred from paying transfer and loan fees to Russian clubs since the war in Ukraine, and what the government is doing about it. The minister replied that such transactions are not banned under current sanctions, clubs must screen ownership, and the government will not disclose future sanction plans.
The cabinet does not provide information on possible future sanction measures, as this would undermine the effectiveness of the sanctions instrument.
Het kabinet verstrekt geen informatie over mogelijke toekomstige sanctiemaatregelen, daar het de effectiviteit van het sanctie-instrument ondermijnt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Boswijk en Ceder over het rapport Vrijheid van Godsdienst Wereldwijd 2023 van Kerk in Nood

MPs Van der Staaij, Boswijk and Ceder asked the Foreign Minister about Kerk in Nood's 2023 religious freedom report, covering persecution of religious minorities, impunity, Nigeria, ICC follow-up, Sahel spread, India, Nicaragua, child marriage and Western cancel culture. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described diplomatic and programmatic responses, and noted that formal ICC investigation depends on the prosecutor's judgment, while declining to interfere with his prosecutorial policy.
The cabinet respects the independence of the Court and therefore refrains from interfering in the prosecution policy of the Court's prosecutor.
Zoals bekend, respecteert het kabinet de onafhankelijkheid van het Strafhof en om die reden onthoudt het kabinet zich van inmenging in het vervolgingsbeleid van de aanklager van het Strafhof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Boswijk over de brief van Eurocommissaris Thierry Breton aan Elon Musk over de desinformatie op X (voormalig Twitter)

MPs Krul and Boswijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about EU Commissioner Breton's letter to Elon Musk on disinformation and illegal content on X after the Hamas attacks, and what the government would do. The government answered that DSA enforcement over X rests with the European Commission, that it supports the Commission, and that X's content policy and transparency are unclear, with X having withdrawn from the EU disinformation Code of Practice.
Primary responsibility for DSA supervision of X lies with the European Commission.
Het primaat van het DSA-toezicht op X ligt bij de Europese Commissie.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de situatie in de zuidelijke Kaukasus

An MP from the CDA asks the Foreign Minister about ethnic cleansing in Nagorno-Karabakh, EU engagement with Azerbaijan, possible Azerbaijani escalation toward Nakhchivan, EU gas dependence, sanctions and humanitarian aid. The minister answers that the Armenian population fled out of insecurity, that whether this is ethnic cleansing is legally complex and will be addressed in a separate letter, and that the EU is exploring non-lethal support, monitoring mission strengthening and economic aid while no concrete sanctions against Azerbaijan are currently planned.
The cabinet will address this question in a separate letter, partly in the context of the adopted motion by MP Ceder.
Het kabinet zal in een separate brief op deze vraag ingaan, mede in het kader van de aangenomen motie van het Lid Ceder
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Hammelburg en Van der Lee  over het bericht dat het moederbedrijf van Douwe Egberts en Pickwick, JDE Peet's, weigert om zich terug te trekken uit Rusland

MPs Boswijk, Hammelburg and Van der Lee asked whether JDE Peet's, parent of Douwe Egberts and Pickwick, should exit Russia, whether government contracts with such firms are acceptable, and whether the Russia sanctions package should ban non-essential goods. The minister answered that firms may trade in Russia if they comply with EU sanctions, that existing government contracts will not be ended while compliance holds, that a list of firms with government contracts will be sent confidentially, and that the luxury goods list may be broadened without disclosing future measures.
This overview will be sent to the House for confidential inspection.
Dit overzicht wordt ter vertrouwelijke inzage aan de Kamer nagezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk en het lid Vedder over het bericht ‘Voor boer Piet dreigt halvering van de veestapel, want er stroomt een beek door zijn weilanden’

MPs Boswijk and Vedder asked about wide buffer strips along streams (100-250 m) under the 7th Nitrates Action Programme, their evidence base, effects on farmland, compensation costs, and unequal treatment of agriculture versus recreation under nature and nitrogen rules. The minister answered that broad stream-valley restoration is a regional, model-based measure within provincial programmes, funded from a 811 million euro transition fund, and that nature permitting applies equally across sectors.
Question 10: Is it true that, unlike the agricultural sector, the recreation sector in the Netherlands experiences little or no hindrance from nature and nitrogen policy?
Vraag 10 Klopt het dat in tegenstelling tot de agrarische sector de recreatiesector in Nederland geen of nauwelijks hinder ondervindt van het natuur- en stikstofbeleid?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Anje dreigt haar boerderij kwijt te raken’

MPs Bisschop and Boswijk asked the minister about reports that farmers feel pushed out of business under the peak-load nitrogen scheme, including the independence of case supervisors, data use, notarial safeguards, PAS cases, municipal zoning delays, and interim operators. The minister answered that participation is voluntary, that schemes will be published by end 2023, and that data sharing is limited to consented parties, but gave only partial or procedural answers on several points, such as the PAS case still being verified and no list of interim operators.
I have asked the RIVM to map the size of the interim operator group.
Ik heb het RIVM verzocht de omvang van de interimmers in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over knelpunten voor (mono)mestvergisting

CDA MPs asked the ministers for an update on steps to expand green gas from manure digestion, including zoning, permitting, manure transport rules and additive innovations. The government answered that it is working with local authorities on faster permitting and a CO2-based blending obligation, but declined to set a sub-target for manure digestion and deferred most issues to local authorities and further research.
The cabinet is not responsible for the requirements in zoning plans; that is up to the local competent authorities.
Het kabinet gaat niet over de eisen in bestemmingsplannen, dat is aan de lokale bevoegd gezagen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk, Boswijk, Ceder, Belhaj, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Sylvana Simons, Dassen en Christine Teunissen over de evacuatie van lokale oud-medewerkers van de Nederlands

MPs from many parties asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the evacuation and resettlement of local former Afghan Security Guards and other local staff, including whether guards were excluded and why EUPOL staff were refused. The government answered that individual requests are assessed under the 2014 interpreter arrangement and special scheme, that criteria were not tightened, and that the resettlement project was folded into the ministries' standing organisations while the remaining group of about 100 people is still being pursued.
Defence aims to take current insights into account in implementing policy and will therefore examine these signals further.
Defensie streeft ernaar actuele inzichten te betrekken bij de uitvoering van beleid en zal deze signalen derhalve nader onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Boswijk en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Ruim 200 boeren met bos krijgen onverwachts megaclaims van fiscus’

MPs from CDA and BBB asked whether the Ministry of Agriculture gave farmers who converted land to fast-growing forest under the set-aside scheme a promise that the land would remain agricultural, and why the Tax Authority now taxes capital gains on that land. The minister answers that the ministry only commented on the planning designation, which stayed agricultural, while the tax authority applies the agricultural exemption only to periods when land was used within a farm business, so the case is pending before the Supreme Court and no concrete remedy is offered.
Because the case is still before the courts, we follow the line of recent court rulings in this answer and await the Supreme Court's judgment.
Omdat de zaak nog onder de rechter is volgen we de lijn van de recente rechterlijke uitspraken in deze beantwoording en wachten we het oordeel van de Hoge Raad af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Vedder over ‘Geen hulp van het Rijk voor ruim 250 boeren zonder stikstofvergunning'

MPs Boswijk and Vedder (CDA) asked the minister why 259 PAS-notifying farms cannot be legalised by the national government, why only part of the 2,488 applications have been assessed, what the legalisation criteria are, and how the government will restore trust after earlier promises. The minister replied that the competent authorities found 259 notifications failing the criteria, that these farms may still obtain permits by buying nitrogen space or reducing emissions, that the remaining dossiers should be assessed by year-end, and that the government considers it is keeping its commitments.
The provinces are asked to examine which solution routes exist for the 259 companies that cannot obtain a solution through the legalisation programme.
Aan de provincies wordt gevraagd om te bezien welke oplossingsrichtingen er zijn voor de 259 bedrijven die via het legalisatieprogramma niet een oplossing kunnen krijgen.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Krul en Boswijk over de beveiliging van luchthaven Schiphol

Three CDA MPs asked ministers how Schiphol's access controls fail when former staff keep passes, uniforms and radios, and who is responsible for fixing this. The government calls the situation unacceptable, says Royal Schiphol Group and employers hold responsibility, and lists audits, sanctions and an automatic alarm as steps taken.
Royal Schiphol Group further intensifies supervision of correct implementation by carrying out random audits of employers.
Royal Schiphol Group intensiveert verder het toezicht op de correcte uitvoering door steekproefsgewijs audits uit te voeren op werkgevers
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Hans en Amarjit zouden 2,5 ton subsidie krijgen, tot ze één foutje maken: provincie is onverbiddelijk’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether a subsidy refusal for an innovative farm project that started a few days before the application, self-reported by the applicants, is proportionate, and why no hardship clause was used as in a Zuid-Holland case. The minister answers that the early start rule is binding under EU and provincial rules, that the province and RVO explored alternatives without success, that the case is pending objection, and that no change to rules is planned beyond general encouragement of innovation.
The case is currently in the objection phase. I do not wish to anticipate its outcome.
Momenteel bevindt de casus zich in de fase van bezwaar. Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomst daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Het geheim van Brabant: hoe criminelen azen op boerenstallen’

The CDA MPs Kuik and Boswijk asked whether the voluntary livestock buy-out scheme accounts for the risk that criminals use vacated farm buildings for drug production and whether farmers can be protected and helped. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that demolition obligations and supervision by municipalities limit this risk, that farmers can report suspected criminal use to the police, and that a national resilience approach and a possible 'flying brigade' for drug waste are being explored, with updates promised later this autumn.
Supervision of timely demolition of the production capacity lies with the municipalities, which are informed about who has applied for a subsidy.
Toezicht op tijdige sloop van de productiecapaciteit ligt bij gemeenten, die geïnformeerd worden over wie een subsidie heeft aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over de wervingscampagne van Defensie

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked the Defence Minister about a recruitment campaign for Ukrainian- and Russian-speaking staff and about security clearance (VGB) policy for personnel with Russian ties. The minister confirmed the operational need for language skills, said there is no policy excluding people with Russian ties, and explained the general criteria and reporting duties for security clearances.
No, Defence does not pursue such a policy.
Nee, Defensie voert een dergelijk beleid niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over methaanemissies in Turkmenistan

CDA MPs asked the government about very high methane emissions from Turkmenistan's largest oil and gas fields and how the Netherlands and EU could press for reductions ahead of COP28. The minister said the emissions figure uses a GWP-20 metric (about 128 Mt CO2-eq on GWP-100, below Dutch national emissions), and outlined EU and Dutch dialogue, technical assistance and the Global Methane Pledge as the response.

The Netherlands will also raise this methane issue in its own bilateral contacts with the Turkmen authorities and point out that several Dutch companies have expertise in detecting and preventing methane leaks.

Nederland zal deze methaan-problematiek ook opbrengen in de eigen bilaterale contacten met de Turkmeense autoriteiten en daarbij aangeven dat bij verschillende Nederlandse bedrijven expertise is voor het detecteren en tegengaan van methaanlekkages.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Weer een tegenvaller bij Gecombineerde opgave’

MPs Boswijk and Van Campen asked the Minister of Agriculture about a system error in the Gecombineerde opgave that forced farmers to re-confirm their parcels, and about compensation, deadlines and support. The Minister acknowledged the error and its burden on farmers, but ruled out compensation or a general deadline extension, offering only two extra weeks to add eco-activities and extended helpdesk hours.

I have decided that farmers who indicated in the Gecombineerde opgave that they participate in the eco-scheme have until 30 June, after the closing of the Gecombineerde opgave, to make adjustments and add eco-activities.

Ik heb besloten dat boeren die in de Gecombineerde opgave hebben aangegeven dat ze aan de eco-regeling deelnemen, na de sluiting van de Gecombineerde opgave tot 30 juni hebben om aanpassingen te doen en eco-activiteiten toe te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Boswijk en Krul over het bericht 'Nieuw probleem bij zoeken opvangplekken: ‘Dassen blokkeren opvang 800 asielzoekers’'

CDA MPs asked whether the government will act urgently to grant general exemptions under the Nature Protection Act so badgers blocking reception locations for 800 asylum seekers can be removed. The minister answered that exemptions are case-specific, the province is the competent authority, a general exemption is being explored with care, and ProRail has a code since January 2023.
As indicated, the province is the competent authority under the Nature Protection Act and it is up to the province to make that assessment.
Zoals aangegeven is de provincie bevoegd gezag op grond van de Wnb en is het het aan de provincie om die afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de fiscale maatregelen voor de glastuinbouw

CDA MPs asked the government about the impact of planned energy tax changes on greenhouse growers, the feasibility of transition timelines, the treatment of combined heat and power plants, and fairness between small and large growers. The government acknowledges the strong impact, points to a combined package of measures and a possible phase-in path decided in August 2023, and says it will consider a revised proposal pending EU state aid approval.
The cabinet will decide in August 2023, based on an impact analysis yet to be published, whether to possibly adopt a phase-in path with substantial steps from 2025.
Het kabinet besluit in augustus 2023 op basis van een nog te verschijnen impactanalyse eventueel tot een ingroeipad met substantiële stappen vanaf 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Boswijk en Van Campen over het ontbreken van consumptieaardappelen op de lijst met winterteelten

MPs Bisschop, Boswijk and Van Campen asked why late-harvested consumption potatoes were left off the winter-crop list, which exempts fields from the cover-crop rule and the nitrogen-norm cut, and whether exceptions could be granted based on residue measurements or sustainability scores. The minister answers that potatoes fail all three winter-crop criteria, that the 1 October cover-crop deadline and the reduced nitrogen norm are required under the 7th Nitrates Directive action programme, and that no exceptions are possible for now.
There is therefore no room for alternatives that are less effective at improving water quality.
Er is dan ook geen ruimte voor alternatieven die minder effectief zijn voor het verbeteren van de waterkwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Boswijk en Grinwis over het bericht in Trouw met als titel: “onenigheid Rijk en provincie fnuikt redding van de grutto”

MPs Bromet, Boswijk and Grinwis asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about a Trouw report that Rijk-provincie disagreement stalls grutto protection and that funds remain unspent. The minister disputes that little money has been paid out (EUR 2.5 million of EUR 3 million allocated), says long-term contracts are legally possible and that provinces are responsible for the decision on long-term commitments, while promising shared intent to resolve the matter by next summer.
It is a competence of the provinces themselves whether or not to conclude long-term contracts at their own risk, without a financial guarantee for the period after 2027–2028.
Het is een bevoegdheid van de provincies zelf om al dan niet op eigen risico langjarige contracten af te sluiten zonder de financiële garantie voor de periode na 2027–2028.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'NEPG maakt zich zorgen over pootgoedproductie’

An MP asked the agriculture minister whether the NEPG's concern about falling Dutch seed potato production, linked to growers switching to processing potatoes and to stricter pesticide rules, is justified and whether production should be stimulated. The minister replied that no major shift is visible, the seed potato area is expected to fall only 3-5%, and no government stimulus is needed since market prices will drive planting decisions.
However, I have no signals that this year there is a major shift in the Netherlands from growing seed potatoes to growing potatoes for the processing industry.
Ik heb echter geen signalen dat er dit jaar in Nederland een grote verschuiving plaatst vindt van de teelt van pootaardappelen naar de teelt van aardappelen voor de verwerkende industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Trek stikstofdossier los door specifieke Nederlandse regels terug te draaien' van VNO-NCW

MPs Boswijk and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the ministers about VNO-NCW's proposals to loosen nitrogen permitting rules (AERIUS link, a 0.5 mol/ha/yr threshold, a national nitrogen bank, ending the intern salderen bill). The minister responded point by point, defending the current legal framework, stating a threshold is not yet ecologically feasible, and promising further dialogue and a study of alternatives to the KDW, but declined to give a project count for the threshold scenario.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Meer ambitie bij het opleiden van militairen'

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Defence about training capacity shortages, outsourcing of military training to civilian providers, and expansion of the Dienjaar Defensie programme. The State Secretary answered that Defence is pursuing civilian cooperation, insourcing and outsourcing where feasible, and gradual scaling of the Dienjaar, while most questions were answered substantively without concrete new commitments beyond further study.
Finally, on-the-job training will become increasingly important, so that regular courses can be shortened.
Ten slotte zal het opleiden op de werkplek steeds belangrijker worden, waardoor reguliere opleidingen kunnen worden verkort.
Antwoord op van de leden Valstar, Van Campen, Bisschop, Grinwis en Boswijk over ‘bestaand gebruik’ in relatie tot de toetsing van de garnalenvisserij aan de Wet natuurbescherming

MPs from VVD, SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the ministers about the Landsadvocaat's advice on whether shrimp fishing licences under the Visserijwet can count as existing use (bestaand gebruik) for Wet natuurbescherming permits, and whether the 1994 licences should be investigated. The minister answered that the legal route is highly complex, that the sector must itself reconstruct licence and emission data via AIS and logbooks, and that the sector remains responsible for the nitrogen deposition calculations.
I share that observation and gladly give these fishers the opportunity and room to demonstrate this.
Ik deel die constatering en biedt deze vissers graag de kans en ruimte om dit aan te tonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Geurts over het bericht 'Nederlands beste boerengrond – in Flevoland – maakt plaats voor woningen en natuur: ‘Maar bos kweken werkt hier niet’'

MPs Boswijk and Geurts asked about a newspaper report that the most fertile farmland in Flevoland is being converted to housing and nature, and about how such land is protected. The government replied that a 'right function in the right place' principle applies, that a framework for land-use changes on farmland is being developed within the National Programme Rural Area, and that provinces and municipalities hold the decisive powers.
The national government has a broad coordinating role to ensure all spatial tasks find a place and to prevent agriculture from being the last resort in the spatial debate.
Het Rijk heeft een brede regiefunctie om ervoor te zorgen dat alle ruimtelijke opgaven een plek krijgen en om te voorkomen dat landbouw het sluitstuk is in de discussie rondom ruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Zonvarken experimenteert met diervriendelijke stallen’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how innovative animal-friendly pig housing (Zonvarken) without official ammonia emission factors can be credited in farm nitrogen obligations and PAS-melder legalisation, and whether the lack of assessment hinders sustainability. The minister explained the proefstal route, that such emission reductions cannot yet be counted for PAS-melders, and promised further work on Wnb assessment and innovation barriers by mid-June 2023.
The aim is to have first insights by mid-June 2023 into what an alternative framework for Wnb permit approval for low-emission stables could look like.
Het streven is om medio juni 2023 de eerste inzichten te hebben hoe een alternatief kader voor Wnb-toestemmingverlening voor emissiearme stallen eruit kan zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Krul en Grinwis over het bericht 'Ministerie betaalde al 15.000 euro aan actiegroep Lelystad Airport: ‘Dit is van de zotte’

Three MPs (Boswijk, Krul, Grinwis) asked why the government pays penalty payments rather than fulfilling a Woo freedom-of-information request from Stichting Laagvliegen, whether aviation emissions above 3,000 feet must be reported under the NEC directive, what sanctions apply for incomplete reporting, and how that affects the nitrogen approach. The minister acknowledges delay and agrees phased publication, says the NEC reporting is not legally binding but commits to including above-3,000-foot emissions from 2024, and maintains that the nitrogen contribution of aviation is about 0.01%.
I regret that it took longer than the applicable statutory deadlines, as a result of which a penalty payment was imposed.
Ik betreur het dat het langer heeft geduurd dan de daarvoor geldende wettelijke termijnen, waardoor er een dwangsom is opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het combineren van maatregelen voor het reduceren van de uitstoot van stikstof en CO2 door industriële bedrijven

CDA MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk asked how the government will combine nitrogen and CO2 reduction for large industrial emitters, which firms overlap, and whether a joint acceleration plan will be made. The minister answered that about 35 firms are covered by a tailor-made approach addressing both CO2 and nitrogen, that grid and permitting bottlenecks remain, and that a joint plan of action with the 20 largest CO2 emitters is being developed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Adviseurs: fouten op RVO-kaarten met sloten en bufferstroken'

An MP from the CDA asked the agriculture minister about errors in RVO's buffer-strip map showing ditches, and about the resulting confusion for farmers. The minister acknowledged that the map inherits inaccuracies from the BGT base registry, that farmers can correct buffer strips in the Gecombineerde Opgave, and that RVO is working on an improvement plan with water boards and other source holders.
RVO is working on an improvement plan to align the BGT base information with the classifications of ditches and watercourses.
RVO werkt aan een verbeterplan om de basisinformatie van de BGT te laten aansluiten bij de typeringen van sloten en waterlopen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Ook Lelystad Airport omstreden stikstofmarkt op: vliegveld is op zoek naar boeren voor opkoop'

CDA MPs asked ministers whether buying up nitrogen rights by Lelystad Airport and the state-linked Schiphol Group, while PAS-melder farmers remain unresolved, is acceptable, and whether the government should stop it and apply the motion on a transparent nitrogen bank. The minister answered that the airport acts within the principle that initiators must mitigate their own emissions, that it only bought from farms that volunteered, that a nitrogen bank does not yet exist, and that Schiphol's operational permit matters are for its board.
The airport's conduct is in line with the nitrogen policy principle that initiators are themselves responsible for mitigating nitrogen emissions.
Het handelen van de luchthaven is in lijn met het uitgangspunt van het stikstofbeleid dat initiatiefnemers zelf verantwoordelijk zijn om stikstofuitstoot te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Knops over de toegang tot veteranenzorg ‘achter slot en grendel’

Two MPs from the CDA asked why veterans in detention may not be placed in the Military Penitentiary Centre in Stroe, which has low occupancy, and what cooperation exists between Justice, Defence and the Netherlands Veterans Institute. The ministers answered that an exploration of placing some detained veterans there is underway with results due in Q1 2023, that a convenant covering certain non-military detainees was signed on 6 December 2022, and that veterans in detention are identified at intake and linked to veteran care.
The outcomes will be reported to the House in more detail in the first quarter of this year.
Over de uitkomsten wordt uw Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van dit jaar nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Boswijk over de opkoop van boerderijen ten behoeve van de verbreding van de A27 bij Utrecht

MPs Grinwis and Boswijk asked whether the national government's buyout of farms for the A27 widening near Amelisweerd, and its use of nitrogen space, undermines provincial area processes, PAS-melder legalisation and fair rules on extern salderen. The minister denies any breach of inter-governmental agreements, rejects claims that Rijk buys nitrogen space for Schiphol, and announces tighter rules, a first-purchase right, a possible pre-emption right, a register of nitrogen banks and an independent enforcement study.

To prevent governments surprising each other, the national government and provinces have inter-governmental agreements on extern salderen, under which the Rijk informs provinces in advance of planned transactions.

Om te voorkomen dat overheden elkaar verrassen, hebben Rijk en provincies interbestuurlijke afspraken over extern salderen, waarbij is afgesproken dat het Rijk de provincies vooraf informeert over voorgenomen transacties op basis van extern salderen.
Antwoord op vragen van Boswijk en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Steunmaatregelen 'zeer teleurstellend' voor glastuinbouw: 'Dit gaat tuinders niet helpen"

MPs Boswijk and Bontenbal asked the ministers of Agriculture and Economic Affairs about reports that support measures for greenhouse horticulture were insufficient, and about the sector's energy costs, its classification, and EU support options. The government disagrees that the measures do not help, points to raised compensation ceilings and a generic SME scheme, and says it sees no need for additional EU-based support for the sector.
I do not agree with the statement that the measures taken do not help the growers.
Ik ben het niet eens met de uitspraak dat de maatregelen die zijn genomen de tuinders niet helpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Boswijk over wachtlijsten bij agrarische kinderopvang vanwege starre regelgeving

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether rigid rules cause long waiting lists for farm-based childcare and whether those rules block growth of this multifunctional farming activity. The government agreed that farm childcare has benefits, said it is working with LTO and VNG on municipal permit barriers and an updated handreiking, and committed to further talks and checking whether linking permits to farm turnover is a problem, without conceding that rules currently make growth impossible.
At present, LNV, together with VNG and LTO, is working on a proposal to update the 2011 'Handreiking Multifunctionele Landbouw en Ruimtelijke Ordening'.
Op dit moment wordt vanuit LNV samen met VNG en LTO aan een voorstel gewerkt om de «Handreiking Multifunctionele Landbouw en Ruimtelijke Ordening» uit 2011 te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat een Nederlands vrachtschip betrokken is bij een illegaal wapentransport naar Libië

MPs Boswijk and Agnes Mulder asked whether a Dutch-flagged cargo ship carried a shipment of armoured vehicles to Libya in breach of the UN arms embargo, who was responsible, whether the cargo was sanctioned, why the ship had documentation, whether Dutch shipping firms will be prevented from future involvement, and whether an investigation has started. The government confirms the ship was inspected in October and the cargo seized pending a UN Panel of Experts investigation that has not concluded, declines to name the client or judge the documentation, says any criminal investigation is for the Public Prosecution Service, and does not name individual cases.

The investigation by the UN Security Council Sanctions Committee Panel of Experts into the client, the cargo, the required documentation including licences, and the possible breach of the arms embargo is still ongoing.

Het onderzoek door het Panel of Experts van het VN Veiligheidsraad Sanctiecomité naar de opdrachtgever, de lading van het schip, de benodigde documentatie – waaronder vergunningen – en de mogelijke schending van het wapenembargo is nog gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van Campen en Grinwis over het bericht 'Boer Arjan moet verplicht zijn veestapel drastisch verkleinen; "Ze maken je helemaal kapot"'

MPs Boswijk, Van Campen and Grinwis asked the minister why promised legalisation of PAS-melder farms has not been delivered, whether the state will pay enforcement penalties, and whether an emergency law or provincial relief is possible. The minister says the legalisation programme, a 250 million euro provincial grant and a damages desk are being pursued, but that withholding enforcement is legally very difficult and penalties cannot be paid by the state.
It is a statutory obligation to have the measures implemented in time.
Het is een wettelijke opgave om de maatregelen tijdig uitgevoerd te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de Kamerbrief 'Openstelling saneringsregeling visserij'

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the fisheries decommissioning scheme, including how payments are calculated, whether it follows earlier advice, the treatment of fishing quotas and tax measures, and the need to reform the quota allocation system under the CFP. The minister answers in detail, explaining that payments are based on gross tonnage and average income loss, that the scheme responds to Brexit quota cuts, and that the quota allocation system will be revised by 2025 in consultation with the sector.
In developing this change I will exercise all necessary care and make room for consultation with the sector, experts and other stakeholders.
Ik zal bij het uitwerken van deze wijziging alle noodzakelijke zorgvuldigheid betrachten en ruimte nemen voor afstemming met de sector, deskundigen en andere belanghebbenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van Campen en Bisschop over het bericht 'Wolf blijft zorgen voor problemen: ook kalveren en pony’s slachtoffer'

Three MPs (Boswijk, Van Campen, Bisschop) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about rising wolf attacks on livestock, the handling of damage compensation, the legal status and management options for the wolf, and related policy. The minister replied that the issues are known, that prevention measures under the Interprovincial Wolf Plan are considered adequate, that management is not currently permitted because no favourable conservation status has been reached, and that an international wolf plan with Germany is in preparation.
That is why I, together with the provinces, am committed to properly protecting livestock and hobby animals in order to prevent animal suffering.
Daarom zet ik, samen met de provincies, in op het goed beschermen van vee en hobbydieren om daarmee het dierenleed te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het artikel ‘Een kleine koe die minder krachtvoer eet is ook een vorm van innovatie’

An MP asked whether the Dutch nitrogen accounting treats all cows alike at 13 kg ammonia per year regardless of management measures, and whether management measures that reduce emissions will be added to the approved low-emission list. The ministers answered that management and feed measures are already partly reflected in the rules and monitoring, that more reliable, verifiable farm-level data is needed before further measures are recognised, and that they will explore incentives for farmers who reduce emissions.
I am examining the possibilities to demonstrate that for other management measures too, ammonia emissions at farm level decrease with sufficient certainty.
Ik onderzoek de mogelijkheden om aan te tonen dat ook bij andere managementmaatregelen de ammoniakemissie met voldoende zekerheid afneemt op bedrijfsniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Boswijk over het artikel 'Munitie-tekort explodeert: problemen met locaties en vergunningen voor kogelfabrieken'

MPs Valstar and Boswijk asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers about Dutch dependence on imported ammunition, the lack of domestic munitions factories, and permitting barriers for new production sites. The government acknowledged the strategic dependence and the value of European cooperation, but said it will not pursue active policy to restart domestic munitions production, that no Defence sites are available, and that the timeline is unknown.
There are no more ammunition factories in the Netherlands. If they were to come, that would be good, but we will not pursue active policy on this.
Er zijn geen munitiefabrieken meer in Nederland. Als die er zouden komen is dat goed, maar we gaan hier geen actief beleid op voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van der Molen en Geurts over het bericht 'Nieuwe dreun voor boeren: burgers die last hebben van stank hebben recht op schadevergoeding'

CDA MPs asked ministers about a Hague court ruling holding the State liable to residents exposed to excessive odour from livestock farms, and its effects on farms, permits, and costs. The government replied that the ruling is still being studied, promised a letter before the 10 November debate, and gave no cost estimate.
At this moment the ruling is being studied.
Op dit moment wordt de uitspraak bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bisschop over het bericht ‘Veel EU-landen rapporteren cijfers stikstof niet aan Brussel’

MPs Boswijk and Bisschop asked the minister whether Dutch reporting on nitrogen impacts on Natura 2000 sites distorts comparisons with other EU states and whether EU assessment of conservation status is uniform. The minister answered that the nitrogen reporting option is optional, that the SDF does not measure emissions, that EU harmonisation is ongoing, and that nitrogen reduction effort is weighed in assessing conservation status.
The Standard Data Form on Natura 2000 areas used in the article contains no data on how much nitrogen is emitted.
Het Standaard Gegevens Formulier over Natura 2000-gebieden dat in het artikel wordt gebruikt, bevat geen gegevens over hoeveel stikstof wordt uitgestoten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Boswijk over grote onduidelijkheid voor akkerbouwers rondom het 7e Actieprogramma (7e AP) en addendum met daarbij de aanvullende voorwaarden uit de derogatiebeschikking, het nie

MPs Grinwis and Boswijk asked the Minister of Agriculture about the uncertainty for arable farmers caused by the 7th Action Programme, the derogation conditions, the new CAP and the ANLb, including buffer strips, harvest and sowing timing, the eco-scheme and communication. The Minister acknowledged the timing problems, committed to working with RVO on implementation, a reduced entry requirement and a 2023 learning year, but declined to adjust the derogation-based buffer strip rules or to set a transition year for several measures.
Work is being done closely with RVO to enable timely elaboration of the necessary regulations and communication about them.
Er wordt nauw samengewerkt met RVO om tijdige uitwerking van de benodigde regelgeving en communicatie daarover mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Nieuwe uitkoopregeling voor boeren op de tocht: mogelijk ongeoorloofde staatssteun'

An MP from CDA asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen whether the new buyout scheme for farmers (MGA-2) may breach EU state aid rules, and what options and consequences follow. The minister confirmed MGA-2 may not proceed in its current form, said informal talks with the European Commission flagged the no-restart condition as essential, and promised to pursue a notification and decide on the scheme in autumn.
My aim is to have the Lbv approved by the European Commission as quickly as possible.
Mijn inzet is erop gericht de Lbv zo snel mogelijk door de Europese Commissie goedgekeurd te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het boek 'De Melkveerevolutie, Lessen van de landbouwtransitie op Schiermonnikoog'

An MP (Boswijk, CDA) asked whether environmental and nature permits can be adjusted when farmers voluntarily shrink their herds, whether government distrust and legal risks obstruct the transition, and about exit schemes and tax barriers for farmers without successors. The minister answered that voluntary reductions can be recorded via partial withdrawal of permits, that the government is examining reintroducing a permit requirement for internal netting, and that a separate letter on fiscal obstacles will follow.
I am also examining the possibility of bringing so-called 'internal netting' back under the permit requirement.
Ik onderzoek overigens ook de mogelijkheid om het zogenoemde «intern salderen» weer onder de vergunningplicht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het scheurverbod in Natura 2000

An MP asked the minister about the ploughing ban in Natura 2000 areas, including agricultural parcels on the Veluwe that became subject to the ban after a Council of State ruling, and about the effect on grassland and wildlife damage. The minister acknowledged the Habitat Directive status of these parcels, noted research showing reseeding options, and committed to adjusting the approach in the national strategic plan and in consultation with the sector.
I am willing to work towards an adjustment in the implementation of GLMC9.
Ik ben bereid om met de invulling van GLMC9 tot een aanpassing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de brief ‘Stand van zaken derogatie van de Nitraatrichtlijn’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, in 24 questions, about the effects of ending the nitrate derogation on water quality, farm finances, fertiliser supply, the feasibility of the plan and the handling of the motion on the negotiations. The minister answered that the effects are uncertain and partly depend on other factors, referred to a forthcoming transition allowance and a later letter on agriculture, and promised to share correspondence with the European Commission on the negotiations once confidentiality allows.
I have not yet informed the House about this due to the confidentiality of negotiations, and will do so as soon as possible.
Ik heb de Tweede Kamer hierover in verband met de vertrouwelijkheid van onderhandelingen tot op heden nog niet geïnformeerd en zal dit zo spoedig mogelijk doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Boswijk en Van Campen over ‘werkbezoeken aan de grensregio in het kader van stikstof en de aangenomen motie over verschillen aan de grens’

Omtzigt, Boswijk and Van Campen ask about nitrogen-related management and differing rules at the German border, including Natura 2000 areas, cross-border cooperation, monitoring, and planned visits to border farms. The minister answers that cooperation with Germany works well, that the KDW is exceeded in some habitats due to foreign deposition, that cross-border management is being coordinated, and that she will visit three border locations on 22 August while withholding exact locations for security reasons.
In light of all the unrest, during the preparation of working visits, on the advice of the security services (police and the ministry's security service), we do not make the exact locations public.

In het licht van alle onrust maken we tijdens de voorbereiding van werkbezoeken, op advies van de veiligheidsdiensten (politie en beveiligingsdienst binnen het ministerie), de exacte locaties niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Agnes Mulder over het stopzetten van een door Buitenlandse Zaken gefinancierd vrouwenrechtenactivistenprogramma in Afghanistan

Two MPs from the CDA asked why the Dutch government stopped funding a women's rights activist programme in Afghanistan, citing deteriorating conditions for Afghan women, and what unacceptable security risks meant. The minister answered that the decision followed careful weighing of security risks against impact, that support for Afghan civil society and women's rights continues through other adapted projects, and that a further letter on longer-term engagement will address this.
The decision to stop this specific project was taken on the basis of a careful weighing of substantive arguments about security risks and achievable impact.
Het besluit om dit specifieke project stop te zetten, is genomen op basis van een zorgvuldige afweging van inhoudelijke argumenten over veiligheidsrisico's en te behalen impact.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'De Urker vloot 'verdrinkt en niemand helpt ons''

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how fishing is faring under high fuel prices, what support is given, and why state aid schemes and a fuel supplement have been delayed. The minister acknowledged the situation, said no specific support measures exist beyond general measures, and explained that the decommissioning scheme awaits European Commission approval while a bridging scheme is being prepared.
I am making every effort to be able to open the decommissioning scheme shortly after the summer.
Ik span mij ervoor in om de saneringsregeling kort na de zomer te kunnen openstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bromet over het bericht 'Is de vezelhennepteelt ten dode opgeschreven?'

MPs Boswijk and Bromet asked whether the greening subsidy of 150 euro per hectare would end in 2023, what this means for farmers, and what the new nitrate rules mean for hemp and sustainable crops. The minister answers that the greening payment lapses at EU level and is replaced by the eco-scheme, with hemp cultivation counting as one of 21 eco-activities, and that the ecoregeling and the autumn cover-crop rules are still being developed.
The greening premium will lapse at European level in the new CAP period from January 2023.
De vergroeningspremie komt op Europees niveau te vervallen in de nieuwe GLB-periode vanaf januari 2023
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over ‘Het reduceren van stikstofuitstoot door het uitkopen van industriële bedrijven’

MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk (CDA) asked whether the province of Gelderland could buy out industrial firms to cut nitrogen and CO2 emissions, since existing buyout schemes cover only farms, and whether such buyouts should be possible for all sectors. The minister replied that buyouts are unlikely to be cost-effective for nitrogen in most areas, that provinces may pursue individual buyouts case by case, and pointed to generic policy and the VEKI subsidy scheme for industrial firms.
Provinces can themselves arrive at a tailored solution to buy out an individual industrial company, provided this is effective and efficient.
Provincies kunnen zelf tot een maatwerkoplossing komen om een individueel industrieel bedrijf op te kopen mits dit doeltreffend en doelmatig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Droogte: natuur voortaan belangrijker dan landbouw'

MPs Boswijk and Van der Molen asked whether farmers in the Peel area must now apply for permits to irrigate fields, after a court annulled the irrigation exemption in the Natura 2000 buffer zone, and about consequences for food security, costs and transition periods. The minister confirmed the exemption was removed, that individual permit applications remain possible, a two-year transition period is planned with an intention agreement, and that responsibility for crop choices and risk lies with farmers.

The court annulled the exemption from the permit requirement for irrigating open crops in the buffer zone around these Natura 2000 areas, included in the management plan because of periodically occurring extremely dry conditions.

De rechter heeft de in het Natura 2000-beheerplan Groote Peel, Deurnsche Peel en Mariapeel opgenomen vrijstelling van vergunningsplicht voor het beregenen van open teelten in de bufferzone rondom deze Natura 2000 gebieden i.v.m. periodiek optredende extreem droge omstandigheden vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Ministerie negeerde ‘desa-streus' stikstofadvies zodat bouwprojecten gewoon door konden gaan'

An MP asked whether the Infrastructure Ministry overrode an advisory committee's recommendations on nitrogen calculation so that infrastructure permits could proceed, and whether the sectors were disadvantaged. The minister denies this, saying the committee's recommendations were taken up, including a uniform 25 km calculation radius for all emission sources, and that AERIUS remains the best available tool.

That is not correct. In cooperation with the departments concerned, other competent bodies and knowledge institutions, under the coordination of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, it was examined how the advice of the Advisory Committee could be followed up.

Dat klopt niet. In samenwerking met de betrokken departementen, andere bevoegde instanties en kennisinstellingen is onder coördinatie van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit onderzocht hoe opvolging gegeven kon worden aan de adviezen van het Adviescollege.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bisschop over het bericht 'Geen staatssteun voor bedrijven die worstelen met hoge energieprijzen'

MPs Boswijk and Bisschop asked the agriculture minister whether the cutter fishing sector is hit hard by high energy prices, why the Netherlands does not use the EU temporary state-aid option for firms hit by Russia sanctions, and whether a COVID-style idle-vessel scheme can be reinstated. The minister confirmed the problem, declined the broader EU state-aid framework and the idle scheme (citing EMFAF rules and innovation priorities), pointed to existing support instruments, and promised an impact study and structural innovation and decommissioning measures.
At my request, Wageningen Economic Research is mapping the short-term economic effects of the war in Ukraine on the fishing sector.
Wageningen Economic Research brengt op mijn verzoek de economische effecten op korte termijn in beeld van de gevolgen van de oorlog in Oekraïne voor de visserij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over de rechtszaak omtrent het toepassen van de partiële vrijstelling voor stikstof (bouwvrijstelling) bij het CO2-opslagproject Porthos

MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk (CDA) asked about the Council of State case by MOB against the nitrogen construction exemption used for the Porthos CO2 storage project and wind-at-sea permits, and about the consequences of a negative ruling for energy projects and CO2 reduction. The minister replied that the cabinet trusts the exemption's justification, awaits the court, is preparing scenarios, and that a negative ruling would cause delays for many energy projects with no concrete generic fix yet.
The cabinet has confidence in the justification of the construction exemption. It is now up to the judge to rule on the Porthos case / the construction exemption.
Het kabinet heeft vertrouwen in de onderbouwing van de bouwvrijstelling. Het is nu aan de rechter om over de zaak Porthos /de bouwvrijstelling te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de overlast die wordt veroorzaakt door de aanwezigheid van de Amerikaanse rivierkreeft

An MP from the CDA asked the minister about damage caused by the American crayfish, its spread, the Water Framework Directive, a possible dike failure at Reeuwijk, and why only professional fishers may catch crayfish. The minister acknowledged the problems, said the financial damage cannot yet be quantified, noted the Reeuwijk investigation is ongoing, and explained that professional fishing gear is restricted for conservation reasons while a new crayfish-specific trap is being explored.
At present the investigation into the possible cause of the dike slide is still ongoing.
Op dit moment is het onderzoek naar de mogelijke oorzaak van de dijkafschuiving nog in uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Grinwis en Boswijk over het bericht 'Hoge gasprijzen dwingen vier van de tien glastuinders definitief of tijdelijk te stoppen'

MPs Valstar, Grinwis and Boswijk asked the ministers for Climate and Energy and for Agriculture about reports that high gas prices may force many greenhouse growers to stop, and about job losses, timelines for switching to sustainable heat, and support. The ministers acknowledge the sector's serious concerns and possible bankruptcies, say sustainability transitions take time, but refuse to compensate high gas prices and promise a letter at the end of April.
We cannot rule out that companies will go bankrupt.
Tegelijk kunnen wij niet uitsluiten dat er bedrijven failliet zullen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van Campen over investeringen in stalsystemen Noord- Brabant

MPs Boswijk and Van Campen asked whether the stricter Noord-Brabant ammonia limits for livestock stables from 2024, and the lack of national transition funds until 2023-2024, create an unequal playing field, and asked the minister to give Brabant farmers early access to subsidies. The minister acknowledged the province's stricter norms and its support, said national stable subsidies will open in Q3 2022 with the aim of giving Brabant farmers early access, and said the timing of stricter emission norms is being explored.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de verdeling van de marges in de zuivelsector

An MP asked the minister whether dairy price noteringen rising sharply (butter, skimmed milk powder) are passed on only partly to farmers' raw milk prices, and what should be done about margin distribution. The minister replied that the two are not directly comparable, the raw milk price follows the market with a lag and is set by private firms, and that existing measures (Agro-Nutri Monitor, ban on unfair trading practices, Geschillencommissie) apply, with agreements with chain parties planned.
Nevertheless, it is of great importance that there are no structural problems with price formation, and that unfair trading practices in the chain are countered.
Niettemin vind het wel van groot belang dat er geen structurele problemen zijn met de prijsvorming, en dat oneerlijke handelspraktijken in de keten worden tegengaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het T-rijbewijs in de grensregio

Three CDA MPs asked why T-category agricultural licences are not harmonised in the EU, why Belgian and German T-licences are not recognised in the Netherlands, and what cross-border options exist for residents of the border region. The minister answers that T-licences fall outside EU harmonisation, that mutual recognition is being explored pending a comparative study by CBR, and that residence requirements apply, with several questions answered by cross-reference.
The CBR has been asked to produce a comparative overview of the national examination requirements in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany.
Aan het CBR is gevraagd om een vergelijkend overzicht te maken van de nationale exameneisen in Nederland, België en Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Boswijk over het bericht 'Accijnzen op voorraad diesel en propaan terugvragen tot en met 8 april'

CDA MPs asked why the deadline to claim excise refunds on stocks of diesel and propane was only one week, whether firms without the required EH3 eHerkenning level could still apply, and whether the deadline would be extended. The Secretary of State said the five-working-day term follows from the Excise Act, that applications can also be filed in writing or via DigiD, and agreed to extend the deadline to 13 April.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over problemen in de glastuinbouwsector als gevolg van de aanhoudend hoge energieprijzen

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about financial distress in greenhouse horticulture caused by high energy prices, including SDE++ subsidies falling with gas prices and possible project shutdowns.
