The ministers acknowledged the problems, said they are in talks with the sector and banks, explained the SDE++ design, declined to intervene in the subsidy scheme, and promised a letter to parliament in April.
We have no information that would allow us to assess how many projects this concerns.
Wij hebben geen informatie waardoor wij kunnen beoordelen om hoeveel projecten dit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Boswijk over ‘het meten van stikstofuitstoot, het stikstofregistratiesysteem en latente stikstofruimte in vergunningen’

Two MPs asked how nitrogen emissions from agriculture and industry are measured and reported, how the SSRS registry tracks available nitrogen space, and how latent unused permit space is handled. The minister answered that reporting rules are largely EU-based, that the registry tracks only deposition space not emissions, that latent space is not registered, and that measures to restrict its use are being explored with provinces.
The size and use of latent space in permits is not registered.
De omvang en ingebruikname van latente ruimte in vergunningen wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van Campen over het gebruik van de RAV-lijst voor vergunningverlening

MPs Boswijk and Van Campen asked the minister about Utrecht province's decision to stop using the RAV emission-factor list for permits pending appeal, and whether emission-reducing stables can be relied on. The minister answered that provinces may depart from standard factors, that the RAV method is not in question (only its use for Natura 2000 certainty), rejected removing factors from the list, and promised further study and consultation without firm deadlines.
Provinces are the competent authorities for granting permits under the Wet Natuurbescherming.
Provincies zijn bevoegde gezagen voor het verlenen van vergunningen in het kader van de Wnb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Boswijk over het persbericht van de provincie Drenthe dat het kabinet overweegt de Johan Willem Frisokazerne te sluiten

CDA MPs Agnes Mulder and Boswijk asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the Johan Willem Friso barracks in Assen will be closed, on what grounds, what has been invested, what the regional impact is, and how other ministries' decisions are coordinated. The State Secretary answered that no decision has been taken, the barracks is part of an internal real-estate review, regional impact will be discussed with local partners, and a letter with first contours will follow in April.
It is therefore too simplistic to say that I intend to close the Johan Willem Friso barracks, but this barracks is part of this review.
Het is dus te kort door de bocht om te stellen dat ik voornemens ben de Johan Willem Frisokazerne te sluiten, maar deze kazerne maakt wel onderdeel uit van deze verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Palland over het misbruik van militaire uniformen bij de coronademonstratie in Amsterdam van 2 januari jl.

CDA MPs asked whether soldiers and veterans in uniform at a 2 January 2022 Amsterdam COVID demonstration, including a violent attack on a police officer, breached rules, and asked for stronger enforcement of uniform misuse laws. The ministers said uniform rules apply, that Defence has instructed commanders that demonstrating in uniform is a disciplinary offence, and that existing criminal provisions are not shown to be causing enforcement problems, though enforcement is discussed with prosecutors and police.
The Commander of the Armed Forces instructed his subordinate commanders in writing in December 2021 on how to act when military personnel in uniform take part in protests or demonstrations.
De Commandant der Strijdkrachten heeft in december 2021 zijn ondercommandanten schriftelijk geïnstrueerd hoe zij kunnen handelen als militairen in uniform meedoen aan protesten/betogingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Agnes Mulder over de situatie in Mali

MPs Boswijk and Agnes Mulder (CDA) asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the situation in Mali, including the future of MINUSMA, the Takuba task force, French withdrawal, Russian paramilitaries, and Dutch evacuation planning. The government answered that it is very concerned, that the Dutch MINUSMA contribution is not under review for now, that Takuba is being withdrawn, and that it is monitoring developments and maintaining diplomatic contacts.
Suspending the Dutch civilian and military contribution to the UN mission MINUSMA is currently not on the table.
Het stopzetten van de Nederlandse civiele en militaire bijdrage aan de VN-missie MINUSMA is momenteel niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de effecten van de Europese Green Deal op de landbouwopbrengst

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a WUR study predicting that EU Green Deal cuts in pesticide and fertiliser use would lower crop yields, raise prices and increase imports and land use abroad. The minister found the study useful but limited in scope, said he would assess each Commission proposal on its merits and inform parliament via BNC-fiches, and pointed to Commission work on new breeding techniques, carbon farming and carbon border adjustment as ways to address farm incomes and leakage.

I will work towards an integrated implementation of the Green Deal, including the Farm to Fork Strategy, and will assess each individual proposal the Commission puts forward under the Green Deal on its merits, including its possible consequences.

Ik ga mij inzetten voor een integrale implementatie van de Green Deal, waaronder de BtB, en zal elk individueel voorstel dat de Commissie onder de vlag van de Green Deal uitbrengt op zijn merites beoordelen, inclusief de mogelijke consequenties ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bontenbal over CO2-levering aan de glastuinbouw

MPs Boswijk and Bontenbal asked why the Amsterdam waste-energy company AEB chose CCS without supplying captured CO2 to greenhouse horticulture, and what barriers and government role exist for CO2 supply and combined CCS/CCU. The minister acknowledges the choice, says the sector needs about 2.5 Mton externally sourced CO2 and that the SDE++ and CO2 allocation pilot still have flexibility and legal-clarity barriers, while committing to a new convenant and a possible roadmap before summer.
If necessary, agreements can also be made there to draw up a roadmap. We will come back to this before the summer.
Zo nodig kunnen daar ook afspraken in worden gemaakt om roadmap op te stellen. Hier komen we voor de zomer op terug.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over mogelijke impact van Europese ESG-standaarden op de defensie- en veiligheidssector

CDA MPs asked the government about the EU EcoLabel draft criteria for financial products, which would exclude firms earning over 5% of revenue from conventional weapons or military products used in combat, and how this affects Dutch defence firms' access to financial services. The state secretary said the criteria are voluntary for banks, that the government will raise the risk of blanket sector exclusion within the EU and talk with the defence sector and the banking association, but gave no commitment to change the criteria.
The current revenue share from trade or production of weapons and/or military products for combat of individual Dutch companies is not known.
Het huidige omzetaandeel van de handel of productie van wapens en/of militaire producten voor « combat » van individuele Nederlandse bedrijven is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over belemmeringen die spelen bij opkoopregelingen in het kader van de stikstofaanpak

An MP asked why the provincial buy-out scheme for farms near vulnerable nature in Zuid-Holland, with a 2 mol nitrogen threshold and a no-relocation condition, is leaving its national budget largely unspent, since farmers wishing to exit are elsewhere and farmers near nature are not interested. The minister acknowledged the scheme's conditions limit flexibility, said a second tranche is exploring relocation with substantial emission reduction, and committed to working with Zuid-Holland on a pilot area-based project.
The periodic progress reports and my conversations with the provinces show that some conditions of the scheme limit the room for manoeuvre in practice.
Uit de periodieke voortgangrapportages en uit mijn gesprekken met de provincies blijkt wel dat een aantal voorwaarden van de regeling de speelruimte in de praktijk beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over autonome wapensystemen

The MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Defence whether the Netherlands should work to stop fully autonomous weapons, whether the ICRC call for new binding rules changes the 2015 Dutch position, and when the AIV/CAVV advice would arrive in time for the December 2021 review conference. The government answered that it rejects fully autonomous weapons in principle, that existing international law suffices for now, that it will first seek clarification of existing frameworks rather than new instruments, and that it will reconsider its position after the new advice.
The cabinet will consider the advice and formulate a cabinet response.
Het kabinet gaat zich buigen over het advies en een kabinetsreactie formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Agnes Mulder over de klimaatimpact van door de veestapel uitgestoten methaan

MPs Boswijk and Agnes Mulder asked the ministers whether IPCC AR6 findings mean the climate impact of livestock methane is overstated, and what this implies for Dutch climate policy, LULUCF, and methane priorities. The minister answered that the IPCC does not say GWP* is better than GWP100, that GWP100 remains the international standard, that the issue will be revisited after the AR6 cycle, and that the national methane reduction target for livestock stands.
The IPCC does not make a statement about which method would be better or which method should be used.
Het IPCC doet daarbij geen uitspraak over welke methode beter zou zijn of welke methode gebruikt zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de voortgang afhandeling waterschade in Limburg en Brabant

MPs from the CDA asked the Justice and Security Minister about the progress of flood damage compensation in Limburg and Brabant, covering teeltplanschade interpretation, communication, helpdesks, processing times, turnover compensation, the Maas floodplains, EU solidarity funding, and climate resilience for entrepreneurs. The minister answered that productie loss is assessed per crop, outlined communication channels and a helpline, said turnover loss is not covered by the Wts and that a decision on compensation is still under exploration, and declined to set a timeline for some questions.
For determining crop plan damage, the production loss is assessed per company per production direction.
Voor de bepaling van de teeltplanschade wordt per bedrijf per productierichting gekeken naar het productieverlies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse president van plan is de gevechtsmissie in Irak voor het einde van het jaar te beëindigen

Boswijk (CDA) asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that the US would end its combat mission in Iraq by year end, including its concrete plans, notification of allies, implications for troop presence and Dutch safety, and the effect of al-Sadr's election win. The government answered that US combat troops will withdraw by 1 January 2022, that allies were informed via the anti-ISIS coalition, that the remaining 2500 troops will focus on advisory and capacity building, and that ISIS remains a threat with ongoing attacks.
On the security risks and mitigating measures for the Dutch deployment, the House will be informed separately in the article 100 letter.
Over de veiligheidsrisico's en mitigerende maatregelen voor de Nederlandse inzet wordt de Kamer separaat in de artikel 100-brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Brussel maakte wél verslag van gesprek over Wierdense Veld’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why she earlier said no report existed of her meeting with the European Commissioner on the Wierdense Veld, when a flash report now surfaces, and questioned the Netherlands' interpretation of Habitats Directive Article 6 and the scientific uncertainty of the measures. The minister answered that she was unaware of the internal Commission report, that the Commission rejected the Dutch interpretation allowing a general-interest use to take priority, that the measures are judged adequate under current insights with monitoring planned, and that compensation is a last resort.

When on 6 September 2021 I answered 'No report was made of the conversation with the Eurocommissioner', I was not aware that an email with a short summary of the conversation had been sent within the services of the European Commission.

Toen ik op 6 september 2021 antwoordde «Er is geen verslag gemaakt van het gesprek met de Eurocommissaris», was ik niet op de hoogte van het feit dat er binnen de diensten van de Europese Commissie een e-mail was verzonden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Landbouwgif in Maas gedumpt'

MPs Boswijk and Amhaouch asked the minister about reports that glyphosate was dumped into the Meuse for about 74 days, and why monitoring at Eijsden did not detect it earlier. The minister confirmed the drinking-water criterion was exceeded, explained that glyphosate is not in the continuous monitoring package and that monthly sampling and lab analysis caused a delay, and described coordination and cross-border warning measures, while the source of the discharge remains unidentified.

In consultation with, among others, the drinking water companies, it is now being discussed how the taking of water samples by different organisations can be better coordinated and timed to follow on from one another.

In overleg met o.a. de drinkwaterbedrijven wordt nu besproken hoe het nemen van watermonsters door verschillende organisaties beter gecoördineerd en aansluitend in de tijd op elkaar kunnen worden ingepland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over de wateroverlast

MPs Boswijk, Van Dijk and Amhaouch asked ministers about flood damage and whether the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen applies to farmers outside Limburg, and about sand bags, food safety, manure bookkeeping and working-time rules. Minister Schouten answered that the compensation law applies only to disasters meeting the Wet veiligheidsregio's definition, that uiterwaard damage is excluded and still under study, and that a ministerial regulation and RVO quick scan are being prepared.
Currently the desirability and possibilities of compensating damage in floodplains along the Maas are being explored, about which your House has been informed.
Momenteel wordt de wenselijkheid en mogelijkheden voor tegemoetkoming van schade in uiterwaarden langs de Maas verkend waarover uw Kamer is geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Boswijk over ‘de onwerkbare situatie voor zwerfdierstichtingen’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Boswijk (CDA) asked the minister about legal uncertainty and impracticable rules for dog-rescue foundations under EU animal health law, illegal dog trade and registration obligations. The minister acknowledged the signals, explained that the regime applies to commercial movements of dogs, promised communication efforts, a regulatory aid tool and talks with the foundations, while declining to confirm or deny claims about illegal trade and forged passports.
The suspicion is that these numbers are considerable, but because of their illegal nature, exact figures are unknown.
Het vermoeden is dat deze aantallen behoorlijk zijn maar vanwege de illegale aard ervan zijn exacte cijfers onbekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over nieuwe natuur

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the scale of the new-nature target under the Natuurnetwerk Nederland, how much stems from nitrogen problems, which actors are involved, how the type of nature is decided, and whether new nature should be less nitrogen-sensitive. The minister answered that roughly 38,530 ha of the 80,000 ha target remained as of 1 January 2020, that the Programme Nature funds provincial restoration programmes in nitrogen-sensitive Natura 2000 areas, that provinces decide the nature type regionally, and that nitrogen sensitivity plays no role in choosing nature types.
For answering the question of which nature should be realised, nitrogen sensitivity plays no role.
Voor het beantwoorden van de vraag welke natuur moet worden gerealiseerd, speelt de stikstofgevoeligheid geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over vanggewassen in het kader van verplichting voor het ecologisch aandachtsgebied (EA) zoals geformuleerd in het Gemeenschappelijk Landbouwbeleid (GLB)

An MP asked the minister whether farmers can meet the GLB ecological focus area cover-crop rules (sowing deadline, establishment, eight weeks standing) in wet weather, and how enforcement handles this. The minister answered that the EU rules are binding with no room for deviation, that the 15 October sowing deadline is a national facilitation rule, that force majeure may apply, and that she is reluctant to add extra national rules on CO2 emissions.
I have no room to deviate from these EU requirements.
Ik heb geen ruimte om van deze EU-eisen af te wijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘NVWA-baas wil keuringen in slachthuizen afstoten’

Boswijk (CDA) asked the minister about the outgoing NVWA inspector-general's call to stop slaughterhouses paying for meat inspections, arguing this creates a appearance of conflict of interest, and about whether NVWA oversight and inspection roles should be separated amid tensions with animal welfare. The minister defended cost pass-through, said EU rules prevent fully ending slaughterhouse funding but safeguards exist, and committed to a separate inspection organisation with a detailed proposal by Q2 2022.
It is important that the safeguards mentioned earlier are also retained or improved in the revision of the NVWA fee system, especially where the independence of supervision is concerned.

Het is belangrijk dat eerder genoemde waarborgen ook bij de herziening van het retributiestelsel NVWA behouden blijven of verbeterd worden, zeker waar het de onafhankelijkheid van het toezicht betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over probleem met de bij Brexit 'vergeten' scheepswerven in Stellendam nog steeds niet volledig opgelost

An MP asked why British fishing vessels heading for Stellendam shipyards must first call at a designated port for NVWA checks, and why NVWA is unavailable at weekends. The minister explains the checks serve EU anti-illegal-fishing obligations, that the shipyard ports lack inspection capacity, and that she will not change the arrangement but remains open to new evidence from the sector.
NVWA oversight is aimed at preventing illegal landings of fish.
Het toezicht van de NVWA is gericht op het voorkomen van illegale aanlandingen van vis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de uitspraak van de rechter in Overijssel over bemesten en beweiden op 29 juli 2021 (AwB19/1185 en AWB 20/186)

MP Boswijk asked the minister how a Overijssel court ruling on manuring and grazing under the nature protection act affects permit exemptions, whether it is coordinated with provinces and whether grazing will now need permits. The minister says Rijk and provinces coordinate monthly, that grazing and manuring are generally exempt when continuously farmed since the reference date, but that exceptions are being mapped and a generic substantiation is being sought.
The national government and the provinces are currently mapping these situations.
Het Rijk en de provincies zijn deze situaties op dit moment in kaart aan het brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Onzekerheid voor getroffen Limburgse ondernemers, 'meer omzetverlies dan waterschade''

CDA MPs asked for an update on flood damage in Limburg and Brabant, including economic losses from revenue loss, the state of compensation, the EU Solidarity Fund, local helplines and the coordinating minister. Minister Grapperhaus answered that economic loss is still poorly understood, that the Wts compensation scheme entered into force on 9 September 2021 with 1,135 reports so far, that a decision on the EU Solidarity Fund will follow by end of September, and that the Justice Minister coordinates the response while other ministers handle their own areas.
The cabinet is in discussion with the region and entrepreneurs' representatives to get a better picture of the economic damage.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met de regio en ondernemersvertegenwoordigers om een beter beeld van de economische schade te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over de schadevergoeding na de wateroverlast in Limburg en Brabant

MPs from the CDA asked why the compensation area for the July 2021 flood damage in Limburg and North Brabant does not match the area actually affected, and whether businesses outside it should be compensated. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that compensation is limited to the legally defined damage area under the Wts, that businesses outside it cannot be covered under current law, and that the government will discuss turnover losses with the region in the fourth quarter.
Outside this area there is no disaster as referred to here.
Buiten dit gebied is er geen sprake van een ramp als hiervoor bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Boswijk over de bijdrage van Nederlandse bedrijven aan de wereldwijde voedselvoorziening

MPs Amhaouch and Boswijk (CDA) asked whether US sanctions block food, seed and planting-material exports and cause hunger, and what Dutch banks and the EU are doing about it. The minister replies that no signals show US sanctions hindering such exports, that hunger is mainly driven by poverty, conflict, climate and Covid-19, and describes EU humanitarian carve-outs, the INSTEX vehicle and ongoing dialogue with the Dutch banking association.
No signals have been received that US sanctions affect the specific sectors and companies in the Netherlands referred to in the question.
Er zijn geen signalen ontvangen dat door de VS ingevoerde sancties de in de vraag bedoelde specifieke sectoren en bedrijven in Nederland raken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de eerdere antwoorden op vragen over de brief ‘Hoe moet het verder met de ontwikkeling van het Wierdense Veld’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the Wierdense Veld peat bog restoration, including validation of provincial ecological and hydrological studies, cost estimates, the Eurocommissioner meeting report, and nitrogen measures. The minister answered that validating studies falls outside her responsibility and refers to the province, that no report of the Eurocommissioner meeting was made, that costs cannot yet be estimated for the nitrogen-law measures, and that the minister will not anticipate the regional process; she did commit to pointing to available nitrogen-sensitivity maps.
Validating studies for the design and management of Natura 2000 areas does not fall under my responsibility.
Het valideren van onderzoeken voor de inrichting en het beheer van Natura 2000-gebieden behoort niet tot mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Rooiseizoen voor biologische aardappeltelers in rook op door schimmelziekte’

An MP asked the minister about resistant organic potato varieties, why organic growers do not use them more, and whether new breeding techniques such as CRISPR-Cas could speed up Phytophthora resistance, given the EU organic target and the potato covenant. The minister answered that 23 resistant varieties exist and cover 80% of organic potatoes, that the sector drives breeding and the covenant targets are not yet met, that new techniques are excluded in organic farming, and that no significant food security effect is expected.
I am willing to contribute to this with additional research if desired.
Ik wil hier met aanvullend onderzoek aan bijdragen indien gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van den Berg over het artikel “Vissen in windpark nu al kansloos” dat onlangs verscheen in de Provinciale Zeeuwse Courant

Two CDA MPs asked the minister why staandwant and jigging were excluded from an experimental fishing project in the Borssele offshore wind farm, and whether this fits a project meant to generate knowledge. The minister answered that these gear types are excluded because safety and ecological suitability have not been shown, that knowledge can be gathered outside the wind farm, and that the government will develop a policy framework and remains open to supporting fishers.
It is only not permitted to experiment in wind energy areas with fishing gear for which it has not been shown that it can be operated safely and included in the BAS.
Het is alleen niet toegestaan in windenergiegebieden te experimenteren met vistuigen waarvan niet is aangetoond dat deze veilig uitgevoerd kunnen worden en hiermee in het BAS kunnen worden opgenomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over LTO Noord wil verlenging mest uitrijden vanwege hevige regenval

Questions from MP Boswijk (CDA) ask whether the minister knows that heavy rainfall has hampered manure spreading in the North of the Netherlands, whether this is acknowledged, what obligations apply, and whether the minister will grant LTO Noord's request to extend the manure-spreading period by two weeks. The item is marked as withdrawn (ingetrokken) on 1 September 2021, so no government answer is present in the text.
The written questions from MP Boswijk (CDA) on LTO Noord wants extension of manure spreading due to heavy rainfall were withdrawn on 1 September 2021.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Boswijk (CDA) over LTO Noord wil verlenging mest uitrijden vanwege hevige regenval zijn op 1 september 2021 ingetrokken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Werner over het bericht ‘Schaapsherders in de knel: er zijn er nog maar een paar over en subsidie komt niet bij hen terecht’

MPs Boswijk and Werner asked whether only four independent shepherds remain, whether shepherding is on the national intangible heritage list, and how the government will secure their survival given that subsidies flow mainly to nature organisations and provinces. The minister answered that traditional flocks number about fifty, that shepherding is on the national inventory, that subsidies come mainly from provinces and the CAP grazing scheme, and that a national scheme for rare breeds is planned for 2023-2027, without guaranteeing survival of each flock.
The whole set of support for traditionally shepherded sheep flocks, as outlined in my letter of January 2019, contributes to the maintenance of shepherded sheep flocks in the Netherlands.
Het geheel aan ondersteuning van traditioneel gescheperde schaapskuddes, zoals geschetst in mijn brief van januari 2019, draagt bij aan de instandhouding van gescheperde schaapskuddes in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het project ‘Wisselpolder Westhoek’ waarin vruchtbare [landbouwgrond] wordt ‘teruggegeven’ aan de Waddenzee

Parliamentary questions from MP Boswijk (CDA) asked whether the 'Wisselpolder Westhoek' project would convert fertile farmland into nature and Natura 2000 land, and how farming interests and earlier stakeholder involvement were being safeguarded. The minister answered that the idea is one of many under a still-open area process led by the province, with no decision taken, and that a broader impact analysis and agreements to return the land to farming would be considered.
Wetterskip Fryslân has collected nearly 200 ideas on and around the sea dike between Koehool and Lauwersmeer.
Het Wetterskip Fryslân heeft bijna 200 ideeën opgehaald op en rond de zeedijk tussen Koehool en Lauwersmeer.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Bromet, Ceder, Kuzu en Dassen over Afghaanse tolken

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how the government would support Afghan interpreters and their families to evacuate as security collapsed, including whether passport requirements would be waived and a charter flight arranged. The government said it is doing everything possible to bring the group to safety, explained that Afghan authorities and airlines required passports and that airport access depends on verifiable identity, and promised a further letter on the consequences of recent developments.
The cabinet will shortly send a further letter to address the consequences of the recent developments.
Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een nadere brief sturen om in te gaan op de consequenties van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch, Ellemeet en Bromet over de wateroverlast in Limburg

MPs asked the government about the flooding in Limburg: the adequacy of responders, damage estimates, applying the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen to victims, flood buffers and climate adaptation funding, and the long-term aid. The minister answered that the government will apply the compensation law, outlined eligible damage categories, said a damage quick scan is being prepared, and described responder support, climate-adaptation programmes and a planned evaluation table.
Given the nature and scale of the disaster, the cabinet has decided to apply the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts).
Het kabinet heeft besloten om, gelet op de aard en de omvang van de ramp, de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) toe te gaan passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bontenbal over koolstofvastlegging

MPs Boswijk and Bontenbal asked the Minister of Agriculture about the potential of carbon sequestration in agriculture, how carbon farming can improve farmers' earnings, whether Commissioner Timmermans' view that the Netherlands is unsuitable for large-scale soil carbon storage is shared, what support is offered to farmers, and what a proposed AFOLU merger could mean for the agricultural sector. The minister answered each question in substance, giving sequestration estimates, outlining revenue options, describing support programmes and pilots, and stating that the AFOLU implications are still being assessed and will be reported to parliament via the BNC route.
Parliament will be further informed about this via the BNC route.
Uw Kamer zal via de BNC-route hier nader over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Rechterlijke uitspraak maakt van natuurvoorzorgsprincipe het verlammingsprincipe’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the potential consequences of a Northern Netherlands court ruling requiring the province of Drenthe to show that drainage and pesticide use near a Natura 2000 area have no significant effects, and whether this would require permits for nearly all economic activity. The minister replied that the province, as competent authority, must still decide on next steps, that the ruling concerns a local case, that she is not aware of similar cases elsewhere, and that she will await the outcome before assessing the wider impact.
It is appropriate for me to await the next steps in this concrete legal proceeding before I can arrive at an interpretation of this matter and determine which steps are needed to map out the impact.

Het past mij om het vervolg van deze concrete rechtsgang af te wachten, voordat ik tot een interpretatie van deze kwestie kan komen en kan bepalen welke stappen nodig zijn om de impact in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Column: Boeren krijgen sancties, natuurorganisaties een 'goed gesprek''

Rep. Boswijk (CDA) asked the minister why farmers in grassland bird-conservation schemes face repeated NVWA inspections and sanctions while nature organisations get only remedy periods and a certificate system; the minister answered that inspections follow the EU control rules and the subsidy system, that organisations are certified by Stichting Certificering SNL with remedy offered first, and that the NVWA's inspections and the GLB greening penalties follow set procedures with figures given. The answers are largely detailed and substantive but describe existing procedures rather than new commitments.
Regarding grassland bird management, the NVWA does not carry out inspections at nature organisations, because grassland bird management by nature organisations is fully nationally financed.
Met betrekking tot weidevogelbeheer voert de NVWA geen controles uit bij natuurorganisaties, omdat weidevogelbeheer door natuurorganisaties volledig nationaal wordt gefinancierd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de ophokplicht en de gevolgen daarvan voor Nederlandse pluimveehouders

An MP from the CDA asked the minister about the avian influenza housing order (ophokplicht) and its effect on free-range egg producers' status, plus related questions on the UWV disability reassessment affair. The answers, given by minister Koolmees for Social Affairs, mostly concern UWV's handling of reassessments, expressing regret for the impact on affected people and pointing to individual remedies, evaluations and planned reports rather than addressing the poultry sector questions.
There has been too little attention to the impact the decisions had on individual people's lives, such as the stress and uncertainty that resulted.
Er is te weinig oog geweest voor de impact die de beslissingen op de afzonderlijke levens van mensen hadden, zoals de stress en onzekerheid die er het gevolg van waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk en het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘LNV wijst oplossing Borkumse Stenen van de hand’

MPs Boswijk and Agnes Mulder asked the minister whether a large closed fishing area north of Schiermonnikoog is set to take effect, why the Dutch fishers' federation's alternative plan for the Borkumse Stenen area was rejected, what alternative LNV proposed, and what the next steps are. The minister answered that the 558 km2 extension in the North Sea Agreement is targeted for 2022 but depends on EU procedures, that the fishers' alternative reduces area and ecological value, and that any boundary change needs consent of all North Sea Agreement partners.
The aim is to implement the measures as quickly as possible.
Inzet is om de maatregelen zo snel als mogelijk uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Geurts over de mentale gezondheid van agrarische ondernemers

MPs Boswijk and Geurts asked the Minister of Agriculture about rising suicide rates among farmers and the gap between farmers and regular mental health care, and what more should be done. The Minister acknowledged the problem, described subsidised projects and sector initiatives to bridge the gap, said a structural follow-up approach and a central referral desk were being prepared, and promised to inform the House once the approach is set.
Once the structural follow-up approach is known and established, I will inform the House of Representatives.
Zodra de structurele vervolgaanpak bekend is en vastgesteld, zal ik de Tweede Kamer informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het voornemen tot overeenkomst voor stikstofsaldering ‘Valkenhorst’ waar het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf van plan is om de stalvergunning van drie agrarische bedrijven te gebruiken vo

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a plan by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf to use the permits of three farms as nitrogen offsetting for 800 homes and a health centre at Valkenhorst, and whether this drains rural land and hampers the shift to circular farming. The minister confirmed the tender, said the land sale is at market value rather than priced per farm or per kg nitrogen, and argued that this internal offsetting within the plan area is legally accepted and not a case of distant buying-out of farm nitrogen space.
Offsetting with space from existing permits is a legally accepted way of mitigating effects when allowing projects on the basis of an appropriate assessment.
Extern salderen met ruimte uit bestaande vergunningen is een juridisch geaccepteerde wijze van mitigatie van effecten bij het toestaan van projecten op basis van een passende beoordeling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Why are peat-based composts banned?’

The MP asks whether peat-based potting soil is sold in the Netherlands, how much it is used, the effects of peat extraction on CO2 emissions and groundwater, and whether the Netherlands should follow the UK ban on peat compost for hobby gardeners. The minister confirms peat is the main ingredient, notes that certified responsibly produced peat is growing in market share, gives no CO2 figures yet, and says the UK approach is not needed given the small Dutch consumer market and the EU fertiliser regulation.
I do not currently have figures available that indicate the exact effect on CO2 emissions.
Ik heb op dit moment geen cijfers beschikbaar die het exacte effect op de CO 2 -uitstoot aangeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de brief ‘Hoe moet het verder met de ontwikkeling van het Wierdense Veld’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the costs, farmer impacts, drinking water supply and legal basis of restoring the Wierdense Veld bog, after the province of Overijssel asked for direction. The Minister answered that restoring the bog is necessary under the Habitats Directive, that the province leads the process, and that she sees no need for independent counter-expertise.
It is therefore not necessary for me to draft such a proposal, because the province of Overijssel will already take this up.
Het is daarom niet nodig dat ik zo’n voorstel uitwerk, omdat de provincie Overijssel dit al zal oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Boswijk over de invoering van de Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Boswijk asked about the Maritime Protection Act (Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij), including the use of Vessel Protection Detachments, piracy in the Gulf of Guinea, and ILT oversight. The government answered in detail, giving request statistics, budget figures, and a reasoned refusal to designate the Gulf of Guinea as a risk area, while promising an EU pilot evaluation and ongoing ILT-Defence arrangements.
Once the results of that are known, your House will be informed about them.
Zodra de resultaten daarvan bekend zijn, zal uw Kamer daarover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Overvallen door stikstofmalaise; Ministerie lijkt niet klaar te zijn geweest voor crisis'

An MP from the CDA asked the minister whether the ministry was prepared for the 2019 Council of State ruling on the PAS nitrogen programme, and why it took so long to assess its consequences and develop a plan B. The minister answered that scenarios were prepared, that the consequences were clear within days, that new nitrogen policy was rolled out step by step and enshrined in law, and that she saw no reason for an internal evaluation.
I see no reason to launch an investigation into this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hier een onderzoek naar in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bisschop over knelgevallen in kader van het fosfaatrechtenstelsel

MPs Boswijk and Bisschop asked whether dairy farms with irreversible investment commitments that could not use their phosphate rights were excluded from the hardship category, whether a count or damage estimate exists, whether a Meststoffenwet exemption is possible, and whether such farms can be exempted. Minister Schouten answered that this group could not be clearly defined and no solution existed without extra general cuts for others, declined to make an inventory as disproportionate, and refused to reopen the exploration given the projected nitrogen overshoot.
I do not consider it useful to make the requested inventory.
Ik acht het niet zinvol de gevraagde inventarisatie te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Geurts over natuur die zich goed ontwikkelt ondanks stikstofdepositie en de definitie van het begrip project bij vergunningsverzoeken

Two CDA MPs asked whether hydrological restoration at Korenburgerveen means nitrogen effects are being offset, and how the legal concept of 'project' under nature permits should be defined and applied. The Minister acknowledged partial improvement from water-management measures but said nitrogen effects remain, that projects must be assessed on significant effects for Natura 2000 areas, and that permits must cover all inseparable parts of an activity.
No, the answer to question 6 shows that the delimitation depends on whether the activity in question may have significant effects on a Natura 2000 area.
Nee, uit het antwoord op vraag 6 blijkt dat de afbakening afhangt van de vraag of de betrokken activiteit significante gevolgen kan hebben voor een Natura 2000-gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Stop procedure voor de radar in Herwijnen’

MP Boswijk asked the State Secretary for Defence why the ministry still suggested the radar might be placed in Herwijnen despite a parliamentary motion to stop that procedure and seek another site, and whether the website wording could be changed. The State Secretary answered that the intention to implement the motion stands, that the Herwijnen site remains the best available on current studies, that the alternative-site and radiation studies are still ongoing with results expected after summer 2021, and that no irreversible steps will be taken in the meantime.

At the same time, due care requires that I have better insight into the consequences of stopping the RCR procedure, so that it is clear how the surveillance of Dutch airspace could otherwise be provided for.
Tegelijkertijd vereist de zorgvuldigheid dat ik meer zicht heb op de gevolgen van het stoppen van de RCR-procedure
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Boswijk en Stoffer over het munitiebudget

MPs Van Wijngaarden, Boswijk and Stoffer asked about a reported cut in the ammunition budget for training from EUR 140 million in 2021 to EUR 80 million in 2023, and its effects on readiness, missions and simulator training. The State Secretary confirmed a structural shortfall of EUR 60 million, partly covered by temporary increases, said cuts would reduce use of expensive munitions while keeping required training levels, and noted that deeper structural fixes depend on future budget room and a future cabinet decision.
It is up to a next cabinet to take a decision on this.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om hierover een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de mogelijkheden tot vervroegde betaling GLB-inkomenssteun in 2021

MP Boswijk asked whether farmers' liquidity problems from COVID-19 have improved, the likely share of farmers in trouble if CAP income support is paid late, and whether national advance payments will be allowed again in 2021. Minister Schouten said there are no clear signs of serious liquidity problems, that about 30% of farmers used advance payments last year, and that the cabinet is still considering a repeat scheme of 80% advances under the de minimis rules.
At present I am considering the possibilities of offering advance payments again in response to the corona crisis.
Op dit moment bezie ik de mogelijkheden om naar aanleiding van de coronacrisis weer voorschotbetalingen aan te bieden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Boswijk en Palland over Nederlandse (midden en klein-)bedrijven meer laten profiteren van grote overheidsaanbestedingen zoals de renovatie van de Afsluitdijk

CDA MPs asked whether Rijkswaterstaat ensured that the Afsluitdijk renovation contract, awarded to Levvel, would use innovative Dutch small and medium enterprises and avoid leakage of money abroad (e.g. Chinese valve products). The minister answered that the contract was tendered as a whole for integrality, that EU procurement law prevents mandating product origin, and that a large share of investment benefits the Dutch economy, though exact figures are withheld for competition reasons.
I cannot make precise figures public for reasons of competition.
Precieze cijfers kan ik uit concurrentieoverwegingen niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Boswijk over lozingen van de chemische industrie op het oppervlaktewater

An MP asked the minister about chemical industry discharges of emerging substances into surface water, including who monitors them, whether a national overview exists, and whether economic motives override risk norms. The minister answered that permitting authorities handle oversight regionally, monitoring is intensive, and emissions are assessed via BBT, cost-effectiveness and immission tests.
A single overview for the whole of the Netherlands is not available and is also not necessary, because this can be addressed well at regional level.
Eén overzicht voor heel Nederland is niet voor handen en ook niet nodig omdat hier regionaal goed invulling aan kan worden gegeven.

verzoekt de regering om samen met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Schoolleiders en de vertegenwoordigers van de schoolbesturen in overleg te treden
Motie Depla c.s. over brede toegankelijkheid van het tweedekansonderwijs
Asks the government, with VNG and MBO Raad, to develop proposals guaranteeing broad accessibility of second-chance education and inform the House.
requests the government, in consultation with VNG and MBO Raad, without prior restrictions, to develop proposals
verzoekt de regering in overleg met de VNG en de MBO Raad, zonder beperkingen vooraf, voorstellen uit te werken
Motie Kraneveldt-van der Veen c.s. over intensief toezicht op nieuw gestichte scholen
Asks the government to propose that the inspectorate keep intensive supervision of newly founded schools, relaxing it once quality conditions are met.
requests the government to formulate proposals so that the inspectorate standardly conducts intensive supervision of newly founded schools
verzoekt de regering om voorstellen te formuleren om de inspectie bij nieuw gestichte scholen standaard intensief toezicht te laten houden
Motie Biskop c.s. over leerhulpmiddelen voor visueel beperkte en dyslectische studenten
Asks the government to send the House an overview of problems obtaining learning aids for visually impaired and dyslexic students, and then a plan to address them.
to send the House a note giving an overview of the bottlenecks
een notitie aan de Kamer te sturen waarin een overzicht wordt gegeven van de knelpunten
Amendement van het lid Jan Jacob van Dijk c.s. over godsdienst-, levensbeschouwelijk of humanistisch vormingsonderwijs
Moves money within the education budget to fund religious and humanist education at public schools through a structural state grant, covered by skimming the price adjustment.
The coverage is found in skimming off the price adjustment.
De dekking wordt gevonden in het afromen van de prijsbijstelling.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over de herijking van de spoorbudgetten en de gevolgen hiervan voor de regio’s en voor PHS

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the re-assessment of rail budgets, the remaining free investment space (about 9 million euro), and consequences for the regions and the high-frequency rail programme PHS, including Gelderland's concerns. The State Secretary answered most questions by referring to the forthcoming MIRT decision process and the PHS progress report, offering only limited figures and no firm commitments on specific projects.
Answer 4: For the available amount, its origin and allocation, I refer you to the proposal that is still subject of discussion in the MIRT administrative consultations.
Voor het beschikbare bedrag, de herkomst en aanwending daarvan verwijs ik u naar het voorstel dat nog onderwerp is van gesprek aan de bestuurlijke overleggen MIRT (zie bijlage) 3 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over trage internetverbindingen in het onderwijs en de ambities op het gebied van digitale leermiddelen en hoogwaardig onderwijs

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education and the Minister of Economic Affairs about slow internet connections in schools and the government's ambitions for digital learning materials. The government says most schools can currently manage with available speeds, describes the Doorbraakproject support and a planned action plan, and says schools should contribute to local broadband initiatives while receiving extra funds.
As a first step, it will be mapped which schools experience problems and which solutions are effective.
Als eerste stap wordt in kaart gebracht welke scholen problemen ervaren en welke oplossingen effectief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Van Haersma Buma, Slob, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Roemer over het bed, bad, brood compromis

MPs from several parties asked the government to explain its reliance on the Council of Europe's Committee of Ministers resolution rejecting the ECSR findings on basic provision for irregular migrants, the conditional 'bed, bath, bread' shelter scheme tied to return cooperation, the funding and sanction mechanism for municipalities, and the buitenschuld permit system. The government answered that the ECSR findings have no basis in the treaty, that Article 3 ECHR sets the floor, that shelter in pre-VBL locations will be time-limited and tied to return efforts, and that details will be settled with the VNG.
It is not for the ECSR to pronounce on the rights of persons residing illegally in our country.
Het is dan ook niet aan het ECSR om zich uit te spreken over de rechten van illegaal in ons land verblijvende personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slob, Van der Staaij en Wilders over de herdenking van de Armeense genocide

MPs Slob, Van der Staaij and Wilders asked whether the cabinet still backs the Rouvoet motion urging Turkey's recognition of the Armenian genocide, given the minister's view that history is not for the cabinet to interpret, and whether a minister would attend the 100-year commemoration in Armenia or in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the cabinet maintains the motion's supportive interpretation and that the Dutch ambassador to Georgia, also accredited to Armenia, will attend the Armenia commemoration, with attendance at other events decided case by case.
The cabinet maintains the interpretation that previous cabinets have given to the motion.
Het kabinet handhaaft de interpretatie die voorgaande kabinetten aan de motie hebben gegeven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Slob over de financiële situatie van kleine ziekenhuizen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the health minister about the financial position of small hospitals, the BDO benchmark finding many in financial danger, their share in shrink regions, the 10-point plan, a availability subsidy, administrative burden, uniform indicators and mergers. The minister acknowledged the report, said hospital boards bear responsibility for their finances, promised to consider regional care and administrative burden measures, and declined to commit to a funding subsidy or hard agreements on indicators.
I consider it important that basic care remains available nearby.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat basiszorg dichtbij beschikbaar blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slob en Dik-Faber over de verkeersveiligheid en de doorstroming op de N36

MPs Slob and Dik-Faber asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about road safety and traffic flow on the N36, including whether the Beerzerveld junction meets the three-star RPS target and whether a grade-separated junction should replace the planned traffic-light solution. The minister confirmed the target and that Beerzerveld has three stars, said traffic flow is not a bottleneck, and stated the traffic-light redesign remains the agreed solution while the regional partners may propose alternatives and preparatory work continues.

In administrative consultation with the region it was agreed that for safety at the Mariënberg (Beerzerweg) junction, redesign with traffic-light installations is the best solution within the existing constraints of time and money.

In het bestuurlijk overleg met de regio is overeengekomen dat voor de veiligheid op de aansluiting bij de Mariënberg (Beerzerweg) de herinrichting met verkeersregelinstallaties de beste oplossing is binnen de bestaande randvoorwaarden, tijd en geld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Roemer, Van Haersma Buma, Wilders, Pechtold, Slob, Van Ojik en Van der Staaij naar aanleiding van zijn uitspraken tijdens het debat op 14 januari jl. over de aanslagen in Parijs

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister whether his remark that the AIVD, with current staffing and funding, can do its job was meant regarding jihadism, how many staff track returnees, whether budget cuts reduced coverage and staff quality, and how police, mayors and national government coordinate. The government replied that all eleven questions were already answered in an earlier letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288), without giving substance in this document.
The written questions ... have been answered by letter 'extra measures counterterrorism and following the debate of 14 January 2015 on the Paris attacks' (Kamerstuk 29 754, no. 288).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «extra maatregelen terrorismebestrijding en n.a.v. debat op 14 januari 2015 over de aanslagen in Parijs» (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Omtzigt, Van Haersma Buma, Voordewind, Slob en Van der Staaij over IS(IS) en de situatie in Irak

Members of parliament from the CDA, ChristenUnie and SGP asked the government about the humanitarian emergency facing Yazidis and Christians fleeing IS in Iraq, US airstrikes and genocide claims, and whether Dutch and EU action is adequate. The minister answered that the government supports US aid to Iraq, has given an extra 400,000 euro via the Red Cross, is examining airlift support through defence, and is pressing for a unity government in Baghdad.

In response to the current humanitarian crisis, the cabinet has decided to immediately provide an extra 400,000 euro via the Netherlands Red Cross to the International Red Cross for emergency aid in Iraq.

Naar aanleiding van de huidige humanitaire crisis heeft het kabinet besloten onverwijld een extra bijdrage van 400 000 Euro via het Nederlandse Rode Kruis te geven aan het Internationale Rode Kruis ten behoeve van noodhulp in Irak.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius, Van Hijum en Slob over de situatie dat Zwolse rolstoelafhankelijke vrouwen voor de screening op borstkanker niet meer terecht kunnen in het ziekenhuis in Zwolle

MPs asked why wheelchair-dependent women from Zwolle cannot use the Isala hospital for breast cancer screening and must travel to a fixed unit in Apeldoorn, and whether the 45-minute travel rule and Valys transport limits should be changed. The minister confirms the situation, defends the policy of prioritising fixed units for quality reasons, refuses to exempt screening trips from Valys kilometre limits, and mentions a possible fixed unit in Zwolle.
I am not willing to exempt transport to the population screening from the maximum number of kilometres a person can travel per year with Valys, as this could set a precedent for other situations.

Ik ben niet bereid om het vervoer naar het bevolkingsonderzoek uit te zonderen van het maximaal aantal kilometers dat iemand op jaarbasis met Valys kan reizen aangezien dit een precedent kan scheppen voor andere situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over het ‘Masterplan Toekomst IJsselmeer’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Masterplan for the future of the IJsselmeer, including funding for a transition fund, a possible three-year fishing halt, compensation and buyout of fishers, and the rejected fishing plan. The State Secretary answered that a total package is important, that the EUR 2.25 million transition budget is for sustainable fishing and ecology rather than buyouts, that other ministries are responsible for funding sources, and that a full response would follow within two weeks.
I consider it very important to come to a total package for the IJsselmeer fisheries, including the deployment of financial resources.
Ik acht het van groot belang om met een totaalpakket voor de IJsselmeervisserij te komen, inclusief inzet van financiële middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slob en Segers over afschaffing slavernij

MPs Slob and Segers asked why the Netherlands did not sign the 1949 UN Convention on trafficking and prostitution, whether it will do so, what anti-trafficking goals exist, and how the government addresses the legacy of slavery such as discrimination. The government answered that it will not join the convention because it would criminalise exploitation of adult voluntary prostitution, that regulation is preferred, and outlined trafficking task force and referral mechanism plans plus commemoration and anti-discrimination actions.
The Netherlands does not intend to become a party to the UN Convention.
Nederland is niet van plan partij bij het VN-Verdrag te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over het stoppen van vergoedingen onbeperkt fysiotherapie

MP Slob asked why four insurers are ending unlimited physiotherapy reimbursement in supplementary insurance, how many people use it, and whether the minister will consult insurers, patient groups and the physiotherapy association. The minister says insurers decide coverage independently, declines to share enrollment figures citing commercial confidentiality, and refuses further consultation because seven insurers still offer unlimited cover.
I do not have this information. Such data is commercially sensitive, which insurers do not disclose for competitive reasons.
Ik heb niet de beschikking over deze informatie. Dergelijke gegevens betreffen bedrijfsgevoelige informatie die de verzekeraars uit concurrentieoverwegingen niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Slob over vergelijkingssites zorgverzekeringen

MPs Dik-Faber and Slob asked the health minister about health insurance comparison websites, including conflicting rankings, whether sites show only policies sold through them, and commissions paid by insurers. The minister answered that transparency about comparison methods and business models is important, pointed to AFM rules and planned deeper AFM review in 2014, and said government no longer provides insurance comparison information via KiesBeter.
The AFM is considering conducting more in-depth research in 2014 into how the comparison is produced.
De AFM overweegt om in 2014 diepgaander onderzoek te doen naar de wijze waarop de vergelijking tot stand komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over de aanhoudende berichten van geweld tegen Koptische christenen in Egypte

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he knew of the Human Rights Watch report on sectarian attacks on Coptic Christians in Egypt and what steps had been taken, including at EU level, to press the Egyptian interim government to protect them. The minister said the government condemns sectarian violence, raised rights and an inclusive transition with Egyptian leaders on 7 August, and that the EU condemned the attacks and addressed them in Council conclusions on 21 August.
The cabinet is concerned about the position of religious minorities in Egypt and condemns all forms of sectarian violence.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over de positie van religieuze minderheden in Egypte en veroordeelt iedere vorm van sektarisch geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over de toekomst  van de spoedeisende hulp in Meppel

An MP asked the health minister about reports that the emergency department in Meppel might move to Zwolle, and what that would mean for acute care access and norms in the region. The minister said there is no plan to move the emergency department, that talks with insurers on regional acute care are ongoing, and that any future changes would have to keep access guaranteed through the regional acute care consultation.
As indicated in question 2, there is currently no question of the emergency department in Meppel disappearing.
Zoals in vraag 2 aangegeven is er op dit moment geen sprake van het verdwijnen van de Spoedeisende Hulp uit Meppel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haersma Buma, Pechtold, Slob, Van Ojik en Van der Staaij over de gevolgen van het akkoord voor de ontwikkeling van het (structurele) EMU-saldo en de staatsschuld in de periode 2014-201

MPs from CDA, D66, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks and SGP asked the government how the social accord affects the structural EMU balance, debt, the 3% deficit target, and the WW premium changes. The minister replied that the accord causes a shortfall of 119 million structurally and up to 543 million in 2017, that the government abandons the 4.3 billion supplementary package but will take further measures if the CPB forecast requires it, and that a CPB analysis of structural effects will come with the June forecast.
The cabinet will take additional measures if the CPB's MEV forecast, given the 2014 balance target, gives reason to do so.
Het kabinet zal aanvullende maatregelen nemen indien de MEV-raming van het CPB gegeven het saldodoel 2014 daartoe aanleiding geeft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Slob met betrekking tot de situatie in de haven van Boulogne

An MP asked the state secretary whether France's new restriction on Dutch fly-shooters in the port of Boulogne breaches the code of conduct and why talks with the port authorities were delayed. The state secretary confirmed the restriction is contrary to the code, raised it with the French minister, and said the situation was positively resolved from early March with police protection added.
Yes, I spoke with my French counterpart about this in Brussels on Tuesday 26 February 2013.
Ja, ik heb mijn Franse ambtsgenoot hier dinsdag 26 februari 2013 in Brussel over gesproken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Slob over contant betalen bij de apotheek

An MP asks the health minister about insured DSW clients of BENU/Escura/Lloyd pharmacies being told to pay cash because no contract exists, and whether insurers must disclose contracted providers before enrolment. The minister says a new contract was concluded, that restitution policies oblige insurers to reimburse, that NZa supervises disclosure rules, and that a legislative amendment and talks on faster contracting are underway, while refusing a legal right to switch insurers twice a year.
I will keep you informed of the progress.
Ik zal u van de voortgang op de hoogte houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over de sluiting van de brandweerpost in Swalmen

MP Slob (ChristenUnie) asked the minister whether the Limburg-Noord safety region's decision to close the Swalmen fire post, given its low response-time compliance, complied with the required coverage plan, and what would be done to improve response times. The minister answered that closure is a municipal responsibility now and a regional one from 2013, pointed to the regional board's actualisation of the coverage plan, and said the Inspectorate will re-examine response times in early 2013.
If the findings of the Inspectorate give cause for it, I will call the chair of the safety region to account.
Indien de bevindingen van de Inspectie VenJ daartoe aanleiding geven, zal ik de betreffende voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio aanspreken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Slob over de aanpak van transportbendes

MP Slob asks why the national transport crime team and the dedicated prosecutor are being abolished with the arrival of the national police, and how the team's successes will be secured. The minister replies that the team's knowledge and expertise will be secured within the national police, that an evaluation and prosecution advice is being considered by the College of Procurators-General, and that the public-private approach will not be abandoned.
I will ensure that the intended objectives of establishing the transport crime team and the national prosecutor for transport crime, and the approaches they developed, are secured.

Ik zal erop toezien dat de beoogde doelstellingen van de instelling van het team transportcriminaliteit en de landelijk officier transportcriminaliteit en de door hen ontwikkelde aanpakken worden geborgd.
Antwoord vragen Slob over de veiling van GSM-frequenties en de mogelijke interferentie met GSM-Rail

MP Slob asked ministers whether the 2012 auction of mobile frequencies would cause interference with GSM-R railway communications, including its frequency, costs, safeguards and whether licence conditions protect rail safety. The ministers acknowledge interference at several sites, describe filters, a new 'adequate protection' licence condition, ongoing studies of signal-strength ceilings and cost questions, and state that no irreversible steps have been taken before the auction starts on 31 October 2012.

On 18 April 2012 I informed your House that the start of the application procedure for potential auction participants from 16 April 2012 is not an irreversible step regarding the resolution of the possible interference problems.

Op 18 april 2012 heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd dat de start van de aanvraagprocedure voor potentiële deelnemers aan de veiling vanaf 16 april 2012 geen onomkeerbare stap is met betrekking tot het oplossen van de mogelijke interferentieproblemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Slob over realisatie van station Barneveld-Zuid

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about delays to the Barneveld-Zuid railway station, including its opening date, a temporary stop, and whether ProRail's linking with the Barneveld Noord double-track project was justified. The minister answered that ProRail expects opening in 2015, that the delay was partly due to a link with the Barneveld Noord project which has since been revised, that a temporary facility is not a clear option, and that a cost-effective capacity package on the Valleilijn will be sent to the House once NS agrees.
I am willing to send the elaboration of the cost-effective measures to improve the robustness of the Valleilijn to the House of Representatives as soon as it is available.
Ik ben bereid de uitwerking van de kosteneffectieve maatregelen ter verbetering van de robuustheid van de Valleilijn aan de Tweede Kamer toe te zenden, zodra die beschikbaar is.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de voortgang van de ombouw van de Hoekse Lijn tot metro (ingezonden 7 maart 2011).

An MP asks the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the conversion of the Hoekse Lijn to metro, including projected passenger growth, ProRail's stance on transferring management, the request to delist the line from the main rail network, tendering of the concession, and financing from the regional BDU fund. The minister answers that a 30% passenger growth is realistic, that the line can be designated a local railway once conditions on safety, freight access and financing are met, and that the region is responsible for financing the conversion.
To make the conversion possible, I earlier this year informed the Rotterdam city region of my intention to designate the Hoekse Lijn as a local railway.
Om de ombouw mogelijk te maken heb ik begin dit jaar aan de stadsregio Rotterdam mijn voornemen kenbaar gemaakt om de Hoekse lijn als lokale spoorweg aan te wijzen.

MP Slob (ChristenUnie) asked ministers of Justice and Security and of Infrastructure and Environment about copper theft on and near the railways, including concrete measures, statistics, risk locations, sentencing, registration rules and European cooperation. Minister Opstelten answered with figures from ProRail, an action plan with ID requirements for copper purchases planned for 2013, a sentencing guideline expected in autumn 2012, and ongoing cooperation in the Waakzaam Koperslag project, while stating some conclusions are premature.
The Public Prosecution Service expects that the present guideline can take effect in autumn 2012.
Het Openbaar Ministerie verwacht dat de onderhavige richtlijn in het najaar van 2012 van kracht kan zijn.
Antwoord vragen Slob over de verkeersveiligheid op de A44 bij de Kaagbrug

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about road safety on the A44 at the Kaagbrug after reported multi-car collisions, including whether the bridge's road layout and sun glare contribute. The minister acknowledged an elevated accident count but no black spot, found no bumps, noted the narrow profile, and announced warning signs, a 100 km/h limit and a structural review by Rijkswaterstaat.
I will place warning signs in the short term in connection with the narrowed road profile, and locally I will introduce a speed limit of 100 km/h.
Ik plaats op korte termijn waarschuwingsborden in verband met het versmalde wegbeeld en lokaal zal ik een snelheidsbeperking van 100 km/u instellen.

An MP asks whether the Dutch guardrail type is outdated and no longer used elsewhere in Europe, and why better alternatives are used only at high-risk locations. The minister answers that the type is also used in Belgium and Germany, meets the European H2 standard, and that a higher-containment guardrail is not always safer, so it is used only in specific situations.
This type meets the European standard (performance class H2).
Dit type voldoet aan de Europese norm (prestatieklasse H2).
Antwoord vragen Slob n.a.v. het bericht “kort volgen op de Flevolijn niet haalbaar” van de provincie Flevoland

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the minister about the feasibility of 'kort volgen' (shortened train headways) for the OV-SAAL rail corridor, including a delayed consultation with regional authorities, the NS factsheet doubting its adequacy, and the promised second opinion. The minister answered that the consultation is pending, the second opinion is due before summer recess, no assessment of the cost and legal aspects is yet needed, and first steps (signal optimisation on the Flevolijn) will proceed in 2016.
The requested report I cannot yet send you, because it is not yet available.
Het gevraagde rapport kan ik u echter nog niet toesturen omdat het nog niet beschikbaar is.
Antwoord vragen Slob over het bericht  ‘Kamervragen Zevenaar’

An MP asks the minister about the planned change of the 1500 V overhead power at Zevenaar, which may create a new power-system barrier for cross-border passenger trains to Germany, and about whether the procedure under the Spoorwegwet was followed. The minister answers that the procedure is correct, that no formal decision under article 17(3) is needed, and that the 25 kV change will go ahead as planned despite NS Hispeed's objections.
No, this does not concern a decision under article 17(3).
Nee, het betreft hier geen besluit conform artikel 17 lid 3.
Antwoord vragen Slob over een voorlopige voorziening aangaande de spieringvisserij

An MP asked whether the Council of State's suspension of the spiering fishing permit, and the timing of the permit and opening decree, could be remedied so fishers get the full three weeks. The state secretary confirmed the facts, explained the permit timing was aligned with publication, and said the rules do not allow extending the period.
Article 65 of the Fisheries Implementation Regulation does not offer this possibility.
Artikel 65 van de Uitvoeringsregeling visserij biedt deze mogelijkheid niet.
Antwoord vragen Slob over de Natuurbeschermingswet-vergunning en de spieringvisserij op het IJsselmeer

An MP asked the state secretary about permits for the smelt (spiering) fishery on the IJsselmeer and Markermeer, including the split between Rijk and province, the handling of the catch threshold, and pending appeals. The answers state that the smelt fishery was licensed under the Visserijwet rather than the Nb-wet, that the Markermeer permit prohibits smelt fishing because the threshold of 2100 per hectare was not met, and that the minister will revise the 2007 protocol without planning a single integrated permit.
I foresee no process to adjust the permit procedure so that there will be a single integrated permit.
Ik voorzie geen traject om de vergunningsprocedure zodanig aan te passen dat sprake zal zijn van één integrale vergunning.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur & Milieu over de overwegbotsing bij Maarsbergen (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asked why the Maarsbergen level-crossing project, planned since 2008 and granted a realisation decision in 2010, had still not started, and whether the planned works still allow for four tracks. The minister explained that renewed local objections over traffic at a neighbouring junction required further agreement, with construction now expected in 2014 and opening in 2015, and confirmed the crossing does not preclude four-tracking.
A realisation decision is in principle only granted once there is agreement with the region on the plan.
Een realisatiebeschikking wordt in principe pas verleend als er met de regio overeenstemming is over het plan.
Antwoord vragen Slob over de stremming van de sluis bij Eefde

An MP asked the minister why the Eefde lock capacity expansion decision was still pending, whether a second lock chamber could be built sooner, and whether there is a funding shortfall. The minister answered that the decision slips to Q1 2012, the second chamber starts in 2014 and opens in 2017, and no shortfall exists since a budget portion will be allocated.
The MIRT project book 2012 lists the end of 2011 as the deadline for the preferred-option decision for the Eefde lock.
Het MIRT projectenboek 2012 vermeldt eind 2011 als termijn voor de Voorkeursbeslissing voor sluis Eefde.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over wachttijden bij in- en uitcheckpaaltjes voor de OV-chipkaart op stations (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

MP Slob asks the minister about long waiting times at OV-chipkaart check-in and check-out poles at stations, notably Overveen with only two poles, and whether NS will set a maximum waiting time and install more poles before 1 January. The minister says NS monitors crowding and will add temporary card readers or permanent poles where waiting times prove structurally too long, but sees no reason for further agreements now.

If it becomes clear that waiting times at the check-in and check-out poles are structurally too long at some stations, NS will temporarily place mobile card readers and then, if necessary, install additional permanent poles.

Als hieruit blijkt dat de wachttijden bij de in- en uitcheckpalen op sommige stations structureel te lang zijn, dan zal NS tijdelijk mobiele kaartlezers plaatsen en daarna, indien noodzakelijk, overgaan tot het bijplaatsen van «permanente» in- en uitcheckpalen.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over spoorverbindingen vanuit Brabant richting Antwerpen (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether the Beneluxtrein connection from Brabant to Belgium will end in December 2011, and why the minister does not keep a prior promise to maintain it until an HSL alternative exists. The minister replies that the train will continue until the Fyra serves Amsterdam-Brussels 16 times daily, probably into summer 2012, but says the minister lacks formal authority over the NS-NMBS service and will only seek a new link and inform parliament later.
Since the Beneluxtrein runs under a cooperation between NMBS and NS, I formally have no authority over this train connection.
Aangezien de Beneluxtrein rijdt op basis van een samenwerkingsverband tussen NMBS en NS, heb ik formeel geen bevoegdheid over deze treinverbinding.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over marktwerking op het spoor (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the minister whether the new main rail concession should set detailed, line-level performance targets, whether monitoring should be done by an independent body, whether NS-dependent regional operators need oversight, and whether the NMa has enough powers. The minister replied that network-wide targets are preferred to avoid sub-optimisation, that self-monitoring with audit rights suffices, that NMa already has oversight powers under the Mededingingswet, and that a pilot on regional rerouting is ongoing.
Furthermore, it is important to me that performance is measured in the same way over a longer period in order to gain insight into developments in performance.
Daarnaast is het voor mij belangrijk dat de prestaties gedurende langere tijd op dezelfde wijze gemeten worden om inzicht te krijgen in de ontwikkelingen van de prestaties.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de overbelastverklaring van de spoorlijnen Tiel/Nijmegen-Elst-Arnhem (ingezonden 8 september 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether ProRail should have issued an earlier capacity overload declaration to prevent the planned splitting of the Tiel/Nijmegen-Elst-Arnhem rail service, and whether the minister will instruct ProRail to keep all trains running. The minister replies that ProRail acted in line with EU rules, that solutions are still being studied, and that no directive will be given until the capacity studies are complete.
It is not yet clear whether this train service can no longer be operated as a through service.
Het is nog niet duidelijk of deze treindienst niet meer als doorgaande treindienst kan worden uitgevoerd.
