Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de spoorverbinding Roosendaal-Antwerpen (ingezonden 7 juli 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the rail link Roosendaal-Antwerp, including whether principle agreements exist on a fast stopping train, why a stopping train was chosen over extending the intercity, whether NMBS plans an extra train by December 2011, whether a business case was made, and whether the faster route is only temporary. The minister answered that no principle agreements exist yet, NMBS sees no short-term extension, a business case was not produced because NMBS deems the service loss-making and extending the intercity technically unfeasible, and NMBS expects the tunnel route to continue after works end.
I am pursuing the Benelux Parliament's recommendation to reach agreements on improving rail services between Roosendaal and Antwerp in full.
Ik streef de aanbeveling van het Beneluxparlement om te komen tot afspraken over verbetering van het treinaanbod tussen Roosendaal en Antwerpen ten volle na.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP) en Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de maatregelen tegen gewetensbezwaarde ambtenaren in Groningen (ingezonden 5 augustus 201

MPs Van der Staaij and Slob asked the minister about Groningen not renewing the contracts of three civil-registry officials with conscientious objections to same-sex marriage, and whether such measures are justified. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for personnel policy within legal bounds, that practical solutions are for the municipality to assess, and that he will not take measures against municipalities requiring officials to perform all marriages given local autonomy.
Given municipal autonomy, I do not intend to take measures against municipalities that impose as a job requirement that an official must conduct all marriages.
Gelet op de gemeentelijke autonomie ben ik niet voornemens maatregelen te treffen tegen gemeenten die als functie-eis stellen dat een ambtenaar alle huwelijken moet sluiten.

Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over kosteneffectieve capaciteitsuitbreiding van de Valleilijn en andere kleinschalige spoorprojecten (ingezonden 11 juli 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why a quick scan for expanding capacity on the Valleilijn requires costly grade-separation tunnels, questioning the cost-effectiveness of the proposed measures and the cost per metre compared with the Hanzelijn. The Minister answered that no statutory duty requires tunnels but the Third Railway Safety Framework requires that level-crossing safety not deteriorate, that a detailed risk analysis is still needed, and that the Valleilijn has a high crossing density, while rejecting a direct cost comparison with the Hanzelijn.
Follow-up research would be needed to better establish the actual necessity, feasibility and costs of the measures.
Vervolgonderzoek zou nodig zijn om de feitelijke noodzaak, de inpasbaarheid en de kosten van de maatregelen beter in beeld te krijgen
Vragen van de leden Haverkamp (CDA), Slob (ChristenUnie) en Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de vertraging ombouw station Enschede (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

MPs Haverkamp, Slob and Omtzigt asked why the reconstruction of Enschede station was delayed and whether a parliamentary motion on cross-border through-connection had been taken into account. The minister answered that the delay stems from new timetable insights requiring 60 km/h switches, and that the motion is separate and will be decided after a study expected to report in October.
I expect to be able to inform the House of the outcomes and the decision to be taken in October.
Ik verwacht de Kamer over de uitkomsten en het te nemen besluit in oktober te kunnen berichten.

Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de samenwerking met Duitsland bij de verkoop van treinkaartjes voor spoorvervoer Limburg (ingezonden 20 mei 2011).

An MP asked the minister why NS does not accept the cross-border Euregioticket on regional trains in Limburg and refuses to join a Floriade combi-ticket, and whether the minister will press NS. The minister said NS cannot be legally obliged to accept the ticket, but will discuss acceptance options, handyticket use and the Floriade initiative with NS.
However, I will enter into discussion with NS to explore the possibilities for accepting regional tickets, such as the Euregioticket.
Ik zal echter wel in gesprek met NS treden, om met hen de mogelijkheden te bespreken voor acceptatie van regionale vervoerbewijzen, zoals het Euregioticket.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het vier weken sluiten van spoorknooppunt Zwolle (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

An MP asked the minister why Zwolle rail junction must close for four weeks, whether relay signalling is outdated and wasteful, and whether alternatives like a temporary terminal, a shortened Almelo-Vroomshoop line and an earlier Hanzelijn opening were considered. The minister answered that ProRail chose one long closure for practical reasons, defended relay technology as cost-effective, outlined the alternatives examined, and declined to order the regional projects, citing the usual decision procedures.
On the basis of the above, I see no reason to instruct ProRail to realise this project by spring 2012.
Op basis van bovenstaande zie ik geen reden om ProRail op te dragen dit project uiterlijk in het voorjaar van 2012 te laten realiseren.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de plannen van ProRail om een groot aantal wissels te slopen (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

MP Slob asks the minister about ProRail's plans to demolish many railway switches, asking for the internal report, its effects on passengers, future timetables, maintenance costs, and consultation of carriers and passenger organisations. The minister says the report is an internal draft on cost-saving methodology not shared with Parliament, that major switch changes require ministerial approval after carrier consultation, and promises to inform Parliament after the summer.
In view of the above, I do not have a document to assess now for sending to the House of Representatives.
Gelet op het bovenstaande beschik ik dus niet over een document om nu te beoordelen of aan de Tweede Kamer te sturen.

Vragen van de leden Roemer (SP), Cohen (PvdA), Wilders (PVV), Sap (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP), Blok (VVD), Slob (ChristenUnie), Thieme (PvdD), Pechtold (D66) en Van Haersma Buma (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van V

MPs from ten parties asked the state secretary of Security and Justice why Germany refused to extradite the fugitive war criminal Klaas-Carel Faber, whether German nationality obtained through a Hitler decree was the reason, and whether the Netherlands would press Germany to enforce the sentence. The minister answered that a Munich court refused extradition because Faber is a German national who did not consent, that German authorities also consider him German without the decree, and that letters were sent to the Bavarian and federal German justice ministers asking that the sentence be enforced in Germany.
By letter of 31 May 2011 I made known to the Minister of Justice of the German state of Bavaria the importance I attach to the law taking its course in this case.
Bij brief van 31 mei 2011 heb ik het belang dat ik eraan hecht dat in deze zaak het recht zijn loop krijgt kenbaar gemaakt aan de Minister van Justitie van de Duitse deelstaat Beieren.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp (CDA) en Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over Euroterminal Coevorden (1712) en de spoorcapaciteit Zwolle–Coevorden–Emmen (1713) (ingezonden 1 april 2011).

The MPs ask about the rail capacity dilemma for freight transport to Euroterminal Coevorden, including whether a freight path is available on Zwolle–Coevorden–Emmen, the effect on passenger services, and the planned amendment to the capacity allocation AMvB. The minister acknowledges the tension, says a freight path is available from around 22:00, notes that concession conditions do not a priori block cooperation, and says the AMvB amendment will be split, with the second part sent to parliament after summer 2011.
The second part will be submitted to your House for prior review after the summer of 2011.
Dit tweede deel zal na de zomer van 2011 bij uw Kamer worden voorgehangen.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de trage procedures en hoge kosten bij de verlenging van rijbewijzen (ingezonden 22 april 2011).

An MP asks the minister about slow processing, long waits for driving tests and medical examinations, and high costs when seniors renew driving licences through the CBR. The minister replies that timelines are set in the Reglement Rijbewijzen, that delays often stem from medical specialists and applicants, that reminder letters will go out 24 weeks ahead, and that the CBR will provide more procedural information.
I have asked the CBR to provide additional information about the procedure to be followed and the associated timeframes, for example on the CBR website.
Ik heb het CBR verzocht zorg te dragen voor extra informatie over de te volgen procedure en de bijbehorende termijnen, bij voorbeeld op de website van het CBR.

Vragen van de leden Slob (ChristenUnie), Koppejan (CDA), Dijkgraaf (SGP) en Houwer (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over blokkades van Franse havens (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

MPs asked the state secretary about French blockades of ports that prevented Dutch fishermen from sailing and whether Dutch fishermen in the Channel had legal rights and protection from French authorities. The state secretary answered that French authorities advised temporarily avoiding landings in northern French ports, that this advice was later narrowed to landing in Boulogne sur Mer, and that blockades conflict with free movement and a consultation was planned.
I consider blockades of ports and obstruction of fishing activities to be contrary to European free movement.
Blokkades van havens en het hinderen van visserij activiteiten acht ik in strijd met het Europese vrije verkeer.

Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over handhaving door waterpolitie, Rijkswaterstaat en Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat van de Binnenvaartwet (ingezonden 8 maart 2011).

An MP asked the minister about enforcement of the Inland Shipping Act after enforcement tasks shifted from the water police to IVW and Rijkswaterstaat, including concerns over nautical expertise, fine reports, and planned capacity cuts. The minister denied that a 16% cut was decided, said nautical knowledge and enforcement credibility are adequately safeguarded, and acknowledged quality problems with fine reports and a temporary halt of administrative enforcement.
To further improve the quality of fine reports, IenM has taken a number of measures, including an additional peer review of their quality.
Om de kwaliteit van boeterapporten verder te verbeteren is ook binnen IenM een aantal maatregelen getroffen, waaronder een extra collegiale toets op de kwaliteit hiervan.

Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bevriezen van het budget voor Programma Hoogfrequent Spoorvervoer en het ophogen van het budget voor wegenprojecten rond Amster

An MP asks the minister why the rail high-frequency programme budget may be frozen against inflation while the Schiphol–Amsterdam–Almere road budget was raised by 190 million euro, and about cost margins. The minister denies the freeze plan, says indexation is normally added to programmes with an exception in 2010, explains the road increase had separate grounds, and states that all projects use binding budgets with normal estimate uncertainty.
The possible size of the effect on the PHS budget cannot be stated.
De eventuele omvang van het effect op het PHS budget is niet aan te geven.

Vragen van de leden De Boer (VVD), Van Bochove (CDA) en Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de belangenafwijking van een kraakpand (ingezo

Three MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Interior about a court ruling that refused eviction of a squatted building and whether a balancing of interests must now be made, and how property rights will be protected. The minister answers that the Squatting and Vacancy Act already protects property, cites recent rulings and a pending cassation appeal, and sees no reason yet for additional measures.
Pending the outcome of this cassation procedure, there is for me no reason to take additional measures to protect property rights.
In afwachting van de uitkomsten van deze cassatieprocedure bestaat er voor mij geen aanleiding aanvullende maatregelen te nemen ter bescherming van het eigendomsrecht.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over knooppunt Hoevelaken en de aansluiting A1/A30 (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

An MP asks the minister about a funding shortfall for redeveloping the Hoevelaken interchange, whether the Hoevelaken exit may disappear, and related questions on the A28/A1/A30 road projects, environmental mitigation, cost transparency, market consultation and benuttingsmiddelen. The minister confirms the reference design costs well above budget, explains that the Hoevelaken exit is omitted for safety and cost reasons, says cost estimates were shared with the region in February, and declines to include the A1/A30 junction in the study.
At the end of February the cost estimate of the reference design, after careful internal checking, was made available to the province and the municipalities concerned as input for Value Engineering.
Eind februari is de raming van het referentie-ontwerp na zorgvuldige interne controle beschikbaar gesteld aan de provincie en de betrokken gemeenten als input voor de Value Engineering.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Slob (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie naar aanleiding van de beantwoording van d

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Slob ask whether newspaper publishers, who face little competition in national distribution and cannot easily switch contractors, can fairly be fully fined under the Dutch Foreign Workers Employment Act (Wav) chain liability. The ministers answer that competition is irrelevant to compliance, publishers must ensure lawful outsourcing, and fines are moderated only where the client bears reduced culpability, with pending court cases to clarify this.
A client is in principle held to account and fined for violations by subcontractors or service providers.
Een opdrachtgever wordt in beginsel aangesproken en beboet voor overtredingen van onderaannemers of dienstverleners.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over carpoolplaatsen langs de A27 (ingezonden 23 februari 2011).

An MP asked the minister about full carpool parking places along the A27 at peak hours, whether more spaces could ease congestion at Gorinchem and boost public transport, and whether extra spaces would be added during roadworks and a central-reservation rail reservation considered. The minister confirmed the lots fill by 6 am, said widening the road is the structural answer, promised temporary measures to be fixed later in an integrated plan with local authorities, said she lacks an overview of occupancy on decentralised roads (promising a letter on Beter Benutten), and said the rail reservation question awaits a provincial study that she will weigh.
For temporary measures see the answer to question 4. As a structural solution I am focusing on widening the road.
Voor tijdelijke maatregelen het antwoord op vraag 4. Als structurele oplossing zet ik in op verbreding van de weg.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over goedkope groeikansen op het spoor Zwolle–Utrecht (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

An MP asks the minister about cheap rail capacity options on the Zwolle–Utrecht corridor, including a new Nijkerk Corlaer station, a quarter-hourly intercity and passing tracks at Harderwijk and Bilthoven. The minister rejects the Nijkerk and frequency ideas as disproportionate, says the Harderwijk and Bilthoven tracks cannot be funded or fitted in, and promises ProRail will study the Valleilijn option and report to the House by 1 July 2011.
I will inform the House, as requested, before 1 July 2011.
Ik zal de Kamer, zoals verzocht, vóór 1 juli 2011 informeren.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over Euroterminal Coevorden en spoorcapaciteit Zwolle–Coevorden–Emmen (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

An MP asks whether ProRail may effectively close the Zwolle–Coevorden–Emmen rail line to freight for most of the day, whether freight trains are blocked because a carrier uses one locomotive, and whether the line should be declared overloaded. The minister denies ProRail has closed the line, says the three ad-hoc requests could not be fitted in, leaves locomotive choice to the carrier, and states the line is not yet overloaded but may be in future allocation rounds.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het Dokkumer Lokaaltje (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether ProRail is dismantling the last authentic Northern Frisian local railway (Dokkumer Lokaaltje), whether this burdens a foundation planning a heritage line, and whether ProRail should be asked to stop. The minister answers that the 2003 sanitation request was properly followed, that ProRail removed the tracks now because scrap prices are favourable, that the track was already unusable so no extra costs arise, and that no land has been sold yet, but does not commit to halting the works.
Given the currently favourable price of raw materials, ProRail has decided to start the demolition now.
ProRail heeft, gezien de huidige gunstige prijs van grondstoffen, besloten om de sloop nu ter hand te nemen.

Vragen van de leden Slob (ChristenUnie), Dijksma (PvdA), Bashir (SP), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Verhoeven (D66) en Thieme (PVDD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de voortgang van de werkzaamheden Landtu

Six MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the schedule, budget and legal challenges for the A2 Leidsche Rijn tunnel and the temporary bypass. The minister answered that the schedule and budget are unchanged, the court rejected residents' challenge on 11 February 2011, and the bypass will open by 1 April 2011.
On Friday 11 February 2011 the court ruled. The appeal was declared unfounded and the request for an interim injunction was also rejected.
Op vrijdag 11 februari 2011 heeft de Rechtbank uitspraak gedaan. Het beroep is ongegrond verklaard en ook het verzoek voor een voorlopige voorziening is afgewezen.

Vragen van de leden Slob en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het Rijksinpassingsplan Windmolenpark No

MPs Slob and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked why the Noordoostpolder wind park spatial plan was adopted before a meeting with Urk, whether NUON wind plans in eastern Flevoland are being considered together, and whether alternative sites were studied. The minister replied that Urk was consulted repeatedly, seven turbines were dropped in response, the EIA addendum examined alternative locations, and follow-up talks were held.
I have informed your House separately about the outcomes of those talks.
Over de uitkomsten van die gesprekken heb ik uw Kamer separaat geïnformeerd.

Vragen van de leden Slob en Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het stopzetten van tenders (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

MPs Slob and Ortega-Martijn asked whether the government had halted new Rijksgebouwendienst investment projects, what compensation and costs market parties face, whether the investment team capacity and PPP market are harmed, and how this fits the Hoge Raad PPP tender. The minister confirmed a temporary investment stop on new housing and ICT projects, said no compensation is in principle due, and expected no lasting harm to the PPP market.
No, the government has no insight into the costs that private parties incur to make offers.
Nee, de overheid heeft geen inzicht in de kosten die private partijen maken voor het doen van aanbiedingen.

Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bestrijdingsmiddelen in pangavis (ingezonden 23 decemb

An MP asked ministers about pesticide residues (chlorpyrifos, trifluralin) found in Vietnamese pangasius, EU import controls, and EU residue limits for fish. The government answered that residues found pose no health risk, import controls exist, and it will raise the issue with Vietnamese authorities.
However, State Secretary Bleker of EL&I will raise the presence of trifluralin and chlorpyrifos residues in pangasius fillet with the Vietnamese authorities.
Wel zal staatssecretaris Bleker van EL&I de aanwezigheid van residuen van trifluralin en chloorpyrifos in pangasiusfilet aankaarten bij de Vietnamese autoriteiten

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Slob (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de gevolgen van ketenaansprakelijkheid op grond

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Slob asked about court rulings holding PCM Distributiebedrijf and newspaper publishers liable for illegal deliverers under the Dutch Foreign Workers Act, whether fine-setting should reflect culpability, communication with industry, evaluation of the broad employer concept, and bankruptcies from fines. The minister answered that the Council of State found publishers fully culpable, that fine guidelines already reflect culpability, that communication and consultation with the press sector occur, that the broad employer concept will be kept, and that payment arrangements are available though bankruptcy data are not kept.
It is not known whether, and if so how many, companies have gone bankrupt as a result of administrative fines.
Het is niet bekend of en zo ja, hoeveel bedrijven er naar aanleiding van bestuurlijke boetes failliet zijn gegaan.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over strooizout op rantsoen (ingezonden 15 december 2010).

An MP asked the minister about reported salt shortages for winter road gritting, the adequacy of Rijkswaterstaat's salt stock, the salt-loket system and its scope, and alternatives to salt. The minister answered that the stockpile was raised and supplemented by contracts, that alternatives such as brine are being pursued, and that road managers bear responsibility for choosing gritting materials.
Because each road manager is itself responsible for winter road maintenance in its area, it is up to the decentralised authorities to weigh which gritting materials to use.

Omdat elke wegbeheerder zelf verantwoordelijk is voor de gladheidsbestrijding op de wegen in zijn gebied is het aan de decentrale overheden om de afweging te maken welke strooimiddelen worden ingezet.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Slob (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Financiën en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het omwisselen van de Naf (Antilliaanse gulden) (ingezonden

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Slob asked why Antillean guilders can no longer be exchanged in the Netherlands, why the fixed-rate exchange into US dollars is limited to Caribbean Netherlands residents, how citizens were informed, and what remedy exists for travellers holding guilders. The minister explains that GWK/Travelex stopped buying guilders, that the restriction aims to prevent license fee avoidance, that an information campaign was run, and that DNB may be asked to consider a temporary exchange facility in the Netherlands.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over langdurige storing Schipholtunnel (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister about the months-long outage of the Schiphol rail tunnel and the shortage of spare materials, and why this only became public a week after the damage. The minister answers that the damage investigation and unique tunnel materials caused delays, that ProRail is responsible for contractual spare-part arrangements with contractors, and that ProRail will be held to account through a new performance-based maintenance contract.
ProRail is responsible for getting the railway available again and, together with NS, for limiting passenger inconvenience.
ProRail is verantwoordelijk voor het weer beschikbaar komen van het spoor en om samen met de NS de reizigersoverlast te beperken.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over spoorcapaciteit Zwolle–Herfte Aansluiting–Emmen (ingezonden 18 oktober 2010).

An MP from the ChristianUnion asks the minister why the Zwolle–Emmen rail line has not been declared overloaded by ProRail and why no capacity analysis or expansion plan has been made despite earlier commitments, and whether the needed measures will be carried out before the new operator starts in 2012. The minister replies that a capacity analysis was done, that ProRail will declare overload only if requests cannot be handled satisfactorily, that a process with the provinces is underway to remove the remaining bottlenecks, and that the provinces will fund the measures from an existing budget.
Since ProRail only declares overload if it proves impossible to handle requests to users' satisfaction, there has been no reason to declare Zwolle–Emmen overloaded.

Aangezien ProRail pas overgaat tot overbelastverklaring als het niet mogelijk blijkt te zijn aanvragen tot tevredenheid van de gebruikers af te handelen, is er geen aanleiding geweest om Zwolle–Emmen overbelast te verklaren.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het overslaan van stations (ingezonden 28 september 2010).

MP Slob asks the minister about NS intercity trains repeatedly skipping stations (Nijmegen Lent, Elst, Arnhem Zuid) due to capacity problems, whether the corridor should be declared overloaded, and whether punctuality indicators should be more customer-oriented. The minister acknowledges 163 skipped stops in the current timetable caused by incidents, says the corridor need not be declared overloaded, and says the new traveller-punctuality indicator will be introduced in 2011 to make indicators more customer-focused.
Skipping stations is undesirable because travellers then do not receive the transport they are counting on.
Het voorbijrijden van stations is ongewenst omdat reizigers dan niet het vervoer krijgen aangeboden waar ze op rekenen.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over dubbel in- en uitchecken bij de OV-chipkaart (ingezonden 27 augustus 2010).

MP Slob asked the minister of Transport about double check-in and check-out on the OV-chipkaart, including NS's three-minute rule and inconsistent practices at RET and in regional transport. The minister confirmed the rules, explained the reasons for the differences, and said he would ask all carriers to look at a more uniform approach to waiting times.
From the perspective of travellers' interests, I will therefore ask all carriers to consider the possibilities for a more uniform solution for building in a waiting time after check-in and check-out.
Vanuit het reizigersbelang zal ik bij alle vervoerders daarom aandacht vragen voor de mogelijkheden van een meer uniforme oplossing om na een check-in en check-uit een wachttijd in te bouwen.

Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat universiteiten mogelijk meer armslag krijgen om studenten met ernstige dyslexie te weigeren (ingezo

MP Slob asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science whether selecting students with severe dyslexia at university entry conflicts with the ban on disability discrimination, and whether institutions may force alternative tracks. The state secretary answered that selection on disability is not allowed, that the equal treatment act requires reasonable accommodations, that complaints can go to the equal treatment procedure and Commissie gelijke behandeling, and that binding referral to a specialisation may not rest on disability.
Selecting on the basis of disability (direct or indirect) is therefore not permitted.
Selecteren op grond van handicap (direct of indirect) mag dus niet.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over snelheidsverhoging op het spoor (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

MP Slob asks the minister about delays in ERTMS signalling and higher speeds (160 and 200 km/h) on rail lines including Amsterdam–Utrecht, the Hanzelijn and the Zwolle area, plus the use of penalties against suppliers and funds reserved for northern Netherlands. The minister answers that the ERTMS delivery slips to December 2010 with penalties applied, that the 160 km/h option is being pursued with the sector without a fixed date, and that other items such as reisttijd effects and the 200 km/h ICE upgrade were not considered necessary.
At present no new setbacks at the supplier are known and ProRail assumes that delivery will be realised by the end of 2010.
Op dit moment zijn er geen nieuwe tegenvallers bij de leverancier bekend en gaat ProRail ervan uit dat oplevering eind 2010 wordt gerealiseerd.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over vertraging bij de realisatie van station Halfweg (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Transport why the Halfweg station is delayed by a year and whether Rijkswaterstaat failed to honour an agreement. The minister replies that Rijkswaterstaat was not a party to the station agreement, that the delay stems from an unresolved safety question on the N200 crossing, and that completion is now expected in mid-2012.
No, because Rijkswaterstaat is not a party to the (station) agreement between the Province, municipalities, ProRail and NS.
Nee, want Rijkswaterstaat is geen partij in de (stations)overeenkomst tussen Provincie, gemeenten, ProRail en NS.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Justitie over beter toezien op loterijen (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

The MP asks whether charity lotteries are operating without adequate oversight and whether the minister will provide extra supervision before the Kansspelautoriteit is established. The minister disputes the press figures, notes that the charity lotteries comply with the 50% pass-through condition, and sees no need for extra supervision.
I have taken note of both reports, but I do not share the view that the charity lotteries appear to be going their own way unjustly.
Ik heb kennisgenomen van beide berichten, maar ik deel de mening niet dat de goede doelenloterijen ten onrechte hun eigen gang lijken te gaan.
Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over onderaanbesteding in het regionale OV (ingezonden 29 juni 2010).

MP Slob asks the minister of Transport about subcontracting in regional public transport, including coach drivers working under a different CAO, rest times, OV-chipkaart access and a single CAO. The minister replies that subcontracting is permitted under national and EU rules, that labour matters are for employers and employees, that the Wp2000 need not change, and that the concession holder remains liable.
The Stadsregio Amsterdam executive board will not take measures to shape the programme of requirements in new tenders so that subcontracting of transport becomes impossible.

Het Dagelijks Bestuur van de Stadsregio Amsterdam gaat geen maatregelen nemen om bij nieuwe aanbestedingen het programma van eisen zo vorm te geven dat onderaanbesteding van het vervoer onmogelijk wordt gemaakt.
Vragen van de leden Slob en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Justitie over de bedreiging van ex-moslims (ingezonden 18 juni 2010).

MPs Slob and Voordewind asked the Justice Minister about threats against ex-Muslims in the Netherlands, including in asylum centres, and whether anonymous reporting, safe houses and civic integration could help. The minister said such threats must be taken seriously, that the COA enforces house rules neutrally, that no separate registration of such complaints exists, and pointed to existing anonymity options, existing shelter places, and the integration exam's coverage of religious freedom.
No separate registration is kept of this.
Daarvan wordt geen afzonderlijke registratie bijgehouden.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over een interne notitie waaruit blijkt dat personeelsleden op het Gomarus in Gorinchem leerlingen én collega’s die relaties aangingen of wilden aangaan met mensen van hetzelfde ges

An MP asked how an internal school directive requiring staff at a Gorinchem secondary school to report students and colleagues with same-sex relationships or interests fits with teachers' legal position and their trust role. The minister condemned the directive as unacceptable and contrary to law, agreed it conflicts with the trust role, and said the government is examining whether teachers' legal position needs further strengthening, including via the Wet Veiligheid op School evaluation.
It is currently being examined whether it is generally necessary to further strengthen the legal position of education staff, as also indicated in the Coalition Agreement.
Er wordt momenteel gekeken of het in algemene zin nodig is de rechtspositie van onderwijspersoneel verder te versterken, zoals ook is aangegeven in het Coalitieakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verdere afname van het schoolzwemmen

An SP MP asked the government about the continued decline of school swimming lessons (from 31% to 26% of schools) and whether national action is needed. The minister answered that school swimming is not a statutory task and is a local matter, pointed to existing subsidy and a national swimming safety plan, and committed to consulting education and municipal stakeholders and to a catch-up support for COVID-related swimming delays.
School swimming is not a statutory task for education.
Schoolzwemmen is geen wettelijke taak voor het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de (her)opening van scholen

An MP asked the education minister about research on pupils' behaviour after repeated school closures, long-term developmental effects, ventilation projects, national school housing policy, the 'scholen veilig open' call, teacher retention, student support and staff absenteeism. The minister answered mostly with descriptions of existing programmes and monitoring, stating no systematic study or long-term prognosis yet exists, while promising continued reporting and measures.
As far as I have been able to determine, no systematic research has yet been conducted into the effect of school closures on pupils' behaviour in class after a closure.
Voor zover ik na heb kunnen gaan, is er nog geen systematisch onderzoek naar het effect van schoolsluiting op het gedrag van leerlingen na een schoolsluiting in de klas gedaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht ‘Bijlesindustrie dreigt publiek onderwijs uit te hollen’

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about regulation of the private supplementary tutoring market, the lack of a mandatory certificate of good conduct (VOG) for staff there, and whether a quality label should be created. The minister replies that the market is private and outside education law and inspection oversight, that schools are responsible for their contracted partners, and that talks with the sector and a reaction to the Onderwijsraad advice will follow.
This also means that the inspectorate has no authority to supervise this.
Dit betekent ook dat de inspectie geen bevoegdheid heeft om hier toezicht op te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het NPO-fonds

An MP asked the government about the NPO-fonds: the timing of the NPO's review, whether its neutrality and independent working are safeguarded under the new performance agreement, and whether its tasks and budget are balanced. The state secretary answered that the review is due in spring 2022, that the NPO itself must safeguard the fund's balance and independence without a separate foundation, and that financial shortfalls for co-production and speelfilm rights are being covered jointly for 2022-2023 with the government to consider the remaining gap.
However, it is for the NPO to safeguard and organise the balance between the fund's tasks, independent working and associated budget.
Het is echter wel aan de NPO om de combinatie van taken, onafhankelijke werkwijze en bijbehorend budget van het NPO-fonds evenwichtig te waarborgen en te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het goochelen met cijfers over vaste contracten in het onderwijs

Kwint and Westerveld ask why the minister presented figures on permanent contracts for recently graduated teachers as a sweeping increase, omitting that the figures include temporary contracts with prospects of permanence and cover only teachers six months after graduation. The minister answers that the figures are accurate, that the sample is defined as recent graduates working six months after graduating, and that combining permanent and temporary-with-prospect contracts is an essential nuance.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de tegenwerking en vertraging van de NPO ten opzichte van aspirant-omroep Ongehoord Nederland, waardoor zij niet per 1 januari 2022 kunnen uitzenden op radio en tv

An MP asked whether the minister recognises Ongehoord Nederland's right to broadcast from January 2022 and whether the NPO is obstructing it, and whether this constitutes censorship. The minister answered that the NPO must provide airtime but programme proposals are assessed against agreed targets, that the NPO is holding a special round to decide quickly, and that the minister cannot intervene in NPO internal processes, pointing to objection and appeal procedures.
I cannot intervene in the internal consultation and programming processes at the NPO.
Ik kan niet treden in de interne overleg- en programmeerprocessen bij de NPO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de uitzending van EenVandaag over staatsvrije scholen

An MP asked the minister about an EenVandaag broadcast on the rise of 'state-free' private schools and whether the government can intervene when quality or safety fails. The minister disputed the figures, said the inspectorate has intervened at two schools, and noted that the government can withdraw recognition and that financial oversight is absent for these schools.
No oversight is exercised over the finances of these schools, because there is no public-law (funding) relationship on that point.
Op de financiën van deze scholen wordt geen toezicht gehouden, omdat op dat punt geen sprake is van een publiekrechtelijke (bekostigings-)relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de berichten 'Wereldwijzer: carrouselmodel voor lessen levensbeschouwing – PO' en 'Levensbeschouwing, maar dan anders'

MP Bisschop (SGP) asked whether a carousel model giving all pupils mandatory lessons on all religions and worldviews, supplied by the Centrum voor Vormingsonderwijs, undermines parents' right to request religious education in a specific direction and how it fits schools' curriculum duty. Minister Slob answered that parents do decide on religious or worldview education under article 50 WPO, that schools' separate duty on religious currents in the regular curriculum (article 9 WPO) remains, and that the subsidy may only be used for article 50 education; he will keep talking with the Centrum.
The Centrum voor Vormingsonderwijs receives a subsidy from OCW to provide education within that framework.
Het Centrum voor Vormingsonderwijs krijgt vanuit OCW subsidie om het onderwijs in dat kader te verzorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van Meenen en Boulakjar over coronamaatregelen in het funderend onderwijs

Three D66 MPs asked the education minister why the government departs from OMT advice on school COVID measures, including testing, the Christmas holiday timing, masks, CO2 meters and air purifiers. The minister confirmed the departures, explained the reasons and pointed to ventilation funding and existing measures, without committing to new national devices.
Naturally the epidemiological situation is monitored and the Cabinet takes the decisions that are necessary.
Vanzelfsprekend is de epidemiologische situatie gemonitord en neemt het Kabinet besluiten die nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Ploumen en Ellemeet over het moedwillig fout informeren van jongeren over abortus

MPs De Hoop, Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Education whether he would act against schools giving young people deliberately false information about abortion, and how widespread such lessons are. The minister said the Inspectorate does not track the content of individual lessons, that schools must ensure students' safety and wellbeing, and that the Inspectorate will consider the signals in its supervision, without committing to a specific new step.
There is therefore no overview available of which information is provided, at what frequency, and by which school.
Er is dan ook geen overzicht beschikbaar van welke voorlichting, in welke frequentie, door welke school gegeven wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Nispen over de aanhoudingen van journalisten tijdens demonstraties

Two SP MPs asked why three journalists were detained at climate demonstrations and what rules protect press identity during arrests. The Justice Minister answered that press cards carry rights but also duties, that the police apply internal rules, that the arrests were lawful and no prosecution followed, and that the issue will be raised in the PersVeilig steering group.
In the aforementioned cases it turned out that the arrest was lawful.
In de voornoemde zaken is gebleken dat de aanhouding rechtmatig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over “de aanhoudende kindermarketing en onderwijsbeïnvloeding door de fossiele industrie”

An MP asked the ministers about Shell's 'children's council' outreach to primary schools near its Pernis and Moerdijk sites, alleged ExxonMobil gifts in classrooms, climate responsibility, and how children are protected from fossil-industry marketing in schools. The minister answered that schools and teachers decide on educational materials under school autonomy, that the government is reluctant to steer material choices, that the sponsorship convenant was tightened, and that no new protective measures are planned.
The central government is therefore very restrained in encouraging or discouraging the use of certain materials in education.
De rijksoverheid is daarom zeer terughoudend in het stimuleren of juist ontmoedigen van het gebruik van bepaalde materialen in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Dealen op scholen heel normaal, harddrugs vaker op gymnasiums’

An MP asks the Justice, Health and Education ministers about reports that drug dealing at schools is becoming normal, and about normalisation of drug use, youth addiction numbers, and prevention such as the Icelandic model. The government says there is no clear trend in dealing or drug use among pupils, points to €82 million for prevention, the planned revival of the LADIS addiction database in 2022, and the Helder op School programme, while declining to expand the Preventie Akkoord for now.
There is no precise data on the number of cases of dealing at school.
Over het aantal gevallen van dealen op school zijn geen precieze gegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de verdubbeling van het aantal thuiszitters op het vwo in de regio Holland Rijnland

An MP asked the minister why the number of VWO pupils out of school in the Leiden region nearly doubled in one year, whether psychological problems and waiting lists are acceptable reasons for keeping children at home, and what the trend says about truancy policy generally. The minister attributes much of the rise to better registration and reporting by the regional truancy bureau, says the problem is complex, and points to ongoing integrated measures and an experiment decree while stating that a budget ceiling alone is no reason to keep a child at home.
When these figures are better mapped, the numbers may rise because a region simply gains better insight into the problem.
Bij het beter in beeld brengen van die cijfers kan het voorkomen dat de aantallen oplopen, omdat een regio simpelweg beter zicht krijgt op de problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de opmerkingen van de hoofdredacteur van Joop.nl over ongevaccineerden

An MP asks the Minister for Media whether the public broadcaster-linked website Joop.nl should be allowed to exclude unvaccinated people, whether the editor-in-chief's remarks wishing unvaccinated people dead should be condemned, and whether apologies or an end to subsidy should be demanded. The Minister replies that public media institutions determine their own content under the Mediawet, that he does not interfere in programme content, and that criminal matters are for the courts.
As Minister for media I do not interfere with the content of programmes broadcast by the NPO, not even in this case
Ik bemoei mij als Minister voor media niet met de inhoud van programma's die door de NPO worden uitgezonden, ook niet in dit geval
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint en Van Meenen over De Monnikskap

MPs asked why the Minister had not kept parliament informed about De Monnikskap, an inclusive education unit facing closure with the Dominicus College, and about the phase-out of its supplementary funding. The Minister answered that the new circumstances arose only recently, that the board guarantees De Monnikskap will continue after 2024, and that the supplementary funding will be phased out from 2023 to 2027.
Only very recently have new circumstances come to light, namely the planned closure of the Dominicus College, which prompted me to inform you.
Er zijn pas zeer recent nieuwe omstandigheden naar voren gekomen, namelijk over de voorgenomen sluiting van het Dominicus College, die aanleiding waren om u te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Meenen over het bericht 'Personeelstekorten kinderopvang lopen spuigaten uit: vrees voor langere wachtlijsten'

Two D66 MPs asked the government about staff shortages in childcare, the status of a motion calling for a labour market vision, and possible actions. The state secretary acknowledged the shortages, said the work on a labour market vision was delayed by COVID-19 and would resume, and listed steps taken such as a recruitment campaign and postponed quality requirements.
I have committed to your House to work towards solutions to address the labour shortage through discussions with the sector.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd om aan de hand van gesprekken met de sector te komen tot oplossingsrichtingen om de krapte aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht 'De baby aanmelden voor een witte basisschool gaat in Utrecht niet meer: 'als mijn kind naar Kanaleneiland moet, zou ik niet blij zijn''

An MP asks the Minister of Education about reports that some Utrecht schools use informal waiting lists to pre-register babies before the legal age of three, favouring children of highly educated parents, and about segregation and admissions policy. The Minister says pre-registration without legal basis must not lead to priority, that the Inspectorate will act on signals, and that a segregation policy agenda and letter to school boards are underway, while admissions remain the responsibility of school boards and no national policy is planned yet.
This school year we are sending all school boards in primary and secondary education a letter about the existing rules on registration and admission.
Dit schooljaar sturen wij alle schoolbesturen in het po en vo een brief over de bestaande regels rondom aanmelding en toelating.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Kathmann, Kuik, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij, Ellemeet, Gündoğan, Omtzigt en Van Esch over de daadwerkelijke inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand en het be

MPs from several parties asked the government about protecting minors and vulnerable groups from online gambling advertising, the 30% youth-audience interpretation in the industry gambling advertising code, enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit, and the implementation of the Vos motion and amendment on warnings. The minister answered that the ban on targeting youth is absolute, enforcement lies with the Ksa, a time-slot restriction is currently not feasible, and a new warning text is being developed via Trimbos.
The Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) supervises compliance with advertising restriction measures laid down in laws and regulations.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) houdt toezicht op de naleving van reclamebeperkende maatregelen die zijn neergelegd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Alarmerende verschuivingen'; Succescoach Jac Orie luidt de noodklok over fysieke ontwikkeling nieuwe generatie sporters’

An MP asked the state secretary about reported declines in youth physical development, its effects on health and elite sport, and the government's response, including physical education and monitoring of funds. The government acknowledged a downward trend in motor skills, said no studies link it to elite sport careers, and pointed to subsidies, a RIVM study on care costs, and a broad-development approach.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht ‘Schoolboeken zonder bloot, dino’s en ‘decadente’ cultuur, s.v.p.’

An MP asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether educational publishers have guidelines to avoid certain topics, such as evolution or historical facts, and whether this conflicts with the civic education mandate. The minister answered that no such guidelines are known, that schools and inspectorate are responsible for covering mandatory content, and that a structural dialogue with publishers and schools is being pursued.
I am not aware of any examples of guidelines to exclude certain topics, such as evolution theory, from being addressed.
Er zijn mij geen voorbeelden bekend van richtlijnen om bepaalde onderwerpen, zoals de evolutieleer, niet aan de orde te laten komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat Daan niet met het taxibusje naar speciale school mag, omdat de gemeente vindt dat hij wel met de bus kan

An MP asked the minister why municipality Woudenberg refused a taxi bus for a ten-year-old with special needs despite parents' and school concerns, and questioned its reliance on a repeat independent assessment and its finances. The minister said the municipality has now agreed to transport the child by taxi bus this school year, that municipalities bear the legal duty to provide appropriate transport, and that finances should not decide the matter, but declined to commit to a general rule making the school admission decision automatically entitle pupils to transport.
For me it is paramount that pupils who are entitled to pupil transport also receive it, and that the municipality provides for this.
Voor mij staat namelijk voorop dat leerlingen die recht hebben op leerlingenvervoer, dat ook krijgen en de gemeente daarin voorziet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving inzake Facebook

An MP asked the minister whether social media giants like Facebook and LinkedIn should be politically impartial, whether Facebook deliberately disabled emergency measures before the Capitol riot, and how to counter platform influence on public debate. The minister said the government cannot assess the Facebook claim, pointed to voluntary self-regulation via the disinformation code and to planned EU DSA obligations on very large platforms, and referred to earlier letters on account blocking.
The cabinet cannot assess whether Facebook actually disabled the relevant emergency measures deliberately too early.
Het kabinet kan niet beoordelen of Facebook daadwerkelijk de desbetreffende noodmaatregelen bewust te vroeg heeft uitgeschakeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over een burgemeester die een boek schreef over kritische burgerjournalisten

MPs Kwint and Leijten asked ministers about a mayor who wrote a book criticising critical citizen journalists, and about local government support for independent local journalism. The government answered that local journalism is essential, that no protocol exists for mayors, that municipalities are encouraged to develop media policy, and that the data available does not show local media budget cuts or communication spending.
No, there is no such protocol.
Nee, er is geen dergelijk protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heerema over het bericht ‘Motoriek basisschoolkinderen verslechterd door coronalockdown’

An MP asked the minister about reports that children's motor skills worsened during the COVID lockdown, including how many schools skipped physical education, how lost PE hours are being tracked and caught up, and the future care costs. The minister answered that schools are responsible for PE and motor catch-up, that no central monitoring exists, that home activity explains most differences, and that a RIVM study on care costs is pending.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over flyeracties om ouderverklaringen te verzamelen

An MP asked the minister about flyer campaigns collecting parent declarations via DigiD to support new schools, questioning whether such non-binding support is valid and whether DUO's process is controlled. The minister answered that initiators may choose their outreach, the declaration signals interest rather than enrolment, the method is more valid than before, and the process will be monitored with DUO and IvhO.
Initiators are free to choose the form in which they bring their initiative to attention.
Het staat initiatiefnemers vrij om de vorm te kiezen waarin zij hun initiatief onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Gijs van Dijk over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

MPs Sneller and Van Dijk asked the government about the tendering of photography contracts, including the administrative burden on photographers, a bureau-based model, tariffs, market power and legal grounds for the new approach. Prime Minister Rutte answered that the new framework will be published around late October/early November, that the hourly rate will be about 109 euros versus 117 now, and that the earlier multi-supplier framework was dropped partly for legal reasons.
The hourly rate in the new framework agreement will in all likelihood be 109 euros, for every hour a photographer takes photos on location.
Het uurtarief in de nieuwe raamovereenkomst zal naar alle waarschijnlijkheid € 109 bedragen, voor elk uur dat een fotograaf op locatie foto’s neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de arbeidsmarkttoelage voor leerkrachten werkzaam op scholen met achterstanden

Van Meenen (D66) asked the education minister whether some school boards fail to pass the labour-market allowance for teachers at disadvantaged schools on to those schools' staff, and what the ministry will do to ensure the money reaches them. Minister Slob answers that the allowance is meant for staff at eligible schools, that monitoring and evaluation will follow, that staff can check eligibility online and must consent via the works council, and that he expects no misuse, without announcing new enforcement measures.
To monitor the use of the funds and their effects, a monitoring and evaluation study will be carried out.
Om de inzet van de middelen en de effecten daarvan te volgen, komt er een monitorings- en evaluatieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het lerarentekort een basisschool dwingt tot het vormen van een megaklas

An MP asked the minister about a primary school forced to merge two groups into a 52-pupil class due to teacher shortages, and about the broader teacher shortage, class size limits, unqualified teachers and monitoring. The minister said the school chose a temporary solution with extra support staff, rejected a national maximum class size, and described the measures taken and ongoing efforts while acknowledging the shortage remains high.
These are often temporary solutions that are not registered nationally.
Dit zijn vaak tijdelijke oplossingen, die niet landelijk geregistreerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het artikel 'Het grootste onderwijsprobleem is niet het lerarentekort

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about the rapid growth of commercial education firms, whether they are linked to learning losses from school closures, how schools spend National Education Programme funds on external providers, and whether marketisation and lump-sum funding have weakened government control and accountability in education. The minister answered that the CBS count is broad and not directly tied to funded schooling, that no direct link to COVID closures is visible, that schools' use of external providers is being monitored, and that accountability for lump-sum funds is being strengthened, but declined to answer the general question on education policy over 30 years.
The research into the scale of supplementary and private education will be repeated in 2022.
Het onderzoek naar de omvang van aanvullend en particulier onderwijs zal in 2022 worden herhaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar discriminatie om geaardheid op Gomarus-scholen’

An SGP MP asked the minister about the criminal complaint (aangifte) filed by the Inspectorate of Education against the Gomarus schools over discrimination based on sexual orientation, including notice to the ministry, the handling of the complaint, and the school's policy on informing parents. The minister answered that the Inspectorate acts independently, that the ministry was informed beforehand, and that the Inspectorate found the school had not learned enough from 2016 and that its formal policy on informing parents remained unclear.
The Inspectorate is authorised to file a criminal complaint.
De inspectie is bevoegd om aangifte te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over het opiniestuk ‘Scholen, aarzel niet tegengif te bieden aan desinformatie uit rechts-radicale hoek’

PVV MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the minister whether a school leader's op-ed criticising a pupil's graduation speech and arguing against denying teachers the right to question, and whether such conduct normalises discrimination against PVV supporters. The minister answered that pupils and teachers may express views freely, that discrimination is unacceptable and that the inspectorate would enforce if discrimination were found.
Should the inspectorate find that discrimination and exclusion occur at a school, it will enforce.
Mocht de inspectie constateren dat er op een school sprake is van discriminatie en uitsluiting, dan zal zij handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Van der Woude over problemen met ouderverklaringen en DUO

MPs Paul and Van der Woude asked about reported instability of DUO's online system for parental declarations needed to found a new school, and about the deadline. The minister says the reported errors were limited, largely traceable to one outage, DUO is investigating, and the deadline will not be extended.
I am closely following developments around MijnDUO, as well as the contact between DUO and the reporters, and will intervene where necessary.
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen rondom MijnDUO nauwgezet, net als het contact tussen DUO en de melders, en grijp in waar nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het coronabeleid

The MP Westerveld asks the ministers about COVID-19 policy, including presymptomatic transmission of the Delta variant, school reopening, vaccination status checks in schools, the use of coronavirus certificates, mask recycling and support for the cultural sector. The minister answers that transmission by asymptomatic people is already taken into account, that the reopening plan was guided by epidemiological data, and that generic support schemes will not be extended after 1 October 2021 while targeted support for night-time hospitality and unseated events is being prepared.
On the elaboration of these support measures, EZK and OCW are in discussion with the sector.
Over de uitwerking van deze steunmaatregelen zijn EZK en OCW in gesprek met de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de extra beloningsregeling voor docenten op het speciaal onderwijs (so) en voortgezet speciaal onderwijs (vso)

An MP asked why the extra teacher pay allocation for special schools uses the cumi (cultural minorities) regulation rather than the CBS disadvantage indicator used in regular schools, and whether this creates inequality. The minister denied unequal treatment, stated that 15% of locations per school type receive the allowance using the same key, acknowledged the cumi regulation is imperfect, and promised to seek an alternative with education organisations and report back.
I will therefore seek, together with the education organisations involved, an alternative to the cumi regulation so that it can be used for the regular funding of educational disadvantage.
Ik ga daarom met de betrokken onderwijsorganisaties op zoek naar een alternatief voor de cumi-regeling zodat die kan worden gebruikt bij de reguliere bekostiging van onderwijsachterstanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Van Meenen over het artikel 'Moslimcollege Beverwijk wil jongens en meisjes op school scheiden'

MPs Van der Laan and Van Meenen asked the minister whether a proposed Islamic school in Haarlem that would separate boys and girls, and reject sexual diversity, is acceptable under Dutch law and recent motions. The minister replied that no application has yet been filed, that new schools will be assessed under the stricter legal criteria, that schools may not reject sexual diversity or drop sexual education, and that gender-separated classes are permitted only with equivalent provision.
No school may opt out of any core objective, so also not of the core objectives concerning citizenship, sexual education and sexual diversity.
Geen enkele school mag zich onttrekken aan enig kerndoel, dus ook niet aan de kerndoelen met betrekking tot burgerschap, seksuele voorlichting en seksuele diversiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van Meenen en Kwint over herkansingen in het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs

MPs Westerveld, Van Meenen and Kwint asked about staatsexamen retake options for vso (special secondary education) pupils, examiner shortages and recruitment. Minister Slob answered that no exams were cancelled for lack of examiners, that about 450 examiners were recruited mostly to replace last-minute withdrawals, and that a retake option for a specific subgroup will be investigated and reported in autumn.
No, no exams were cancelled due to insufficient qualified examiners.
Nee, er zijn geen examens afgezegd wegens onvoldoende bevoegde examinatoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de aankoop van het ANP om politiek-activistische redenen en de gevolgen daarvan voor de onafhankelijke nieuwsgaring

An MP asked the minister about the takeover of the news agency ANP by Chris Oomen for political reasons, its effects on the independence and objectivity of news supplied to the NOS, the NOS's sourcing and contract criteria, and whether the NOS would end cooperation. The minister replied that editorial independence safeguards remain in place, that the NOS and ANP are responsible for their own journalistic choices, and that the contract costs are confidential.
The costs and the duration of the NOS contract with the ANP are confidential business information.
De kosten alsmede de looptijd van het contract van de NOS met het ANP zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over ventilatie

Two CDA MPs asked the health and education ministers about ventilation in schools and buildings, including past instructions, the SUViS subsidy, the Bouwbesluit compliance, and studies such as the Binnenklimaat label. The minister answered that guidance and webinars were provided, that compliance data is not centrally held, that the SUViS funds were exhausted, and that the RIVM advice has not changed; the research motion on air purifiers is still being scoped.
There is no central picture of how many schools comply with the Bouwbesluit.
Er is dus geen centraal beeld hoeveel scholen voldoen aan het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de coronamaatregelen in het onderwijs en de start van het nieuwe studiejaar

MP Kwint (SP) asked the ministers how the government prioritises reopening schools and universities for the new school year, and about ventilation, vaccination, self-testing and quarantine rules for children. The ministers answered that in-person education has been a top priority, that the 1.5-metre rule was lifted in higher education, and that additional funding for ventilation and vaccination outreach has been arranged.
The monitoring study into the use of self-tests in education is still ongoing.
Het monitoringsonderzoek naar het gebruik van de zelftesten in het onderwijs loopt op dit moment nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Strien over het bericht ‘Boos: influencers zetten 6500 doden in Qatar opzij voor gratis trip naar WK 2022’

An MP asked the Minister of Education and Media about the BOOS report on influencers promoting Qatar's World Cup and how influencer sponsorship is made transparent. The minister said influencer advertising rules under the Mediawet are being elaborated by the Commissariaat voor de Media, that no sanctions on influencers have yet been imposed, and that complaints can be filed with the regulator and the Reclame Code Commissie.
The Commissariaat has recently consulted on this policy rule for this purpose.
Het Commissariaat heeft hiertoe de beleidsregel onlangs geconsulteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Sjoerdsma over het verdwijnen van BVN

MPs Wuite and Sjoerdsma asked why BVN satellite broadcasting ended on 1 July 2021, leaving many Dutch citizens abroad without access to public broadcasting, and whether the government would restore it or renegotiate with Flanders. The minister answered that funding cuts forced the end of worldwide satellite coverage, that content remains available via app, website and NPO Start, and that no legal obligation requires BVN to remain fully accessible worldwide.
There is no legal obligation that BVN programming must remain fully and effectively accessible to all Dutch citizens worldwide.
Er is geen wettelijke verplichting dat de BVN-programmering volledig en daadwerkelijk bereikbaar moet blijven voor alle Nederlanders wereldwijd.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sneller, Wuite, Romke de Jong en Van Weyenberg over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked whether the Ministry of General Affairs' tender for photography services, which bundles assignments with a large image bank, would exclude freelancers and SMEs and create a monopsony. The Prime Minister's answer says the tender is in preparation, that a pool of photographers will be selected via a single agency, that the image-bank and commissioned photography will be split into separate tenders, and that the approach honours the 2017 Vos/Mulder motion.
The Ministry of General Affairs has decided, after further consideration, that the commissioned photography and image-bank photography, initially bundled, will be decoupled in this tender.
Het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken heeft op basis van nadere afwegingen besloten dat de van aanvang gebundeld ingezette opdracht- en beeldbankfotografie in deze aanbesteding worden losgekoppeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Westerveld en Kwint over het LinkedIn-bericht ‘Grote flyeractie in boekenpakketten!’ van 'Mr. Chadd'

MPs Segers, Westerveld and Kwint asked the minister about a LinkedIn post advertising paid homework coaching via flyers in publicly funded school book packages, and whether such advertising, its money flows and shadow education in general are acceptable. The minister confirmed awareness, said schools choose their suppliers, acknowledged risks to equal opportunity, referred to a planned repeat study and a spring 2022 update, and said the distributor's payments were unknown to him.
This is a matter between the distributor and the provider.
Dit is een zaak tussen de distributeur en de aanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over de vrijwillige of verplichte ouderbijdrage voor kosten voor overblijven op school

Two MPs asked the minister whether parents must pay for lunch-break supervision at school, whether a court ruling affects this, and whether guidelines should be tightened. The minister answered that the ruling confirms current rules, that the school followed consultation and consent procedures, and that no new guidelines are needed.
I see no reason to tighten the rules on whether a compulsory parental contribution may be requested.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de regels over het al dan niet mogen vragen van een verplichte ouderbijdrage aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Kwint over de situatie op het Tjalling Koopmans College in Hurdegaryp en de Scholen voor Persoonlijk Onderwijs

MPs Van Meenen and Kwint asked the minister about problems at schools run by SvPO, including a board chair lending foundation money for family mortgages, teacher suspension and high teacher turnover. The minister said the inspectorate is supervising, that financial oversight is being tightened and repair orders issued, but could not act directly on private foundation loans and left several follow-ups to the inspectorate.
I do not have that possibility myself either.
Ik heb die mogelijkheid zelf ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de dreigende schoolsluiting in de drie grote steden

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that three large cities may have to close schools due to teacher shortages, whether the 116 million euro agreed earlier is sufficient, whether ministers can coordinate cross-domain problems, and whether he will meet city aldermen and cabinet colleagues. The Minister says the convenant measures are taking effect, will review results this autumn, notes housing is primarily a municipal matter, and does not commit to a new meeting in the answer shown.
I expect the results of the first year of the convenants this autumn and will inform the House in December with the annual letter on the education labour market.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van het eerste jaar convenanten dit najaar en zal de Kamer in december met de jaarlijkse brief over de onderwijsarbeidsmarkt hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht ‘Het is nog altijd onrustig op het Haga Lyceum’

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether the Inspectorate's visit to the Cornelius Haga Lyceum, reported as ongoing unrest, is consistent with its earlier positive 2020 assessment and whether the school's recovery obligations are at risk. The Minister says the Inspectorate found no reason for immediate further investigation, will use its information in two planned inquiries after the summer, and will report on results under the usual procedure.
The Inspectorate has decided to use the information obtained in designing the two previously announced inquiries into the board and the school, which take place after the summer.
De inspectie heeft besloten de verkregen informatie te gebruiken bij de inrichting van de eerder aangekondigde twee onderzoeken bij het bestuur en de school die na de zomer plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het lerarentekort

A Van Haga MP asks the education minister whether he will freeze the extra COVID catch-up money, draw up a teacher-shortage plan, and give bonuses to teachers in large cities and incentives for part-timers to go full-time. The minister answers that the money helps schools recover learning losses, that a labour-market allowance of EUR 375 million is planned, and that part-time incentives will be tested with results reported in autumn.
In spring 2022 I will inform you about the progress.
In het voorjaar van 2022 informeer ik u over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het bericht 'Pijnlijke ironie: de coronamiljarden voor scholen vergroten het lerarentekort'

An MP asked the minister whether the corona education funds, by drawing teachers toward schools with the greatest needs, worsen teacher shortages in some schools and whether the Dutch big-city teacher shortage reflects the difficulty of working in disadvantaged schools. The minister answered that the Nationaal Programma gives schools flexibility, that a 375 million euro labour-market allowance aims to retain teachers, that teacher choices are their own, and that the government will report on mobility and city covenants in the autumn.
In the autumn I will report to the House, as in autumn 2020, on the mobility of teachers between regions.
In het najaar rapporteer ik de Kamer, net als in het najaar 2020 over de mobiliteit van leraren tussen regio's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Lerarentekort alleen maar groter door coronamiljarden’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether the corona education billions are worsening teacher shortages, especially in disadvantaged and special schools, and whether schools should rely less on extra staff and more on training and other measures. The Minister acknowledges the shortages, points to the menu of measures and a €375 million teacher allowance for schools with complex pupil populations, but gives no new commitments beyond monitoring the programme and informing parliament.
I monitor the approach to the shortages and the National Education Programme as a whole, and will inform you about this.
Ik monitor de aanpak van de tekorten en het Nationaal Programma breed en zal u hier ook over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het coronavirus

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health and education ministers about COVID-19 school self-test uptake, the end of the school self-test ordering scheme, vaccination of homeless people, serological tests for certificates, and the origin of the virus. The government answered that test uptake data is still incomplete, the ordering scheme was under review, vaccination of vulnerable groups is underway, and it would not use serological tests for the certificate, while not fully answering the virus-origin question and missing the deadline.
Answer 8: No, unfortunately, due to the diversity of topics affecting two ministries, it has not proven feasible to answer the questions by 1 July 2021.
Antwoord 8 Nee, helaas is het vanwege de diversiteit aan onderwerpen die twee ministeries raken niet haalbaar gebleken om de vragen voor 1 juli 2021 te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Mijn kind wil niet meer Joods zijn’

An MP asked the Minister about reports that Jewish pupils face hostility at school during the Israel-Gaza conflict, including whether the Inspectorate is acting on such signals and how it coordinates with the National Coordinator against Antisemitism. The Minister replied that the Inspectorate received no reports of incidents against Jewish pupils, that it acts on serious signals on a risk basis, that teachers singling out Jewish pupils for Israel's conduct is unacceptable, and that he will consult the National Coordinator and support existing anti-antisemitism organisations.
The Inspectorate has received no reports in recent months of incidents directed at pupils of Jewish schools or Jewish pupils.
De inspectie heeft in de afgelopen maanden geen meldingen ontvangen van incidenten gericht tegen leerlingen van Joodse scholen of Joodse leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht ‘Spanning in de klas: verdwijnen controversiële thema’s van het lesrooster?’

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether teachers have become more cautious about teaching controversial topics, following a survey by history and civics teacher associations, and what concrete steps will support teachers. The Minister acknowledges the concern, outlines planned research and monitoring, support programmes for sensitive topics, and civic education reforms, but gives no specific new commitments to parliamentary scrutiny of executive power.
No representative research has been conducted into how many school leaders responded to the call from my colleague Van Engelshoven and myself, or actively discouraged it.
Er is geen representatief onderzoek gedaan naar hoeveel schoolleiders gehoor hebben gegeven aan de oproep van mijn collega Van Engelshoven en mijzelf, dan wel dit actief afgeraden hebben.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Onderwijsinspectie op bezoek bij Tjalling Koopmans College vanwege hevige onrust, SVPO blijft knokken tegen publicatie rapporten’

MPs Paul and Aukje de Vries asked the minister about inspection findings of very weak quality at SVPO schools, the inspectorate's handling of them, and SVPO's court action to delay publication of the reports. The minister confirmed the very weak ratings, described the recovery orders, financial-oversight measures and a specific financial investigation, explained that publication is suspended pending a court ruling, and promised to inform parliament on the inspection's findings.
Article 21 of the Education Supervision Act provides that the inspectorate publishes reports in the fifth week after they are established.
Uit artikel 21 van de Wet op het onderwijstoezicht volgt dat de inspectie rapporten in de vijfde week na vaststelling openbaar maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over sneltestpilots in het PO en VO

An MP asked the Ministers of Health and Education about rapid antigen test pilots in primary and secondary schools, including test sensitivity, expected false positives and negatives, and safeguards.
