The government answered that the pilots ran until April, were then discontinued on expert advice in favour of self-tests, and that false negatives are addressed by repeat testing.
The research outcomes are expected in June and will be sent to your House.
De onderzoeksuitkomsten worden in juni verwacht en zullen aan uw Kamer worden toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over de beschikbaarheid en de betaalbaarheid van het aanbod van sport op televisie

MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked whether paywalls making popular sport available only on subscription harm access and what could be done, including a review of the events list. The minister says the market should set broadcasting, notes the events list guarantees free-to-air access for major events, and promises an evaluation in 2023 but no immediate new research.
It is up to the public and commercial broadcasters to determine the content of their programming.
Het is aan de publieke en commerciële omroepen om de inhoud van hun programmering te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht ‘Onderzoek inspectie: 1 op 3 scholen weigert schooladviezen bij te stellen’

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about a report that one in three schools refuses to revise school advice after the final test, and whether this breaches the legal duty to reconsider. The Minister acknowledges the concern, says schools must reconsider and will discuss this with the Inspectorate and others, but rejects making upward revision mandatory.

Schools are legally required to reconsider the school advice when the final test score is higher, and I consider it part of the school's professional attitude to carry out this reconsideration seriously for each individual pupil.

Scholen zijn wettelijk verplicht om het schooladvies te heroverwegen bij een hogere eindtoetsscore en ik vind het onderdeel van de professionele attitude van de school om deze heroverweging per individuele leerling serieus uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht over problemen met examenpost: ‘Sommige leerlingen zullen uitslag donderdag niet weten’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Basic and Secondary Education how he learned of problems with the delivery of exam work, what action was taken, and whether schools followed the protocol. The minister answered that reports began on 2 June, that exam work went missing for three to four schools, that exceptions were made so affected pupils could receive results, and that schools were advised to make copies of exam work in future.
For these pupils I made an exception so that they could still receive their results today.
Voor deze leerlingen heb ik een uitzondering gemaakt zodat zij vandaag alsnog hun uitslag konden ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Werner over het bericht 'Andere Tijden verdwijnt na 21 jaar van de televisie'

An MP asks the minister whether the public broadcaster's plan to cut or move the programme Andere Tijden and other programmes (Radar, Opsporing Verzocht) online, reducing older viewers' access, serves public-broadcasting goals. The minister replies that programming decisions belong to the NPO and broadcasters, that government does not interfere with programme content or scheduling, and declines to discuss the matter with the NPO.

It is up to the NPO, in consultation with the broadcaster(s) concerned (the NTR in this case), to ensure that a programme can meet the quality requirements the public broadcaster sets for its own programming.

Het is aan de NPO om in samenspraak met de betreffende omroep(en) (de NTR in dit geval) ervoor te zorgen dat een programma kan voldoen aan de kwaliteitseisen die de publieke omroep aan de eigen programmering stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over signalen dat er nog steeds geen zelftesten beschikbaar zijn op scholen

An SP MP asked the health and education ministers whether schools still lacked COVID self-test kits for teachers and pupils, how distribution was progressing, and where schools could report shortages. The minister replied that rollout to secondary and primary schools was largely complete, with about 300 primary schools receiving top-up deliveries, a helpdesk and online ordering module in place, and secondary schools supplied ahead of reopening.
However, about 300 primary schools reported that they had received too few tests to test all their staff preventively twice a week until the summer holiday.
Wel hebben ongeveer 300 scholen in het primair onderwijs aangegeven te weinig testen te hebben ontvangen om al hun personeel tot aan de zomervakantie twee keer per week preventief te laten testen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de korte tijd die scholen krijgen om de coronamiljarden uit te geven

An MP asked the minister whether the 2.5-year window for schools to spend the corona billions is too short, whether schools are being pushed toward commercial providers, and whether the programme will be structurally effective. The minister answered that the timeframe was agreed with parliament, pointed to an intervention menu, support helpdesk and monitoring, said schools keep control over planning, and promised a survey of schools in early next school year.
I will inform your House about the outcomes in the autumn.
Over de uitkomsten informeer ik uw Kamer in het najaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over ventilatie in scholen

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether school ventilation policy would change in light of aerosol transmission evidence, why the 2020 motion on school ventilation has not been implemented, how many schools and grants are involved, and what happens with the SUViS budget and the remaining 260 million euro. The minister answered that ventilation guidance from RIVM is followed, that the SUViS subsidy is nearly exhausted, that the remaining funds await the IBO recommendations, and that full adequate ventilation cannot be achieved by autumn.
Er wordt geen centraal overzicht bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Van der Werf over het bericht 'Persfotograaf en vriendin aangevallen bij opnames: 'Met shovel aangereden''

Two D66 MPs asked the Justice and Security Minister about the attack on a press photographer and his companion during filming of a car fire, and about press freedom, Persveilig.nl, a forthcoming report and enforcement against violence against journalists. The minister condemned the violence, said three suspects were arrested with an investigation ongoing, noted the Netherlands fell one place in the RSF index, and pointed to planned research and the agreement with police and prosecutors while giving limited detail on case numbers.
The investigation by the police and the public prosecution service is still in full swing. As is known, I cannot go into further detail on an ongoing investigation.
Het onderzoek van politie en OM is nog in volle gang. Zoals bekend kan ik niet nader ingaan op een lopend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘PricoH stopt met Kwadraatonderwijs. Ouders reageren verbijsterd: ‘Dit is een grote ramp’’

An MP asked the minister whether a Hoogeveen school board's plan to close its gifted-education (Kwadraat) department, leaving 17 pupils without alternatives, was correct and how thuiszitters would be prevented. The minister answered that the department will continue with a different financing arrangement paid by the regional partnership, and that the remaining questions were not currently at issue, while describing general support measures and monitoring.
The Kwadraat department will not be closed (see the answer to question 1).
De Kwadraatafdeling zal niet worden gesloten (zie beantwoording vraag 1).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat bij het onderwijsplan misbruik en willekeur op de loer ligt

An MP asked the education ministers about Algemene Rekenkamer concerns over the Nationaal Programma Onderwijs (8.5 billion euro for catching up after COVID learning delays), including accountability, reporting burden, distribution, timelines and funding. The ministers answered that accountability will use standardized reporting via XBRL and a national monitor, but that the timeline will not be extended and that structural funding is not for this demissionary cabinet to decide.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht ‘Enquête: Extra lerarengeld is niet op de juiste plek beland’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether the extra 150 million euro for secondary education had been spent with teachers and works councils involved, and whether the minister would monitor this and address commercial outsourcing of learning support. The minister answered that the 2020 annual reports will show spending and teacher involvement, a tussenevaluatie found most works councils were involved, and he will discuss the findings with the sector council and use the annual reports, while declining a larger role for the Inspectorate.
I see no reason to give the Inspectorate of Education a larger role in monitoring the involvement of works councils in the use of funds.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de Inspectie van het Onderwijs een grotere rol te geven bij het monitoren van de betrokkenheid van medezeggenschapsraden bij de inzet van middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het gebruik van commerciële bijlesbureaus en examentrainingen om corona-achterstanden in te halen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked whether schools spent corona catch-up funds on commercial tutoring and exam-training firms, and whether this should be curbed. Minister Slob replied that schools control how funds are spent, outsourcing is allowed with works council consent, and that accountability runs through school reports, the works council and the inspectorate, while declining to report detailed spending and deferring broader tutoring measures.
There is no obligation for schools to communicate their spending in detail.
Er is geen verplichting voor solen om gedetailleerd over hun uitgaven te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'School duwt kinderen ongevraagd uit de kast'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister how he assesses reports that the Gomarus school in Gorinchem pressured LGBTI pupils to come out and detained them, and whether this conflicts with the Dutch school safety and citizenship duties. The minister called the reports unacceptable, said the Inspectorate is investigating with results expected by summer 2021, and declined to pre-empt that investigation, while noting that schools may hold a traditional marriage view provided the school culture meets the basic values.
The Inspectorate is examining the extent to which the school safeguards pupils' safety and whether legal requirements such as the citizenship duty and the Social Safety at School Act are met.
De inspectie onderzoekt in hoeverre de school de veiligheid van leerlingen waarborgt en of aan wettelijke eisen als de burgerschapsopdracht en de Wet sociale veiligheid wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Zorgen over seksuele intimidatie op scholen: "Het staat vaak niet op het netvlies"’

An MP asked the minister for Primary and Secondary Education about reports that sexual intimidation in schools is poorly handled, the legal duties schools have, and the outcomes of reports. The minister answered that schools' duties are set by law, that a planned extension of the consultation duty to cover suspicions of intimidation is being prepared, and that data on reports and criminal complaints are partly available.
I do however want to extend this consultation duty, so that schools must also consult the trust inspectorate on suspicions of sexual intimidation.
Ik wil deze overlegplicht echter uitbreiden, zodat scholen ook bij vermoedens van seksuele intimidatie in overleg moeten treden met de vertrouwensinspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over de lerarenbeurs

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked about the number of teacher grant applications, whether all rejected 2020 applicants would be granted, the DUO website outage, whether the budget would be increased if oversubscribed, and compensation for self-paid courses. The minister answered that final numbers are not yet known, promised all 2020 rejected initial applications can be granted, confirmed a brief outage, declined to raise the budget pending an evaluation due this autumn, and said there is no room to compensate teachers.
We will inform you after the allocation by DUO of the final number of applications and the number of grants for the Teacher Grant for the coming school year (by the end of June at the latest).
Wij informeren u na afloop van de toekenning bij DUO over het definitieve aantal aanvragen en het aantal toekenningen voor de Lerarenbeurs voor het aankomende schooljaar (uiterlijk eind juni).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Bestuurscrisis kostte Avicenna College bijna kwart miljoen euro'

The MP asks how the Avicenna College could spend nearly a quarter million euros on extra pay and interim staff in 2020 without benefiting students, and how this money can be recovered. The minister answers that the Inspectorate found no unlawful spending, that the law did not yet allow recovery of 2020 spending, and that governance and supervisory roles have since been separated.
The inspectorate did not find in its report that there was any unlawful spending.
De inspectie heeft in haar rapport niet geconstateerd dat er sprake was van onrechtmatige uitgaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de onderbetaling van artiesten die in de media optreden

MP Kwint asked the ministers whether the adopted motion requiring fair payment of artists appearing on public broadcasting has been implemented, and whether it is true that only about 5 cents per euro of music programme spending reaches artists. The minister replied that public broadcasters set artist fees themselves, that talks with the NPO and broadcasters are ongoing with a report to parliament promised before the summer recess, and that the NPO does not recognise the 5-cent claim.
On 17 February 2021 your House was informed by letter about the progress in implementing the Kwint et al. motion.
Op 17 februari 2021 is uw Kamer per brief 2 geïnformeerd over de voortgang van de uitvoering van de motie Kwint c.s.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, El Yassini en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Journalisten aangevallen bij kerkdiensten Urk en Krimpen: ‘Dit is een aantasting van de rechtsstaat''

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Security minister about attacks on journalists at church services on Urk and in Krimpen aan den IJssel, police and prosecution handling, PersVeilig complaint figures, the 200% sentencing uplift for violence against journalists, a team for threatened journalists, support for freelance journalists, and COVID-era church gatherings. The minister answered in detail, stating that suspects were processed with proces-verbaal, that the police and local tripartite were responsible for risk assessment, and that research on violence against journalists and taskforce options were underway.
In the first 3 months of 2021, journalists reported threats, assault and intimidation to the PersVeilig reporting point 73 times.
Journalisten hebben in de eerste 3 maanden van 2021 73 keer melding gemaakt van bedreiging, mishandeling en intimidatie bij (het meldpunt) PersVeilig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de belaging van journalisten in Urk en Krimpen aan den IJssel

An MP asked about police inaction against threats and violence toward journalists in Urk and Krimpen aan den IJssel and whether the PersVeilig protocol works as intended. The minister condemned the violence, said police de-escalation kept the situation manageable, and stated the protocol is expected to function, with awareness and additional measures for freelance journalists being pursued.
We have said it before and we say it again: keep your hands off journalists.
Wij hebben het eerder gezegd en zeggen het nu weer: blijf met je handen van journalisten af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over het bericht dat tientallen miljoenen sneltests stof verzamelen in de opslag en het onderwijs aan een lijntje wordt gehouden

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked why tens of millions of rapid COVID tests sit in storage while schools are kept waiting for them. The minister answered that professional-supervision requirements blocked school testing, that self-tests were approved and are being rolled out to schools gradually, and that he will continue working on broader availability.
I have adopted the advice of the expert panel.
Ik heb het advies van het deskundigenpanel overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de Subsidieregeling Schoolkracht

MP Peters (CDA) asked the minister about school applications for the Schoolkracht subsidy that were fully pre-filled by commercial firms E-WISE and Faqta, and about lessons for the national education recovery programme. The minister answered that about 70 E-WISE applications were estimated, that Faqta only assisted, that a lottery selected applicants, and that the government will monitor outsourcing and is preparing a tender and extra support.
Submitting company-completed subsidy applications without substantive involvement of the school itself is, however, an undesirable development.
Het indienen van door bedrijven ingevulde subsidieaanvragen zonder inhoudelijke betrokkenheid van de eigen school, is echter wel een onwenselijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Westerveld over de ontstane situatie bij L1

MPs Sneller and Westerveld asked the minister about reports that the director of broadcaster L1 planned hidden cameras and access to staff email, and about the supervisory board's handling of the conflict with staff. The minister answered that covert monitoring is generally prohibited and conditionally allowed, that the director withdrew his plans, that L1's internal appointment falls under internal procedures, and that the outcome of an enterprise-chamber procedure will be awaited.
Covert camera surveillance and access to email correspondence are in principle not permitted, because they constitute a serious intrusion into personal privacy.
Heimelijk cameratoezicht en toegang tot mailcorrespondentie is in beginsel niet toegestaan, omdat het een grote inbreuk maakt op de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat een D66-campagnefoto zes voorpagina’s heeft gehaald

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked about a D66 campaign photo that appeared on six front pages, asking whether photo credits matter for photojournalism, whether political control over journalistic images is desirable, the status of minimum rates for journalists, and the position of freelance photojournalists during COVID-19. The minister answered that source attribution is important, that journalistic independence must be respected, that binding fair practice rules now apply to public broadcasters and talks on a publishing-sector code are ongoing, and that COVID support measures were available to freelancers, without committing to new action.
Journalistic independence is a great good and a strong pillar of our democratic society, in which journalists act as a sound counterweight to politics and government.
Journalistieke onafhankelijkheid is een groot goed en een sterke pijler van onze democratische samenleving, waarin journalisten als een gedegen tegenmacht van politiek en overheid fungeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kuiken en Van den Hul over de vaccinatiestrategie voor kwetsbaren

MPs Westerveld, Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the health minister about the vaccination strategy for vulnerable people, including people in voluntary quarantine, children who cannot attend school, the risk groups, and the timing of vaccinations for those with medical indications. The minister answered that the government does not track the number of people in voluntary quarantine, that schools are expected to keep in contact with vulnerable pupils and find alternative education, and that vaccination for the highest-risk groups has started with the Gezondheidsraad's advice still pending for children.
The behavioural unit does not record who is in voluntary quarantine.
Door de gedragsunit wordt niet geregistreerd wie er in vrijwillige quarantaine is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over leerlingen in het voortgezet onderwijs die op 1,5 meter moeten sporten in de buitenlucht

An MP asked whether secondary school pupils must keep 1.5 metres apart during outdoor PE lessons, and why this differs from adult sports clubs, and asked for the 1.5-metre rule to be dropped for outdoor PE. The minister replied that pupils are legally exempt from the distance rule during PE for enforceability reasons, that RIVM still advises keeping distance, and declined to drop the rule.
Secondary school pupils are not legally required to keep 1.5 metres apart during physical education lessons, but the RIVM strongly advises it.

Leerlingen in het voortgezet onderwijs zijn wettelijk niet verplicht om tijdens de lessen lichamelijke opvoeding 1,5 meter afstand van elkaar te houden, maar dit wordt wel dringend geadviseerd door het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een directeur zijn eigen journalisten wil volgen met een geheime camera

An MP asked whether a regional broadcaster director may covertly camera-monitor and read the e-mails of his own journalists, and whether the government will investigate and intervene. The minister answered that covert camera surveillance is in principle prohibited and e-mail reading is limited by GDPR and works-council consent, that the director withdrew his plans, and that the matter is an internal one for L1 now before the Enterprise Chamber.
In principle this concerns an internal matter of L1.
In beginsel betreft dit een interne aangelegenheid van L1.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over onnodige lesuitval door de onvoorspelbaarheid van de tijd die coronatests kosten

MPs asked whether school closures caused by unpredictable COVID test waiting times for teachers are acceptable, how schools cope given teacher shortages, and why teachers do not get priority testing. The minister apologised for the late reply, said priority testing for education staff has existed since September 2020 and capacity has been expanded, and said schools must offer alternatives such as remote teaching.
Since September 2020, education staff, like care staff, can be tested with priority.
Sinds september 2020 kan onderwijspersoneel, net als zorgpersoneel, met voorrang getest worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over het testprotocol COVID-19 bij kinderen onder de 13 jaar

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked why children under 13 could only be tested for COVID-19 when symptomatic, whether schools' case increases were reported, and why GGD school case figures were not public. The minister answered that testing policy for under-13s was tightened in February 2021, testing capacity is sufficient, GGD school-level data stay regional or aggregated, and the RIVM has central registration by region and age.
I do not have information on the precise figures of the School Reporting Point, however.
De precieze cijfers van het Scholenmeldpunt heb ik echter geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Van den Hul over de inzet van sneltests op scholen

MPs Asscher and Van den Hul asked whether rapid tests could be used in schools as a preventive measure, as some European countries do, and about their capacity, priority for vital professions, and turnaround times. Minister De Jonge answered that school testing can add value, that pilots face scalability and legal problems being addressed by an expert panel, that rapid tests are being prepared for self-testing, and that teachers can book priority testing with reported turnaround times of 20 to 25 hours.
In the COVID-19 status letter of 23 March I informed your House about this and explained how I am working towards further rollout of testing in education based on the experts' recommendations.

In de stand van zaken brief COVID-19 van 23 maart heb ik uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd en toegelicht hoe ik met de aanbevelingen van de deskundigen toewerk naar een verdere uitrol van testen in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Zonder kleding voor de klas in nieuw NPO-Zappprogramma’

An MP asked the ministers whether a children's NPO Zapp programme showing nude adults to primary-school pupils is pedagogically acceptable, whether it conforms to the Kijkwijzer classification and parental consent, and whether the broadcast should be stopped. The minister replied that media content is for the public broadcaster and parents to judge, that the programme was classified 'Alle Leeftijden' by NICAM with Rutgers input and consent obtained, and that the government cannot ask the NPO to refrain from broadcasting because prior review is prohibited.
It is therefore not appropriate for the government to appeal to the NPO or the broadcasters to refrain from broadcasting.
Het past dan ook niet dat de overheid een appél doet op de NPO of de omroepen om van uitzending af te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Meenen over de digitale toegankelijkheid van lesmateriaal voor kinderen met een leesbeperking

MPs Westerveld and Van Meenen asked the minister about the availability of digitally accessible textbooks for children with reading disabilities, including responsibility for publishers, the GEU, Dedicon funding and school compliance. The minister answered that responsibility lies mainly with publishers and schools, that the ministry funds conversion only for visually impaired pupils, and that no additional steps or legal anchoring of the right to support are planned.

That responsibility lies with the publishers, who must make the learning materials available, if requested, to entities that can convert them into an accessible form for pupils with reading disabilities.
Die verantwoordelijkheid ligt bij de uitgeverijen, die dienen de leermiddelen wel, indien gevraagd, beschikbaar te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de examens in het voorgezet speciaal onderwijs

An MP asks whether the minister's exam measures for special secondary education (vso) are adequate, and why second retakes, split college exams, a relaxed examiner role and the kernvak clause are not extended to all candidates. The minister defends the measures as feasible and proportionate, citing capacity limits, and declines to extend retakes to certificate candidates or change the examiner role, while promising no decision yet on the 2021-2022 duim rule.
I am of the view that I have taken adequate measures for all pupils and candidates and have also implemented the Van Meenen/Van Raan motion.
Ik ben van mening dat ik toereikende maatregelen heb getroffen voor alle leerlingen en kandidaten en tevens uitvoering heb gegeven aan de motie Van Meenen/Van Raan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het vloeren van een Groningse video-vondst door de Europese omroep

An MP asked the minister about the EBU ending cooperation with the Groningen firm JetStream, alleged disclosure of trade secrets, NPO dropping JetStream, and US dominance and privacy concerns. The minister replied that EBU is a private entity not bound to public tendering, that it is unknown whether secret technical information was disclosed, that trade secret protection exists under Dutch and EU law, and that privacy oversight rests with the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
EBU, as a private entity, is not obliged to tender publicly.
De EBU is als private entiteit niet verplicht openbaar aan te besteden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Westerveld over de effecten van de Coronacrisis op het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs

MPs Van den Hul and Westerveld asked the minister about the effects of the COVID-19 crisis on pupils in special secondary education (vso), including pass and fail rates, class sizes and support measures. The minister answered that pass rates in vso rose in 2020, that no extra measures were needed beyond those already taken, and that the staatsexamen and extraneus figures do not show the feared deterioration.
Based on the 2020 pass rates, I see no reason to assume that the exam performance of vso pupils is worrying.
Op basis van de slagingspercentages van 2020 zie ik geen reden om aan te nemen dat de examenprestaties van leerlingen in het vso zorgwekkend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de verzamelbrief moties en toezeggingen primair en voortgezet onderwijs

An MP asked the minister about the Inspectorate's partial funding suspension of the Jewish school Cheider over social safety, sex and worldview education, and finances, and whether sanctions are meant to force rapid compliance. The minister confirmed the facts, explained that funding suspension aims to restore compliance, and said the court suspended the sanction pending objection proceedings, with the board responsible for pupil safety in the meantime.
The judge suspended the sanction decisions until six weeks after the decision(s) on objection.
De rechter heeft de sanctiebesluiten geschorst tot zes weken na de beslissing(en) op bezwaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het artikel 'Tot 40% van leerlingen dreigt te zakken voor eindexamen'

Van Meenen (D66) asked the minister about a news report that 30 to 40 percent of pupils risk failing their final exams due to COVID-related learning gaps, and about the lack of in-person teaching and whether the central exams should go ahead. Minister Slob answered that the picture is differentiated across schools, that the exams will proceed with added support measures, and that consultation with the sector continues.
I do not have specific data on how many pupils had in-person teaching before and after the distance rule was introduced.
Ik heb geen specifieke gegevens over hoeveel leerlingen er voor en na de invoering van de afstandsregel er fysiek onderwijs hebben gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het artikel ‘Moet de groep 8-toets worden aangepast op leerachterstanden?’

An MP asked the minister whether the group 8 end-of-primary test should be adjusted for learning losses caused by COVID-19 school closures, and how students will be guided into secondary school. The minister replied that learning losses are being analysed, that the test norms may be adjusted to avoid disadvantaging students, and outlined measures such as encouraging ambitious school advice and heterogeneous first-year classes.
Together with the end-test providers, I am examining how we can take learning losses into account in the norming this school year, if the analyses show they exist.
Met de eindtoetsaanbieders bekijk ik hoe we dit schooljaar in de normering rekening kunnen houden met opgelopen achterstanden, indien de analyses laten zien dat deze er zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van den Hul en Van der Graaf over emotionele verwaarlozing en huiselijk geweld als gevolg van de lockdown

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA and ChristenUnie asked the government about a Leiden study showing more emotional neglect and domestic violence during the lockdown, why official reporting figures did not show the same rise, how professionals and schools can support vulnerable families, and how the findings should inform policy. The state secretary answered that the government is aware of the study, monitors reporting trends through CBS and the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, points to helplines and support tools, and agrees the school closures' effects on vulnerable families must be weighed, while stating that secondary schools cannot reopen yet.
We therefore, together with these organisations, closely monitor the (numerical) developments currently and also in the coming period.
Wij houden daarom samen met deze organisaties de (cijfermatige) ontwikkelingen momenteel en ook de komende tijd nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de subsidieregeling Specifieke uitkering ventilatie in scholen

An MP asks the Dutch government about the SIVUS subsidy scheme for school ventilation, including whether school boards or municipalities bear primary responsibility for funding building ventilation and whether the investment ban for school boards is compatible with the required substantial works. The minister replies that school boards and municipalities share responsibility, that a bill to ease investment rules and an interdepartmental review are underway, and that funds have already been made available.
As communicated earlier before the summer, a bill is being prepared to improve the planning of housing investments.
Zoals eerder voor de zomer gecommuniceerd, is een wetsvoorstel in voorbereiding om de planvorming voor investeringen in huisvesting te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Fors meer scholieren geschorst voor wapenbezit op school

MPs asked the ministers about the rise in school suspensions for weapon possession, the number of police reports by schools, and whether schools can check pupils and what sanctions apply. The minister confirmed the increase is worrying, cited rising suspension counts and police incident figures, said no data explain the rise, and pointed to the existing Actieplan Wapens en Jongeren for local cooperation with youth work.
Police systems cannot automatically generate how many schools have filed reports.
Antwoord 4 Uit de politiesystemen valt niet automatisch to genereren door hoeveel scholen aangifte is gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat afstand tussen scholieren wel belangrijk is

MP Kwint asked the minister whether the cabinet knew last summer that keeping the 1.5-metre rule in schools was advisable, why it did not act sooner and why the Chamber was not informed, and questioned the consistency of school policy and exam arrangements. Minister Slob replied that the cabinet bases its policy on the collective OMT advice, that the cited views were of individual OMT members, that the cabinet was informed of the adjusted advice only with the 94th OMT advice, and that the advice was shared with the Chamber, while on exam classes and the 1.5-metre rule he said organisational adjustments are needed but largely succeed.
The advice of the OMT is always shared with the Chamber after publication.
De adviezen van het OMT worden na publicatie altijd gedeeld met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Westerveld over de financiering van ventilatie verbetering scholen

MPs Van den Hul and Westerveld asked whether municipalities lacking funds can meet the 70% co-financing condition for school ventilation upgrades and whether this creates inequality between schools. Minister Slob replied that the SUViS scheme is open, co-financing can take other forms, schools and municipalities are urged to talk, and further funding will be shaped later this year.
I closely monitor the applications and signals regarding the SUViS scheme.
Ik monitor de aanvragen en signalen rond de SUViS-regeling nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Slob: verklaringen die homoseksuele identiteit afwijzen gaan te ver'

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether schools may be barred from issuing statements rejecting homosexuality, how this fits with his remarks in a debate, and what he will do if schools still use such statements. The minister answered that discrimination of pupils on sexual orientation is already prohibited under the Equal Treatment Act and school duty of care, that he found some old statements, that the inspectorate will act, and that no new legislation is needed.
No school in the Netherlands may condemn or reject pupils on the basis of their sexual orientation.
Geen enkele school in Nederland mag leerlingen veroordelen of afwijzen op basis van hun seksuele gerichtheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over een documentaire over D66-lijsttrekker Kaag tijdens de verkiezingscampagne

An MP from PVV asks why the NPO broadcasts a long documentary about D66 leader Sigrid Kaag shortly before the elections, and whether it breaches Mediawet balance rules and campaign finance rules, given links between NPO/VPRO leadership and D66 and Filmfonds funding. The minister answers that broadcasters are editorially independent, the Commissariaat voor de Media supervises afterwards, the Filmfonds is independent, and the documentary was commissioned before Kaag became lijsttrekker.
The broadcasters are editorially independent and themselves responsible for their media output.
De omroepen zijn redactioneel onafhankelijk en zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun media-aanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over eventuele aangescherpte coronamaatregelen op voorgezet speciaal onderwijs

MP Van Meenen (D66) asked the minister about overcrowded special secondary education classes, distance rules, hybrid teaching and learning delays during COVID-19. Minister Slob answered that class sizes and distancing are school choices, that in-person teaching remains essential for vulnerable pupils, and that schools are running regular programmes with recovery support.
I therefore do not, for the time being, intend to pursue offering 'half and half' education in special secondary education.
Ik zet daarom vooralsnog niet in op het bieden van «half om half» onderwijs in het vso
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van den Berg over koude werkplekken in het onderwijs

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Education and of Health about cold classrooms, school ventilation norms, the SUDS/SUViS funding, UV-C and ionisation research, and air purifiers. The minister answered that school boards must ensure a safe workplace and that funding for ventilation (SUViS, opening 1 January 2021) does not cover specific air purifiers, while stating no research commission on UV-C or ionisation is planned for now.
Yes, but I do not expect the impossible of schools.
Ja, maar ik verwacht niet het onmogelijke van scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat na het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs de meeste leerlingen een uitkering wacht

An MP asked the education minister about reports that most students leaving special secondary education face benefits after two years, and what regional action, sector data, diplomas and inclusion measures exist. The minister disputed the framing (about two-thirds of the 46% entering the labour market, not of all leavers), listed existing employment initiatives and funding, declined to provide sector data, and said no further action was needed.
OCW does not keep data on the sectors in which students go to work after leaving education.
OCW houdt geen gegevens bij over de sectoren waar leerlingen na het verlaten van het onderwijs gaan werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat een laptop eisen niet mag, maar scholen ermee wegkomen

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the Minister whether schools may effectively require pupils to buy laptops or tablets, and whether devices should fall under the free-textbook law and its funding. The Minister answered that parents may be asked to buy devices only voluntarily, that schools must provide devices themselves where needed, and that the free-textbook law evaluation and policy response on devices will follow in the first half of 2021.
Schools may never oblige parents to purchase a laptop.
Scholen mogen ouders nooit verplichten een laptop aan te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de zeer beperkte kansen voor leerlingen uit het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs

An MP asks the minister why most vso (special secondary education) leavers end up on benefits and what concrete steps are being taken to improve their labour market chances. The minister answers that most leavers pursue further education or work, that the share on benefits has fallen since 2015, and that a joint action plan with SZW and SBB, plus ESF-funded support, is underway.

Together with my colleague of SZW, I have asked SBB to also elaborate the Action plan for internships and apprenticeships for current and future MBO students, jobseekers and workers for pupils of practical education

Ik heb samen met mijn collega van SZW aan het SBB gevraagd om het Actieplan stages en leerbanen voor huidige en aankomende mbo-studenten, werkzoekenden en werkenden, ook uit te werken voor leerlingen van het praktijkonderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over de berichten 'Docent Rotterdams college bedreigd om spotprent' en 'Docent duikt onder om cartoon in de klas'

Two MPs asked the government about reports that a teacher in Rotterdam was threatened over a cartoon and went into hiding. The minister answered that he contacted the school and teacher, supports them, that police and the Inspectorate acted, a criminal investigation is ongoing, and that the Wet veiligheid op school is being evaluated.
Arrests have since been made in this case and the criminal investigation is ongoing.
Er zijn inmiddels aanhoudingen verricht in deze zaak en het strafrechtelijk onderzoek is gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over het bericht 'Onderwijsminister Slob: Pluryn in de fout bij overdragen leerlingen Hoenderloo College'

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked why parliament was only informed in November that some pupils of the Hoenderloo College had no school place after closure, despite earlier assurances. The minister answered that Pluryn wrongly reported places were found, that the Inspectorate issued repair orders and intensive monitoring, and that all pupils were placed by 16 October 2020.
The board has taken its responsibility. This led to the last young person receiving a follow-up education place on 16 October 2020.
Het bestuur heeft zijn verantwoordelijkheid genomen. Dit heeft ertoe geleid dat op 16 oktober 2020 de laatste jongere een vervolg onderwijsplek heeft gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over ‘Raadsel rond nieuwbouw Avicenna College: ‘2,5 miljoen euro aan belastinggeld verdwenen’’

An MP asked the minister about the Rotterdam audit finding that the Avicenna College new building cost EUR 2.5 million less than budgeted, alleged sharing of the remainder between board and builder, inspectorate oversight, and whether board members can found a new school in The Hague. The minister said the municipality decides on conclusions from the audit, the inspectorate monitors lawful spending but not municipal housing funds, and the inspectorate will follow the school closely with a repair investigation in autumn 2021, while founding approval rests on legal conditions and new eligibility rules apply.
The research results give the inspectorate reason to critically follow developments at Avicenna College through a supervision plan, progress meetings and a repair investigation in autumn 2021.

De onderzoeksresultaten zijn voor de inspectie reden om de ontwikkelingen bij het Avicenna College kritisch te volgen door middel van een toezichtsplan, voortgangsgesprekken en een herstelonderzoek in het najaar van 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Cameraploeg PowNed belaagd door leerling Emmauscollege in Rotterdam’

MPs El Yassini and Heerema asked the Minister about reports that a PowNed camera crew was attacked by a pupil at the Emmauscollege in Rotterdam, including whether security intervened and what sanctions the school imposed. The Minister answered that a suspect was arrested, the criminal investigation is ongoing, the school provides support and sanctions for the minor, and that harassing journalists is unacceptable.
The criminal investigation is still ongoing, so I cannot yet make a statement about this case.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek loopt nog, waardoor ik over deze zaak nog geen uitspraak kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Van Meenen over ophef over een taalboek van de educatieve uitgeverij Malmberg

MPs Van den Hul and Van Meenen asked the minister whether the government would act on a grade 6 textbook exercise explaining 'allochtoon' and 'autochtoon' through stereotypes, which many saw as discriminatory. The minister answered that the government does not oversee textbook content given freedom of education, pointed to publisher-led responses and a conference on gender stereotypes, and declined to ask the Inspectorate to monitor the material.
Given the constitutionally anchored freedom of education and expression, it is not appropriate for the government to monitor, prohibit and/or test the content of learning materials.
Het past de overheid, gezien de grondwettelijk verankerde vrijheid van het onderwijs en meningsuiting, niet om toe te (laten) zien op de inhoud van leermiddelen, deze te verbieden en/of te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat NOS-medewerkers bedreigd worden

An SP MP asked the minister whether the NOS dropping logos from its satellite vans due to threats is unacceptable, whether the Stuurgroep Agressie en Geweld tegen Journalisten was consulted, whether police capacity suffices, and whether threats against journalists are rising. The minister condemned the threats, reported contact with NVJ/PersVeilig, police and the NOS, cited rising PersVeilig report figures for 2019 and 2020, and pointed to regeerakkoord funds for investigative journalism.
In our democratic society, the press must be able to do its work in freedom and safety.
In onze democratische samenleving moet de pers haar werk in vrijheid en veiligheid kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, El Yassini, Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over het bericht dat de NOS na aanhoudende bedreiging van journalisten de logo’s van de auto’s haalt

MPs asked the government about the NOS removing vehicle logos after persistent threats against journalists, and what concrete steps protect press freedom. The minister condemned the threats, described the PersVeilig and protocol measures and reports rising incident numbers, but gave no confirmed prosecution-effect data and committed only to a letter on the scheme's operation.

Because this registration option has only been available for a relatively short time, it cannot yet be established whether there is an increase in the number of cases in which prosecution was instituted for aggression against journalists.

Omdat deze registratiemogelijkheid nog maar relatief korte tijd beschikbaar is, kan nog niet worden vastgesteld of er sprake is van een toename van het aantal zaken waarin vervolging is ingesteld wegens agressie tegen journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘NOS haalt na aanhoudende bedreigingen logo van satellietwagens’

Two MPs asked the government about the NOS removing logos from its satellite vans after threats, the state of press freedom, measures in other countries, and online disinformation. The ministers answered that press freedom is a serious concern, pointed to existing protocols and prosecutions, and described existing measures against disinformation without announcing new structural steps.
In our democratic society it is of crucial importance that the press can carry out its work in freedom, safety and independence.
In onze democratische samenleving is het van cruciaal belang dat de pers haar werk in vrijheid, veiligheid en onafhankelijkheid kan uitoefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het nieuws dat leerlingen schoolexamens en herkansingen mislopen door thuisblijven met coronaklachten

Van den Hul (PvdA) asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether schools refuse to let pupils who miss school exams due to Covid symptoms or quarantine make them up, and whether this undermines equal opportunity. Minister Slob confirmed such reports, said schools must make reasonable efforts to allow make-up exams but set their own rules within the law, and that the Inspectorate handles any signs of unlawful conduct.

If there are signals that schools are acting outside the legal framework, it is up to the Inspectorate of Education to investigate what is happening and, where appropriate, supervise compliance with the laws and regulations.

Indien er signalen zijn dat scholen buiten de wettelijke kaders treden, is het aan de Inspectie van het Onderwijs om te onderzoeken wat er speelt en eventueel toe te zien op de naleving van de wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de  uitzending van Nieuwsuur van 5 oktober 2020

An MP (D66) asked the minister about a Nieuwsuur report on a Limburg special school that reportedly shifts pupils between funding categories and refunds the difference to the regional partnership, and about pupils over 18 remaining in special secondary education. The minister says the practice is legal and not a concern for funding categories, notes that care funds must not be used to choose funding categories, and says there is no clear evidence of pupils sitting at home after 18.
For a full answer to your questions I refer you to my response to your committee letter on the alleged TLV fraud at Tyltylschool De Maasgouw.
Graag verwijs ik u voor een uitgebreid antwoord op uw vragen naar mijn reactie op uw commissiebrief over de vermeende TLV-fraude op Tyltylschool De Maasgouw
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over ventilatiesystemen in schoolgebouwen

Two SP MPs asked whether school ventilation systems meet standards, how quickly they could be improved, which countries the RIVM cited for keeping schools open, and what it would cost to fix ventilation in all Dutch schools. The minister said the OMT and RIVM saw no reason to change ventilation policy, pointed schools to existing Bouwbesluit requirements and guidance, noted that 11 percent of school buildings in an incomplete survey fell short, and referred to a 360 million euro fund that municipalities can draw on with schools.
The advice to schools is, insofar as they have not yet done so, to check their ventilation against the applicable requirements.
Het advies aan scholen is – voor zover dat nog niet gedaan is – hun ventilatie te controleren op de daarvoor geldende eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Utrecht moet vervoer naar islamitische school in Amsterdam betalen'

An MP asked the minister whether transport cost rules for pupils should exclude schools rated very weak or harmful by the inspectorate, and why the government will not tighten the 'closest accessible school' rule. The minister replied that school performance is not a condition in the law, parents choose the school, and the inspectorate and minister handle failing schools instead.
It is up to the Inspectorate of Education to determine whether a school meets the legal requirements and to issue remedial orders in case of shortcomings.
Het is aan de inspectie van het onderwijs om vast te stellen of een school aan de wettelijke eisen voldoet en bij tekortkomingen herstelopdrachten te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Omroepen voor het karretje misdaad’

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Media ministers about reports that broadcasters serve criminals, including the OM's reaction to the series Cannabis, a police officer being discredited, a secretly recorded prosecutor-lawyer call, and payments to a convicted drug trafficker. The minister declined to comment on the ongoing case, referred to the OM for its own view, pointed to tightened NPO payment rules, and stated that the broadcaster said no payment was made to the drug trafficker.
Moreover, it is not appropriate for me to make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal case.
Daarnaast past het mij niet inhoudelijke mededelingen over een lopende strafzaak te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Docenten Emmauscollege bedreigd om spotprent na aandacht voor moord op Samuel Paty'

An MP asked the minister about threats against teachers at a Rotterdam school after a satirical cartoon was shown in class following the Samuel Paty killing. The minister condemned the threats, confirmed a police report and support from the inspectorate and a school safety foundation, and said schools and teachers will be supported but gave no new structural measures.
It is completely unacceptable that a teacher has been intimidated and threatened for wanting to convey the value of free speech to his pupils.
Het is volstrekt onacceptabel dat een leraar is geïntimideerd en bedreigd omdat hij de waarde van het vrije woord wil overbrengen op zijn leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kröger en Van den Berge over maatregelen tegen verspreiding COVID-19 op scholen

MPs from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Basic and Secondary Education about poor school ventilation, school closures due to COVID-19 infections, online education for quarantined pupils, mask rules and related guidance. The minister answered that schools are responsible for ventilation improvements supported by €100 million short-term and €260 million long-term funding, and outlined existing monitoring, advice and guidance without committing to new binding measures.
In addition, I call on schools to share the results with staff and parents.
Daarnaast roep ik op de resultaten te delen met het personeel en de ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Rutgers: 1 op 3 basisscholen geeft geen les over homoseksualiteit'

MP Bergkamp asked the Minister of Education whether schools teach about sexual diversity as required by the core objectives, given a Rutgers survey showing a third of primary schools do not, and what action will be taken on lesson methods, mbo and secondary teaching and teacher training. The minister replied that schools have discretion in how they meet the core objectives, cited an inspectorate study finding 86 percent of schools address sexual diversity, pointed to inspection enforcement and a request for further monitoring, and noted the curriculum revision will sharpen the core objective.

I have asked the inspectorate to give further attention in upcoming studies to how schools address sexual diversity, and to keep me informed of the current state of affairs regarding schools' attention to sexual diversity.

Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd de invulling die scholen geven aan seksuele diversiteit in komende onderzoeken verder aandacht te geven, en mij op de hoogte te houden van de actuele stand van zaken rond de aandacht van scholen voor seksuele diversiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de noodkreet dat het lerarentekort niet meer wordt gemeld

MP Kwint (SP) asked the education minister how the government will respond to a teacher's plea that the shortage reporting website no longer gives a realistic picture of teacher shortages, and whether the government will take over measurement itself. Minister Slob answered that he regrets the initiator stopping, that corona and other data sources are being used, and that a fuller measurement method will be decided in spring after a G5 survey and a review in December.
I would have liked the website to stay online and we would have worked on increasing the number of registrations, but I respect his decision.
Ik had graag gezien dat de website in de lucht bleef en we zouden werken aan het verhogen van het aantal registraties, maar ik respecteer zijn beslissing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Directeur Avicenna College moet terugtreden'

An MP asked the minister about press reports on governance failures and poor education quality at Avicenna College, including the director's role, the inspectorate's oversight and a new school application in The Hague. The minister replied that an external expert's recommendations are being adopted, an interim board is being appointed with a new supervisory board, the inspectorate is investigating both governance and quality, and the Hague school approval stands while SIVOR must first fix Rotterdam.
At the same time, the school has the full attention of the Inspectorate of Education.
Tegelijkertijd heeft de school de volle aandacht van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Yassini over het bericht ‘Benoeming Matthijs van Nieuwkerk krijgt staartje’

An MP asked the Minister whether the NPO, BNNVARA and NTR had misled the ministry about possible salary constructions and cost increases for the Matthijs van Nieuwkerk programme after the Court of Audit report, and what consequences and checks would follow. The Minister maintained that the cost rise is explained by outsourcing and programme changes, that no salary construction exists under the applicable rules, and announced talks with the broadcasters and a proposal for lower pay caps, but declined further investigation of other programmes.
I therefore see no reason at this stage to conduct further research into this, especially since it has been agreed with your House that programme costs will be reported at genre level.
Ik zie dus vooralsnog geen aanleiding om hier nader onderzoek naar te doen, te meer omdat met uw Kamer is afgesproken dat over de programmakosten op genreniveau zal worden gerapporteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, El Yassini, Sneller en Van der Graaf over het bericht 'Hoe Jeroen Pauw vertrok en toch een beetje kon blijven'

MPs asked the minister about reports that BNNVARA rejected a production company's proposal around Jeroen Pauw's contract as a salary-cap workaround, and about transparency of presenter pay constructions at the public broadcaster. The minister answered that he does not interfere in individual contract negotiations, that BNNVARA acted within the BPPO framework, and that he will discuss tighter rules with the NPO and broadcasters, reporting in the November 2021 media budget letter.
Given the division of responsibilities, it is not for me to interfere in individual contract negotiations.
Vanuit de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling die geldt past het mij niet om me te mengen in individuele contractonderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Rog over het al dan niet verplicht dragen van mondkapjes in het leerlingenvervoer

MPs Van den Berg and Rog (CDA) asked why the emergency regulation requires masks for travellers aged 13 and over while official guidance exempts pupils in special secondary education, and asked for clarity before schools reopened. The minister confirmed the regulation prevails over sector protocols, said pupils need not wear masks in school transport, and announced a formal instruction to safety regions ending enforcement of the mask requirement for that transport.
This clarity is provided through an additional instruction to the chairs of the safety regions under the Public Health Act
Deze duidelijkheid wordt geboden door een aanvullende aanwijzing aan de voorzitters van de veiligheidsregio’s op grond van de Wet publieke gezondheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Van der Graaf over het bericht ‘Onderwijs is failliet’

ChristenUnie MPs asked whether planned education cuts on Curaçao (a further 18% for special education on top of 12.5% wage cuts) follow from Dutch crisis-support conditions, and whether a proper impact analysis, equal funding and governance improvements are in place. The State Secretary replied that no cuts have been decided, the 12.5% wage reduction is a Curaçao-determined measure rather than a specific education demand, and a joint review of education governance and financing will precede any reforms.
The reforms in education proposed by the Netherlands will start with a thorough, joint review of the current state of education, which will also examine governance and financing.

De door Nederland voorgestelde hervormingen in het onderwijs starten met een gedegen, gezamenlijke doorlichting van de huidige staat van het onderwijs, waarbij ook gekeken zal worden naar de governance en de financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van der Molen over de berichten 'Geweld door drillrappers verheerlijkt' en 'Ingewijden: Rotterdammer (19) doodgestoken door lid Amsterdamse drillrapgroep'

Two CDA MPs asked whether drill rap glorifying violence is linked to youth knife incidents, whether a causal link has been studied, and whether public broadcaster BNNVARA should have published violent drill videos on its platform. The minister said a national action plan on youth weapon possession is being drafted, that research on Rotterdam is awaited, that broadcasters are editorially independent and BNNVARA removed two videos and added warnings and classification.
The action plan is expected to be ready by early November.
Het actieplan zal naar verwachting begin november gereed zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Ruim de helft van de basisschoolleerlingen heeft vanwege coronamaatregelen drie maanden geen gymles gehad’

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education whether schools met the two-hour weekly physical education requirement after COVID-19 closures left many pupils without gym, and what would be done about resulting motor-skill deficits and compliance after summer. The minister said the inspectorate monitors via signals and would intervene if needed, schools can use catch-up funding, and the government will stay in dialogue on post-summer continuity.

When the inspectorate, for example following signals, establishes that a school does not comply with the current legal framework, it will address the school or board and, if necessary, issue a remedial order.

Wanneer de inspectie, bijvoorbeeld naar aanleiding van signalen, vaststelt dat een school zich niet aan de huidige wettelijke kaders houdt, dan zal zij de school of het bestuur daarop aanspreken en volgt zo nodig een herstelopdracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘schrappen eindtoets groep 8 kan ongelijkheid vergroten’

An MP asks the education minister about a CPB report warning that scrapping the basic-school final test (eindtoets) may disadvantage around 14,000 pupils, especially those from lower-income or lower-educated or migrant families, who would miss a higher school recommendation. The minister accepts the CPB conclusions, points to schools' professional judgement, the April 2020 letter urging schools to place pupils generously, and planned monitoring and a new school-advice handbook, but does not adopt mandatory rules.
For this reason I have asked primary and secondary schools to pay attention to pupils who may not enter at a level that suits their abilities in school year 2020/2021.

Om die reden heb ik bij scholen in het primair en voortgezet onderwijs aandacht gevraagd voor leerlingen die in schooljaar 2020/2021 mogelijk niet instromen op een niveau dat past bij hun capaciteiten en mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht dat journalisten bedreigd zijn na berichtgeving over boerenprotesten

MPs Sneller and Van Beukering-Huijbregts asked the government how it views threats and blockades against journalists covering farmer protests, whether complaints were filed, and whether it will engage with the affected media. The Minister answered that threats against journalists are unacceptable, pointed to the PersVeilig initiative and prosecution protocols, reported no fines or known complaints for the Best incident, and said the government stands for a free press without committing to new talks.
Aggression and violence against journalists is unacceptable.
Agressie en geweld tegen journalisten is onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Rog en Van Meenen over LVS-instrumenten

MPs Bisschop, Rog and Van Meenen asked the minister whether the Expert Group on Primary Education Tests can assess observation instruments in the student tracking system (LVS) given the legal basis, and why the rules, criteria and transparency of the assessment framework are as they are. The minister answered that observation instruments count as LVS tests, that a Toetsbesluit amendment is needed to limit kindergartners to observation instruments, that no separate framework is needed, and that the framework was briefly unavailable online due to a website error.
An amendment to the Toetsbesluit PO is needed so that for kindergartners only observation instruments can qualify for approval by the Expert Group.
Een wijziging van het Toetsbesluit PO is nodig, zodat voor kleuters alleen observatie-instrumenten in aanmerking kunnen komen voor goedkeuring door de Expertgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van Meenen, Kwint en Rog over de lerarenbeurs

MPs asked why the teacher grant (lerarenbeurs) budget was exhausted in 2020, how many applications were rejected, and why the Chamber was not informed earlier. The ministers answered that 2,416 initial applications were rejected after renewal applications were prioritised, and that budget cuts from parliamentary amendments reduced the budget from 78 to 49.6 million euros, communicated through several channels.
We could not inform you earlier because applications could be submitted until 30 June, and only afterwards was it clear how many renewal applications had been submitted.
Wij konden u niet eerder informeren omdat er tot en met 30 juni aanvragen ingediend konden worden en het pas daarna duidelijk was hoeveel herhaalaanvragen waren ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat Doekle Terpstra voorzitter is van het nieuwe coördinatieteam ventilatie op scholen

An MP asked the minister whether the chair of the new school ventilation coordination team, who also chairs the installation-sector trade body Techniek Nederland, creates a conflict of interest and threatens independence. The minister answered that the team only advises and inventories, that the chair acts in a personal capacity, and that school boards and GGDs remain responsible for action and costs.
I do not doubt his integrity.
Ik twijfel niet aan zijn integriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over omscholingstrajecten om leraar te worden

An MP asks how career changers into teaching can find routes, how many drop out and why, whether unmet demand causes waiting lists, and why a second education master costs about 9,000 euro for 25 EC. The ministers answer that a national helpdesk and regional points exist, dropout data is incomplete and being studied, the subsidy must be reported if training stops, and a maximum institutional tuition rate will apply from 2022-2023 via a pending bill.
We share your view that more insight is needed into the course of the career-changer route.
Wij delen met u dat er meer inzicht nodig is in het verloop van de route zij-instroom.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de lopende band aan seksadvertenties die worden geplaatst op platforms waarop veel kinderen actief zijn

An MP asked the Minister whether the government would act against automated sex-advertising spambots appearing in comments on platforms popular with children, and who is responsible for preventing this. The Minister answered that children should be protected through media literacy, that platforms bear responsibility and remove content mostly by AI, and that he will raise the concern with his Irish counterpart regarding the Irish regulation of platforms.
I will convey your and my concerns about inappropriate spam comments to my Irish counterpart, with the request to take this into account in the regulation for tech companies established in Ireland.
Ik zal mijn Ierse ambtsgenoot uw en mijn zorgen over ongepaste spamreacties overbrengen met het verzoek hier bij de regelgeving voor in Ierland gevestigde techbedrijven rekening mee te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat het Pax Christi College in Druten voornemens is om de huidige techniekprofielen vanaf het schooljaar 2021 te laten vervallen

An MP asks whether the Minister will protect technical vocational (vmbo) profiles at Pax Christi College in Druten, which plans to replace them with a single profile, and how this fits the government's funding for technical education. The Minister answers that the school's plan is a local and regional choice, that technical electives can remain, that regional Sterk Techniekonderwijs plans cover the area, and that a reverse-efficiency test was considered but a stronger accountability duty for school boards needs further study.
The Mondial College in Nijmegen offers the PIE and BWI profiles.
Het Mondial College in Nijmegen biedt de profielen PIE en BWI aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over de recente Zuid-Koreaanse studie naar de overdraagbaarheid van COVID-19 door kinderen

Two SP MPs asked the Health and Education Ministers about a South Korean study on children's transmission of COVID-19 and its implications for school reopening. The government answered that the study rests on few children, offers no new insight into transmission and did not study school openings, and committed to monitoring the literature and reporting school-linked clusters to OCW.
RIVM informs the Ministry of Health about the latest developments so they can be taken into account in policy-making.
Het RIVM informeert VWS over de meest recente ontwikkelingen, zodat deze meegenomen kunnen worden in de beleidsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over “bijlagen bij WOB verzoek goedkeuring SIVOR”

An MP asked the minister whether the Islamic secondary school foundation SIVOR's application was rejected because its enrolment forecast fell below the foundation norm, whether DUO's forecasting software contained errors, and whether the ministry adjusted the application in the applicant's favour. The minister confirmed the software errors were corrected and the application assessed as submitted, while explaining that DUO's control forecast can revise forecasts up or down and that application rules are applied equally.
The errors in the calculation module have been corrected, after which a correct forecast was used to assess this application.
De fouten in de rekenmodule zijn gecorrigeerd, waarna alsnog een juiste prognose is gebruikt voor de beoordeling van deze aanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Rog over het onterecht innen van verplichte ouderbijdragen voor onderwijs aan hoogbegaafden

MPs Kwint and Rog asked whether schools illegally collected mandatory parental contributions for gifted-children education, how much was collected, whether parents were refunded and informed, and what sanctions apply. The minister answered that the school had stopped collecting, the inspectorate found no reason for specific investigation, refunds were made or reserved, letters were sent to schools, and sanctions are enforced by the inspectorate.
I will ask the board to bring this to the attention of all parents.
Ik zal het bestuur vragen dit onder de aandacht te brengen bij alle ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het sneuvelen van het wetsvoorstel afschaffen fusietoets funderend onderwijs in de Eerste Kamer

MP Kwint asked the Minister what steps will follow the Senate's rejection of the bill abolishing the merger test in primary and secondary education, and why the Commission for the merger test (CFTO) was dissolved early, along with costs, recent mergers, and lessons learned. The Minister answers that the light test remains in force, the council-support guarantees fall away, the CFTO will not be re-established for now, and the Senate's concerns about school scale enlargement are noted.
I will investigate whether I can find a solution for that.
Ik ga onderzoeken of ik daar een oplossing voor kan vinden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul  over ongeveer 14.000 leerlingen met een migratieachtergrond, kinderen van laagopgeleide ouders en kinderen van ouders met een laag inkomen die volgens het Centraal Planbureau z

An MP asked whether the cancellation of the primary school final test during the corona crisis means pupils with migrant backgrounds and from low-income or low-educated families will more often miss a higher secondary school recommendation, and whether existing measures suffice. The minister acknowledges the risk, points to guidance to schools, a transfer form and an extra evaluation in first-year secondary, and promises to keep monitoring the group and take further measures if needed.

I trust that secondary schools will take their responsibility here and, as I have promised, I will continue to follow this group of pupils in the coming period and take additional measures where necessary.

Ik vertrouw erop dat vo-scholen hier hun verantwoordelijkheid in zullen nemen en zal, zoals ik heb toegezegd, deze groep leerlingen de komende tijd blijven volgen en waar nodig aanvullende maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Jasper van Dijk over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat nog altijd één op de vijf reformatorische scholen het homohuwelijk moreel onacceptabel vindt

Two MPs asked the minister how rejecting homosexuality as contrary to God's word fits with a safe school climate for gay pupils, and whether the inspectorate has been asked to ensure this, and whether the planned sexual-diversity kerndoelen in the coalition agreement will still be realised this term. The minister replied that schools must take responsibility for a safe climate, that the inspectorate already supervises this and will intervene on signals of insecurity, and that the sexual-diversity goals will be reviewed alongside the integral curriculum revision from autumn 2020.
The inspectorate therefore already supervises this.
De inspectie houdt dus al toezicht hierop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het verwijderen van oude tv-programma’s die heel erg kwetsend zijn

An MP asks the Minister whether the removal of older TV programmes such as Fawlty Towers and Gone with the Wind for political-correctness reasons threatens artistic and expression freedom, and whether the NPO should be called to account for asking public broadcasters about older programmes. The Minister answers that the debate on racism is legitimate, that the NPO and broadcasters act on their own public responsibility rather than government instruction, that no content is removed unless broadcasters and makers agree, and that the NPO should be transparent about its considerations.
It goes without saying that the NPO and the public broadcasters take part in that debate and, in that context, reflect on programmes from the past.
Het is vanzelfsprekend dat de NPO en de publieke omroepen deelnemen aan dat debat en in dat kader nadenken over programma's uit het verleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld  en Van den Hul over het bericht dat dertig leerlingen uit het speciaal basisonderwijs noodgedwongen ondergebracht worden bij reguliere scholen

MPs Kwint, Westerveld and Van den Hul asked whether a school board could unilaterally move 30 pupils from a special primary school to regular schools without parental consent, and how the Inspectorate handled complaints about the school. Minister Slob answered that the law does not expressly regulate this, that parents were individually consulted and given school visits, that the Inspectorate received 12 complaints and a repair inspection is under way, and that no further action is needed.
The legislation does not expressly regulate this.
In de wetgeving is dit niet uitdrukkelijk geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen  van de leden Van den Hul, Van Meenen, Westerveld en Kwint over selectief aanmeldbeleid bij basisscholen

MPs asked the minister how government and the Education Inspectorate responded to research showing Utrecht primary schools operated pre-registration practices that breached the law and harmed equal access, including for children with migrant backgrounds. The minister said the inspectorate can intervene, that the municipality and school boards are drafting an improvement plan due in October, and that a broader study of admission policy and a policy agenda on segregation will follow.
If it becomes apparent that this is not being complied with, the Education Inspectorate can intervene.
Als blijkt dat daaraan niet wordt voldaan kan de Inspectie van het Onderwijs ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het lerarentekort in Rotterdam

MPs asked the minister about the teacher shortage in Rotterdam, including the doubled shortfall under a new measurement method, the disadvantage faced by schools with many pupils at risk of educational disadvantage, the adequacy of funding, and the use of unqualified teachers for up to 22 hours a month. The minister answered that the shortage is being tackled through regional and G5 emergency plans with funding, that a better measurement method is under study with a report expected in December, and that the qualification requirements are not being changed.
I expect to be able to inform your House further about these methods in December.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer in december nader te kunnen informeren over deze methodes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht over de sluiting van basisschool De Fontein te Lelystad

An MP asked the education minister about the closure of primary school De Fontein in Lelystad, including parents' ability to choose a school during COVID-19 and whether closure could be postponed one year. The minister confirmed contact with the school, said no generic exemption from the closure norm would be granted, and noted the school had decided to close and pupils were being placed elsewhere.
I see no reason for a generic exception to grant schools a one-year postponement due to the coronavirus crisis.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een generieke uitzondering om scholen een jaar uitstel te verlenen in verband met de coronacrisis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over het Hoenderloo College

MPs Hijink and Kwint asked the ministers about an open letter from Hoenderloo College staff alleging misconduct by Pluryn toward the works council, parents and youth, the inspectorate's role, and the closure and social plan. The minister answers that responsibility lies primarily with Pluryn, that the inspectorate monitors closely and rejects the staff's description of its role, that placements are being arranged with ongoing monitoring, and that a social plan was agreed on 26 June 2020.
The education inspectorate supervises the quality and continuity of education.
De onderwijsinspectie ziet toe op de kwaliteit en continuïteit van het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht over de sluiting van basisschool De Fontein te Lelystad

An MP asked the minister whether the planned closure of primary school De Fontein in Lelystad, due to failing the closure norm, should be postponed a year given the closure of the neighbouring school and the Covid-19 crisis, and whether the school could be funded for another year.
