The minister confirmed awareness of the local support for postponement but said the board has definitively decided to close the school on 1 August 2020, with the ministry, municipality and other boards now seeking placements for pupils, and refused to extend funding.
I have since learned from the board of De Fontein that they are definitively closing their school as of 1 August 2020.
Inmiddels heb ik van het bestuur van De Fontein vernomen dat zij hun school definitief sluiten per 1 augustus 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over het Hoenderloo College

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked why the Hoenderloo College is closing by 1 August 2020, whether Pluryn is meeting its duty of care, and whether the ministers can intervene or place the foundation under curatorship. The ministers replied that the closure date is only a target, the institution closes only once every young person has a suitable follow-up placement, the inspectorate is monitoring this and has tightened supervision, and curatorship of a private foundation is not possible outside bankruptcy.
It has been agreed, however, that the Hoenderloo Group will only close once a suitable and sustainable follow-up place has been found for every young person.
Afgesproken is, echter, dat de Hoenderloo Groep pas sluit als er voor iedere jongere een passende en duurzame vervolgplek is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Provinsje tsjin foarnimmen minister Slob om Tresoar ôf te stjitten'

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet and Van der Molen asked the minister whether he intends to withdraw the Rijk from the joint regulation with Tresoar and keep funding only archive tasks, and whether this respects Frisian language obligations. The minister confirms the planned exit from the regional historical centres' joint regulations from around 2024, says the Rijk will continue funding both archive and Frisian language tasks, and states that partnership in the joint regulation is not needed to meet those obligations.
I intend to continue both of these contributions to Tresoar.
Ik ben van plan deze beide bijdragen aan Tresoar te continueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het racisme bij de NOS

An MP from the PVV asks the minister about a 'diversity trophy' at the public broadcaster NOS, alleging it sidelines journalistic objectivity, discriminates against white people, and downplays negative news about immigrants, and asks whether the NPO board members should be removed. The minister answers that the NOS's aims and working method are its own responsibility, that the trophy has been discontinued, that the awards are an internal editorial matter, and that the public broadcaster's diversity mandate is in the Mediawet; he sees no reason to doubt the NOS's objectivity.
Government interference does not fit in that.
Daarin past bemoeienis vanuit de overheid niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Yassini over het bericht 'NOS divibase: Staatsomroep heeft geheime wisselbokaal voor 'divers profileren''

An MP asked the Minister about the NOS 'Divibase' database and monthly 'Divibokaal' award, and whether tracking guests by sex or ethnicity is acceptable and consistent with GDPR. The Minister answered that the NOS aims for a diverse range of sources, that the award was an internal tool without formal criteria, that privacy compliance is for the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens to judge, and that the NOS has since stopped the award.
It is not for me to pass judgment on this. That is the task of the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Het is niet aan mij om hierover een oordeel te vellen. Dat is de taak van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over misstanden bij het Haga Lyceum

An MP asks the minister about governance failures at the Haga Lyceum, including the alleged wiretapping of the Inspectorate during its investigation, the board crisis, and whether the school should be closed. The minister answers that the inspectorate could complete its work, that the court ordered two of three board members to step down, that a special intervention (aanwijzing) is being pursued, and that closure is not the aim.
The inspectorate is currently conducting a new investigation at the Cornelius Haga Lyceum and into the board.
De inspectie voert momenteel opnieuw onderzoek uit bij het Cornelius Haga Lyceum en naar het bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over extra voordelige Ster zendtijd voor brancheorganisaties en belangenverenigingen

An MP asked whether the farmers' action group FDF received discounted Ster advertising airtime, whether ads breaching the Advertising Code should be barred from preferential slots, and whether charities should receive equal shares of the discounted airtime. The minister answered that FDF bought airtime at regular rates, that Ster is bound by Advertising Code Commission rulings, and that airtime allocation is Ster's responsibility under the Media Act, so he cannot intervene.
Filling the Ster airtime is the responsibility of Ster.
Het invullen van de Ster-zendtijd is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Ster.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Van Meenen en Rog over het beoordelingskader voor LVS-instrumenten van de Expertgroep toetsen PO

MPs Bisschop, Van Meenen and Rog asked the minister why the Expert group on primary school tests applies its quality framework to observation instruments in early childhood (kleuters) and how that fits the legal basis and the pending bill removing mandatory normed tests. The minister answered that observation instruments tracking pupil growth must be approved by the Expert group, that the criteria are transparent, and that the Inspectorate will carry out an implementation check on the amendment before any change takes effect.
I therefore ask the Inspectorate to carry out an implementation check on the amendment, as is usual for regular legislative procedures.
Ik vraag de inspectie daarom een uitvoeringstoets uit te voeren op het amendement, zoals ook bij reguliere wetstrajecten gebruikelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over steun voor The Daily Herald op Sint Eustatius en Saba

An SP MP asked whether The Daily Herald, a Sint Maarten paper serving Sint Eustatius and Saba, should be supported during the coronavirus crisis, given its dependence for local news and its financial strain. The ministers answered that the government values local information provision, that a one-off emergency fund for Caribbean Netherlands media has been created, and that The Daily Herald will be able to claim a fixed amount per island.
Yes. The Daily Herald will be able to claim a fixed amount per island within its service area in the Caribbean Netherlands from the OCW-Caribbean Area department of the RCN.
Ja. The Daily Herald zal bij de afdeling OCW-Caribisch Gebied in RCN aanspraak kunnen maken op een vast bedrag per eiland binnen haar verzorgingsgebied binnen Caribisch Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het leerlingenvervoer in het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister about school transport for special secondary education pupils after reports that some municipalities could not arrange it and that taxis refused pupils or required masks. The Minister said municipalities are responsible, that transport has largely gone well with few reports of missed school, and that children who cannot keep masks on should be transported with 1.5m distance, but gave no concrete new step.
Responsibility for implementing pupil transport lies with the municipality, because locally it is best assessed what transport is needed.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer ligt bij de gemeente, omdat lokaal het beste kan worden bekeken welk vervoer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Macron gaat buitenlandse imams weren’

MPs Becker, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Heerema asked the government about France's plan to restrict foreign imams, about radical religious influence in Dutch neighbourhoods, closing institutions, foreign-trained imams, an imam certification system, an imam training programme, informal education oversight and French-language rules in schools. The minister answered that the government will act against antidemocratic conduct without targeting any religion, points to a taskforce and a bill on dissolving legal persons, and promises an exploratory report on informal education before summer.
Due to signals of possible antidemocratic or intolerant elements within a number of organisations offering informal education, I have announced a broad exploration.
Vanwege signalen van mogelijke antidemocratische of onverdraagzame elementen binnen een aantal organisaties die informele scholing aanbieden, heb ik een brede verkenning aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het afleggen van examens in het buitenland

An MP from the CDA asked the education minister about the feasibility of foreign-based pupils taking Dutch state exams in the Netherlands during COVID-19 travel restrictions, and about the possibility of sitting exams at Dutch embassies. The minister answered that candidates abroad may request postponement, that the exam board will find solutions in exceptional cases, that Bonaire exams will be replaced by digital administration, and that embassy-based exams are not a general option.
Because the central written exam is cancelled this school year, the state exam consists only of the college exam.
Vanwege het vervallen van het centraal schriftelijk examen in dit schooljaar bestaat het staatsexamen alleen uit het college-examen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Tal van reformatorische scholen hanteren afwijzende verklaringen over LHBTI’s’

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen (D66) asked the ministers whether reformed schools' statements rejecting same-sex marriage and LGBTI lifestyles create an unsafe climate and exclude LGBTI pupils, and what the government will do. The ministers answered that schools may state their principles but must respect pupils' rights, must ensure a safe climate, are inspected on civic education and safety standards, and that a curriculum revision is underway, without committing to specific new action against the named schools.
It is up to the inspectorate to establish whether a school complies with these provisions.
Het is aan de inspectie om vast te stellen of een school aan deze bepalingen voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Jasper van Dijk over onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat nog altijd één op de vijf reformatorische scholen het homohuwelijk moreel onacceptabel vindt

MPs Van den Hul and Van Dijk asked whether reformed schools that describe homosexuality as contrary to God's word, and state that sexuality belongs only in a man-woman marriage, will be held to the legal duties on safety and citizenship, and whether the 2009 motion against such staff declarations is respected. The ministers answered that schools' freedom is bounded by fundamental rights, that the Inspectorate monitors safety and will intervene, that the employment exception no longer allows discrimination on sexual orientation, and that the attainment targets on sexual diversity will be sharpened as part of curriculum reform.
It is up to the inspectorate to establish whether a school complies with these provisions and to intervene if it does not.
Het is aan de inspectie om vast te stellen of een school aan deze bepalingen voldoet en om in te grijpen als dat niet het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de manier waarop corona de kansenongelijkheid in het onderwijs vergroot

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education whether corona is widening educational inequality, including under-advising of children from lower-educated families, and what structural measures will be taken. The minister acknowledged the widening gap and the need for extra support, pointing to a 244 million euro catch-up fund, continued equity programmes and the handreiking schooladvisering, but did not commit to new structural changes beyond existing measures.
The cabinet is allocating 244 million euros to make up for the disadvantages that children in vulnerable positions suffered in education during the corona lockdown.
Het kabinet trekt 244 miljoen euro uit om de achterstanden weg te werken die kinderen in een kwetsbare positie tijdens de corona-lockdown in het onderwijs hebben opgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over de wanhopige oproep van de docenten van de Hoenderloo Groep en de huidige stand van zaken

MPs Hijink and Kwint asked about teachers' distress over the closure of the Hoenderloo Groep, including the lack of a social plan, placement of pupils, and whether the school should stay open. The minister answers that a social plan is under negotiation, pupils are being transferred to suitable youth-care places, and he sees no reason to keep the school open, while promising to keep the Chamber informed.
The Minister of VWS is willing to keep the Chamber informed of the progress of the closure, as he has done in the recent period from his system responsibility.
De Minister van VWS is bereid de Kamer, zoals hij ook de afgelopen periode heeft gedaan vanuit zijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid, op de hoogte te houden van de voortgang van de sluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het bericht 'Te weinig aandacht voor genocide Srebrenica in geschiedenisonderwijs'

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the limited attention to the Srebrenica genocide in history textbooks, and the victims' perspective, should be expanded. The minister acknowledged the importance of Srebrenica, pointed to existing curriculum references and the curriculum.nu process, but said content of teaching materials is not for the cabinet to assess under article 23(6) of the Constitution.

As my predecessors and I have already indicated to the House in earlier written questions, under article 23(6) of the Constitution it is not for the cabinet to assess the content of teaching materials, but for schools.

Zoals mijn voorgangers en ik aan uw Kamer in eerdere schriftelijke vragen hierover ook al hebben aangegeven, is het – conform artikel 23, lid 6 van de Grondwet – niet aan het kabinet om de inhoud van leermiddelen te beoordelen, maar aan scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Kwint over het bericht 'FunX-dj stopte met Ramadan late Night: 'Niet alleen ik werd met dood bedreigd''

MPs El Yassini and Kwint asked whether the government considers it unacceptable that a FunX DJ needed protection and stopped his Ramadan programme after death threats, and what is being done about press safety. The minister calls the threats unacceptable, says the programme ended for editorial reasons, declines to comment on a criminal investigation, and points to existing press-safety initiatives such as PersVeilig and a protocol with police and prosecutors.
Freedom of expression and press freedom are a great good and an important pillar of our society in a democratic constitutional state like the Netherlands.
Vrijheid van meningsuiting en persvrijheid zijn in een democratische rechtsstaat als Nederland een groot goed en een belangrijke pijler van onze samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een radioprogramma stopt na doodsbedreigingen

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a public radio programme ending after death threats was acceptable, whether the Stuurgroep Agressie en Geweld tegen Journalisten had been contacted, whether police protection was adequate, and whether the affected staff had been offered help. The minister called the threats unacceptable, said the broadcaster decided to end the programme for editorial reasons, reported contact with the NPO and PersVeilig, and stated that staff had not reported feeling unsafe.
Freedom of expression and press freedom are a great good and an important pillar of our society in a democratic constitutional state like the Netherlands.
Vrijheid van meningsuiting en persvrijheid zijn in een democratische rechtsstaat als Nederland een groot goed en een belangrijke pijler van onze samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ''Middelbare scholen: neem het maatwerkdiploma serieus''

MPs Heerema and Wiersma asked the education ministers about reports that pupils with a mixed-level (maatwerk) secondary diploma struggle to gain access to university or higher vocational study, and about related pilots and rules. The ministers answered that current routes exist for such pupils, that a broader review of mixed-level diplomas will be sent to parliament before summer, and that the experiment group and admission rules are being examined.

We are currently working on our policy response to the study on the advantages and disadvantages of diplomas with subjects at different levels in combination with access to further education, as mentioned in the coalition agreement.

Momenteel werken wij aan onze beleidsreactie op het onderzoek naar «voor- en nadelen van diploma’s met vakken op verschillende niveaus i.c.m. toegankelijkheid van het vervolgonderwijs»» uit het regeerakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint  en Van Meenen over het artikel ‘De prijs van een kleine klas’

MPs Kwint and Van Meenen asked the minister about Scholen voor Persoonlijk Onderwijs (SvPO): its time-counting, parental contributions, materials, governance and oversight. The minister answered that the Inspectorate is investigating several of these matters, that the school board may spend its budget freely within legal limits, and that parental contributions are voluntary.
The inspectorate will examine in the autumn whether this shortcoming has been remedied.
De inspectie onderzoekt in het najaar of deze tekortkoming is hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Van Toorenburg over het rapport van het Centrum tegen Kinderhandel en Mensenhandel (CKM) aangaande criminele uitbuiting onder Nederlandse scholieren

MPs Kuik, Rog and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the government about a CKM report on criminal exploitation and drug-related recruitment of Dutch schoolchildren, including school protocols, normalisation of drugs, prosecution statistics, non-punishment protection and the UK approach. The state secretary answered that protocols and prevention programmes exist, that data on drug-related trafficking cases is not registered separately, and that the government will explore closer cooperation and learn from the UK.
The Public Prosecution Service does not register in how many of these cases the exploitation is drug-related, nor whether it occurs among schoolchildren.
Het OM registreert niet in hoeveel van deze gevallen het gaat om drugsgerelateerde uitbuiting, en ook niet of dat gebeurt onder scholieren.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het onderschatten van leerlingen uit gezinnen met een lagere sociaaleconomische status

An MP asks the minister how the government responds to reports that children from lower-SES families are underrated by teachers, and what is done about regional under- and over-advising. The minister says he trusts school-advice professionals, will publish a school-advice handbook, is aware of the bias risks, and points to a bill on a single enrolment moment and publication of advice procedures.
At present, a school advice handbook is being developed in cooperation with SLO and the education sector.
Op dit moment wordt, in samenwerking met SLO en het onderwijsveld, een handreiking schooladvisering ontwikkeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de Luchtverkeersleiding met juridische stappen dreigt tegen NH Nieuws

MP Van Raan asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that air traffic control (LVNL) threatened legal action against NH Nieuws and NOS over broadcasting radio transmissions of a runway incident at Schiphol, and about the incident itself, including sixteen landings on a closed runway and a go-around. The minister answers that LVNL asked the media to stop rebroadcasting, that LVNL dropped legal steps, that the incident is under LVNL and OVV investigation with published reports, and that the procedural failure has been addressed by a system update.
LVNL has indicated that indeed it has not objected to all online fragments with R/T.
LVNL heeft aangegeven dat inderdaad niet tegen alle fragmenten met R/T die online staan bezwaar is gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over consequenties van de corona-crisis voor examenkandidaten in het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs bij de slaag-zakregeling die via een staatsexamen hun diploma moeten behalen

An MP asked the Minister of Basic and Secondary Education about the consequences of the corona crisis for special secondary education exam candidates taking state exams, including children out of sight, laptop provision, exam fairness and retake options. The minister answered that about 500 special secondary pupils are out of sight, that exam requirements are the same as in regular secondary education with tailored adjustments, and that a third retake option was added.
Following the debate in the House on 29 April, I agreed with the College voor Toetsen en Examens that a third retake will be added.
Naar aanleiding van het debat in de Kamer op 29 april heb ik met het College voor Toetsen en Examens afgesproken dat hier een derde herkansing aan wordt toegevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Hul over de verhuisbewegingen en onderwijs aan minderjarige asielzoekers

MPs Westerveld and Van den Hul asked whether frequent relocations of minor asylum seekers harm their Dutch-language learning and school access, and whether the coalition goal of minimising moves is being met. Minister Slob acknowledges the negative effect of moves, points to mitigation measures (a COA relocation checklist, summer relocations, the Flexibilisering Asielketen programme with implementation planned 2020–2024), says data on move trends are not yet conclusive, and rejects reports of schools refusing children, while noting the two-year funding period.
That is why the focus is mainly on medium-term measures.
Daarom wordt vooral ingezet op middellange termijn maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de eindrapportage `Begeleiding startende leraren 2014-2019’

An MP asked the minister about the final report on support for starting teachers (2014-2019), which found that support does improve teaching and that outflow falls when all schools in a board provide it, and about why support falls short of the sector accord target. The minister agreed the situation is unsatisfactory, said he is working on statutory strategic HRM requirements and talks with the VO-raad, and gave no firm new deadline or binding commitment beyond ongoing work.
That is why I am working on statutory requirements for strategic HRM policy.
Daarom werk ik aan wettelijke eisen voor strategisch HRM beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de effecten van de corona-crisis op kwetsbare kinderen en kansengelijkheid

An MP asked the education minister about vulnerable children during the COVID-19 crisis, including how to identify and reach them, care arrangements for children of essential workers, device access via SIVON, and long-term inequality. The minister said municipalities and schools are identifying vulnerable children, that monitoring is in place, that SIVON applications will be accepted beyond the deadline, and that he expects widening inequality and will inform parliament later.
I will inform you in due course about how we will, together with schools and municipalities, offer extra education and support to these children
Ik zal u te zijner tijd informeren over de manier waarop we samen met scholen en gemeenten deze kinderen extra onderwijs en begeleiding aan zullen bieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul, Nijboer en Kuiken over de gevolgen van het coronavirus

MPs from the Labour party asked the government about measures during the coronavirus crisis across care, education, housing, debt, and the Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered most questions by referring to earlier letters, while giving substantive answers on mantelzorg communication, eviction restrictions, and utility disconnection protections.
Because there may be obvious reasons for eviction, such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance, the cabinet is not willing to impose a moratorium.
Omdat er evidente redenen kunnen zijn om tot huisuitzetting over te gaan, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast, is het kabinet niet bereid om tot een moratorium over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat lokale en regionale kranten steun zoeken om de coronacrisis te overleven

MP Kwint asked the Minister of Education and Media whether local and regional newspapers facing coronavirus revenue losses would be supported, and whether support would be conditional on protecting freelancers and refraining from profit payouts to shareholders. The minister answered that a temporary support fund for free newspapers and local public broadcasters is being set up, that no conditions on profit distributions are considered necessary given the type of organisations, and that support will be provided as a credit later convertible to a grant.
Given the type of organisations the support fund targets and the size of support per organisation, conditions on profit distributions are in my view not relevant.

Gezien het type organisaties waar het Steunfonds zich op richt en de omvang van de verleende ondersteuning per organisatie zijn voorwaarden ten aanzien van winstuitkeringen mijns inziens niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van der Graaf, Sneller en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Lokale en regionale kranten zoeken steun om coronacrisis te overleven’

MPs asked the minister for Education and Media about the financial crisis facing local and regional newspapers during the coronavirus crisis, including support options, advertising revenue loss, consultation with publishers and foreign ownership risks. The minister announced a temporary support fund for free newspapers and local public broadcasters, coulance measures, and called on municipalities and provinces to contribute, without addressing executive oversight directly.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Ouders klagen nu ook in Amsterdam over School voor Persoonlijk Onderwijs‘

An MP asks the Minister about parent complaints at School voor Persoonlijk Onderwijs (SvPO) branches, including the inspectorate's handling of signals, the Utrecht 'zeer zwak' rating, governance, medezeggenschap, and sanctions. The Minister answers at length, describing inspectorate reports, the legal procedures, a planned broad inspection investigation, and that sanctions will be considered after that report.
I will await the inspectorate's report and then consider whether further measures are necessary and desirable.
Ik wacht de rapportage van de inspectie af en zal dan bezien of verdere maatregelen nodig en wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een rechterlijke uitspraak over het Haga Lyceum

Rep. Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education whether the court ruling limiting government action against the Haga Lyceum is acceptable, whether article 23 of the Constitution hinders intervention, and whether antidemocratic education and board members should be easier to dismiss. The Minister declined to comment on the pending appeal, said the citizenship education law should be clarified, and pointed to sanction powers and two bills already submitted to parliament.
That an independent judge rules on the lawfulness of government action is a great good that we must cherish.
Dat een onafhankelijke rechter oordeelt over de rechtmatigheid van overheidshandelen is een groot goed, dat we moeten koesteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over de sluiting van de onderwijstak van De Hoenderloo Groep

MPs Hijink and Kwint asked the ministers whether Pluryn's separation of the Hoenderloo College education branch into a separate foundation was used to strip teachers of their rights and funds, and what action the government would take. Minister Slob answered that the closure of the Hoenderloo College followed inevitably from closing the care locations, that the Inspectorate monitors Pluryn's finances and compliance, and that Pluryn has promised a social plan and new posts for teachers.
The Inspectorate of Education supervises compliance with laws and regulations, and if irregularities are found it will take appropriate measures.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs ziet toe op naleving van wet- en regelgeving en als blijkt dat er onrechtmatigheden zijn begaan dan zal de inspectie passende maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema, Smeulders, Westerveld en Özütok over het coronavirus (COVID-19)

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about its whole-of-government approach to COVID-19, equipment and ICU capacity, school decisions, Caribbean Netherlands coordination, economic measures like part-time unemployment benefit, accessibility of public communication, and intensified publicity. The minister answered that broad measures are in place, outlined capacity expansions and procurement steps, and committed to letters on decision-making and a school decision framework.
During the debate of Thursday 5 March I committed to inform you about this by letter.
Ik heb tijdens het debat van donderdag 5 maart toegezegd u hierover per brief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over leraren die onder druk worden gezet

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about reports that parents pressure teachers over school recommendations, that too-high placements harm pupils, and about testing and support for pupils. The Minister disputes the DUO study's conclusions, says pressure on primary schools has not risen, cites Oberon/Twente findings on second chances, and announces a school-recommendation handbook to be piloted in spring.
Furthermore, a handbook on school recommendations is currently being developed in cooperation with SLO and other stakeholders in the education sector.
Verder wordt op dit moment, in samenwerking met SLO en andere betrokkenen uit het onderwijsveld, een handreiking schooladvisering ontwikkeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de gevolgen van de invoering van de ja/ja-sticker voor huis-aan-huiskranten

An MP asked the minister whether municipal yes/yes sticker policies threaten local free newspapers, which they consider important for local news and democratic scrutiny, and what role the minister would play. The minister agreed that local journalism matters, said he would discuss the issue with aldermen and the VNG, but stressed that municipal sticker policy is a matter of local autonomy he will not override.
The importance of free local newspapers for citizens' information and local democracy should not, in my view, be jeopardised in the considerations around tackling waste mountains.

Het belang van huis-aan-huiskranten voor de informatievoorziening van burgers en voor de lokale democratie zou naar mijn mening niet in het gedrang mogen komen in de afwegingen rondom het tegengaan van afvalbergen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Geschiedenisles over de Holocaust op een diverse school: ‘soms lastige vragen’

Two VVD MPs asked the education minister about a report that teaching the Holocaust in diverse schools is sometimes difficult, whether the mandatory Holocaust curriculum is taught everywhere, and how teachers are supported. The minister answered that schools are obliged to teach the Holocaust but decide how, that the inspectorate does not monitor every school, that teachers can use School and Veiligheid training, and that the citizenship bill does not regulate content.
It is important that every pupil learns about the atrocities that took place during the Second World War.
Het is van belang dat elke leerling leert over de verschrikkingen die in de Tweede Wereldoorlog hebben plaatsgevonden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Yassini over antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het bericht dat Laura H. 400 euro vergoeding ontving voor haar deelname aan het televisieprogramma ‘Mensen met M’ en het bericht ‘Ergerni

An MP asked the Minister for Education and Media to clarify whether Laura H. received a 400-euro payment or an expense-related fee, in VVV vouchers, for appearing on the public broadcast programme 'Mensen met M', and whether this complies with the NPO code forbidding payment for stories. The Minister answers that she received a fee for preparatory efforts rather than for her story, that other guests were not paid, that the broadcaster is responsible for editorial content, and that supervision of the code lies with the Commissie Integriteit Publieke Omroep.
I have not received any signals about this. The NPO governance code provides sufficient clarity on what media institutions are and are not permitted to do.
Ik heb hier geen signalen over ontvangen. De governancecode NPO biedt voldoende duidelijkheid over wat de media-instellingen wel en niet is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse school is 5600 euro parkeergeld kwijt per docent’

An MP asked the minister about reported parking costs for teachers in Amsterdam, whether schools compensate them, and whether cities should be allowed unorthodox measures such as free parking or a city allowance. The minister said no data exist on parking costs or compensation, noted the sums are a maximum scenario and that parking policy is a local matter, and said he would not commit to a city allowance but declined to direct municipalities.
No data are available on this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over schooladviezen die jongeren kansen ontnemen

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked about reports that school recommendations underestimate children from low-educated families, and about measures against under-advising. Minister Slob acknowledges the concern, cites monitoring and a second opinion via the final test, and says a guidance handbook will be piloted and distributed, but denies being able to rule out under-advising.
I find it worrying that for some pupils there is under-advising.
Ik vind het zorgelijk dat er bij een deel van de leerlingen sprake is van onderadvisering.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht dat niemand precies weet hoeveel nieuwe leraren de zware opleiding tot juf of meester op de basisschool voor zij-instromers heeft opgeleverd

MP Van den Hul asked the minister about reports that nobody knows how many career-changer teachers the primary-school teacher training has produced, about estimated 20% dropout, the role of the ministry in monitoring this, and whether the 20,000-euro subsidy per career changer should be doubled. The minister answered that DUO has limited data on post-training retention, commissioned an evaluation and an inspectorate study, stated that supervision is the schools' and training institutes' responsibility, and said the subsidy is meant as a supplement, not to cover all costs.
For that reason I am having an evaluation study carried out on career-changer entry into primary, secondary and vocational education.
Om die reden laat ik een evaluatie-onderzoek uitvoeren naar zij-instroom in het po, vo en het mbo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht 'Dure zzp-er rukt op in scholen'

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about reports that self-employed teachers (zzp-ers) are increasingly used in schools, including the rise in self-employed workers in education and the costs schools pay for flexible staff. The minister confirmed the rise in the CBS figures, said the scope of school-level data on flexible staff is limited, and pointed to a pilot to make such data mandatory for school boards.
From the available information I have almost no information about flexible non-employed staff (PNIL).
Uit de beschikbare informatie heb ik nagenoeg geen informatie over de PNIL.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de 5-daagse sluiting van zestien basisscholen als gevolg van het lerarentekort

An MP asked the Minister why sixteen Amsterdam primary schools closed for a week due to teacher shortages, and how the government monitors the shortage's impact on education quality. The Minister said the inspectorate was informed in advance, pointed to a letter on teacher registration, and outlined regional emergency plans and extra funding for affected cities.
Given the complexity of this issue, we are choosing a combination of measures to arrive at as clear a picture as possible.
Vanwege de complexiteit van dit vraagstuk kiezen wij voor een combinatie van maatregelen om tot een zo helder mogelijk beeld te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de salarissen in het basisonderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about how a gross monthly teacher salary figure of about 4,400 euro was calculated, why holiday and year-end pay were included, and what the actual salary distribution and cost of closing the pay gap with secondary education would be. The minister defended the methodology, gave salary and total-pay figures per scale, reported cost estimates, and committed to answering before the next debate.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Studies niet toegerust op hoogbegaafd talent’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that higher education is not equipped for gifted students, and whether schools may charge parents for gifted-student provision and what action is taken against them. The minister acknowledges uneven provision, points to a subsidy scheme funding 139 partnerships, says there is no overview of gifted students or of costs, and states that voluntary parental contributions are legally allowed with inspectorate oversight and sanctions.
I have no overview of the number of gifted students who do or do not receive appropriate provision.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal hoogbegaafde studenten dat wel of geen passend aanbod krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het integraal verwerken van klimaatlessen in het Italiaanse onderwijs

An MP asked the ministers about Italy's plan to integrate climate and sustainability lessons across the curriculum and how this relates to Dutch education, including a parliamentary motion on inspectorate oversight of company-provided education. The ministers replied that the Italian plans are not yet concrete, that climate and sustainability already feature in Dutch curricula, that curriculum.nu addresses sustainability, and that schools have autonomy, so they see no need for intervention.
Moreover, we have no signals that this is the case.
Wij hebben trouwens geen signalen dat hiervan sprake zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het onderzoek van de Erasmus Universiteit over de representatie van mensen met een beperking in de media

An MP asked the minister about an Erasmus University study finding that only 66 of 6,129 talk-show guests had a disability, and what the government would do about representation in public broadcasting. The minister acknowledged the findings, said programming is a matter for the broadcaster under programmatic autonomy, and promised only to raise attention to disability visibility with the NPO.
However, how the public broadcaster fulfils this task in the form and content of its programmes is not for the government or politicians to decide.
De wijze waarop aan deze taak door de publieke omroep invulling wordt gegeven in vorm en inhoud van programma's is echter niet aan de overheid of politiek om te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het slechter presteren van kinderen als gevolg van het lerarentekort

MP Van den Hul asked whether the Inspectorate would investigate links between the teacher shortage and pupils' vocabulary, Cito scores and school advice, and what role the minister takes in countering the resulting inequality. Minister Slob answered that the Inspectorate does not investigate that direct link but considers teacher shortages in its supervision, and that tackling inequality is a shared responsibility supported by funding, regional measures, and teacher training.
The inspectorate does not conduct research into a direct link between the teacher shortage and vocabulary, Cito scores and school recommendations.
De inspectie voert geen onderzoek uit naar een direct verband tussen het lerarentekort en woordenschat, cito-scores en schooladviezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Islamitisch onderwijs groeit: aantal leerlingen in tien jaar tijd met 60 procent toegenomen’

An MP asked the minister about the reported growth of Islamic education, Cito scores of Islamic schools, underperforming schools, the use of the book 'Help ik word volwassen', and the value of diverse schools. The minister answered that religious denomination is not tracked as a growth factor, that the Inspectorate rates only two of 59 Islamic primary schools as weak or insufficient, that the schools' freedom of education is constitutionally protected, and that civic education duties apply to all schools.
It is not for the cabinet to assess the content of teaching materials.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om de inhoud van leermiddelen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Yassini over de uitzending ‘Mensen met M’ met als gast IS-ganger Laura H.

An MP asked the minister whether the KRO-NCRV paid guests of the programme 'Mensen met M', including convicted IS member Laura H., and whether public money should fund terrorists' stories and a planned series about her. The minister answered that the broadcaster paid a maximum of €750 per guest, that Laura H. received €400, that the series has not been acquired, and that broadcasters' editorial independence means he will not intervene.
The editorial independence of the broadcasters is a great good.
De redactionele onafhankelijkheid van de omroepen is een groot goed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Rog en Bisschop over het bericht “Bijzonder onderwijs furieus over intieme vragen bij inspectiebezoek”

MPs Bruins, Rog and Bisschop asked the minister about inspectors allegedly asking intimate questions of pupils during unannounced visits to about eighty schools for a thematic study of teaching materials. The minister replied that the Inspectorate acts independently, that the study is thematic stelseltoezicht with a broad sample, that unannounced visits are a legitimate instrument, and that the Inspectorate denies that intimate or personal questions were asked, with no complaints received.
The Inspectorate does not recognise the picture painted in the article you cite.
De inspectie herkent het beeld dat wordt geschetst in het door u aangehaalde artikel niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Hul over het bericht dat jongeren met een beperking te vroeg van school worden gestuurd

MPs Westerveld and Van den Hul asked the minister whether young people with disabilities are being removed from special secondary education too early, whether school boards can decide this unilaterally, and whether oversight and legal protection are adequate. The minister answered that the age limit is not absolute, decisions must be based on the pupil's development plan agreed with parents, the inspectorate has been asked to supervise, and existing appeal routes and legal protection are sufficient.
I have asked the Inspectorate to ensure that the partnerships comply with the statutory provisions in this regard.
Ik heb de Inspectie gevraagd er op toe te zien dat de samenwerkingsverbanden zich aan de wettelijke bepalingen in deze houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Von Martels en Van der Graaf over een onkostenvergoeding van vrijwilligers bij het Songfestival

MPs Van der Molen, Von Martels and Van der Graaf asked why volunteers at the Eurovision Song Contest cannot claim travel costs while paid staff can, and whether the minister would agree arrangements on volunteer expense reimbursement. The minister agreed volunteering deserves recognition, explained that paid staff are compensated under their contracts while volunteers get a local OV card, catering and clothing, and said he would raise volunteer positions with the NPO rather than commit to a specific reimbursement arrangement.
I will also draw the NPO's attention to the position of the volunteers.
Ik zal de NPO ook attenderen op de positie van de vrijwilligers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de GenietFabriek als voorziening voor thuiszitters

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether she supports the GenietFabriek initiative for children who cannot attend regular or special schools, and about enforcing a motion on school-board cooperation with such initiatives. The Minister said the initiative is still only a concept, that existing options such as orthopedagogical didactic centres and upcoming education-care arrangements address the problem, and declined to see the initiative as a pilot candidate for collective funding.
I am working with Minister De Jonge on solutions to this problem through the education-care arrangements.
Oplossingen voor dit probleem werk ik samen met Minister De Jonge uit bij de onderwijszorgarrangementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Bijna honderd miljoen gaat in 25 jaar naar vernieuwing Tilburgse middelbare scholen’

An MP asked the minister about reports that Tilburg secondary schools must fund a large share of building renewal, and whether municipalities use education housing funds from the municipal fund for other purposes. The minister answered that municipal funds are unearmarked and that schools may contribute to new buildings, while proposing legal clarification of responsibilities for school buildings.
The funds municipalities receive from the municipal fund are not earmarked and therefore fall under municipalities' policy and spending freedom.
De middelen die de gemeenten uit het gemeentefonds ontvangen zijn niet geoormerkt en vallen daardoor onder de beleids- en bestedingsvrijheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over mogelijke inzet van derdejaars pabo-studenten als zzp’er

The MP asked whether schools using third-year teacher-training (pabo) students as self-employed freelancers, who set their own fees and are cheaper than certified teachers, is acceptable for education quality and cost-effectiveness. The minister answered that third-year pabo students may not teach independently, only as interns, that fourth-year students may be employed as LIO trainee teachers under the law and collective agreement, and that the undesirable practice is already blocked without a new ban.
A third-year pabo student may not yet teach independently.
Een derdejaars pabo-student mag nog niet zelfstandig les geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Laçin over het bericht dat de lucht op achterstandsscholen vuiler is

SP MPs Kwint and Laçin asked the government about research showing children at disadvantaged schools breathe dirtier air, and about fine-dust zones, filtration, and school segregation. Minister Slob rejected the general conclusion, said data on fine-dust per school and filtration is not centrally available, and said responsibility for school housing lies with municipalities and school boards, while pointing to a planned integrated housing plan obligation.
No national data on fine-dust concentration per school are known to me.
Er zijn mij geen landelijke gegevens bekend over de fijnstofconcentratie per school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Verhoeven over het bericht dat DPG Media uitgeverij Sanoma overneemt

MPs Sneller and Verhoeven asked about DPG Media's takeover of publisher Sanoma and its effects on media plurality and competition. The minister replied that media concentration is not automatically a loss of plurality, that the ACM will assess competition effects in its merger review, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media monitors plurality annually.
Concentration of ownership within the media sector cannot simply be equated with a restriction of plurality.
Concentratie van eigenaarschap binnen de mediasector kan niet zonder meer gelijk gesteld worden aan inperking van pluriformiteit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Nijkerken-de Haan en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘schorsing om herkenbare leerlingen in bescherming te nemen’ en ‘drie jongens opgepakt voor mishandeling Gorinchem’

MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Education ministers why students filmed in a violent assault in Gorinchem were suspended rather than arrested, whether the schools protected perpetrators, and whether parents should lose child benefit, plus questions on youth gangs and the number of suspects. The minister answered that police arrested fourteen suspects under sixteen, all six incidents were reported, suspensions were to protect school calm, child benefit cannot be cut for under-sixteens, no national overview of youth gangs exists, and he will report on administrative approaches to street terror before the recess.
Due to the ongoing criminal investigation, I cannot make further statements about this case.
In verband met het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Peters over sluiting van jeugdzorginstelling Hoenderloo Groep

CDA MPs asked why youth care provider Pluryn is closing De Hoenderloo Groep, how the roughly 200 youths and 500 staff will be placed elsewhere, and what the financing of special education for the Gelderse Vallei consortium implies. The minister answers that Pluryn has announced the closure citing quality, finances and regional care, that a one-year phase-out plan with individual placements is in preparation under IGJ and education inspectorate supervision, and that funding changes and a planned AMvB on realistic youth care prices are being pursued, while the education funding issue has been corrected by a recovery action.
The IGJ is already involved and will assess this plan and actively supervise the care transfer of the youths currently staying at De Hoenderloo Groep.
De IGJ is reeds betrokken en zal dit plan beoordelen en actief toezien op de zorgvuldigheid van de zorgoverdracht van de jeugdigen die nu bij De Hoenderloo Groep verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘De stagiair is vogelvrij’ op AOb.nl op 19 november 2019

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether the position of teacher-trainee (lio) interns should be better safeguarded and why schools do not follow collective agreement rules on interns, after an AOb report that interns are treated as unprotected. The ministers answer that lio trainees may teach under supervision with a temporary contract, that existing collective agreement rules and a 2018 handreiking govern their deployment, and that they will ask the school boards' associations to inform schools and pay trainees.
We will ask the PO-Raad and VO-raad to inform school boards about this issue and urge them to pay a fee for the internship
We zullen de PO-Raad en de VO-raad vragen besturen te informeren over deze kwestie en erop aandringen een vergoeding te betalen bij de stage
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'De stagiair is vogelvrij'

An SGP MP asked the education ministers about reports that trainee teachers (stagiairs) are treated unequally and arbitrarily, performing lio-level duties without lio pay. The ministers said lio status and pay are set by the CAO, that stagiairs should not carry lio-level responsibilities, and that they will urge school boards via the PO-Raad and VO-Raad to pay stage allowances and to stop using stagiairs as lio.
We consider a remuneration for trainees desirable.
Daarbij vinden wij een vergoeding voor stagiairs wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de overstap van de voormalige voorzitter van het Commissariaat van de Media als lobbyist naar Netflix

An SP MP asked whether the former chair of the Commissariaat voor de Media moving to Netflix as a lobbyist, shortly before lobbying on the audiovisual directive, conflicts with integrity rules and whether this should be prevented. The minister answered that the move complies with current rules because about half a year passed between her departure and joining Netflix, and said he intends to introduce a longer cooling-off period in upcoming governance proposals.
I will include this in the amendment proposals I expect from the ongoing investigation into the governance of the Commissariaat.
Ik zal dit meenemen bij de wijzigingsvoorstellen die ik verwacht uit het nog lopende onderzoek naar de governance van het Commissariaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over de stevige impact van armoede op leerlingen in het basisonderwijs

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister, with the social affairs state secretary, how poverty affects primary school pupils and whether schools should take specific measures, such as referring parents to helpers and creating funds for school trips. The minister agreed equal opportunities matter and described existing municipal poverty funding, a school handbook and a forthcoming handreiking for schools, while stating schools cannot solve poverty alone.
Together with the state secretary of SZW, I am focusing on supporting schools in dealing with poverty at schools.
Met de Staatssecretaris van SZW zet ik in op ondersteuning van scholen in het omgaan met armoede op scholen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Brief voor ex-zorgmedewerkers: kom terug!’

An MP asked why health ministers could write to former care workers to return, while privacy law blocked a similar letter to former teachers in the stille reserve. The minister said the Data Protection Authority advised that pension-fund data cannot be used for this purpose, so he will not write to former teachers, and pointed to regional re-integration measures and subsidies instead.
The advice confirms that the purpose for which the ABP collects personal data is not compatible with the purpose for which the data would be used.
In het advies wordt bevestigd dat het doel waarmee het ABP persoonsgegevens verzamelt niet verenigbaar is met waar de gegevens voor worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over misstanden in realityshows

An MP asked the minister whether participants in reality shows such as De Villa and Temptation Island are manipulated through staged scenes and contractual pressure, and whether rules should be drawn up with the Commissariaat voor de Media. The minister replied that producers bear responsibility, that RTL commissioned an independent external inquiry, and that the media regulator has no remit over commercial productions, while criminal liability is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess.
It is not the Commissariaat's task to supervise how commercial broadcasters produce programmes and shape their content.
Het is niet de taak van het Commissariaat om toezicht te houden op de wijze waarop commerciële omroepen programma's produceren en inhoud geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het besluit om de peildatum voor de ledentelling te verschuiven van 31 december 2019 naar 31 december 2020

An MP asks the minister why he changed the eligibility reference date for broadcaster membership counts from 31 December 2019 to 31 December 2020 by ministerial decision just before the related bill was debated, and whether this was correct. The minister answers that he had announced the intended shift earlier and now exercises his statutory power under the Mediawet to fix the date, to give broadcasters and new initiatives certainty.

Given the desired certainty about the reference date for broadcasting organisations, both existing ones and new initiatives preparing an application for a (provisional) recognition, I considered it necessary to take and publish the decision now, anticipating the completion of the bill, to shift the reference date by one year.

Gelet op de gewenste zekerheid over de peildatum voor omroeporganisaties, zowel bestaande omroeporganisaties als nieuwe initiatieven, die zich voorbereiden op een aanvraag voor een (voorlopige) erkenning, achtte ik het noodzakelijk om anticiperend op de afronding van het wetsvoorstel nu het besluit te nemen en te publiceren om de peildatum met een jaar te verschuiven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Alkaya over het bericht dat AstroTV in 2020 van tv verdwijnt

MPs Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister about misuse of non-compete clauses, including the AstroTV case where Talpa ended broadcasting in 2020 and the producer continued via phone and app. The government answered that media companies decide their own programming without prior oversight, that consumer-protection rules still apply via the ACM and Reclame Code Commissie, and that it sees no need to act on the broadcast.
The ACM makes no statements about any ongoing investigations.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken doet de ACM geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de onzekerheid bij de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep

MP Van den Hul asked the minister whether the public broadcaster NPO can absorb falling advertising revenue without harming makers and programming, and about the basis for the proposed savings on support activities. The minister answered that the NPO and broadcasters must make structural savings, that the government gave a one-off extra budget this year, and that he will request options and report to parliament in the first quarter of 2020.
I will ask the NPO and the College of Broadcasters to inform me about this in the first quarter of 2020.
Ik zal de NPO en het College van Omroepen vragen om in het eerste kwartaal van 2020 mij hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat jonge kinderen betaald krijgen om reclame te maken

MPs Kwint and Van Dijk asked how child labour rules apply to children paid to advertise brands on YouTube and social media, and how enforcement and transparency of sponsored content work. The Secretary of State answered that child labour rules apply when children work under authority or under a contract, including payment in kind, that children up to 12 need an Inspectorate exemption, and that the Inspectorate handles reports that are directly fineable, with a review planned for 2020.
It is conceivable that young vloggers and influencers who talk about a product they have received enter the commercial sphere, so that the ban on child labour applies.

Het is denkbaar dat jonge vloggers en influencers die iets vertellen over een product dat ze hebben gekregen daarmee in de commerciële sfeer raken, waardoor het verbod op kinderarbeid van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de inhuurkosten van externen bij de NPO vier keer hoger dan de Roemernorm is.

MP Kwint (SP) asked the minister why the NPO cannot attract talent for permanent posts and why consultancy hiring has grown, and whether the minister will agree to a 10% external-hiring norm (the Roemer norm). The minister answered that the specialist labour market is tight and the NPO cannot always compete on pay, that consultancy use reflects specialist needs for several projects, that external costs have since fallen, and that the NPO itself decides on its hiring, with its board and supervisory board responsible.
It is up to the NPO itself to decide how it spends the available budget as wisely as possible and to what extent it uses external advice and hiring.
Het is aan de NPO om zelf te bepalen hoe hij het beschikbare budget zo verstandig mogelijk inzet en in welke mate hij bijvoorbeeld gebruik maakt van (extern) advies en inhuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over het Songfestival

An MP from the PVV asked whether the Netherlands could hold the Eurovision Song Contest budget-neutrally, as Finland reportedly did, and whether the broadcaster should pay to host it rather than receive extra funds. The minister replied that the EBU rules assign hosting to the winning country's broadcaster, that the 2007 Finnish event was not profitable though it raised sponsorship and other income, and that such income can likewise cover costs in the Netherlands within Mediawet rules.
The Eurovision Song Contest is an event of the EBU and the public broadcasters of the participating countries.
Het Songfestival is een evenement van de EBU en de publieke omroepen van de deelnemende landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over “schoolboeken en ander lesmateriaal waarin veel minder vrouwen dan mannen staan en relatief weinig personages met een niet-westerse naam”

An MP asked the ministers whether they would pursue publishers over gender and ethnic underrepresentation and stereotyping found in school textbooks, and whether publishers should act more decisively. The ministers replied that content of teaching materials is for schools to judge given freedom of education, that publishers voluntarily cooperated with the Leiden research and will discuss findings with authors, and that the government will not assess teaching materials.
Given freedom of education and expression, the autonomy of schools and the professional space of teachers, the government does not consider it appropriate to judge teaching materials.
Het past de regering, gezien de vrijheid van het onderwijs en meningsuiting, de autonomie van scholen en de professionele ruimte van leraren, niet een oordeel te geven over leermiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Allah verafschuwt homoseksualiteit, leren kinderen op islamitische basisscholen’

D66 MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education whether Islamic primary schools teaching that Allah abhors homosexuality, and related lesson material, are acceptable, and whether the Inspectorate will intervene. The Minister answered that the Inspectorate is investigating, that schools have constitutional freedom within the democratic rule of law, and that teaching material must respect basic democratic values, deferring judgment on the specific material until the inspection report.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Allah verafschuwt seks tussen mensen van het eigen geslacht’

MPs Wiersma and Rudmer Heerema asked the Minister about reported Islamic school teaching materials that reportedly condemn same-sex relations, questioning whether the Inspectorate of Education should have acted and whether it has sufficient expertise and powers. The Minister answers that the Inspectorate has been asked to investigate, that schools must operate within democratic rule-of-law values with sanctions possible, but largely defers judgment until the Inspectorate's report and notes the publisher will review the method with external experts.
Following the reporting, I informed your House that I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to conduct further investigation into this case.
Naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving heb ik uw Kamer laten weten dat ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: inspectie) heb gevraagd om nader onderzoek te doen naar deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het uitvallen van studenten aan de lerarenopleiding

MP Van den Hul asks the Education Minister about high dropout among teacher-training students, citing a Parool report, and whether this worsens the teacher shortage and what the government will do. The minister confirms higher dropout in second-degree teacher training, lists causes such as extra work in schools and later-life career choices, announces a practice-oriented action research project with the institutions, and says the shortage projections already account for past dropout trends.
Based on the discussions, and with the agreement and cooperation of all institutions, we are now preparing a study together with the second-degree teacher training institutions.
Op grond van de gesprekken, en met instemming en medewerking van alle opleidingen, bereiden we nu samen met de tweedegraads lerarenopleidingen een onderzoek voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht over de peperdure opleiding die het mensen moeilijk maakt om voor de klas te gaan staan (Omroep Brabant, 13 november 2019)

An MP asks the education minister how she views a case where a former healthcare worker starting a second-degree teacher training faces high tuition fees, and whether tailored solutions can be created given the teacher shortage. The minister acknowledges the problem but points to existing routes (zij-instroom, school subsidies) and says tailored arrangements are already possible, without committing to new measures.
As far as can be gathered from the report, the person in question does not seem to have secured an appointment as a teacher/zij-instromer, and is therefore looking for an alternative training option.

Voor zover op te maken uit het bericht, lijkt het echter alsof de betreffende persoon geen aanstelling als leraar/zij-instromer heeft weten te bemachtigen, en daarom een alternatieve opleidingsmogelijkheid zoekt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over onrust bij het Commissariaat voor de Media

MP Kwint asked whether a new chair had been appointed to the Commissariaat voor de Media so binding administrative decisions could resume, what the consequences were for local broadcasters, whether an emergency procedure existed, and whether the rules on disclosure and vetting of side jobs would apply to a new chair. The minister answered that an interim chair would start on 15 November 2019, that routine decisions continue under a mandate decision, and that disclosure and vetting of side jobs will apply to all members and that talks with the Commissariaat will follow.
I will talk with the Commissariaat as soon as possible about how that transparency and vetting will be structurally guaranteed in practice from now on.
Ik zal zo spoedig mogelijk met het Commissariaat in gesprek gaan over de wijze waarop die transparantie en toetsing voortaan in de praktijk structureel gewaarborgd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het slechter presteren van kinderen als gevolg van het lerarentekort

An MP asked the education minister about a survey claiming teacher shortages cause children to perform worse, and about measures, pay and oversight. The minister said the inspectorate has no data confirming a direct link, pointed to pay rises and regional measures, and promised a letter on teacher policy in December.
The inspectorate, however, has no research data confirming a direct link between the teacher shortage and vocabulary, Cito scores and school recommendations.
De inspectie heeft echter geen onderzoeksgegevens die een direct verband tussen het lerarentekort en woordenschat, cito-scores en schooladviezen bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de stijgende reserves bij samenwerkingsverbanden

An MP asked the minister about rising reserves at special-education cooperative bodies (samenwerkingsverbanden) and what should be done. The minister says reserves are a concern, lists reasons given by the bodies, and defers on acceptable ratios and measures until an Inspectorate study reports in spring 2020.
The Oberon study you will receive by the end of the year is separate from the Inspectorate's study.
Het onderzoek van Oberon, dat u voor het einde van het jaar ontvangt staat los van het onderzoek van de Inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Rog over de geplande opschaling van Respect Education Foundation

MPs Peters and Rog asked the government about the planned scaling-up of the Respect Education Foundation and what it had done on the earlier motion to support the RespectPact. The minister answered that the departments saw no financial room, that the foundation has not yet sent a proposal for immaterial support, and that the cabinet is willing to offer immaterial support once that proposal arrives.
The cabinet is willing to provide immaterial support for the REF's work, but is awaiting a proposal from the REF.
Het kabinet is bereid tot immateriële ondersteuning van het werk van het REF, maar is in afwachting van een voorstel van het REF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het speciaal onderwijs dat de massale toestroom van leerlingen niet aankan

An MP asked the education minister about waiting lists at special schools reported by LECSO, the number of children affected, whether teacher shortages and school referrals are to blame, and what will be done about staffing. The minister said no national data exist on waiting-list numbers or consequences, attributed the causes to a mix of factors, and committed to a meeting with LECSO and to measures under the teacher-shortage approach.
No national information is kept on this, as you know.
Hierover wordt, zoals bij u bekend, geen landelijke informatie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de vaststelling van de begrotingsstaten van het ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW) voor het jaar 2020

An MP asked the minister for figures on the number of teachers and education staff receiving supplementary (bovenwettelijke) unemployment benefits in primary, secondary and vocational education, the total amounts spent, and the nature of these entitlements. The minister provided tables for 2017 and 2018 showing recipient counts and spending, and described the duration and calculation of WW and supplementary benefits set in collective agreements.
The WW benefit is, as in most sectors, fully topped up above the statutory level in the collective agreements of the education sectors shown.
De WW uitkering is, net als in de meeste sectoren, volledig bovenwettelijk gerepareerd in de cao's van de weergegeven onderwijssectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het terugbetalen van de lerarenbeurs

An MP asked the education minister about students of Open Universiteit education sciences who must repay teacher grants, the number affected, the average repayment, the reasons for clawback, and whether the conditions were unclear. The minister confirmed 573 students with an average repayment of about 4,156 euro, explained the grant is a subsidy subject to clawback rules, and refused to create a special arrangement for those affected.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de voorgenomen verhuizing van SLO naar Amersfoort

An MP asked the minister whether SLO's planned move from Enschede to Amersfoort would cost jobs in Twente, why the minister would not urge SLO's board to reconsider, and whether replacement jobs would be pursued. The minister answered that the direct effect on regional jobs is nil, the indirect effect is minimal, that the board decides on its own housing, and that no replacement employment effort is needed.
I cannot and will not intervene in this.
Ik kan en wil hier niet op ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over schoolkassa van ParnasSys

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked whether the ParnasSys Schoolkassa brochure and emails wrongly suggest multiple or compulsory parental contributions, implicitly encourage excluding children who do not pay, and whether the minister will discuss this with ParnasSys. The minister answered that schools must state contributions are voluntary, that ParnasSys has already revised the wording, and that schools themselves are responsible for their communications and compliance.
Schools are obliged to state the voluntary nature of the parental contribution in the school guide and to communicate this clearly.
Scholen zijn verplicht om de vrijwilligheid van de ouderbijdrage te vermelden in de schoolgids en daar duidelijk over te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over absurde uitzendtarieven in het onderwijs

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked about excessive temp-agency rates in education, how much school staffing money goes to agencies, and whether the government will ban such agencies or engage the sector. The minister says the spending is undesirable, DUO is piloting better data on non-employed staff, schools are making collective agreements, and a ban on high rates is not possible since agencies set their own tariffs.
I do not know the exact spending on temp agencies in primary education.
De exacte uitgaven aan uitzendbureaus in het primair onderwijs ken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over de kosten van OCW-voorzieningen voor Nederlanders met een (niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the ministers of education, culture and media to quantify the costs of education and culture provisions for people with a non-Western migration background and to say how these compare with their returns. The government answered that costs cannot be attributed to origin because funding is lump-sum and not tracked by background, and cited targeted programmes and their amounts.
The share of pupils and students with a non-Western migration background cannot be translated into a share of the costs.
Het aandeel leerlingen en studenten met een niet-westerse migratieachtergrond kan niet worden doorvertaald naar een aandeel in de kosten.
Antwoord op vragen va het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat INEOS via kindermarketing het draagvlak voor schaliegas probeert te vergroten

An MP asked whether INEOS's sponsorship of The Daily Mile, used to build support for shale gas, should be countered, and whether schools should be warned and the programme publicly funded. The minister replied that INEOS is not a sponsor in the Netherlands, that JOGG runs the programme independently, that schools can use the sponsorship convenant, and that the government sees no reason for further action.
INEOS is not a sponsor of The Daily Mile in the Netherlands.
INEOS is in Nederland geen sponsor van The Daily Mile.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de wachtlijsten bij het speciaal onderwijs

An MP asked the minister about waiting lists in special primary and secondary education, teacher shortages, and whether these teachers should fall under the secondary-education collective agreement. The minister said no waiting-list data exists but will explore collecting it, gave enrolment trends, outlined teacher-shortage measures, and costed moving teachers to the secondary cao.
No information is available on the number of pupils on a waiting list for special primary education (sbo) and (secondary) special education (v)so.
Er is geen informatie beschikbaar van het aantal leerlingen dat op een wachtlijst voor het speciaal basis onderwijs (sbo) en (voortgezet) speciaal onderwijs (v)so staat.
Antwoord vragen van het  lid Kwint over het bericht dat er veel maatregelen worden genomen, maar er nog lang niet  genoeg leraren zijn

MP Kwint asked the minister about reports that many measures are taken against the teacher shortage but not enough, including whether the national approach is too limited, whether the PO-Raad's projected shortage is correct, and whether the government will prioritise the issue in the 2020 budget. The minister answered that the government invests in salaries, workload reduction, career changers and regional approaches, that the cited projections use non-comparable methods, and that no further concrete budget commitment was made.

As I indicated in my answers to earlier parliamentary questions from members Van den Hul and Van Meenen, the definitions and methods used for the studies I send to your House annually, the labour market projections and the labour market barometer differ from those used in the PO-Raad study, so the results are not easily comparable.

Zoals ik in mijn antwoorden op eerder gestelde Kamervragen van de leden Van den Hul en Van Meenen heb aangegeven zijn de definities en methoden die gebruikt worden voor de onderzoeken die ik jaarlijks aan uw Kamer stuur, de arbeidsmarktramingen en de arbeidsmarktbarometer, anders dan de definities en methoden die in het onderzoek van de PO-Raad zijn gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den  Hul en Asscher over extra geld voor leraren dat mogelijk slechts de loonbijstelling betreft

MPs Van den Hul and Asscher asked whether the 285 million euro for teachers announced by the minister is merely the regular wage adjustment rather than new money, and how the government will address teacher shortages, school closures and the primary-education salary gap. The minister confirmed the funds are available and that solving the shortage needs a broad, shared effort, offering incidental extra money for 2020 only if social partners quickly conclude a collective agreement using the existing 285 million.
It is up to employers and employees to make agreements about this money.
Het is aan werkgevers en werknemers om afspraken te maken over dit geld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Tielen en Nijkerken-De Haan over het bericht van Innovo dat iemand die eerder aan de pabo is begonnen niet voor een zijinstroomtraject in aanmerking komt

Three VVD MPs asked whether someone who started but did not finish the pabo (primary teacher training) is blocked from the zij-instroom (career-changer) teaching route, and whether the rule should be lifted. The minister answered that eligibility requires a completed higher education degree, that the person may be able to start a shortened part-time programme, and that he does not intend to change the degree requirement.
I do not intend to change the condition that a career-changer must have a higher education diploma, which appears to be the problem in this situation.
Aan de voorwaarde dat een zijinstromer een ho-diploma moet hebben, wat in deze situatie het probleem lijkt, wil ik niet tornen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het Stella Maris in Meerssen gedeeltelijk stopt met Kunskapsskolan

An SP MP asked the education minister about reports that Stella Maris in Meerssen is partly ending the Kunskapsskolan concept after poor inspection ratings, and whether experimenting with unproven teaching concepts is acceptable.
