The minister declined to judge the school's choice, noted the inspectorate is investigating and has issued a recovery order with a follow-up in spring 2020, and rejected concern that the new-schools bill weakens quality control because a quality test will be introduced.
The inspectorate closely monitors this school, and a recovery inspection will take place in spring 2020.
De inspectie volgt deze school nauwgezet, er vindt in het voorjaar 2020 een herstelonderzoek plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van den Hul en Kwint over de subsidiepot voor zijinstroom in het onderwijs

MPs asked why the subsidy pot for career changers (zij-instroom) in education hit its ceiling for a second year, why DUO sent letters saying applications were on hold, and whether the scheme should become open-ended. The minister says the ceiling has been raised, unfunded applications will be reallocated after the October deadline, the letter wording will be corrected, and budgets will be monitored and reset annually.
The content of the letter will be adjusted.
De inhoud van de brief wordt aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kwint over de ongepaste en onwettelijke inzage in de onderzoeksopzet Shell Papers

Two SP MPs asked whether the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate's request for the research outline of a journalistic FOIA request on Shell was improper and unlawful. The minister answered that the request was too broad and needed clarification under the Wob, that EZK speaks on behalf of 14 other bodies without a formal mandate, and that the purpose question was asked only to specify the request, not to restrict journalism.
It is up to the requester to indicate what specific information they wish to receive; the administrative body can only assist in this.
Het is aan de verzoeker om aan te geven waar hij of zij specifiek informatie over wenst te ontvangen; het bestuursorgaan kan hierbij slechts behulpzaam zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Sneller over het bericht dat de NPO overweegt om uit NLZIET te stappen

MPs Van der Molen and Sneller asked the minister about reports that the NPO might leave the NLZIET platform for NPO Start Plus, and about a working group's draft scenario diverging from the vision letter. The minister answered that the NPO denies this, the draft was an unapproved staff document, the NPO remains loyal to NLZIET, and stricter conditions for NPO Start Plus are planned from the next concession period.
The NPO has assured me that this report is not correct.
De NPO heeft mij verzekerd dat dit bericht niet klopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Kwint over tal van constructies om het salarisplafond (WNT-norm) bij de publieke omroep te omzeilen

MPs Aartsen and Kwint asked whether public broadcasters use contracting constructions, such as external producers paying presenters, to circumvent the WNT salary cap, and how side-job registers are kept and published. The minister answered that he has no overview of the contracts, that the broadcasters report no such constructions, and that oversight of the Governance Code and registers lies with CIPO and the Commissariaat voor de Media.
Because contracts do not have to be submitted to me, I have no overview.
Omdat overeenkomsten niet aan mij voorgelegd hoeven te worden, heb ik geen overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Westerveld over het bericht 'Vijf stenen door de ramen bij journalist Willem Groeneveld van stadsblog Sikkom'

MPs Smeulders and Westerveld asked about the stone-throwing attack on journalist Willem Groeneveld, whether a landlord could be barred from the housing market if linked to it, what is being done to protect journalists, and how malicious landlords are targeted. The minister condemned threats against journalists, deferred on the landlord question until police and prosecutors finish, listed press-freedom and journalist-protection measures, and described pilots and ongoing work against bad landlords without committing to a keurmerk or mystery-guest checks.
Once the investigation is complete, I will consider whether further action on my part is desirable.
Na afronding van het onderzoek zal ik bekijken of verdere actie van mijn kant gewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Verhoeven over hoge marktconcentratie onder dagbladuitgeverijen

MPs Sneller and Verhoeven asked about high market concentration among Dutch newspaper publishers, including De Persgroep's expansion, falling freelance rates, and whether the market remains competitive. The minister answered that concentration is high but the market is hybrid and digitalising, that the ACM reviewed and approved the Independer takeover on competition grounds, and that the government is pursuing collective bargaining options for freelancers while having no comparative EU data.
The takeover of Independer by De Persgroep was notified to the ACM at the end of October 2018.
De overname van Independer door De Persgroep is eind oktober 2018 bij de ACM gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Banken dreigen rekening Haga Lyceum te blokkeren’

An MP asked the education minister whether schools can receive lump-sum funding on foreign bank accounts and whether this could be banned, after reports that banks threatened to block the Haga Lyceum's account. The minister replied that all Dutch secondary schools hold Dutch accounts (except three in the Caribbean Netherlands), no urgent need for new rules exists, and schools account for spending via annual reports and audits.
At present all secondary schools in the Netherlands have a Dutch bank account and there is no acute need for new laws or regulations on this point.
Antwoord 2 Op dit moment hebben alle vo-scholen in Nederland een Nederlandse bankrekening 2 en ontbreekt een acute noodzaak tot nieuwe wet- en regelgeving op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat er onrust heerst binnen het Commissariaat voor de Media

An MP asked the minister about unrest at the Commissariaat voor de Media, including the effect of board resignations on decision-making, rules on side jobs, the chair's generous severance scheme, and safeguards against post-employment conflicts of interest. The minister answered that mandate extensions keep routine decisions going, that a new chair is expected soon, that the severance scheme will be revised and the chair will not claim it, and that existing rules sufficiently prevent conflicts of interest.
Once a new chair is in office, I will consult with the Commissariaat on how optimal transparency and review of side positions can be achieved.
Zodra een nieuwe voorzitter in functie is, zal ik met het Commissariaat nader overleggen hoe optimale transparantie en toetsing van nevenfuncties bereikt kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Aartsen, Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over de problemen bij het Commissariaat voor de Media

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the minister about problems at the Commissariaat voor de Media, including a reprimand of a board member, his side job at Mail.ru, the handling of a dismissed member, and the continuity of the board. The minister acknowledged inadequate information provision, said no consequences were attached to the reprimand, defended the Mail.ru side job as not objectionable for now, and promised to review the wachtgeld and side-job rules with the new chair.
However, I conclude that in this case the provision of information was not sufficient, as it has since emerged that I did not have certain information.
Wel concludeer ik dat in dit geval de informatievoorziening niet voldoende was nu achteraf is gebleken dat ik bepaalde informatie niet had.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over interne chaos bij het Commissariaat voor de Media

An MP asked the minister about internal turmoil at the Commissariaat voor de Media, including staff distrust, high turnover, the departure of the director and chair, suspension of a board member, and the chair's severance arrangement. The minister answered that the body is not leaderless, that interim measures keep routine operations running, that a new chair is expected soon, and that the severance rules and the suspended member's dismissal were justified, though the framework will be revised.
The Commissariaat voor de Media is in a phase requiring extra attention due to several causes.
Het Commissariaat voor de Media (hierna: Commissariaat) verkeert door verschillende oorzaken in een fase die extra aandacht vergt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat er grote verschillen zijn in financiële steun die scholieren krijgen voor digitale middelen

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about large differences in financial support for pupils' digital learning materials, including whether schools may require expensive laptops and who should pay. The minister replied that schools must fund digital materials from their lump-sum budget, may request but not require a specific device, and that a study on the adequacy of funding will report in March 2020.
I am currently having research carried out into the efficiency and adequacy of the funding.
Ik laat op dit moment onderzoek doen naar de doelmatigheid en toereikendheid van de bekostiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de faciliteiten van jongerenorganisaties

An MP asked the education, health and interior ministers about whether youth organisations deserve facilities, how youth are consulted on policy, which subsidies exist and how board grants (bestuursbeurzen) are allocated. The government answered that youth participation matters, outlined existing consultation channels and subsidies, and defended the current allocation criteria limited to higher-education-relevant organisations.
No, there is no separate overview of youth organisations that receive facilities or subsidies from the national government.
Nee, er is geen afzonderlijk overzicht van jongerenorganisaties die faciliteiten of subsidie krijgen van de landelijke overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de leegloop van oudere leraren in het onderwijs en de effecten op het lerarentekort

An MP asked the Minister about older teachers leaving early and its effect on teacher shortages, citing a survey that half of older teachers want to stop sooner due to workload. The Minister said forecasts are unchanged, pointed to workload measures and a planned legal requirement for strategic personnel policy, and declined to commit to a teacher retention bonus, leaving it to the sector.
I trust that in most situations a solution can be found, but the teacher shortage remains a concern.
Ik vertrouw erop dat het in de meeste situaties lukt om een oplossing te vinden, maar het lerarentekort blijft zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Kwint over het bericht ‘Sportende kinderen maken teveel herrie: sluiting sportveld dreigt na veertig jaar’

MPs Heerema and Kwint asked the minister about a Nijmegen primary school's sports field facing closure over noise complaints from neighbours, questioning the investment, the noise-based closure, and possible guidance for schools. The minister replied that the municipality is responsible for local matters, the closure procedure has been paused for joint talks, and no guidance document for schools is considered necessary.
How this is shaped within the legal framework is a local matter.
Hoe dit binnen de wettelijke kaders wordt vormgegeven is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de start van het nieuwe schooljaar van basisscholen en scholen voor voortgezet speciaal onderwijs met  meer vacatures dan vorig jaar

An MP asked the minister about teacher vacancies at the start of the school year, the teacher shortage projections, its effect on educational inequality, the salary gap between sectors, and when a national registration of the shortage will be available. The minister acknowledged the shortage, pointed to existing support measures and promised to report on the registration in the autumn.
In the autumn I will inform the House of the outcome.
In het najaar informeer ik uw Kamer over de uitkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over  het bericht "Lerarentekort loopt  verder op: ‘Funest voor de kwaliteit'"

An MP asks the Minister about reported teacher shortages in primary education, including vacancy figures, the status of motions on registration, pay for substitute teachers, unemployed teachers placement, sick leave and part-time work. The Minister answers that the shortage is a real problem, outlines ongoing measures (regional approach, Participatiefonds plan, registration talks, sick-leave support) and states there is no room for extra funding.
I recognise that the teacher shortage is a problem at many schools and that it is becoming increasingly difficult to fill vacancies.
Ik herken dat het lerarentekort op veel scholen een probleem is en het steeds moeilijker wordt om vacatures te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het  bericht dat  bijlesscholen de zomerklandizie zien toenemen.

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that private tutoring firms see summer demand rising, linked to teacher shortages and education quality, and asked about costs, inequality and causation. The minister answered that a study on supplementary education is underway with results due in September, that the costs are not separately recorded, that teacher shortage is not a stated motive in earlier research, and that the regional teacher-shortage approach is still too early to evaluate.
In September I will share the final report of the study on the forms, scope and motives of supplementary and private education with your House.
In september zal ik het eindrapport van het onderzoek naar de verschijningsvormen, omvang en motieven van aanvullend en particulier onderwijs met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het  toenemend aantal basisschoolleerlingen dat  bijlessen volgt als gevolg  van het  lerarentekort

An MP asked whether the rise in primary pupils taking private tutoring is caused by teacher shortages, and when results on measuring the shortage would be shared. The minister said a study on tutoring motives is under way with results due in September, that the shortage is not a stated motive in earlier research, and that the registration of the shortage will be reported in autumn.
At present I am having in-depth research carried out into the scope of supplementary education provision and parents' motives for choosing it.
Op dit moment laat ik verdiepend onderzoek uitvoeren naar de omvang van het aanbod van aanvullend onderwijs en de motieven van ouders om voor aanvullend onderwijs te kiezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een verdienmodel van een uitzendbureau met een wurgcontract voor docenten

An MP asked the minister about a staffing agency contract that reportedly blocks schools from hiring a teacher directly for about half to a full year unless a buyout fee of about 8,000 euros is paid, and what this means for the teaching profession. The minister called such practices undesirable, said school boards are responsible for hiring and that parties should know the conditions in advance, but did not commit to a concrete intervention.
School boards are responsible for appointing sufficient staff to deliver education.
Schoolbesturen zijn verantwoordelijk voor het aanstellen van voldoende personeel om het onderwijs vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht Leraar waarschuwt tegen ‘wurgcontract’ van uitzendbureau

Two MPs asked the minister whether a staffing agency's demand for a buyout fee before a teacher could be hired on a permanent contract, and the resulting teacher turnover, is acceptable and harms pupils. The minister said school boards are responsible for staffing, called the practice undesirable, will raise the case with the PO-Raad and is running a pilot on non-employed staff, but declined to propose new restrictions.
School boards are responsible for appointing temporary agency staff, in line with what has been agreed in the collective labour agreement.
Schoolbesturen zijn verantwoordelijk voor het aanstellen van uitzendpersoneel, in overeenstemming met wat daarover is afgesproken in de cao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het inzichtelijk maken van (de gevolgen van) het lerarentekort

An MP asked the education minister whether schools should be required to report the effects of the teacher shortage to the inspectorate, and how the government guarantees every child receives good teaching every day, including whether it tracks students sent home or missing subjects. The minister said he opposed mandatory registration, that a parliamentary motion to register the shortage is now adopted and will be implemented, that the inspectorate intervenes case by case, and largely referred the registration questions to the answer to question 1 without giving a concrete overview.
Meanwhile, your motion, together with Mr Kwint and Ms Westerveld, on registration of the teacher shortage by OCW has been adopted. I will therefore look into how to implement it in the coming period.
Inmiddels is de motie van u, de heer Kwint en mevrouw Westerveld over registratie van het lerarentekort door OCW aangenomen. Ik ga daarom de komende tijd kijken hoe ik hier uitvoering aan kan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over achtergehouden informatie van mogelijke fouten met examens

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that a school's exam results were delayed and whether parents and pupils had been kept uninformed, and whether the minister would contact the school. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Inspectorate handles contact with the school, acknowledged the need for transparency and the confusion caused, and promised to keep parliament informed.
As I promised in my letter of 14 June, I will also keep your House informed of the state of affairs.
Zoals ik heb toegezegd in mijn brief van 14 juni zal ik ook uw Kamer op de hoogte houden van de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Docent DaCapo in Sittard-Geleen weg na ongepaste mails aan leerlinge'

An MP asked the education minister about a teacher dismissed for inappropriate messages to a student who then could work elsewhere, and whether a teaching register or other measures could prevent such teachers returning to classrooms. The minister answered that screening staff is the employer's responsibility, that the register is no longer being pursued, and that teachers must maintain a safe school climate, without committing to a new barrier.
Screening and hiring staff is the responsibility of an employer.
Het screenen en aannemen van personeel is de zaak van een werkgever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over staatsexamens

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the education minister why state examination candidates get their centralized exam results later than regular pupils, why the state exam timetable and reading lists differ, and whether exam results can be released before enrolment deadlines. Minister Slob answered that the staatsexamen timetable is fixed by the availability of examiners, results can only be released once all centralized results are processed, and reading lists are not stricter than for regular pupils.
The CvTE tells me that announcing the results before the start of the college examinations is not possible, because not all centralized exam results are then known and/or processed.

Het CvTE vertelt mij dat bekendmaking van de resultaten voorafgaand aan de start van de college-examens niet mogelijk is, omdat dan nog niet alle resultaten van de centrale examens bekend en/of verwerkt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ellemeet over freelancejournalisten die onder het minimumloon werken

MPs Asscher and Ellemeet asked whether freelance journalists earning below the minimum wage, their falling per-assignment income, and calls for collective bargaining and competition-law exemptions are acceptable. The minister says fair pay is important, announces a planned statutory generic minimum rate for self-employed workers, leaves fair practice to the sector, and points to ongoing work on the Ellemeet/Asscher motion and an ACM guideline.
The cabinet therefore intends to introduce a statutory generic minimum rate so that self-employed persons can earn an income sufficient for a subsistence minimum.
Het kabinet is daarom voornemens om een wettelijk generiek minimumtarief in te voeren om zelfstandigen in staat te stellen een inkomen te verwerven waarmee in een bestaansminimum kan worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over de hoge ouderbijdrage van ouders met hoogbegaafde kinderen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked the minister about very high voluntary parental contributions (up to 500 euro and beyond) charged for gifted-child classes, and about the possibility of parents appealing to schools or subsidies to normalise these fees. The minister agrees that implicit barriers are unacceptable and that a high voluntary contribution can deter enrolment, but points to school complaint procedures, says no maximum amount will be introduced for now, and promises only to discuss the example at a future meeting with the PO-Raad and to raise the monitoring question with researchers.
There is no complete picture of how many gifted-child classes ask for voluntary parental contributions.
Er is geen compleet beeld bij hoeveel hoogbegaafdenklassen vrijwillige ouderbijdragen worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over onderwijs en leerlingenvervoer aan vluchtelingenkinderen

An MP asks the education minister about pre-school education, schooling, school admission, transport and absenteeism for refugee children. The minister answers that the government will consult VNG and COA, study pre-school provision in asylum reception, and describes existing support and admission rules, without committing to new structural changes.
In addition, I will conduct a study into the provision of pre-school education for toddlers in asylum reception, following the adopted motion by MP Westerveld.
Daarnaast zal ik een onderzoek doen naar het aanbod van voorschoolse educatie voor peuters in de asielopvang, naar aanleiding van de aangenomen motie van lid Westerveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het onderwijsboek Geobas 7

Azarkan (DENK) asked whether the minister finds passages in the textbook Geobas 7 about grey suburbs, guest workers, mosques and crime stereotyping, and whether the publisher should be pressed to revise it or a scan of teaching materials should be ordered. The minister answered that content of teaching materials is the responsibility of schools under freedom of education, and that parents and pupils can raise concerns via the school council or complaints procedure, with criminal law as the only external limit.
As I and my predecessors have already indicated in answers to earlier written questions, it is not for the cabinet to assess the content of teaching materials, but for the schools.
Zoals ik en mijn voorgangers in de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen al hebben aangegeven, is het niet aan het kabinet om de inhoud van leermiddelen te beoordelen, maar aan de scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Van den Hul over problemen door het krimpend frequentiespectrum

MPs Moorlag and Van den Hul asked whether the government knows that shrinking radio spectrum, from 4G/5G expansion and the loss of the 700 MHz band for PMSE users from 2020, will harm media production, events and public broadcasting, and whether promised support for PMSE was delivered. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, described coordination measures, a joint action plan with the sector, alternative frequency bands and a licensed shared access pilot, while stating that the consequences are being managed in ongoing consultation.
On possible consequences and solutions, my ministry and Agentschap Telecom are in ongoing consultation with the sector.
Over mogelijke gevolgen en oplossingen zijn mijn ministerie en Agentschap Telecom in voortdurend overleg met de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht 'Lerarensteun voor klimaatactie op initiatief van Greenpeace'

An MP from the PVV asked whether the education minister would oppose teachers' collective 'Teachers for Climate', allegedly started at Greenpeace's initiative, for using schools and pupils for activism, including truancy, and whether a ban on activist groups infiltrating education would be introduced. The minister replied that school autonomy and teacher professional freedom are constitutionally protected, that parents and pupils can raise concerns via the school board, medezeggenschap or complaints procedures, and declined to introduce a ban.
This fits the autonomy of schools and the professional space of teachers to make their own considerations in this regard.
Het past bij de autonomie van scholen en de professionele ruimte van leraren om daarin eigen afwegingen te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht ‘Dagbehandeling autisme voor kinderen uit regio Eindhoven op de helling; GGzE worstelt met bezuinigingen'

An MP asked the minister whether a special day-treatment programme for children with severe autism in Eindhoven, threatened by municipal budget cuts, should be preserved, and whether the minister would intervene with the municipality and the education inspectorate. The minister answered that the municipality has extended the programme to August 2021, that the education offered there is not fully in line with regulations and needs clearer arrangements, and that contacts with the municipality and inspectorate are ongoing without committing to direct intervention.

It is up to the municipality, within the framework of the Youth Act and the regional youth policy set by the youth region, to provide a coherent package of youth care for all young people in the municipality.

Het is aan de gemeente om binnen de kaders van de Jeugdwet en het regionale jeugdbeleid zoals vastgesteld in de jeugdregio, een samenhangend geheel aan jeugdhulp te bieden voor alle jeugdigen in de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ’Lerarentekort? In Brabant zitten 300 basisschoolleraren in de WW’

MPs Heerema and Wiersma asked why hundreds of qualified primary-school teachers in Brabant are on unemployment benefits while schools face a teacher shortage, and whether UWV should be obliged to match them to vacancies. The minister acknowledges the problem, describes re-integration efforts via the Participatiefonds and regional coordinators, provides a provincial table, and says a research report will be sent before summer without committing to a UWV obligation.
I agree that employers and job seekers must be able to find each other and that the parties with a role in the education labour market must do everything to ensure this happens.

Ik ben het met u eens dat werkgevers en werkzoekenden elkaar moeten kunnen vinden en dat de partijen die een rol vervullen op de onderwijsarbeidsmarkt er alles aan moeten doen om ervoor te zorgen dat dit ook gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht dat een NPO-topman bestuurder was van een brievenbusfirma en het bericht over de declaraties van de NPO-directeur

MP Krol asked whether the NPO director concealed directorship of a UK company, whether the board should have probed his restaurant ownership, whether a jubilee dinner in his own restaurant breached governance rules, and how the minister views NPO's handling and integrity enforcement. The minister answered that the restaurant ownership was disclosed at hiring and judged not conflicting, that CIPO found the code applied adequately, and that integrity is primarily the organisations' own responsibility with the Commissariaat supervising.
This was therefore known to the NPO at hiring on 1 May 2014 and was subsequently included in the 2014 compliance declaration.
Dit was dus bij indiensttreding op 1 mei 2014 aan de NPO bekend en is nadien opgenomen in de complianceverklaring over 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht dat de voormalig Oostenrijkse vice-kanselier een Oostenrijkse krant wilde verkopen aan een Russische investeerder

MP Sneller asked about reports that former Austrian vice-chancellor Strache offered a Kronen Zeitung stake to a Russian-linked investor, and about rules for foreign takeovers of Dutch newspapers and whether such takeovers are desirable for democratic resilience. The minister declined to comment on the Austrian matter as internal to Austria, said no sector-specific takeover rules exist (ACM and EU merger control apply generally), and announced planned bans on donations from outside the EU to political parties and a forthcoming Political Parties Act.
It does not befit me to go into the circumstances of the matter, since this is an internal Austrian affair.
Het past mij niet om in te gaan op de toedracht van de zaak, aangezien het hier een interne Oostenrijkse aangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Kan ik meer verdienen met hetzelfde werk in het PO?’

An MP asked the minister about a KVLO article on PE teachers in primary education placed through staffing agencies or sports service bureaus, which may earn less and change more often than school-employed teachers, and whether schools pay more through such arrangements. The minister answered that no general or national data are available on contract types, pay or agency profits, that the equal-pay rule for hired workers applies, and that he is consulting the PO-Raad and KVLO to raise the issue with their members.
With the information available to me, it is not possible to make general statements about the distribution of the different types of appointments schools make with their teachers.
Met de informatie die mij bekend is, is het niet mogelijk om algemene uitspraken te doen over de verdeling van de verschillende typen aanstellingen die scholen aangaan met hun leerkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over schokkende verschillen tussen de schooladviezen die Friese kinderen in groep 8 krijgen

An MP asked the minister about large regional differences in secondary school advice given to Frisian pupils in group 8, with pupils in some northeastern municipalities scoring above their advice. The minister acknowledged the regional pattern of under-advice, said it is a concern, and referred to a forthcoming separate evaluation letter for measures.
I consider this a worrying development.
Ik vind dit een zorgelijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over leerlingen die worden uitgeschreven op school

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asks the minister about pupils being unlawfully unenrolled from school, the role of the inspectorate, complaints committee and education consultants, and whether a national complaints point is needed. Minister Slob answers that schools may not expel pupils without parental consent and procedures are strict, that the inspectorate can impose sanctions but the Vossius case was addressed, and that a national point is not planned, while exploring binding advice for the complaints committee.
It is indeed not the intention that school boards evade their duty of care for appropriate education by unenrolling pupils.
Het is inderdaad niet de bedoeling dat schoolbesturen zich aan de zorgplicht passend onderwijs onttrekken door leerlingen uit te schrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat het basisonderwijs het meest seizoengevoelige beroep in de Werkloosheidswet (WW) is

Parliamentary questions from MP Van Meenen (D66) ask about a UWV finding that primary school teachers show the strongest seasonal unemployment pattern, with a summer peak, and whether dismissals at summer's start and contract types contribute. The minister attributes the summer peak mainly to school-year changes, notes it fell 38% in 2018, says data on contract types and WW-entry is limited, and rejects legal measures, leaving pay arrangements to employers and unions via the CAO.
I do not intend to take legislative measures.
Ik ben niet van plan om wettelijke maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Sneller over het bericht ‘NPO blokkeert mogelijkheid om programmastreams te downloaden’

MPs Van Meenen and Sneller asked the minister why the public broadcaster NPO blocks downloading of programme streams since March 2019, and whether public-funded programmes should be freely available, including for schools. The minister answered that DRM was introduced to protect copyright and for reporting reasons, that downloads are not required of public broadcasters, and that educational reuse is facilitated via Beeld en Geluid.
A public institution such as the NPO cannot be expected to disregard agreements and the rights of producers, broadcasters and makers.
Er kan niet van een publieke instelling als de NPO worden verwacht dat hij afspraken en rechten van producenten, omroepen en makers negeert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de gesprekken met de onderwijssector over het oplossen van het lerarentekort

An MP asked the Minister about the government's talks with education sector partners on the teacher shortage, including the AOb union's withdrawal from national consultation and its threatened action over the spring budget. The Minister answered that the shortage is a top priority, that a multi-line plan is being pursued with other partners, and that a regional approach is being supported, but declined to meet the AOb bilaterally before the spring memorandum was sent to parliament.
As long as it has not been sent to the House, members of the cabinet do not enter into discussions about the spring memorandum.
Zolang deze niet naar de Kamer is gestuurd, gaan leden van het kabinet niet in gesprek over de voorjaarsnota.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Westerveld, Van Meenen en Kwint over de uitvoering van de motie Van den Hul c.s. (35 000 VIII, nr. 173) inzake het inzichtelijk maken van de ruimtebrief

Four MPs asked the government why it will only 'point to' a Parliament motion asking education employers to make the 'ruimtebrief' (budget space letter) public at collective bargaining tables, and why the letter's name is changing. The minister replied that the government cannot oblige employers to disclose the letter's contents, that collective bargaining freedom precludes forced disclosure, and that it will send employers a cover note pointing to the motion while noting it conflicts with confidentiality and negotiating freedom.
The cabinet cannot and will not oblige education employers to make the contents of the letters transparent at the negotiating table.
Het kabinet kan en wil de onderwijswerkgevers niet verplichten om de inhoud van de brieven inzichtelijk te maken aan de onderhandelingstafel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat te weinig leraren getraind zijn in de aanpak van radicalisering

MPs Becker and Rudmer Heerema (VVD) asked whether the government agrees that too few teachers have been trained to recognise and address radicalisation, given few school reports and concerns from NCTV and AIVD. Minister Slob replied that about 5,000 education professionals have been trained via SSV and 2,000 via ESS, that the government will focus training on priority municipalities and promote it, but will not make teacher training mandatory.
I do not intend to oblige teachers to follow a training.
Ik ben niet voornemens docenten te verplichten een training te volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over leerlingen op basisscholen in achterstandswijken die massaal kampen met problemen bij taal en leren, concentratieproblemen en ouders die hun kinderen vaak niet kunnen helpe

An MP asked the minister whether a survey finding that most teachers in deprived neighbourhoods see language and concentration problems among pupils is accurate, what this means for equal opportunity, and what consequences follow. The minister said the survey's figures are hard to verify, that neighbourhood characteristics are not a significant predictor beyond family factors, and pointed to existing disadvantage funding, the Gelijke Kansen Alliantie and a planned programme, without committing to new measures.
The exact figures mentioned in the research are not known to me in such detail, and they are also difficult to verify.
De exacte cijfers die in het onderzoek worden genoemd zijn mij niet zodanig bekend en deze zijn ook lastig te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Den Boer over het bericht ««Helft vrouwelijke journalisten heeft met bedreigingen te maken» NRC checkt»

MPs Sneller and Den Boer asked the government about an NRC report finding that nearly half of female journalists face threats, and about the recommendations to protect them, including freelancers and journalists with a migration background. Minister Slob answered that threats against journalists are unacceptable, pointed to the Stuurgroep agreement and the PersVeilig project, and said the specific position of female and minority journalists will be addressed in a safety plan due in autumn.
It is unacceptable that journalists carrying out their work are hindered in doing so by the actions of others.
Het is onaanvaardbaar dat journalisten die hun werk uitvoeren, belemmerd worden in de uitvoering hiervan door de acties van anderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Slootweg over weeffout in de wet op financiering van het Passend Onderwijs

CDA MPs Rog and Slootweg asked about a funding flaw in the Passend Onderwijs law that leaves the Gelderse Vallei special-needs region bearing costs for pupils released from a secure youth institution, and what the government will do. Minister Slob answered that a residence-based funding issue is being addressed through transitional measures, with a letter to neighbouring regions and a policy review promised after summer.
I will send a letter to the surrounding cooperation associations asking for their cooperation given the specific situation in Deelen.
Ik zal een brief versturen aan de omliggende samenwerkingsverbanden waarin hen om medewerking wordt gevraagd gezien de specifieke situatie in Deelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg, Van der Molen en Van Dam over de inzet van een gebarentolk bij crisiscommunicatie door de overheid en bij persconferenties van de overheid

CDA MPs asked whether sign-language interpreters should be used in government crisis communication and press conferences, after the Utrecht attack gave deaf people no interpretation. The ministers answered that a plan of action will be sent to parliament after the summer, that transcripts of post-cabinet press conferences are published, and that the government does not consider the UN disability convention breached.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özütok over examens op Aruba, Bonaire en Curaçao

MPs Westerveld and Özütok asked whether Dutch-language exams disadvantage Caribbean Netherlands pupils whose home language is not Dutch, and whether exams, N-term adjustments or extra time should change. The minister answered that Dutch exam language is set by law and by Aruba and Curaçao themselves, that extra funding for Bonaire language policy is provided, and that adapting exams to other languages or N-terms is not planned.
I am aware that Dutch is the instruction and examination language of secondary education on Bonaire
Ik ben bekend met het feit dat het Nederlands de instructie- en examentaal van het voortgezet onderwijs is op Bonaire

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kwint en Westerveld over examens van 38 eindexamenleerlingen van de Duin en Kruidbergmavo uit Driehuis aangetekend op weg waren naar de tweede correctie, maar niet op de plaat

MPs asked why exam scripts sent by registered post to second correctors went missing again, questioning the reliability of postal transport and the fairness to pupils who must retake exams. The minister said schools are responsible for dispatch under the protocol, that such losses are rare (six cases this year, mostly theft), that retakes are unnecessary once scores are established, and that scanning and emailing scripts carries fraud and hacking risks.
As a rule, sending exam work by registered post is reliable.
In de regel is verzending van het examenwerk per aangetekende post betrouwbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht van de gemeente Rotterdam dat Stichting Acato, een onderwijsvoorziening voor leerlingen met autisme met dit werk moet stoppen

An MP asks the education and health ministers whether they still stand by their letter ending the Acato autism education project in Rotterdam, and whether they will investigate and intervene to keep it running. The ministers answer that Rotterdam and the schools must find a suitable alternative, that the matter is under examination by the municipal ombudsman, and that they will not intervene directly but will report on the motion in a later letter.
The situation is currently being examined by the Rotterdam municipal ombudsman.
De situatie wordt momenteel onderzocht door de gemeentelijke ombudsman van Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Moordende rapper scoort gouden plaat in de bajes’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a convicted murderer could record a gold-selling album and give a radio interview from prison, and pressed for sanctions, asset seizure, isolation and withdrawal of station funding. The Minister said the prisoner was disciplined with a cell placement for unauthorised media contact, that the prison law allows seizing income only for outstanding fines, and that there is no legal basis to cut FunX's subsidy.
The prisoner in question did not ask for permission for the radio interview about his gold album.
De betreffende gedetineerde heeft voor het radiointerview over zijn gouden plaat geen toestemming gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Ploumen over ontvoeren en uithuwelijken van meisjes naar het buitenland

MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Ploumen asked the government about abduction and forced marriage of girls abroad, including whether children aged twelve and under are affected, the role of teachers, legal options to block travel, and possible exit bans. The government answered that child marriages are hard to detect, pointed to the meldcode and existing child-protection measures, noted that preparing a forced marriage abroad is already punishable under article 285c Sr, and said further measures are being explored within the 'Geweld hoort nergens thuis' programme.
Child marriages are an invisible and complex problem.
Kindhuwelijken zijn een onzichtbaar en complex probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat meisjes met een migratie-achtergrond al in de basisschoolleeftijd worden ontvoerd en uitgehuwelijkt

MPs Becker, Rudmer Heerema and Van Wijngaarden asked whether girls with a migration background are abducted and married off from primary school age, how many cases exist, how schools report them, and what legal and consular tools exist. The minister answered that no 2018 reports involved primary-school-age victims, gave case counts, pointed to existing reporting and court-intervention routes, and promised further steps in a June progress report.
Exact figures on the abandonment of minors abroad are currently not available, as figures on this specific subject cannot be derived from the current registration system.

Exacte cijfers over achterlating van minderjarigen in het buitenland, zijn momenteel niet beschikbaar aangezien cijfers over dit specifieke onderwerp niet te herleiden zijn uit het huidige registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Becker over het bericht ‘Islamitische Haga Lyceum van plan meer omstreden predikers uit te nodigen’

MPs Heerema and Becker asked the government about a school inviting controversial preachers, asking whether it can refuse entry, act through EU-level lists, and use the proposed changes to article 2:20 BW against such schools. The minister called the invitations undesirable, said entry bans on EU citizens are unrealistic and EU blacklists undesirable due to the ban on censorship, and said dissolution of organisations under 2:20 BW is case-dependent for the courts.
Under article 2:20 of the Civil Code, the court may, at the request of the Public Prosecution Service, declare a legal entity whose activities conflict with public order prohibited and dissolve it.
Op basis van artikel 2:20 BW kan de Rechtbank op verzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie een rechtspersoon waarvan de werkzaamheid in strijd is met de openbare orde, verboden verklaren en ontbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘slapeloze nachten voor hoogbegaafden nu het Leids initiatief voor educatie LIVE per 1 mei stopt’

An MP from the VVD asked the minister whether the Leiden LIVE initiative for gifted children, which lost municipal funding on 1 May 2019, leaves children at home without education, and what the regional special-needs partnerships, municipality and inspectorate are doing. The minister answered that alternative provision was created for the affected pupils, that the inspectorate is investigating the partnerships' lawful use of funds, and that no further consultation is needed.
The inspectorate's investigation focuses on the lawful use of funds by the partnerships involved.
Het onderzoek van de IvhO richt zich enerzijds op de rechtmatige besteding van middelen van de betrokken samenwerkingsverbanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht 'Moslimdocenten wilden mij weg hebben'

MPs from the PVV asked whether a teacher's criticism of Islam, immigration and climate policy outside school is permitted, whether other teachers were pushed out for criticising Islam, and whether school managers should face consequences for how a teacher was treated by Muslim colleagues. The minister confirmed a teacher may voice criticism outside school, said no similar cases are known, and declined to judge the individual school situation, leaving it to school leadership.
It is not appropriate for me to pass judgment on that based on a newspaper article.
Het past mij niet om daarover op basis van een krantenartikel een oordeel te vellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Middendorp over de artikelen ‘Molly Russell’s father: cutting, biting, burning — my daughter was shown it all on social media’ en ‘You have amazing ability, Damian Hinds tells te

Two MPs asked the government about UK press reports on the death of a teenager linked to social media content, whether similar Dutch cases are known, whether Dutch research on social media and suicide will be undertaken, and what action will be taken. The minister said no Dutch data on causes of suicide are kept, a 113 Suicide Prevention study on 2017 youth suicides is underway with results expected at year end, and pointed to EU audiovisual rules, media literacy in the curriculum and existing support networks.
In the Netherlands no data are kept on the causes of suicide.
In Nederland worden geen gegevens bijgehouden over de oorzaken van zelfdoding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld inzake het bericht ‘Meneer Bouwels moet blijven’

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked whether LVO, a school board in Limburg, is not renewing temporary teacher contracts amid a teacher shortage, and about the situation at VMBO Maastricht. The minister denied that all temporary contracts are being cut, attributed non-renewals to declining pupil numbers and the board's personnel policy, and said he will report on LVO and VMBO Maastricht in June 2019.
The school board has the responsibility for conducting good strategic personnel policy.
Het schoolbestuur heeft de verantwoordelijkheid voor het voeren van goed strategisch personeelsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht van de Commissariaat voor de Media ‘Commissariaat niet tevreden over beoordeling nevenfuncties KRO-NCRV’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Education and Media about the Commissariaat voor de Media's finding that KRO-NCRV's assessment of a presenter's side job was inadequate, and whether public broadcasters' registers of ancillary activities are complete, mandatory and supervised. The minister answered that the Governancecode requires registers and that CIPO supervises compliance, that KRO-NCRV has revised its procedures, and that the presenter's programmes are not classed as journalistic so the side job need not be published.
The Commissariaat is charged with supervising compliance with the said provisions of the Mediawet 2008.
Het Commissariaat is belast met het toezicht op de naleving van genoemde bepalingen in de Mediawet 2008.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Televisie naar de smaak van de netmanager'

An MP from the CDA asked the minister whether network managers at the NPO interfere in programme content and presenter choice, whether the combined role of 'directeur televisie' and 'netmanager NPO1' is acceptable, and whether broadcaster autonomy is adequately protected. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the combined role is not good from a checks-and-balances perspective and expects the NPO to remedy it, and argued that programme autonomy is well protected by law and that existing rules and dispute procedures suffice without further regulation.
From the perspective of checks and balances, I do not consider this a good combination.
Vanuit een oogpunt van checks and balances vind ik dit geen goede combinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de macht van de netmanager groot is

An SP MP asks whether the growing power of NPO network managers over programme content, at the expense of broadcasters, is undesirable, whether this was foreseen when the Media Act was amended, and whether combining the network manager and director roles is acceptable. The minister says such concerns are known and views differ, points to statutory safeguards added in 2016 to protect broadcasters' responsibility for programme content, and considers combining the roles poor checks and balances but expects the NPO to remedy any excessive concentration of power.
From the standpoint of checks and balances, I do not consider this a good combination.
Vanuit een oogpunt van checks and balances vind ik dit geen goede combinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over scholen die hun eigen regels voor aantallen toetsen op één dag aan hun laars lappen

An MP asked the minister about schools exceeding their own limits on the number of tests per day, and about student stress and how students can enforce school rules. The minister said schools must set test limits in their student statutes, that schools should monitor compliance, and that students can complain via student councils, the works council, or LAKS, but gave no concrete new measure.
I am not familiar in detail with the situation the student describes in NOS Stories.
Ik ken de situatie waarover de leerling in de NOS Stories spreekt niet in detail.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van den Bosch over de beantwoording op vragen inzake het bericht ‘Verval in de gymzaal: kapotte trampolines en turnbruggen’

MPs Heerema and Van den Bosch asked whether municipalities are responsible for financing and maintaining gym facilities and equipment, how often schools have held them to account, whether an investigation into slow replacement of defective gym equipment is planned, and whether municipal Gemeentefonds funds should be cut for non-replacement. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for accommodation financing while school boards are responsible for safety, that objection and appeal routes exist, that no investigation is planned given horizontal supervision, and that cutting Gemeentefonds funds is undesirable and lacks a legal basis.
I have no insight into how often schools have held their municipality to account on this responsibility.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoe vaak het is voorgekomen dat scholen hun gemeente op deze verantwoordelijkheid aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Lodders over het bericht dat journalisten aangifte moeten doen

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether journalists threatened in Flevoland can easily file criminal complaints, and whether police could refuse to record threats as too hard to prove. The minister condemned threats against journalists, said a complaint must always be possible, outlined an action plan with police and prosecutors, and noted a new reporting point and tougher sentencing guideline.
A journalist, or anyone else, who wishes to file a complaint about a criminal offence must have the opportunity to do so in all cases.
Een journalist, of ieder ander, die aangifte wil doen van een strafbaar feit, moet daar in alle gevallen de mogelijkheid toe hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over fors grotere voorziening groot onderhoud scholen

An MP asked whether the accounting rules for large maintenance provisions in schools are being interpreted more strictly, causing a large increase in required provisions, and what the minister would do to prevent negative effects. The minister confirmed the rule change from 2019, said the provision method is unchanged, and promised a study, a transition arrangement for 2018-2019, and communication with school boards.
In consultation with the accountants and the primary and secondary education sectors, it has been agreed that research will be carried out into the effects for school boards.
In overleg met de accountants en de sectoren primair en voortgezet onderwijs is afgesproken dat er een onderzoek wordt gedaan naar de effecten voor schoolbesturen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over meldingen van bedreiging door journalisten

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked whether journalists find it hard to file complaints about threats and violence, and how many reports and complaints were made. The minister replied that a 2018 accord with police and prosecutors gives journalists priority protection, that complaints are indicatively counted at about 21 in 2018, and that the government will not comment on individual cases.
These figures are indicative, because the police do not record the victim's profession.
Deze cijfers zijn indicatief, omdat de politie het beroep van het slachtoffer niet registreert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Apple presenteert eigen streamingdienst Apple TV+ voor tv-series en films' (Tweakers)

An MP asked whether the minister knew of Apple's planned video streaming service, whether the ministry had contact with Apple, which Dutch media rules apply, and whether a levy on streaming services should be introduced. The minister answered that there was no contact, that Apple falls under Irish law under the country-of-origin principle unless a member state imposes a financial contribution, and that a study on support measures for Dutch audiovisual content is pending.
We will send the research report to the House before the summer and inform it about which measures will be taken to stimulate the Dutch cultural audiovisual offering.
Wij zullen uw Kamer voor de zomer het onderzoeksrapport toezenden en informeren over welke maatregelen genomen zullen worden om het Nederlandse cultureel audiovisueel aanbod te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht 'Opnieuw geschiedvervalsing in Nederlands schoolboek'

PVV MPs asked why a VMBO textbook allegedly omits Jewish history of Jerusalem and the Middle East and wanted the government to ensure historically accurate teaching. The minister replied that the content of teaching materials is for schools to assess under freedom of education, pointing to school complaint and participation routes and criminal law limits.

As I and my predecessors have already indicated to your House in many earlier written questions on this subject, it is not for the cabinet to assess the content of teaching materials, but for schools.

Zoals ik en mijn voorgangers aan uw Kamer in vele eerdere schriftelijke vragen hierover ook al hebben aangegeven, is het niet aan het kabinet om de inhoud van leermiddelen te beoordelen, maar aan scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Amerikaanse immigratiedienst bouwde database van journalisten'

The MPs asked whether the Dutch government cooperates with a US immigration agency's reported database of journalists and activists critical of US immigration policy, and whether Dutch and foreign journalists are in it. The minister answered that the Netherlands did not cooperate, no Dutch journalists are known to be on the list, and the government will not intervene in a US internal matter unless press freedom there is at stake.
No cooperation with the Dutch government took place in this.
Hierbij is niet samengewerkt met de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht 'ZZP-docent rukt op'

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about the growing number of teachers working as self-employed freelancers (zzp'ers), its effect on workload, costs and possible sham self-employment. The minister called such self-employment undesirable where aimed at higher pay, said he lacks specific data on teachers as zzp'ers or on sham self-employment, and pointed to planned data collection and regional agreements.
I do not have information about cases of possible sham self-employment.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over gevallen van mogelijke schijnzelfstandigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het lerarentekort mogelijk op te lossen is met de Onderwijsassistent-Plus

An SP MP asked whether a Summa College and Scholengroep Eenbes pilot training teaching assistants into 'Onderwijsassistent-Plus' staff, who could effectively teach alone, circumvents teaching-qualification rules and lowers quality. The minister replied that such staff may not teach independently except in emergencies under a qualified teacher's responsibility, that no rules are being relaxed, and that the initiative is an in-house training programme.
There is no question of an experiment in the sense of deviating from national laws and regulations.
Er is geen sprake van een experiment in de zin van afwijken van de landelijke wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Van Meenen over het bericht 'VO-raad: middelbare scholen verdwijnen in krimpregio's’

MPs Schonis and Van Meenen asked about reports that secondary schools are disappearing in shrinking regions and what the government will do to keep access reasonable. The minister acknowledges concern, says school boards are primarily responsible, points to accountmanagers and a process facilitator, and commits to working with the Interior Ministry and provinces on an integrated regional approach.
The problem of pupil decline in such regions is much broader than education alone and also concerns the liveability of the region.
Het probleem van leerlingendaling in zulke regio's is veel breder dan alleen het onderwijs, en gaat ook over de leefbaarheid van de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf , Aartsen en Van der Molen over de werkwijze van het NPO-fonds

MPs asked the Minister of Education and Media about the opaque NPO Fund procedure, including anonymous advisory committee members, undisclosed committee composition, possible conflicts of interest and limited objection options. The Minister answered that the NPO board is responsible for the procedure, that NPO keeps anonymity to protect advice quality, that conflicted members are excluded, and that the fund will better publicize existing exclusion and discussion options.
The working method and procedure of the NPO Fund is the responsibility of the NPO board of directors.
De werkwijze en procedure van het NPO-fonds is voor verantwoordelijkheid van de raad van bestuur van de NPO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Rog over het onderwijs in het Fries

MPs Van der Molen and Rog asked about the quality of Frisian-language education, the Inspectorate's thematic research, school exemptions and oversight powers. The minister replied that exemptions are provincially granted, earlier recommendations have been largely implemented, a new inspectorate study is planned, but transferring supervision to the province is not on the agenda.
Transferring supervision to the province of Fryslân is not on the table.
Overdracht van het toezicht aan de provincie Fryslân is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over twee Groningse scholen voor speciaal onderwijs die zich door het lerarentekort gedwongen zien om over te gaan tot invoering van een vierdaagse lesweek

An MP asked the minister about two Groningen special-education schools that adopted four-day school weeks due to teacher shortages, and whether oversight is adequate. The minister confirmed the schools' four-day weeks, said the inspectorate monitors them under the handreiking and may request a plan of action, and called the situation worrying while stating that lesson loss must be prevented.
The inspectorate supervises regular primary education and (secondary) special education. There is no separate or more intensive supervision of special education.
De inspectie houdt toezicht op het regulier basisonderwijs en op het (voortgezet) speciaal onderwijs. Er is geen apart of intensiever toezicht op speciaal onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Gent over het plaatsen van (bewerkte) foto’s en filmpjes van leerkrachten in klaslokalen op internet

Two VVD MPs asked whether pupils posting edited photos and videos of teachers online is a growing problem, whether this breaches GDPR, and what sanctions apply. The minister said schools should set their own rules on phone use, that Kennisnet and the School and Safety foundation will be supported, that lawfulness under GDPR is for the Dutch data protection authority or courts to judge, and that the government does not hold figures on sanctions imposed.
The data on the number of sanctions is not known to me.
De gegevens over het aantal sancties zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het opdoeken van groep 8 als gevolg van het lerarentekort in Leiden

An MP asked the minister about the closure of a group 8 class at a Leiden primary school due to teacher shortage, including the school's contact with the inspectorate, the impact on the 15 pupils and whether other classes were closed. The minister answered that the inspectorate is handling the case, that pupils were redistributed without missing lessons, and that the inspectorate monitors the solutions and reports the Haarlem case as the only comparable one.
I find the situation undesirable – especially because it concerns a group 8 – but it is for the inspectorate to assess the case substantively.
Ik vind de situatie onwenselijk – temeer omdat het hier een groep 8 betreft – maar het is aan de inspectie om de casus inhoudelijk te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bericht dat de beloning van Van Nieuwkerk binnen de regels is en geen schijnconstructie

MP Aartsen asked the minister whether NPO's review of the pay of presenter Van Nieuwkerk and BNNVARA ignored possible use of outside producer MediaLane, why NTR outsourced College Tour, and about costs and disclosure. The minister said the NPO review found no pay construction, the outsourcing was a business decision, costs rose only modestly, and cost detail is reported at genre level.
Reporting costs per programme adds no value to transparency about salaries.
Opgave van de kosten per programma heeft geen toegevoegde waarde voor de openheid over salarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van der Molen over Confuciusinstituten in Nederland

Two CDA MPs asked whether Confucius Institutes in Dutch higher education, their secret contracts, influence on schools and Chinese-perspective teaching materials conflict with Dutch academic integrity and democratic values. The minister answered that institutions are autonomous, that the Leiden institute will not renew its agreement, that contracts are generally not confidential except where a partner has weighty reasons, and that schools and the inspectorate are responsible for teaching content.
The starting point is that agreements which the institutions conclude with third parties are not confidential.
Uitgangspunt is dat overeenkomsten die de betrokken instellingen sluiten met derden niet vertrouwelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over kindermishandeling

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about the finding that nearly half of schools lack clear procedures for suspected child abuse, teacher training on recognising abuse, and how the verbeterde meldcode will be implemented in schools. The minister answered that school boards are legally responsible for the meldcode, the Inspectorate will pay extra attention, and the government is running implementation support, teacher-training reviews and pilots.
Given the implementation of the improved meldcode, I am asking the Inspectorate of Education to pay extra attention to this in the coming years.
Ik vraag de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gezien de implementatie van de verbeterde meldcode de komende jaren hiervoor extra aandacht te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht “dat Pim wil en kan leren, maar niet naar vwo mag”

An SP MP asks why a pupil with autism and a high havo average (8.6) is refused permission to move to vwo, given the missing second modern foreign language, and whether the hardship clause and a right to move from havo to vwo should be used. The minister refuses a hardship exemption, arguing the second modern language is an integral part of the vwo diploma, but says no legal barrier prevents the move and a uniform havo-vwo transfer right is being explored.
I am currently considering a havo-vwo transfer right with possible uniform admission requirements.
Daarom beraad ik mij momenteel op een doorstroomrecht havo-vwo met eventuele uniforme toelatingseisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over leerlingen uit het speciaal onderwijs die willen doorleren maar vastlopen

An MP asked the minister whether pupils moving from special to regular secondary education who have gaps in required subjects can be helped to continue and combine education levels, and whether exceptions are possible in such cases. The minister acknowledged the difficulty, said no national data is kept, argued that enough school options exist, and said no exception is needed since pupils with subject gaps may move up but must repair them at school level.
No, no national data is kept on this.
Nee, hierover worden geen landelijke gegevens bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het artikel 'Expertisecentrum SLO wil tóch weg uit Enschede'

An MP from the CDA asks whether the SLO curriculum institute's board is planning to move its headquarters out of Enschede, whether the works council has advised on it, and whether the minister will urge reconsideration as her predecessor did. The minister answers that SLO is a private-law body whose board decides on its own organisation and housing, that the formal works council advice is not yet complete, and that the minister will not intervene in the board's decision.
SLO is a private-law legal entity with statutory tasks. Its board therefore decides on its own organisation and internal affairs.
SLO is een privaatrechtelijke rechtspersoon met wettelijke taken. De bestuurder van SLO gaat daarom over haar eigen organisatie en huishouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘VLC heeft ruimtegebrek én leegstand’

An SGP MP asked the education minister about reports that a Barneveld secondary school faces both space shortages and vacancies, and how passend onderwijs funding and VNG model rules account for the extra housing needed for pupils with extra support needs. The minister answered that housing costs are not part of education funding and fall to municipalities, that he sees no reason to call huisvesting a forgotten chapter, that the zorgplicht exemption for lack of space exists by law, and that he will report on talks with the VNG in the progress report before summer.
Municipalities are responsible for making funds available for education housing, within the financial frameworks they set.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ter beschikking stellen van middelen voor de onderwijshuisvesting, binnen de door hen vastgestelde financiële kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat een leerkracht van het Hoofdvaart College geschorst is wegens ’belediging profeet’

A ChristenUnie MP asked the minister about reports that a technology teacher at Hoofdvaart College was suspended after students said he insulted the prophet Mohammed, and questioned the proportionality and treatment of teachers. The minister replied that it is a time-out rather than a suspension, that the inspectorate found it a personnel matter and not a case for ministerial judgment, and that schools' boards are responsible for such decisions.
Imposing a time-out or a suspension is a matter between employer and employee.
Het opleggen van een time-out of een schorsing is een kwestie tussen werkgever en werknemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het nieuwsbericht ‘Leerkracht geschorst na ‘beledigen profeet’

MPs Heerema and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked why a Hoofddorp technical instructor was suspended after allegedly insulting the prophet Mohammed, whether this falls under free speech, and what sanctions could follow if complaints were false. Minister Slob answered that the suspension is a personnel matter between employer and employee, that the Inspectorate found an open school climate, and that he will not intervene in the pending appeal hearing or speculate on its outcome.
It is important that this committee can do its work undisturbed and carefully. I therefore do not wish to speculate about a possible ruling.
Het is belangrijk dat deze commissie ongestoord en zorgvuldig haar werk kan doen. Ik wil daarom niet speculeren over een mogelijke uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht 'Leerkracht geschorst na beledigen profeet'

PVV MPs asked the Education Minister whether a teacher's suspension after insulting the prophet shows that yielding to Islam is a pattern, whether intimidating pupils should have been punished instead, and whether the government will act to reinstate the teacher. The minister denied endorsing the premise, said school boards decide on suspensions within legal limits, and declined to intervene in the case.
In practice it is up to the board, school leader, teachers, parents and pupils to make arrangements with each other, within the limits of the law, about the school culture.
In de praktijk is het aan het bestuur, schoolleider, leraren, ouders en leerlingen om met elkaar en uiteraard binnen de grenzen van de wet afspraken te maken over de invulling van een schoolcultuur
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht dat de NPO-app op tv’s van vóór 2014 niet meer werkt

An MP asked the minister about reports that the NPO app no longer works on TVs made before 2014, whether the public broadcaster must serve everyone including catch-up viewing, and whether a solution would be explored for affected viewers. The minister confirmed the problem, stated that the NPO is responsible under the Mediawet for accessibility, and declined to adapt the app for older Smart TVs, pointing to cost and to alternative viewing routes such as the website and casting.
Adapting apps for all versions of Smart TVs involves relatively high costs, while the media offering is also available through other means.
Het aanpassen van apps voor alle versies van Smart TV’s gaat gepaard met relatief hoge kosten terwijl het media-aanbod ook via andere manieren beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Westerveld over het bericht 'Ook stichting kijkonderzoek verzamelde data met omstreden methode'

GroenLinks MPs Özütok and Westerveld asked whether the audience-measurement method reported by NOS (collecting data via a contested method, with questions on legality, informed consent, and whether public broadcasters should stop participating) is lawful and whether it should be banned. Minister Slob replied that the GDPR question is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority to judge, that the AVG rules are adequate, and that he expects the NPO and its contractors to comply with the law.
It is not for me to make a statement on this.
Het is niet aan mij om hier een uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van der Molen over het bericht dat de lokale omroepen aan de rand van de afgrond staan

MPs Kwint and Van der Molen asked whether the minister knows of financial distress at local broadcasters such as 1Twente and whether bankruptcies would damage local democracy, and what should be done to make them viable. The minister replied that funding is a municipal responsibility, that an advisory request on organisation and financing was sent in February 2019, that a possible pilot for regional broadcasters is being explored, and that the EUR 5 million for investigative journalism is not meant to keep local broadcasters afloat.
I am aware of the signals about the precarious financial situation of the broadcasters 1Twente and Omroepstichting ZuidWest.
Ik ben bekend met de signalen over de precaire financiële situatie van de omroepen 1Twente en Omroepstichting ZuidWest
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over peperdure zesweekse schoolreizen van vierduizend euro

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about costly six-week school trips of 4,000 euro organised by 't Wylde Leren, including whether schools may outsource teaching, whether such trips count as lawful education, and whether they may be compulsory or exclude pupils. The minister answered that such trips can fit within the rules if run under school responsibility and approved by the works council, flagged inequality risks, but gave no monitoring inventory and said the school board, not the provider, is accountable for quality.
I currently see no reason for further inventory.
Ik zie op dit moment nog geen aanleiding voor verdere inventarisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Kops over het bericht 'Slob: leerplicht gaat vóór klimaatspijbelen'

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education whether the school-strike-for-climate absences should be treated as truancy and whether leerplichtambtenaren should register them as unauthorised absence. The Minister said truancy is never a solution, that schools decide whether absences are truancy and only report at 16 hours in four weeks, and declined to send truancy officers to school climate-strike days.
No, this is up to the leerplicht official in the municipality and the school.
Nee, dit is aan de leerplichtbeambte in de gemeente en aan de school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Verval in de gymzaal: kapotte trampolines en turnbruggen'

A VVD MP asked the minister about reports that many gym teachers use condemned sports equipment, and about who is responsible for safe materials and their replacement. The minister acknowledged the reports, said he has no detailed figures on affected schools, pointed to a planned study, and said responsibility lies with school boards, municipalities (under the Wpo) and exploitants.
I have no insight into how many schools exactly have to deal with materials that do not fully comply.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoeveel scholen exact te maken hebben met materialen die niet volledig voldoen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Van Meenen en Rog over brieven waarin schoolleiders gewezen worden op de wettelijke verplichting om gegevens van leraren aan te leveren voor het Lerarenregister

MPs Bruins, Van Meenen and Rog asked whether letters pressing school leaders to supply teacher data for the teacher register, threatening inspection consequences, were unnecessary and whether the Inspectorate would enforce the obligation. The minister admitted the letter was incomplete and should not have been sent, promised corrective letters, and said he is discussing inspection oversight of professional development with the Inspectorate and will embed HRM policy in the law.
This letter should not have been sent in this form: the information it contains is incomplete.
Deze brief had niet in deze vorm verstuurd moeten worden: de informatie die er in staat is onvolledig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over initiatieven voor passend onderwijs

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the Minister of Education about the ZON-approach to inclusive education, including whether schools may experiment with it, how to provide education outside school for some children, and the Linawijs initiative. The Minister said schools may choose their method within current law, that existing rules already allow education outside school, and that an evaluation and joint policy work with VWS will follow, but declined to answer the questions before the committee meeting.

As indicated in the education-care letter 2, Minister de Jonge and I are developing education-care arrangements in which we examine whether the current education and care frameworks provide enough scope and clarity to offer tailored support to children with strong support needs.

Zoals aangegeven in de onderwijs-zorgbrief 2 werken Minister de Jonge en ik onderwijs-zorgarrangementen uit waarin wij bekijken of de huidige onderwijs- en zorgkaders genoeg ruimte en duidelijkheid bevatten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Bergkamp en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Bestuurder reformatorische school tekende Nashville-verklaring’

MPs asked whether a board member of a reformed school signing the Nashville Statement, which denies LGBT identities, is acceptable and whether the government would act on school discrimination duties. The minister distanced the cabinet from the statement, said schools are assessed on citizenship and social safety duties, noted the hoger onderwijs discrimination rule does not apply to primary and secondary schools, and said the board was consulted and the school will keep working on an open climate.
The cabinet has distanced itself from the Nashville Statement.
Het kabinet heeft afstand genomen van de Nashville-verklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over uitreiking Predicaten Excellente School

An MP asked the minister whether the LAKS student organisation's own excellence awards based on student satisfaction are meaningful, and whether student and teacher voices are weighted enough in the Inspectorate's and jury's Excellente School process.
