The minister defended the existing process, saying students and teachers are consulted in jury and inspectorate visits, declined to change the framework, and said an inspectorate evaluation would follow in 2019.
In 2019 the inspectorate will carry out an overall evaluation of the Excellente Scholen process.
In 2019 zal de inspectie een algehele evaluatie uitvoeren naar het traject Excellente Scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Aartsen over het bericht 'Geen Nederlandse media meer op Europese nepnieuwslijst'

MPs Kwint and Aartsen asked whether Dutch media had been excluded from EU East StratCom's EUvsDisinfo list, whether the Dutch government would send a letter on it, whether Dutch journalists would stop appearing on the list, and who funds EUvsDisinfo. The minister replied that no Dutch sources remain on the website after assurances from the EEAS, that she assumes no future Dutch press articles will appear, and that the taskforce is funded from the EEAS communication budget within the general EU budget, without a copy of the agreement being provided.
There is no copy of that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Weyenberg over toepassing van het verlaagde btw-tarief op e-publicaties

MPs Sneller and Van Weyenberg asked whether the government will lower VAT on e-publications following the October 2018 EU political agreement, and what preparations, timeline and consultation with the sector are planned. The state secretary confirmed the agreement and earlier commitments, said preparations are underway including a draft bill for internet consultation in the first half of 2019, and targeted entry into force on 1 January 2020.
Furthermore, I intend to consult broadly on a draft bill in the first half of 2019 via an internet consultation, so that all stakeholders have the opportunity to respond.

Verder ben ik voornemens om een conceptwetsvoorstel in de eerste helft van 2019 breed te consulteren via een internetconsultatie, zodat alle belanghebbenden in de gelegenheid worden gesteld te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Leraren vinden moeilijk een woning op plekken waar werk is'

Two PvdA MPs asked the Ministers of Interior and Education whether teachers can realistically find affordable homes in big cities, and what the government will do about it. The minister says housing supply is a municipal responsibility, describes existing national and municipal instruments and initiatives, and states the government is stimulating housing construction without committing to specific new measures for middle-income teachers.
Data on the size of the shortage in these cities is not available to central government.
De gegevens over de omvang van het tekort in deze steden zijn niet bij het Rijk beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van DUO Onderwijsonderzoek & Advies naar de sociale veiligheid van docenten

An MP asked the minister about DUO survey results showing a quarter of secondary school teachers face abuse or violence from pupils, the handling of specific incidents, whether such incidents are concealed, teacher training and involving teachers in solutions. The minister acknowledged the concern, explained the monitoring method, said schools generally work hard on safety, and pointed to training and sector-partner initiatives.
I am not aware which school this concerns or when this took place.
Mij is niet bekend om welke school het hier gaat of wanneer zich dit heeft afgespeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het onderzoek sociale veiligheid van docenten

An MP from D66 asked the minister about a DUO survey showing many teachers face verbal and physical abuse, and about school safety measures, teacher training, reporting and support. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to VOION and SSV support initiatives and existing legal duties, and said he has no insight into teachers' willingness to file police reports.
Given the importance of this activity, I will again urge VOION to speed up the implementation.
Gezien het belang van deze activiteit zal ik er bij VOION nogmaals op aandringen haast te maken met de uitwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over veel lhbt-leerlingen die het volgens de Amerikaanse Columbia University nog altijd zwaar hebben op Nederlandse middelbare scholen

An MP asked the education ministers about the Columbia University survey finding that many LGBT pupils in Dutch secondary schools suffer negative remarks and inadequate teacher responses, and whether all schools should mandatorily address LGBT topics in lessons and anti-bullying programmes. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing GSA support and curriculum revisions, and promised to raise the issue with school leaders and teacher training, without committing to new mandatory rules.
That is why I would like to call on school leaders to sit down with teachers to discuss this.
Daarom zou ik schoolleiders op willen roepen om samen met docenten om tafel te gaan om hierover te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het beschikbare lesmateriaal over het conflict tussen Israël en de Palestijnen

An MP asks whether CIDI's Israel-Palestine teaching materials and university course are biased and whether the government should stop their influence in education. The minister answers that education freedom is constitutionally protected, the ministry does not judge the content, schools and parents can raise concerns via participation councils, and CIDI and other organisations may freely offer materials.
Education freedom is enshrined in the Constitution, so it is not the ministry's task to judge the content of the available teaching materials.
In de Grondwet is de vrijheid van onderwijs verankerd en het is dan ook niet de taak van het ministerie om een oordeel te vormen over de inhoud van het beschikbare lesmateriaal
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de cijfers over bevoegde en benoembare docenten in het voortgezet onderwijs

An MP asked the education minister to explain the difference between old and new measurement methods for qualified and appointable teachers in secondary education, to provide 2009–2018 breakdowns, and to distinguish qualified from appointable teachers in official reporting. The minister answered that pre-2014 data are unreliable so only 2014–2017 tables are provided, that the government will distinguish the categories going forward, and that the Inspectorate will be asked to do the same.
It is not possible to provide a reliable series for the entire period 2009–2018.
Het is niet mogelijk om een betrouwbare reeks voor de gehele periode 2009–2018 aan te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government, including the Minister responsible for education and media, about the Greta Thunberg COP24 speech and whether ministers accept responsibility for climate policy, with 20 questions on whether the government will change its climate and growth policy. The answer, sent jointly by several ministers, states only that the questions were answered by reference to an Aanhangsel in the parliamentary proceedings, without addressing the substance in this document.
The written questions from MP Van Raan (PvdD), question number 2018Z24282, have been answered by means of the Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Raan (PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24282 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een 16-jarige scholier wil doorstromen naar het vwo, maar geen enkele school hem wil hebben

MP Kwint asked whether it is acceptable that a 16-year-old with a havo diploma was refused admission to vwo at every school in the Hague region, how common extra admission requirements are, and whether a right to progress from havo to vwo should be legislated. Minister Slob answers that a conditional progression right is planned for havo to vwo, that extra requirements are used regularly according to a sample study, and that an impact analysis will be sent to parliament.
I will therefore develop a right to progress from havo to vwo, in line with the planned progression right from vmbo to havo.
Ik zal daarom analoog aan het te ontwikkelen doorstroomrecht vmbo-havo een doorstroomrecht havo-vwo uitwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over schoolkosten

Two MPs asked the education minister about extra school costs for bilingual education, sports, trips, devices and tutoring, asking for per-school overviews, 20-year trends, the legal fit with the Dutch secondary education act, and the effect on segregation. The minister said costs are monitored by survey, cited falling average secondary school costs since 2006, stated parental contributions must be voluntary and cannot condition admission, and promised a new cost monitor and talks with the VO-raad.

We periodically monitor school costs in primary, secondary and vocational education through a survey of schools and parents. We therefore do not have an overview of school costs per school broken down by school activity.

We monitoren de schoolkosten in het po, vo en mbo periodiek door middel van een enquête onder scholen en ouders. We hebben dus geen overzicht van de schoolkosten per school uitgesplitst naar schoolactiviteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het lesmateriaal Nederlands

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Education whether school textbook material describing Geert Wilders as a danger amounts to political indoctrination and whether measures would be taken. The minister replied that schools freely choose teaching materials, that structural insults in education are not accepted as a premise, and that complaints can be raised through the school's participation council.
Schools are free in their choice of teaching materials.
Scholen zijn vrij in de keuze van leermiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Alkaya over Astro TV

MPs Sneller and Alkaya asked whether the psychic programme 'Astro TV' and similar shows that promise financial good fortune to callers, aimed at vulnerable people, amount to misleading practice and whether the Authority for Consumers and Markets or other supervisors should act. The government answered that the programme cited is actually RTL's 'Dit is mijn toekomst', that responsibility for assessing misleading practices lies with the ACM and the courts, that the AFM and Commissariaat have no clear remit, and that RTL has agreed limits on advice and is reconsidering the programme.

Ultimately it is up to the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) and the courts to determine whether the practices of Astro TV, 'Dit is mijn toekomst' and similar media are misleading in that context.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) en de rechter om te bepalen of de praktijken van Astro TV, «Dit is mijn toekomst» en soortgelijke media in dat kader misleidend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Aartsen over het bericht dat John van den Heuvel wegens dreiging niet meer in de studio van RTL kan verschijnen

MPs Sneller and Aartsen asked why journalist John van den Heuvel could no longer appear in the RTL studio due to threats and how this squares with the agreement on protecting journalists. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the decision was a proportionate local security assessment by the Amsterdam triangle, that press freedom is not curtailed, and that the agreed journalist-protection measures are being implemented.
There is, however, no question of Mr Van den Heuvel being denied the right to speak or being advised against expressing himself (on television).
Er is echter geen sprake van dat dhr. van den Heuvel het woord wordt ontnomen of hem wordt afgeraden zich (op televisie) te uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de grote kloof tussen gelukkige en kwetsbare kinderen

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked about the large gap in wellbeing between happy and vulnerable children found by the Children's Ombudsman, including safety at home, stress, youth care, and participation. The minister acknowledged the findings, said the Ombudsman's follow-up research will be awaited, and pointed to existing programmes on domestic violence, child poverty, education equality and sport, without committing to new measures.
We will await the outcomes of the follow-up research and then weigh whether further research is needed.
We zullen de uitkomsten van het vervolgonderzoek afwachten en vervolgens de afweging maken of er nader onderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een docent op een reformatorische school mag worden ontslagen om een theaterstuk

An MP asked the minister whether an identity committee could dismiss a teacher for a theatre play in his free time, given that the school's info guide offered drama, and whether a committee jointly appointed by boards and staff is independent. The minister answers that drama was never taught at the school, that the committee's composition is statutory and independent, and that he sees no reason to doubt the procedure was followed.
I have no reason to assume that in this case the rules were not followed, nor that the independence of the committee is at stake.
Ik heb geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat bij onderhavige casus niet conform deze regels gehandeld zou zijn, noch dat de onafhankelijkheid van de commissie in het geding zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht dat de experimentele klas voor hoogbegaafde leerlingen in Leiden (LIVE) in haar voortbestaan wordt bedreigd

An MP asked the ministers about the threatened Leiden experimental class for gifted pupils (LIVE), which lost its education funding because it is not a formal school, and whether the 15 million euro coalition funding and the Thuiszitterspact apply. The minister answered that LIVE is not a recognised school, so education funding and inspectorate oversight do not apply, that municipality and regional partners are responsible, and that they are working with the region and Gedragswerk to find a suitable arrangement.
The initiative has not been designated as a school within the meaning of the Compulsory Education Act 1969. Therefore, funding from education is not permitted.
Het initiatief is niet aangemerkt als school in de zin van de Leerplichtwet 1969. Daarom is financiering vanuit onderwijs niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Beckerman over het bericht dat de nieuwbouw van een school in de problemen komt door stijgende bouwkosten

MPs Kwint and Beckerman (SP) asked ministers whether rising construction costs delaying a school building in De Bilt reflect a national problem, whether budgets are sufficient, and how mould and damp in schools are addressed. The ministers replied that rising costs are a market trend with no specific school-building data kept, that existing budgets for maintenance are adequate, and that they see no further options to curb cost increases beyond a pilot programme.
Beyond that, I see no options for curbing the rising costs of school construction resulting from market developments.
Verder zie ik geen mogelijkheden om de stijgende kosten van scholenbouw als gevolg van marktontwikkelingen in te perken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over onderzoek van Sociaal Werk Nederland waaruit blijkt dat meer ouders peuters thuishouden

Two MPs asked whether administrative burden of the childcare allowance application is causing parents to keep toddlers out of playgroup-type care, with consequences for language delay, and proposed free preschool. The state secretary answered that research shows no national trend of parents dropping out, that a verbetertraject for the allowance and a new study are underway, and that a precise cost estimate for free preschool is difficult but a rough figure of about 850 million euro was given.
That is why I will again examine at the beginning of 2019 what the effects of the harmonisation are.
Daarom zal ik begin 2019 opnieuw onderzoeken wat de effecten van de harmonisatie zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de AOb past voor landelijk overleg over lerarentekort

MPs Kwint asked the minister about the AOb union withdrawing from the national teacher shortage talks and whether the shortage can be solved without structural extra funding. The minister regrets the withdrawal, says the national talks will continue, defends the handreiking and the regional approach, and points to existing structural investments in workload reduction and salaries.
I regret the AOb's departure from the national teacher shortage consultation.
Ik betreur het vertrek van de AOb uit het landelijke overleg lerarentekort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het vastlopen van het landelijk overleg lerarentekort

An MP asked the education minister about the collapse of national talks on the teacher shortage after primary-school unions walked out and the AOb withdrew, and how the government will still pursue a pact with municipalities and businesses. The minister regrets the walkouts, says cooperation continues with other parties, and refers the motion's pact to regional approaches and existing projects.
That does not stop me from continuing with the other organisations to tackle the shortages.
Het weerhoudt mij er echter niet van om met de andere organisaties verder te gaan om de tekorten aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht dat 24 van de 100 journalistieke banen bij de KRO-NCRV verdwijnen

Sneller (D66) asked whether the minister had conditioned the 40 million euro compensation for NPO advertising shortfalls on not reversing earlier decisions, which would infringe broadcasters' journalistic independence. The minister denied any such condition, said the funds were made available to protect programming as far as possible, and stated he knows of no such condition.
Making these funds available may indeed not be a vehicle for imposing conditions that conflict with the independence of the public broadcaster.
Het beschikbaar stellen van deze middelen mag inderdaad geen vehikel zijn om voorwaarden te stellen die in strijd zijn met de onafhankelijkheid van de publieke omroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het incident waarbij een WNL-journalist is belaagd en bedreigd in Zoetermeer

An MP asked the minister about a WNL journalist who was harassed and threatened in Zoetermeer by a group of twenty people, and whether journalists can report threats and how safety is protected. The minister condemned the intimidation, said journalists should be able to work safely, and described a steering group with the NVJ, editors, prosecutors and police plus funding for protection, though no reporting point exists.
There is no reporting point for journalists who are threatened, but a steering group on tackling aggression and violence against journalists has been established
Er is geen meldpunt voor journalisten die bedreigd worden, maar er is een stuurgroep aanpak Agressie en geweld tegen Journalisten opgericht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht 'Gezocht, oppasouder voor als de leraar ziek is'

MP Kwint (SP) asks the education minister about reports of schools using parents as supervisors when teachers are ill, whether this is education, its effect on quality, how many schools take such measures, and whether first-year pabo students may teach alone. Minister Slob answers that supervision alone is not education, that unqualified staff may only be a temporary emergency measure, that the inspectorate is investigating shortages and that first-year students may not teach independently, while admitting no national overview of unqualified teachers exists.
Deploying unqualified staff in certain situations, however, remains a temporary emergency solution.
Het inzetten van onbevoegde medewerkers in bepaalde situaties blijft echter een tijdelijk noodoplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Westerveld over de uitzending van Radar over online kindermarketing

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about online child marketing of unhealthy food shown on Radar, including influencer reach, YouTube disclosure rules and the Jongeren Op Gezond Gewicht programme. The government acknowledged the concern, said it will annually monitor compliance with the food advertising code including social media, and will discuss the results with industry and the Alliantie Stop Kindermarketing.
I will conduct annual research into compliance with these agreements and will explicitly include the influence of social media in it.
Ik zal jaarlijks onderzoek doen naar de naleving van deze afspraken en zal de invloed van sociale media hierin nadrukkelijk meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Hul over verschillen in schooladviezen tussen inkomensgroepen

Two MPs (Westerveld and Van den Hul) asked why school-advice revisions appear to differ by parental income and education level, and what the ministry is doing about it. The minister says revision rates are misquoted, that the link with parental education is not linear, that causes will be studied, and that the inspectorate's simulation tool and evaluation will address objectivity.
I am having the causes investigated, and these results will be included in the final evaluation of the Primary School Final Test Act.
Ik laat de oorzaken hiervan onderzoeken en deze resultaten zullen worden meegenomen in de eindevaluatie van de Wet eindtoetsing po.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Meenen inzake de zorgboerderij de Grote Brander

MPs Kwint and Van Meenen asked why funding for education at the Grote Brander care farm in Deventer stopped, leaving children without the schooling they benefited from. The minister answered that the location does not meet legal requirements for a school site, so it is not eligible for education funding, and that the school board and municipality are working on individual solutions.
However, it is also my responsibility to be able to guarantee the quality of education for every child.
Het is echter ook mijn verantwoordelijkheid om de kwaliteit van onderwijs voor elk kind te kunnen garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht dat de strengere gedragscode van de NPO niet wordt nageleefd

Sneller (D66) asked why public broadcasters have not yet published side-jobs of key journalistic staff, such as presenters, as required by the 2018 Governance Code, and what sanctions apply. Minister Slob confirmed the disclosure duty covers presenters, said the NPO and the CIPO oversight commission must enforce it, noted that a compliance review had just begun, and that the NPO board could withhold budget or the Commissariaat could fine for breaches.
It is up to the NPO and the Public Broadcasting Integrity Commission (CIPO) to point broadcasters to their obligations arising from the Governance Code.
Het is aan de NPO en de Commissie integriteit publieke omroep (CIPO) om omroepen te wijzen op hun verplichtingen die voorvloeien uit de Governancecode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bestuur van het Venlose OGVO dat in verband met financiële problemen leraren meer laat werken voor hetzelfde salaris

An MP asked the minister about reports that the board of the Venlo school group OGVO, facing financial problems, is making teachers work more hours for the same pay, and about a reported climate of fear among staff. The minister replied that school boards are responsible for personnel policy, that the supervisory body can intervene, that the Inspectorate will investigate OGVO this school year as already planned, and that the sector's collective agreement, to be interpreted by its social partners, caps teaching hours.
This school year the Inspectorate will conduct an investigation at OGVO.
Dit schooljaar zal de Inspectie onderzoek doen bij OGVO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Syriërs sturen kinderen naar weekendscholen'

VVD MPs Becker and Rudmer Heerema asked about reports that Syrian refugees send children to weekend schools teaching their own language and culture, asking for data, content oversight, and whether such schools undermine integration and Dutch values. The government answered that it has no information on the content or numbers of these weekend schools because they are not schools under education law and fall outside Inspectorate oversight, while stating that informal education is free but should not obstruct integration or promote anti-democratic views.

At present the cabinet has no information on the nature and scope of the education at weekend schools focused on language, culture and religion, because weekend schools are not schools within the meaning of education legislation.

Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen informatie over de aard en omvang van het onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen die zich richten op taal, cultuur en religie, omdat weekendscholen geen scholen zijn in de zin van de onderwijswetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een alarmerende daling van studentenaantallen voor Nederlandse Taal en Cultuur

The MP asked whether the reported collapse in student numbers for Dutch language and culture is accurate, what it means for the shortage of Dutch teachers in upper secondary education, and how the minister assesses proposals to reverse the trend. The minister confirmed a roughly 60% fall in intake over ten years that has levelled off but still gives cause for concern, pointed to sector initiatives such as a Delta plan for languages and a KNAW analysis, and said curriculum reform will be examined.
In addition, I have asked the KNAW to produce a problem analysis and possible solutions for the Dutch studies programme.
Daarnaast heb ik de KNAW gevraagd om tot een probleemanalyse en eventuele oplossingsrichtingen te komen voor de studie Nederlands.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een docent op een reformatorische school mag worden ontslagen om een theaterstuk

An MP asked the minister whether a teacher at a reformed school may be dismissed over a theatre production about his gambling addiction, whether the identity committee's approval is sound, and whether the inspectorate granted exemptions from core curriculum goals on arts and citizenship. The minister said the identity committee's approval is outside his role, that no exemption from the core goals was granted since 2006 and none is needed, and that the school's claim about an exemption rested on a misunderstanding.
I have no further role in that.
Ik heb daar verder geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat tientallen Haagse basisscholen Shell-festival Generation Discover boycotten

An MP asked the education minister about dozens of The Hague primary schools boycotting Shell's Generation Discover festival, whether schools should be urged to avoid it, and whether the ministry's secretary-general opening the festival is consistent with that. The minister answered that schools decide for themselves which events to attend, that the ministry will not urge a boycott, and that the festival serves technical education recruitment, with the ministry also joining the annual CEO consultation held there.
It is not for the government to judge whether or not to attend an event.
Het is niet aan de regering om het wel of niet bezoeken van een evenement te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van den Hul over de berichten over het niet uitkomen met de financiële middelen bij een scholenkoepel in Zeist

An MP asked the education minister about reports that school federation Wereldkidz in Zeist would not have enough funds after offsetting workload-reduction money against cuts, and whether this affects other schools. The minister said the federation's calculation cannot be traced to the cited items, that a new disadvantage-funding model is pending, that salary funding was increased structurally, and that he will keep talking with social partners.
No, I do not have this overview.
Nee, dit overzicht heb ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Becker over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse school ruilt Paasontbijt voor Suikerfeest’

Two VVD MPs asked the education minister about an Amsterdam primary school replacing its Easter breakfast with a Suikerfeest celebration, including whether parents and the medezeggenschapsraad were consulted and whether Dutch traditions are protected. The minister answered that schools set their own celebrations, the school's participation body had discussed broader attention to faith traditions, and the civic-education duties and a forthcoming bill clarifying the citizenship mandate were pointed to.
Primary schools themselves determine which festivals, celebrations or commemorations take place at school.
Basisscholen bepalen zelf welke feesten, vieringen of herdenkingen op school plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over terugloop van het aantal kinderen met een (leer)achterstand in de voorschoolse opvang in Amsterdam

The SP MP Kwint asked the minister whether the share of children with a learning disadvantage in Amsterdam pre-school care is falling by 20-25% as a city alderman claimed, whether this is a national trend, and how the government will tackle it. The minister answered that the Inspectorate will report reach figures in 2020, that a harmonisation study is planned, that additional funding of 170 million euros per year is provided from 2020, and that no national trend of drop-out due to income-related contributions has been found.
State Secretary Van Ark will conduct research early next year into the state of affairs of the harmonisation.
Staatssecretaris Van Ark zal begin volgend jaar onderzoek doen naar de stand van zaken van de harmonisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over terugloop aantal kinderen in Amsterdamse voorscholen

An MP asks the minister whether the reported drop in toddlers attending Amsterdam pre-schools due to parental costs and difficulties with childcare allowance applications is recognised, and what is being done about it. The minister acknowledges the problem may exist, points to information provision and a forthcoming study on harmonisation effects, and says the existing budget is sufficient while declining to fund full fee coverage in Amsterdam.
State Secretary Van Ark will conduct research early next year into the state of affairs of the harmonisation.
Staatssecretaris Van Ark zal begin volgend jaar onderzoek doen naar de stand van zaken van de harmonisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Hoe onafhankelijk is Yvon Jaspers?’

An MP asked the Minister for Education and Media whether a presenter of the KRO-NCRV programme 'Onze Boerderij' has a paid side job with listed feed manufacturer For Farmers, and whether this creates a conflict of interest with the public broadcaster's independence obligation. The minister answered that the Commissariaat voor de Media is investigating the arrangements, that outcomes cannot be anticipated, and that broadcasters themselves are primarily responsible for managing conflicts of interest under the governance code.
Following recent media reports on this presenter's side job, the Commissariaat voor de Media is examining the arrangements with this presenter regarding this programme.

Naar aanleiding van de recente berichten in de media over de nevenfunctie van deze presentatrice, onderzoekt het Commissariaat voor de Media (hierna: het Commissariaat) de afspraken met deze presentatrice ten aanzien van dit programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de daling van het aantal kinderen met een risico op (taal)achterstand in de voorschoolse educatie in Amsterdam en Rotterdam

An MP asked the government about the reported drop in toddlers at risk of language and education delay attending pre-school in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, and how this fits with the government's aim to reduce inequality of opportunity. The minister replied that the government prioritises combating educational disadvantage, that monitoring and a follow-up study on harmonisation and possible demand drop-out are planned, and that municipalities can already offer free or low-cost pre-school places using existing funds.

Should the outcomes of the aforementioned study show a drop in participation of target-group toddlers in pre-school education, I will enter into discussion with representatives of municipalities and childcare organisations about the policy choices municipalities make.

Mocht uit de uitkomsten van het eerder genoemde onderzoek blijken dat er sprake is van een terugloop in deelname van doelgroeppeuters aan voorschoolse educatie, dan zal ik in gesprek gaan met de vertegenwoordigers van gemeenten en van kinderopvangorganisaties over de beleidskeuzes die gemeenten maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over leraren meer laten werken voor hetzelfde salaris

An MP asked the minister whether a school board's plan to have teachers work 30 extra hours a year without extra pay breaches the collective labour agreement, and how the minister would ensure schools honour their agreements amid the teacher shortage. The minister answered that compliance with the CAO is a matter for the social partners and the parties to the agreement, declined to engage directly with the board, and noted the 750-hour cap for 2018 and 720 hours from 2019.
This is a question that must be answered by those who concluded this CAO, namely the social partners.
Dit is een vraag die beantwoord moet worden door degenen die deze cao gesloten hebben, nl. de sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat kinderen hun lunch soms niet op krijgen omdat er op school maar 15 minuten de tijd voor is

Bruins (ChristenUnie) asked whether short 15-minute lunch breaks under continuous-day schedules are acceptable and whether rules should change. Minister Slob replied that schools and parents decide the schedule, that schools should allow enough time to eat calmly, and that the Inspectorate provides guidance without new rules.
Schools decide, in consultation with parents, how they organise the teaching time and which school hours go with it.
Scholen bepalen, in samenspraak met de ouders, hoe zij de onderwijstijd indelen en welke schooltijden daarbij horen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de subsidie voor zij-instromers primair onderwijs bijna op is

An SP MP asked whether the subsidy ceiling for career-changer teachers in primary education was nearly exhausted, and whether redistributing funds between education sectors is acceptable given the teacher shortage. The minister confirmed the ceiling was nearly reached, raised the budget by 4 million euro, and defended inter-sector redistribution as efficient budget use.
The budget is therefore being increased by 4 million euro.
Het budget wordt daarom met 4 miljoen euro verhoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Geef leraar onbeperkt toegang tot onderzoek’

An MP asked the ministers whether teachers should get free access to academic publications and whether the government would provide it quickly, rather than waiting for open access policy. The minister agreed knowledge access matters, pointed to open access goals for 2020 and existing NRO and KB services, and did not commit to free access for all teachers now.
That is why I am working to actually realise that free access.
Daarom span ik me in om die vrije toegang daadwerkelijk te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘Graaf Huyn College sluit bouwafdeling’

MP Rog (CDA) asked the minister whether the closure of the building trade department at Graaf Huyn College, due to declining pupil numbers, could be prevented, whether talks took place with the ministry, and what it means for regional provision. The minister answered that the school made a broad regional assessment, that a nearby school still offers building courses, that the EUR 100 million technical vmbo investment is tied to regional plans, and that closures remain necessary where pupil numbers fall.
Graaf Huyn College did not seek contact with the ministry about the planned closure and is not obliged to do so.
Het Graaf Huyn College heeft geen contact gezocht met het ministerie over de voorgenomen sluiting en is daartoe ook niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het bericht ‘Termijn LVO voorzitter Postema na examdebacle met twee jaar verlengd’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education whether the supervisory board of Limburgs Voortgezet Onderwijs, while investigations into the school group and its chair Postema are ongoing, should extend his contract by two years, whether the minister was consulted, and whether she could use her instruction powers to reverse it. The minister answered that the board did not consult her, that she would have advised against the extension, that she has no insight into the chair's new salary, and that she will await Inspectorate reports before deciding on any binding instruction.
I am awaiting the reports of the Inspectorate of Education to see whether an instruction is appropriate.
Ik wacht de rapporten van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs af om te zien of een aanwijzing passend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Smeulders en Van Kent over onderbetaling journalisten door payrolling

MPs Van Dijk, Smeulders and Van Kent asked the ministers about public broadcasting journalists being underpaid through payrolling, including questions on pensions, the regeringsakkoord, zzp collective bargaining and flex allowances. The ministers answered that the Wab bill will extend equal pay and adequate pensions to payroll workers, that broadcasters must set their own budgets and wage terms under the cao, and declined to research the effects on journalistic quality.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Gerven over het bericht dat een school een blaastest invoert voor dronken leerlingen

Two SP MPs asked the government about a school introducing voluntary breath tests for intoxicated pupils and about alcohol use among minors at school and local events. The state secretary said the school's voluntary test is its own choice, enforcement of the age limit lies with municipalities, and prevention and a national prevention accord are being pursued.
Supervision and enforcement of the 18-year age limit for alcohol sales is assigned to municipalities.
Het toezicht en de handhaving van de leeftijdsgrens van 18 jaar bij de verkoop van alcohol is belegd bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de aanhoudende onrust bij LVO Maastricht

An MP asked the minister about reports of wrongly issued vmbo diplomas, grading errors and unreached pupils at LVO Maastricht, and about the school board's self-evaluation and whether the inspectorate will examine board accountability, the works council and the supervisory board. The minister states that the inspectorate found no wrongly issued diplomas, that eight pupils were in doubt and six were granted the diploma, that the grades are correct, and that the board, works council and supervisory board are being questioned in the inspectorate's ongoing investigation, whose outcome he awaits.
Handling of complaints and communication about them is part of the inspectorate's investigations.
Het omgaan met klachten en de communicatie daarover is onderdeel van de onderzoeken van de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het verplicht betalen van de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage bij het bestellen van schoolboeken

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked whether schools may require parents to pay the voluntary parental contribution when ordering textbooks online, and what the minister will do about it. The minister answered that payment must never be a condition for receiving textbooks, that the inspectorate monitors this and sanctions may follow, but declined to guarantee it will not recur and refused to require distributors to change their systems.
It is contrary to the law to make payment of the parental contribution mandatory, for example by imposing it as a condition when ordering school textbooks.
Het is in strijd met de wet om het betalen van de ouderbijdrage te verplichten, bijvoorbeeld door deze als voorwaarde op te leggen bij het bestellen van schoolboeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over de kosten van digitale leermiddelen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked the minister about parents struggling to pay for compulsory laptops or tablets at secondary school and rising ICT costs. The minister said the contributions are voluntary, that schools must provide devices if they go fully digital, and that a new cost monitor and a 2020 evaluation of the Free School Books Act will follow.
Schools may not oblige parents to pay for a laptop or tablet.
Scholen mogen ouders niet verplichten om een laptop of tablet te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Westerveld over het voortgezet onderwijs in met name Groningse en Drentse krimpregio’s dat bij de nieuwe rijksbekostiging op het hakblok gaat

MPs Van den Hul and Westerveld asked whether the new funding model for secondary education would force school closures and cut vmbo support in Groningen and Drenthe shrinkage regions, and whether a 'krimpcheck' proposed by northern provinces would be adopted. The minister answered that the funding simplification has only limited redistribution effects, that closures stem from pupil decline and regional planning by school boards, that vmbo pupils receive a higher amount so schools are not disadvantaged, and that the provinces' letter was addressed in a separate letter.
This will apply to all types of boards in future, both narrow vmbo schools and broad school communities.
Dit geldt straks voor alle soorten besturen, zowel smalle vmbo-scholen als brede scholengemeenschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Westerveld over de loonkloof tussen primair en voortgezet onderwijs, en de om die reden stukgelopen cao-onderhandelingen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about the salary gap between primary and secondary teachers, the teacher shortage, and the stalled collective bargaining, and whether dialogue with the sector would resume. The minister answered that salaries in primary education have risen substantially, that the gap has narrowed, that additional measures and funding for workload are being taken, and that talks with employer and employee organisations on the teacher shortage are ongoing, while noting PO in Actie no longer wishes to participate.
I am currently in talks with the employer and employee organisations about the approach to the teacher shortage.
Ik ben op dit moment in gesprek met de werkgevers- en werknemersorganisaties over de aanpak van het lerarentekort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over Groningse basisschoolleraren die hun leerlingen vaker onderschatten dan hun collega’s in rest van Nederland

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked why Groningen primary teachers give lower secondary school advice more often than elsewhere in the Netherlands, and what this means for pupils' opportunities, while also raising the role of parental pressure, school-level agreements and the research of Bosker. The minister confirmed more Groningen advice is revised downward, said no research has yet explained the gap, pointed to Drenthe research and an Inspectorate game, and promised to return to the topic in the 2018 results report and the final evaluation of the eindtoets law.

No substantiated statements can be made about the province of Groningen, since no research has yet been conducted in that province into the cause of the difference between school advice and test advice.

Er kunnen over de provincie Groningen geen onderbouwde uitspraken worden gedaan, aangezien er in die provincie nog geen onderzoek gedaan is naar de oorzaak van het verschil in schooladvies en toetsadvies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over vrijstellingen van de leerplicht op grond van artikel 5a

MP Van den Hul asks whether exemptions from school attendance under article 5(a) of the Leerplichtwet for children with severe physical or psychological conditions are rising, and whether perverse incentives such as performance pressure and the passing of gifted children between regular and special education are behind this. Minister Slob confirms the rise, rejects the claim that cooperative bodies are excluding children, finds no evidence for the other suspicions, and promises a bill in the first half of 2019 to broaden the assessment before an exemption is granted.
I want to do this by involving the education sector in this procedure and strengthening the role of the municipality (in the form of the school attendance officer).
Ik wil dit doen door het onderwijsveld in deze procedure te betrekken en de rol van de gemeente (in de vorm van de leerplichtambtenaar) te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Futselaar over de alarmerende omvang van het lerarentekort

MPs Kwint and Futselaar asked the ministers about the teacher shortage, including the lack of vacancy data, spending on temp agencies, overtime, and higher tuition for second degrees in education and care. The ministers acknowledged the shortage, said they do not hold current vacancy figures, pointed to schools' own choices and the work-pressure accord, and referred to a recent letter on the shortage.
The ministry does not have a current vacancy overview.
Het ministerie heeft geen actueel vacatureoverzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een immens lerarentekort op de Amsterdamse basisscholen

An MP asked the Minister about reported teacher shortages leaving thousands of Amsterdam primary school pupils without a teacher after summer, and whether the problem reflects salary gaps and what structural solutions are planned. The Minister acknowledged the shortage, pointed to a planned meeting with the alderman and to investments in salaries and workload, and referred to a separate letter on the teacher shortage for further measures.
I will therefore soon hold talks with the alderman about the situation in Amsterdam and combine this with a working visit.
Ik ga daarom binnenkort met de wethouder in gesprek over de situatie in Amsterdam en combineer dit met een werkbezoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over het bericht Miljoenen aan onderwijsgeld gaat naar commerciële bureaus

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked whether schools spending millions on commercial staffing agencies is desirable given the teacher shortage, and whether the government would cap such spending. The minister said the teacher shortage is urgent, that the government does not know how many schools use agencies, will collect data from agencies in January 2019, and that staffing contracts are a matter for school boards, so no cap is planned.
Recruiting staff is a matter for school boards.
Het werven van personeel is een zaak van besturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over miljoenen die zijn bedoeld voor onderwijs maar terecht komen bij commerciële bureaus

An MP asked whether schools facing teacher shortages spending public education money on commercial temp agencies, which offer high pay and perks, is acceptable and whether it harms teaching continuity. The minister called the trend undesirable but said hiring is a matter for school boards, that pay is often normal after costs, and that regional cooperation will be encouraged, with no generic measures against agencies planned.
Recruiting staff is a matter for school boards.
Het werven van personeel is een zaak van besturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de brief van het Platform VVVO aan de Coördinatiegroep over de ontwikkelingen omtrent de curriculumherziening

An SP MP asks the education minister about the Platform VVVO letter criticising the curriculum.nu redesign: whether the development task is too big, whether the breadth of school subjects is secured, whether assessment is being planned too early, and whether teachers and subject associations should lead. The minister answers that the timeline is feasible, subject expertise is safeguarded through subject circles, assessment follows content, and the current format gives sufficient direction.
For that reason I maintain the assignment for the development teams.
Ik houd om die reden dan ook vast aan de opdracht voor de ontwikkelteams

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over conciërges en ander onderwijsondersteunend personeel die het moeten doen met een veel lagere loonsverhoging en die niet de forse bonus ontvangen die leerkrachten wel ontvan

An MP asked the minister why primary school support staff such as caretakers and classroom assistants received only a 2.5% pay rise and no bonus, while teachers received a larger increase and bonus, and whether this would reduce support staff availability and increase teachers' workload. The minister replied that the collective agreement gives all staff a 2.5% raise and a one-off payment of EUR 750, that the social partners negotiated it, that no shortage signals are known, and that workload funds allow schools to hire support staff.
Making collective agreements is a matter for the social partners, namely the PO-raad and the trade unions, who weigh the various interests against each other.
Het maken van cao-afspraken is een zaak van sociale partners in casu de PO-raad en de vakorganisaties, waarbij de verschillende belangen tegen elkaar worden afgewogen.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Basisscholen missen 1300 leraren, na de zomer dreigt lesuitval’

Two VVD MPs asked about reports of 1,300 missing primary school teachers, including the extension of the chain-employment rule, use of the supplementary unemployment benefit pool, part-time and retired teachers, and vakleerkrachten for physical education. The minister answered that the chain-rule exemption for substitutes took effect in August 2018, that re-integration results were not previously tracked but monitoring starts in September, and that several proposals (such as Vervangingsfonds coverage for self-employed teachers) are being reviewed or are not the government's responsibility.
As a result, data are currently lacking to factually answer how many benefit recipients return to teaching.
Hiermee ontbreken dus momenteel gegevens om de vraag feitelijk te kunnen beantwoorden hoeveel uitkeringsgerechtigden terug keren voor de klas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht "Ik heb guns, TRRRRRRR"

An SGP MP asked the Minister for Education and Media how a public broadcaster's theme channel could give a platform to convicted rappers, whether this normalises crime, whether it fits the Media Act, and what will be done to stop it. The Minister replied that broadcasters set their own content, that freedom of expression and the absence of censorship apply, that the public may complain to BNNVARA, and that no investigation into criminal liability is known and enforcement is for police and prosecutors.
It is therefore not for me as Minister to judge the (un)desirability or quality of certain content or performances by persons.
Het is daarom niet aan mij als Minister om een oordeel te geven over de (on)wenselijkheid of kwaliteit van bepaalde inhoud of optredens van personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vele berichten dat kinderen en volwassenen verdrinken in de zomerperiode

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care, with the Minister of Education, about drownings linked to weak swimming skills, falling swimming ability among children, and supervision of recreational water sites. The minister said the statistics show drownings are stable and largely in line with past years, pointed to the national swimming safety plan and the NL Zwemveilig project, and said provinces enforce supervision rules under the Whvbz, with no obligation for every recreational site to appoint supervisors.
I trust that this plan will adequately address the various aspects you mention.
Ik vertrouw erop dat dit plan voldoende in gaat op de diverse aspecten die u hiervoor noemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Becker over het bericht 'Onvrede over moskee-schoolreis'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether schools organising class visits to mosques, possibly to salafist mosques with past hate preachers, conflict with parental rights and the civic-education duty, and whether the inspectorate should act. The minister said schools decide their own programmes within legal limits, parents can request exemption, the inspectorate sees no signals of conflict with democratic basic values, and he will clarify the civic-education duty and ask the inspectorate to reinforce oversight.
I intend to make active promotion of the basic values of our democratic constitutional state an explicit part of the civic-education duty, as part of clarifying that statutory duty.

Ik ben van plan om, als onderdeel van de verduidelijking van de wettelijke burgerschapsopdracht, actieve bevordering van de basiswaarden van onze democratische rechtsstaat daarvan expliciet onderdeel te laten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat particulier onderwijs een vlucht neemt

An SP MP asked the minister about the rapid growth of private education and whether it signals declining quality and rising inequality in regular schools. The minister rejects the claim that regular education quality is declining, states that parental choice for private schools is protected by freedom of education, and says he sees no reason to discourage it.
I therefore see no reason for the ministry to discourage parents from enrolling their child in a private school.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om vanuit het ministerie ouders te ontmoedigen hun kind in te schrijven op een particuliere school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de CPB notitie ‘Effectieve interventies leerachterstanden in het primair onderwijs’

An MP asked the education minister how he responds to the CPB's tips on effective interventions for learning disadvantage in primary education, including teacher quality, class size and universal versus targeted pre-school education. The minister endorses the CPB tips, points to funding and a teacher release pilot, notes class size only helps with large reductions, and defends targeted pre-school education based on Dutch longitudinal research.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Bruins over hogere reiskosten voor leerlingen door aanpassing van de scholierenlijn naar Gouda

MPs Van der Graaf and Bruins asked whether the government is aware that shortening school bus line 646/647 to Woerden would more than double travel costs for about 150 pupils travelling to Driestar College in Gouda, and whether it considers this unreasonable and will press for fare integration. The State Secretary said the matter is a regional responsibility of the province of Utrecht, that fare integration is not desirable, and that the concept transport plan will be decided by provincial executives on 11 September.
However, it is not for me to judge the reasonableness.
Het is echter niet aan mij om te oordelen over de redelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Minder efficiënt onderwijs is beter onderwijs’

MP Van Raan asked the education ministers about an article arguing that less efficient education is better education, touching on technology, globalisation, the purpose of schooling, and cost comparisons with other sectors. Minister Slob answered that the article has interesting analyses, that the curriculum review addresses broad social purposes, and that Baumol's cost-disease argument justifies deliberate budget choices.
The article contains some interesting analyses of the role of sociology and economics in thinking about education.
Het artikel bevat enkele interessante analyses over de rol van sociologie en economie in het denken over onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over het niet publiceren van de namen van geslaagde leerlingen

An MP asks the minister whether the GDPR is being applied so strictly that schools can no longer publish the names of students who passed their final exams, and whether the Dutch data protection authority should refrain from fining such schools. The minister says the GDPR does not forbid publication but requires prior consent, that the regulator is independent so he will not intervene, and that the tradition can continue with consent.
It is therefore not appropriate for me to interfere with the supervision of the GDPR.
Het past mij daarom niet om me met het toezicht op de AVG te bemoeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Meenen over het bericht dat de NPO gaat experimenteren met nasynchronisatie van buitenlandse series

MPs Sneller and Van Meenen asked the minister about the NPO's experiment with dubbing foreign series, including the effects on language learning. The minister answered that the public broadcaster is independent in programme matters, that the experiment is for audience research, and that he is not involved in its evaluation.
The experiment falls under the NPO's programme autonomy.
Het experiment behoort tot de programma-autonomie van de NPO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het College voor Toetsen en Examens (CvTE) compenseert in de normering bij examens

MPs Kwint asked whether the CvTE's practice of compensating errors through normering rather than adjusting correction models, as argued by Rene Kneyber, is accurate and defensible. The minister answered that the picture is incorrect, that the CvTE is responsible for the exams, that expert reports confirm the normering method is correct, and that teachers may not invoke article 32e(2) WVO to override correction guidance but must use the route in article 7 of the general correction rules.
The CvTE is responsible for the content and assessment of the central examinations in secondary education.
Het CvTE is verantwoordelijk voor de inhoud en beoordeling van de centrale examens in het voortgezet onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het onderzoek van scholierenorganisatie LAKS over veiligheid op school

An MP asked the minister how to explain that only 56% of vmbo and 48% of praktijkonderwijs pupils feel safe at school according to the LAKS survey, why school safety rules are not producing better results, and what will be done to improve safety perception at vmbo schools. The minister acknowledges the gap, points to the Wet veiligheid op school and the monitoring duties that some schools failed to report, and promises further talks with the VO-raad on anti-bullying programmes and support.
Unfortunately, many schools did not do this in that school year.
Helaas hebben veel scholen dit in dat schooljaar niet gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Rog over de berichten 'Verus niet akkoord met nieuwe onderzoekskaders» en «Inspectie mag geen richting geven aan kwaliteit'

SGP and CDA MPs asked the minister about reports that Verus objected to new inspection frameworks and that the Inspectorate may not set quality direction, including concerns over mixing controlling and stimulating roles. The minister answered that consultation was held, Verus's concerns led to clarifications and removal of brackets, and the government intends to make the Inspectorate's power to correct funding for evident inefficient spending explicit in sector laws.
The brackets can indeed unintentionally cause confusion and have therefore been removed.
De haakjes kunnen inderdaad onbedoeld verwarring wekken en zijn daarom geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Kent over het bericht dat wanbetaling van freelance-journalisten in de hand wordt gewerkt door de overheid

SP MPs Kwint and Van Kent asked whether freelance journalists are underpaid, whether minimum rates and collective bargaining should be allowed, and whether labour inspections target abuses at publishers. The minister answered that the government wants more protection for low-paid self-employed workers through a rule presuming an employment contract, that collective rate-setting by freelancers is restricted by competition law, and that inspections are risk-based without commenting on ongoing investigations.
I do not make any statements about possible ongoing investigations by the Inspectorate.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken van de Inspectie doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat Italië weigert CETA te ratificeren

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade about Italy's reported refusal to ratify CETA over protection of Italian specialty products, why only 41 Italian products are protected under CETA versus 221 in the EU, and whether this shows unfair competition. The minister replied that the government awaits Italy's explanation, that many regional specialties are excluded in trade deals for negotiating reasons, that CETA protects 143 European regional specialties in Canada, and that the provisional application continues unaffected.
CETA offers additional protection to regional European specialties.
CETA biedt regionale Europese specialiteiten aanvullende bescherming.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht: ‘Basisschool wil geen homorol in eindmusical vanwege geloof leerling’

MPs Heerema and Yesilgöz-Zegerius (VVD) asked whether a Hengelo primary school's ban on same-sex roles in the final musical, reportedly due to a Jehovah's Witness pupil's faith, was consistent with the attainment targets on sexual diversity. The minister answered that schools have discretion within the attainment targets, that she would not assess this individual case, and that the school is itself holding a dialogue on the issue.
It is not for me to assess the school principal's conduct in this individual case.
Het is niet aan mij om de handelwijze van de schoolleider in deze individuele casus te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een basisschool die homorollen schrapt uit de musical vanwege het geloof van een leerling

An MP asks the ministers how they judge a Hengelo primary school director who removed same-sex roles from a graduation musical because of a pupil's Jehovah's Witness background, and whether children must be prepared for the Dutch society's acceptance of homosexuality. The minister answers that school leaders have discretion within the kerndoelen on sexual diversity, does not assess this individual case, and considers the matter a debate for the school to resolve.
It is not for me to assess the conduct of the school leader in this individual case.
Het is niet aan mij om de handelwijze van de schoolleider in deze individuele casus te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haersma Buma en Pechtold over het bericht ‘Veel trots, weinig kennis’

MPs Van Haersma Buma and Pechtold asked about a Historisch Nieuwsblad survey showing weak Dutch historical knowledge and its implications for national identity and the curriculum. The minister answered that no comparable ministry research exists, lists regeerakkoord measures on historical awareness and curriculum review, and reports the minister's own quiz results.
Question 8: Are you willing to take the history test yourself as well and publish the results?
Vraag 8 Bent u bereid de geschiedenistest zelf ook te maken en de resultaten ervan te openbaren?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over examenkandidaten van het Vreewijk Lyceum in Rotterdam die massaal zijn gezakt voor hun examen

MP Van den Hul asked the minister about the high failure rates at the Vreewijk Lyceum in Rotterdam and whether the school's lenient school exams and the inspectorate's oversight were adequate. The minister confirmed the pass rates, said it was too early to draw conclusions, noted the inspectorate had no reason for risk research before, and promised an external evaluation of the inspectorate's handling of the VMBO Maastricht case.
Over the past period there was no reason for the inspectorate to carry out risk research.
Er was de afgelopen periode voor de inspectie geen aanleiding om risico-onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over onderwijs aan hoogbegaafde kinderen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked about parental contributions of thousands of euros for gifted-children programmes, whether these are lawful, funding adequacy, teacher training and oversight of the additional 15 million. The minister answered that voluntary contributions are allowed but admission may not depend on them, that no recent national figures exist, and that a subsidy scheme with evaluation will be introduced.
No recent national figures are available on developments in parental contributions for support for gifted children.
Er zijn op landelijk niveau geen recente cijfers beschikbaar over (ontwikkelingen in) ouderbijdragen voor ondersteuning van hoogbegaafden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de toekomstplannen van de NPO

An MP asked the minister whether the NPO plans to replace the current affairs programme EenVandaag with a soap opera and how this fits the Media Act's public mission and the NPO's investigative journalism plans. The minister answered that no decision has been taken, that entertainment is permitted under the Media Act and the NPO's entertainment policy, and that performance agreements with the NPO will be strengthened.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de dreigende terugloop van het aantal kinderen met een (leer)achterstand in de voorschoolse opvang

An MP asked whether the minister recognises reports that early-childhood education in Rotterdam is losing disadvantaged children due to income-dependent parental contributions after national harmonisation. The minister replied that Rotterdam sees no current drop in participation, a monitoring report shows no national trend, and gemeenten decide their own early-education design, with a commitment to keep monitoring and discuss with municipalities.
The municipality of Rotterdam reports seeing no decline in participation figures at this time.
De gemeente Rotterdam geeft aan op dit moment geen terugloop in de deelnamecijfers te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over de St. Maartenschool te Nijmegen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked about the financial and care arrangements of the St. Maartenschool in Nijmegen, including a loan with municipal guarantees, responsibility between the ministries, and whether parents must arrange care funding themselves. The ministers answered that a process to organise care during school hours is underway with a process facilitator, that municipalities provided a bridging subsidy, and that the government is exploring direct funding for complex cases but this will take time.
In the letter we will send to the House of Representatives on this issue, we will also set out how we can support schools and parents in the meantime.
In de brief die wij over deze problematiek aan de Tweede Kamer zullen sturen, zullen we ook opnemen op welke wijze wij scholen en ouders in de tussentijd kunnen ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Westerveld, Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over het artikel ‘Zó ‘helpt’ de televisie kwetsbare tieners’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the minister for Basic and Secondary Education and Media about an article on a broadcaster's treatment of vulnerable teenagers in a TV programme, including what rules apply and whether NPO governance rules and the NPO ombudsman's remit should be tightened. The minister replied that media freedom and the Mediawet 2008 leave programme content to broadcasters without prior supervision, that BNNVARA's own code applies, and that he will consult the NPO and College van Omroepen on whether duty of care toward participants can be added to governance rules or the ombudsman's remit, reporting to parliament with the 2019 media budget letter.

I will consult with the NPO and the CvO on how careful treatment of programme participants can be part of the codes of conduct, for example through the governance code or the broadcasters' programme statutes, and whether the ombudsman can have a role.

Ik zal met de NPO en het CvO overleggen op welke manier zorgvuldige omgang met deelnemers aan programma's onderdeel kan zijn van de gedragsregels, bijvoorbeeld via de governancecode of de programmastatuten van de omroepen, en of de ombudsman een rol kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rog over de klachten over het centraal eindexamen Frans

An MP asked the minister about complaints over the 2018 central exam in French for havo and vwo, including more texts than German, questions set in French, lack of teacher consultation and correction. The minister, relying on the CvTE, replied that the exam was carefully reviewed and corrected, that the CvTE is working to improve contact with teachers, and that the answers could not be given before the results were published.
The CvTE has promised to accept the texts on this forum as a means of contact with French teachers and to pass the posted texts on to the committee.
Het CvTE heeft beloofd de teksten op dit forum te accepteren als het middel van contact met docenten Frans
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de failliet verklaarde iPadscholen

Written questions from MP Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked whether the iPad schools received preferential treatment in founding, why DUO and the inspectorate allowed funding to continue for months after the school was effectively closed, and whether money could be recovered. The minister denied preferential treatment, explained the inspectorate's investigation timeline and DUO's legally constrained recovery procedure, and said a claim had been filed with the bankruptcy curator, with recovery depending on the bankruptcy.
There is no question of preferential treatment.
Van een voorkeursbehandeling is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het verkopen van tv-series aan video-on-demandbedrijven door de publieke omroep

An MP asked whether the public broadcaster NPO may license older series and documentaries to video-on-demand services, and how this fits the ban on serving commercial third-party interests. The minister answered that a limited, non-exclusive experiment is permitted, that the NPO board and the Commissariaat voor de Media supervise such side activities, and that commercial production for third parties would require Commissariaat approval.
Apart from the specific side-activities test, the prohibition on serving commercial interests also applies in full.
Behalve de specifieke nevenactiviteiten-toets geldt ook het dienstbaarheidsverbod onverkort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over privacyschendingen door Facebook

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether they would confront Facebook over reported privacy breaches, where citizens can complain, whether the Dutch data protection authority is investigating, and whether stricter oversight is warranted. The minister answered that Facebook must comply with privacy law, that the AP handles complaints and has wider powers from 25 May 2018, that an AP investigation concerns another matter while it is in contact with the UK regulator, and that the EU working party has made social media a key priority, and committed to discussing responsibility with Facebook and other providers.
I will engage with Facebook and other providers to remind them once again of their responsibility.
Ik zal met Facebook en andere aanbieders in gesprek gaan om hen nog eens op hun verantwoordelijkheid te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Hul over privacyschendingen door Facebook

MPs Kuiken and Van den Hul asked whether the government would contact Facebook after reports that data of about 89,000 Dutch users reached Cambridge Analytica, how affected users could trace their data, and whether government should inform the public about privacy risks. The minister answered that the Dutch DPA and EU regulators supervise Facebook under the GDPR, that the minister will talk with Facebook about its responsibility, explained the access and erasure rights, and said that the GDPR information duties and government guidance cover the risks.
I will engage in discussion with Facebook and other providers to point them once again to their responsibility.
Ik zal met Facebook en andere aanbieders in gesprek gaan om hen nog eens op hun verantwoordelijkheid te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat de ouderbijdrage in het basis- en voortgezet onderwijs steeds hoger wordt en daardoor de ongelijkheid tussen leerlingen groeit

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked whether voluntary parental contributions in primary and secondary schools have risen sharply, widening inequality, and asked for figures by denomination, region and level. Minister Slob answered that the cited data do not show that rise, that a new Schoolkostenmonitor is due end 2018, that per-denomination and per-region figures are not monitored, and that PO-Raad and VO-raad agreements are expected by year end, with legislation possible if they fail.
If no or unsatisfactory agreements come, I will consider whether it is necessary to amend the law.
Mochten er geen of onbevredigende afspraken komen, dan zal ik bezien of het nodig is de wet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over zij-instromers die binnen een jaar hun lesbevoegdheid halen

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked how a one-year pabo teacher training run by LOI Hogeschool for career changers fits with the regular four-year route and the accreditation and suitability requirements, and how its quality is ensured. The ministers answered that the programme is NVAO-accredited (valid to 2021), is the only such one-year route found, and that the training includes all required outcomes, so teaching requirements are not being compromised.
It is a 240-credit programme. No exemptions are granted.
Het is een opleiding van 240 studiepunten. Er worden geen vrijstellingen verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het arrest van het gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden over de vordering van een gezakte leerling

An MP asked the minister about a Court of Appeal ruling that a failed pupil's civil claim was inadmissible because administrative law remedies applied, and about whether exam correction rules and appeal notices should change. The minister said the Court made no substantive ruling on the exam body's conduct, that the pupil can appeal to the Supreme Court, that no talks with the exam body are planned, and that the exam body lacks legal personality so the State acts as party in civil cases.
Since the pupil was declared inadmissible, the State has no legal means to continue proceedings.
Nu de leerling niet-ontvankelijk was heeft de Staat juridisch geen middelen om verder te procederen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht 'Hoe de digitale halsband van Magister de privacy van schoolkinderen nekt'

An MP asked the education minister about the concentration of the pupil tracking system market, retention periods for pupil data, whether marketing use is excluded under the privacy covenant, US-based hosting by Magister, and whether enforcement and investigation are adequate. The minister answered that no abuse of dominance signals are known, that the privacy covenant bans advertising use, that data is stored on Dutch servers with Akamai services provided in Europe, and that the Dutch data protection authority is responsible for oversight, with the minister promising a monitor report later this year.
It is the role of the Dutch Data Protection Authority to supervise and, where necessary, conduct investigations.
Het is de rol van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens om toezicht te houden en indien nodig onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint, Rudmer Heerema en Van Meenen over het oppotten van geld door schoolbesturen

Four MPs asked the minister whether school boards are hoarding funds, whether a liquidity upper bound of 1.5 is desirable, and related questions on reserves, the Commissie-Don benchmarks, and the inspectorate's oversight. The minister rejected an absolute upper bound, argued that average liquidity is not a causal result of lump-sum funding and that the 'oppotten' label does not fit, and said the inspectorate uses signalling values as detection tools while committing to adjust the framework.
I see no reason to take a different position.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om een ander standpunt in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Aangifte misbruik in joodse school pas na druk minister’

MPs Heerema asked why reporting alleged sexual abuse at a Jewish school took so long, what action is taken against the school board, whether the suspect still works there, and how often schools fail to report abuse. Minister Slob refused to comment on the individual case citing the confidentiality of the inspectorate's trust inspector, but ordered the inspectorate to investigate the board's handling of social safety.
Given the seriousness of the signals and the concerns about the safety and well-being of the pupils, I have asked the inspectorate to investigate social safety and the board's conduct.

Gelet op de ernst van de signalen en de zorgen die bestaan over de veiligheid en het welzijn van de leerlingen, heb ik de inspectie gevraagd onderzoek te doen naar de sociale veiligheid en het handelen van het bestuur daarbij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Kindcentra krijgt 'extra punten' in Den Bosch’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the new admissions policy of a primary school foundation in Den Bosch, which gave extra points to children attending certain childcare centres, was acceptable and whether it creates unfair competition. The minister replied that the policy was adjusted after local debate, that schools may use priority criteria within legal limits, that complaints or court review are available, and that no further action is planned.
In the meantime I have understood that the proposed admissions policy in Den Bosch has been adjusted in response to the local debate.
Ondertussen heb ik begrepen dat het voorgestelde aanmeldbeleid in Den Bosch is aangepast als reactie op het lokale debat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Peters over het bericht 'Kindcentra krijgt ‘extra punten’ in Den Bosch'

Two CDA MPs asked the education minister whether a school admission point system in Den Bosch, which favoured children in certain childcare centres, unduly restricted parental school choice and the level playing field for childcare providers. The minister replied that the policy had already been revised after local debate, that schools may use admission criteria if applied consistently and transparently, and that he saw no reason to instruct school boards further.
I see no reason to do so, see the answers to questions 2, 3 and 4.
