Hier zie ik geen aanleiding toe, zie het antwoord op vragen 2, 3 en 4.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het predicaat Excellente School

An MP asked the minister about the 'Excellente School' label, including criticism that it is confusing, time-consuming and costly, and why most schools do not apply. The minister rejected the criticism, said the process is voluntary and valuable for improvement, gave cost figures, and declined to change or stop the process.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over een financieel nadeel voor docenten die in België wonen en in Nederland hun beroep uitoefenen

Two MPs from D66 asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education whether teachers living in Belgium but working in the Netherlands face a financial disadvantage from double tax-premium coordination, and whether the teacher clause in the Dutch-Belgian tax treaty should be changed. The government confirmed the mismatch under the treaty's two-year residence-state taxation rule, said the Netherlands no longer aims for such clauses, and stated that the issue is being raised in ongoing treaty negotiations with Belgium.
The Netherlands has already raised the issue of the professor clause with the aim of resolving the problem.
Nederland heeft de problematiek met betrekking tot de hooglerarenbepaling al aan de orde gesteld met als doel de genoemde problematiek op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht 'Videodiensten moeten kinderen beschermen tegen gewelddadige porno'

An MP asks the minister whether the Commissariaat voor de Media's view that 16-year-olds' moral development is insufficient means minors are adequately protected from online pornography, and whether the UK Digital Economy Act could serve as an example for mandatory age verification. The minister acknowledges that current Mediawet rules do not yet require protection of minors from harmful content in on-demand services, supports extending Kijkwijzer classification online, and promises to implement the revised AVMD Directive in the Mediawet once adopted.
I therefore support extending the level of protection that NICAM has achieved over recent years with Kijkwijzer for linear services to online media offerings.

Ik ben er dan ook voorstander van dat het beschermingsniveau dat het NICAM de afgelopen jaren met de Kijkwijzer heeft bereikt voor de lineaire diensten doorgetrokken wordt naar het online media-aanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over zij instromers

Two MPs asked the ministers about career-entrant teachers who obtain their teaching qualification within a year, after a TV programme showed trainees teaching alone after five weeks. The ministers replied that career-entrants must qualify within two years under individual support, that the TV programme's one-year course is a separate intensive pabo track where trainees are not fully alone in the classroom, and that they will not weaken teaching standards.
We have no plans to tamper with the requirements of the teaching profession.
Wij hebben geen plannen om te tornen aan de eisen van het leraarschap.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de eerste 100 dagen van het kabinet

An MP asked the government about measures to give teachers and other public-sector professionals more recognition, funding, burn-out figures and a plan against workload and staff shortages. The ministers answered by listing a €720 million structural package, a €237 million workload deal, a guidance brochure and a teacher-shortage action plan, but gave limited detail on other sectors.
For recognition, support and room for professionals in primary education, a structural amount of €720 million has been included in the coalition agreement.
Voor waardering, ondersteuning en ruimte is ten behoeve van de vakmensen in het primair onderwijs een bedrag van structureel € 720 miljoen in het Regeerakkoord opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht dat in Limburg scholen miljoenen aan onderwijsgeld mislopen

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked whether Limburg schools lose millions in disadvantage funding under the current allocation rules and what the minister will do about it. Minister Slob acknowledged problems with the current weighting scheme and administration, said a new CBS-based allocation system is being developed with a target of 2019–2020, and said additional structural funds are being added.
That is why I am currently working on a new allocation system.
Daarom werk ik momenteel aan een nieuwe verdeelsystematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Van Meenen en Westerveld over de begeleiding van leerlingen in en de kwaliteit van het particulier onderwijs

MPs Kwint, Van Meenen and Westerveld asked whether Avatar-related ideas spreading in democratic private schools, paid Avatar courses being advertised at schools, and the lack of stricter inspection and diploma requirements are acceptable. Minister Slob answered that the inspectorate will take the signals into its regular supervision of private schools, that paid services may be offered at schools, that no equalisation of inspection with publicly funded schools is planned, and that the qualification obligation remains important though students may take the state exams or pursue other routes.
The signals will be taken into account by the inspectorate in its supervision.
De signalen zullen door de inspectie worden betrokken in haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de invloed van de fossiele industrie op de inhoud van het onderwijs

An MP asked whether fossil fuel industry involvement, such as Shell teacher training and industry-supplied teaching materials, risks influencing the content of education, and whether industry representatives shape the technology curriculum. The minister answered that schools are responsible for their own sponsorship and material choices under a sponsorship covenant, that curriculum consultation is open to all, and that the government will remind schools of the covenant rules.
The school is responsible for the quality and content of education. This also includes the school's sponsorship policy.
De school is verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en inhoud van het onderwijs. Daaronder valt ook het sponsorbeleid van de school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht 'Ruzie op Geldropse basisscholen, leraren melden zich massaal ziek'

An MP asked the education minister about a dispute at school board 't Nut in Geldrop, where teachers reported sick en masse, including how long the inspectorate knew, whether the supervisory board followed participation rules when appointing an interim board member, and how pupils could return to school. The minister answered that the inspectorate was alerted in April 2017, that the supervisory board did not follow the school participation law by consulting the works council in time, that the inspectorate mediated a resolution on 19 March leading to resignations and interim appointments, and that further investigation would be considered if needed.
The supervisory board did not comply with the School Participation Act (WMS) in this regard.
De raad van toezicht heeft zich daarbij niet gehouden aan de Wet Medezeggenschap Scholen (WMS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Rog over basisscholen die dreigen te verdwijnen uit de Gelderse dorpen Spijk en Lathum

Two MPs asked the minister about primary schools in Spijk and Lathum falling below the municipal closure threshold, and whether the Verenigde Zelfstandige Dorpsscholen experiment could be extended to save them. The minister said the closure decisions rest with the school boards, found no reason to doubt their care, and declined extension because the experiment is for testing a teaching concept, not keeping schools open.
I have no reason to doubt the care taken in the decision-making.
Ik heb geen redenen om te twijfelen aan de zorgvuldigheid van de besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over onderwijs aan vluchtelingenkinderen

An MP asked the education minister whether schools spend many hours obtaining correct information when enrolling refugee children, whether they must repay funds, whether BRON data errors matter, and whether admin procedures hinder access to education. The minister answered that no direct signals were received, that schools face documentation requirements but no repayments are expected after an audit, and that access has not been impeded, while promising a government response to the Onderwijsraad advice.
I have not received any direct signals that primary schools spend a lot of time obtaining the correct information when enrolling refugee children.
Mij hebben geen rechtstreekse signalen bereikt dat basisscholen veel tijd kwijt zijn om de juiste informatie boven tafel te krijgen bij het aanmelden van vluchtelingenkinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over maatschappijprofielen op vwo die niet aansluiten op de universiteit

MP Van den Hul asked whether the finding that vwo students with social-science profiles perform worse than science-profile students in alpha and gamma university programmes should be addressed, and whether social-science subjects could link more to academic research, and what consequences the minister draws for the curriculum development teams. The minister acknowledges the thesis's explanations, says social-science profiles adequately prepare most students, suggests links at school level, and states that curriculum renewal is led by the sector and the teams have been made aware of the thesis, without drawing direct consequences.
For that reason I currently refrain from drawing consequences myself from this thesis.
Daarom zie ik er op dit moment van af om zelf consequenties te verbinden aan dit proefschrift.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat OCW geen standpunt meer inneemt over doorbetalen stakers in het basisonderwijs

MP Kwint (SP) asked why the education ministry takes no position on whether schools should pay striking teachers, and why the minister did not clarify this for school boards. The minister replied that pay during strikes is a matter between employer and employee since primary-education pay has been decentralised, that the law does not require payment, and that he does not wish to appear to endorse paying strikers.
Whether the employer actually pays the salary or not is a matter between employee and employer.
Of de werkgever het salaris daadwerkelijk al dan niet doorbetaalt is een zaak tussen werknemer en werkgever.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht 'Te veel leraren ziek, basisschool moet dicht'

Two MPs asked the minister whether the temporary-contract chain rule under the Wet werk en zekerheid is causing school closures due to teacher sickness, and what options and timelines exist for relief. The minister answered that the chain rule exemption for winter sickness substitutes applies only in January to March, that schools are using many workarounds, and that a statutory fix is planned for 2018 with entry into force by 2020.
The cabinet wants to submit the legislation in the course of 2018.
Het kabinet wil de wetgeving in de loop van 2018 indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Meenen over de begeleiding van leerlingen in en de kwaliteit van het particulier onderwijs

MPs Kwint and Van Meenen asked whether it is acceptable that tutors and therapists recruit clients on private schools, the number of such schools, and the quality of private democratic schools, including a case where a pupil learned nothing for two years. The minister answered that schools must provide necessary support themselves, that paid extra services are permitted, that the Inspectorate monitors quality and can withdraw recognition, and that no further research or legal change is planned.
I have no insight into the number of schools where additional paid services are offered.
Ik heb geen zicht op de hoeveelheid scholen waarop aanvullende betaalde diensten worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul inzake het bericht 'School wilde kinderen weren bij kerstdiner'

An MP asked the minister about a primary school that reportedly barred pupils from its Christmas dinner because parents had not paid the voluntary parental contribution, and whether this pressure was permissible. The minister answered that compulsion is not allowed, that the contribution must be voluntary, and that parents can turn to the school, the works council, the complaints committee or the inspectorate, while declining to take direct action with the school or parents.
No, that is not permissible. A parental contribution is always voluntary.
Nee, dat is niet geoorloofd. Een ouderbijdrage is altijd vrijwillig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld  over het bericht dat ouders steeds meer aan de basisschool betalen

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about rising parental contributions to primary schools for trips and extra activities, unclear voluntariness, exclusion of children, and whether contributions should be capped or limited. The minister answered that schools may only request voluntary contributions, that schools must communicate this clearly, that the parental-consent role in school councils governs amounts, and that new measures will be announced in a letter, but declined to cap contributions.
In my letter on the implementation of the Vermue and Van Dijk motion I state that I am also concerned about the parental contribution, based on the signals I receive.
In mijn brief over de uitvoering van de motie Vermue en Van Dijk geef ik aan dat ik me ook zorgen maak over de ouderbijdrage, op basis van de signalen die ik ontvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de mogelijkheden van mensen met een visuele of auditieve beperking om tv-programma’s te bekijken en zorgwebsites te bezoeken

MP Westerveld asked about audio description on NPO television and accessibility of healthcare websites for blind, visually impaired and deaf users. The minister replies that audio description continues in 2018 and is being evaluated, and that digital accessibility of care websites is a responsibility of care providers, to be addressed through the VN Convention implementation programme.

The Minister of VWS has no insight into which websites are or are not sufficiently accessible and therefore cannot monitor whether patients with a disability have sufficient access to care institutions' websites.

De Minister van VWS heeft geen zicht op welke websites al dan niet voldoende toegankelijk zijn en kan dan ook niet in de gaten houden of patiënten met een beperking voldoende toegang hebben tot websites van zorginstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over uitzendbureaus in het primair onderwijs

An MP asked the minister about education staffing agencies charging high fees to primary schools, zero-hour style contracts and possible government levers. The minister acknowledges the problem and says he will discuss it with the PO-Raad, but states that staffing and contracting are matters for school boards and declines to intervene.
I have no insight into the development of the number of agencies that supply education staff.
Ik heb geen zicht op de ontwikkeling van het aantal bureaus dat onderwijspersoneel aanbiedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de daling van het aantal leerlingen op het vmbo en mbo

An MP asks the education ministers about the decline in vmbo and mbo pupil numbers, the monitoring of havisten entering mbo, implementation of the regeerakkoord measures for vmbo teachers, the status of vmbo-mbo pathway experiments, and ways to improve the esteem of practical education. The ministers answer that the decline is mainly demographic, that havist inflows show no clear increase, that the teacher measures are not in the coalition agreement but teacher training is underway, and that pathway experiments are progressing with a bill planned.
The measures you mention are not in the coalition agreement.
De door u benoemde maatregelen staan niet in het regeerakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over jonge en potentiële leraren die massaal afhaken doordat zij carrièreperspectief, uitdaging en salaris missen

An MP asked the minister how to respond to a Motivaction study showing young and potential teachers leaving or avoiding the profession, and whether existing policy suffices against the teacher shortage. The minister called the study a useful input for circular careers and hybrid teachers, pointed to existing career-changer schemes, retention efforts and cost support, and answered that current policy is sufficient alongside a six-line action plan.
Together with the social partners, teacher training institutions, school boards and municipalities, we are working to reduce the teacher shortage.
Samen met de sociale partners, de lerarenopleidingen, schoolbesturen en gemeenten werken we aan het terugdringen van het lerarentekort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat de oudejaarsconference van BNNVARA subsidie heeft ontvangen

MPs Laan-Geselschap and Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked whether BNNVARA's New Year's Eve cabaret show received subsidy from the CoBO Fund on top of public broadcasting funding, and whether this was justified and transparent. Minister Slob answered that CoBO's contribution comes from the public broadcaster's own programme funds, that the decision is independent, that costs are capped at 20% and that the government committed to annual budget transparency reporting by the NPO.
I have no opinion on the CoBO board's decision to make a contribution to BNNVARA's New Year's Eve conference.
Over het besluit van CoBO om een bijdrage te geven aan de Oudejaarsconference van BNNVARA heb ik geen oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de “mini-subsidies” om werkdruk tegen te gaan

Westerveld (GreenLeft) asked Minister Slob about the proposed small grants of up to €8,000 for 50 primary schools to reduce workload, criticised by education organisations, and about the involvement of teachers, the Staatscourant publication, and the high consultant costs in sample applications. Slob defended the scheme as a first step alongside €430 million structural investment, said teachers were involved through conditions and co-determination, and declined to add the €400,000 or change the scheme.
I will focus on disseminating the good examples and using them in future policy to reduce workload.
Ik zal inzetten op de verspreiding van de goede voorbeelden en het gebruik daarvan in toekomstig beleid om werkdruk te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosman over een taalcommissie van de NOS

An MP from the PVV asked the minister about an NOS language committee that reportedly treats the word 'blank' as negative, asking its mandate, members, decisions and scientific basis, and whether this resembles Orwellian control of language. The minister answered that the NOS follows external spelling guidance and internal style rules, that its language committee is a normal editorial body, that the word question is an editorial matter for the NOS, and that in an open democracy the political sphere should keep distance from such editorial choices.
I am of the view that politics must keep its distance from such editorial choices.
Ik ben van opvatting dat de politiek afstand moet houden van dergelijke redactionele keuzes
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over Amsterdamse ouders die hun kind van de voorschool halen nu die geld kost

An MP asked the minister whether Amsterdam parents are withdrawing children from pre-school now that it costs money, whether middle incomes are affected, whether this occurs elsewhere, and whether it is temporary or structural. The minister answers that about 3 percent of children in large providers have stopped attending due to costs, that municipalities have policy freedom to charge parent contributions, that the effect is expected to be temporary, and that Inspectorate monitoring and a study are planned.
Municipalities have policy freedom to require a parental contribution from parents for pre-school education.
Gemeenten hebben beleidsvrijheid om een eigen bijdrage te vragen van ouders voor voorschoolse educatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over inzake het bericht 'Christelijke scholen hebben geen zin in Wilhelmusplicht'

An MP asked the minister about reports that Christian schools oppose the coalition plan requiring pupils to learn the Wilhelmus, and how that plan would be implemented and when. The minister said the plan will be part of the curriculum revision, with development teams preparing proposals and legislation targeted for 2019 applying to all schools.
The cabinet aims to introduce legislation for an updated curriculum in 2019, based on the proposals of the development teams.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar om – op basis van de voorstellen van de ontwikkelteams – in 2019 te komen met wetgeving voor een geactualiseerd curriculum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het oppotten van geld door schoolbesturen

An MP asked the education minister about school boards accumulating reserves instead of spending education funds, and about the inspectorate's financial thresholds. The minister says the inspectorate does not see structural over-saving, explains reasons for reserves, and rejects mandatory reserve clawbacks while pointing to inspectorate oversight and medezeggenschap involvement.
I disapprove if school boards accumulate money year after year without any reason.
Ik keur het af als schoolbesturen zonder enige reden jaar in jaar uit geld oppotten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Kinderen klunziger’

An MP asked the minister for Primary and Secondary Education about reports that children's motor skills are declining, the effects of this, and whether physical education hours and quality have improved in primary schools. The minister acknowledged the concern, said physical education hours have not increased, and promised additional agreements with the PO-Raad, while placing primary responsibility for children's exercise with parents.
Therefore I will agree additional actions with the PO-Raad to achieve more progress in the coming years.
Daarom ga ik met de PO-Raad aanvullende acties afspreken om de komende jaren meer voortgang te realiseren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de publieke omroep informatie doorgeeft aan adverteerders

An MP asked the minister whether the public broadcaster's app shares viewing data with advertisers without consent, and whether this should stop until users can opt out. The minister answered that the NPO is responsible for its advertising choices within privacy law, that supervision lies with the Commissariaat, ACM and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, and that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is investigating the app, without committing to a new step.
It is the NPO's own responsibility to make considerations and choices within the applicable laws and regulations and to account for them.
Het is de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de NPO om binnen de geldende wet- en regelgeving afwegingen en keuzes te maken en daar verantwoording over af te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over dreigend geweld tegen journalisten

An MP asked the ministers how the government and prosecutors respond to threats against journalists, whether they support a special protection scheme like that for public-task workers, and whether they will meet the prosecution service and the NVJ on an action plan. The government says threats are unacceptable and that talks on journalist protection are ongoing in a steering group, but it considers a scheme like Veilige Publieke Taak hard to realise for journalists.
A protection comparable to the Veilige Publieke Taak programme is, however, difficult to realise.
Een vergelijkbare bescherming zoals het programma Veilige Publieke Taak is echter lastig te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint, Van den Hul en Van Raan over het bericht 'Steeds meer kinderen in 'plofklassen''

MPs from GroenLinks, SP, PvdA and PvdA-adjacent PvdD asked the ministers about reports that more children are in large classes, with questions on class size trends, staffing ratios, teacher workload and passend onderwijs. The minister answered that large-class shares fell in 2017, gave statistics across primary and secondary education, and said no binding class-size targets or sector-wide agreements would be made.
The share of large classes has fallen over the past year.
Het aandeel grote klassen is het afgelopen jaar gedaald.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het artikel in de Telegraaf van 21 december 2017 over honderden oudere leerkrachten die graag nog  voor de klas hadden willen staan, maar die werkloos thu

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education whether older teachers forced into unemployment via settlement agreements contributed to primary-school staff shortages and whether the 2012-era dismissals and policy were sensible. The minister answered that no data exist to verify the claim, that school boards are responsible for staffing decisions, and that measures such as a return-to-work subsidy and a Participatiefonds plan to reintegrate the unemployed teachers are being pursued.
There is no data available on the basis of which this question can be answered.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar op grond waarvan deze vraag kan worden beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat tonnen aan onderwijsgeld verloren gaan

MP Kwint asked whether schools using costly staffing and recruitment agencies to hire teachers, diverting education funds, is desirable, and how many schools do so and why. The minister answered that schools are responsible for staffing, that data on agency use is lacking and is being explored, and that the government is monitoring developments and will raise the matter with the PO-Raad without halting the practice.
There is no data available on the number of school boards that use commercial companies to recruit teachers.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal schoolbesturen dat gebruik maakt van commerciële bedrijven om leraren te werven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Futselaar over het bericht dat middelbare scholen, universiteiten en bedrijven de handen ineens slaan voor het aanpakken van het lerarentekort

MPs Kwint and Futselaar asked about a plan in which secondary schools, universities and Shell jointly retrain surplus Shell staff as teachers, raising questions about funding ties, teacher independence, loyalty and pay. The ministers welcomed the initiative as a way to expand career-changer entry, said Shell only points staff to the option and funds some training costs, and stated that schools set contracts and pay while relying on existing checks.
We rely on the checks and balances built into education regulation, among other things.
Wij vertrouwen op de checks and balances die onder meer door regelgeving in het onderwijs zijn ingebouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over transparantie en reserves bij samenwerkingsverbanden

An MP from GroenLinks asks the minister about transparency and growing reserves at special-education partnerships (samenwerkingsverbanden) and whether the Court of Audit's concerns about tracking passend onderwijs funds are being addressed. The minister answers that a bill requiring online publication of annual accounts is planned for 2018, that a new reporting model is being introduced, and that reserve levels are a local matter to be assessed by the inspectorate rather than capped nationally.
I am currently working on a bill that will ensure that all annual accounts of both schools and partnerships in primary and secondary education must be published online.
Momenteel werk ik aan een wetsvoorstel dat ervoor zorgt dat alle jaarstukken van zowel scholen als samenwerkingsverbanden in het primair en voortgezet onderwijs online moeten worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht van het CBS “Kinderen eten te weinig fruit, groente en vis”

An MP asked the ministers whether the CBS finding that most children eat too little fruit, vegetables and fish is worrying, why lower-educated parents' children eat less healthily, what role government plays in healthy eating, and whether VAT on fruit and vegetables should be reduced. The state secretary acknowledged the concern and the socioeconomic gradient, pointed to Voedingscentrum information, school and childcare programmes and a forthcoming Nationaal Preventieakkoord, defended the National School Breakfast and sponsorship rules, and said the IBO found weaker evidence for price measures on food than on tobacco and alcohol.
I will inform your House about this in more detail.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld inzake het bericht dat op de ene school de helft van de vmbo'ers doorgaat naar de havo en op de andere niemand

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked why some vmbo schools send over half their pupils on to havo while many others send none, and whether schools' fear of dropout and their performance ratings discourage stapelen. The minister attributes differences to school admission policy and transition programmes, says there are no signals of schools refusing pupils for dropout fears, and defends the statutory vmbo-havo right conditional on one extra exam subject.
I have no signals that havo schools refuse pupils solely because they are negatively assessed on dropout.
Ik heb geen signalen dat havo-scholen leerlingen enkel weigeren om de reden dat zij negatief worden afgerekend op uitval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over STER-inkomsten

An SP MP asked why the shortfall in STER advertising revenue and the expected gap in the public broadcaster budget were not raised at the coalition talks, and why the EY reports and the ministry's knowledge of the shortfall were not disclosed sooner. The minister replied that these issues were not discussed at the formation table, that the EY draft reports are internal and not published, that the ministry informed the state secretary and NPO during the study, and that the November media budget letter was the proper moment to inform parliament.
Draft versions are part of the internal process and are not made public.
Conceptversies zijn onderdeel van het interne proces en worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld en Van den Hul inzake het eindrapport van de Taskforce Voortgezet Onderwijs Zeeuws-Vlaanderen 'Gewoon goed onderwijs!'

MPs Kwint, Westerveld and Van den Hul asked the minister about the Zeeuws-Vlaanderen secondary education taskforce report, including OCW's role, the funding of about 3 million euro per year, eligibility for island-school status, passend onderwijs deficits and start groups. The minister answered that schools bear primary responsibility, that OCW funds only mandatory education and will contribute only one-off transition costs, that the schools do not qualify for the island regulation, and that other items fall to other ministries or to the regional partners.
The national government makes no contribution to the structural additional costs.
Het Rijk levert geen bijdrage aan de structurele extra kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over Ster-inkomsten

MP Kwint asked when the falling STER advertising revenues became known at OCW, why the EY report dated 9 September 2017 was not shared, and why the shortfall was absent from the coalition agreement and reported only after the new minister took office. The minister answered that EY's final report was delivered on 5 October 2017, the 9 September date being a planned deadline, that the findings were used in the media budget letter of 17 November 2017, and that no other shortfalls are known.
EY delivered the final report on 5 October last.
Het definitieve rapport heeft EY opgeleverd op 5 oktober jongstleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over regionale samenwerking tussen publieke en private mediabedrijven

The MP asks about the Friesland decision to end a regional media centre combining public broadcaster Omrop Fryslân with a private publisher, and whether the Mediawet blocks such public-private cooperation. The minister answers that EU state-aid rules and the Mediawet's dienstbaarheidsverbod limit such cooperation, that the Commissariaat has issued guidance and will intervene only if the law is breached, and that simply amending Dutch law would not solve the problem.
The Commissariaat recently published a new brochure clearly explaining in which cases cooperation is permitted and under which conditions.
Het Commissariaat heeft onlangs een nieuwe brochure uitgebracht waarin helder wordt uitgelegd in welke gevallen samenwerking is toegestaan, en onder welke voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een Rotterdamse school die zorgleerlingen weert

An MP asked the minister about a Rotterdam school reportedly refusing pupils with disabilities and care needs, including whether trial lessons are used to exclude them and whether the inspectorate will investigate. The minister said the school appears to meet its care duty, explained the legal limits on refusal, noted about 30 inspectorate signals this year, and said the inspectorate is in contact with the school to clarify its practice.
The inspectorate is in contact with the school's management and board. It has been agreed that the current lack of clarity about the practice will be resolved.
De inspectie heeft contact met schoolleiding en bestuur. Afgesproken is dat de huidige onduidelijkheid over de handelwijze wordt weggenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het niet verspreiden van meldingen ten aanzien van ontucht met een minderjarige scholier

An MP asked the minister how the reporting procedure under Article 3 of the Secondary Education Act works after reports of suspected sexual misconduct by a teacher at a Capelle aan den IJssel school, and whether prior reports to the inspectorate should be shared with the school board. The minister declined to discuss the individual case because it is before the courts, explained the duties of the board and the inspectorate's advisory role, and saw no need to change policy.
I cannot go into this case, because it is currently before the court.
Op deze casus kan ik niet ingaan, omdat deze op dit moment onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het artikel ‘Onderwijs raakt in de knel door complexe regelgeving’

An MP asked about complex regulation burdening education, including identical annual reporting rules for small and large institutions, high administrative costs of the Wet normering topinkomens (WNT), its complex transitional rules, and enforcement gaps. The minister answered that rules apply regardless of size for transparency, that administrative costs are being reduced via simplifications and a new audit protocol, and that sanctions such as orders with penalty payments exist.

Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de mogelijk inefficiente uitvoering van de aanpassing van perronhoogtes door ProRail (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

MP Slob asked the minister about ProRail's possibly inefficient raising of platform heights (e.g., Hilversum), noting the 76 cm norm was known earlier and asking about costs, planning and legal changes. The minister answered that the 84 cm standard was lawful until the TSI-PRM took effect in 2008, that cost-efficiency and bundling with other works are being pursued, and that the regulation will be amended in 2011.
I will inform your House more fully about this soon with the Accessibility Update Report 2010.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover binnenkort nader informeren met het Actualisatierapport Toegankelijkheid 2010.

m: Motie van het lid Van Klaveren over het laten ontbinden van stichtingen die geweldpredikers uitnodigen
Asks the government to pursue dissolution of foundations that invite preachers of violence to promote integration.
requests the government, to promote integration, to pursue dissolution of foundations that invite preachers of violence
verzoekt de regering, de integratie te bevorderen door in te zetten op het laten ontbinden van stichtingen die geweldpredikers uitnodigen
Motie van het lid Van Klaveren over beëindiging van de subsidiëring van het bijzonder religieus onderwijs
Asks government to work towards ending state subsidy of special religious education.
Motie van het lid Van Klaveren over het ontnemen van het Nederlanderschap met staatloosheid tot gevolg

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de Turkse regering die campagne voert in Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would act against Turkish ministers campaigning in the Netherlands, including by pressing the Turkish government and preventing municipalities from hosting such events, as Germany had done. The answer refers to a separate letter to the House on the campaign visits and the events around 11 March 2017, rather than answering the questions on substance.
The written questions from MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes ... have been answered by way of the letter 'Campaign visits by Turkish ministers and the events that took place around 11 March 2017'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes ... zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Campagnebezoeken van Turkse ministers en de gebeurtenissen die daaromtrent plaatsvonden rond om 11 maart 2017»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de schoffering van Nederland door de Turkse regering

Two MPs from the Bontes/Van Klaveren group asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about Turkey's alleged insults to the Netherlands, dual nationality and loyalty, expelling the Turkish ambassador, and halting EU accession talks. The government referred to a separate letter on Turkish ministers' campaign visits and did not answer the substantive questions directly.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Van Klaveren en Voordewind over de vluchtelingendeal met Turkije

MPs from several parties asked whether PM Rutte and Chancellor Merkel made a gentlemen's agreement with Turkey to resettle 150,000-250,000 Syrian refugees a year, and whether the government asked Turkey to postpone a visit by Minister Cavusoglu. The government denied any side agreement, pointed to the EU-Turkey statement of 18 March 2016 and ongoing EU resettlement talks, denied any request to postpone the visit, and declined to answer the questions one by one before the requested deadline.
No. Agreements have only been made at European level on resettling Syrian refugees from Turkey.
Antwoord 4 Er zijn enkel in Europees verband afspraken gemaakt over het hervestigen van Syrische vluchtelingen vanuit Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanstaande Hamas-conferentie in Rotterdam

Two MPs asked the Justice and Home Affairs ministers whether a Palestinian conference in Rotterdam organised by the Palestinian Return Centre, alleged to be linked to Hamas, should be stopped, and whether the mayor should be pressed to cancel it. The minister replied that the conference was not established as Hamas-organised, that no threat or legal breach was indicated, that public order lies with the municipality, and that action would follow if laws were broken.
However, from the information known to us it cannot be concluded that the conference in Rotterdam is organised by Hamas, so there is also no reason to exclude the organisation of the conference.

Uit de bij ons bekende informatie kan echter niet geconcludeerd worden dat de conferentie in Rotterdam georganiseerd wordt door Hamas, waardoor er ook geen reden is om de organisatie van de conferentie te weren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de enorme tekorten aan marechaussees op Schiphol

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about the reported shortage of Royal Marechaussee staff at Schiphol and the government's response to warnings that security was at risk. The ministers replied that temporary extra capacity (135 fte) and e-gates will allow minimum performance in 2017, with structural needs to be considered in the 2018 budget and formation options to be proposed.
Together with the airports, the aim is a safe yet swift flow of passengers, and a proper balance between mobility and security is continually sought.
Gezamenlijk met de luchthavens, wordt gestreefd naar een veilige doch snelle doorstroom van passagiers en wordt voortdurend naar een juiste balans tussen «mobiliteit» en veiligheid gezocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een terreur-imam in Eindhoven

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why a Kuwaiti preacher placed on a US terrorism list could speak at an Eindhoven mosque the next day, how the listing procedure works, and why mosques hosting such preachers are not closed or their foundations dissolved. The minister replied that a US sanctions listing alone is not sufficient grounds to bar a speaker, that Dutch listing is an independent procedure, that the high legal bar for dissolving a legal entity under Article 2:20 BW applies, and that measures for visa-required preachers are set out in the Integrated Approach to Jihadism programme.
Listing on the American sanctions list alone is insufficient grounds to refuse a speaker entry.
Vermelding op de Amerikaanse sanctielijst alleen is onvoldoende grond voor het weren van een spreker.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de opgepakte Syriëgangers in Turkije

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether returning jihadists should always be denied entry to the Netherlands, whether the government will explicitly refrain from requesting their extradition from Turkey, and the status of the nationality-revocation bill. The minister replied that the government does not adopt a blanket entry ban but assesses each returnee case by case with arrest, prosecution, multidisciplinary consultation and monitoring, declined to say whether extradition will be requested citing ongoing criminal investigations, and reported that the bill passed the Eerste Kamer plenary on 31 January 2017.
Regarding criminal investigations, the cabinet makes no statements about the instruments the Public Prosecution Service does or does not wish to deploy in that context.
Inzake strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doet het kabinet geen mededelingen over de instrumenten die het OM in het kader daarvan al dan niet wenst in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het verlof van de moordenaar van het meisje van Nulde

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the state will abolish unaccompanied leave for TBS detainees after a murderer of a girl from Nulde was granted such leave, and how the victim's father can be supported. The state secretary answered that leave is carefully phased with multiple assessments and revocation rules, that the government will not abolish unaccompanied leave, and that victims' relatives can use free support from Slachtofferhulp Nederland.
No, TBS treatment is aimed at a responsible and safe return to society.
Nee, de tbs-behandeling is gericht op een verantwoorde en veilige terugkeer in de maatschappij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Van Klaveren en Knops over de wapenopbouw van Hezbollah

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Hezbollah's arms build-up in southern Lebanon, Iranian supply, civilian shielding, and possible Dutch support for Israel and tougher action against Iran. The minister answered that the government cannot verify the reports, condemns any use of civilians as shields, urges Iran to play a constructive role, and says new sanctions against Iran are not currently on the table.
The government has taken note with concern of the media reports but cannot comment on the accuracy of this information.
Het kabinet heeft met zorg kennisgenomen van de berichtgeving in de media maar kan geen uitspraken doen over de juistheid van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanstaande Midden-Oosten conferentie in Parijs

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Israel had lobbied the Netherlands to stay away from the Paris Middle East conference and whether the Netherlands would oppose anti-Israel UN steps. The minister confirmed Israel asked for ministerial non-attendance, said he attended to argue for the two-state solution, and rejected the premise that settlements are Israeli domestic policy.
Israel asked the Netherlands, in a conversation between the National Security Council and the Dutch ambassador in Tel Aviv, not to take part at ministerial level in the Paris conference.
Israël heeft Nederland in een gesprek tussen de National Security Council en de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Tel Aviv verzocht niet op ministerieel niveau deel te nemen aan de conferentie in Parijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het Meldpunt Discriminatie Internet (MiND) dat stelt gewelddadige homohaat mag op grond van de islam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether MiND (Meldpunt Discriminatie Internet) was right to say that violent anti-gay hatred based on Islam is not discrimination, and whether it should be subsidised. The Minister acknowledged a serious error by MiND, which has apologised and had the posts removed, but said the Public Prosecution Service is the body that judges criminal conduct and that he will talk with MiND without ending the subsidy for now.
MiND's response to the posts submitted to them was a serious error.
De reactie van MiND op de aan hen voorgelegde uitingen was een ernstige fout.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de terreurdreiging van een synagoge

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a terrorist threat to a synagogue in Amsterdam, the removal of police posts from Jewish sites, and whether the municipality should keep police posts alongside camera surveillance. The minister answered that current protective measures match the threat, that consultation with the Jewish community has occurred, and that Amsterdam chose camera surveillance as a more effective and efficient option within a broader package, declining to detail that package for security reasons.
For security reasons, I will not comment on the further content of this package.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik over de verdere inhoud van dit pakket geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de geheime moskeelijst van het kabinet

Two MPs asked whether a list of mosques and Islamic organisations receiving Saudi funding exists, why parliament was allegedly misinformed, and whether anything is being withheld. The government refers to earlier answers on the matter, says there is nothing further it is withholding, and states that the overview was shared confidentially with parliament.
The cabinet has shared the relevant overview with your House on a confidential basis.
Het kabinet heeft het betreffende overzicht vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over terreursteun voor Rotterdamse salafistenschool

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a Qatari charity linked to terrorism financed a Rotterdam salafist school, whether its foundations should be dissolved, and whether salafist schools and foreign funding should be banned. Minister Plasterk answered that the property was bought with Qatari funds but that the organisation is not on Dutch, EU or UN sanctions lists, that dissolution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, and that the government will address foreign funding in a letter in November.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether there are facts and circumstances that give cause to file a request with the court for civil prohibition or dissolution under art. 2:20 BW.

Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of er feiten en omstandigheden aanwezig zijn die aanleiding vormen om een verzoek tot civielrechtelijke verbodenverklaring of ontbinding ex art. 2:20 BW bij de rechtbank in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het stoppen van ontwikkelingshulp aan de Palestijnse Autoriteit

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government shares concerns that the Palestinian Authority and other Palestinian organisations still receive Dutch and EU funds despite alleged terrorism links, and whether it will stop subsidising antisemitic and anti-Israeli organisations as the UK did. The minister denied any facilitation of terrorism, said the PA should do more to condemn violence and pressed this point, and stated the government will not fund organisations that make antisemitic statements or glorify terror.
There is no question of the Palestinian Authority or other Palestinian organisations supported by the Netherlands or the EU facilitating terrorism.
Er is geen sprake van faciliteren van terrorisme door de Palestijnse Autoriteit of andere door Nederland of de EU gesteunde Palestijnse organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over discriminatie van autochtonen door een Haagse wethouder

Two MPs asked the ministers whether a The Hague alderman's plan to give preference to candidates of migrant background in hiring, when equally qualified, amounts to discrimination against natives and whether the alderman should be called to account. The minister answered that such preferential policy is permitted under strict conditions of the Algemene wet gelijke behandeling, that municipalities bear their own responsibility, and that he sees no reason to intervene for now, while promising to inform the House on follow-up action after an anti-discrimination monitor.
A municipality has in principle its own responsibility, and the municipal executive must account for this to the municipal council.
Een gemeente heeft in beginsel een eigen verantwoordelijkheid en het gemeentebestuur dient hierover rekenschap te geven aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Lespakketten over Zwarte Piet

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a municipality (Maassluis) was distributing controversial lesson packs on Zwarte Piet to primary schools, including a quiz with racist-tinged questions, and whether the mayor should be urged to stop. The state secretary replied that the municipality only helped connect schools with an outside foundation, that schools decide their own teaching materials, that the government takes no position on the origins of Piet, and that it would not intervene.
No lesson packs are distributed to primary schools from the municipality of Maassluis.
Vanuit de gemeente Maassluis worden geen lespakketten onder basisscholen verspreid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes inzake een nieuw formaldehydelek

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary about a new formaldehyde leak at a DuPont plant, whether Chemours failed to report it to municipalities, and why detectors allegedly did not alarm the regional service. The State Secretary answered that the company was only obliged to report to the province, that detectors did register a raised value on 10 August, and that the province imposed an order under penalty and stricter inspections.
There is no legal obligation for the company to report to other authorities.
Er bestaat voor het bedrijf geen wettelijke plicht tot het melden bij andere overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Dijkgraaf, Visser, Geurts, Graus, Bruins, Van Klaveren en Van Vliet over het bericht dat een groot deel van de Noordzee nauwelijks bevist wordt

MPs asked the minister whether the finding that nearly 40% of the North Sea is barely fished changes the government's commitment to closing 10% of Dutch waters to bottom-trawling and the proposed extra closures on the Friese Front and Centrale Oestergronden. The minister answered that the study does not address protected ecological areas, which is the focus of the Dutch ambition, that the proposal remains a valid implementation of the 10-15% goal, and that she will inform parliament on how the Bisschop motion is executed, but could not answer before the committee meeting.
Soon I will, on behalf of the State Secretary for Economic Affairs as well, inform your House how I have executed the Bisschop motion.
Binnenkort zal ik, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, uw Kamer informeren hoe ik de motie Bisschop heb uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over doodsbedreigingen aan adres Nederturken door Erdogan-aanhangers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the ministers about threats, boycott lists and demonstrations by Erdogan supporters against critical Turkish-Dutch people, and about foreign influence via Diyanet. The government condemns intimidation and refers to earlier letters, says foreign funding of mosques is not banned but is watched for undue influence, and states that Turkish-Dutch integration is a concern to be discussed with communities.
The Netherlands has no ban on foreign financing of mosque associations, general religious associations or institutions.
Nederland kent geen verbod op buitenlandse financiering van moskeeverenigingen, algemene religieuze verenigingen of instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een Erdogan-informant bij de politie

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether police data on victims of threats linked to criticism of Erdogan was leaked to Erdogan supporters, how many such cases exist, what measures will protect victims, and whether the situation undermines the rule of law. The Minister said leaks are unacceptable, an investigation into the reported case is ongoing so no conclusions can be drawn, no similar reports are known, and any officer can take a complaint regardless of background.
If there are reasons to assume this is the case, an investigation will be launched.
Indien er redenen zijn om aan te nemen dat hier sprake van is, wordt een onderzoek ingesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Recourt, Van Nispen, Van Tongeren, Thieme, Van Klaveren, Krol, Houwers en Klein over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten

MPs asked the ministers about a 14 July 2014 letter from a Dutch liaison officer in Thailand requesting that Thai authorities open their own investigation into Van Laarhoven, and whether the Dutch government bears responsibility for his Thai prosecution. The minister answered that the request was made at the public prosecutor's request to speed up mutual legal assistance, that the courts found the state's conduct lawful, that consular assistance is provided, and that the prosecutor decides on instruments such as a transfer.
In general, cooperation with foreign authorities is not unusual when a suspect is located in another country.
In zijn algemeenheid is het niet ongebruikelijk dat samenwerking plaatsvindt met buitenlandse autoriteiten indien een verdachte zich in een ander land bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over "leenhelmen" voor militairen

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Defence Minister about reports that soldiers on missions must share helmets, and about shortages of equipment and ammunition, asking whether every soldier will get a helmet and whether the 2% NATO spending target will be met. The minister answered that 22,500 new helmets are being bought, 18,000 for operational personnel and 4,500 for a central pool, that equipment is issued on a need-to-have basis, that ammunition stocks are being raised, and that the government is taking steps toward the NATO spending commitment.
Defence is therefore purchasing 22,500 new helmets, of which 18,000 will be issued to military personnel with an operational function.
Defensie schaft daarom 22.500 nieuwe helmen aan, waarvan 18.000 worden verstrekt aan militairen met een operationele functie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Klaveren over de verstoring van een Israëlkraam in een Jumbo supermarkt

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Van Klaveren asked the ministers whether an online protest campaign against an Israeli product display in a Jumbo supermarket in Krimpen aan den IJssel was undesirable, and what the government would do to protect supermarkets and staff from intimidation. The minister answered that such actions fall under freedom of expression, that criminal law applies to threats or intimidation, that no signals of disruption of public order were received, and that no extra measures against protest campaigns are needed.
I therefore see no reason to take additional measures against protest campaigns.
Ik zie derhalve geen reden om extra maatregelen te nemen tegen protestcampagnes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het Turkse dreigement de vluchtelingendeal op te blazen

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the government would yield to Turkey's threat to end the refugee deal unless visa liberalisation for Turks is granted by October, and whether the deal was wise given Turkey's authoritarian turn. The minister answered that government visa policy is unchanged (visa-free travel only once all roadmap benchmarks are met), that the deal is needed to manage migration, that criticism of Turkey's post-coup developments stands, and that pre-accession aid would be cut and the death penalty is a red line if the rule of law deteriorates further.

Government visa liberalisation policy remains unchanged: only when Turkey meets all benchmarks of the Roadmap for visa liberalisation can the Netherlands agree to visa-free travel for Turkish citizens.

Het kabinetsbeleid ten aanzien van visumliberalisatie blijft onveranderd: enkel wanneer Turkije aan alle benchmarks van de Roadmap visumliberalisatie voldoet, kan Nederland instemmen met het invoeren van visumvrijheid voor Turkse burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de intimidatie en doodsbedreiging aan het adres van een homostel

Two MPs asked the ministers about intimidation and death threats against a gay couple in Amsterdam, including whether police advised them not to file a complaint and whether non-Western minorities are overrepresented in anti-gay violence. The minister condemned the threats, said police encouraged mediation but that a discrimination complaint should always be recorded, rejected the statistical framing, and pointed to existing action plans and a planned protocol with partners.
A complaint of discrimination must always be recorded under the Discrimination Directive.
Een aangifte van discriminatie dient volgens de Aanwijzing Discriminatie altijd opgenomen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de noodzaak om NAVO-kernwapens weg te halen uit Turkije

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the government shares concern about NATO nuclear weapons stored at Incirlik in Turkey, whether they should be removed, and whether Turkey should be expelled from NATO after the post-coup crackdown. The ministers declined to confirm locations or numbers of nuclear weapons, stated that Turkey's NATO membership is not under discussion, and said the Netherlands will keep urging Turkey to respect the rule of law.
Based on alliance and legally binding agreements, no statements are made about the locations and numbers per location of these nuclear weapons in Europe.
Op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken worden geen mededelingen gedaan over locaties en aantallen per locatie van deze kernwapens in Europa.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Lodders, Graus, Dik-Faber, Dijkgraaf,  Van Klaveren en Houwers over het bericht van Cumela om voor 24 augustus 2016 duidelijkheid te geven over het verzoek van Cumela voor uitstel

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs to clarify before 24 August 2016 whether he would postpone the manure spreading ban, as requested by the trade association Cumela. The State Secretary answered that he had asked the Technical Committee Soil for advice on a possible exemption under the Soil Protection Act, expected to decide within the week and communicate it promptly.
I expect this advice to be received shortly and will then decide on an exemption.
Ik verwacht dit advies op korte termijn te ontvangen en zal daarna besluiten over een vrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over antisemitische bedreiging na tonen Israëlische vlag

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether they recognise that Jewish citizens are threatened for displaying an Israeli flag, whether they share concern about rising antisemitism and its causes, and what measures the government will take. The minister says such threats are unacceptable, cites research linking Middle East tensions to antisemitism, and points to the existing National Action Programme against Discrimination, with a progress report promised for early 2017.
The cabinet takes the feelings of fear and unease within the Jewish community seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de gevoelens van angst en onbehagen binnen de joodse gemeenschap serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Italiaanse banken en “plannen” voor een EU-noodpakket van 150 miljard euro

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports of a proposed EU 150 billion euro rescue package for Italian banks, Italy's high non-performing loan rate, and whether Italy could be allowed exceptions to EU rules or leave the eurozone. The minister replied that no EU rescue package is planned, that bank problems must be solved by banks first under the banking union bail-in rules, that no exceptions to EU rules will be made, and that leaving the eurozone is not a solution.
There are no European plans for such an EU rescue package, and as far as I am concerned there will not be one.
Er zijn geen Europese plannen voor een dergelijk EU-noodpakket en wat mij betreft komt dat er ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over busterreur in Almere

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked why bus service in Almere was halted after stone-throwing attacks by youths, why no arrests were made, and whether the mayor should adopt zero tolerance. The Minister of Justice replied that service was halted only for hours, that about ten incidents are under investigation with some arrests, that the OM and police have national enforcement agreements, and that enforcement of public order is primarily the mayor's responsibility.
As the investigation into these various incidents is still ongoing, I cannot currently provide further substantive information on this.
Nu het onderzoek naar deze diverse incidenten nog loopt, kan ik hier op dit moment geen verdere inhoudelijke mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bezoek van een antisemitische geweldsimam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a preacher with antisemitic violent rhetoric would speak in the Netherlands and why he was not barred, and urged dissolving the inviting organisation. The minister said there was no confirmation of a Dutch appearance, declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to visa and entry-refusal tools and the courts' power to dissolve organisations, and considered current practice consistent with the Bontes motion.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de plannen om mensen met zware schulden geen rekeningen te laten betalen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the proposed Breed Moratorium (blanket debt-collection pause) for heavily indebted people unfairly harms creditors and encourages payment laxity. The State Secretary replied that the moratorium only suspends collection, not repayment, is reserved for exceptional cases, and requires the debtor to make efforts to repay.
The moratorium does not suspend the repayment of debts, only the collection.
Het Moratorium schort niet het afbetalen van schulden op, maar enkel de incasso.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Krol en Van Klaveren over "het behandelvoorbehoud op het EU-voorstel inzake bedrijfspensioenfondsen"

MPs Omtzigt, Krol and Van Klaveren asked whether the government would present the negotiated text on the EU occupational pensions (IORP) directive in time for Parliament to instruct its voting position, and by when. The State Secretary replied that the consolidated negotiation text was sent to Parliament on 24 June and made available via the Council extranet, that COREPER would discuss it on 30 June, and that Parliament could still state its view before the Council decision.
The consolidated text of the negotiation result will be submitted to COREPER
De geconsolideerde tekst van het onderhandelingsresultaat zal worden voorgelegd aan COREPER
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de enorme prijsstijgingen als gevolg van directe en indirecte belastingverhogingen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about price rises caused by tax increases, the link to stagnating purchasing power, and whether to cut VAT, excise and corporate tax or introduce a flat tax. The government denied purchasing power has stagnated, pointed to a EUR 5 billion labour tax cut, and rejected the flat tax and the broad tax cuts as budget-costly and distributionally unbalanced.
These burden-increasing measures were at the time necessary to restore public finances to order.
Deze lastenverzwarende maatregelen waren destijds noodzakelijk om de overheidsfinanciën weer op orde te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht 'Samenscholingsverbod na 'Marokkaanse' onlusten in Ede'

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a ban on gatherings after riots in Ede, the arrests made, and whether Moroccan youth over-representation in crime and military-style discipline should be pursued. The government answered that 10 suspects were arrested and released, that youth crime risk factors are social and spatial rather than ethnic, and that it does not support military discipline, favouring tailored interventions.

So far 10 suspects have been arrested for violating the gathering ban, resisting officers, insult, failure to obey an official order, deliberately violating the area ban, violating the Identification Act, rowdiness, or a combination of these offences.

Er zijn tot nu toe 10 verdachten aangehouden voor respectievelijk overtreding van het samenscholingsverbod, wederspannigheid, belediging, niet voldoen aan een ambtelijk bevel, het opzettelijk overtreden van het gebiedsverbod, overtreding van de Wet op de Identificatieplicht, baldadigheid of voor een combinatie van deze feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het inroepen van hulp van de Marokkaanse consul bij rellen Ede

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether calling in the Moroccan consul to restore order among rioting youths in Ede undermined Dutch authority, and what the government would do to restore order. The minister replied that the consul only sought talks at the mayor's request, that Dutch authorities alone hold authority, and that maintaining public order is a local responsibility with no further central measures announced.
Maintaining public order is a local responsibility.
Het handhaven van de openbare orde is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een verbod op de anti-Israëlische Boycot, Desinvestering en Sancties (BDS)-beweging

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether publicly funded bodies should be banned from boycotting Israeli products, whether the ANBI status of BDS-linked organisations such as docP should be revoked, and about reported supermarket patrols. The minister answered that consumers may investigate product origins, that ANBI status is granted and revoked only by the Tax Authority under neutral criteria, and that no ban on boycotts is planned.
The cabinet has no power to revoke a granted ANBI status.
Het kabinet heeft geen bevoegdheid om een verleende ANBI-status in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een gesubsidieerd haatfeest

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether The Hague municipality sponsors a Ramadan festival that allegedly features gender segregation and glorification of terrorists, and whether the government will stop such support or cut the municipal fund. The minister answered that The Hague gave no sponsorship or other support to the event, that the municipality has a policy of not subsidising religious gatherings, that subsidy decisions are a local matter, and that cutting the municipal fund is not possible.
Furthermore, the decision whether or not to subsidise initiatives is a local matter.
Voorts is het zo dat de afweging om wel of niet over te gaan tot het subsidiëren van initiatieven een lokale aangelegenheid is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een Nederlandse die vast zat in Qatar

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware that a Dutch woman had been detained in Qatar since March after reporting being raped, why she remained in custody, what had been done to bring her home, and whether the Qatari ambassador would be summoned. The minister referred to his answers to earlier written questions on the same case without restating substance in this document.
See my answers to the written questions from MPs Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Grashoff and Sjoerdsma on the arrest of a Dutch woman in Qatar.
Zie mijn antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Knops, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Grashoff en Sjoerdsma
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een jihad-prediker naar de As Soennah moskee

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a Belgian imam who allegedly preaches violent jihad could speak at the As Soennah mosque in The Hague, and whether the mosque should be closed or dissolved and the municipality should stop cooperating with it. The minister answered that the imam showed no incitement to violence, that as an EU national he cannot be barred, that the prosecutor has seen no grounds to seek dissolution, and that cooperation with the mosque is a municipal matter.
Based on the facts and circumstances, the prosecution service has so far seen no reason to ask the court to close a mosque.
Op basis van feiten en omstandigheden heeft het OM tot op heden geen aanleiding gezien om de rechter te verzoeken een moskee te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Vrij reizen voor veteranen op Veteranendag

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether free travel for veterans on Veteranendag could be extended to active veterans, and whether the government shares the view that veterans deserve more open recognition. The Minister of Defence answered that the 76 percent public support for veteran recognition is noted, that recognition policy is already in place, and that active veterans can already claim travel costs to veteran events.
Veterans in active service already have that option. They can claim travel to veterans' events.
Veteranen in werkelijke dienst hebben die mogelijkheid al. Zij kunnen reizen naar veteranenevenementen declareren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over €10.000 aan shoptegoed voor asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why refugee families in Oisterwijk receive EUR 10,000 in shopping credit from the municipality without repayment, whether a national guideline with lower costs and loans should be set, and whether Australian-style regional-only reception should be adopted. The State Secretary answered that individual special assistance is a municipal competence accountable to the municipal council, the ministry has no overview of municipalities above EUR 2,000, and regional reception is part of the cabinet's migration approach.
The granting of special assistance is decentralised both in policy and financially to the mayors and aldermen (colleges of B&W).
De verlening van bijzondere bijstand is zowel beleidsmatig als financieel gedecentraliseerd aan de colleges van burgemeester en wethouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bezoek van een terreurprediker aan een moskee in Boskoop

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a controversial imam speaking at a mosque in Boskoop and whether such preachers should be barred, mosques closed, or ANBI status withdrawn. The minister said the cleric is Belgian and EU free-movement rules limit exclusion, that the government opposes intolerant speakers and will act on criminal conduct, and that no mosque closure or ANBI revocation was warranted so far, while noting the mayor's response.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het miljoenenoverschot bij gemeenten op het zorgbudget

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that many municipalities underspent their social domain care budgets, questioning how this fits with unmet care needs, whether the funds should be earmarked, and whether municipal tendering harms care recipients. The state secretary answered that the 2015 figures are too early to draw conclusions, that underspending may be reserved for future costs, that earmarking was deliberately not adopted, that no evidence shows municipalities harming care users, and promised a proposal on responsible market conduct and a qualitative study on care avoidance.
At the time, the decision not to earmark was deliberately made.
Destijds is bewust gekozen voor het niet oormerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat de verdachte van de liquidatie in IJsselstein op voorwaarden vrij was

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked how a suspect in an IJsselstein killing could evade reclassering supervision while on conditional release, and whether TBS and PIJ leave should be abolished. The state secretary said supervision was carried out properly according to the Inspectie, and defended PIJ and TBS leave as necessary for resocialisation, declining to abolish it.
Because this is an individual case, I cannot go into the arrangement of the supervision in this specific case.
Omdat het een individuele casus betreft kan ik niet ingaan op de invulling van het toezicht in dit specifieke geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de zorgelijke financiële positie van veel gepensioneerden

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Secretary of State whether the financial position of middle-income pensioners, who miss out on many allowances, has worsened, whether pensions should be compensated for non-indexation, and whether the mandatory pension system unduly restricts members' freedom to safeguard accrued pensions. The Secretary of State acknowledged pressure on older people's incomes, pointed to CBS and CPB figures showing improvement and a 2016 purchasing-power rise for most older people, and defended compulsory pension participation as a core feature of the system.
Any imbalances in the purchasing-power picture for next year will be considered in the August budget decision-making.
Eventuele onevenwichtigheden in het koopkrachtbeeld voor volgend jaar zullen in de augustusbesluitvorming worden bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de passieve rol van de Nederlandse overheid ten tijde van de jodenvervolging

Two MPs asked the Prime Minister whether the Dutch government should give fuller expression to commemoration of WWII, how it judges the Dutch government-in-exile's inaction on reports of Jewish deaths and deportations, and why the Netherlands has never apologised for its passive role in the persecution of Jews. The government answered briefly, pointing to commemorations, to publications and an independent institute as the proper domain of historiography, to Queen Beatrix's 1995 speech to the Knesset, and to earlier condemnations of antisemitism; it did not apologise.
The assessment of publications on these subjects belongs to the domain of science and society.
De beoordeling van publicaties over deze onderwerpen behoren tot het domein van wetenschap en samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het initiatief van het Europees Parlement om Turks toe te voegen als officiële EU-taal

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the Netherlands, as Council presidency, received a Cypriot request to add Turkish as an EU official language, and urged rejection given Turkey's human rights record. The minister confirmed the Cypriot request is linked to Cyprus reunification preparations, that its scope is unclear, that treaty change would require all member states' consent, and that the Netherlands will stay in contact with Cyprus and the Commission on it.
The request is not related to the EU accession negotiations with Turkey.
Het verzoek houdt geen verband met de EU-toetredingsonderhandelingen met Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de oproep van het Turkse consulaat in Nederland om beledigingen van Erdogan te melden

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Turkish consulate in Rotterdam was right to call on Turkish organisations in the Netherlands to report insults of Erdogan, and how the government would respond. The answer is a cross-reference to a letter on a related request from MP Karabulut, so the substance of the government's position is not set out in this document.
The written questions from MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes, question number 2016Z08377, have been answered by means of the letter
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes (beiden Groep Bontes/Van Klaveren), vraagnummer 2016Z08377 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de grote bezwaren tegen de komst van honderden extra asielzoekers naar Maastricht

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about strong local objections to hundreds of extra asylum seekers in Maastricht and whether municipalities should hold referendums before asylum centres are opened. The State Secretary confirmed the numbers, described local consultation and information evenings, and said regional reception remains a key principle while international obligations still apply.
The municipal government decides on the arrival of an asylum centre.
Het gemeentebestuur besluit over de komst van een asielzoekerscentrum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een door de school in de steek gelaten geïntimideerde homo-leerling

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a gay pupil was moved out of class after bullying and whether the school yielded to homophobia, and what the minister will do. The minister denies the reported framing, says the placement was pedagogical and not a punishment, cites the school safety law, sexuality curricula and an ongoing inspectorate study, and calls the asylum comparison inapt.
