In general terms I believe victims should not be relocated, but perpetrators should be punished.
In algemene zin ben ik van mening dat slachtoffers niet herplaats moeten worden, maar daders gestraft moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over aanwezigheid van de minister president in het buitenland terwijl in Nederland grote onrust heerst

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Prime Minister why he was abroad on an economic mission to Atlanta during the 2015 asylum unrest in the Netherlands and whether he would cut short his trip and refrain from further travel. Rutte replied that the mission served Dutch interests, that he stayed in contact with ministers at home, particularly on asylum, and that return was unnecessary; he did not name a maximum number of asylum seekers and referred to earlier letters and debates.
Modern communication allows us to stay in permanent contact with each other, so returning to the Netherlands was not necessary.
Moderne communicatie stelt ons in staat permanent met elkaar in contact te staan, waardoor terugkeer naar Nederland niet noodzakelijk was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Nederlandse subsidie voor antisemitisme- en terreurverheerlijking

Two Dutch MPs asked whether the government funds the Palestinian NGO RWDS, which held events honouring a terrorist, and whether it will stop indirect subsidies to organisations promoting antisemitism and terrorism. The minister confirmed past funding of RWDS (about 460,000 euro and 104,852 euro via Oxfam Novib), denied any support for the event, and said the government will not fund such organisations and will suspend or end grants if subsidy conditions are breached, though it did not commit to a specific new stop or the requested EU/UN initiative.
If, however, it is established that an organisation has breached the subsidy conditions, measures will be taken, including suspending or ending the contribution.

Indien evenwel geconstateerd wordt dat er sprake is van schending van de subsidievoorwaarden door een organisatie, zullen maatregelen worden getroffen, waarbij het opschorten of beëindigen van de bijdrage tot de mogelijkheden behoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de zwakke beveiliging van de Nederlandse kerncentrales tegen terrorisme

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the weak protection of Dutch nuclear power plants against terrorism, with only unarmed guards, is acceptable, and whether the government will follow US experts' advice to station armed teams on site. The minister answered that protection meets national and international rules, threat levels are monitored, no concrete threat information exists, and the government will not change its approach without concrete threat intelligence.
No substantive information is provided about specific security measures.
Over specifieke beveiligingsmaatregelen worden verder geen inhoudelijke mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over ‘de aantasting van de pensioenen’

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether ECB policy threatens pensions, whether rate windfalls on state debt could fund AOW or pension compensation, and whether the mandatory supplementary pension should be replaced by an opt-out. The government said it is in talks with social partners, DNB and others and will send a DNB report in May, declined to make theoretical windfall calculations, would consider pensioners in the purchasing-power decisions, and kept mandatory pension participation while planning a differentiated approach to be sent to parliament before summer.
In May the cabinet will send the DNB report with an assessment of the figures to your House.
In mei stuurt het kabinet de rapportage van DNB met een appreciatie van het cijferbeeld naar uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over politiebezoek na een tweet over juichende leerlingen vanwege aanslagen België (Herdruk)

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether police visits to a Breda resident after a tweet about students cheering the Brussels attacks were intimidating, what the police meant by a quoted remark, and what the government thought of cheering students. The minister said wijkagents may judge such conversations part of normal policing under local authority responsibility, that the quoted remark was not used by police, and that teachers should be equipped to handle such reactions.
I therefore see no reason to change the police's approach on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om de werkwijze van de politie op dit punt te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het verminderde aantal verkiezingsborden voor het referendum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why a January 2016 ministry circular told municipalities that election boards were unnecessary for the referendum, in contrast to the 2005 campaign that used A2 posters on election boards. Minister Plasterk answered that extra funds were used in 2005 at parliament's request, that information for this referendum is now provided via a digital toolkit, abri posters, newspaper ads and websites, and that the government will not deploy extra funds to get municipalities to place boards, though municipalities may do so.
The cabinet is not deploying extra funds to encourage municipalities to place election boards.
Het kabinet zet geen extra middelen in om gemeenten ertoe te bewegen verkiezingsborden te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over niet (tijdig) verstuurde stempassen voor het referendum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether voting passes for the 6 April 2016 referendum were sent late to voters in several municipalities, and what measures would ensure voters receive them. Minister Plasterk answered that the deadline was 23 March, that passes were sent in time in the named municipalities, that individual non-receipt can occur and is handled by reissue on request, and that no late dispatches are known so no measures are planned.
Enquiries have informed me that the voting passes in each of the named municipalities were sent before this deadline.
Navraag heeft mij geleerd dat de stempassen in elk van de genoemde gemeenten vóór deze deadline zijn verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het antisemitische motief van een extreem gewelddadige overval

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a violent robbery of an elderly Jewish couple with alleged antisemitic motive, including whether the Public Prosecution Service withheld the antisemitic aspect from a TV appeal. The minister said the investigation covers all aspects including discrimination, declined to discuss ongoing investigative details, explained that appeal content was limited to verified information, and listed prevention measures against antisemitism without addressing the withholding question substantively.
Since this is an ongoing investigation, I cannot provide further information on the content of the investigation.
Aangezien het een lopend onderzoek betreft kan ik over de inhoud van het onderzoek geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over plannen om het referendum te verstoren

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Interior and Foreign Ministers about reports of plans to disrupt the Dutch referendum on the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement through intimidation and other pressure, and whether these threats are serious. Minister Plasterk answered that reports are investigated by relevant bodies and security measures taken where risk warrants, noting Ukrainian authorities say the documents are forged and referring to a separate answer on militia threats.
Reports of possible attempts to disrupt the referendum are investigated by the relevant authorities where necessary.
Meldingen van mogelijke pogingen om het referendum te verstoren, worden waar nodig onderzocht door de relevante instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over groeiende Turkse staatscensuur

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the government knows of the Turkish state takeover of a critical newspaper, shares concern over intensifying censorship, and whether it will press Turkey on press freedom and oppose its EU membership. The minister confirmed the reports and concern, said the Netherlands raises press freedom bilaterally and in the EU, and opposed the view that Turkey should never join the EU, preferring accession talks as the framework for reform.
The Netherlands therefore continues to proactively raise press freedom with Turkey, bilaterally and within the EU.
Nederland blijft Turkije daarom proactief aanspreken op persvrijheid, bilateraal en in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de financiële puinhoop in Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Interior about the financial mess in Amsterdam and whether it warranted measures, and whether Deputy PM Asscher could responsibly manage the SZW budget. The minister said the municipal council and provincial supervisors must judge Amsterdam's finances, that the city is financially sound, and that the Tweede Kamer assesses ministerial spending through the annual accountability process.
It is up to the Amsterdam municipal council to pass judgment on this.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad van Amsterdam om hierover een oordeel uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de doodsbedreigingen aan het adres van een anti-IS-strijder

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Justice Minister about death threats against Jitse Akse, a Dutch anti-IS fighter who is under criminal investigation, and whether the government would instruct the prosecutor to drop the case. The minister condemned threats, said protective measures are not disclosed, and stated the prosecution decision is for the Openbaar Ministerie without a directive.
The investigation by the Openbaar Ministerie into Jitse A. is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie naar Jitse A. loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanhoudende bedreigingen door een militie uit Oekraïne in verband met het referendum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a threatening video from a Ukrainian militia against the Dutch public in connection with the referendum is authentic, whether earlier threats were investigated, and whether security measures will be taken, including for referendum initiators. The minister answered that the Ukrainian government and the Azov battalion distance themselves from the threats, the videos are known to Dutch investigative authorities, and security measures would be taken under local authority if the threat warrants it.
The videos are known to the Dutch investigative authorities.
De filmpjes zijn bekend bij de Nederlandse opsporingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de Franse dreiging om de content van een Nederlandse website te censureren

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether France's threat to block content of the Dutch website TPO.nl, and possible censorship, is compatible with freedom of expression and how the Netherlands would respond. The Minister answered that such requests are specific, that member states implement EU counter-radicalisation commitments under their own law, that the Netherlands uses notice-and-take-action procedures and stresses rule-of-law limits, and that the Turkish YouTube case differs because the French request is targeted and providers can go to French courts.
The specific request referred to in the TPO article came from the French authorities.
Het specifieke verzoek waaraan wordt gerefereerd in het TPO-artikel is uitgegaan van de Franse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en  Bontes over het doorgaan van een bijeenkomst met een islamitische geweldsprediker

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would bar an Islamist preacher of violence from a planned gathering in Almere, in line with their motion. The Minister of Security and Justice said visa-required speakers who spread anti-integrative or anti-democratic messages are not welcome, that individual cases are assessed on their merits, that EU-national access can only be refused for a current, serious threat, and that criminal law and mayoral area bans remain available.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een opgepakte anti-IS-strijder

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the arrest and possible prosecution of a Dutch veteran who fought against IS in Syria, and why returning jihadists receive assistance while he is detained. The minister declined to comment on the individual case under investigation, described the general approach to returning jihadists, and explained that fighting IS can in principle be prosecuted under ordinary criminal law.
The investigation by the Public Prosecution Service into Jitse A. is still ongoing. I will not comment on an individual case that is still the subject of a criminal investigation.
Het onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie naar Jitse A. loopt nog. Ik ga niet in op een individuele casus die nog onderwerp is van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een  geweldsprediker naar Utrecht

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a violent preacher (al-Haddad, who reportedly calls for killing adulterers and apostates) should be denied entry to the Netherlands, how this fits the Bontes motion, whether foundations inviting such preachers could be banned, and whether a database of such preachers exists. The government answered that intolerant preachers are unwelcome and that visa or entry refusal depends on individual assessment and legal status (for this UK national, entry can only be refused on an actual, serious threat), that a study on the 'danger criterion' for banning associations is underway, and that no blacklist exists, only an alert list.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het intrekken van een subsidieaanvraag voor het referendum door de handelswijze van de referendumcommissie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether unclear forms, poor communication and an unsupportive attitude by the Referendum Commission caused applicants, including the initiators of a referendum, to withdraw subsidy requests, and whether this obstructs the democratic process. The Minister answered that withdrawing is applicants' own responsibility, that the forms and procedure were clear to most applicants, that subsidy statistics show many applicants did receive funds, and that he does not share the view that the process amounts to obstruction.
It is the applicants' own responsibility to withdraw a subsidy application.
Het is de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van aanvragers om een aanvraag voor een subsidie in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes inzake het weren van journalisten bij informatieavonden over azc's

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the exclusion of journalists from information evenings on asylum centres threatens press freedom and what measures the government will take. The state secretary said municipalities weigh safety and space against openness, that press freedom is protected but restrictions must be proportionate, and that municipalities must account for their choices to their councils.
Municipalities have their own responsibility to make a proportionate assessment between safety and openness when organising information evenings.
Gemeenten hebben een eigen verantwoordelijkheid om bij de organisatie van informatieavonden een proportionele afweging te maken tussen veiligheid en openheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over consulaten die geen registratieformulieren voor het referendum hebben ontvangen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether consulates abroad failed to receive pre-printed registration forms for the 2016 advisory referendum, whether this frustrated expatriate voters, and whether all consulates would be sent forms. The minister answered that one case was known, that posts were told to point voters to the Den Haag website and print forms on request, and that registration procedures match those for regular elections.
All embassies and consulates-general have since been reminded of this once more.
Inmiddels zijn alle ambassades en consulaten-generaal hier nogmaals op gewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de registratie van criminele asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the ministry lacks central oversight of how many criminal asylum seekers lose or are denied residence permits, and whether a central register will be created. The State Secretary rejected the premise of missing central oversight, explained that the IND assesses these cases and that rules were recently tightened, and noted that public order can now be recorded as a refusal or withdrawal ground.
I do not share the picture described regarding the absence of oversight in the registration of criminal asylum seekers.
Het geschetste beeld met betrekking tot het ontbreken van regie op het vlak van registratie van criminele asielzoekers deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een subsidie aan hulporganisatie B’Tselem die Palestijnse doodseskaders faciliteert

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Dutch government funds B'Tselem, which they say informs on Palestinians selling land to Jews, leading to torture and death, and whether that funding will be stopped and recovered. The Minister says the government is aware of the reports, that the Palestinian law carries prison or forced labour rather than death, that the Israeli investigation found no link to injury or death, and that Netherlands jointly funds B'Tselem (USD 710,000 for 2014–2016) as a legitimate human rights voice, so no halt or recovery is planned.
Organisations like B'Tselem represent a legitimate voice in Israeli society and strengthen the democratic character of Israel.
Organisaties als B’tselem vertegenwoordigen een legitieme stem in de Israëlische samenleving en versterken het democratische karakter van Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het weren van journalisten bij een informatieavond over een asielzoekerscentrum (azc) in de Noord-Oostpolder

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether police barring journalists from an information evening on an asylum centre in Noordoostpolder, and home visits to critical residents, unduly restrict press freedom and intimidate citizens. Minister Plasterk said press freedom is protected, noted the matter is before the court and so declined to judge the case, and placed responsibility for proportionate decisions with municipalities accountable to their councils.
The specific situation in Noordoostpolder has now been submitted to the court. For that reason I will not make a further statement on it.
De specifieke situatie in de Noordoostpolder is inmiddels voorgelegd aan de rechter. Om die reden doe ik hierover verder geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de ‘doofpot’ na aanrandingen in Almere

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether sexual assaults by asylum seekers in Almere were withheld or discouraged from reporting by police. The Minister said one case with four suspects was known locally, three victims filed complaints, police did not discourage reporting, and publicising incidents is for local authorities and the prosecution service.
Making incidents and reports public falls under the responsibility of local authorities.
Het openbaar maken van incidenten en meldingen valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over politiebezoek om twitter-kritiek op AZC

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police home visits over critical tweets about asylum centres were intimidating and how to stop them. The Minister rejected the concern, saying police may verify social media signals of possible public order disturbances, that home visits are normal policing under the mayor's authority, and that no change in policy is planned.
No, I do not share that. The police have the task of maintaining public order.
Nee, die deel ik niet. De politie heeft tot taak het handhaven van de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het antisemitisch Nieuwjaarsgeweld

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about antisemitic violence during New Year's Eve 2015 in Amsterdam, the scale of antisemitism, Holocaust teaching and security needs of Jewish institutions. The minister answered that the suspects were sent home with a conduct order, that the government rejects antisemitism, and listed measures such as teacher support, a dialogue with community leaders and recording of incidents.

Early 2016 SZW therefore organises a consultation with key figures from the Jewish and Islamic communities on their efforts to reduce the impact of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict in the Netherlands.

Begin 2016 organiseert SZW daarom een overleg met sleutelfiguren uit de Joodse en islamitische gemeenschap over hun inzet om doorwerking in Nederland van het Israelisch-Palestijnse conflict te verminderen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een van groepsverkrachting verdachte asielzoeker

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about an asylum seeker suspected of group rape, including his status, his reception centre, whether such offenders always forfeit residence, and how EU border travel is controlled. The State Secretary answered that the suspect is a family member of an admitted asylum seeker, that stricter criminal-conviction thresholds apply and the IND will await court outcomes, and that Schengen alerts would ensure his return and prosecution.
The IND will, where necessary, wait as long as legally permitted to decide on the asylum application until the court's ruling in any criminal case is known.
De IND wacht, indien nodig, zo lang als wettelijk toegestaan met de beslissing op de asielaanvraag tot de uitspraak van de rechter in een eventuele strafzaak bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten onderzoek doen naar onder meer het GeenPeil-initiatief

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether US intelligence services are investigating Russian influence on European initiatives including the GeenPeil referendum initiative, whether the Dutch government will check on US monitoring of its initiators, how Dutch intelligence is involved, and whether this is worrying. The minister answered that US services may not conduct operations in the Netherlands without Dutch government consent, that the cited article is insufficient evidence of such activity, and that the government cannot publicly comment on alleged activities of Dutch intelligence services.
The cabinet cannot publicly address (alleged) activities of the Dutch intelligence services.
Het kabinet kan niet in het openbaar ingaan op (vermeende) activiteiten van de Nederlandse inlichtingendiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van verschillende geweldspredikers naar Eindhoven

Two MPs asked whether preachers who legitimise suicide bombings and call for the death penalty for homosexuals should be denied entry, why such visits keep being allowed despite a motion to bar them, and whether foundations inviting them should be dissolved under Book 2 of the Civil Code. The government answered that visas are refused or withdrawn for preachers threatening public order, that each case is assessed individually and some visas were withdrawn, that it is pursuing a three-track approach, and that dissolution of legal persons is a matter for the courts on request by the public prosecutor.
Each individual case is assessed on its own merits and tested against these principles.
Elk individueel geval wordt op zijn eigen merites beoordeeld en getoetst aan deze uitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het succesvolle ontmoedigingsbeleid van België

Two MPs asked whether the government will adopt a Belgian- and Danish-style discouragement campaign aimed at asylum seekers to reduce inflows. The State Secretary answered that the government supports providing accurate information about the asylum process and reception conditions, but sees no reason to expect higher inflows from other countries' policies and therefore no additional measures.
I have no reason to assume that the countries mentioned choose to paint an incorrect picture in their information provision.
Ik heb geen redenen om te veronderstellen dat de genoemde landen er voor kiezen een onjuist beeld te schetsen in hun informatievoorziening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de demagogische uitlatingen van eurocommissaris Timmermans

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Prime Minister whether the government would distance itself from European Commissioner Timmermans' remarks that the only alternative to the EU is war, and whether it would urge a return to the EEG. Minister Koenders answered that he does not share the 'demagogic war rhetoric' characterisation, sees no reason to distance the government from the speech, and that a return to the EEG does not match cabinet policy.
No, this speech gives no reason to do so.
Nee, deze speech geeft daartoe geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over visumvrij reizen voor staatsburgers Oekraïne

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether visa-free travel for Ukrainian and Georgian citizens is planned for mid-2016, whether the Commission recommended approval, and how the Association Agreement's visa provisions relate to the referendum and EU competence. The minister replied that both countries have a perspective on visa liberalisation, that the Commission found all conditions met and will propose list changes in 2016 subject to Parliament and Council decision, and that provisional application of Article 19 does not require suspension and does not remove the need for a separate EU decision.
Once that proposal has been received, your House will be informed in accordance with the usual procedure and within the applicable deadlines.
Zodra dat voorstel is ontvangen, zal uw Kamer hier volgens de gebruikelijke procedure en binnen de geldende termijnen over worden geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de uitlatingen van de Nederlandse Vertegenwoordiger bij het Politiek en Veiligheidscomité van de EU, over het immigratiebeleid de "Merkel-way"

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch representative's remarks praising Merkel's migration policy as an opportunity, and whether the government would distance itself from it. The minister answered by referring to existing government positions on migration and EU asylum packages, without explicitly disavowing the remarks, and said the Netherlands would act as an honest broker during its EU presidency.
Are you willing to distance yourself from the remarks of the representative concerned?
Bent u bereid afstand te nemen van de uitlatingen van de betreffende Vertegenwoordiger
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de veel te hoge prijs die Nederland betaalt voor kankergeneesmiddelen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Netherlands overpays for cancer drugs, noting it ranks in the top three payers for seven of nine costly drugs, and why Spanish hospitals obtain larger discounts. The minister acknowledged the study, said price transparency and purchasing power need strengthening, and promised a broader medicines policy vision and package of measures in Q1 2016.
That is why I am in favour of more transparency about prices.
Ik ben mede daarom voorstander van meer transparantie over de prijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het krantenartikel ‘Misschien Arabische verkeersborden Oranje’

Two MPs asked the minister whether Arabic traffic signs were being seriously considered for introduction in the Netherlands, following a newspaper report. The minister answered that there are no plans to add Arabic signs to the official traffic sign regulation and that local road managers handle site-specific safety issues.
There are no plans to include Arabic traffic signs in it.
Er zijn geen plannen om hier Arabische verkeersborden in op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de groeiende geldnood

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about rising household debt arrears and proposed a flat tax, lower VAT and corporate tax, and phasing out allowances, arguing this would reduce the state's role. Minister Asscher answered that arrears reflect income losses, defended the progressive tax and allowance system, rejected the flat tax, and said the government had not accepted the claim that large redistribution necessarily curbs growth.
I do not share this view. The current tax system is individual and progressive and aimed at stimulating labour participation.
Deze mening deel ik niet. Het huidige belastingsysteem is individueel en progressief en gericht op het stimuleren van arbeidsparticipatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de Syrische zelfmoordterrorist die via Griekenland naar Europa kwam

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether a Syrian suicide bomber in Paris entered Europe via Greece as a refugee, how this fits with the NCTV's statement that no jihadists were known to enter via the refugee flow, and whether the government will stop admitting asylum seekers. The Minister replies that the French investigation is ongoing but two attackers likely came through the migration flow, that the NCTV considers such abuse conceivable, that asylum seekers are screened, and that he is not willing to stop admitting people fleeing war.
The French investigation into the circumstances of the attacks and the events leading up to them has not yet been concluded.
Het Franse onderzoek naar de toedracht van de aanslagen en de aanloop daarnaartoe is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de Europese oproep extra maatregelen te treffen tegen chemische of biologische terreuraanvallen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the government reacts calmly to an EU call for extra measures against chemical or biological terror attacks, whether the Netherlands has taken new steps such as producing an antidote, and whether the public will be informed preventively as in France and the UK. Minister Van der Steur answers that the Netherlands has long been alert to misuse of CBRN substances, has taken precautionary measures, and has already provided information to the public on how to act in a crisis, referring to earlier answers.
The Netherlands has been alert for years to the threat posed by misuse of chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear substances and has taken the necessary precautionary measures.
Nederland is al jaren alert op de dreiging die uitgaat van misbruik van chemische, biologische, radiologische en nucleaire stoffen en heeft daarvoor de nodige voorzorgsmaatregelen getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over voorzorgsmaatregelen tegen een chemische en/of biologische terreuraanval

MPs asked whether the Netherlands is prepared for a chemical or biological terrorist attack, including specific civilian protocols, public information, cross-border planning and a Frenchstyle antidote stockpile. The Minister of Justice and Security replied that the Netherlands has multidisciplinary CBRN protocols, specialist units, citizen information via Crisis.nl and NL-Alert, existing atropine stocks and EU and BTWC cooperation.
The Netherlands has in recent years taken a package of measures to prepare for incidents involving chemical, biological, radiological or nuclear (CBRN) material.
Nederland heeft de afgelopen jaren een pakket maatregelen genomen ter voorbereiding op incidenten met chemisch, biologisch, radiologisch of nucleair (CBRN) materiaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het verzoek om OVSE/ODIHR-waarnemers te laten observeren bij het aanstaande referendum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would invite OSCE/ODIHR observers to the April 2016 advisory referendum on the EU-Ukraine association agreement, which is the first referendum under the Wrr and does not regulate observers. The minister replied that observers may attend with consent of the mayor and polling board chair, that the government will invite ODIHR, but that ODIHR decides independently whether and how to observe.
Although the Wrr does not require it, the cabinet will invite OSCE/ODIHR to send observers to the upcoming referendum so they can be present when the votes are cast.
Hoewel de Wrr daartoe niet verplicht, zal het kabinet OVSE/ODIHR uitnodigen bij het aankomende referendum waarnemers te zenden om aanwezig te kunnen zijn bij het uitbrengen van de stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de uitlating van de president van Oekraïne met betrekking tot het aanstaande referendum over het associatieverdrag

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Prime Minister how to read President Poroshenko's remark that the Dutch referendum does not stop the EU-Ukraine association agreement, and why the government did not react. Foreign Minister Koenders answered that the agreement only enters into force once all parties, including the Netherlands, ratify it, that Dutch ratification is suspended pending the advisory referendum, and that the agreement is partly applied provisionally.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de van terrorisme verdachte asielzoeker

Two MPs asked the government about an asylum seeker arrested on terrorism suspicion, whether other suspects exist, and how screening failed to detect him at intake. The State Secretary said the case is under investigation, no confirmed cases of asylum seekers joining the stream for terrorist motives exist per the NCTV threat assessment, and no decision on the asylum claim will be made until the investigation concludes.
Until then, no decision is taken on the asylum application.
Tot die tijd wordt niet op de asielaanvraag beslist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van geweldsboodschapper Haneen Zoabi naar een Kristallnacht-herdenking

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Justice Minister about the planned visit of Knesset member Haneen Zoabi to a Dutch Kristallnacht commemoration, her support for the kidnapping of three Israeli boys, and whether such figures could be denied entry to the Netherlands. The minister replied that Zoabi is an democratically elected Knesset member, that Israel suspended her for six months without prosecution, that the Netherlands can refuse visa-free third-country nationals on public order or national security grounds assessed case by case, and that inflammatory messages can be addressed through criminal law.
In general, the Netherlands can refuse visa-free third-country nationals entry if their presence or activities pose a threat to public order or national security.

In algemene zin geldt dat Nederland aan visumvrije derdelanders de toegang kan weigeren indien van hun aanwezigheid of hun activiteiten een gevaar uit gaat voor de openbare orde of nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het voornemen een noodopvang-locatie neer te zetten in een joodse wijk in Amstelveen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about plans to place an emergency asylum shelter for up to 400 refugees in a Jewish-associated area of Amstelveen, and whether antisemitism risks from migrants were being addressed. The government answered that the location is acceptable, that Amstelveen and COA will take measures such as community dialogue and house rules banning discrimination, and that regional reception is part of its migration strategy.
At the same time, I also believe that the population makeup of a neighbourhood should not in itself be a reason to refrain from reception at that location.
Tegelijkertijd vind ik ook dat de bevolkingssamenstelling van een buurt op zich geen aanleiding mag zijn om af te zien van opvang op die locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over ontvoering van kinderen

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that 25 Dutch children were abducted abroad over summer, and about the case of two children held in Egypt since 2003. The government said the figure came from a CIKO press release, explained the Hague Convention and diplomatic routes for return, and declined to discuss individual cases citing privacy law.
I cannot go into the substance of ongoing individual cases in the interest of those cases and under the Personal Data Protection Act.
Op de inhoud van lopende individuele zaken kan ik in het belang van deze zaken en in het kader van de Wet Bescherming Persoonsgegevens niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de opvang van asielzoekers op een landgoed voor psychiatrische patiënten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the municipality of Den Bosch's preference to house asylum seekers on a estate used by psychiatric patients was a concern, and whether the Secretary of State would advise against it. The Secretary said talks between the municipality, COA and the mental health institution are at an early stage with no agreement yet, that a COA site existed there before without problems, and that he sees no reason the site could not be used.
At this moment I have no reason to assume that a COA reception location could not be established on this site because of the combination of the groups of residents.
Op dit moment heb ik geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat er op dit terrein geen COA-opvanglocatie zou kunnen komen vanwege de combinatie van de groepen bewoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de verwachte lange termijnkosten van de asielinstroom

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about child benefit paid to refugees, the expected share of Syrian and Iraqi asylum seekers who will stay permanently, and long-term costs of asylum inflow. The minister answered that child benefit went to about 9,000 households in Q2 2015 (around EUR 4.6 million), that long-term stay cannot be forecast so no long-term cost estimate is possible, and that benefits from participation should also be considered.
Because the development of that situation cannot be predicted, no quantitative calculation can be made either.
Omdat de ontwikkeling van die situatie niet valt te voorspellen, kan evenmin daarover een cijfermatige doorrekening plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het zweren op Allah bij de militaire beëdiging

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Islamic oath taken by soldiers at a public swearing-in is a wrong development and whether military oaths should be aligned with those of police and civil servants. The Minister replied that no new development exists, that the 1916 royal decree already regulates oaths for Muslim soldiers, and that military oaths differ from civil-service oaths, so no measures are planned.
There is no question of a development.
Er is geen sprake van een ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de oproep tot geweld tegen Israëlische toeristen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a public call to attack Israeli tourists and what measures would prevent such violence. The Minister said the call is punishable, that police protect everyone including Israeli tourists when needed, and that a criminal investigation is ongoing, so no further details can be given.
In the interest of the investigation, no further statements can be made at this time.
In het belang van het onderzoek kunnen op dit moment verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over chique buurten die worden ontzien bij de opvang van asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary whether asylum reception is concentrated in working-class neighbourhoods, whether municipalities should be advised to place reception where electoral support exists, whether a maximum number of asylum seekers should be set, and whether Schengen border controls should be reopened. The State Secretary replied that COA does not observe a link between neighbourhood prosperity and support, that COA does not differentiate locations by neighbourhood, that no fixed numbers are used, and referred to an earlier letter on border controls.
COA makes no distinction when recruiting reception locations and also does not advise municipalities regarding neighbourhoods where a reception location is realised.
Het COA maakt geen onderscheid als het gaat om het werven van opvanglocaties en adviseert gemeenten ook niet met betrekking tot buurten waar een opvanglocatie gerealiseerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en Klaveren over het bericht dat de Palestijnse Autoriteit veroordeelde Hamas terroristen heeft betaald

MPs asked whether the Palestinian Authority pays convicted Hamas terrorists, the total amounts paid, and what the government will do to press the EU to stop the policy. The minister declined to confirm the reported amounts, referred to earlier answers, said Pegase payments do not fund prisoners, and said the Netherlands will keep raising the issue bilaterally with the PA and PLO.
The cabinet cannot confirm the amounts mentioned in the news report.
Het kabinet kan de in het nieuwsbericht genoemde bedragen niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over vermoedens van malversaties bij Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about alleged misconduct at Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland, including unfair competition, the director's salary, a possible monopoly, volunteers in language courses and a cooperation with a commercial firm. Minister Asscher answered that the allegations are disputed, the salary follows the Balkenende norm, there is no monopoly, volunteers only complement paid teachers, and the cooperation is not unfair.
I do not share your concern.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat meer dan een half miljoen illegalen Europa zijn binnengekomen

Two MPs asked the government whether it was aware of reports that over 600,000 illegal migrants had entered Europe, what the ratio of legal to illegal migrants is, how many are heading to the Netherlands, and what measures will prevent this. The government answered that it is working on Europe-wide and national solutions, that no data exist on legal or illegal entries as such (Frontex counted 425,167 illegal border crossings from June 2014 to June 2015, often by the same people), and that where these migrants went cannot be established with certainty, referring to IND reports.
Where these foreigners went cannot be established with certainty.
Waar deze vreemdelingen naar toe zijn gegaan valt niet met zekerheid te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de Leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aantasting van de financiële positie van grote pensioenfondsen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about the financial position of large pension funds, asking whether an opt-out from mandatory supplementary pension and conversion of contributions into gross salary is possible. The State Secretary answered that the cabinet wants to keep a form of mandatory participation, while pursuing a differentiated approach such as opt-out defaults, a fund for flexworkers and more customisation.
The cabinet believes that some form of mandatory participation for employees must be maintained.
Het kabinet vindt dat een vorm van verplichtstelling voor werknemers daarbij moet worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de falende kabinetslobby inzake terugkeer asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary whether the cabinet's lobbying for return of rejected asylum seekers is failing, citing an advisory commission finding that export and business contracts weigh more heavily than forced return, and asked how ministries will be made to prioritise return and where the 7,000+ non-removed foreigners are. The government answered by referring to its letter on the ACVZ report on the strategic country approach and the migration and development progress report, rather than answering each question directly.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar een gemeenteraadslid

Two MPs asked whether a criminal investigation into a Haarlemmermeer council group leader, reportedly filed by the mayor, is real, and what action will be taken after a police officer's alleged remarks in a café. The minister confirmed a criminal investigation exists but withheld further details citing the investigation's interests, referred the officer's conduct to the police internal affairs unit, and said notifying a suspect early depends on the case.
In the interest of this investigation, I cannot currently provide any further information.
In het belang van dit onderzoek kan ik op dit moment geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het ontmoedigen van asielzoekers naar Nederland te komen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government will discourage asylum seekers from coming to the Netherlands, following Belgian and Danish examples, including via cuts to allowances and removing housing priority for status holders. The State Secretary answered that the government will provide accurate information about the asylum process and housing, but rejects a maximum reception number and frames housing priority changes as aimed at freeing housing rather than deterrence.
The cabinet considers it important to provide correct and complete information about the asylum process and the expectations people may have of it.
Het kabinet acht het van belang om juiste en volledige informatie te verstrekken over het asielproces en de verwachtingen die mensen daarover mogen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke, Van Klaveren, Knops en Voordewind over “De oplaaiende terreur in Nigeria”

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about escalating attacks on civilians, many of them Christians, in Central Nigeria, the government's protection efforts, Boko Haram's trajectory, regional cooperation, humanitarian funding and gender-specific attention. The minister answered that the Middle Belt violence is largely driven by economic and land/water conflicts between herders and farmers, that Nigerian authorities have been ineffective at protecting civilians, and that Nigeria bears primary responsibility for countering Boko Haram, with Dutch support channelled through EU and humanitarian programmes.
The violence against the population makes clear that the Nigerian authorities have not been effective in protecting civilians.
De gewelddadigheden tegen de bevolking maken duidelijk dat de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten niet effectief zijn geweest in de bescherming van burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over huisbezoeken van wijkagenten bij leden van Asielzoekerscentra (AZC)-alert in Enschede

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether police home visits to members of the anti-asylum-centre group AZC-alert in Enschede, which may feel intimidating, should be stopped and whether this capacity could be used for crime fighting. The minister replied that such contact is routine police work under local authority responsibility, does not infringe free speech or assembly, and that there is no reason to change the practice.
In view of my answers to the above questions, there is no reason to change the police's working method on this point.
Gelet op mijn antwoorden op bovenstaande vragen, is er geen reden om de werkwijze van de politie op dit punt te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de aanstelling van een migratiegezant

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked why former GroenLinks leader Bram van Ojik was appointed special envoy for migration and whether a more neutral candidate should be chosen, plus an overview of all special envoys. Minister Koenders defended the appointment as an operational, non-political role within the existing policy, said Van Ojik's background is not relevant, and listed the eight special envoys, all based in The Hague except the Syria envoy in Istanbul.

I have full confidence in Mr Van Ojik's performance and in the way he will convey the Dutch government's positions in his contacts with international organisations, EU member states and third countries.

Ik heb het volste vertrouwen in het functioneren van de heer van Ojik en de wijze waarop hij in zijn contacten met internationale organisaties, EU-lidstaten en derde landen de standpunten van de Nederlandse regering zal uitdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over weer 700 extra asielzoekers voor het Drentse dorpje Oranje

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the government plans to house another 700 asylum seekers in the small village of Oranje despite earlier agreements with the municipality and province, and whether it will limit asylum to regional reception and close borders. The state secretary referred to a letter of 13 October, said the government is pursuing humane but sober reception and regional solutions, and did not commit to closing borders or dropping the proposed measures.
For an answer to this question I refer to the letter to your House of 13 October.
Voor antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar de brief aan uw Kamer van 13 oktober jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over berichtgeving dat de Landmacht snijdt in het budget voor reservisten

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Defence Minister whether the Army's cuts to the reservist budget limit reservist deployment and endanger national security. The minister said deployment is growing fast, a temporary measure curbs overruns at the Army command, national security is not harmed, and the 2% NATO spending commitment is addressed in the 2016 budget and later steps.
The measure has no adverse effects on national security.
De maatregel heeft geen nadelige effecten voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de waarschuwing voor massasterfte van herten in de Oostvaardersplassen

An MP asked the minister whether she knew of warnings that some 5,000 deer in the Oostvaardersplassen could starve, what the costs would be, and whether the failed experimental management should be ended by selling all grazers. The state secretary answered that the warning concerns about 2,000 animals, that early-reactive management is in place within regular costs, that the plan is not a failure, and that selling all grazers is not planned.
No. I refer you for this also to my letter of 12 March.
Nee. Ik verwijs u hiervoor ook naar mijn brief van 12 maart jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de uitkomst van het Europese fraudeonderzoek naar een moskeeverzamelgebouw

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about OLAF's finding of no irregularities in an EU-subsidised multifunctional building in Amsterdam that houses prayer rooms, and whether Amsterdam asked OLAF to drop the case. The minister replied that no EU subsidy went to the religious part, no fraud was found, and Amsterdam never asked OLAF to drop the case.
In this case there is no question of fraud or irregularity.
Er is in dit geval geen sprake van fraude of onregelmatigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de huisuitzetting van studenten ten behoeve van asielzoekers

An MP asked whether students were being evicted from Houthavens container housing to make room for asylum seekers, and why status holders get priority in social housing. The minister denies students are displaced by asylum seekers, says the units were rented on a temporary basis and are being reused, and states the priority rule for status holders will be scrapped.
For that reason, the priority arrangement for residence-entitled persons is being removed from the Housing Act.
Om die reden wordt de voorrangsregeling voor verblijfsgerechtigden uit de Huisvestingswet geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het Saoedische voornemen een tiener te kruisigen en onthoofden

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares outrage at Saudi plans to crucify and behead a teenager, whether pressure will be applied, whether the UN Human Rights Council is discredited by a Saudi diplomat chairing its advisory panel, and whether the Saudi ambassador should be expelled. The minister confirmed awareness, called the sentence a breach of the UN Children's Rights Convention, said the EU and member states will raise concerns with Saudi authorities, defended the Council's role and the panel's procedures, and declined to expel the ambassador.
From that standpoint, the EU and member states will raise their serious concerns about this case in their contacts with the Saudi authorities.
Vanuit die zienswijze zullen de EU en lidstaten in hun contacten met de Saoedische autoriteiten hun grote zorgen omtrent deze zaak opbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het voorstel van de Belgische premier om de Schengen-akkoorden open te breken

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government backs Belgium's proposal to reopen the Schengen agreements amid terrorism and migration pressure, and whether it will support the Australian model. The government answered that no change to Schengen rules is currently needed, that internal border controls can be intensified under existing rules, and that it will raise the issue in the Luxembourg presidency's December discussions.
For now there is no need to amend the Schengen rules to counter illegal migration flows within the Schengen area.
Vooralsnog is er geen noodzaak de Schengenregelgeving aan te passen om de illegale migratiestromen binnen het Schengengebied tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de herinvoering van grenscontroles door Duitsland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Germany's reintroduction of border checks would be followed by Dutch checks, how long they would last, and whether the Netherlands would support Germany and push to abandon Schengen. The government answered that Germany acted under the Schengen Border Code, that the Dutch had intensified targeted checks and could reintroduce border controls if public order required, and that no change to Schengen rules was currently needed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een nieuwe islamitische geweldprediker naar Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a preacher known for endorsing flogging and violence would speak at a Rotterdam mosque, whether his visa could be revoked, and what measures would stop such foreign preachers. The government said the preacher holds a visa issued by another Schengen country and no grounds for revocation currently exist, the mosque has no ANBI status, and it will use enforcement plus dialogue and, where needed, criminal action against incitement.
This preacher received a visa from another Schengen country.
Deze prediker heeft van een ander Schengenland een visum gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het Deense ontmoedigingsbeleid

Two MPs asked whether the government would adopt Denmark's policy of discouraging asylum seekers, such as cutting allowances and funding for recreational courses, and whether it would actively deter asylum seekers and publicize this in the region. The government answered that information campaigns may be used where migration flows stem from misperceptions, but that it distinguishes this from admission policy, and it acknowledged that a new group of migrants will require attention on integration and participation.
A distinction must be made between informing migrants about the actual situation and the admission policy to be pursued.
Er dient een onderscheid te worden gemaakt tussen het informeren van migranten over de feitelijke situatie en het te voeren toelatingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes inzake een anti-Westerse en anti-Israëlische docent

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Education about a trainee civics teacher whose views on the West, Israel and refugees were reported. The Secretary of State answered that the views do not belong in education, that the school found no evidence of such views being passed to pupils, that the person has since left the school, and that the statements were made in a private capacity.
Statements that run counter to the fundamental values of our democratic constitutional state do not belong in education.
Uitspraken die ingaan tegen de fundamentele waarden van onze democratische rechtsstaat, horen niet thuis in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes inzake een antisemitisch schoolboek

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the education minister how she views antisemitic claims in a secondary-school history supplement on the Middle East and whether such material belongs in Dutch schools. The state secretary replied that the ministry does not judge individual textbooks, that the publisher revised some content after consultation with critics, and that teachers and experts should ensure historical objectivity.
It is not for me to establish the objectivity of historical sources used in teaching methods.
Het is niet aan mij om de objectiviteit vast te stellen van historische bronnen die in lesmethoden worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de duizenden fraude-gevallen bij het generaal pardon

Two MPs asked how many of the roughly 28,000 asylum seekers under the 2007-2008 general pardon committed identity fraud, which municipalities helped amend identity data, and what action would be taken against them. The State Secretary denied large-scale identity fraud, reporting only ten residence permits revoked for personal-data fraud in two years, and said municipalities apply the BRP law on their own, so no measures against them were needed.
The picture painted in the reporting, namely that foreigners are seeking to change their personal details on a large scale, is not one I recognise.
Het beeld dat in de berichtgeving wordt geschetst namelijk dat vreemdelingen op grote schaal hun persoonsgegevens willen wijzigen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over mogelijk kindermisbruik in een asielzoekerscentrum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether four children were sexually abused at the Bellingwolde asylum centre and whether the perpetrator's asylum procedure should be halted and he be barred from the country, and asked for the number of reported child sexual abuse cases at asylum centres. The State Secretary confirmed the police are investigating, declined further comment on the case, said perpetrators are prosecuted like others and criminal records feed into asylum decisions, and reported seven (2014) and nine (2015) reports nationwide without naming locations.
In the context of this ongoing investigation, no further statements can be made about this.
In het kader van dit lopende onderzoek kunnen hierover geen verdere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het niet vergoeden van basisbandage voor kankerpatiënten door een zorgverzekeraar

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why insurer Menzis refused to reimburse thoracic bandages for cancer patients from the basic package, and whether other insurers do the same. The minister replied that Menzis states the bandages are reimbursed when policy conditions are met, that Menzis's prior-authorisation procedure is in its policy terms, and that she sees no need for measures, noting the NZa and IGJ supervise insurers' statutory duty of care.
I do not intend to take measures now that Menzis has stated that these aids will be reimbursed.
Ik ben niet voornemens om maatregelen te nemen nu Menzis heeft verklaard dat deze hulpmiddelen vergoed worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de zaak Romano van der Dussen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister whether the ministry lied about when it learned of DNA certainty in the Romano van der Dussen case, why a 2010 trust report did not lead to earlier action, and whether he can return home by year-end. The minister answered that the questions were addressed in his earlier letter answering MPs Omtzigt and Knops, referring to that letter instead of responding substantively.
I refer you to the answers to the parliamentary questions from MPs Omtzigt and Knops, which I sent you by letter of 27 August 2015, reference DCV/CA-133/15.
Graag verwijs ik naar de antwoorden op de Kamervragen van de leden Omtzigt en Knops die ik u bij brief van 27 augustus 2015, kenmerk DCV/CA-133/15 deed toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over een Nederlandse militair die overgelopen is naar IS

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister whether a Dutch soldier who defected to IS would lead to tighter screening, whether the investigation extends beyond the Air Force, the soldier's nationality, the intelligence services' current monitoring, and how many other ex-soldiers have joined Islamist terror groups. The minister referred the MPs to a separate letter answering a related request from another MP about possible radicalisation of an active soldier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het verzoek van Israël om financiering van omstreden NGO's stop te zetten

Two MPs asked whether the government will stop funding NGOs that Israel considers antisemitic or terror-glorifying, after an Israeli request. The minister answered that human rights NGOs are supported for their work, that the government will not fund organisations making antisemitic statements or glorifying terror, and that existing procedures provide safeguards.

The cabinet does not want to provide support to organisations that make antisemitic statements or glorify terror, or to organisations that pass these subsidies on to organisations guilty of such conduct.

Het kabinet wil geen steun verlenen aan organisaties die antisemitische uitingen doen danwel terreur verheerlijken of aan organisaties die deze subsidies doorgeven aan organisaties die zich daaraan schuldig maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het Franse voorstel een eigen regering te vormen voor de eurozone

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government shares opposition to French president Hollande's idea of a separate eurozone government and parliament, and whether the euro project has failed and should be dismantled. The minister replied that the cabinet's view on EMU is set out in its letter on the Five Presidents Report, that it values democratic legitimacy and national parliaments' role, and that a eurozone government is not on the table.
In that context the cabinet wants to ensure that the principle of subsidiarity is safeguarded and that national parliaments remain responsible for national policy.
Daarbij wil het kabinet erop toezien dat het subsidiariteitsbeginsel geborgd blijft en nationale parlementen verantwoordelijk blijven voor nationaal beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de bedreiging en intimidatie in asielzoekerscentra (AZC) door islamitische asielzoekers (vervolgvragen)

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked follow-up questions about reported threats and intimidation of Christian asylum seekers by Muslim residents in asylum centres, and whether the government's earlier answers ignored religious components. The State Secretary maintained that most tensions are between individuals rather than groups, said COA does not recognise a pattern of group intimidation, pointed to reporting-facilitation measures, and said misconduct can affect asylum procedures depending on the facts and penalty.
COA does not recognise the picture that a (majority of a) certain group intimidates, harasses and/or threatens another group.
Het beeld dat een (meerderheid van een) bepaalde groep een andere groep intimideert, lastigvalt en/of bedreigt herkent het COA niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het onderzoek naar jodenhaat onder islamitische jongeren

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Social Affairs about research on antisemitism among Muslim youth, including a 12% negative view of Dutch Jews, and contrasting surveys. The minister said the study finds no inherent link between Islam and antisemitism, rejected the Motivaction survey as methodologically flawed, and pointed to school-based prevention measures.
The research provides no support for the view that antisemitism is inherent to Islam or to Muslims in the Netherlands.
Het onderzoek levert geen ondersteuning voor het beeld dat antisemitisme inherent is aan de islam of moslims in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het tekort aan munitie bij het Nederlandse leger

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister about a shortage of ammunition in the Dutch army, which they called shameful, and what measures would end it and whether defence spending would rise to 2% of GDP. The minister acknowledged the shortage as undesirable, attributed it to limited shelf life, long lead times and production delays, said deliveries were expected in 2015 and 2016 and that stocks were redistributed, and deferred the spending question to the 2016 budget.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanslag in een Thalys vanuit Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about the foiled terrorist attack on a Thalys train from Amsterdam: the attacker's nationality, whether it was jihadist, how a Kalashnikov could be carried aboard, and whether armed forces and marechaussee should guard vulnerable locations and honour the passengers who overpowered him. The minister answered that the attacker was Moroccan with a Spanish residence permit and that French authorities assume a jihadist motive; that passenger checks on international trains have limits; that security measures are reviewed after each incident without disclosing specific locations; and that the government respects the passengers' response, referring to earlier answers on decorations.
For security reasons I do not wish to go into the locations and the security measures in more detail.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen wil ik niet nader ingaan op de locaties en de beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht 'Bijna oorlog met Venezuela'

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Venezuelan naval incursions into Aruban waters were concealed and what military steps were taken, and why the government changed its position on the immunity of Carvajal. The minister answered that no Venezuelan navy vessel entered Aruban waters, no military action was needed, and the immunity conclusion was based on the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations, with the government accepting that Aruba's release was an autonomous decision.
The Venezuelan navy did not sail through Aruban waters.
De Venezolaanse marine is niet door Arubaanse wateren gevaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de mogelijke vervolging in Oostenrijk van een Nederlandse parlementariërparlementariër

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would object to Austrian prosecutors considering prosecuting Dutch MP Wilders for incitement, and whether it would relax Dutch hate speech laws. The minister replied that assessing criminality abroad is for Austrian authorities, expressed confidence in their decision, and said the cabinet will take a position on the initiative bill in parliament.
Assessing the criminality of acts that occurred in another country is primarily reserved for the authorities of that country.
Beoordeling van strafbaarheid van handelingen die zich hebben voorgedaan in een ander land is in eerste instantie aan de autoriteiten van dat land voorbehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanhoudende onrust in de Schilderswijk

Two MPs asked whether the government shares outrage over riots in The Hague's Schilderswijk after a death in custody, whether it will distance itself from racism accusations against police, how many rioters were arrested and how damage will be recovered, and why the mayor allegedly failed to restore order and whether a curfew and marechaussee deployment will be pressed. The minister answered that the Rijksrecherche investigation is ongoing and cannot be commented on, that 246 suspects were arrested, that municipal damage is EUR 77,600 with recovery being explored, and that the mayor acted as competent authority and did not fail.
Since the investigation into the acts of violence is still ongoing, the number of arrested suspects may increase further.
Het onderzoek naar de geweldplegingen nog in volle gang is, kan het aantal aangehouden verdachten verder oplopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat de Turkse autoriteiten de verzoeken om rechtshulp inzake de kwestie Demmink niet hebben gehonoreerd

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked why Turkish authorities have not honoured Dutch requests for legal assistance in the criminal investigation into former senior civil servant Demmink, and what the government will do to secure cooperation. The Minister replied that Turkey is still studying the requests, that a final Turkish dismissal of the facts may conflict with ne bis in idem, that the government has pressed hard including a personal call with the Turkish minister, and rejected the suggestion of an atmosphere of obscurity.
The possibility of executing the Dutch legal assistance requests is still being studied in Turkey.
De mogelijkheid tot uitvoering van de Nederlandse rechtshulpverzoeken wordt in Turkije nog bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de gevangenisstraf voor een optredende agent

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a prison sentence and damages imposed on a police officer who fired on a suspect in a ramming case conflicts with public sense of justice and deters police action. The Minister declined to comment on the case because it is before the courts, acknowledged the emotional impact on police, and pointed to an ongoing review of the legal framework for police use of force with a letter promised after the summer.
Because the case is before the courts, it is not appropriate for me to make statements about it.
Omdat de zaak onder de rechter is, past het mij niet hierover uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de bedreiging en intimidatie in asielzoekerscentra (AZC) door islamitische asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary about reports that Christian asylum seekers were threatened and intimidated by Muslim asylum seekers in reception centres, why a 2011 improvement programme had not helped, whether perpetrators rather than victims should be moved, whether offenders should lose residence rights, and whether Australia's regional-only model should be adopted. The State Secretary rejected the picture as inaccurate while acknowledging tensions, described COA anti-discrimination measures and a working group, said relocations depend on the most suitable solution, noted police involvement and possible consequences for asylum procedures, and affirmed the government's regional reception policy alongside international obligations.
This picture is not consistent with the facts, though tensions between residents do certainly occur.
Dit beeld klopt niet met de feiten, wat niet wegneemt dat er wel degelijk spanningen tussen bewoners voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het advies van de Adviesraad Internationale Vraagstukken om zeker 3,3 miljard euro extra te investeren in de krijgsmacht

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Defence Minister about an advisory council recommendation for several billion euros in extra defence spending, the adequacy of the armed forces, tanks, the NATO 2% norm and a naive Russia policy. The minister denied the armed forces are in a dire state, referred the advice to a government response due around Prinsjesdag, and otherwise restated existing policy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een extremistische moslimprediker in Almere

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a preacher linked to jihadist groups, invited by an Almere mosque, could be stopped from spreading extremist messages in the Netherlands, including via visa refusal and revoking the mosque's ANBI tax status. The minister answered that the preacher holds Belgian nationality so no visa applies, that he cannot be pinned to jihadism, that non-visa preachers can be addressed through criminal law, and that ANBI status can be withdrawn without legislative change if activities conflict with the public interest.

Regarding non-visa-required preachers who call for hatred and violence, the letter of 3 March stated that if they lawfully reside in the Schengen area, they can be assessed on the message they spread during their stay.

Ten aanzien van niet-visumplichtige predikers die oproepen tot haat en geweld is in de brief van 3 maart gesteld, dat indien zij rechtmatig in het Schengengebied verblijven, zij beoordeeld kunnen worden op de boodschap die zij tijdens hun verblijf uitdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de vervolging wegens de ‘fuck de koning-uitspraak’

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the government whether article 111 of the Criminal Code (insult of the King) is outdated, whether prosecution under it should be deprioritised, whether its five-year maximum sentence and its compatibility with free speech are justified, and whether it should be repealed. The Minister referred back to earlier answers to D66 questions and refused to repeal the provision, defending it as it stands.
Are you willing to repeal article 111 of the Criminal Code? If not, why not?
Bent u bereid artikel 111 Sr te schrappen? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de deplorabele toestand van de landmacht

Two MPs asked the Defence Minister about reports that the army is in a deplorable state, including old equipment, ammunition shortages and insufficient trained staff, and whether she will present a long-term vision and raise defence spending by at least 5 billion euro. The minister confirmed the report, said the commander's remarks match her May letter on material readiness, and said a letter on the long-term vision will follow in June as requested in a motion.
The cabinet has previously informed you that parliament will receive a letter by June in response to the Van der Staaij et al. motion.
Het kabinet heeft u eerder geïnformeerd dat het parlement uiterlijk in juni een brief ontvangt naar aanleiding van de motie-Van der Staaij c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de berichtgeving inzake het verhinderen van de arrestatie van Desi Bouterse door toenmalig minister Van Mierlo

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the blocking of Desi Bouterse's arrest in 1997 relates to Dutch involvement in the 1980 February coup and to a state-secret classification of Suriname files, and whether that classification should be lifted. The government denies any known link, says it aims for maximum openness balanced against third-party interests, and notes that the Tweede Kamer restricted some 1984 report annexes until 2060.
The cabinet strives for maximum openness.
Het kabinet streeft maximale openheid na.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat een gevaarlijke killer nachtverlof heeft gekregen tegen de regels in

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether a six-fold murderer serving life imprisonment, who remains in a forensic psychiatric clinic with unsupervised leave, was granted night leave against the rules, and how such situations are prevented. The Secretary of State confirmed the case, explained that leave was granted by court order and that clinic staff exceeded the permitted scope, stated that life sentences are in principle for life, and said that placement of lifers in such clinics is no longer policy except in individual cases.

At the end of February 2015 it was found that the Van der Hoeven clinic, in exercising the leave authorisation for the person concerned, granted him more freedoms than the leave authorisation permitted.

Eind februari 2015 is geconstateerd dat de Van der Hoevenkliniek in de uitoefening van de verlofmachtiging van betrokkene meer vrijheden aan betrokkene heeft verleend dan op grond van de verleende verlofmachtiging was toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de enorme groei van het aantal antisemitische incidenten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a sharp rise in antisemitic incidents, including a rise of over 70 percent and a doubling of insults and physical violence against Jews, and asked what measures would be taken. The minister confirmed concern, linked the rise to Middle East events and jihadist attacks, and pointed to existing policy letters and a planned reassessment of the anti-discrimination approach before year end.
Before the end of this year, the cabinet will make proposals to recalibrate the approach to discrimination.
Voor het eind van dit jaar zal het kabinet voorstellen doen om te komen tot een herijking van de aanpak van discriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over berichten dat de totale advocaatkosten in de affaire Demmink meer gekost hebben dan aan de Kamer werd gemeld

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the total legal costs in the Demmink affair exceeded what had been reported to the House, and why earlier answers omitted costs of the State Attorney. The minister denies incomplete information, explaining that the disputed costs were incurred for the State itself, and gives the reimbursed legal aid figures for Demmink, including a newly received claim of EUR 21,243.17 plus about EUR 6,000 in procedural costs.
These costs were therefore not incurred "for Mr Demmink" but on behalf of the State.
Deze kosten zijn dus niet «voor de heer Demmink» gemaakt, maar ten behoeve van de Staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat de helft van de Somaliërs in de bijstand zit
