MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about threats by a pro-ISIS pupil against Jews, the safety of pupils and staff, the rise of antisemitism among Muslim pupils since the AIVD warned in 2004, and whether anti-terrorism laws such as administrative detention will be introduced. The Minister said the OM will assess prosecution for the statements, declined to discuss security arrangements in public, pointed to schools' duties and existing support, and held that new administrative measures are not necessary because the OM has sufficient criminal tools.
I cannot make public statements about the security situation of persons or organisations.
Over de veiligheidssituatie van personen of organisaties kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de miljardenkosten van toeslagen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about rising allowance costs (toeslagen), whether the childcare and healthcare allowance growth shows the system is unsustainable, and whether abolishing the allowances and introducing a low flat tax would reduce dependence and boost growth. The State Secretary answers that the healthcare allowance is being reduced by half a million recipients in 2015, that the wider reform will be discussed with parliamentary groups before any proposals, and that the government aims to lower labour and business taxes.
I do not want to anticipate the outcomes of the various discussions I wish to have with the parliamentary groups on the reform of the system and the research to be carried out in that context.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van de diverse gesprekken die ik wil voeren met de fracties over de stelselherziening en de in dat kader te verrichten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het aftuigen van een tiener door dertig man

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a teenager beaten by a group of about thirty people, including whether the suspects were mainly of Turkish origin and whether multicultural tensions are growing. The Minister replied that the police investigation is ongoing, one minor suspect was arrested and released pending further inquiry, the group members had varied ethnic backgrounds, and that existing local tools would be used if threats to public order arise.
Because of conflicting witness statements, it is among other things still not clear what the circumstances were and who was all involved.
Door tegenstrijdige getuigenverklaringen is onder meer nog niet duidelijk wat de toedracht was en wie allemaal betrokken waren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanval op een student in defensie-uniform

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether an alleged knife threat and car incident against students in defence uniform were linked to jihadist danger, and what measures would be taken. The minister replied that police found the threat report was false and the car incident was not deliberate, that no other such incidents are known, and that Defence takes staff safety seriously but will not disclose its measures.
So as not to undermine the intended effect, no statements are made about measures taken or still to be taken.
Om het beoogde effect hiervan niet te ondergraven, worden over genomen of nog te nemen maatregelen geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de grote zorgen van de Commandant der Strijdkrachten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister about the Commander of the Armed Forces' concerns over underfunding, NATO's 2% target, limits on possible ISIS operations, a stepwise budget plan and a 15-year vision. The minister acknowledged the remarks, pointed to a forthcoming letter on the motion-Van der Staaij and NATO summit commitments, noted some operational constraints, and referred to earlier reports without committing to a budget schedule.

As the Prime Minister committed during the General Political Considerations, the cabinet will inform the House by letter before the Defence budget debate on how it intends to implement the Van der Staaij motion.

Zoals de Minister-President heeft toegezegd tijdens de Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen zal het kabinet de Tweede Kamer vóór de begrotingsbehandeling van Defensie per brief informeren over de wijze waarop het kabinet uitvoering wil geven aan de motie-Van der Staaij
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over potentiële jihadisten op luchthavens

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether jihadists working at airports had been arrested in the Netherlands, whether Dutch and Belgian intelligence services were in contact, and whether airport staff should be screened like in Belgium. The minister answered that no such cases were known to the Public Prosecution Service, declined to comment on international intelligence cooperation, and explained that airport positions with national security risk are designated as trust positions requiring a security clearance from the AIVD.
No public statements can be made about international cooperation between intelligence and security services.
Over de internationale samenwerking tussen inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het groeiende aantal jihadgezinnen

MPs asked about the growing number of jihadist families, reported departures from several municipalities, information sharing with mayors, and passport and nationality measures against departing jihadists. The Minister declined to give municipality-level details, described AIVD and municipal information sharing, outlined the passport and citizenship-revocation options, and described counter-radicalisation communication efforts.
I cannot go into individual cases in public.
Ik kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het gegeven dat er een ‘Pietoverleg’ zal plaatsvinden

Two MPs asked the government about a reported meeting on Sinterklaas and Zwarte Piet, which organisations attended, and whether the government would oppose the 'Zwarte Piet' criticism and accept the political-correctness pressure. The minister listed the attending organisations, stated that the feast is a societal tradition with no government rule on how it is celebrated, and said the government appeals to everyone's responsibility rather than imposing terms.
There is no law, guideline or other form of obligation imposed by the government regarding the way the Sinterklaas feast is celebrated.
Er is geen sprake van een wet, richtlijn of andere vorm van verplichting die door de overheid wordt opgelegd als het gaat om de wijze waarop het Sinterklaasfeest wordt gevierd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat 60 procent van het Defensiepersoneel geen vertrouwen in de minister heeft

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister whether she is aware that 60% of defence personnel reportedly lack confidence in her, whether she still considers herself credible, and when a new collective labour agreement and compensation for the WUL and AOW gap will follow. The minister acknowledges eroded staff confidence due to cuts and reorganisations, says a new cao cannot be guaranteed before the November budget debate, and declines to detail negotiation content while pointing to a structural 50 million euro allocation and a planned AOW-gap solution.
I cannot give guarantees on the timing of completion, but my aim is to reach good cao agreements as quickly as possible.
Ik kan geen garanties geven voor het tijdstip van voltooiing, maar mijn streven is zo snel mogelijk tot goede cao-afspraken te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over verijdelde islamitische terreuraanslagen in België

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about foiled jihadist attacks in Belgium, whether Dutch threat levels will rise, links to Dutch jihadists, attack counts, and whether administrative detention and loss of nationality for recruiters will be introduced. The minister said the threat level stays at Substantieel, declined to discuss individual cases or attack numbers, and rejected administrative detention for now while noting other measures, including possible reporting duties and contact bans, are being considered.
Recruiting for jihad is a criminal offence. The public prosecution service decides case by case on possible prosecution.
Het ronselen voor de jihad is een misdrijf. Het openbaar ministerie beslist per geval over eventuele vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het op vrije voeten stellen van jihadgangers

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the release of jihadist fighters after pre-trial detention was not extended for three of four suspects, and whether administrative detention would help prevent such outcomes. The minister explained the court process (appeal, detention reinstated then suspended with passports seized) and said existing criminal and administrative tools suffice, so administrative detention is not necessary, though temporary measures are being considered.
I do not currently consider it necessary to create administrative detention possibilities.
Ik acht het creëren van administratieve detentiemogelijkheden op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Italiaanse illegalen-taxi's

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Italian taxi drivers are smuggling illegal migrants into the Netherlands, how many were caught, and what measures are taken. The State Secretary said the number transported by taxi is unknown, about 150 smugglers were arrested (none Italian), and pointed to EU-level and bilateral measures against secondary migration.
It is not known how many illegal migrants have been transported by Italian taxi drivers.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel illegale migranten door Italiaanse taxichauffeurs zijn vervoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de voorwaarden voor een ANBI-status

Mr Van Klaveren asks the State Secretary of Finance whether a foundation holding ANBI status, Stichting Democratie en Media, may legitimately favour left-leaning media subsidy applications while rejecting right-leaning ones. The State Secretary confirms the foundation's ANBI status, says an ANBI may serve a specific ideological segment, and states that the Belastingdienst's ANBI team assesses both statutes and practice, but declines to comment on supervision of an individual institution.
I cannot make any statements about the supervision of an individual institution.
Over het toezicht op een individuele instelling kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het wegsturen van een agent in de Schilderswijk

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a police officer was removed from the Schilderswijk after firm action, under foreign pressure, and whether officers should receive special tension training. The minister denied that the officer was dismissed or disciplined, saying his posting change was planned for training reasons before the incident, and declined to return him.
No, that is not correct. The police officer was not sent away.
Nee dat klopt niet. De politiemedewerker is niet weggestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over ebola in Nederland

Two Groep Bontes/Van Klaveren MPs asked the Minister of Health about a possible Ebola case in Roelofarendsveen and whether Dutch ebola medicines and preparedness were adequate. The minister replied that the suspected patient, a returning doctor, tested negative for Ebola (malaria was the cause), that hospitals and GGDs are prepared, and that the RIVM is pursuing experimental drug supply.
I have asked the RIVM to actively follow developments in experimental ebola medicines and to keep me informed.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd de ontwikkelingen van experimentele medicijnen tegen ebola actief te volgen en mij daarvan op de hoogte te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een oplossing voor de massale toestroom van asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary whether the asylum system is inadequate given mass inflow, whether asylum seekers could be housed in other countries, and why the government will not push for a Dutch opt-out in EU migration policy. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the system is inadequate, rejected housing asylum seekers abroad as a general principle while allowing it in acute emergencies, and argued that migration must be tackled through joint European action.
The Cabinet stands for ensuring that persons who need protection actually receive that protection.
Het Kabinet staat er evenwel voor dat personen die bescherming nodig hebben, deze bescherming ook daadwerkelijk krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over activiteiten van Stichting Kinderpostzegels

An MP asked the minister whether the government will investigate subsidised 'anti-Israeli' support by charities such as Stichting Kinderpostzegels, after Urk boycotted the foundation over a project in the Palestinian territories, and why it receives over a million euro in government subsidy. The minister rejected the characterisation, defended the project and the partnership model, and saw no reason for a broad investigation beyond existing reporting obligations.
I see no reason for an investigation such as the one the questioner refers to.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een onderzoek als waar vragensteller naar verwijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de veel te linkse publieke omroep

An MP asks the State Secretary about the Raad voor Cultuur's view that public broadcasting is too left-leaning and whether the government will correct this and dismantle the current broadcasting system. The State Secretary disputes the premise citing audience and monitoring research, promises a forthcoming policy letter on public media, and rejects dismantling.
I do stand for an independent and pluriform public broadcaster.
Ik sta wel voor een onafhankelijke en pluriforme publieke omroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de enorme geweldsdruk op gevangenisbewakers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about rising violence against prison guards and whether planned job cuts in prison staffing are wise. The State Secretary reported falling incident numbers, said staff safety is a condition of DJI's budget cuts, and gave no new commitments beyond continued monitoring.
The development in the number of violent incidents is closely monitored by the Custodial Institutions Agency.
De ontwikkeling van het aantal geweldsincidenten wordt door de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen nauwlettend gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over onze ontmantelde krijgsmacht

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister about the state of the Dutch armed forces, including whether they can contribute to fighting ISIS, the NATO 2% spending norm, and a long-term vision. The minister answered that the armed forces remain capable, that the 2% commitment will be addressed in a letter before the budget debate, and that the existing course in the 2013 policy note still applies.

As the Prime Minister promised during the General Political Considerations, the cabinet will inform the House of Representatives by letter before the Defence budget debate, planned for 12 and 13 November, on how it implements the Van der Staaij motion.

Zoals de Minister-President heeft toegezegd in de Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen zal het kabinet de Tweede Kamer vóór de begrotingsbehandeling van Defensie, gepland op 12 en 13 november, per brief informeren over de wijze waarop het kabinet uitvoering geeft aan de motie-Van der Staaij
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht Kogel voor een allochtone familie

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report on threats against a migrant family, including a bullet delivered to their home, and how the family's safety is guaranteed. The minister confirmed awareness, said an investigation is ongoing and declined to give details on the status of the investigation or on any protective measures.
I cannot give you any information about the status of this criminal investigation.
Over de stand van zaken van dit opsporingsonderzoek kan ik u geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de islamitische bedreiging van een christen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about reports of a Christian man being spat on and threatened by Muslims, whether the perpetrators were arrested, whether Yezidis are also threatened, and what measures will prevent escalating violence linked to returning jihadists. The minister answered that a complaint was filed, no arrests yet, no indications of threats to Yezidis, and pointed to the integrated jihadism action programme for measures.
The criminal investigation has not yet led to arrest(s).
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek heeft nog niet tot aanhouding(en) geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over onzalige accijnsverhogingen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether excise increases on fuels yielded little or a net loss, whether fuel sales dropped, and whether the planned 2015 inflation adjustment would be cancelled. The State Secretary referred to his cover letter for most questions and said the 2014 excise revenue trend and falling sales do not justify cancelling the 2015 inflation correction.

Neither the development of fuel excise revenue in the first half of 2014 nor the trend of declining fuel sales, due among other things to a more fuel-efficient vehicle fleet and the economic situation, give cause to suspend the inflation correction as of 1 January 2015.

Noch de ontwikkeling van de accijnsopbrengst van brandstoffen in het eerste halfjaar van 2014 noch de trend van teruglopende brandstofverkopen als gevolg van onder meer een zuiniger wordend wagenpark en de economische situatie geven aanleiding om de inflatiecorrectie per 1 januari 2015 buiten werking te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de enorme geweldsterreur door Marokkaanse criminelen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of hundreds of Moroccan-Dutch youths involved in shootings and robberies, and about tougher sentencing, deportation of criminal immigrants and more police funding. The minister declined to give numbers citing ongoing investigations, said existing sentencing law suffices, rejected deportation-by-default and extra police funding, and gave no new commitments.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that concrete numbers of persons involved cannot be linked to this.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) heeft mij bericht dat concrete aantallen van betrokken personen hieraan echter niet kunnen worden verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het tekort aan politierechercheurs door liquidatiegolf

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the shortage of detectives caused by the rise in liquidations is acceptable, whether assaults go unpursued because of police capacity problems, how the many violent offences will be reduced, and whether one billion euros extra should be invested in the police. Minister Opstelten answered that police detective capacity has grown to about 14,000 FTE, that cases are prioritised by seriousness, that a violence-reduction approach is being pursued, and that he is not willing to invest an extra billion.
There is sufficient capacity available at the national police.
Er is voldoende capaciteit bij de nationale politie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een nieuw treindebacle

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary about high breakdown rates and falling punctuality of the IC Direct trains, the reliability of NS's Traxx locomotives, and what measures would be taken. The State Secretary answered that NS and ProRail have introduced measures including a quick-response team, new rolling stock, and periodic reporting to parliament.
I have asked NS and ProRail to periodically inform me about the progress and effects of these measures.
Ik heb NS en ProRail gevraagd mij periodiek te informeren over de voortgang en de effecten van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de groep wetsondermijnende uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about an Amsterdam group of rejected asylum seekers ('We are here') that keeps squatting buildings, and whether national government should cut Amsterdam's municipal fund payments, detain or expel the group, and press Brussels for an immigration opt-out. Secretary Teeven confirmed the squatting, said Amsterdam's policy does not amount to structural undermining of the law, rejected a funding cut, and stated national policy gives no shelter to rejected asylum seekers while pledging EU-level efforts on returns.
I believe the approach of the municipality of Amsterdam described above cannot be characterised as structural undermining of the law through facilitating asylum seekers.
Ik meen dat het hiervoor beschreven uitgangspunt van de gemeente Amsterdam niet kan worden geduid als structurele ondermijning van de wet door het faciliteren van asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over grote geldproblemen bij de recherche

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that overtime budgets for detectives were running out and that surveillance and arrest teams might withdraw their labour. The Minister replied that overtime is compensated first by time off and otherwise by money within budgets, that Amsterdam has already used much of its 2014 overtime budget, and that police capacity is adequate and must be prioritised, rejecting the call for an extra billion euros.
I expect that management and staff will jointly arrive at solutions.
Ik ga ervan uit dat leiding en medewerkers in deze gezamenlijk tot oplossingen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de angst van joodse burgers in de Haagse Schilderswijk

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about fear among Jewish residents of The Hague's Schilderswijk after recent antisemitic incidents, including whether extra protection and an investigation into those planning to leave were warranted. Minister Opstelten answered that additional protective measures are being taken at Jewish institutions, that no separate investigation will be carried out, and that the government will raise the issue at a roundtable on antisemitism.
We do not intend to carry out an investigation as suggested in the question.
Wij zijn niet voornemens tevens een onderzoek zoals in de vraag wordt gesuggereerd te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de onbeheersbare georganiseerde criminaliteit in Noord-Brabant en Limburg

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about organised crime in Noord-Brabant and Limburg, including drug production, criminal earnings, corruption of officials and threats to mayors, and whether a national coordinator for organised crime should be appointed. The Minister declined to confirm or give figures on many allegations, noted the Public Prosecution Service does not comment on threats or rumours about individuals, and said intensified regional police capacity and existing structures make a national coordinator unnecessary.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it does not make statements about possible threats against public officials.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij bericht dat het geen mededelingen doet over eventuele bedreigingen van openbaar bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over ‘Nederlands geld voor terreurorganisaties’

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of money flowing from the Netherlands to terrorist organisations, including the number of FIU reports, amounts, and arrests, and whether anyone sending money should be treated as a member and prosecuted. The Minister confirmed 108 terrorism files were reported to the FIU in 2013, said suspicious transactions do not themselves prove a crime, declined to disclose report contents, and stated that terrorist financing is punishable and that a planned extension of nationality revocation is coming.
I cannot make any statements about the content of the reports.
Ik kan over de inhoud van de meldingen geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de  'radicaliseringsaanpak' van dit kabinet

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about the government's approach to radicalisation, including meeting hate imams with mayors, the failure of the earlier 2007-2011 programme, the link between jihadism and Islam, and closing mosques or expelling imams and returning Syria fighters. The ministers answered that hate preachers are denied visas and can be handled administratively, that prior programme lessons are kept in a knowledge bank, that violent jihadism conflicts with the rule of law, and that nationality revocation for terrorist offences is being prepared.
Preachers or imams from visa-required countries who are known to call for hatred and violence are refused a visa.
Aan predikers of imams uit visumplichtige landen en van wie bekend is dat zij oproepen tot haat en geweld, wordt een visum geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de onzinnigheid van voorschoolse extra taallessen voor allochtonen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about a study reporting no proven effect of pre-school language programmes for children of immigrant background, the cost of roughly 400 million euro per year, and whether parents should bear the costs. The State Secretary disputed that the study shows no effect, cited ongoing quality issues and a forthcoming longitudinal study, gave the annual budget figures, and rejected full cost recovery from parents because education is a child's right.
The pre-cool study does meet the conditions for (quasi-)experimental research, so that reliable conclusions become possible.
Met het «pre-cool» onderzoek wordt wel voldaan aan de voorwaarden voor (quasi) experimenteel onderzoek zodat betrouwbare uitspraken mogelijk worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het opheffen van het locatieverbod en enkelband voor Volkert van der Graaf

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the minister finds it outrageous that a court lifted the location ban and electronic tag for Volkert van der Graaf, the murderer of Pim Fortuyn, and what steps would be taken against it. State Secretary Teeven replied that it is not for him to judge court rulings, noted the decision was an interim measure, and said the Public Prosecution Service has appealed and he awaits the higher court's ruling.
It is not for me to judge rulings of a judge.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over uitspraken van een rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de stelselmatige terreur tegen joden in Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked how the government will respond to reported systematic intimidation and threats against Jewish people in the Netherlands, including antisemitism linked to anti-Israel demonstrations, and who pays for security costs. The minister condemns antisemitism, outlines dialogue and an interfaith meeting, explains the limits of the mayor's powers over demonstrations, and says the state covers security measures it imposes while individuals are first responsible for their own protection.

The cabinet will, as also announced in the joint statement after consultation with Jewish organisations on 4 August, take the initiative with all relevant parties to discuss the rising tensions between groups and intervene where necessary.

Het kabinet zal, zoals ook is aangekondigd in de gemeenschappelijke verklaring na het overleg met de Joodse organisaties op 4 augustus jongstleden, in navolging van verschillende gemeenten, het initiatief nemen met alle betrokken partijen om de oplopende spanningen tussen groepen te bespreken en waar nodig te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een anti-Israëlische ambtenaar op het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a civil servant at the ministry who publicly claimed ISIS was a Zionist plot, and whether such a person could pose a state security risk given access to sensitive information. The minister distanced the government from the statements, explained the official was in a support role outside the NCSC's operational work, and reported her secondment was ended and she was suspended pending possible employment consequences.
At this stage the person concerned has been informed of the intended employment-law consequences.
In dit stadium is betrokkene geïnformeerd over de voorgenomen rechtspositionele gevolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Klaveren over “het groeiende antisemitisme en anti-Israëlsentiment”

The MP asks the ministers about a Sparta goalkeeper calling the CIDI a criminal organisation, the KNVB's response, why Muslim communities do not condemn conflicts abroad, and whether antisemitism is growing. The minister deplores the remark, notes the KNVB and Sparta see no role for themselves, and defers the question on growing antisemitism to a parallel answer given to the Prime Minister.
Both the KNVB and football club Sparta see no role for themselves in this.
Zowel de KNVB als voetbalclub Sparta zien hierin geen rol voor zichzelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de groei van het anti-homogeweld

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a reported rise in violence against gay people in Amsterdam, whether it is structural, the ethnic background of suspects, and whether repressive measures should replace prevention. The minister acknowledged a modest rise in registered incidents (176 to 189), declined to record suspects' ethnicity, and restated a combined prevention and repression approach included in the Veiligheidsagenda 2015-2018.
The national police does not record the ethnic background of suspects or perpetrators.
De Nationale politie registreert niet op de etnische achtergrond van verdachten of daders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanhoudende antisemitische golf die ons land overspoelt

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the government about a rising wave of antisemitic incidents in the Netherlands, including a violent attack, and why they had not yet adopted ten proposed action points. Minister Asscher answered that the government rejects antisemitism, will hold a round table and an interfaith meeting, and will inform parliament on jihadism and prevention measures, but did not commit to adopting the specific ten action points.

The cabinet will, as also announced in the joint statement after the meeting with Jewish organisations on 4 August, take the initiative with all parties involved, following several municipalities, to discuss the rising tensions between groups and intervene where necessary.

Het kabinet zal, zoals ook is aangekondigd in de gemeenschappelijke verklaring na het overleg met de Joodse organisaties op 4 augustus jongstleden, in navolging van verschillende gemeenten, het initiatief nemen met alle betrokken partijen om de oplopende spanningen tussen groepen te bespreken en waar nodig te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de NAVO-vrees voor een Russische inval

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister about NATO fears of a Russian invasion of Ukraine, the value of Russia's humanitarian convoy proposal, next NATO steps, a defence vision, and reaching 2% of GDP on defence. The minister answered that Russian forces are massed at the border, that NATO is preparing reassurance measures to be decided at the Wales summit, and that further defence cuts are not advisable, with the spending question left to Prinsjesdag.
The cabinet is of the view that further cuts to Defence do not seem advisable, given the developing security situation in the Euro-Atlantic region.
Het kabinet is van mening dat verdere bezuinigingen op Defensie, gegeven de zich ontwikkelende veiligheidssituatie in de Euro-Atlantische regio, niet voor de hand liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de recente ebola-uitbraak in Afrika

An MP asked the Health Minister about Dutch preparedness for a possible Ebola arrival, including whether flights from affected countries should be blocked and what the government would do given spread to Nigeria and transport of cases to the US. The minister answered that RIVM advises organisations, protocols and reporting duties exist, WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions, and RIVM monitors developments closely.
RIVM follows the daily updates issued by the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) and the World Health Organization (WHO).
Het RIVM volgt de dagelijkse updates die het European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) en de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO) uitgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het schrappen van vluchten van en naar ebola-landen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why KLM still flies to Nigeria during the Ebola outbreak while British Airways suspended flights, how the government views staff fear, and whether it will close Dutch airspace to Ebola-country flights. The minister answered that airlines make their own assessments, that the WHO advises no travel restrictions which the government follows, that screening and guidance are in place, and that closing airspace is not proposed.
No. We currently follow the WHO advice, which states that no restrictions on international traffic are necessary.
Nee. Wij volgen op dit moment de adviezen van de WHO die aangeeft dat er geen beperkingen van internationaal verkeer nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over hakenkruizen bij een anti-Israëldemonstratie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about swastika flags shown at an anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, whether anyone had been arrested, what measures would be taken, and about rising antisemitism. The minister answered that the mayor had acted within the Municipal Act after the organiser was warned, that no arrests had been made, that a criminal complaint is being examined by the Public Prosecution Service, and that the government is addressing antisemitism with stakeholders.
With regard to the statements made during the demonstration of 12 July 2014 in The Hague, a criminal complaint has been filed.
Ten aanzien van de uitingen die zijn gedaan tijdens de demonstratie van 12 juli 2014 in Den Haag, is aangifte gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de antisemitische demonstratie in Den Haag

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about an antisemitic demonstration in The Hague, including Hitler salutes, threats to journalists and calls to kill Jews, and why no arrests were made. The minister condemned antisemitism, attributed the rise in incidents to tensions linked to the Middle East conflict, referred to answers given to parallel questions, and said the mayor is accountable to the municipal council, with no commitment to new action.
The assessment of the mayor's conduct is therefore primarily reserved for the municipal council.
De beoordeling van de handelwijze van de burgemeester is dan ook primair voorbehouden aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een demonstratie in de Schilderswijk

Two MPs asked the ministers about a demonstration in the Schilderswijk in The Hague, including why police rerouted an anti-ISIS march, how many people were arrested, whether such neighbourhoods undermine state authority, and whether a billion euros should be invested in the police. The government answered that six people were arrested, referred to earlier answers on the policing and order questions, rejected the call for an extra billion euros for the police, and said the police have sufficient resources.
During the demonstration of 10 August, six persons were arrested.
Tijdens de demonstratie van 10 augustus jl. zijn er 6 personen aangehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over visserij-uitspraken van Eurocommissaris Damanaki

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the State Secretary shares criticism of EU Commissioner Damanaki's call for consumers to avoid fish caught with bottom-disturbing methods, and whether she will publicly oppose the remarks to defend Dutch fisheries. The State Secretary answered that the Commissioner's views are her own responsibility, that bottom trawling does affect ecosystems, that she supports pulse fishing, and that the Commissioner did not target Dutch fishing specifically.
What the Commissioner writes in her weblog is primarily her own view and her own responsibility.
Wat de Eurocommissaris in haar weblog schrijft, vind ik primair aan haar en is haar verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht inzake felicitaties van het kabinet aan Erdogan met zijn verkiezing

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government condemns Erdogan's antisemitic remark comparing Israeli policy to Hitler's, whether it is aware of his record on press freedom and human rights, and why it congratulated him on his election. The Minister answered that congratulating heads of state with regular relations with the Netherlands is customary and the government sees no reason to depart from it.
It is customary to congratulate heads of government of states with which the Netherlands maintains regular relations on such occasions.
Het is gebruik om regeringsleiders van staten waarmee Nederland reguliere betrekkingen onderhoudt bij dergelijke gelegenheden te feliciteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het anti-Israëlbeleid van de gemeente Eindhoven

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether Eindhoven's street names with inscriptions referring to 'Palestina' (e.g. Tiberiasstraat) wrongly suggest Israeli cities lie in Palestine, and asks the minister to ask the municipality to change the signs. The minister replies that the inscriptions refer to the Biblical Palestine background of the names, that street naming is a local matter, and that the municipality has decided to remove the inscriptions during regular sign replacement.
Street names and the placement of signs belong par excellence to local autonomy.
Straatnamen en de plaatsing van borden behoren bij uitstek tot de lokale autonomie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het EU-advies om onder andere belastingen op consumptiegoederen te verhogen

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about an EU Eurogroup statement urging Dutch labour tax reduction offset by higher consumption or environmental taxes, and whether the government would commit to no tax increases until 2017. The State Secretary confirmed the statement, said tax shifting is for member states to decide, and promised a broader letter on the tax system after the summer, without committing to the requested tax freeze.
Whether and how tax shifting takes place is, given the sovereignty of Member States in fiscal matters, up to the Member States themselves.
Of en hoe verschuiving van belastingen plaatsvindt, is gezien de soevereiniteit van de Lidstaten op fiscaal gebied aan de Lidstaten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat de marineleiding helikopters wil kopen als alternatief voor de NH-90

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister whether, after the NH-90 problems, a replacement combat helicopter should be bought quickly and whether the Seahawk should be considered. The Minister replied that compensating measures are being worked out, that the NH-90 problems are being addressed with NAHEMA and the manufacturer, that there is no reason yet to consider another helicopter type, and that the defence budget is part of the overall budget deliberations.
Defence is currently working on compensating measures to reduce the capacity shortfall, including the deployment of additional own Cougar helicopters.
Defensie werkt momenteel compenserende maatregelen uit om het capaciteitstekort te verminderen, waaronder de inzet van extra eigen Cougar-helikopters.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over meer dan 500 dagen geen Defensie-CAO

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister why more than 500 days have passed without a new collective labour agreement for defence personnel, citing financial pressure and asking for a 10% pay rise for 2015. The minister answered that the previous agreement's terms remain in force, that delays are normal under a wage freeze, promised an study of financial problems among soldiers, and said pay talks with unions are ongoing without committing to a specific figure.
I promised your House during the oral question hour on 15 April that research would be carried out into financial problems among military personnel.
Ik heb uw Kamer in het mondelinge vragenuur op 15 april jl. toegezegd onderzoek te laten doen naar financiële problemen onder militairen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het verbod op de Morgenstervlag tijdens Veteranendag

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Defence Minister whether the government bears responsibility for the Veterans' Day committee, which includes military staff, banning the Morgenstern flag, and whether it would ask the committee to allow it. The minister answered that the committee is independent, understands the ban as reinforcing the formal character of the parade, and refused to request that the flag be allowed.
The Netherlands Veterans' Day Committee has an independent status, in line with the advice of the Van Eekelen Committee in 2003.
Het Comité Nederlandse Veteranendag heeft een onafhankelijke status, overeenkomstig het advies van de Commissie-Van Eekelen in 2003.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de militaire dreiging door Venezuela om Aruba binnen te vallen

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about reports of a Venezuelan military threat to invade Aruba, the release of Venezuelan intelligence chief Carvajal, and Maduro's remarks about escalation, and whether defence spending should rise. The minister answered that Carvajal was released because he enjoys consular immunity under international law, that justice is autonomous for Aruba, that Maduro's remarks were noted from the media, and that further defence cuts are not advisable though any increase will be considered in budget talks.
Diplomatic and consular relations, including immunity, are powers of the Kingdom.
Diplomatieke en consulaire relaties, inclusief immuniteit, zijn bevoegdheden van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het hoogste aantal asielzoekers in 13 jaar

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the highest number of asylum seekers in 13 years, including concerns about integration, welfare, police and courts burden, and whether opt-outs on immigration should be pursued in the EU. The State Secretary answered that the surge requires extra effort across the migration chain, that opening reception locations is being accelerated with local information, that Eritrean and Syrian applicants are often granted protection, and that Netherlands will not seek an EU immigration opt-out but will pursue joint EU action on return.
I also want to push ahead with a joint, effective EU approach to return.
Ook wil ik graag doorpakken op een gezamenlijke, effectieve EU-aanpak voor terugkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht “VS willen meer veiligheid luchthavens Europa”

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the US is pressing for tighter security at European airports with direct flights to the US, whether Dutch airports are affected, and whether explosives without metal are a threat to Schiphol. The government confirmed that only Schiphol is affected, that the threat of non-metal explosives is known and monitored with the US and partners, and that additional security measures for US-bound flights took effect on 8 July.
Schiphol is the only Dutch airport to which this applies.
Schiphol is de enige Nederlandse luchthaven waarop dit van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over gevaarlijke jihadisten die buiten beeld zijn

An MP asked why European intelligence services exchange few jihadist names, whether open borders enable jihadists to move unnoticed, when border controls will be reintroduced, and what steps will improve data sharing. The Staatssecretaris answered that cooperation is improving, that reintroducing border controls is not proportionate now and is a last resort, that a national action programme will follow, and referred to earlier answers for data sharing.
At this moment, deploying these extreme measures is not proportionate to their effectiveness.
Op dit moment staat het inzetten van deze uiterste maatregelen niet in verhouding tot de effectiviteit daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een antisemitische oproep tot geweld tijdens de Haagse pro-ISIS-demonstratie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he knew of a reported antisemitic call to violence (invoking Khaybar and 'Joden, herinner je Khaybar') at a pro-ISIS demonstration in The Hague, and what measures would follow. The State Secretary said he had noted the report, that discriminatory statements are punishable, and that the Public Prosecution Service is gathering complaints and will assess whether the statements were criminal.
Following these complaints and the Omroep West broadcast, the Public Prosecution Service will assess whether there are criminal statements.
Naar aanleiding van deze aangiften en de uitzending van Omroep West zal het Openbaar Ministerie beoordelen of er sprake is van strafbare uitlatingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Klaveren over het uiten van extreme geweldsdreigementen en het plegen van daadwerkelijk terroristisch geweld tegen (de Joodse inwoners van) Israël door te

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Van Klaveren asked whether Fatah officials and affiliated groups calling for violence and firing rockets at Israel should be treated as terrorism, whether the Palestinian Authority is responsible, and whether EU and Dutch funding and cooperation should be halted. Minister Timmermans answered that these are not formal Fatah statements, that Fatah is a political movement that renounced violence, and that suspending cooperation is not on the table, while pledging to raise the issue at the EU Foreign Affairs Council.
No. Fatah is a political movement that has renounced violence.
Nee. Fatah is een politieke beweging die geweld heeft afgezworen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de integratie van de Luchtmobiele Brigade in het Duitse leger

Van Klaveren asked the Defence Minister whether integrating the Luchtmobiele Brigade into the German army is a step toward a European army, whether it limits Dutch sovereignty, and whether the government should instead invest heavily in national defence. The minister replied that no European army is planned, that each country keeps the final say over its own troops, that sovereignty is strengthened through shared capabilities, and that cooperation is not a budget-cutting measure.
Even with the integration of units, Germany and the Netherlands each have the final say over the deployment of their own military personnel.
Ook bij de integratie van eenheden geldt echter dat Duitsland en Nederland elk het laatste woord hebben over de inzet van de eigen militairen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een veroordeelde pedofiel

MPs asked how a convicted sex offender was able to obtain housing above a childcare centre in Amersfoort and whether such offenders could be barred from child-rich areas. The State Secretary said the municipality did not allocate the home, the offender arranged it himself and the mayor was informed only after the move, and that barring offenders from all child-rich areas is not practically feasible, while pointing to a bill on longer supervision.
The mayor of Amersfoort informed me that there was no allocation of a home by the municipality.
De burgemeester van Amersfoort heeft mij gemeld dat er geen sprake was van toewijzing van een woning door de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een Nederlandse topdiplomaat die steun wilde geven aan Hamas

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel seeks to declare UN envoy Robert Serry persona non grata for allegedly trying to channel aid to Hamas, and whether the Netherlands should condemn his action. The minister confirmed the media reports, explained Serry's account of a Palestinian request about paying Hamas-employed civil servants in Gaza, and said Dutch involvement was not at issue.
On the basis of the information described in the answer to questions 2 and 3, the cabinet does not consider Dutch involvement to be at issue.
Op basis van de informatie zoals beschreven in het antwoord op vragen 2 en 3 acht het kabinet Nederlandse betrokkenheid niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het niet vervolgen van vluchtelingen met valse papieren

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether a Supreme Court ruling stops prosecution of refugees entering with false papers, its effect on asylum policy, the expected number affected and pull effect, and whether the government would denounce the Refugee Convention to reverse it. State Secretary Teeven answered that prosecution remains possible only after a final asylum refusal or after a residence permit is granted, the ruling does not directly affect admission policy, and denouncing the Convention is not an option.
The Supreme Court ruling concerns the criminal prosecution of foreigners for using false or forged travel documents.
Het arrest van de Hoge Raad ziet op de strafrechtelijke vervolging van vreemdelingen voor het gebruiken van valse of vervalste reisdocumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Klaveren over een door terrorisme-experts verwachte aanslag

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about expert warnings of a terrorist attack and whether all returned Syria fighters are actually monitored, and whether administrative detention should be introduced. The minister responded that the AIVD gives highest priority to these returnees and additional capacity has been freed, but declined to introduce administrative detention because existing criminal and administrative instruments are considered sufficient.
Research into these jihadist returnees therefore has the highest priority at the AIVD.
Het onderzoek naar deze jihadgangers heeft bij de AIVD dan ook de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst winst van WK-pooltjes wil gaan belasten (Herdruk)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority intends to tax winnings from World Cup pools above EUR 454 and whether this is absurd, including for bingo and raffles. The State Secretary answered that the 29% gambling tax applies to pools outside the private sphere above that threshold, that the Tax Authority is not actively hunting pool organisers and has other priorities, and gave no concrete new measures.

As I also stated in my answer to the question from MP Koolmees, it is definitely not the case that the Tax Authority is now actively hunting Dutch people who organise a World Cup pool among family or friends.

Zoals ik ook in mijn antwoord op de vraag van het Kamerlid Koolmees heb gesteld, is het beslist niet zo dat de Belastingdienst nu actief jacht maakt op Nederlanders die in familie- of vriendenkring een WK-poule organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een islamitische geweldsprediker

An MP asked the ministers whether preacher Al-Haddad's activities in Almere, a municipality labelled a jihad town, are monitored and whether such preaching harms integration. The minister stated that hateful or violence-inciting statements are unacceptable, that individual monitoring cannot be disclosed, and that the mayor had publicly distanced herself from the preacher and reminded the inviting group of its responsibilities.
I cannot make public statements about the application of measures on an individual basis.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over de toepassing van maatregelen op individuele basis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een opgepakte jihadist

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a returned jihadist held in pre-trial detention for preparing a terrorist offence and weapons possession, including his contacts, the destination of the proceeds of a planned robbery, and whether other returnees finance jihad. The minister confirmed the detention extension, declined to comment on concrete cases or ongoing investigations, and described general financial-monitoring arrangements and criminal liability for financing terrorism.
As you know, I do not make statements about concrete cases or ongoing investigations.
Zoals u weet, doe ik geen uitspraken over concrete gevallen of lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de relatie tussen de bekostiging van de jihad en de georganiseerde criminaliteit

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether jihadists who went to Syria had prior police or prosecution contact, whether criminal money funds jihad, how counterterrorism policy addresses links with organised crime, and whether all returning jihadists should be placed in administrative detention. The minister answered that criminal backgrounds are weighed in threat assessments, that financial flows are mapped but criminal funding is often unclear, that existing criminal and administrative tools suffice, and that additional administrative detention is not considered necessary.
In line with earlier correspondence with your House on this subject, the Cabinet currently does not consider it necessary to create additional administrative detention powers for counterterrorism.

Conform eerder correspondentie met uw Kamer over dit onderwerp, acht het Kabinet het creëren van aanvullende administratieve detentiemogelijkheden ten behoeve van terrorismebestrijding, op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren inzake het artikel in de Telegraaf van 23 mei jl. over de leegloop van de krijgsmacht

An MP asked the Defence Minister about a Telegraaf report that one in five military posts is unfilled and whether this endangers operations, and what causes the staffing problem. The minister denies the one-in-five figure, says vacancies are shrinking and operations are not at risk, attributes the shortage to cautious recruitment during reorganisations, and says Defence must invest in personnel and pay regardless of budget level.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een verboden vlag tijdens Veteranendag

MPs asked the Defence Minister whether the Indonesian embassy pressured organisers to ban the Morgenster flag at the Veterans Day parade and why it was banned for the first time. The minister replied that the organising committee decided in 2013 to allow only regiment flags at the formal parade, that veterans may carry the flag on the Malieveld, and that the decision is the committee's responsibility.
The organisation of Veterans Day falls under the responsibility of the Dutch Veterans Day Committee.
De organisatie van de Veteranendag valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van het Comité Nederlandse Veteranendag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Hamas die toetreedt tot de Palestijnse regering

An MP asked whether Hamas was joining the Palestinian Fatah-led government and whether Dutch aid to the Palestinian Territories should be cut as a result. The minister denied that Hamas had joined, described the government as technocratic and unaffiliated, and said the cabinet would judge it on its actions without expressing outrage.
No. Hamas has not joined the Palestinian government.
Nee. Hamas is niet toegetreden tot de Palestijnse regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over studiefinanciering voor jihadstrijders

MP Van Klaveren asked whether jihadist fighters receive student finance, how many and how much, whether all such benefits should be stopped permanently, and whether students in proliferation-sensitive fields could pose a risk. The minister confirmed that some departed Dutch jihadists received student finance, that it has been stopped for all known cases, that social benefits were stopped in some dozens of cases, and described the export-control style ministerial exemption procedure for proliferation-sensitive studies, but gave no numbers or amounts.
In the interest of the effectiveness of the approach, I do not provide information on specific cases.
In het belang van de effectiviteit van de aanpak doe ik geen mededelingen over concrete gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de onmogelijkheid tot herinvoering van grenscontroles

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the Eritrean influx justified reinstating internal border controls, what counts as a threat to public order, and whether EU asylum and migration directives harm the Netherlands and warrant an opt-out. Secretary Teeven answered that the influx is not a serious threat under EU law, that border checks mainly target illegal stay and cannot stop asylum applicants, that the directives harmonise law usefully, and that an opt-out would need a treaty change so it is not on the table.
Migration and crossing of external borders by a large number of third-country nationals may in principle not be regarded as a threat to public order or internal security.

Migratie en het overschrijden van buitengrenzen door een groot aantal onderdanen van derde landen mag in beginsel niet worden gezien als een bedreiging van de openbare orde of de binnenlandse veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over Turkse rellen in Rotterdam

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked why only one person was arrested after riots by Turkish football supporters in Rotterdam, how costs would be recovered, and whether the riots reflect failed integration. The minister said the response focused on restoring public order, camera footage would be used to investigate offenders, damage recovery would be pursued through criminal and civil routes if damage is identified, and the incidents were treated as isolated.
Based on camera footage, further investigation will be carried out into persons who committed criminal offences.
Op basis van camerabeelden zal nader onderzoek worden gedaan naar personen die strafbare feiten hebben gepleegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de verdubbeling van geweld tegen homo's

An MP asked the ministers whether the reported doubling of violence against gay people (based on police-registered incidents rising from 623 to 1,143) is accurate, whether police will make combating anti-gay violence a top priority, and whether the rise is linked to the growing influence of Islam. The government answered that the figures cover all registered discrimination incidents based on sexual orientation, not only violence, that police anti-violence work remains a top priority and will be pursued in the 2015-2018 security agenda, and it rejected the link to Islam.
Yes, tackling violence is and remains a top priority of the police.
Ja, de aanpak van geweld is en blijft een topprioriteit van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het zoveelste anti-joodse incident

An MP asked the ministers about an antisemitic defacement of an Anne Frank poster, the causes of rising antisemitism, and whether the perpetrators have been caught. The government condemned the act, pointed to a planned follow-up study on triggers of antisemitism among youth due early 2015, and reported that police investigated but no suspect has been arrested.
To be able to combat antisemitism better, I previously promised a follow-up study examining the trigger factors that contribute to the emergence of antisemitism.
Om antisemitisme beter te kunnen bestrijden heb ik eerder een vervolgonderzoek toegezegd, waarin de triggerfactoren, die bijdragen aan het ontstaan van antisemitisme, worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over kermisgeweld door allochtone jongeren

An MP asked the ministers about youths harassing fairground visitors and shoppers in IJmuiden, whether the offenders would be arrested, and how to prevent them escaping with community service. The state secretary answered that police investigation is ongoing, that the local authority decides on measures, and that sentencing is for the judge, who may impose community service alone only in limited circumstances.
The police investigation into this incident has not yet been concluded.
Het politieonderzoek naar dit incident is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een half miljard extra voor ontwikkelingshulp

The MP asks whether the extra 500 million euros for development aid is due to EU accounting rules, whether public support will erode, and whether the money should instead go to tax relief at home. The minister answers that aid is tied to GNP, the ESA2010 revision drives the budget change, 0.6 billion was reserved, and the exact effects will only be known by the Miljoenennota 2015.
The Chamber will be further informed about this no later than the Miljoenennota 2015.
Hierover zal de Kamer uiterlijk bij Miljoenennota 2015 nader worden geïnformeerd.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes (Groep Bontes/Van Klaveren) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de dreiging na een antisemitische aanslag in Brussel (ingezonden 27 mei 20

Two MPs asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about security threats to Jewish institutions in the Netherlands after an antisemitic attack in Brussels, and whether the Jewish community should contribute to its high security costs. The minister answered that Dutch authorities monitor the situation closely, that no official data confirm growing European antisemitism, that one suspect with Syria links is known, and referred the cost question to an earlier answer.
Yes, that is correct. The security situation in the Netherlands is closely monitored by the Dutch authorities.
Ja, dat klopt. De (veiligheids)situatie in Nederland wordt door de Nederlandse autoriteiten nauwlettend in de gaten gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over mogelijk honderd nieuwe Syriëgangers

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that about a hundred potential jihadists were being monitored in nine municipalities and whether administrative detention should be introduced for counter-terrorism. The minister confirmed over a hundred travellers to Syria, described case-by-case threat assessments and local multidisciplinary interventions, and said the government does not consider new administrative detention powers necessary because existing criminal and administrative instruments suffice.
As I have previously informed your House, the Cabinet considers creating additional administrative detention powers for counter-terrorism purposes unnecessary.
Zoals ik eerder uw Kamer heb bericht, acht het Kabinet het creëren van aanvullende administratieve detentiemogelijkheden ten behoeve van terrorismebestrijding, niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een ‘Nederlandse’ terreurstudent

Van Klaveren asked whether a Saudi terror suspect studying in the Netherlands, allegedly linked to Al-Shabaab, was known to the intelligence services and should be denied entry, have his studies ended and his student finance reclaimed. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, but explained that IND can refuse or withdraw residence permits on the basis of an AIVD report without a criminal conviction, and that non-EEA students receive no Dutch student finance.
I do not make public statements about individual cases.
Ik doe in het openbaar geen mededelingen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de mogelijke doodstraf na bekering tot het christendom

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentence imposed on a Sudanese woman for converting to Christianity, and whether Dutch aid to Sudan should be halted. The government condemned the verdict, summoned the Sudanese ambassador, pursued EU action and noted that Dutch bilateral aid ended in 2011, with remaining humanitarian and NGO funding not to be stopped now.
The Netherlands will closely follow the case and, depending on the progress of the legal proceedings, consider with EU partners what further measures can be taken.
Nederland zal de zaak nauw blijven volgen en, afhankelijk van het verloop van de rechtsgang, samen met EU-partners bezien welke verdere maatregelen genomen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Nederlandse zelfmoordterroristen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about Dutch nationals who became suicide bombers abroad, the victims, their dual nationality, whether AIVD budget cuts should be reversed, and whether the threat level will be raised. The minister confirmed two Dutch suicide attacks, declined to give victim or nationality details for operational reasons, said jihadist investigations were prioritised through internal reprioritisation, and stated the threat level remains substantial with no direct change.
For operational reasons I cannot publicly address matters that could reveal the identity of the two Dutch suicide bombers.
Ik kan om operationele redenen niet in het openbaar ingaan op zaken die de identiteit van de twee Nederlandse zelfmoordterroristen kunnen prijsgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Nederlandse zelfmoordjihadisten in martelarenvideo's

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch suicide jihadists are glorified in martyrdom videos, whether distributing such videos is punishable, whether intelligence services' budget cuts are wise, whether administrative detention and deprivation of nationality for returning jihadists are warranted. The government answered that such videos are not punishable per se, that NCTV asks providers to act under their own terms, that the AIVD reprioritised internally, that existing criminal tools suffice instead of administrative detention, and that deprivation of nationality is possible only for dual nationals after a final terrorism conviction.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de voortgaande subsidiëring van anti-Israël organisaties

An MP asked whether Dutch taxpayer money funds Palestinian NGOs (Badil, Addameer, Al-Haq) via the Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat, and whether an investigation or measures to stop such funding are planned. The minister answered that the funding supports rights monitoring, that the Secretariat has strict selection and suspension procedures, and that no investigation or additional measures are considered necessary.
On the basis of the above, the cabinet sees no reason to take additional measures.
Het kabinet ziet op grond van het bovenstaande geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de mishandeling van een gehandicapte bejaarde

An MP asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a reported assault and robbery of a disabled elderly man, including the suspects' background, whether arrests were made, and whether criminal foreigners should be expelled for violent crimes. The minister says the Public Prosecution Service found the report to be a false complaint and explains the existing rules for expelling foreign offenders.
Research by the Public Prosecution Service shows that there was a false complaint.
Uit onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie blijkt dat er sprake is van een valse aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat Duitse agenten asielzoekers weigeren aan de grens

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether German police really turn asylum seekers back at the border and whether the Marechaussee should get the same powers. State Secretary Teeven answered that German authorities forward asylum requests to their federal migration office rather than returning people, that border handover under the Benelux-German treaty applies to illegal immigrants, and that he sees no reason to change Marechaussee powers.
Following the Telegraaf report, I immediately made inquiries with my German colleague.
Naar aanleiding van het bericht in de Telegraaf heb ik direct navraag gedaan bij mijn Duitse collega.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de zware en zinloze mishandeling van een voorbijganger

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a severe group assault on a passer-by in Gulpen and whether suspects had been arrested and whether perpetrators should always face prison rather than community service. The minister condemned the violence, said an investigation is ongoing with several suspects arrested, declined further comment for investigative reasons, and noted that the law requires a custodial element when serious assault is prosecuted.
In view of the interests of investigation and prosecution, I cannot make further statements about this incident.
In verband met de belangen van opsporing en vervolging kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over dit incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over tentendoeken als bescherming tegen raketaanvallen

An MP asked the Defence Minister why Dutch soldiers in MINUSMA were housed in tents rather than armoured containers from day one, why the housing policy was not smoother after the Chinook helicopter problems, and whether defence spending should rise to 2% of GDP. The minister answered that the threat level justified tents initially due to container delivery times, that armoured containers are now being procured, and that the current defence budget is adequate.
Defence will not hesitate to take additional measures if necessary.
Defensie zal niet aarzelen om aanvullende maatregelen te nemen indien dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Klaveren over de invoering van de sharia in Brunei

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Sharia criminal law taking effect in Brunei applies to non-Muslims, how many Dutch nationals are there, and what measures will protect them. The minister confirmed the first phase took effect 30 April 2014, said the law reaches non-Muslim residents and foreigners though some provisions apply only to Muslims, and promised monitoring with EU embassies and advice to Dutch citizens.

In close contact with EU member state embassies established in Brunei Darussalam and the international business community there, how the introduction and enforcement of the new legislation develops will be assessed.

In nauw contact met de in Brunei Darussalam gevestigde ambassades van EU-lidstaten en het daar gevestigde internationale bedrijfsleven zal worden beoordeeld hoe de invoering en handhaving van de nieuwe wetgeving zich zal ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over jihadsteden in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported 'jihad cities' in the Netherlands, whether passport revocation is useful given dual nationality, the nationalities of jihadist sympathisers, and whether deportation or denaturalisation should be a structural solution. The minister declined to name the cities, said case-by-case measures are chosen, noted most persons hold a second nationality, and rejected deportation as a structural solution.
Since it is up to the municipalities concerned whether or not to communicate about this matter, I make no statements about it.
Aangezien het aan de betrokken gemeenten zelf is om wel of niet te communiceren over deze kwestie, doe ik hierover geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de extra miljoenen voor de EU en ontwikkelingshulp

An MP asked whether the national net contribution to the EU and development aid would rise due to a revised national accounts methodology, and how this affects lastenverlichting. The ministers answered that the effect cannot yet be quantified, that information will follow in the Voorjaarsnota and Miljoenennota 2015, and that they do not share the view that the money should go to tax relief at home.
The cabinet will inform the House in the Voorjaarsnota about changes in this budget year to EU contributions compared with the Miljoenennota 2014.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer in de Voorjaarsnota informeren over wijzigingen die zich dit begrotingsjaar in de EU-afdrachten voordoen ten opzichte van de Miljoenennota 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de groei van het aantal eerwraakmoorden

An MP asks the ministers of Security and Justice and Social Affairs about the reported growth in honour killings, whether this is linked to immigration from Islamic countries, what measures will be taken, and whether perpetrators should be deported after serving their sentences. The minister confirms awareness of the reported figures and refers the MP to earlier answers to parallel questions, without substantive answers in this document.
I refer to my answers to the written questions from members De Graaf and Wilders of your House.
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders van uw Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over gewelddadig tuig in Rotterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a violent home invasion by youths in Rotterdam, whether suspects had been arrested and their nationalities, and whether penalties should be raised. The minister said the investigation is ongoing and cannot be discussed, that local authorities choose the measures, and that statutory maxima are adequate.
I cannot make further statements about this investigation because of the interests of investigation and prosecution.
Over dit onderzoek kan ik verder geen mededelingen doen vanwege de belangen van opsporing en vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over allochtone homohaters uit Amersfoort

MPs asked the ministers about reports that a gay man in Amersfoort was driven out of his neighbourhood by harassment from young men, and whether mass immigration and Islamisation hinder gay emancipation and whether perpetrators should be expelled or punished more harshly. The ministers condemned discrimination, said perpetrators must be tackled and victims protected, rejected expulsion of Dutch nationals, and listed existing local and national support measures without new concrete commitments.
Perpetrators must be tackled and victims protected.
Daders moeten worden aangepakt en slachtoffers beschermd.
Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over hulp aan terugkerende jihadisten (ingezonden 14 maart 2014).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Arnhem would help a returned jihadist with work or study, whether such returnees should be punished rather than helped, and whether administrative detention should be introduced. The minister declined to discuss concrete cases, said existing criminal and administrative tools suffice so additional administrative detention is not necessary for now, and noted that reintegration help may sometimes be sensible.
As previously reported to your House, I consider creating additional administrative detention powers for counter-terrorism purposes not necessary for the time being.
Zoals eerder aan uw Kamer gemeld 3 , acht ik het creëren van aanvullende administratieve detentiemogelijkheden ten behoeve van terrorismebestrijding voorshands niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Madlener en Wilders over gesjoemel met EU-subsidie voor moskeeën

MPs asked whether Amsterdam and the Interior Ministry obtained EU subsidy for two mosques by misdescribing a building as a multicultural centre, and asked about a mosque construction halt and punishment of those responsible. The minister answered that the mosque part was excluded from subsidy, that the subsidy went to Amsterdam Groot-Oost rather than the ministry, that the OLAF investigation outcome is pending, and rejected a construction halt and a withdrawal of EU involvement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het toenemende antisemitisme

An MP asked the minister about rising antisemitic incidents, whether they relate to mass immigration and Islam, and how the government will respond to a professor's claim about Islamic antisemitism. The minister confirmed the rise in reported incidents, denied a link to immigration, pointed to research on youth antisemitism, and said the government will focus on combating youth antisemitism.
No, I do not see that relationship.
Nee, die relatie zie ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over ‘jihadbruiden’

An MP asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about female jihadist travellers to Syria, including passport measures, administrative detention and stripping dual nationals of Dutch citizenship. The minister answered that case-by-case criminal and administrative measures apply, that administrative detention is not considered necessary, and that citizenship can be revoked only after a final terrorism conviction for dual nationals.
I therefore do not consider it necessary to create additional administrative detention powers for counterterrorism.
Ik acht daarom het creëren van aanvullende administratieve detentiemogelijkheden ten behoeve van terrorismebestrijding niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over een jihadist uit Almere die poseert met 5 afgehakte hoofden

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a jihadist from Almere photographed with five severed heads, asking about his punishment, expulsion and the government's approach to jihadists leaving the Netherlands. The minister confirmed awareness of the photo, said the man's residence right had ended with a 20-year entry ban, and described measures such as stopping benefits, freezing assets and local-triangle interventions, while declining to disclose individual-level details.
However, I cannot make further public statements about the application of the aforementioned measures on an individual basis.
Ik kan echter in het openbaar geen nadere mededelingen doen over toepassing van voornoemde maatregelen op individuele basis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over antisemitische propaganda door organisatie 'Stop de Bezetting'
