An MP asked the ministers whether they were aware of antisemitic articles on the website of Stop de Bezetting, whether they condemn them, what they will do about the group's past funding from Oxfam Novib, and whether they will investigate antisemitic propaganda by subsidised organisations. The government condemned antisemitism, said the articles were not found on the site (one was found elsewhere), noted no subsidy relationship with the ministry, and said that only a court can determine discrimination, so filing a complaint is the appropriate route.
Whether there is discrimination under the criminal code can only be determined by the judge.
Of er sprake is van discriminatie op grond van het wetboek van strafrecht kan alleen de rechter bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de oproep een Marokkaanse dame 50 zweepslagen te geven

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice about calls for a Moroccan businesswoman to receive 50 lashes after she opened a wine shop, including death threats she received. Minister Opstelten called the call for lashes unacceptable, left the criminal qualification to the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declined to disclose investigative or protection measures, and said nationality revocation and expulsion for common crimes are not possible.

It is not in the interest of the investigation or of the person concerned to make public statements about whether, and if so which, investigative actions in this case have been or are being carried out.
Het is niet in het belang van de opsporing en van betrokkene om publiekelijk mededelingen te doen over de vraag of, en zo ja welke, opsporingshandelingen in deze zaak zijn of worden verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over het vrijlaten van Syrië-gangers

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he is aware of a court releasing Syria-travellers pending trial, whether they should be detained rather than released, and whether administrative detention and denaturalisation should be used against returnees. The minister answered that courts weigh flight and recidivism risk, that reclassering supervision intensity follows a risk instrument, that the AIVD assesses returnees, and that administrative detention is unnecessary since criminal and administrative tools already exist.
I cannot make statements about the specific situation of the persons concerned.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over de specifieke situatie van betreffende personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een islamitische terrorist die poseert met afgehakt hoofd

An MP asked why a jihadist shown posing with a severed head was not detained despite revoked residence rights, and whether administrative detention is needed against terrorism. The government said he was arrested in 2011, released for lack of serious suspicion, left for Syria with a 20-year entry ban, that prosecution was dropped for lack of national interest, and that it sees no need for new administrative detention powers.
I therefore do not consider it necessary to create additional detention possibilities for the purpose of counterterrorism.
Ik acht het creëren van een aanvullende detentiemogelijkheden ten behoeve van terrorismebestrijding dan ook niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Turkse campagnes tijdens de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen 2014

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether campaigns for Dutch municipal elections should be conducted in Dutch, questioning the credibility of a minister responsible for integration who campaigned in Turkish. The minister answered that everyone has the same rights and duties, that political parties may reach non-Dutch speakers through campaigns, and that no measures are planned.
Political parties are free to reach these people and actively involve them in our democracy through a campaign.
Het staat politieke partijen vrij deze mensen te bereiken en actief te betrekken bij onze democratie door middel van een campagne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de vermeende steunbetuiging op Facebook van een PvdA-raadskandidaat aan islamitische terreurorganisaties

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a PvdA council candidate who 'liked' jihadist Facebook pages, including ISIS and Al-Nusra-linked ones, found this objectionable and whether it incited violence. The minister confirmed awareness of the 'likes', noted the candidate's statements that she follows groups she does not support, and called such online jihadist expressions worrying without committing to any concrete action.
I have taken note of the fact that a PvdA council candidate clicked the so-called 'like' button on various Facebook pages with a jihadist profile.
Ik heb kennisgenomen van het feit dat een PvdA-raadskandidaat bij diverse Facebook-pagina's met een jihadistisch profiel de zogenaamde « like » knop heeft aangeklikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de groeiende groep terugkerende jihadisten

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice where returned jihadists are located, why they are not arrested on return, and whether administrative detention should be introduced. The minister declined to disclose locations, said the AIVD assesses threats, the OM examines criminal investigation per case, and rejected administrative detention as unnecessary given existing criminal and administrative tools.
I do not make public statements about concrete cases.
Ik doe in het openbaar geen mededelingen over concrete gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over "de levenslange uitkering van remigranten"

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether it is fair that migrants who return under the Remigration Scheme receive a lifelong benefit, health insurance allowance and no job-seeking obligation, and whether the PVV proposal to abolish these will be adopted. The minister answered that the scheme targets long-term benefit-dependent migrants who voluntarily return, that payments are based on living costs in the country of origin and are lower than Dutch benefits, and that the amended Remigration Act takes effect on 1 July, referring to parliamentary debate for further detail.
On 1 July the amendment to the Remigration Act takes effect.
Op 1 juli aanstaande treedt de wijziging van de Remigratiewet in werking.
Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over indoctrinatie door de islamitische Gülenbeweging (ingezonden 3 februari 2014).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Gülen movement is anti-Western and indoctrinates children in Gülen study houses, and what measures will be taken. The minister answered that there is no evidence of Islamisation aims, could not confirm the 100-study-house figure, said parents may send children to such institutions provided they follow the law, and saw no need for measures.
I see no need to take measures.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de explosieve stijging van de OZB voor huiseigenaren

An MP asked the minister whether he knew of reports that homeowners face sharply higher property tax (OZB) and whether he would act so that OZB cannot rise when WOZ values fall. The minister said municipalities set their own OZB rates under the Gemeentewet, that he would not change this, and that the revenue norm is under evaluation.
Under the Municipalities Act, it is each municipality's autonomous power to set its OZB rate every year.
Ingevolge de Gemeentewet is het een autonome bevoegdheid van iedere gemeente om jaarlijks hun OZB-tarief vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over trainingen voor de jihad in thuislanden van westerse Syrië-gangers

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Western jihadists are trained in Syria for attacks at home, how this is reflected in policy, how many have returned, and whether administrative detention and citizenship revocation should be used. The minister answered that the terrorism threat level was raised, that policy covers intelligence, criminal and administrative tools, roughly twenty jihadists have returned, administrative detention is deemed unnecessary, and dual nationals can lose Dutch citizenship after a final terrorism conviction.
No statements are made about concrete cases.
Over concrete gevallen worden geen mededeling gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Haagse loyaliteit aan Al-Qaida

An MP asked whether the government recognises the violent character of a jihadist pledge made in The Hague, what links exist to Al-Qaida, and whether recruiting for jihad should be punished by denaturalisation and deportation. The minister declined to discuss individual cases, cited the existing criminal provision on recruitment and the limited grounds for revoking nationality, and said the government rejects such conduct while treating Islam as a religion and jihadist radicalisation as a security and integration issue.
I do not make concrete public statements about individual cases.
Ik doe in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een jihadistische radiozender

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the jihadist radio station Radio Ghurabaa, whether other Islamic stations call for violence, why it is not taken off air and prosecuted, and whether the government recognises a violent character of Islam. The minister confirmed the station is jihadist propaganda, said no other Islamic stations concretely call for violence, explained that the NCTV only alerts internet providers who must assess content under their own terms and that prosecution is for the OM, and denied that Islam is inherently violent.
The decision on possible prosecution rests with the Public Prosecution Service.
De beslissing tot eventuele vervolging ligt bij het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de aanhoudende Marokkaanse straatterreur in Helmond

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked about youth street crime in Helmond, its harsh enforcement, the over-representation of Moroccan-Dutch youths in crime statistics, and why criminal non-citizens and dual nationals are not deported or stripped of nationality. The minister replied that policing has been intensified with a zero-tolerance approach, that the approach does not distinguish by ethnicity, that sentencing is for the prosecution service, and that revoking Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible.
The share of suspects among Moroccan-Dutch boys under 23 is indeed much higher than the share of suspects among native Dutch youths.
Het aandeel verdachten onder Marokkaans-Nederlandse jongens tot 23 jaar is inderdaad veel hoger dan het aandeel verdachten onder autochtone jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het bericht dat €15 miljoen Nederlands belastinggeld voor een vliegveld in Tanzania

An MP asked the minister why the Netherlands co-finances a Tanzanian airport upgrade (EUR 15 million) while Dutch services are cut, and why aid flows to a country seen as corrupt. The minister defended the ORIO infrastructure project, said anti-corruption clauses apply and payments go to the contractor, and rejected reversing the decision.
Preventing and combating corruption is a priority for the Netherlands and the EU.
Het voorkomen en tegengaan van corruptie is voor Nederland en de EU een prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren over jonge criminelen die hulpverleners uitlachen

PVV MPs Helder and Van Klaveren asked the Justice Minister about young criminals mocking youth-care and police workers, doubting the effectiveness of the youth gang approach, judges' acquittals, expanding ISD measures to 12-year-olds, and parental liability. The minister rejected the claim that the approach fails, pointed to judicial independence, said ISD is being tested for 16-23 year olds and youths 12+ already have sanctions, and noted parents can be prosecuted or held liable for damages up to age 14 or 15 in civil law.
On 12 November 2013 I informed the House of Representatives about this.
Op 12 november 2013 heb ik de Tweede Kamer hierover geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over “islamitische geweldsprediking”

An MP asks whether mosques calling for violence should be closed immediately and whether Islam is inherently violent, and urges action against 'Islamisation'. The ministers answer that incitement to violence is prohibited and the Public Prosecution Service can ask a court to close an institution acting against public order, but they reject judging a religion by a violent minority and do not commit to new measures.
Calling for hatred or inciting violence is explicitly not permitted.
Het oproepen tot haat of het aanzetten tot geweld is nadrukkelijk niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Klever en Wilders over het zwichten van voetbalclub Vitesse voor de Jodenhaat van de VAE (Verenigde Arabische Emiraten)

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether Vitesse's decision to travel to the UAE without Jewish player Dan Mori, who was unwelcome there, reflects antisemitism and dhimmitude, and what measures would follow. The minister called the decision a bad signal, acknowledged concern about contemporary antisemitism and announced a study into its causes, but declined any measures against the club and noted that the question about admitting the player was moot after the team's return.
It was a bad signal from Vitesse to travel to the United Arab Emirates without its own player Mori.
Het was een slecht signaal van Vitesse om zonder haar eigen speler Mori af te reizen naar de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en De Graaf over Oost-Europese overlast op vakantieparken

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers about nuisance and overcrowding caused by Eastern European migrant workers housed on holiday parks, including whether a deterrence policy should replace the national housing declaration and whether work permits should be reintroduced. The government answered that municipalities enforce nuisance rules, that regional agreements have added 31,000 housing places, that free movement of workers cannot be reversed under the accession treaties, and that permanent occupation of recreational homes is a municipal matter.
Statistics Netherlands examined, in the municipalities of the 9 regions of the Flexwonen Arbeidsmigranten programme, how many migrant workers are housed in which municipality.
Het CBS heeft onderzocht in de gemeenten uit de 9 regio’s van het programma Flexwonen Arbeidsmigranten hoeveel arbeidsmigranten er in welke gemeente gehuisvest zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en De Roon over subsidies voor anti-Israëlische hulpclubs

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and De Roon asked whether Dutch government subsidies to Oxfam Novib, which funds the Coalition of Women for Peace (said to back an Israel boycott), should stop, and how much money flowed to such groups. The minister confirmed Oxfam Novib funds a project from its own resources rather than government money, declined to comment on a Canadian minister's remarks, and refused to end subsidies.
Since 2013 Oxfam Novib provides funds from its own resources to the Coalition of Women for Peace.
Oxfam Novib verstrekt sinds 2013 fondsen uit eigen middelen aan de organisatie Coalition of Women for Peace .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het bericht dat er minder verkochte woningen zijn geregistreerd en er meer gedwongen verkopen waren

An MP asked the housing minister about the Kadaster report of fewer home sales in late 2013, rising forced sales, and when households with negative equity will recover. The minister attributed the December dip to a tax-driven peak in 2012, argued that sales recovered in Q4, said forced sales are a lagging indicator, and listed measures to help households with restschulden move.
I see signs of growing confidence in the housing market.
Ik zie tekenen van groeiend vertrouwen op de woningmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over falend toezicht op jihadisten

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that supervision of jihadists had failed, how many supervised jihadists had left for abroad, whether returnees should be arrested and denaturalised, and when jihad as such would be criminalised. The minister answered that one supervised person probably went to Syria, outlined the existing tools (AIVD risk assessments, prosecution, passport revocation, citizenship withdrawal) and noted that participation in jihadist fighting is already punishable under article 134a of the Criminal Code.
At present there is one departee who was under supervision of the probation service.
Op dit moment is sprake van één uitreiziger die onder toezicht van de reclassering stond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Klaveren over Arabische informatiebrieven van woningcorporaties

PVV MPs Fritsma and Van Klaveren asked whether housing corporations send information letters in Arabic, whether others do so, and what measures will stop it. The minister said one letter about waste collection in Leeuwarden was sent in Dutch, English and Arabic on behalf of the municipality, that no national overview exists, and that communication should be in Dutch with exceptions; he committed to no new measures.
No national overview exists of the information housing corporations provide, or in which language they do so.
Er bestaat geen landelijk overzicht van de informatie die door corporaties wordt verstrekt noch in welke taal zij dit doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over levenslange gevangenisstraf voor homo's in Oeganda

An MP asked whether the government condemns Uganda's bill imposing life imprisonment for homosexuality and whether all development aid to Uganda should stop. The minister called the bill a violation of fundamental human rights, said it is too early to assess consequences since the president had not signed it, and argued that keeping aid lets the Netherlands keep pressing for non-discrimination.
Stopping development aid makes it harder to exert pressure and keep attention locally on the principle of non-discrimination.
Het stopzetten van ontwikkelingshulp maakt het moeilijker om druk uit te oefenen en de aandacht lokaal op het principe van non-discriminatie te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Roon en Madlener over belastinggeld voor Palestijnse ambtenaren

PVV MPs asked how many Palestinian officials and pensioners funded by EU and Dutch money are former prisoners convicted of terrorism, asked why aid to the Palestinian Authority is rising, and whether it should be halted and reclaimed. The minister said Pegase salary payments exclude sanctioned persons, could not confirm the $50,000 figure, and that the government sees no reason to change the policy.
The cabinet sees no reason to change this policy, as also stated in the Coalition Agreement.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om dit beleid, zoals tevens verwoord in het Regeerakkoord, te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over het subsidiëren van een aan Milli Gorus gelieerde islamitische stichting

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether a Milli Gorus-affiliated youth foundation (MGT) receiving municipal subsidy should lose its funding after its annual report was written 'in the name of Allah', and what measures the government would take. The minister answered that the Amsterdam-West district is responsible for subsidy decisions, that MGT received about EUR 21,725.50 in 2013 for two project subsidies with no 2014 subsidy so far, and that the subsidies do not violate church-state separation, so no further measures were announced.
In this case it is up to the Amsterdam-West district to weigh the granting of subsidies.
Het is in dit geval aan het stadsdeel Amsterdam-West om een afweging te maken ten aanzien van het verstrekken van subsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over opgepakte jihadisten in Turkije

The MP asked whether Turkey had arrested jihadists with Dutch nationality, what happened to those returned to the Netherlands, and why the government does not apply harsher repression and deportation. The minister replied that no information is available from the OM or police on such cases, that AIVD assesses each returnee and OM considers prosecution case by case, and that no further public statements on concrete cases will be made.
About any information provided by the Turkish intelligence and security services to the AIVD, I make no further public statements.
Over eventuele informatie verstrekt door de Turkse inlichtingen-en veiligheidsdiensten aan de AIVD doe ik in het openbaar geen verdere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Roon en Wilders over Nederlands belastinggeld voor anti-Israëlische propaganda

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch aid money funded a youth NGO's broadcast calling Israelis 'crows and rats' and whether aid to the NDC and Palestinian Authority should stop. The minister condemned the rhetoric, denied NDC funds went to the producer PYALARA, and declined to halt aid.
The cabinet condemns this kind of incitement.
Het kabinet veroordeelt dergelijk opruiend taalgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema over de voortgaande islamisering van het universitaire onderwijs

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether a VUmc workshop on treating patients of the other sex and related Islam-linked activities at a Dutch university are acceptable and whether measures will be taken against 'Islamisation' of higher education. The minister answered that the event is a legitimate diversity activity within institutional autonomy, that education remains accessible and lawful, and that she will take no measures.
I do not intend to take measures.
Ik ben niet voornemens maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en De Roon over de jihadcoalitie

MPs Van Klaveren and De Roon asked about a reported jihadist coalition in Syria, the number of Dutch jihadists involved, and whether participation should be criminalised with citizenship revocation and expulsion. The minister answered that the coalition groups are not designated terrorist groups and are distinct from ISIL and JaN, that about a hundred Dutch nationals are fighting there, and that participation is already punishable under article 134a Sr with citizenship revocation possible under conditions.
Participating in jihadist fighting or following training abroad is punishable under article 134a of the Dutch Criminal Code.
Het deelnemen aan de jihadistische strijd of training volgen in het buitenland is strafbaar op grond van artikel 134a Wetboek van Strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de komst van geweldsimam Al Haddad

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether the minister knew of reports that Islamist preacher Al-Haddad called for stoning adulterers and death for apostates, whether he posed a public-order threat, and whether he should be expelled. The minister said such statements would be reprehensible but prosecution is for prosecutors and courts, that Al-Haddad may voice his views, and that under EU rules a British citizen can only be refused entry for a genuine, serious threat to public order, which was not established; the event was reported cancelled.
The assessment of criminal liability must in an individual case first be made by the public prosecutor and ultimately by the criminal court.
De beoordeling van de strafbaarheid dient in een individueel geval in eerste instantie door het openbaar ministerie en uiteindelijk door de strafrechter te geschieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Van Klaveren over multiresistente bacteriën bij deelnemers aan de jihad in Syrië

MPs Klever and Van Klaveren asked whether returning jihadists from Syria could carry multi-resistant bacteria, whether they are screened and whether they should be quarantined. The minister answered that hospital isolation rules apply only to patients treated abroad, that ordinary travellers are not a risk group, and that quarantine is unnecessary, while prosecution is for the public prosecutor.
Because the risk of spread is limited and no different from that of ordinary travellers, it is unnecessary to place this person in quarantine.
Omdat het risico op verspreiding beperkt is en niet anders dan bij «gewone» reizigers is het onnodig deze persoon in quarantaine te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over Nederlands geld voor de jihad in Jemen

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the Justice Minister whether money from the Netherlands funds jihad in Yemen, how much, and what will be done to stop it and prosecute donors. The minister confirmed informal, mostly small-scale flows may reach fighters, said the police and AIVD monitor such flows, and that prosecution under Article 421 of the Criminal Code is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide case by case.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service (OM) to decide case by case whether to proceed with prosecution.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) om per geval te besluiten of tot vervolging wordt overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Klaveren over een jihadistische ex-militair

Two MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers whether a former Dutch soldier who served in 2009-2010 is now fighting as a jihadist in Syria, whether others have done so, and whether participating in jihad should mean loss of Dutch nationality. The minister confirmed the report is likely accurate, said two other ex-soldiers are possibly fighting, and explained that nationality can be revoked only after a final conviction for a terrorist offence, only if the person holds another nationality, and only for offences committed after 1 October 2010.
For every person returning from Syria, it is examined whether criminal action is necessary and possible.
Van elke persoon die terugkeert uit Syrië wordt gekeken of strafrechtelijk optreden noodzakelijk en mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Klaveren over het extreme graaien door corporatiebobo's

Opposition MPs Fritsma and Van Klaveren asked the minister whether he knew of reports that housing corporation directors would receive a 42% pay increase, requested a salary overview, and asked what measures would bring the salaries down. The minister confirmed the reports, referred to an earlier overview of 2012 pay, said the 2014 maximum-pay regulation allows higher maxima than before while at least 40% of current directors must be brought down over time, and stated that all corporations are bound by the regulation and will be enforced against.
All housing corporations are bound by the 2014 Regulation on maximum remuneration of senior officials of recognised housing associations, and enforcement will take place accordingly.
Alle woningcorporaties zijn aan de Regeling bezoldigingsmaxima topfunctionarissen toegelaten instellingen volkshuisvesting 2014 gebonden en daarop zal gehandhaafd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over banen en opleidingen voor jihadisten

Two MPs asked whether returning jihadists are being helped with jobs, training and neighbourhood activities instead of being prosecuted, and what measures will stop this. The minister answered that each returnee gets a threat assessment, criminal prosecution is examined case by case, a local tailored approach may be used to reduce threat, and the prosecution service is examining criminal investigation options for returnees.
For every person returning from Syria a threat assessment is made and it is examined whether criminal prosecution is necessary and possible.
Van elke persoon die terugkeert uit Syrië wordt een dreigingsinschatting gemaakt en wordt gekeken of strafrechtelijk optreden noodzakelijk en mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het ontslag na melding misstanden moskee-internaten

An MP asks the ministers how they view the dismissal of a civil servant who reported serious misconduct at a mosque boarding school, and whether that employee deserves reinstatement and action against the responsible administrator. The minister declines to comment on individual employment decisions, says the dismissal is the responsibility of the municipality of Rotterdam and a matter for the courts, and states no intention to intervene.
I do not intend to interfere in a matter that falls under the own responsibility of the municipality of Rotterdam.
Ik ben niet voornemens te interfereren in een zaak die tot de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Rotterdam moet worden gerekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over het verbod op de intocht van Zwarte Piet

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government shares a view that Dutch traditions such as Zwarte Piet should be protected against multicultural objections, and what it will do given moves to ban the Piet arrival and remove Piet from schools. The minister answered that the Sinterklaas celebration is a matter for society and local committees and schools, and declined to take national action.
The arrival is a local matter. School boards are free to celebrate festivities and shape them as they see fit.
De intocht is een lokale aangelegenheid. Schoolbesturen zijn vrij om naar eigen inzicht feesten te vieren en deze vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over tientallen miljoenen extra voor ontwikkelingshulp

An MP from the PVV asked the minister why 50 million euros in development aid, allegedly earmarked for trade, would be added and whether lowering aid to cut taxes at home would be wiser. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, described a parliamentary amendment to shift 50 million euros from the Dutch Good Growth Fund to Syria relief and child welfare, and defended aid as contributing to stability and development in the Netherlands.
The Dutch commitment is aimed at eradicating extreme poverty within one generation and promoting sustainable and inclusive growth in the Netherlands and in low and middle-income countries.
De Nederlandse inzet is gericht op het uitbannen van extreme armoede in één generatie en het bevorderen van duurzame en inclusieve groei in Nederland en in lage en midden-inkomenslanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de beveiliging van joodse instellingen

An MP asked the ministers whether they would act against the roughly 800,000 euro yearly security costs borne by Jewish institutions and about research on antisemitism among Muslim youth. The minister replied that security is risk-based and applied equally to all institutions, that no new measures are currently warranted, and that antisemitism is addressed as a priority and a Dutch study is planned.
For every citizen, cultural, religious or educational institution, security measures are taken in the same way on the basis of threat and risk.
Voor iedere burger, culturele, religieuze of onderwijsinstelling worden op gelijke wijze beveiligingsmaatregelen genomen op basis van dreiging en risico.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de bouw van een moskee in Groningen

An MP asked the ministers whether they know of plans for a new mosque in Groningen, how it is financed and by which foreign actors, and whether they will stop its construction given alleged antisemitic and misogynistic content. The minister answered that the mosque is financed by its own foundation and congregation, that the municipality contributes nothing, and that building new mosques is permitted under the constitution unless laws are broken, refusing to halt construction.
The construction of new mosques is permitted in the Netherlands, on condition that Dutch rules and laws are not violated.
De bouw van nieuwe moskeeën is in Nederland toegestaan, op voorwaarde dat de Nederlandse regels en wetten niet worden overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Europese steun aan Wit-Rusland

An MP asked whether EU aid flowing to Belarus under President Lukashenko, including a border-management project, is absurd and how much Dutch contributions went there. The minister answered that EU support is limited, targets the population and democratisation, and that the border project (EUR 2 million spent in Belarus in 2012 from a EUR 44 million regional programme) serves European security interests; he gave no commitment to stop funding.
The EU provides limited support to Belarus: a full partnership with the regime of President Lukashenko is ruled out.
De EU verleent beperkt steun aan Wit-Rusland: een volwaardig partnerschap met het regime van president Loekasjenko is uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de jihad vlag op een Haags veld

An MP from the PVV asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers how to interpret a jihad flag displayed on a The Hague football pitch, what the danger of jihadist ideology is, and whether sharia exists in The Hague. The minister called the incident an expression of support for jihadist ideas, described jihadism as the core of the terrorist threat, and said there is no separate sharia-based legal system competing with the democratic legal order in The Hague.
There is no separate legal system in The Hague competing with the democratic legal order.
Er is in Den Haag geen sprake van een aparte, met de democratische rechtsorde concurrerend rechtssysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de Marokkaanse groepsmishandeling van een vrouw

MPs from the PVV asked about a reported group assault on a woman by Moroccan men, whether the perpetrators had been arrested, whether the government would acknowledge a 'Moroccan problem' and expel convicted offenders, and whether group liability should be extended. The minister replied that police found the woman admitted to fabricating the account, a false-report procedure was started, and that group participation in violence is already punishable under article 141 of the Criminal Code, referring to earlier answers for the rest.
Following this confession, the police drew up an official report against her for filing a false complaint.
Naar aanleiding van deze bekentenis heeft de politie proces-verbaal tegen haar opgemaakt wegens het doen van een valse aangifte.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Klaver over de uitwerking van het verlaagde energiebelastingtarief voor decentrale duurzame elektriciteitsopwekking door coöperaties en V.v.E.’s zoals overeengekomen in het

GreenLeft MPs asked how the reduced energy tax rate for cooperatives and homeowners' associations generating renewable electricity would work, including metering, self-consumption, and whether business members may participate. The State Secretary answered that metering and netting are allowed under conditions, that business members are excluded for policy and state-aid reasons, and that the scope for business small users will be studied by summer 2014.
Entrepreneurs may not be members of the cooperative, because the scheme is intended for local renewable energy generation by cooperatives of, and for, private small consumers.

Ondernemers mogen geen lid zijn van de coöperatie, omdat de regeling is bedoeld voor de lokale duurzame energie opwekking van energie door coöperaties van – en ten behoeve van – particuliere kleinverbruikers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over bezwaren tegen het Sinterklaasfeest

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Sinterklaas celebration is part of Dutch culture, whether objections to it should be disregarded, and whether the Amsterdam arrival with Zwarte Piet will go ahead. The minister answered that the feast is part of Dutch culture with differing views coexisting, did not recognise the portrayal of a 'go-away' mentality, and said the arrival is a local matter in which the national government has no role.
The arrival of Sinterklaas is a local matter. The national government has no involvement in it.
De intocht van Sinterklaas is een lokale aangelegenheid. Het Rijk heeft daar geen bemoeienis mee.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma over het onophoudelijke graaien van woningbobo's

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether he knew of reports that housing corporation directors' salaries were rising again, requested a 2012 salary overview, demanded that excess pay be repaid and apologies offered, and asked what measures he would take. The minister confirmed awareness, said no Wopt report for 2012 exists and offered confidential 2012 salary data later, stated that excess pay cannot yet be formally established under the WNT and that he finds high pay inappropriate, and said he will intervene for 2013 overruns where applicable.
For remuneration in 2013 I can and will intervene in case of breaches of the applicable norms, insofar as they do not fall under the transitional law of the WNT.
Voor de bezoldiging over 2013 kan en zal ik bij overschrijdingen van de geldende normen en voor zover niet vallend onder het overgangsrecht in de WNT ingrijpen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de Ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bouw van de grootste moskee van Nederland (ingezonden 16 september 2013

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about the financing of the Ulu mosque in Utrecht, the wages of its board and imam, and how to stop new mosque construction. The minister answered that the mosque was funded by donations, board members are unpaid, the imam is paid by ISN, and that building mosques is lawful under freedom of religion, while urging mosques to be transparent about financing.
I generally do not have information on the financing of mosques or houses of worship and/or their administrators.
Ik beschik in het algemeen niet over informatie over de financiering van moskeeën of gebedshuizen en/of de bestuurders daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de voortgaande buitenlandse islamitische inmenging in Nederland

An MP asked the government about foreign Islamic financing of a Rotterdam foundation (reportedly 380,000 USD from the Islamic Development Bank), the risks to integration, and measures against foreign funding of mosques. The minister said foreign funding is permissible but intervention is warranted where core democratic values are at stake, that the state cannot intervene in mosque boards or finances due to church-state separation, and that mosques should be transparent, with additional instruments under review.
I therefore call on mosque boards receiving money from abroad to maximise openness in their financial relations with foreign countries.
Ik roep de moskeebesturen die geld ontvangen vanuit het buitenland dan ook op om maximale openheid te betrachten in de financiële relaties met het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Roon en Wilders over "de islamitische inmenging van Koeweit in Nederland"

MPs Van Klaveren, De Roon and Wilders asked whether Kuwaiti state involvement in the Blue Mosque in Amsterdam, including funding and board links, should be tolerated, and whether the mosque should be closed and the Kuwaiti ambassador expelled. The minister said the state cannot intervene in mosque boards or funding absent national security concerns, asked the mosque board for openness on financing, and rejected closure and expulsion.
I do not have information on Kuwait's funding of mosques and/or their administrators.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de bekostiging door Koeweit van moskeeën en/of de bestuurders.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf en Van Klaveren over het bericht ‘Asscher’s hypocriete waarschuwing tegen EU-arbeidsmigranten’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Van Klaveren asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Foreign Affairs about a news report on Asscher's warning regarding EU labour migrants, questioning Polish, Romanian and Bulgarian crime and welfare figures and calling for the closure of borders and reintroduction of work permits. Minister Asscher answered that the crime and welfare figures are relatively elevated but must be nuanced, announced a pilot on residence-rights and benefits and a governmental summit on EU labour migration, and stated the transitional restrictions cannot be extended after 1 January 2014.
Under the Accession Treaties, a Member State of the European Union may (under conditions) impose restrictions on the free movement of workers from new member states.
Op basis van de Toetredingsakkoorden kan een lidstaat van de Europese Unie (onder voorwaarden) beperkingen stellen aan het vrij verkeer van werknemers met nieuwe lidstaten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema en Van Klaveren over het plan van een imam-opleiding op het Ibn Ghaldoun

Two PVV MPs asked whether a Turkish-linked imam training programme at the Ibn Ghaldoun school, funded in part by the Diyanet network, should be allowed and whether public money is involved. The state secretary answered that the school is funded only for secondary education, that the imam training is paid for by a foundation and not public funds, that freedom of religion and educational choice apply, and that the inspectorate's investigation into the school's governance will determine its future.
Ibn Ghaldoun is funded by the national government for providing education within the meaning of the Secondary Education Act.
Het Ibn Ghaldoun wordt door het Rijk bekostigd voor het verzorgen van onderwijs in de zin van de Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de miljoenen voor narcostaat Bolivia

An MP from the PVV asks the minister for Foreign Trade and Development why Dutch taxpayers' money, including indirect funding via NGOs, goes to Bolivia, and whether all aid should stop. The minister says Bolivia's bilateral aid ends in 2014, that NGOs allocate their own funds without reporting per country, and that she does not intend to halt development aid.
These organisations are themselves responsible for allocating government funds by country and report by development objective, and therefore not by country.
Deze organisaties zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de verdeling van de overheidsmiddelen naar landen en rapporteren per ontwikkelingsdoelstelling, en dus niet per land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Agema over gesegregeerde ouderenzorg

MPs Van Klaveren and Agema (PVV) asked whether a care centre for dementia patients organised by cultural background (De Beukelaar, Laurens) is acceptable, how much public money it receives, and whether it should be stopped. The minister said the centre is funded like any AWBZ provider, that cultural background matters for dementia care, that residents mix, and that he will not stop the project.
No, I am not going to do that.
Nee, dat ga ik niet doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het totaal mislukte Vogelaarbeleid

An MP from the PVV asks ministers whether they recognise the link between immigrant overrepresentation in crime and neighbourhood decline in the Vogelaar districts, why hundreds of millions were spent without results, and how future waste and lawlessness will be prevented, including deportation of offenders. The minister replies that the districts were selected on 18 indicators, that evaluations show mixed results, that the structural funding is ended except for nurses, and that further information on liveability will follow in autumn.
In the vision on liveability that you will receive this autumn, I will go into this further.
In de visie op leefbaarheid die u dit najaar ontvangt, zal ik hier verder op in gaan.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de islamitische bedreigingen na arrestatie ronselaarster (ingezonde

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether more recruiters for jihad should be arrested, how Islamic threats after a Zoetermeer recruiter's arrest should be viewed, whether Islam should be combated structurally, and whether jihadist recruiters can be denaturalised and deported. The minister answered that only one arrest has been made so far, rejected all threats, refused to treat Islam as a totalitarian ideology, and said citizenship can be revoked only for dual nationals convicted of terrorism.
For persons holding Dutch nationality, Dutch citizenship can be revoked if the person has been finally convicted of a terrorist offence.
Bij personen die in bezit zijn van de Nederlandse nationaliteit kan het Nederlanderschap worden ingetrokken als de betrokkene onherroepelijk is veroordeeld wegens een terroristisch misdrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over het laffe Marokkaanse geweld tegen twee zusjes

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked the ministers about a violent incident against two sisters by Moroccan youths, the over-representation of Moroccan Dutch in violent crime statistics, the government's seriousness on the issue, and whether offenders should be prosecuted, denaturalised and deported. The minister answered that the SCP explains only part of the gap, that the approach targets risk behaviour without ethnic distinction, that local authorities handle public order, and that revoking Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible.
Revoking Dutch nationality following a conviction for common offences is not possible.
De intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit wegens een veroordeling voor commune misdrijven is niet mogelijk.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Bontes (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het onophoudende Marokkaanse geweld (ingezonden 4 juli 2013).

Three PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers how to interpret reports that Moroccan Dutch are over-represented in violent and property crime, whether mass immigration has made society less safe, and whether a harsher repressive approach and immigration stop are warranted. The minister acknowledged the high crime rates, said SCP research shows background factors explain only part of the gap, and rejected group-based measures and denaturalisation for common crimes, favouring prevention and tough action without ethnic distinction.
Revoking Dutch nationality following a conviction for common crimes is not possible.
De intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit wegens een veroordeling voor commune misdrijven is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het bericht dat huiseigenaren door de bank als melkkoe worden gebruikt

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether banks' mortgage margins are historically high, whether the price-leadership ban on Dutch banks should be ended, and what measures will lower mortgage rates. The minister replied that the ING price-leadership restriction has ended and the ABN Amro ban is being weighed in ongoing Commission talks, and referred to earlier answers on mortgage rates without announcing new measures.
See the answers to questions 2 and 3 from MP Monasch (PvdA) to the ministers of Finance and for Housing and Government Organisation on the ECB interest rate decision.
Zie beantwoording van de vragen 2 en 3 van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en voor Wonen en Rijksdienst over het rentebesluit van de ECB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de belachelijke militaire multiculti-oefening in Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked about child abuse at a Tilburg Koran school, why the complaint did not lead to prosecution, how many complaints against Islamic institutions led to cases, and whether schools promoting hatred should be closed. The minister said the prosecutor found too few leads for further investigation, data cannot be split by institution type, and closure is possible only where needed for public order or building-safety violations.
The Public Prosecution Service assessed the complaint and concluded it offered too few leads for further criminal investigation.
Het OM heeft de aangifte beoordeeld en is tot de conclusie gekomen dat deze te weinig aanknopingspunten biedt voor een nader strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het PvdA-cliëntelisme inzake Rotterdamse moskee-internaten

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about alleged clientelism in Rotterdam Feijenoord district linked to mosque boarding schools, including whether the city board should be placed under supervision and whether a national investigation should follow. The minister accepted the integrity agency's findings, endorsed the imposed supervision of the district board, and said signals of clientelism would be examined, but declined to comment on the employment position of the official who exposed the matter.
Following the BING report, the Rotterdam municipal executive has taken far-reaching measures.
Naar aanleiding van het rapport van BING zijn door het gemeentebestuur van Rotterdam ingrijpende maatregelen getroffen.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over miljoenen belastinggeld voor Afrika

MP Van Klaveren (PVV) asked whether Dutch aid money for Africa should be cut and questioned the grounds for continuing it, including OIC membership and corruption of recipient states. Minister Ploumen defended the aid as contributing to stability and development, declined to characterise the OIC, and refused to withdraw the plan.
No. This contribution to structural solutions fits within the policy as formulated in my memorandum 'What the World Deserves'.
Neen. Deze bijdrage aan structurele oplossingen past binnen het beleid zoals geformuleerd in mijn nota «Wat de wereld verdient».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren,  Bontes en Wilders over 'Ramadandiensten' bij de politie

PVV MPs asked whether police receive extra Ramadan shifts, whether Ramadan and Eid generate more reported nuisance and crime, whether police adapt to Islamic practice, and whether extra deployment could be recovered from convicted offenders. The state secretary confirmed the news report, said police and prosecutors do not record Ramadan-related incidents, stated that the mayor decides deployment based on safety needs, and saw no reason to recover costs.
Neither the police nor the Public Prosecution Service records how many reports are related to Ramadan or the Eid festival.
Er wordt door de Politie of OM niet bijgehouden hoeveel meldingen gerelateerd zijn aan de Ramadan of het Suikerfeest.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, de Roon, Madlener en van Klaveren over de samenwerking tussen de EU en de Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC)

Four PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about EU cooperation with the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation, including its observer status, its stance on criticism of Islam and whether the EU should end contacts. The minister rejected most premises, affirmed continued support for free expression and religious freedom, and declined to end the observer status.
No. However, the OIC has for some time paid considerable attention to combating religious intolerance.
Nee. Wel heeft de OIC al geruime tijd veel aandacht voor het tegengaan van religieuze intolerantie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over Nederlandse sponsoring van een Turks festival in Turkije

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands sponsored a Turkish festival in Bodrum with taxpayer money and whether it would be recovered. The minister confirmed a 5,000 euro contribution to the International Bodrum Carnival to showcase Dutch culture and two Dutch bands, and defended cultural promotion abroad as serving Netherlands' international image.
The Netherlands contributed 5,000 euros to the International Bodrum Carnival in Bodrum, with the aim of introducing a Turkish and international audience to Dutch culture.
Nederland heeft 5.000 euro bijgedragen aan het International Bodrum Carnival in Bodrum, met als doel een Turks en internationaal publiek te laten kennismaken met Nederlandse cultuur.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Wilders en De Roon over de belachelijke militaire multiculti-oefening in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked the Defence minister about a military exercise in Amsterdam neighbourhoods, questioning its purpose, whether soldiers should be taught about Islam, and whether mosque construction is facilitated abroad. The minister replied that contact with local populations is standard training, that cultural customs are respected where needed, and that soldiers do not interfere in local opinions, though infrastructure reconstruction may occur on missions.
Soldiers train daily for all possible deployments and missions of the armed forces within their legal tasks at home and abroad.
Militairen oefenen dagelijks voor alle mogelijke inzet en missies van de krijgsmacht in het kader van de wettelijke taken in binnen- en buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over de wens van het Nederlandse volk de voortgaande islamisering te stoppen

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Klaveren asked the government whether it would stop mosque construction, introduce a constitutional ban on sharia, halt immigration from Islamic countries, and apologise for mass immigration and Islamisation. The minister answered that freedom of religion is a core democratic right, that municipalities decide on new mosques, that nationality is not relevant to residence permits, and that the government does not recognise mass immigration or Islamisation.
People are free to adhere to and profess any religion they choose.
Het staat mensen vrij welk geloof dan ook aan te hangen en te belijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Tony van Dijck over 25% meer betalingsachterstanden op de hypotheken

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Housing and Finance about the 25% rise in mortgage payment arrears, whether the government's policy is causing harm, and whether the PVV's proposal to keep mortgage interest deduction should be pursued. Minister Blok answered that arrears are hard to forecast but not expected to fall soon, that the government's measures give clarity and that he will not change current mortgage rules.
I can agree with the view that stability in the housing market is necessary.
Ik kan mij vinden in het standpunt dat rust op de woningmarkt noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord vragen Helder, Wilders en Van Klaveren over het bericht: ‘Discriminatie in cellen’

Three PVV MPs asked whether non-Muslim prisoners are being discriminated against by Muslim prisoners, whether Muslim prisoners gain undue influence, what measures will be taken, and how many prisoners hold dual nationality. The state secretary answered that no cases of structural discrimination or complaints to supervisory committees are known, that directors can sanction such conduct and file complaints, and that no further measures are needed.
I am not aware of any cases of (structural) discrimination of non-Islamic detainees by detainees with an Islamic background.
Mij zijn geen gevallen bekend van (structurele) discriminatie van niet-islamitische gedetineerden door gedetineerden met een islamitische achtergrond.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Bontes en Helder over de Nederlandse politie als islamitische huwelijksbemiddelaar

Three PVV MPs asked whether police and the subsidised organisation Fier Fryslân helped arrange an Islamic marriage of minors, how many police hours this cost, how many Islamic marriages occur, the link between Islam and honour-related violence, and whether perpetrators should be denaturalised. The minister replied that both organisations did not assist in a religious marriage of a minor, that no data exist on Islamic marriages, that honour codes are cultural rather than religious, that prosecution was suspended in favour of mediation, and that the Nationality Act does not allow denaturalisation for these offences.
That is not correct. Based on the factual account requested from Fier Fryslân and the official police report, both organisations did not assist in a religious marriage of a minor.

Dit klopt niet. Op basis van het bij Fier Fryslân opgevraagde feitenrelaas en het bij de politie opgevraagde ambtsbericht blijkt dat beide organisaties niet hebben meegewerkt aan een religieus huwelijk van een minderjarige.
Antwoord vragen Bisschop en Van Klaveren over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur van 11 mei 2013 inzake een klokkenluider

MPs Bisschop and Van Klaveren asked the minister about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on a whistleblower alleging safety and permit failures and clientelism in Rotterdam. The minister said fire safety was in order, the zoning and permit issue was resolved in April 2013, whistleblower channels exist via the municipal ombudsman and the Adviespunt Klokkenluiders, and he welcomed an independent Rotterdam culture investigation while declining to comment on an individual employee's employment situation.
No statements can be made about the employment situation of individual civil servants and the considerations involved.
Over de rechtspositionele situatie van individuele ambtenaren en de afwegingen daarbij kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en De Graaf over het zwichten voor islamitisch antisemitisme

PVV MPs asked whether a memorial plaque for Jewish WWII victims was dropped after Muslim residents objected, and about combating Islamic antisemitism and a national study of it. The minister says the earlier Joods Lyceum memorial debate was not a concrete initiative and no objections were known, and points to existing research and a round table rather than a new national study.
I am prepared to commission specific follow-up research if the expected research results provide too little knowledge
Ik ben bereid om specifiek vervolgonderzoek te laten uitvoeren als de te verwachten onderzoeksresultaten te weinig kennis opleveren
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over de bouw van een Turkse enclave in Rotterdam

An MP from the PVV asks the ministers whether they will stop a planned Turkish-only neighbourhood in Rotterdam, whether ethnic segregation is undesirable, and whether Turks should be advised to leave the Netherlands. The minister answers that a neighbourhood exclusive to one ethnic group would be undesirable and that the municipality says it will be open to all, but that the project is a local matter and no national measures will be taken, and that return is an individual choice.
I will not take any measures. The possible development of this project and projects like it is a local matter.
Ik zal geen maatregelen nemen. De eventuele ontwikkeling van dit project en projecten als deze zijn een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over de steun van Nederlandse moslims voor jihadgangers naar Syrië

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether a survey showing that nearly three-quarters of Muslims view jihadist travellers to Syria as heroes reflects Islamic approval of violence, and what the government will do about the supposed large-scale support among Muslims for jihadists. Minister Asscher answered that the research confirmed emotional engagement and broad support for fighters against the Syrian regime, but did not examine support for jihadist motives, so the conclusion of majority support for jihadist travellers cannot be drawn.
Support for jihadist motives and jihadist factions in the Syrian conflict was not examined in this research.
De steun voor jihadistische motieven en jihadistische facties in het Syrische conflict is in dit onderzoek niet onderzocht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de komst van  de imam al Mutawa

Two PVV MPs asked whether the minister would act against a cleric they described as a hate preacher who called for stoning women, including by denying him entry and questioning the Islamic University Rotterdam that invited him. The minister condemned calls to violence but said there were no indications the cleric incites violence, that visa applications are assessed under the Visa Code, and that the inviting institution has not shown itself harmful to integration.
However, I have no indications that the person in question calls for violence.
Ik heb echter geen aanwijzingen dat genoemde persoon oproept tot geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Madlener over de absurde verhoging van de EU-uitgaven aan ontwikkelingshulp

Two PVV MPs asked why EU development spending is rising, including the planned EDF amount for 2014-2020 and Dutch contributions, and whether the government will stop the flow of Dutch money to development aid. The minister confirmed Dutch EU development contributions of about 507 million euro for 2013, explained that the final EDF 2014-2020 envelope was lowered to 30.5 billion euro, and said the Regeerakkoord cuts the ODA budget by 750 million euro per year in 2014-2016 and 1 billion euro from 2017.
The coalition agreement includes a substantial cut target for the development cooperation budget.
In het Regeerakkoord is een forse taakstelling opgenomen met betrekking tot het budget voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de band tussen de Moslimbroederschap en een Amsterdamse moskee

An MP asks whether the owner of an Amsterdam mosque is linked to the Muslim Brotherhood, whether the government will bar foreign-funded mosques or Islamic-cooperation-linked funding, and which mosques receive foreign funding. The minister answers that the government does not track such affiliations, that religious freedom limits intervention, that AIVD can investigate threats, and that a Parliament motion on foreign financing is being followed up.
This is not known to us. The government does not keep an overview of which individuals are affiliated with which organisations.
Dit is bij ons niet bekend. De overheid houdt geen overzicht bij van welke individuen aan welke organisaties zijn gelieerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de absurde steun voor het islamitische boevennest Mali

An MP asked why tens of millions of Dutch taxpayer euros go to Mali rather than tax relief, how much more will be spent, and why aid to Mali should not stop. The minister answered that aid supports stability in the Sahel, plans about EUR 52 million for 2013 with strict conditions on transparency, and that budget beyond 2013 will be detailed in the 2014 budget proposal.
You will be informed about the intended budget for 2014 and beyond in the draft 2014 budget.
Over het beoogde budget voor 2014 en verder zult u worden geïnformeerd in de ontwerpbegroting 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Miljoenen Euro's belastinggeld voor Somalië

An MP from the PVV asked the foreign minister why Dutch taxpayer money should go to Somalia, a country under sharia and ranked among the most corrupt, and urged withdrawing the aid. The minister defended the aid as serving Dutch interests on piracy, terrorism and migration, noted it is channelled through the UN and IOM rather than the Somali government, and refused to withdraw it, while stating funding for one project would stop if Somalia frustrates forced returns.
I am not willing to withdraw the mentioned commitments.
Ik ben niet bereid de genoemde toezeggingen in te trekken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Nederlanders op talibanscholen

An MP asked the State Secretary and Foreign Minister whether they knew of Dutch nationals studying at Taliban-linked schools in Pakistan, which nationalities they hold, how many Dutch nationals attend Islamic institutions abroad, and whether dual nationals should be denaturalised and expelled on return. The minister confirmed awareness, said travel is unregistered so the numbers cannot be tracked, and explained that denaturalisation is possible only after a terrorism conviction and only where the person holds another nationality.
It is therefore not possible to keep track of who travels to Pakistan, or abroad in general, nor which educational institutions they attend.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk bij te houden wie er naar Pakistan, of het buitenland in het algemeen, reist noch wie welke onderwijsinstellingen bezoekt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over het mislukken van de linkse methode van 'pappen en nathouden'

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government will stop funding social prevention projects such as street coaches, neighbourhood barbecues and combat sports in favour of harsher repression, after a study found such interventions did not reduce neighbourhood nuisance. The minister answered that the study will be shared with municipalities, that local authorities are primarily responsible for choosing combinations of preventive and repressive measures, and that the government will not change course toward minimum sentences or wider expulsion powers beyond existing policy.
It is therefore up to the local government and its partners to assess which (combinations of) measures are deployed.
Het is dan ook aan het lokaal bestuur en zijn partners om te beoordelen welke (combinaties van) maatregelen worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren over het bericht “Erdogan maakt werk van Yunus”

MPs Helder and Van Klaveren asked whether Turkey taking the Yunus case to the European Court of Human Rights infringes Dutch sovereignty, and whether Turkey's EU accession should be rejected. The minister answered that it has not been confirmed Turkey has referred the case, and that the government sees no reason to change its policy supporting Turkey's accession perspective.
It has not been confirmed that Turkey is referring the Yunus case to the European Court of Human Rights.
Het is niet bevestigd dat Turkije de zaak Yunus aan het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens voorlegt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema, Van Klaveren en Wilders over de anti-Westerse opvattingen binnen de Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam

PVV MPs asked the education minister whether the Islamic University of Rotterdam receives state subsidies and whether its rector's and teachers' views, which they called incompatible with Western norms on gender, sexual orientation and apostasy, justify withdrawing accreditation and barring its graduates from government chaplaincy work. The minister answered that the university receives no state funding, that the cited statements date from over ten years ago and were personal, that the programmes are accredited with no reason to withdraw accreditation, and that she does not share the view that Islamic chaplains trained there should be barred from government service.
The relevant programmes at the IUR are accredited and I see no need to withdraw these accreditations.
De betreffende opleidingen aan de IUR zijn geaccrediteerd en ik zie geen noodzaak om deze accreditaties in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over tot geweld bereide moslima’s

PVV MPs asked whether Islam calls on Muslims to use violence, how large the group of Muslim women willing to commit violence is, and what measures will counter the long-term risk. The minister says the research sample is not representative so no extrapolation is possible, and refers to the terrorism threat assessment and existing counter-radicalisation measures.
Based on the study 'Radicaal (On)zichtbaar' referred to in the cited newspaper article, no estimate can be made here.
Op basis van het onderzoek «Radicaal (On)zichtbaar» waar het geciteerde krantenartikel naar verwijst kan hier geen schatting van gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Bontes en Wilders over de enorme toename van het aantal «Nederlandse» jihadisten

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about the sharp rise in Dutch jihadists, whether the government has oversight of them, their dual nationality, Islam's teaching on jihad, and deportation or denaturalisation of jihadists with dual nationality. The minister said the AIVD keeps as much oversight as possible, declined to give numbers or individual cases, noted most have a second nationality (mainly Moroccan or Turkish), and explained that citizenship can be revoked only for those with another nationality who are finally convicted of terrorism.
I cannot make concrete public statements about numbers or individual cases.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen doen over aantallen of individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de mishandeling op Koranscholen

The MP asked whether the government knew of reports of abuse at Koran schools in Tilburg, which schools were involved, whether a national inquiry would be launched, and whether all schools using violence should be closed. The state secretary confirmed the reports concern two Tilburg-North venues, declined a new national study pointing to the 2012 inventory, and stated that corporal punishment is prohibited and closure is possible only under specific legal conditions.
We currently see no reason to repeat such a study.
Wij zien nu geen reden om een dergelijk onderzoek 3 te herhalen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over "de dagelijkse imperialistische moskeeoproep"

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether daily mosque calls to prayer are harmful to integration and whether mosques should be prevented from broadcasting them. Minister Asscher answered that religious freedom and church-state neutrality protect such calls, that municipalities may set rules on duration and volume under the Wet openbare manifestaties, and that no ground exists for banning them.
There is no ground for that.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema over de eis dat Nederland betaalt voor Turkse les op school

MPs Van Klaveren and Beertema asked whether the government agrees that a migrant organisation demanding Turkish-language lessons in Dutch schools at taxpayers' expense is absurd, and whether it will urge members to speak Dutch at home and leave for Turkey if they want Turkish lessons. The State Secretary replied that OALT was abolished in 2004 and that the matter is before the court so he will not comment further, while stressing that Dutch-language skills matter and that the ministers will work with migrant organisations, including Turkish ones, on improving children's Dutch.
Since the matter is now before the court, I will refrain from further comment.
Aangezien het nu onder de rechter is, onthoud ik mij verder van commentaar.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Van Vliet over de mogelijke komst van duizenden Marokkanen naar Nederland

Two PVV MPs asked whether the cessation of Dutch child benefit for children living abroad could drive thousands of Moroccan teenagers to the Netherlands, and asked about dual nationality and measures to prevent it. The minister replied that parents freely choose where their children live, that child benefit is only partial support, that the number of affected teenagers is about 1500, and that no measures to prevent such moves are planned.
I do not intend to take measures to prevent children currently living in Morocco from possibly moving to the Netherlands.
Ik ben niet van plan om maatregelen te treffen om te voorkomen dat kinderen die op dit moment in Marokko wonen eventueel in Nederland gaan wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de nieuwe salafistische moskee van imam Fawaz

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked how the AIVD monitors imam Fawaz after his departure from the As Soenna mosque, whether they agree that a new salafist mosque is unwelcome, whether he should be denaturalised and expelled for calls to violence, and what measures will prevent the mosque opening. The minister declined to comment on individual AIVD investigations, defended religious freedom, explained that calls to violence alone are not grounds for losing Dutch nationality, and said the opening of a prayer house is a municipal zoning matter for The Hague.
No public statements are made about AIVD investigations in individual cases.
Over onderzoek van de AIVD in individuele zaken worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma over het bericht dat «consumenten 1,3 procent teveel hypotheekrente betalen»

MPs Van Klaveren and Fritsma asked whether banks' mortgage margins are excessive, whether the Brussels price-leadership ban causes lack of competition, and what measures the government will take to lower mortgage rates. The minister says CPB and DNB find no systematic higher funding costs, that the ABN AMRO price-leadership ban remains and will be discussed with the Commission, and points to a forthcoming NMa margin study and new consumer-protection rules from 1 January 2013.
The Central Planning Bureau (CPB) states that there are no indications that financing costs in the Netherlands are systematically higher than in the surrounding countries.
Het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) stelt dat er geen aanwijzingen zijn dat de financieringskosten in Nederland systematisch hoger zijn dan in de ons omringende landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de aangifte tegen een klokkenluider

An MP asked the Interior Minister about Rotterdam filing a criminal complaint against an official who leaked information on a mosque boarding-school meeting, and whether whistleblowers are protected. The minister answered that officials must report misconduct through the whistleblower procedure, which carries a non-retaliation rule, but that leaking information to the press is a criminal offence and does not fall under that protection.
Reporting misconduct in accordance with the applicable whistleblower scheme must be distinguished from leaking information.
Het melden van een misstand overeenkomstig de daarvoor gelden klokkenluidersregeling dient onderscheiden te worden van het lekken van informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Van Klaveren over het CPB rapport «De Nederlandse woningmarkt – hypotheekrente, huizenprijzen en consumptie»

MPs Tony van Dijck and Van Klaveren asked the government to respond to a CPB report finding Dutch mortgage rates about 1 percentage point above neighbouring countries, and asked how to end excessive margins, quantify lost consumption, housing wealth and tax revenue, and recover losses from the financial sector. The minister acknowledged the rate gap, attributed house price changes to several factors, and said a quantification of 'excessive' interest and lost revenue was not feasible because no objective benchmark exists.

A calculation of the loss of purchasing power due to possibly 'excessively paid' interest is not feasible in my view, because there is no unambiguous and objective measure for the possibly 'excessively paid' part of the interest.

Een berekening van het verlies aan koopkracht als gevolg van eventueel «te veel betaalde rente» acht ik niet goed mogelijk omdat er geen eenduidige en objectieve maatstaf is voor het eventueel «te veel betaalde» deel van de rente.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klever, Van Klaveren en Wilders over de poging van de KNVB om de mening van een scheidsrechter te verbieden

MPs from the PVV asked the minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the KNVB's attempt to silence a referee who had made comments on social media about Moroccan youth problems. The minister said the KNVB respects free speech but was concerned about offensive posts, that it is for the KNVB to set its own rules, and declined to summon the KNVB board or demand an apology.
I leave it to the KNVB to choose its own course within the federation.
Ik laat het aan de KNVB om binnen de bond daarin een eigen weg te kiezen.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Beertema over de ziekmeldingen van islamitische leerlingen met carnaval

PVV MPs asked whether Islamic objections to carnival can justify children staying away from school, whether parents should be fined, and whether the Netherlands has a Judeo-Christian and humanist tradition excluding Islam. The minister answered that such objections are no legal ground for leave or exemption under the Compulsory Education Act, that prosecution is for the courts, and that he rejects excluding Islam from the national tradition.
Objections to carnival do not constitute grounds for which leave and/or an exemption from compulsory education can be granted.
Bezwaren tegen carnaval vormen geen grond waarvoor verlof en/of een vrijstelling van de leerplicht kan worden verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Van Klaveren over het meenemen van geleidehonden in de taxi

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether refusing blind passengers with guide dogs in taxis is unacceptable, whether the government will enforce this or legislate, and whether it will act despite religious objections to dogs. The state secretary called refusal unacceptable, said a national legal obligation is unnecessary, and said he will urge municipalities to use their power under the Taxi Act to bar such refusals.
However, I will explicitly point the municipalities to the possibility the Taxi Act offers to impose additional requirements on taxi transport.
Wel zal ik de gemeenten nadrukkelijk wijzen op de mogelijkheid die de Taxiwet biedt aanvullende eisen aan het taxivervoer te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de mogelijke komst van een moskee op de Pier in Scheveningen

Two MPs from the PVV asked whether a mosque on the Scheveningen pier was being planned by a foundation called Al Sahab, and whether such a mosque should be prevented. The government answered that the foundation does not exist (the report was a joke by a broadcaster) and that municipalities decide on building permits within zoning rules.
It is up to municipalities to judge possible applications for building permits; these must in any case fit within the zoning plan.
Het is aan gemeenten om te oordelen over mogelijke aanvragen voor bouwvergunningen; deze dienen in ieder geval te passen binnen het bestemmingsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over een petitie tegen de mogelijke bouw van een moskee in Enschede

PVV MPs asked whether the government received a petition against a mosque in Enschede, whether growing opposition should halt construction, and whether the Turkish state controls the Islamic Stichting Nederland. The minister acknowledged the petition, said citizens' wishes matter but that the municipality must judge them, and explained that the mosque will join the ISN network founded under Turkish religious authority, which is permitted within Dutch law.
Everyone in the Netherlands has the right to freedom of religion.
Iedereen in Nederland heeft het recht op vrijheid van godsdienst.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het afbrokkelde draagvlak voor de miljarden uitgaven aan ontwikkelingshulp

An MP from the PVV asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about eroding public support for aid spending, questioning EU aid to China, aid to Egypt, Tunisia and Libya, and whether the more than 4 billion euro spent should go to elderly care, tax relief and security instead.
