The minister answered that middle-income countries like China should no longer receive bilateral EU aid, that stability in Arab transition countries makes continued support crucial, and that development spending contributes to stability and security in the Netherlands.
I believe that countries that, based on their income, should be considered able to finance their own development should no longer be eligible for bilateral aid from the European Union.

Ik vind dat landen die op grond van hun inkomen in staat moeten worden geacht hun eigen ontwikkeling te financieren, niet meer in aanmerking zouden moeten komen voor bilaterale steun van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma over het bericht dat Eindhoven een miljoen verspilt bij verplaatsing woonwagenkamp

MPs Van Klaveren and Fritsma asked the Minister of Interior whether Eindhoven's municipal government could account for 2.2 million euros in relocation compensation paid for a caravan camp, and what would be done to limit the damage and prevent such excesses. The Minister replied that the money was paid on suspected forgery, that the municipality has filed a criminal complaint and commissioned an internal review, and that accountability rests locally, so no generic national measures are planned.
Accountability for this matter must take place at the local level, and I therefore see no reason for generic measures on my part.
De verantwoording over deze kwestie dient op lokaal niveau plaats te vinden, en ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor generieke maatregelen van mijn kant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de enorme groei van het aantal salafisten aan de Nederlandse grens

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Interior about reports of a rising number of radical salafists near the German-Dutch border, including possible Dutch targets, contacts with German intelligence, and mosques under monitoring. The state secretary replied that there are no indications of a threat to Dutch targets, declined to detail contacts with German services citing confidentiality, and said no mosque leaders are currently known to threaten public order.
I cannot make further public statements about the content of these contacts.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen nadere mededelingen doen over de inhoud van deze contacten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de vermoedelijke eerwraak op een 16-jarig meisje

PVV MPs asked whether an apparent honour killing of a 16-year-old in IJsselstein was honour-motivated, how many honour killings occurred in ten years, whether immigration from Islamic countries is linked to them, and whether perpetrators with dual nationality should be deported. The state secretary declined to comment on the motive during the ongoing investigation, provided registration figures, rejected the links to religion and immigration, and explained the sliding-scale deportation rules without addressing individual cases.
The investigation into the death of the 16-year-old schoolgirl from IJsselstein is still in full swing.
Het onderzoek naar de dood van de 16-jarige scholiere uit IJsselstein is nog in volle gang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de onstuitbare opmars van de Marokkaanse crimineel

PVV MPs asked whether Moroccan youth are an unstoppable rise in crime and whether the government will confront a 'Moroccan problem' head-on. The minister rejects the claim in general terms, notes overrepresentation in specific crimes, says policy applies no ethnic distinction and points to existing prevention and enforcement measures.
The cabinet acknowledges that certain groups cause more nuisance and crime than others.
Het kabinet onderkent dat bepaalde groepen meer overlast en criminaliteit veroorzaken dan andere.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, de Roon en Wilders over Malinese jihadisten die profiteren van Nederlands belastinggeld

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch aid to Mali, including via subsidised NGOs, benefits jihadists and should be stopped or recovered. The minister confirmed aid to the Malian government was suspended after the 2012 coup, said stopping other aid is not at issue and no grounds exist to reclaim funds, and rejected the personal accusation in question 4.
Following the coup in Mali of 22 March 2012, the Netherlands decided in April 2012 to stop aid to the Malian government.
Naar aanleiding van de staatsgreep in Mali van 22 maart 2012 besloot Nederland in april 2012 tot stopzetten van de hulp aan de Malinese overheid.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over het openen van een Islamitische gebedsruimte in pretpark Walibi.

Two PVV MPs asked whether Walibi amusement park would open an Islamic prayer room and whether the government would act against Islamisation. The minister replied that it is a quiet room open to all faiths, that the government does not oppose it, and that the park is a private company whose activities are not for the cabinet to comment on.
It is not for the cabinet to comment on activities that take place there, as long as they stay within the bounds of the law.
Het is niet aan het kabinet zich uit te laten over activiteiten die zich daar voltrekken, zolang deze binnen de grenzen van de wet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over sharia-patrouilles in Londen

Two MPs from the PVV asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Muslim patrols in a London suburb, including their remarks about white women, whether such patrols show Islam's nature, the existence of 'Muslim areas' in a major European city, and whether shariah-promoting movements should be banned. Minister Opstelten rejected the remarks and intimidation, said Islam's nature is not shown by the conduct of a few, and that courts would assess any dissolution request case by case under article 20 of the Civil Code.
If the public prosecution service so requests, the judge will have to assess each individual case on the basis of article 20 of the Civil Code.
In het geval dat het openbaar ministerie daartoe verzoekt, zal de rechter elke afzonderlijke zaak moeten beoordelen aan de hand van artikel 20 Burgerlijk Wetboek.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de islamitische opvoeding als vrijbrief voor verkrachting

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether a UK court's decision not to jail a rapist because of his Islamic upbringing shows the misogynistic nature of Islam, and whether the government would condemn it and ensure Dutch judges never act similarly. The minister answered that one individual's statements say nothing about a religion and that it is not for the Dutch government to judge a British judge's application of British law in an individual criminal case.
It is not for the Dutch government to make statements about the correct application of British law by a British judge in an individual criminal case.
Het is niet aan de Nederlandse regering om uitspraken te doen over de juiste toepassing van het Britse recht door een Britse rechter in een individuele strafzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Van Klaveren en Helder over het bericht «Bejaarde is leven niet meer zeker na massale afranseling»

PVV MPs asked the government whether criminal Moroccan youths terrorising neighbourhoods and committing racist violence should be harshly punished, sent to re-education camps, and deprived of Dutch nationality with family deportation. The minister answered that policy does not distinguish by ethnicity, outlined prevention and tough enforcement, rejected re-education camps as unproven, and said revoking nationality for common crimes is not possible.
In this approach no distinction is made by ethnicity.
In deze aanpak wordt geen onderscheid naar etniciteit gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over het racistische Marokkaanse geweld

Three PVV MPs asked whether the government shares a claim that Moroccan-origin youths cause a structural problem of violence, asked for the causes of police contact among young Moroccan men, and asked whether dual-nationality offenders could be denaturalised and deported. The minister answered that socio-economic and demographic factors explain over-representation in crime, that enforcement applies no ethnic distinction, and that revoking Dutch nationality for common offences is not possible.
Of course, it is the case that the groups that more often cause problems will accordingly come into contact with this approach more often.
Wel is het uiteraard zo dat de groepen die vaker problemen veroorzaken navenant meer met deze aanpak in aanraking zullen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders van uw Kamer inzake het aftuigen van buurtbewoners door Marokkaanse leerlingen

PVV MPs asked the government whether schools refusing police help after pupil violence should be held to account, why Moroccan girls are increasingly suspects of crime, and whether harsh punishment and denaturalisation should address the Moroccan problem. The state secretary answered that schools must take necessary measures, the mayor decides on police deployment, a joint safety team was set up, there are no figures showing rising crime among Moroccan girls, and sentencing is for judges while denaturalisation for common crimes is not possible.
Educational institutions facing a violence problem must take the measures they consider necessary.
Onderwijsinstellingen die kampen met een geweldsprobleem moeten de maatregelen nemen die zij noodzakelijk achten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de moskee als toevluchtsoord voor schietende criminelen

PVV MPs asked whether a group of men fleeing a shooting incident in Rotterdam hid in a mosque, whether police entered promptly, and whether the minister would close the mosque. The minister answered that the building was an annex (library, barber) rather than a prayer space, that police entered and found no one, and that closing a mosque is a municipal competence.
The possible closure of a mosque is a municipal competence.
Eventuele sluiting van een moskee is een gemeentelijke bevoegdheid.
Antwoord vragen Bontes en Van Klaveren over een politiesnoepreisje naar Marokko

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether Dutch police trips to Morocco, reported as a costly study trip, were necessary and whether police diversity policy was absurd. Minister Opstelten answered that the trip's necessity is tested by the Landelijke korpschef under a new Gedragscode Buitenlandse Dienstreizen, and that non-operational trips are reported in advance to his ministry.
The starting point of this code of conduct is that foreign business trips undertaken by the police must always be integrity-based, useful and necessary.
Het vertrekpunt van deze gedragscode is dat buitenlandse dienstreizen die door de politie worden ondernomen altijd integer, nuttig en noodzakelijk dienen te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaveren en Helder over de dodelijke schietpartij bij een kickboksgala

Two PVV MPs asked about a fatal shooting at a kickboxing gala, the suspect's reported school-shooter background, the overrepresentation of Moroccan and Turkish youths in violent crime statistics, and whether a suspect with a serious criminal record should be deported. The minister said the overrepresentation is partly explained by demographic and socioeconomic factors, declined to comment on individual cases, and described the general rules on deportation after conviction and a planned tightening of the sliding scale.
I will not comment on individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en van Klaveren over de verblijfsgrond van in Nederland verblijvende verdachten / criminelen die in verband met recente geruchtmakende zaken in het nieuws waren

Two PVV MPs asked why the government refused to answer questions about individual criminal foreigners tied to recent news cases, when earlier individual cases had been answered, and whether it is inconsistent to withhold information on criminals while disclosing information on people to be deported. State Secretary Teeven replied that he declines to discuss individual cases to protect the privacy of those involved, since the data are special personal data under the Dutch data protection law, and that privacy will generally weigh heavily.
I refrained from going into the individual cases because, for the protection of the privacy of those involved, I do not consider it desirable to go further into them.
Ik heb afgezien om in te gaan op de individuele zaken omdat ik het uit oogpunt van bescherming van de privacy van betrokkenen niet gewenst acht hierop verder in te gaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de bouw van de Amsterdamse Westermoskee

An MP from the PVV asked ministers about the Westermoskee in Amsterdam: whether construction will resume, who finances it, which organisations are involved, whether links exist to Milli Gorus, and what measures could block it. The answer states construction resumes in Q1 2013 financed by Manderen BV, that the AIVD has no information indicating threats, and that the municipality cannot stop the mosque because a permit and leasehold contract already exist.
Manderen BV holds an irrevocable building permit issued in 2007.
Manderen BV beschikt over een onherroepelijke bouwvergunning die is afgegeven in 2007.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over de vele moskee-internaten in Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the minister how many mosque boarding schools exist in the Netherlands, what legal steps will be taken against them over reported corporal punishment and illegal shops, and how they will be closed. The minister said no national overview is known, that local authorities are responsible, that he will consult affected municipalities on whether existing instruments suffice, and that no legal measures are currently warranted.
It is the responsibility of the local government to have insight into the presence of boarding schools within the municipal boundary.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale overheid om inzicht te hebben in de aanwezigheid van internaten binnen de gemeentegrens.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over ‘De miljoenen voor leuke seks in ontwikkelingslanden’

An MP from the PVV asked whether the minister should cancel a development project on 'fun sex' in developing countries, which he considered a waste of taxpayer money. The minister replied that the project implements approved sexual and reproductive health and gender policy, aimed at reducing maternal and child mortality, teenage pregnancy and domestic violence, and refused to cancel it.
I support this project, because it contributes to implementing the current SRGR and gender policy.
Ik ondersteun dit project, omdat het bijdraagt aan de uitvoering van het vigerende SRGR- en genderbeleid.
Antwoord vragen het lid Van Klaveren over de mishandeling van een man bij een voetbalwedstrijd tussen Neptunus-Schiebroek en Kocatepe in Rotterdam

The PVV MP Van Klaveren asked the minister whether he would act on an assault on an elderly man over a ham sandwich at a Rotterdam football match, including whether the club's licence should be withdrawn and whether perpetrators could be denaturalised and deported. The minister said the case is with the Public Prosecution Service, condemned all violence, and stated that the KNVB is autonomous on licensing and the club had already expelled the perpetrator, so no licence withdrawal was warranted.
From the Ministry of Security and Justice I have learned that the case is with the Public Prosecution Service and that no further statements can be made about it at this time.
Van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie heb ik vernomen dat de zaak bij het Openbaar Ministerie ligt en dat er op dit moment geen verdere mededelingen over kunnen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het schrappen van de registratie van de dubbele nationaliteit voor in Nederland geborenen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior whether removing dual-nationality registration in the GBA affects other bodies, how many people face problems with it, who would need the data for denaturalisation, and how dual nationals would be tracked. The minister answered that other bodies' use depends on their work processes and no major impact is expected, that a 2009 quickscan found around 10% of municipalities received complaints, that the IND would use its own case files for denaturalisation, and that tracking would depend on each body's procedures.
No quantitative research has been carried out into how many people experience problems with the current registration of multiple nationality.
Er is geen kwantitatief onderzoek gedaan naar hoeveel mensen problemen ondervinden met de huidige registratie van de meervoudige nationaliteit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de structurele straatterreur in Hilversum

An MP asked the ministers about street terror and youth nuisance in Hilversum, whether the troublemakers could be expelled from the neighbourhood, whether benefits could be cut for nuisance, and why Turkish people are overrepresented in sexual coercion. The government answered that municipalities hold the tools and Hilversum is acting on youth nuisance, referred to a 2010 VROM report, and said prevention through awareness and open discussion is the approach to sexual coercion.
Municipalities have a broad range of measures at their disposal to tackle nuisance.
Gemeenten hebben een breed scala aan maatregelen tot hun beschikking om overlast aan te pakken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over invoering van de doodstraf op homoseksualiteit in Oeganda

An MP asked whether the government shares outrage at Uganda's planned death penalty for homosexuality and whether it will halt all development aid except emergency aid. The government says the bill is a concerning private member's bill that conflicts with Uganda's international obligations, and that suspending aid is not on the table.
Ending development cooperation with Uganda is not on the agenda.
De ontwikkelingssamenwerking met Oeganda opzeggen is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over de 3 miljoen euro steun voor Gaza

An MP from the PVV asked whether the Netherlands should withhold all development aid to Gaza while it is governed by Hamas, and whether it would reconsider its 3 million euro pledge. The minister answered that the government condemns Hamas rocket fire but will not hold the Palestinian civilian population collectively responsible, so it sees no reason to deny them aid.
The cabinet does not hold the Palestinian civilian population collectively responsible for the actions of Hamas.
Het kabinet houdt de Palestijnse burgerbevolking niet collectief verantwoordelijk voor het handelen van Hamas.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Klaveren over de verblijfsgrond van in Nederland verblijvende verdachten / criminelen die in verband met recente geruchtmakende zaken in het nieuws waren

MPs Fritsma and Van Klaveren asked how various suspects and convicted criminals obtained residence rights in the Netherlands, and what measures would remove them after serving their sentences, and whether residence permits could require a criminal-record statement from origin countries. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, described the sliding-scale test for ending lawful residence after conviction and his plan to tighten it, and said he would inform parliament this year about using antecedent declarations.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren over het bericht ‘Marokkaanse gevangenen naar eigen land’

PVV MPs asked whether a large share of prisoners are Moroccan nationals, whether transferring them to Morocco to serve sentences would save costs, and whether an agreement with Morocco should be concluded. The state secretary answered that about 5% of intake is Moroccan nationals, that transfer is only possible under WOTS or WETS with consent and the receiving country's agreement, and that the ministry will explore a supplementary bilateral agreement with Morocco.
The Ministry of Security and Justice will look into whether there are possibilities to conclude a bilateral (supplementary) agreement between the Netherlands and Morocco.
Vanuit het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie zal worden geïnformeerd of er in hoeverre er mogelijkheden zijn om een bilaterale (aanvullende) overeenkomst te sluiten tussen Nederland en Marokko.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de constatering dat hulpclubs overbodig werk verrichten

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about claims by experts that aid through NGOs such as Cordaid, Novib and ICCO is wasteful and sustains corrupt or undemocratic regimes, and asks about total subsidies and whether funding can be stopped. The state secretary disputes the one-sided criticism, reports average annual spending of EUR 245 million through these organisations over 20 years, cites evidence of effectiveness, and sees no reason to change current policy.
I therefore see no reason to change the current policy.
Daarmee zie ik geen aanleiding het huidige beleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het artikel ‘Eigen zorgcentrum Marokkanen absurd’

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Agema asked about a news report on a care centre (Julianastaete) that may cater to Moroccan residents, asking how much public money it receives, whether such centres undermine integration, and whether Moroccan elderly should be advised to return. The government answered that the centre's total public funding cannot be isolated from the parent organisation's accounts, that care providers may target specific groups but may not exclude anyone on grounds protected by the equal treatment act, and that returning home is an individual choice it will not advise.
Since this concerns a consolidated income statement, it is not known how much of the above funds were received in connection with services at the Julianastaete location.
Aangezien het hier een geconsolideerde resultatenrekening betreft, is niet bekend hoeveel van bovengenoemde middelen zijn ontvangen in verband met de dienstverlening op de locatie Julianastaete.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de geplande islamitische betogingen voor het Amerikaanse consulaat

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew of planned Islamic demonstrations near the US consulate in Amsterdam, which organisations were behind them, whether AIVD monitors those involved, and whether violence would be met with firm action. The minister confirmed awareness, named the two organising groups, declined to say whether the AIVD monitors anyone, and declined to pre-announce how police would act, saying only that any response would be effective and proportionate.
I cannot publicly disclose anything about groups or individuals who are or are not under investigation by the AIVD.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over groepen/individuen die al dan niet in onderzoek zijn bij de AIVD.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de zoveelste brute mishandeling door Marokkaans tuig en de bizarre reactie door de politie

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Immigration about a brutal assault by a group they describe as Moroccan youths and about an alleged police failure to assist the victim. The government confirmed awareness of the report, said the investigation is ongoing, denied that police left the victim behind, and stated that it does not distinguish by ethnicity in tackling youth nuisance while leaving sentencing to the courts and noting that revoking Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible.
The criminal investigation into the precise facts and circumstances of this case is still ongoing.
Het opsporingsonderzoek naar de precieze feiten en omstandigheden in deze zaak is nog gaande.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de islamitische waarschuwing voor rellen

An MP from the PVV asked the Justice and Immigration ministers whether reported Muslim warnings of riots in Amsterdam reflect Islamisation and what measures have been taken against it. The minister answered that there are currently no concrete indications of riots and that the quoted views are illustrative only, not evidence of Islamisation.
At this moment I do not have concrete indications that riots, as described in the article, threaten in Amsterdam.
Op dit moment beschik ik niet over concrete aanwijzingen dat er rellen, zoals beschreven in het artikel, dreigen in Amsterdam.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de mogelijk koop van een moskee en bijbehorend terrein door de gemeente Medemblik

An MP from the PVV asks the minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum whether the government shares the view that a municipal purchase of a mosque is absurd, and whether it will act to prevent public money being spent on it. The minister rejects the view that mosques should only be bought to reduce their number, says zoning is a municipal responsibility, and takes no measures because the municipal council exercises democratic control.
The municipal executive is free to use the financial resources it has, within the limits of the law.
Het staat het gemeentebestuur vrij om de financiële middelen die het heeft, binnen de grenzen van de wet, aan te wenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Besselaar, Van Klaveren en Wilders over "het ‘ramadan-proof’ maken van cao’s"

PVV MPs asked whether collective labour agreements should accommodate Ramadan, asked about economic costs of Ramadan fasting, and whether Muslims should work in Islamic countries. The minister answered that employers and employees may agree facilitation of religious activities, that direct discrimination on religion is prohibited under equal treatment law, that costs are unknown, and that such arrangements are the employee's own responsibility.
It is the employee's own responsibility to make good arrangements with the employer when he or she wishes to take time off work to take part in such activities in private life.

Het is de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de werknemer om goede afspraken met zijn werkgever te maken wanneer hij of zij vrij wil nemen van het werk voor deelname aan dergelijke activiteiten in de privésfeer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat twee meisjes in Hilversum zwaar zijn mishandeld door Marokkaans tuig

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Klaveren asked minister Opstelten about two severe assaults on girls in Hilversum, the second this year, and about the police response, the ethnic share of youth suspects, and whether dual-national perpetrators should be denaturalised. The minister replied that suspects were arrested, extra measures were taken with partners, the wider approach does not single out ethnicity, and denaturalisation for common offences is not possible.
The police and municipality, with the other safety partners, have taken additional measures.
Politie en gemeente hebben met de overige veiligheidspartners extra maatregelen getroffen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Jong en Wilders over het bericht dat de werkloosheid onder allochtone jongeren dramatische vormen aanneemt

PVV MPs asked the ministers why unemployment among non-Western immigrant youth is so much higher than among Chinese youth, and whether mass immigration of unskilled migrants and work refusal in Rotterdam's port explain it. The minister attributed the gap to cyclical sensitivity, lower education levels and flexible contracts, rejected the claim of mass unskilled immigration and of mass work refusal, gave a welfare figure, and declined to revoke residence permits, saying non-Western migrants are treated like Western ones.
The cabinet does not treat non-Western allochtones differently from Western allochtones
Het kabinet behandelt niet- westerse allochtonen niet anders dan westerse allochtonen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de groep Somaliërs die weigert ons land te verlaten

An MP asked the immigration minister about a group of rejected Somali asylum seekers protesting near the IND and refusing to leave, and whether they could be detained or deported to a neighbouring country. The minister said forced return to Somalia is currently not possible, so detention is not applicable, and that the government will keep examining options and await a new country report expected in November.
At this moment forced deportation to Somalia is not possible.
Op dit moment is gedwongen uitzetting naar Somalië niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaveren en Wilders over de komst van een moskee na administratief geblunder van de gemeente

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether a mosque replacing a church after a municipal administrative error should be opposed and how the municipality of Utrecht could be made to reverse the decision. The minister answered that religious freedom applies to all faiths, that the municipality corrected its error by excluding the church plan, and that the minister would not comment on local matters.
It does not befit me as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to comment on local matters.
Het past mij als minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties niet om mij uit te laten over lokale aangelegenheden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over islamitische sekseongelijkheid bij de naturalisatieceremonie

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a naturalisation is valid when a Muslim woman did not personally take the oath, what the consequences are, and whether immigrants who reject gender equality should be barred from citizenship or face expulsion under an assimilation contract. The minister replied that the woman did in fact take the oath alongside her husband, that integration courses cover gender equality, and that assimilation is not an aim of integration, though demands that a husband take the oath for his wife would not be accepted.
Contrary to what the question states, the woman did take the declaration of allegiance.
Anders dan de vraag stelt, heeft de vrouw de verklaring van verbondenheid wel afgelegd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bontes, Van Klaveren en Wilders met betrekking tot de inzet van politie tijdens de Ramadan

Three PVV MPs asked whether extra police deployment against Ramadan-related crime existed, its cost, whether police see a link between Ramadan and crime, and whether the costs could be recovered from convicted offenders. The state secretary answered that no extra police capacity is deployed during Ramadan, only capacity management of existing rosters, that no data exist on the suggested link, and that cost recovery is not warranted.
In both The Hague and Utrecht no extra police capacity is deployed during Ramadan.
In zowel Den Haag als Utrecht wordt geen extra politiecapaciteit ingezet gedurende de Ramadan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over het verknipte en gevaarlijke advies extremistische islamitische organisaties invloed te geven op beleid

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they agree that an advisory report by Forum recommending engagement with extremist Islamic organisations is dangerous, whether the Forum subsidy will be stopped, and whether all Islamic organisations will be monitored and sanctioned. The government disagrees with the advice's clarity but will not adopt it, keeps the Forum subsidy, and rejects blanket monitoring of all Islamic organisations, while pointing to targeted AIVD investigation and existing legal tools.
Should the researchers' advice be to let extremist organisations exert influence on policy, I assure you I will not adopt that advice.
Mocht het advies van de onderzoekers zijn om extremistische organisaties invloed te laten uitoefenen op beleid, verzeker ik u dat ik dat advies niet overneem.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over invallen bij Duitse salafisten

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether Dutch police should raid mosques and homes of salafist groups as Germany did, whether such groups should be banned, and what measures the government will take. Minister Opstelten answered that the German group term covers a narrower spectrum than the Dutch use of salafism, that AIVD has observed no threatening activities by Dutch salafists so far, and that measures will be taken if the security services find cause.
The AIVD has so far not observed any activities by Dutch salafists that pose a threat to national security or that justify the measures you propose.
De AIVD heeft bij Nederlandse salafisten vooralsnog geen activiteiten waargenomen die een bedreiging vormen voor de nationale veiligheid of die de door u voorgestelde maatregelen rechtvaardigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema en Van Klaveren over de uitspraak dat salafistische ouders thuisonderwijs mogen geven

Two PVV MPs asked the minister of Education whether a court ruling allowing Salafist parents to homeschool is absurd, whether she recognises the dangers of Salafist messages, and what measures she will take to make this form of homeschooling impossible. The minister said courts decide whether religious objections justify exemption from compulsory schooling, that she will not judge a court ruling, that inciting violence is inappropriate, and that she is preparing a bill to attach conditions to religious exemptions from school attendance.
I am preparing a bill aimed at attaching a number of conditions to exemption from compulsory schooling on grounds of religion or belief.

146 ) al aangekondigd dat ik bezig ben met de voorbereiding van een wetsvoorstel met het doel de vrijstelling van de leerplicht op grond van godsdienst of levensbeschouwing aan een aantal voorwaarden te verbinden.
Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de mogelijke terroristische plannen van Sharia4Holland (ingezonden 8 juni 2012).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether claims by hackers that Sharia4Holland members communicate about terrorist plans and foreign financing are true, and what measures will be taken against the threat. The minister said there are no indications the claim is true, and that relevant services remain alert and will intervene if warranted.
I have no indications that the claim is based on the truth.
Ik beschik niet over aanwijzingen dat de claim op waarheid berust.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en De Jong over "uitkeringsfraude door niet-westerse allochtonen"

MPs Van Klaveren and De Jong asked the government about the scale of benefit fraud by non-Western immigrants and how foreign property held by benefit recipients is checked. The state secretary answered that fraud policy is not based on origin, described municipal and SVB checks abroad (403 asset investigations in 2011), and declined to start a separate investigation while promising a fuller overview in the third quarter.
We see no reason to start an investigation from our ministries in addition to the work of the municipalities and the SVB
Wij zien geen aanleiding om in aanvulling op bovenstaande werkzaamheden van de gemeenten en de SVB vanuit onze ministeries een onderzoek te starten
Antwoord vragen van de leden Helder en Van Klaveren over de onbegrijpelijke uitspraak van Marokkaans scootertuig

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the acquittal of suspects in a fatal scooter chase, which they found incomprehensible, and whether the suspects were effectively rewarded for silence. The State Secretary replied that the Public Prosecution Service disagrees with the acquittal and has referred the case to the Supreme Court, and that the appellate ruling must now be tested by the cassation judge, so no further substantive comment is given.
Since no final judicial ruling has yet been handed down in this case, I cannot go into this further.
Nu in deze zaak nog geen finaal rechterlijk oordeel is geveld kan ik hierop verder ingaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Driessen over kenniscentrum E-Quality en de afscheidsreceptie van zijn directeur

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about subsidies to knowledge centre E-Quality, the costs of a farewell reception for its director, and whether future subsidies should be stopped. The minister listed the subsidy amounts from 2007 to 2012 and said the reception costs were not yet known, and declined to end subsidies, citing the emancipation subsidy scheme.
The costs of the event are not known at this moment; what costs were involved will become clear in the accountability report.
De kosten van de bijeenkomst zijn op dit moment niet bekend; welke kosten hiermee gemoeid waren zal blijken bij de verantwoording.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het zoveelste onzinadvies van de RMO

An MP asks the minister about a Council for Social Development (RMO) advisory report recommending the government stop using the term 'allochtoon', questioning the RMO's stance on immigrant integration statistics and whether the council should be abolished. The minister says the RMO is free to advise, the cabinet will respond to the advice, and that the council's advice has added value, though he does not necessarily agree with its content.
As laid down in the Framework Act on advisory bodies, the cabinet will send both chambers a response to the advice.
Zoals vastgelegd in de Kaderwet adviescolleges zal het kabinet beide Kamers een reactie op het advies doen toekomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de dood van een baby na de racistische mishandeling van de moeder door Marokkaans straattuig

An MP asked the ministers whether suspects in a fatal street assault on a pregnant woman were released too quickly and whether they should be locked up longer and deported after denaturalisation. The Minister of Justice replied that the decision to lift or suspend pre-trial detention belongs to the examining judge, that the prosecutor appealed some of these decisions, and that he will not comment on sentencing in a pending case; denaturalisation for common offences is not currently possible.
It is not for me to pass judgment on the examining judge's decision to lift or suspend the pre-trial detention.
Het is niet aan mij een oordeel te vellen over de beslissing van de rechter-commissaris tot de opheffing en/of schorsing van de voorlopige hechtenis.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over de komst van een geweldpredikende imam

An MP asked whether the government knows of a planned conference by Sharia4Belgium and of a Belgian preacher convicted for incitement, and whether he should be denied entry to the Netherlands. The minister confirmed awareness, said the venue is unknown, said such preachers can threaten democracy, and said he does not expect the preacher to visit, while noting Belgium's refusal to extradite its nationals.
The precise location has not been made public.
De precieze locatie is niet bekend gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over de verspreiding van korans in Duitsland

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the minister about salafists distributing millions of Qurans in Germany and whether such activity poses a threat in the Netherlands. The minister replied that salafist activity currently poses no national security threat, no plans are known, and distributing the Quran as such is not a threat to public order, while measures would be taken if disturbance were indicated.
Distributing a widely circulated religious text as such does not constitute a danger to public order.
Het verspreiden van een wijdverspreid religieus geschrift als zodanig vormt geen gevaar voor de openbare orde.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over islamitische censuur

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether the minister would act against billboard ads covered over by alleged Islamic censorship and whether he knew of similar cases. The minister answered that no state censorship occurred because private parties apparently covered the ads, saw no reason to intervene, and knew of no comparable cases.
Censorship in that sense does not arise in this concrete case, in which an advertising message was apparently covered by private individual(s).
Van censuur in die zin is in dit concrete geval, waarin een reclameboodschap schijnbaar door (een) particulier(en) is afgeplakt, geen sprake.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Van den Besselaar en Helder over de Midden- en Oost-Europese misdaadgolf die over ons land trekt

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Immigration and of Security and Justice about a Central and Eastern European crime wave, including whether the open borders policy was naive, whether a dedicated police chief should be appointed, and whether expulsion and entry bans are the most effective response. The minister replied that free movement brings economic benefits alongside crime risks, that measures on mobile gangs have been taken, that a separate police chief is unnecessary, and that expulsions and unwelcome declarations are used alongside preventive and European cooperation measures.
The cabinet has therefore taken measures to combat and prevent crime committed by mobile gangs from Central and Eastern Europe.
Het kabinet heeft daarom maatregelen genomen om criminaliteit die gepleegd wordt door mobiele bendes uit Midden- en Oost Europa te bestrijden en te voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Hernandez en Van Klaveren over politieke uitspraken van legerimam Ali Eddaoudi

MPs Hernandez and Van Klaveren asked the Defence Minister whether it is acceptable that an Islamic chaplain and defence employee, Ali Eddaoudi, took political positions in an interview that contradict government policy on a face-veil ban and called Dutch people cheese heads. The minister answered that Eddaoudi only estimated the number of face-veil wearers without giving an opinion on the bill, that the term 'kaaskoppen' was not in his view grievous, and that he retains confidence in him.
He does not give his opinion on the bill.
Hij geeft niet zijn mening over het wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van Klaveren, Van der Staaij en Sterk over de komst van een extremistische imam naar Nederland

MPs asked whether statements by an extremist imam, Al Haddad, that the minister called reprehensible, possibly including calls to violence, justified refusing his entry into the Netherlands, and how entry decisions are made. The minister answered that the statements may not be criminal in isolation, that without concrete indications of serious threat entry could not lawfully be refused, and that entry decisions for EU and non-EU nationals follow Schengen rules and case-by-case checks.
The law does not give me the room to refuse someone entry to the Netherlands solely on the basis of his statements, without concrete indications of imminent serious criminal offences.
De wet biedt mij niet de ruimte om zonder concrete aanwijzingen voor dreigende ernstige strafbare feiten iemand de toegang tot Nederland te ontzeggen louter op basis van zijn uitspraken.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over de sprekers op het Nationaal Islam Congres 2012

An MP asked whether speakers at the 2012 Nationaal Islam Congres who had called for violence should be denied entry, and whether the government would refuse them. The minister answered that entry can be refused only where there is a demonstrable threat to public order or national security, assessed case by case, and that no such indications were found for the individual speakers.
In the information available to me I see no indications of such a danger to public order or national security.
In de mij beschikbare informatie zie ik geen aanwijzingen voor een dergelijk gevaar voor de openbare orde of nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Helder over de structurele terreur in Utrechtse wijken

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Immigration, Integration and Asylum about reported structural intimidation of a family in Utrecht neighbourhoods, whether mayors would be convened, and whether a police crackdown, neighbourhood evictions and denaturalisation would solve it. Minister Opstelten answered that the recent events fall within an earlier mayors' meeting, that the council judges the mayor's functioning, that the government is pursuing an ethnicity-neutral approach to youth crime, and that police investigated and arrested suspects.

Specifically regarding the events of 19 and 20 February 2012 in Utrecht, I can inform you that the police immediately launched an investigation and that suspects have since been arrested and taken into custody.

Specifiek ten aanzien van de gebeurtenissen op 19 en 20 februari 2012 in Utrecht kan ik u melden dat de politie direct onderzoek heeft ingesteld en dat er inmiddels verdachten zijn aangehouden en in hechtenis genomen.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Helder over het bericht dat de islamitische schaamtecultuur medepalend is voor de strafmaat

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked the Justice minister whether the 'Islamic shame culture' should influence sentencing and whether incidents like refusing to stand for judges signal Islamisation of the judiciary. Minister Opstelten answered that sentencing considers case-specific circumstances proven to be relevant, not group membership, and that the isolated incidents do not show Islamisation.
These are special circumstances that must be shown to exist and be relevant in the specific case brought before the judge, and not something assumed in general for certain categories of suspects.

Het gaat hier om bijzondere omstandigheden waarvan moet worden aangetoond dat zij zich voordoen en relevant zijn in het specifieke geval dat aan de rechter is voorgelegd, en niet om iets dat in zijn algemeenheid wordt aangenomen voor bepaalde categorieën verdachten
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over de uitspraak van een kantonrechter dat de religieuze plicht zwaarder weegt dan de plicht te voldoen aan de Nederlandse wet

Two PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a cantonal court ruling that a religious duty outweighs the duty to obey Dutch law undermines the rule of law and what measures will be taken. The minister answered that everyone must obey Dutch law, exceptions exist only where the law provides them, interpretation is for the courts, and he will not comment further because the prosecution has appealed.
The Public Prosecution Service has lodged an appeal against the cantonal judge's ruling.
Het OM heeft beroep tegen de uitspraak van de kantonrechter ingesteld.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Helder en Brinkman over de zoveelste gewelddadige straatroof in Utrecht

MPs Van Klaveren, Helder and Brinkman asked ministers about repeated violent street robberies in Utrecht, whether they still trusted Utrecht mayor Wolfsen, what measures would be taken against him, and whether heavy sentences and denaturalisation of dual nationals would largely solve the problem. The government replied that the municipal council judges mayoral performance, referred to earlier answers on youth groups, stated that repressive and preventive measures are both needed, left sentencing to judges, and said a bill is being prepared so that Dutch nationality lapses after a final conviction within five years for offences carrying twelve or more years.
It is primarily for the municipal council to judge the functioning of a mayor.
Het is primair aan de gemeenteraad om te oordelen over het functioneren van een burgemeester.
Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Immigratie, Integratie en Asiel over de komst van wederom een pedofilie promotende imam (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the immigration minister whether a preacher accused of promoting paedophilia and inciting violence against women, Al Arifi, should be barred from the Netherlands and whether mosques preaching such views should be closed. The minister answered that entry decisions are assessed case by case, that the public prosecutor handles criminal incitement, and that closing a mosque is possible only in exceptional cases through a court under civil law.
Closing a mosque is possible only in exceptional cases.
Een moskee sluiten kan slechts in uitzonderlijke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Klaveren, Van der Staaij, Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en Ormel over de komst van een extremistische imam naar Nederland

MPs asked whether a British cleric known for antisemitic and misogynistic statements, invited to a VU symposium, should be barred from entering the Netherlands. The government answered that it had examined an entry ban but found the statements insufficient grounds under EU free-movement rules, which require a current, genuine and serious threat to public order.
The objectionable statements, however, are insufficient indication that such a danger exists.
De verwerpelijke uitspraken zijn echter onvoldoende aanwijzing dat een dergelijk gevaar aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hernandez en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat Defensie de eerste islamitische gebedsruimte heeft geopend

MPs Hernandez and Van Klaveren asked the defence minister about the cost and rationale of opening an Islamic prayer room at a Defence base amid budget cuts, and whether Defence is 'Islamising'. The minister confirmed the room, gave the cost (EUR 18,247.57), argued Islam is treated equally to other religions, and rejected the Islamisation claim and the radical characterisation of a chaplain.
Defence spent EUR 18,247.57, from the budget of the Chaplaincy Services, to set up an existing room for Islamic prayer services.
Defensie heeft voor een bedrag van € 18 247,57 – uit de begroting van de Diensten Geestelijke Verzorging – een bestaande ruimte ingericht voor islamitische gebedsdiensten.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Helder over de nieuwe veelpleger

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked the ministers about reports of a 'new repeat offender', the role of the Rotterdam-Rijnmond police chief, juvenile criminal law for 12-year-olds, and ethnic overrepresentation in crime statistics. The minister answered that the term distinguishes younger, more violent offenders from the 'old' repeat offender, that existing juvenile law suffices for 12-year-olds, and that all offenders should be prosecuted regardless of origin.
The cabinet is making a strong effort to reduce boundary-crossing behaviour among at-risk young people, individually and in groups.
Het kabinet zet stevig in op het terugdringen van grensoverschrijdend gedrag van risicojongeren, individueel en in groepen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Immigratie, Integratie en Asiel en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat salafisten worden ingezet als ordetroepen tijdens de jaarwi

Two PVV MPs asked whether the police in The Hague enlisted the As Soenna mosque, which the AIVD had monitored, to help secure New Year's Eve in the Schilderswijk, and whether this was acceptable given the mosque's views. Minister Opstelten replied that the project involves many community organisations under identical agreements, that policing responsibility stays with the police, and that cooperation with citizens and mosques within legal limits is standard practice.
Responsibility for maintaining public order also during New Year's Eve lies entirely with the police.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de ordehandhaving ligt ook tijdens de jaarwisseling geheel bij de politie.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de ministers voor Immigratie en Asiel en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de mishandeling van een Marokkaanse vrouw door Marokkaanse straatterroristen (ingezond

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked ministers whether they condemn the assault on a Moroccan woman by young men, whether such street nuisance is a structural problem, what measures will hold parents financially liable and cut benefits, and whether offenders should be denaturalised and deported. The government condemned the conduct, said youth nuisance is addressed through a non-ethnic approach and local measures, and announced a bill so that Dutch nationality lapses after a conviction within five years for offences carrying twelve or more years' imprisonment.

The cabinet is preparing a bill providing that Dutch nationality lapses by operation of law if, within five years of acquisition, an irrevocable conviction is handed down for an offence carrying twelve or more years' imprisonment.

Het kabinet bereidt een wetsvoorstel voor dat regelt dat het Nederlanderschap van rechtswege vervalt indien binnen vijf jaar na verkrijging een onherroepelijke veroordeling plaatsvindt voor een misdrijf waar twaalf jaar of meer gevangenisstraf op staat.
Antwoord vragen Brinkman, Helder en Van Klaveren over slechts een taakstrafje na mishandeling van een agent

PVV MPs Brinkman, Helder and Van Klaveren asked why a community sentence was imposed for assaulting a police officer, whether such sentences undermine public trust, and whether the community sentence should be removed from the Criminal Code and denaturalisation used. Minister Opstelten said the prosecution regrets not demanding a partly unconditional prison term and has appealed, that the cabinet wants to keep the community sentence but restrict it for serious violent crimes, and that a bill on loss of Dutch nationality for serious offences is in preparation.
Following this case, the prosecution leadership spoke with all officials involved to learn lessons from this case.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus heeft de parketleiding gesproken met alle betrokken functionarissen om uit deze casus lering te trekken.
Antwoord vragen Gerbrands en Van Klaveren over de vergoeding van anti-homotherapie

PVV MPs Gerbrands and Van Klaveren asked whether insurers must reimburse 'anti-homosexuality therapy' offered by a recognised care institution and how it will be removed from the basic package. Minister Schippers answered that such therapy is not part of the Zorgverzekeringswet package, that IGZ inspection found no such therapy being provided, and that IGZ will act if a complaint is filed.
However, the inspection visit that the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) paid to the institution in question shows that no such therapy is being provided.
Uit het inspectiebezoek dat de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) aan de betreffende instelling heeft gebracht blijkt echter dat er geen sprake is van het verlenen van een dergelijke therapie.
Vragen van de leden Bontes, Driessen en Van Klaveren (allen PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over een nieuwe Nigeriaanse anti-homowet (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

Three PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a Nigerian Senate-passed anti-homosexuality law, a senator's call to kill homosexuals, the death penalty under sharia, and whether aid should be halted. The minister confirmed awareness, condemned the call to violence, explained that Nigeria receives no direct development relationship but Dutch and EU human-rights programmes continue, and argued that cutting aid would not help LGBT people.
The Netherlands does not maintain a development relationship with the Nigerian government.
Nederland onderhoudt geen ontwikkelingsrelatie met de Nigeriaanse overheid.
Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het verstoren van het Sinterklaasfeest door straattuig (ingezonden 8 december 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether disruption of Sinterklaas celebrations by youths in Moroccan-populated neighbourhoods reflects a broader pattern, and what measures would prevent it. The minister called any disruption reprehensible, said periodic consultations with municipalities do not show it is more than isolated incidents, and noted street nuisance is primarily a local matter with incidents not recorded nationally.
Tackling street nuisance is in the first instance a local matter.
De aanpak van overlast op straat is in eerste instantie een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Elissen en Wilders over de islamitische hoofddoek van ons staatshoofd

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum whether the Queen's headscarf during a mosque visit in Abu Dhabi legitimises the oppression of women and whether this could have been prevented. The government answered that when the Queen visits a place of worship the dress rules of that building are respected, without addressing the substance of the criticism.
When Her Majesty the Queen visits a house of worship, the associated dress regulations are respected.
Bij een bezoek van H.M. de Koningin aan een godshuis worden de daarbij behorende kledingvoorschriften gerespecteerd.
Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de dreiging van een aanslag op Amsterdam (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether they were aware of a reported Al Qaeda plot against Amsterdam, how seriously the threat should be taken, and what security measures were taken. The minister confirmed awareness, said the threat is being investigated and gives no reason to change the threat level, and declined to disclose any security measures publicly.
I cannot make any public statements about security measures.
Over beveiligingsmaatregelen kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.

Vragen van de leden Driessen, Van Klaveren en Bontes (allen PVV) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Zimbabwaanse dictator Mugabe die homo's erger dan varkens en honden noemt (ingezonden 29

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about Mugabe's remark that gay people are worse than pigs and dogs, about Dutch aid to Zimbabwe, and why the Netherlands sends funds there. The minister confirmed the remark, declined to qualify predecessors' statements, and said aid goes via civil society and NGOs to democratisation, LHBT rights and the poorest, with no direct funding to the government.
The Dutch government provides no direct financial support to the Zimbabwean government.
De Nederlandse regering geeft geen rechtstreekse financiële steun aan de Zimbabwaanse regering.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de schaalvergroting van een Ottomaanse moskee in Limburg (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior about enlarging an Ottoman-style mosque in Limburg, arguing its growth increases Islam's harmful influence and that funding from the Turkish-linked Islamitische Stichting Nederland should be barred. The minister rejected the premise, citing constitutional religious freedom and state non-involvement in religious building finance absent illegal activity, and committed to no new measures beyond existing oversight.
I do not share this view. Moreover, freedom of religion applies in the Netherlands.
Ik deel deze visie niet. Bovendien geldt in Nederland vrijheid van godsdienst.

Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over gekuiste inburgeringspakketten in Nederlandse bibliotheken (ingezonden 24

An MP asked the ministers whether it is outrageous that public libraries acquire censored versions of self-study packages for civic integration courses, and whether the omission of scenes is a sign of Islamisation. The minister rejected both premises, explaining the censored versions exist because some countries of origin criminalise such imagery, and declined to remove the versions, saying library collection policy is a local responsibility.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de aanwezigheid van haatpredikers bij de opening van een Amsterdamse moskee (ingezonden 1 novemb

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether a Taliban-linked speaker and a radical imam who had reportedly called for violence in Germany, both present at the opening of an Amsterdam mosque, pose a public safety threat, whether such mosques should be closed, what the AIVD did with a German warning, and how entry of such preachers is prevented. The government answered that freedoms of speech, religion and association are constitutionally protected, that prosecution or local closure is possible in specific cases, that the AIVD received no warning beforehand, and that entry can be refused on public order grounds.
If statements constitute a punishable offence, the Public Prosecution Service can proceed to prosecution.
Indien uitspraken een strafbare gedraging opleveren, kan het Openbaar Ministerie tot vervolging overgaan.

Vragen van de leden De Jong en Van Klaveren (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat allochtone probleemjongeren in Utrecht werkschuw zijn (ingezonden 17 november 201

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about reports that allochtone problem youths in Utrecht are work-shy, questioning the sustainability of the welfare safety net, the spending on reintegration projects, and whether benefits should be stopped and fraud fully recovered. The state secretary agreed that refusing suitable work should lead to benefit withdrawal, noted the Utrecht project was municipally run with limited results so far, and pointed to planned fraud-recovery proposals and existing interest-charging rules.
The cabinet has developed proposals so that, in cases of benefit fraud, wrongly received benefits are fully recovered and a sanction of up to the fraud amount can additionally be imposed.

Het kabinet heeft voorstellen ontwikkeld om in geval van uitkeringsfraude, de onterecht ontvangen uitkeringen geheel terug te vorderen en daarnaast een sanctie op te leggen van maximaal het fraudebedrag.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de bouwplannen voor een megamoskee in Zoetermeer (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Interior Minister about neighbourhood unrest over a planned mosque in Zoetermeer, its financing, and whether the government would try to stop the mosque or restrict its minarets and loudspeakers. The minister said the local council must weigh the interests, that the municipality provides no funding, and refused to intervene.
It is up to the local authority to weigh the various interests and make a decision on building a mosque at this location.
Het is aan het lokale bestuur om de verschillende belangen te wegen en een besluit te nemen over de bouw van een moskee op deze locatie.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de bedreiging en het aanzetten tot geweld door de wereldvoorzitter van de Ahmadiyya Moslim Verga

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether a statement by the world leader of the Ahmadiyya movement, warning Geert Wilders and others that they would be destroyed, constitutes incitement to violence and what measures would follow. The minister answered that the statement calls for destruction through prayer rather than violence, sees no incitement to violence and therefore no reason for measures, and that the Dutch branch is part of the worldwide movement.
In the statements I see no incitement to or call for violence, and therefore I see no reason for measures against the Ahmadiyya Muslim Jamaat.
In de uitlatingen zie ik geen aanzet tot of oproep tot geweld en daarom zie ik ook geen aanleiding tot maatregelen tegen de Ahmadiyya Moslim Djamaat.

Vragen van de leden Dille, Van Klaveren en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voorstel om besnijdenis van meisjes te legaliseren (ingezonden

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Health whether they agree that female genital cutting is barbaric, whether legalising it would advance Islamisation, and whether they will guarantee it stays criminal. The minister confirmed it is criminal mutilation under the Criminal Code, said changing those articles is not planned, and did not give the requested guarantee in absolute terms.
Girls' circumcision is punishable in the Netherlands.

Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de onophoudelijke straatterreur tegen homostel

An MP asked several ministers about persistent street harassment of gay couples, whether police should prioritise it, whether perpetrators should be evicted, whether a failing mayor can be held accountable, and what concrete measures will be taken. The government answered that street nuisance is primarily a municipal matter, that mayors are accountable to the council rather than the national government, and listed existing anti-discrimination measures and a commitment from 40 municipalities to submit local plans by February 2012.
As a municipal administrative body, the mayor is accountable to the council for all of his functioning.
De burgemeester is als gemeentelijk bestuursorgaan over al zijn functioneren aan de raad verantwoording verschuldigd.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Elissen (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de hoeveelheid Nederlandse jihadisten (ingezonden 15 septe

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Justice how many Dutch passport holders take part in jihad abroad, whether they should be held in a terrorist ward on return, how many have dual nationality, and whether they should be denaturalised and expelled. The government answered that criminal investigations start on reasonable suspicion, that detention on a terrorist ward is possible under criteria, that AIVD data include Dutch, dual and foreign nationals, and that citizenship can be revoked for terrorist offences committed after 1 October 2010 provided it does not cause statelessness.
Under the Netherlands Nationality Act (RWN) it is possible to revoke Dutch nationality from a person irrevocably convicted of a terrorist offence.
Op basis van de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap (RWN) is het mogelijk om het Nederlanderschap te ontnemen van een persoon die onherroepelijk is veroordeeld wegens een terroristisch misdrijf.

Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de structurele straatterreur door Marokkanen (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the ministers of Interior and of Security and Justice whether street terror by Moroccan youths is a structural problem and whether measures such as curfews, denaturalisation, and withdrawing benefits from parents should be used, and whether failing mayors should be dismissable. The government answered that street nuisance is primarily a local matter, that problematic youth groups are a priority regardless of origin, and that mayors are accountable to the municipal council, which is primarily responsible for sanctioning them.
Consequently, in our administrative system it is primarily up to the council to sanction the mayor's performance where necessary.
In het verlengde daarvan is het in ons bestuurlijk bestel primair aan de raad om het functioneren van de burgemeester eventueel te sanctioneren.

Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Van Klaveren (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Archiefstukken homostel Hans en Ton vernietigd» (in

PVV MPs asked whether the destruction of 2009 driehoeksoverleg files about a harassed gay couple was deliberate, whether the Rijksrecherche should investigate, and whether the mayor should be dismissed. The minister explained the files were destroyed due to an expired archive authorisation rather than deliberately, saw no basis for a Rijksrecherche investigation, and said the municipal council must assess the mayor's conduct.
It is in the first place for the Utrecht municipal council to assess the conduct of Mayor Wolfsen.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan de gemeenteraad van Utrecht om de handelwijze van burgemeester Wolfsen te beoordelen.

Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over islamitische zending bij de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Infrastructuur en Milieu (in

An MP asked whether ministries should facilitate an Eid al-Fitr celebration organised by their youth associations, citing cost and ideological concerns, and what measures would prevent such events. The minister rejected the view, stated the event cost 600 euro borne by the youth associations plus indirect costs of staff time, and said no measures were planned.
The minister of BZK does not concern himself with the nature of their activities, as long as the limits of the law are not exceeded.
De minister van BZK houdt zich niet bezig met de aard van hun activiteiten, zolang de grenzen van de wet niet worden overschreden.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de mogelijkheid werkloze Turken te weren op basis van een EU-richtl

PVV MPs asked whether the 2004 EU directive could be used to exclude unemployed Turkish nationals, and whether the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling on Turkish civic integration was damaging. The minister replied that Turks are not EU citizens and cannot invoke the directive, so its restrictions do not apply to them, while the government is still reviewing how to secure integration.
Turks are not EU citizens and therefore cannot derive rights from the EU directive.
Turken geen EU-burgers zijn en dus geen rechten kunnen ontlenen aan de EU-richtlijn.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de bouw van een moskee met een imperialistische minaret van 27 meter hoog (ingezonden 12 augustu

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior about a mosque with a 27-metre minaret in Leiden, including whether it reflects Islamisation, how citizens are consulted on mosque construction, and whether mosques lower house prices. The minister rejected the Islamisation framing, pointed to municipal competence and the public consultation procedure used in Leiden, and said he knows of no research showing house price drops.
The authority to grant a building permit rests with the municipality.
De bevoegdheid tot het verlenen van een bouwvergunning berust bij de gemeente.

Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep dat Turken niet hoeven in te burgeren (ingezonden 17 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the minister how a Central Appeals Tribunal ruling that Turkish nationals need not complete civic integration relates to the cabinet's earlier position that the integration obligation falls outside the EU-Turkey Association Agreement, and what steps will be taken. The minister acknowledged the ruling, said the cabinet still holds that integration is essential and is considering how to secure it for Turkish nationals, and committed to continuing to seek an amendment of the Association Agreement.
The cabinet will also continue to work towards amending the EU-Turkey Association Agreement so that mandatory civic integration of Turks remains possible.
Het kabinet blijft zich daarnaast inzetten voor aanpassing van het EU-Associatieverdrag met Turkije zodat verplichte inburgering van Turken mogelijk blijft.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een reis van Nederlandse moslims naar een Egyptisch haatkamp (ingezonden 29 augustus 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about a reported trip by Dutch converts to an Egyptian Islamic camp, asking whether returnees would be monitored, whether the trip threatens security, whether the Landelijk Platform Nieuwe Moslims received subsidy, and whether citizens could be barred from returning. The Minister answered that citizens are free within legal limits, that there is no information indicating a terrorist threat from the camp, that the platform received no central government subsidy, and that Dutch nationals cannot be denied entry.
I have no information that the Islamic camp in Egypt would pose such a threat.
Ik beschik niet over informatie dat van het islamkamp in Egypte een dergelijke dreiging uit zou gaan.

Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de honderden eerwraken in de politieregio's Haaglanden, Zuid-Holland-Zuid en Rotterd

An MP asks ministers about reports of hundreds of honour killings per year in three police regions, the Delft arson case, the Islam link, and concrete measures. The ministers say the Delft case is under investigation, the figures concern honour-related violence cases consulted with the national expertise centre rather than confirmed killings, culture rather than religion drives the phenomenon, and point to the programme letters for measures.
I cannot comment on this, because the Public Prosecution Service has informed me that the investigation is not yet concluded.
Ik kan hier geen uitspraak over doen, omdat het Openbaar Ministerie mij heeft medegedeeld dat het onderzoek nog niet is afgerond.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over gratis vechtsportlessen voor overlastgevend tuig in Gouda (ingezonden 5 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether free martial arts lessons for nuisance youths in Gouda rewarded bad behaviour, what the project costs were, and why not harsher punishment or loss of nationality instead. The minister rejected the reward framing, said the preventive project targets beginning nuisance behaviour with costs of EUR 36,618, and stated that prosecution is for the OM and that nationality cannot be withdrawn for ordinary offences.
I do not share this view. There is no question of rewarding bad behaviour.
Ik deel deze visie niet. Er is geen sprake van beloning van slecht gedrag.

Vragen van de leden De Jong en Van Klaveren (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over fraude bij rijexamen (ingezonden 24 mei 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about fraud at driving theory exams, the number of exams taken with interpreters and their costs, and whether caught fraudsters should be permanently excluded and whether Dutch language should be required. The minister answered that fraud is a criminal matter for the prosecutor and courts, listed interpreter-assisted exam numbers and costs, said language proficiency is not a requirement, and committed to making the extra costs of individual exams with interpreters transparent.
Committing fraud at the theory exam is a criminal offence.
Het plegen van fraude bij het theorie-examen is een strafbaar feit.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de belachelijke uitlatingen van een Surinaams parlementslid over het homohuweli

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Education and Foreign Affairs about remarks by a Surinamese parliamentarian calling same-sex marriage a European epidemic and urging eradication of homosexuality. The government answered that the remarks speak for themselves, that the MP spoke as a member of the Surinamese National Assembly, and that it deplores and condemns the statements.
The Dutch government deeply regrets and condemns the remarks of the parliamentarian.
De Nederlandse regering betreurt en veroordeelt de uitlatingen van het parlementslid ten zeerste.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Driessen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de honderdduizenden euro's belastinggeld voor een opvoedingsproject voor Marokkanen (ingezonden

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about EUR 300,000 of public money for a parenting project for Moroccan families, arguing it conflicts with the coalition agreement's end of target-group policy and suggesting denaturalisation and deportation instead. The minister replied that parenting support is a municipal responsibility under decentralised youth policy, so no cut to the municipal fund is warranted, and that the government will pursue reforms to nationality revocation for serious offences.
Youth policy falls under decentralised policy. The municipality acts within the policy space it has.
Jeugdbeleid valt onder het gedecentraliseerde beleid. De gemeente handelt binnen de beleidsruimte die de gemeente heeft.
Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Dille (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de weigering van de Amsterdamse en Tilburgse GGD (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

MPs Van Klaveren and Dille asked why the Amsterdam and Tilburg GGD refused to investigate child abuse in mosques and what measures would be taken. The minister answered that a misunderstanding arose: the refused study concerned mosque education by Verwey-Jonker Instituut, which was halted because mosque boards would not agree to research, while the GGD Nederland study covers the social environment and selected other municipalities.
Apparently a misunderstanding arose because two studies were confused with each other.
Er is kennelijk een misverstand ontstaan doordat er twee onderzoeken door elkaar zijn gehaald.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de gratis parkeermogelijkheden in verband met de Ramadan (ingez

Two PVV MPs asked whether Bergen op Zoom opened parking barriers for Ramadan, whether this shows growing Islamic influence, and whether the municipality's costs should be cut from the municipal fund. The minister answered that the free night parking was a temporary trial to equalise city-centre parking rules, not related to Ramadan, and that parking policy is a municipal responsibility.
Parking policy is an autonomous task of the municipality.
Het parkeerbeleid is een autonome taak van de gemeente.

Vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het uitroepen van sharia-zones in Engeland (ingezonden 1 augustus 201

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Klaveren asked whether the government condemns reports of sharia zones in England, the statements of a 'Muslims against crusades' supporter, and whether such organisations should be banned. Minister Rosenthal answered that sharia law does not apply in the UK and is unacceptable in the Netherlands, rejects the statements, and noted that the group Islam4UK has been banned in the UK.
The key point is that sharia legislation does not apply in the United Kingdom.
