MPs El Abassi and Ergin asked whether supermarkets selling halal-certified chicken that is actually cheaper plofkip (broiler) meat amount to consumer deception, and whether ACM, NVWA oversight of halal slaughter and the 2012 convenant are adequate. The minister replied that supermarkets' move to BLk1* chicken is a private initiative outside government judgment, that halal certification is a private matter with no government role, and that existing accreditation and inspection frameworks are sufficient, committing to no new action.
The halal certification mark is a private initiative.
Het halal keurmerk betreft een privaat initiatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het sluiten van de nachtspoedhulp van het Evidensia dierenziekenhuis in Den Haag

An SP MP asks the agriculture minister about Evidensia closing its overnight emergency animal clinic in The Hague, sending owners to Amsterdam and Barendrecht, and whether this shows private chains' power over animal care. The minister says emergency care organisation is for the profession, a regional meeting is planned, a plan is due before summer, and price and chain-power research results are expected in autumn.
It is up to the profession how care, including emergency care, is organised and kept accessible.
Het is aan de beroepsgroep hoe zorg, waaronder de spoedhulp, ingericht wordt en toegankelijk blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Holman over het bericht ‘Experts bezorgd om vogelgriep bij Amerikaanse koeien: is Nederland voorbereid op een uitbraak? 'Tests liggen klaar'’

MPs Hertzberger and Holman asked the Minister of Agriculture about H5N1 avian flu in US dairy cattle, including surveillance, risks for Dutch dairy farming, trade restrictions and vaccines. The minister answered that the Netherlands is well informed via several channels, that the Dutch monitoring system would detect an infection quickly, and that contingency scenarios are being prepared, but gave no firm commitments beyond informing parliament later.
Once the research results are known, expected shortly after summer 2024, I will inform the House of Representatives about this.
Zodra de onderzoeksresultaten bekend zijn, naar verwachting kort na de zomer van 2024, zal ik de Tweede Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het bericht ‘Boetes elk jaar omhoog, behalve voor dierenleed in slachthuizen’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why fines for animal welfare violations in slaughterhouses have not been raised since 2012/2013 while other fines rise yearly. The Minister answered that an inflation correction is planned, that larger slaughterhouses may face higher fines, that a new procedure is targeted for July 2025, and that the NVWA is working to shorten the long delays before fines are issued.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Flach over de toepassing van de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling (BOR) in de agrarische sector

Two MPs from the SGP asked the Minister of Agriculture about how the business succession scheme (BOR) applies to crop-lease arrangements in agriculture, including whether the Grondkamer's rules on necessary crop rotation and the exclusion of grass and maize are fair to landowners. The Minister confirmed the rules, explained the rationale for excluding grass and maize, and declined to extend BOR treatment to one-sided crop leases before a planned revision of the Pachtwet.
When the crop lease regime was created, the legislature determined that it was not intended for maize and grass.
Bij de totstandkoming van de teeltpacht is door de wetgever bepaald dat het regime niet bedoeld is voor mais en gras
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over de huis- en hobbydierlijst

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the pet list (huis- en hobbydierenlijst), including transitional rules, the legal basis after a 2017 court ruling on transparency, a pending objection by Our-EARTH, and whether enforcement can be paused during appeal. The minister answered that transitional rules allow existing animals to be kept until death, that the list rests on independent scientific advice, that objections have no suspensive effect so enforcement continues, and gave short answers to the remaining questions.
Objection and appeal procedures have no suspensive effect (see article 6:16 of the General Administrative Law Act) on the entry into force of the pet list on 1 July 2024.
Bezwaar- en beroepsprocedures hebben geen schorsende werking (zie artikel 6:16 van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht) ten aanzien van de inwerkingtreding van de huis- en hobbydierenlijst op 1 juli 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Eerdmans over puppy-yoga

MPs Kostić and Eerdmans asked the minister about puppy yoga practices shown by Radar, including puppies handled for hours, lack of animal behaviour oversight, and possible welfare violations. The minister agreed the practice is undesirable, reported NVWA inspections finding overtreding with intended fines, and announced preparation of a general administrative order (AMvB) to ban puppy yoga.
I will therefore prepare a general administrative order to prohibit yoga with puppies.
Ik zal dan ook een algemene maatregel van bestuur voorbereiden om yoga met puppy's te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach, Vedder, Postma, Grinwis en Pierik over de visserij en ETS-2

Five MPs asked whether fisheries should be brought under the EU ETS-2 carbon market and what the consequences would be for the sector. The minister answers that the cabinet has decided not to opt fisheries in, citing lack of a viable path for the sector, EU state-aid limits and unequal competition, and that a WECR impact study will be sent to Parliament.
The cabinet has now decided not to bring fisheries under ETS2 through the opt-in.
Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om visserij niet onder het ETS2 te brengen middels de opt-in
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Van der Plas over het rapport “Hinweise zum Einsatz autogener BTV-3 Impfstoffe”

Two MPs from BBB asked the Minister of Agriculture about a German expert report on autogenous BTV-3 vaccines, including whether Dutch vets may prescribe them, whether NVWA enforcement threats harm farmers, and liability for damage. The Minister confirmed conditional authorisation of three regular BTV-3 vaccines, said autogenous vaccines are restricted to specific herds and recalled by the German manufacturer for safety issues, refused liability, and declined to individually answer all questions by the deadline.
I am not going to ensure that.
Ik ga daar niet voor zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over uitbetaling GLB-gelden ecoregelingen

MP Pierik (BBB) asked the minister why many farmers had still not received their CAP eco-scheme payments, why the expected payment share was delayed, and whether compensation was possible. Minister Adema attributed the delay to late approval of national funding, a complex and late-finalised 2023 CAP strategic plan, and set 30 June 2024 as the deadline for all payments, while declining compensation.
I do not provide for compensation because the statutory deadline for the payments is 30 June following the year in which the application was submitted.
Ik voorzie niet in compensatie want de wettelijke termijn van de betalingen is 30 juni 3 volgend op het jaar dat de aanvraag is ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostic´ over een dikbilstier die vanwege de stress is overleden op de veemarkt in Schagen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about a double-muscled bull that died from stress at a cattle market in Schagen, and about welfare problems linked to markets, NVWA inspection, breeding of double-muscled cattle and caesarean births. The minister calls the death an incident, rejects a market ban and a fokverbod, and says a welfare-based breeding agreement is planned while the sector's evaluation is still pending.
Introducing a breeding or keeping ban conflicts with the European Breeding Regulation 2016/1021.
Het instellen van een fok- of houdverbod is in strijd met de Europese Fokkerijverordening 2016/1021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de Verordening welzijn en traceerbaarheid van honden en katten

An MP asked whether the Netherlands would push for bans on brachycephalic breeding, chip and registration duties for all dogs and cats, and registration of all breeders in the EU dog and cat welfare regulation, and questioned the exemption for small-scale trade. The minister confirmed Dutch participation, said the Netherlands supports the proposal and will push for these measures, though full EU-wide identification of all animals is unlikely.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet whether its 2030 targets (housing, social rental share, insulation, affordable rent quotas) were still achievable. The minister answered that progress is on track for most targets, with some delays in housing and insulation of rental homes, and promised further reporting.
For the National Insulation Programme the targets are not out of sight.
Voor het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma zijn de doelstellingen niet uit beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to state, for each 2030 target, whether it is still achievable, including nitrogen halving and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that nitrogen deposition targets are out of reach due to revised critical deposition values, and that organic farmland is growing steadily but a large gap remains, with extra funding reserved.
The nitrogen targets are currently out of reach.
De stikstofdoelen liggen op dit moment buiten bereik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked about progress toward the cabinet's 2030 targets on poverty and debt, and whether current measures suffice. The minister answers that poverty and child poverty targets will not be met without additional policy per the CPB forecast, while the debt target shows a slight rise with no CBS forecast, and commits to informing parliament in early June.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the cabinet whether four education and research targets (zero truant children, 3% R&D spending, fewer than 18,000 early school leavers by 2026, and basic skills by 2028) remain achievable and why. The Minister answered that the targets are not hopeless, described the measures taken, and acknowledged that R&D spending (2.30% of GDP) and truancy figures are behind track, without changing the cabinet's commitments.
The picture that the targets under K, Q, U and V have become hopelessly out of reach is not one we recognise.
Het beeld dat de genoemde doelstellingen onder K, Q, U en V hopeloos uit beeld zijn geraakt herkennen wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over een via Nederland verspreide tuberculose-uitbraak bij apen die als proefdier worden gebruikt

An MP asked the health and agriculture ministers why parliament was not informed of a tuberculosis outbreak in laboratory macaques imported via the Netherlands, and about the import and export controls on such animals. The minister replied that the risk to public health was negligible, that no enforcement was needed because the importer broke no rules, that the import trade continues because research still needs these animals, and that the answers came late.
Infections with (possible) zoonoses in kept or wild animals are found more often. We do not report every infection to you, only where it may have consequences for public health.

Het komt vaker voor dat er besmettingen met (mogelijke) zoönosen bij gehouden of wilde dieren worden aangetoond. We melden u niet elke besmetting, alleen waar dat mogelijk gevolgen voor de volksgezondheid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current progress on 19 government targets for 2030 and beyond, with concrete figures per target. The answer, limited to the target of 50% less raw material use, says the government is replacing that target with a new set of national circular-economy goals and that PBL will monitor progress in its next report in 2025.
In the National Circular Economy Programme 2023–2030 it was announced that the target of using 50% fewer abiotic raw materials by 2030 will be replaced by a set of overarching national goals.

In het Nationaal Programma Circulaire Economie (NPCE) 2023–2030 ... is aangekondigd dat de doelstelling om in 2030 50% minder abiotische grondstoffen te gebruiken, vervangen zal worden door een set aan overkoepelende doelen op nationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to report progress on its 2030 targets, including 100% clean water by 2027 under the EU Water Framework Directive. The minister answered only that sub-question, stating that roughly three-quarters of about 100,000 water-body targets are currently met, that many planned measures risk not being completed by 2027, and that a progress update will come before a June debate and an evaluation at year end.
In the run-up to the Water committee debate of 25 June, the House will receive an update on the progress of the KRW impulse programme.
In aanloop naar het Commissiedebat Water van 25 juni ontvangt de Kamer een update over de voortgang van het KRW-impulsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government for the progress on its 2030 targets for CO2 reduction and R&D spending, citing reports that the targets were out of reach. The ministers answer that the 55-60% CO2 target is within reach given PBL projections of 46-57% plus further measures, and that the 3% GDP R&D target is ambitious, with uncertainty from the paused National Growth Fund.

The PBL indicates that the expected greenhouse gas emission reduction in the Netherlands in 2030, based on the policy on the agenda for which an effect estimate could be made, comes to about 46–57% compared with 1990.

Het PBL geeft aan dat de verwachte broeikasgasemissiereductie in Nederland in 2030 op basis van het geagendeerde beleid, waarvoor een effectschatting kon worden gemaakt, uitkomt op circa 46–57% ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Flach over de brief ‘Looptijd EHF project’

Two MPs asked the agriculture minister about a letter from a Zeeland water storage partnership requesting an extension because a 20-month wait between application and grant cut the project's runtime by about half, partly linked to ELFPO funding. The minister acknowledged the delay, attributed it to an overspent crisis-era EHF scheme and budget reshuffling, said the funding is not from ELFPO, pointed to the 2025 deadlines and the new CAP period, and declined to comment on the pending objection procedure.
The project in question is the subject of an objection procedure, so no statement can be made on it now.
Het voorliggende project is onderwerp van een bezwaarprocedure, daarom kan daar nu geen uitspraak over gedaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het intrekken van de subsidie voor een innovatief en kansrijk plan voor een paneerkaasmakerij in de provincie Utrecht

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why a subsidy for a Utrecht cheese-making project was withdrawn after applicants self-reported a minor error, and whether the 'kennelijke fout' rule could help them. The minister answered that the rule does not apply, that the GLB policy rule has no retroactive effect, and that the province had to refuse subsidy because the activity started before the application, offering only a new application round.
In the present case there is no question of an obvious error.
In de voorliggende casus is geen sprake van een kennelijke fout
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current status of its 2030 targets, including halving road deaths. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answers only the road-casualty sub-question: the target is likely too ambitious, the cabinet keeps existing measures and will examine an extra step, with results expected mid-2024.
For question 2, under e, you will receive a separate answer from me shortly.
Voor vraag 2, onder e, zult u op korte termijn een separaat antwoord van mij ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Kostić over over het bericht dat Adema achter de schermen pleitte voor een glyfosaatverbod

MPs Ouwehand and Kostić asked the minister, after a Zembla report, why the Netherlands did not vote against renewing glyphosate's EU approval, citing scientific criticism of the Ctgb's cancer and Parkinson's assessment. Minister Adema answered that the Netherlands abstained, that EU and national assessments found no causal link to Parkinson's or cancer, that a RIVM study on Parkinson's was commissioned, and that approvals would be revisited if new evidence emerged.
I cannot make any statements about the precise content of the discussions within the cabinet.
Over de precieze inhoud van de gesprekken binnen het kabinet kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de kersenteelt

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the minister why a cherry-farming exemption for Exirel conditions excluding treatment after prior cyantraniliprole use leaves most orchards unable to use it, and why the minister chose a different implementation than the parliamentary motion requested. The minister answered that the conditions follow Ctgb advice, that risk-reducing measures are required, and that the NVWA advice on Tracer and Exirel for other crops is expected soon, with a decision to follow after consultation and no firm deadline promised.
In granting an exemption I rely on advice from the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA) and the Ctgb.
Ik laat mij bij het verlenen van een vrijstelling adviseren door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) en het Ctgb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen zoals in deze vragen geformuleerd onder i, j, r, s en t

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government about progress on cabinet targets for 2030 and 2040, including zero homelessness, zero youth in closed youth care, reducing health inequalities and reducing overweight. The State Secretary replied that targets are ambitious but progress is partial: homelessness and overweight targets are unlikely to be met without intensified measures, closed placements have fallen but zero is not yet reached, and the health-inequality mission has no quantitative forecast yet.
The calculation shows that the agreements do contribute to fewer people with overweight, but with the actions from the NPA introduced in recent years the ambitions for 2040 will not be achieved.

De doorrekening laat zien dat de afspraken weliswaar bijdragen aan minder mensen die overgewicht hebben, maar met de acties uit het NPA die de afgelopen jaren zijn ingevoerd worden de ambities voor 2040 niet bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over dat Appelsientje de frisdrankentaks ontwijkt door koemelk aan een product toe te voegen

An MP asked why fruit juice producer Appelsientje can avoid the soft drinks excise by adding a small amount of milk fat, and whether the government will close this loophole and reconsider the dairy exemption. The state secretary answered that the dairy exemption has existed since 1993 and is currently lawful, that a contour letter sets out options for a differentiated sugar-based levy and for changing the dairy exemption, and that any change would need 12 to 24 months of preparation by Customs.
The attached contour letter sets out the options for a differentiated consumption tax.
In bijgaande contourenbrief zijn de opties voor een gedifferentieerde verbruiksbelasting uiteengezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht '#SIA2024: lancement du plan gouvernemental renforcé de reconquête de notre souveraineté sur l’élevage'

MP Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a French government plan on livestock sovereignty, including its framing of livestock farming, its push for an EU ban on cultivated meat, and whether the Netherlands would raise this with France. The minister answered that the French plan is vague on its claims, that cultivated meat is seen as complementary to conventional farming, that the Netherlands opposes an early ban and will seek a coalition of like-minded member states, and that the French policy choices are not a reason to doubt French government independence.
The cabinet will, together with like-minded member states, consider with which member states constructive discussions can be held on this topic.
Het kabinet zal, samen met gelijkgestemde lidstaten, bezien met welke lidstaten er constructieve gesprekken gevoerd kunnen worden over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over mestderogatie

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality to explain the EU enforcement mechanisms (infringement, interim measures, periodic penalties, CAP payment cuts, national court challenges) that would follow if the Netherlands suspended its 2022 manure derogation and reverted to the earlier rules, along with timelines and likelihoods. The Minister answered each sub-question in detail, stating that non-compliance would be evident and likely lead to rapid EU proceedings, fines and penalties, CAP reductions, and quick national court action, and that obtaining a new derogation or using proportionality arguments is not realistic.
Failure to meet the conditions of the decision may be grounds for the Commission to withdraw it.
Het niet voldoen aan de voorwaarden van de beschikking kan voor de EC een reden zijn voor intrekking ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over de onlangs openbaar gemaakte Woo-documenten “stikstofadvies Remkes” deel I-II-III

Two MPs from BBB asked the Minister of Nature and Nitrogen, on behalf of the Minister of Agriculture, about the released Woo documents on the Remkes nitrogen advice, covering the MOB letter, bank and supply-chain steering, buffer strips, socio-economic impact methodology, and permit revocation. The government answered that the MOB letter is public, that the Remkes report took its own line, that the Landbouwakkoord failed so the concept commitments are not binding and no instruments to secure supply-chain contributions have yet been developed, and that provinces are not obliged to use the socio-economic impact method or specific instruments.
The agreement did not come about and therefore the draft agreements are not binding.
Het akkoord is er niet gekomen 7 en daarmee zijn de conceptafspraken niet bindend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Bromet over de aanwezigheid van hoge concentraties van het verboden gewasbeschermingsmiddel dinoterb in oppervlaktewater in het Natura 2000-gebied het Zwanenwater

MPs Gabriëls and Bromet asked about dinoterb, a banned pesticide, found in surface water in the Natura 2000 area Zwanenwater, including its origin, enforcement capacity, sanctions and whether enforcement should be tightened. The minister said a HHNK investigation into sources is underway, that residues may leach from soil or illegal use is possible, that NVWA found no dinoterb in inspections, and that enforcement was adequate while the ministries explore improving oversight.
I am waiting for the results of the investigation before deciding whether further action is necessary.
Ik wacht de resultaten van het onderzoek af om te kunnen bepalen of verdere actie noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over het grote verschil tussen de Duitse en de Nederlandse Schijf van Vijf

An MP asked the state secretaries of Health and Agriculture about the gap between the revised German and the Dutch food guidelines (Schijf van Vijf), including the 60/40 plant-animal protein target and whether sustainability should be weighed. The government confirmed the 50/50 target for 2030, said the Gezondheidsraad advice is being followed, and explained the differences in method and scope, while leaving updates of the Schijf van Vijf to the Voedingscentrum and new ambitions to a new cabinet.
Formulating new ambitions or policy goals is up to a new cabinet.
Het formuleren van nieuwe ambities of beleidsdoelen is aan een nieuw kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans, Wilders, Omtzigt en Van der Plas over het bericht 'Ingrijpend miljardenpakket voor opkoop boeren moet koude sanering veestapel voorkomen'

MPs Hermans, Wilders, Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the agriculture minister about press reports of a multi-billion buyout package to prevent a cold clearance of livestock, and whether the government would refrain from announcing buyout schemes during the formation period. The minister says a broad action plan responding to the Van Campen motion is being prepared, that a buyout scheme is only one component, that the European Commission has ruled out a new derogation, and asks the Chamber to debate the plan urgently.
This cabinet considers the situation very urgent and intends to send an action plan to the House at short notice after final decision-making.
Dit kabinet vindt de situatie zeer urgent en is voornemens om, na definitieve besluitvorming, op korte termijn een plan van aanpak aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over de Kamerbrief ‘voortgang emissiereductie veehouderij’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, about shortcomings of emission-reducing livestock barn systems, liability for farmers' investments, how to obtain nature permits for innovative barns, the status of the appropriate-assessment handbook, monitoring, timelines for a regieorgaan and pilots, and subsidies. The Minister answers at length, explaining the revamped barn-assessment programme, interim permit routes, and timelines of roughly three years, and generally gives substantive but often non-committal responses, while declining to settle liability questions definitively.
The research on securing the use of low-emission barn systems for permits with a Natura 2000 activity will be completed shortly.
Het onderzoek over de borging van het gebruik van emissiearme stalsystemen voor vergunningen met een Natura 2000-activiteit wordt binnenkort afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de vreselijke import van kalfjes uit Ierland

An MP (Ouwehand, PvdD) asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why Dutch calf imports from Ireland keep rising despite past talks with the sector, and presses for a ban on long-distance transport of unweaned calves, on the Irish authorities, on infringement proceedings and on suitable drinking systems. The Minister says she supports an EU-wide ban on transports over 8 hours in the revised Transport Regulation, cannot ban the imports herself due to free movement rules, will raise the issues with Ireland and the Commission, and points to sector commitments and an upcoming IBR/BVD control plan.
However, I cannot prohibit these transports because of the rules on the free movement of goods and the transport regulation, which permits long-distance transport of unweaned calves under conditions.

Deze transporten kan ik echter niet verbieden vanwege de regels omtrent vrij verkeer van goederen en de transportverordening die langeafstandstransporten van ongespeende kalveren onder voorwaarden toelaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de verkoop van illegaal gefokte dieren met ernstige erfelijke aandoeningen via Marktplaats

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why illegally bred Scottish Fold kittens with hereditary defects can still be advertised on Marktplaats, and what enforcement and platform measures will stop it. The minister confirmed breeding is prohibited and enforcement letters were sent, but said platforms have no duty to verify legality, declined to require faster removal of ads, and pointed to a planned house-ban and EU rules as the remedy.
To ensure an end to the illegal breeding of animals that suffer from hereditary traits, it is also necessary to stop the demand for these animals.
Om ervoor te zorgen dat er een einde komt aan de illegale fok van dieren die lijden vanwege erfelijke kenmerken is het ook nodig om de vraag naar deze dieren te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over amfetamine in mestvergisters

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked the government about amphetamine found in digestate from manure digesters, the applicability of the Opiumwet and Meststoffenwet, and compensation for affected operators. The minister answered that the Opiumwet is not directly applicable given the mixed-in residues, that digestate may be traded as fertiliser only if it poses no health or environmental risk, that responsibility for waste enforcement lies with provinces and municipalities, and that she declines to offer compensation.
The Ministry of LNV was not involved in this action, but only afterwards provided a view at the request of the provinces on the interpretation of the Meststoffenwet.
Het Ministerie van LNV is in dit handelen niet betrokken, maar heeft op verzoek van de provincies pas naderhand een zienswijze verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over de felle kritiek op dierenpark Mondo Verde

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about public criticism of zoo Mondo Verde, including enclosure conditions for wolves, camels, big cats and panthers, prior permit refusals, and past welfare incidents, and whether the zoo's licence would be withdrawn. The minister answered that RVO and the NVWA are handling inspections and enforcement, that a camel enclosure lacks a permit and will be addressed, and that the licence will not be withdrawn yet pending the inspection findings.
RVO will hold the animal park to account on this and the situation must be restored.
RVO zal het dierenpark hierop aanspreken en de situatie moet hersteld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de illegale spieringvisserij in de Waddenzee

An MP asked the Minister about large-scale illegal smelt fishing in the Wadden Sea, enforcement failures after a 2023 court ruling, the fishing techniques of shrimp fishers, and the delayed introduction of fishing-free zones near fish migration structures. The Minister said unlicensed fishers were formally warned, that inspectors monitor the fishing and will act on further violations, and that the fishing-free zones are still being decided, with results to be shared shortly.
The Minister for Nature and Nitrogen has formally warned three fishers about this.
De Minister voor Natuur en Stikstof heeft drie vissers hierop formeel gewaarschuwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Baasje van ‘barbaarse’ bijthond lijkt van aardbodem verdwenen’

An MP asked the ministers whether the owner of a dog that killed a small dog, and who was ordered by a civil court to pay compensation but cannot be found, will be tracked down, and about dog-bite registration, a national reporting point and mandatory dog-owner courses. The minister answered that the case is civil rather than criminal, that enforcement runs through a bailiff, that a national reporting point is planned, and that the detailed bite-prevention measures will be sent to parliament after the summer.
The Judiciary does not keep figures on cases in which owners of a biting dog fail to comply with a court judgment.
Antwoord 4 De Rechtspraak houdt geen cijfers bij over zaken waarbij eigenaren van een bijthond het vonnis van de rechter niet nakomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice concerns about the winning parties, and whether such meetings are compatible with civil service neutrality. The government answered that the meetings were regular discussions of the election outcome, denied that working attitudes changed, declined to say how many staff attended, and said no similar meetings are planned.
No, it is not recorded how many staff members took part in regular staff meetings and consultations on the election outcome during the day.
Nee, er wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers gedurende de dag in reguliere staven en overleggen over de verkiezingsuitslag hebben gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice their feelings about the outcome, whether this places civil servants who voted for winning parties in an awkward position, and whether such meetings will be held again. The VWS minister answered that discussions about what the result means for policy work took place, that attendance was not recorded, that civil servants must remain politically neutral, and that the ministry values an open and safe working climate.
It was not recorded how many employees were present.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government confirmed that BZK held two meetings to interpret the result, stated civil servants must remain politically neutral, and said such sessions fit an open workplace culture without committing to avoid them in future.
Civil servants have a supporting, advisory and executing role, in which they are expected, on the basis of professionalism, to advise objectively.
Ambtenaren hebben hierbij een ondersteunende, adviserende en uitvoerende rol, waarin zij op basis van professionaliteit worden geacht om objectief te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether the Ministry of Defence organised meetings for officials after the November 2023 election, including whether such meetings put civil servants in a difficult position and whether they will be repeated. The minister answered that no departmental, DG or directorate-level meetings were held, only regular discussions of the election result, and that a safe working environment and political neutrality of officials are important.
No meetings were organised at the Ministry of Defence at departmental, directorate-general or directorate level following the election result.
Op het Ministerie van Defensie zijn geen bijeenkomsten georganiseerd op departementaal, dan wel op directoraat-generaal of directieniveau naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether civil servants were gathered after the November 2023 election to voice concerns about winning parties, and whether such meetings would recur. The minister replied that no formal meetings were held, only routine discussions on the election result, and that civil servants should be free to share reflections while staying politically neutral.
No formal meetings were organised by the ministry or at Directorate-General level.
Er zijn geen formele bijeenkomsten georganiseerd door het ministerie of op DG-niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings for civil servants after the November 2023 election result, what they were for, and whether such gatherings undermine civil servant neutrality. The minister confirmed meetings were held to reflect on the result, said staff were encouraged to share views without restriction, declined to give attendance numbers, and said such meetings may be repeated after a new coalition agreement.
It was not recorded how many colleagues attended the various meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel collega's de verschillende bijeenkomsten hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election results, what their purpose was, whether staff could voice how their working approach would change, and whether such meetings threaten civil servants' neutrality. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the ministry held an online briefing on the election outcome for all staff, with no interactive input, plus internal directorate discussions, that such briefings are standard after elections and planned after the coalition agreement, and that civil servants remain politically neutral.
Because many employees watched the online presentation together on one screen, it cannot be determined exactly how many employees attended.
Omdat veel medewerkers de online presentatie samen op een scherm hebben bekeken, is niet exact te achterhalen hoeveel medewerkers hierbij aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether OCW held internal meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome and how this affects their neutrality. The minister confirmed a departmental meeting and several directorate meetings focused on the implications of the results and the primacy of politics, stating civil servants remain politically neutral and that such reflection is part of their work.
It is important that civil servants remain politically neutral in their work.
Het is belangrijk dat ambtenaren politiek neutraal zijn en blijven in hun werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, whether staff could voice how the result changed their work, and whether such meetings threaten civil service neutrality. The minister replied that no formal meetings were organised, only informal discussions in some units, that such open dialogue fits a safe working climate, and that civil servants remain politically neutral and execute decisions made by ministers.
There is no insight into how many people participated.
Er is geen zicht op hoeveel personen deelnamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether they held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, what was discussed, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The Minister of LNV answered that meetings were held to anticipate policy implications, that no restrictions were placed on input, and that such meetings remain acceptable, while stressing civil servant political neutrality.
It was not recorded how many civil servants attended the meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel ambtenaren bij de bijeenkomsten aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the election result, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government answered that such discussions took place only within existing regular meetings, that no separate meetings are planned, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
This is not possible; no overviews are kept of how many and which employees attended which meetings.
Dit is niet mogelijk, er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van hoeveel en welke medewerkers er bij welke overleggen aanwezig zijn geweest
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de schade door PFAS in landbouwgif

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about PFAS in pesticides and biocides, including their health effects, legal maximum levels, soil accumulation, the EU restriction proposal, and whether a warning should be placed on the Ctgb website. The minister answered substantively on most points, stating PFAS are present in about 5% of approved products, that the EU proposal targets PFAS as excipients, and refusing a website warning because no official classification exists.
I support these proposals and will continue to actively question the European Commission about them.
Ik steun deze voorstellen en zal de Europese Commissie hier actief op blijven bevragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van     22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether civil servants were invited to meetings after the November 2023 election about how their working conditions might change under a new coalition, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The government answered that no departmental meetings were held beyond regular discussions of the election, that it does not rule out future meetings about election outcomes, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
No, I do not rule out that in the future meetings will take place where the outcome of elections is discussed.
Nee, ik sluit niet uit dat in de toekomst bijeenkomsten plaatsvinden waar over de uitkomst van verkiezingen wordt gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het leven en lijden van konijnen in de vleesindustrie

An MP (Ouwehand, PvdD) asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about footage of suffering rabbits in meat production, including caged housing, deaths among animals, lax enforcement with warnings rather than sanctions, and whether sector improvements since 2019 are real. The Minister condemns the illegal filming, says the footage is distressing, describes the sector's housing plan, inspection counts and antibiotic reductions, admits no central mortality data exists, and says the NVWA applies a specific intervention policy and that central mortality registration becomes mandatory only from 2025.
Central registration of mortality is however not mandatory and I therefore have no figures on mortality.
Centrale registratie van uitval is echter niet verplicht en ik heb daarom geen cijfers over de uitval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de gevolgen van het aalverbod op vissen met de ankerkuil in grote wateren

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the eel fishing ban covers all types of anchor trap (ankerkuil) in coastal waters such as the Eems-Dollard, Wadden Sea and Westerschelde, even though those traps lack eel-catching features and no eels are caught there, and asks for a change in rules or exemptions. The minister replies that EU rules and the national regulation require a ban on any gear that can catch eels, that no separate definition exists for coastal anchor traps, and that the government will investigate whether a modified trap can be permitted in the closed period.
For the anchor trap, I intend to start research into this.
Voor de ankerkuil ben ik voornemens om hiervoor onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de gevolgen van de korting op het tongquotum

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the socio-economic impact of a 60% cut to the North Sea sole quota, the reach of fishing vessel decommissioning, financial support options, sole stock assessment uncertainties, and the cumulative ecological effects of offshore wind farms on fish. The minister answered that the Netherlands raised the sole cut repeatedly but is not at the negotiating table, that impact assessments are pending from Wageningen Economic Research, that some decommissioned quotas will be made available to active fishers via producer organisations, that a new financial support scheme is largely legally blocked for now, and that research on wind farm impacts continues, though commercial species are not yet covered.
It is not possible to make the consequences of the high cut visible for individual fishers.
Het is niet mogelijk om de gevolgen van de hoge korting inzichtelijk te maken voor individuele vissers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Tjeerd de Groot, Kostić en Koekkoek over de controle op visfraude door de NVWA

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, D66, PvdD and Volt asked the minister about the court ruling on NVWA fish-fraud controls, overfishing, the adequacy of staffing and EU compliance of the inspection system. The minister acknowledged ongoing EU infringement procedures and announced capacity expansion and a revised steekproefplan, while largely defending current staffing levels and declining to share confidential Commission advice.
These advice and remarks are confidential.
Deze adviezen en opmerkingen zijn vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het wetenschappelijke vangstadvies voor tong

Pieter Flach (SGP) asked the minister why she warned of a possible zero sole catch advice for 2025 citing Wageningen Marine Research, and whether that claim was justified. The minister answered that she nuanced her earlier statement, that ICES's advice implies a 34-60% cut and a possible further decline, and promised to keep communicating carefully.
I have nuanced my earlier explanation in the debate of 7 December.
heb ik mijn eerdere toelichting in het debat van 7 december jongstleden genuanceerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over het oprichten van een brievenbusfirma in Nederland door het grootse vleesbedrijf ter wereld

MPs Van Raan and Akerboom asked the government about JBS's plan to set up a Dutch holding company as part of a US listing, and about the environmental, animal welfare, corruption, labour and tax allegations against the firm. The government said it does not comment on individual companies, expects Dutch-based firms to follow OECD and UN due diligence standards, and said that tax-driven conduit companies are undesirable and that an EU-wide approach ('Unshell') is preferred.
However, the cabinet does not make statements about claims and possible violations of law by individual companies.
Het kabinet doet echter geen uitspraken over claims en mogelijke wetsovertredingen van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Wassenberg over Nederlandse paling, vol met giftig PFAS

Two MPs asked the government about eel from Dutch waters containing PFAS above the EFSA tolerable intake, and whether consumption advice, warnings for pregnant women, eel-fishing closures or PFAS-based closures should change. The minister answered that eating large amounts of such eel is undesirable, that the Voedingscentrum advice is to vary fish, that no mandatory health warnings or PFAS-based fishery closures will be introduced, and that producers bear responsibility for safe products.
I will not make health warnings mandatory when selling eel and the other mentioned fish for pregnant women.
Ik ga geen gezondheidswaarschuwingen verplichten bij de verkoop van paling en ander genoemde vis voor zwangere vrouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Nieuwe klap voor boeren: grond onder hun voeten vandaan’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about Staatsbosbeheer's letters telling nature-managing farmers their leases may not be renewed after the Didam ruling forced an open tender procedure. The minister confirmed the letters, said the criteria are objective and the process does not favour intensive dairy, and acknowledged the farmers would have preferred earlier notice.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haga over het rapport 'Nitrogen deposition around dairy farms: spatial and temporal patterns'

An MP asks the minister about a study showing most nitrogen deposition travels far from its source, and why derogation-free zones around Natura 2000 areas are justified given uncertain deposition sources, isotope methods, outdated NV-area data and compensation. The minister replies that the zones follow from the EU derogation decision and WEnR advice, that AERIUS remains the best available tool, that compensation exists via a grassland subsidy, and that the isotope method is not currently a reason to change course.
I currently see no reason to change this, for example with the isotope method.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om dit aan te passen, bijvoorbeeld met de isotopenmethode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Van Raan over het rapport van bureau Profundo 'Rabobanks share in the Brazilian bill, accountable for € 9,5 billion to € 61 billion'

MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Van Raan asked how bank financing of Brazilian deforestation-linked projects fits Rabobank's climate commitment, and how the polluter-pays principle, supervision, transparency and pricing of climate and nature risks apply to financial institutions. The minister answered that the climate commitment sets no concrete measures, that the government expects alignment with 1.5 degrees, that a sustainable finance policy and consultation on legislation are underway, and that some questions (consumer switching data, pricing of past damage) fall outside its information or legal reach.
I do not have this information and, to my knowledge, it is also not publicly available.
Deze informatie heb ik niet en is naar mijn weten ook niet openbaar beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de voorgenomen gebiedssluiting voor de visserij in de Voordelta

An SGP MP asks the Minister of Nature and Nitrogen about a proposed partial area closure of the Voordelta to bottom-disturbing fishing, questioning whether fishers were pressured into accepting it, who bears compensation costs, and whether the closure is scientifically justified as nature compensation for the Second Maasvlakte. The minister replies that the closure is a legal obligation because the required habitat quality improvement was not achieved, that Rijk rather than Havenbedrijf Rotterdam bears the risk under a 2008 agreement, and that she is delaying the decision and exploring flanking measures.
I therefore intend to put a Access Restriction Decision into effect. However, I am taking more time to arrive at a balanced package of measures.
Ik ben daarom voornemens een Toegangsbeperkend Besluit in werking te laten treden. Ik neem echter meer tijd om tot een evenwichtig pakket met maatregelen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de mestderogatie

An MP from BBB asks the Minister of Agriculture why nutrient-polluted (NV) areas were not designated by the 1 January 2024 derogation deadline, and how farmers' costs, Natura 2000 buffer zones, manure surplus reduction, feed subsidies and the 19% agricultural share in water pollution will be handled. The Minister answers that designation was published on 19 December 2023 after consultation with the Commission, that buffer zones follow the derogation decision's whole-site rule, that economic studies will follow in January 2024, and that the binding Commission conditions leave no room to deviate.
I will help farmers in the NV areas ensure water quality there is brought in order as quickly as possible.
Vanwege die ingrijpendheid zal ik de agrariërs in de NV-gebieden helpen om er zo snel mogelijk voor te zorgen dat de waterkwaliteit in deze gebieden op orde komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de herkomst van het Blauwtongvirus in Nederland

MP Van Haga asks the Minister of Agriculture about the origin of bluetongue serotype 3 in the Netherlands, challenging her public remarks on sheep losses, the unreviewed WUR origin report, the possible role of Italian waste bales, and calls for further investigation. The minister defends her remarks and the WBVR research, says the origin route is unlikely to be traced, and commits only to expert consultations and possibly further research or trap monitoring.
I will still consider whether further research into this is useful and, if so, how it could be shaped.
Ik zal nog bekijken of nader onderzoek daarnaar zinvol is en zo ja op welke wijze dit kan worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het bericht ‘GLB-premie fors omlaag: voorlopig bedrag basispremie €150’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Agriculture why the budget for the CAP basic income support and eco-scheme was miscalculated, causing lower-than-announced provisional premiums, and what will be done for farmers. The minister acknowledges higher-than-expected participation, says the estimate was too low, states the definitive rates will be set in spring 2024 and that she is exploring ways to limit the reduction, but gives no guarantees.
It is not yet possible to make a more precise estimate of the shortfall, because the definitive picture still has to be determined.
Het is nog niet mogelijk om een nadere inschatting te maken van het tekort, omdat het definitieve beeld nog bepaald moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ‘het gebrek aan landelijke registratie van bijtincidenten door honden en het gebrek aan landelijk beleid om die bijtincidenten terug te brengen’

An MP asked the ministers about the lack of national registration of dog bite incidents and the absence of national policy to reduce them, following serious attacks. The government acknowledges that no complete registration exists, admits only about 50 of 342 municipalities report to the Landelijk Honden Dossier, and promises to investigate broader incident registration and owner-related risk factors, with a separate letter to follow.
That is why I intend to investigate how dog bite incidents can also be brought into view where no supervisors are involved.
Daarom ben ik voornemens te onderzoeken hoe ook bijtincidenten in beeld gebracht kunnen worden waar geen toezichthouders bij betrokken worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het besluit van de Omgevingsdiensten in Drenthe, Groningen en Friesland waarbij ruim 20 vergisters een afvoerverbod van digestaat is opgelegd.

An MP asked why the Northern environmental services required about 20 biogas plants to stop removing digestate after amphetamine was found, why it took a month to act, and whether the unaccredited test method and legal basis were sound. The State Secretary and Minister answered that the environmental services acted adequately, the method is used for sporadic analyses at an accredited lab, amphetamine has zero tolerance under the Opium Act, and no sanctions were imposed.
This question concerns the conduct of the environmental services. We do not share your view.
Deze vraag betreft het handelen van de omgevingsdiensten. Wij delen uw mening niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over het artikel ‘Wilde theorieën’ over hoe sporen van amfetamine bij 23 mestfabrieken terechtkwamen’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that amphetamine was found in digestate at 23 manure digesters, whether a chemical process could explain the positive tests, the effect on manure processing capacity and the manure market, and the status of a motion requesting cost-benefit analyses of losing the derogation. The minister confirmed the detections, said the cause is still under investigation with no evidence yet for the chemical explanation, and said the affected digesters cannot sell digestate under the Opium Act while the market effects are unclear and cost-benefit results are expected after the Christmas recess.
Once the cause is known, measures can be taken to prevent the presence of amphetamine in the future.
Zodra de oorzaak bekend is, kunnen maatregelen worden getroffen om de aanwezigheid van amfetamine in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ‘De verlaagde GLB-premies’

An MP asked the agriculture minister why CAP (GLB) payment rates were being lowered after more hectares were claimed than budgeted, whether this was foreseeable, and how it affects farm incomes. The minister answered that the lower provisional rates result from more hectares being claimed, that definitive rates will be set in spring 2024, and that options for full payment under the eco-scheme are being explored without guarantees.
Without being able to give guarantees, I am looking for ways under the eco-scheme to fully reward farmers for the public services they provide.
Ik zoek, zonder garanties te kunnen geven, voor de ecoregeling naar mogelijkheden om de boeren volledig voor de geleverde maatschappelijke diensten te belonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de verlaagde GLB-premies

An MP asked the minister whether the lower provisional CAP payment rates undermine a reliable government, whether compensation is possible, how the cuts affect incentives for sustainability and young farmers, and why the Netherlands secured less CAP funding than France. The minister acknowledged poor communication, said definitive rates will be set in spring 2024, said she is seeking ways to compensate eco-scheme participants despite no guarantees, and explained the budget allocation was set in the EU's multiannual framework.
It is crucial that farmers can rely on the government and on the CAP as an instrument to support them in the transition.
Het is cruciaal dat boeren kunnen rekenen op de overheid en op het GLB als instrument om ze te ondersteunen in de transitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de vaststelling van de voorlopige tarieven GLB 2023

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture why the provisional 2023 CAP tariffs for the basic income support and eco-scheme were set well below earlier communicated levels, how much budget is short, and whether 2023 eco-scheme funding can be topped up without drawing on 2024 budget. The Minister acknowledges poor communication, explains the lower tariffs stem from more applications than budgeted and a risk of clawbacks, commits to seeking additional eco-scheme funding without guaranteeing it, and says the 207 euro floor for basic income support is kept.
Once I have the definitive data, I can set the definitive tariffs.
Zodra ik de definitieve gegevens heb, kan ik de definitieve tarieven vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over openbare pachtveilingen van het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf

An MP asked the ministers why public tenders by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (government property agency) of farmland, including an organically farmed plot in Almere, did not state organic use and allowed bulb cultivation, and how this fits the 15% organic farming target. The minister answered that a binding crop plan applied, organic use was not known to the agency because the outgoing tenant did not provide it, the agency rewards organic bids, and that a joint study will examine stimulating organic farming on regular leases, while the buffer-zone question falls outside any binding rule.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de voortgang van de onderhandelingen over de Europese Natuurherstelverordening en het voornemen van de regering om daarmee in te stemmen

MP Omtzigt asked about the progress of EU Nature Restoration Regulation negotiations, how the government's concerns were addressed, risks to housing, infrastructure and energy, the feasibility of targets, and whether an impact assessment should precede a Dutch vote. The minister replies that the provisional agreement softened the non-deterioration obligation and other priorities, that feasibility assessments are still in progress, and that the Netherlands will inform parliament before adoption.
I will inform the House of Representatives when the Presidency schedules the Nature Restoration Regulation for adoption in a Council.
Wel zal ik de Tweede Kamer informeren wanneer het Voorzitterschap de Natuurherstelverordening voor adoptie agendeert in een Raad
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot  over de stemming omtrent de verlenging van glyfosaat

Parliamentarian Tjeerd de Groot asked whether the European Commission will extend glyphosate approval for ten years despite the lack of a committee majority, what conditions attach, and whether the Netherlands will push for stricter EFSA criteria. Minister Adema replied that the Commission will adopt a positive decision by 14 December 2023, listed the conditions in the Commission proposal, noted the Dutch call for neurodegenerative-effects testing, and said the Netherlands will keep contributing to the scientific assessment framework.
At this appeal committee again no majority was reached for or against the Commission's proposal, so the Commission is now empowered to take an independent decision on the proposal.
Tijdens dit beroepscomité is wederom geen meerderheid vóór of tegen het voorstel van de EC bereikt, waardoor de EC nu gemachtigd is om een eigenstandig beslissing op het voorstel te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over ‘de gruwelijke jacht op kangoeroes in Australië, die nog altijd wordt ondersteund in Nederland door kangoeroeproducten te importeren.’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about cruelty in Australian kangaroo hunting, Dutch imports of kangaroo products, enforcement of the Australian code of practice, and Dutch import restrictions. The minister answered that Australian authorities are responsible for oversight, that the EU Commission sees no legal basis for an import ban on welfare grounds, and that a textile-related motion is being explored with another minister.
It is up to the Australian authorities to monitor compliance with the code of practice.
Het is aan de Australische autoriteiten toe te zien op de naleving van de gedragscode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het opnieuw verlengen van de gedoogperiode voor de garnalenvisserij op de Waddenzee en de Noordzeekust zone

An MP asked the minister what perspective a further extension of the tolerance period for shrimp fishing in the Wadden Sea and North Sea coast offers, whether a definitive answer will come on fishers' request to fall under existing rights, and whether a legally sound route exists. The minister answers that the extension gives fishers time to invest in sustainability, that licensing decisions will follow in 2024 with a long-term perspective being developed, that fishers have not yet supplied adequate documentation for an existing-rights claim, and that she cannot guarantee such a claim would hold legally.
I intend to move on to decision-making on the licence applications during 2024.
Ik wil in de loop van 2024 vervolgens overgaan op besluitvorming op de vergunningaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het artikel 'US agency refuses to examine toxicity of 'inactive' pesticide chemicals to crops'

An MP asked the Agriculture and Health ministers whether EU/Dutch pesticide approval covers inactive co-formulants, whether PFAS or POEA are used, and whether other very high concern substances are approved or used as co-formulants. The minister answered that co-formulants are assessed alongside the active substance, that the EU now bans unacceptable co-formulants, that POE-tallowamines were removed and are being phased out, and that several RIVM-identified substances have been or will be removed from use.
When assessing plant protection products in the EU, the co-formulants in the formulation are also examined alongside the active substance.
Bij de beoordeling van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in de EU wordt naast de actieve stof ook gekeken naar de hulpstoffen in de formulering.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over de beantwoording van vragen

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers to convey appreciation to civil servants for timely, careful answers to parliamentary questions. The Prime Minister answered yes, a brief acknowledgement with no substantive commitment.
Are you willing to convey great appreciation to your civil servants for answering all written, factual and oral questions that the questioner has asked in recent years
Bent u bereid de grote waardering over te brengen aan uw ambtenaren voor de beantwoording van alle schriftelijke, feitelijk en mondelinge vragen die vragensteller de afgelopen jaren stelde
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over aardbevingsschade aan stal en mestkelder

Van Haga asks whether the government will generously compensate earthquake damage to a farmer's manure cellar and barn, and whether claims that paying for a new barn would be illegal state aid are correct. The state secretary answers that the IMG has adopted a faster, more generous manure-cellar procedure with a working group, and that compensation could become illegal state aid if it greatly exceeds actual damage, so solutions are sought case by case.
For this reason, the IMG adjusted its procedure for handling manure cellar damage this summer, so that damage to manure cellars can be assessed and settled more quickly and generously.
Daarom heeft het IMG deze zomer de werkwijze voor de schadeafhandeling van mestkelders aangepast, waardoor sneller en ruimhartig schade aan mestkelders kan worden vastgesteld en afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Vedder en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Ruim 200 boeren met bos krijgen onverwacht megaclaims van fiscus’

MPs Inge van Dijk, Vedder and Van der Plas asked whether farmers who joined the set-aside scheme and planted fast-growing forest were wrongly denied the agricultural exemption and faced tax assessments after decades. The State Secretary of Finance answers that the Tax Authority's position is consistent, that no assurances were given about the agricultural exemption, and that the pending Supreme Court ruling will be awaited.
As with our answers of 5 September 2023 to the previous questions from your House on this subject, we note at the outset that the case is still before the courts.
Net als bij onze antwoorden van 5 september 2023 op de vorige vragen van uw Kamer over dit onderwerp stellen wij voorop dat de zaak nog onder de rechter is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het bericht 'Wolven in Europa: Commissie roept lokale overheden op om bestaande uitzonderingen ten volle te gebruiken

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the European Commission's call to use existing derogations for wolves, the legal basis for deviations under the Habitats Directive, the data sent to the Commission, and the wolf's protected status. The minister answered that provinces are competent to grant derogations, no derogations for wolves have been granted, data was shared with the Commission, and the Netherlands will not prejudge the upcoming EU analysis or the Raad voor de Dierenaangelegenheden advice.
I do not want to prejudge this advice and the outcomes of the European Commission's analysis in my position and attitude towards the wolf.
Ik wil in mijn standpunt en houding jegens de wolf niet vooruitlopen op dit advies en de uitkomsten van de analyse van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over het bericht ‘In november geen schoolfruit meer’

An MP asked the agriculture minister about reports that school fruit deliveries would stop in November because the per-portion subsidy was too low, and whether calculation errors by Wageningen Economic Research had caused this. The minister acknowledged calculation errors, raised the unit price from 18 to 20 cents for 2023/2024, and said any shortfall would be covered from the ministry's budget.
Following questions from market parties, it appeared that calculation errors were made in this study.
Naar aanleiding van vragen van marktpartijen is gebleken dat er in dit onderzoek berekeningsfouten zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de verdenking dat de treinen met Romeins huisafval mogelijk de bron zijn van het Blauwtongvirus type 3.

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether waste trains from Rome to AEB Amsterdam could be the source of bluetongue serotype 3, and asked about permits, objections, risk analysis, sampling, and vaccine efficacy. The Minister answered that the EVOA notification gave no public objection route, no risk analysis was required, no sampling was planned as there was no reason to suspect Italy, and sequencing shows the Dutch strain is unrelated to the Italian one, while refusing to halt the transports.
No, that did not happen. That is not part of the notification procedure.
Nee dat is niet gebeurd. Dat is geen onderdeel van de kennisgevingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de waterkwaliteit in Nederland en de gevolgen van schadelijke stoffen in oppervlakte- en drinkwater voor de volksgezondheid

An MP asked ministers about bisphenol A, pharmaceutical residues and other pollutants in surface and drinking water, their health effects, and whether monitoring and reporting should be tightened. The minister answered that existing EU rules and monitoring apply, that BPA is being tightened and pharmaceutical residues addressed through sector programmes, and declined to commit to annual reporting of BPA levels in people because such data is not measured.
Because BPA values are not measured annually in children and adults in combination with health complaints, annual reporting on this is not possible.
Omdat de waardes BPA niet jaarlijks worden gemeten bij kinderen en volwassen in combinatie met gezondheidsklachten, kan hier niet jaarlijks over gerapporteerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de koeiensterfte aan de dijk van het Reevediep

An MP asked about cattle deaths on a farm beside the Reevediep dike and about the investigation into soil used in the dike, including contact with the water board and the farmer's cooperation. The state secretary answered that the province of Gelderland has commissioned soil research, that the dike was built under the soil quality rules with 98.7% of the soil in the cleanest class, that the farmer has withdrawn cooperation, and that results are expected in November 2023 with the parliament to be informed.
Once the final results of the research are known and any follow-up steps, I will inform your House about this.
Zodra de definitieve resultaten van het onderzoek bekend zijn en eventuele vervolgstappen zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over het niet opvolgen van de aanbevelingen van de OvV om stalbranden terug te dringen

Akerboom (PvdD) asks why the government has not yet implemented OvV recommendations to curb stable fires, such as compartmentalisation, a maximum animals-per-compartment norm and tracking technological risks, and whether the minister has taken full responsibility. Minister Adema answers that recommendations are at different stages, mandatory annual fire inspections are being prepared, WUR research is pending, and some recommendations fall to other parties.
I have followed up on this recommendation.
Ik heb opvolging gegeven aan deze aanbeveling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het negeren van de wens van de Kamer om de maximumtemperatuur voor diertransporten spoedig te verlagen

An MP asked why the minister has not yet lowered the maximum temperature for animal transports despite repeated parliamentary requests, and whether she is waiting for an industry impact analysis. The minister confirms the request, says the maximum will be lowered with a target of summer 2024, and notes that an internet consultation will start while still awaiting impact analyses from the remaining sector parties.
I will therefore lower the maximum temperature for animal transport, in line with the wish of the House.
Ik ga de maximumtemperatuur voor diertransport, conform de wens van de Kamer, dan ook verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over 73 biggen die zijn verdronken in hun eigen mest nadat een verouderde roostervloer het begaf

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about pigs and calves drowning in manure after floor gratings collapsed, and whether owners and the government are responsible for checking ageing floors. The minister answers that owners bear primary responsibility, that municipal building control and the NVWA are not informed of such incidents, and promises consultation with fire services, VNG and the NVWA to ensure systematic reporting and an information leaflet.

From an animal welfare perspective, however, I consider it desirable that municipal building control and the NVWA are informed after a stable incident, so they can decide whether to inspect the stable concerned.

Uit oogpunt van dierenwelzijn vind ik het echter toch wenselijk dat het gemeentelijke bouwtoezicht en de NVWA na een stalincident geïnformeerd worden, zodat zij een afweging kunnen maken om de betreffende stal te controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'De gezondheidsrisico’s van glyfosaat'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether pesticide approval authorities (Ctgb) properly prioritise public health, whether an independent review of the Ctgb should be held, and whether the government will act on a motion to phase out glyphosate. The Minister rejected the claim of insufficient duty-fulfilment, pointed to improved frameworks, committed to an independent analysis of approval procedures, and said the motion is being implemented.
To find out whether the current approval procedures deliver the best results, I want to commission an independent analysis of gaps in the approval procedures
Om inzichtelijk te krijgen of de huidige toelatingsprocedures de beste resultaten opleveren, wil ik een onafhankelijke analyse laten uitvoeren naar lacunes in de toelatingsprocedures
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de veroordeelde horrorfokker in Eersel opnieuw honden houdt

An MP asked the minister whether a convicted dog breeder in Eersel, who had hundreds of neglected dogs removed earlier, was again keeping dogs, and how enforcement and bans could prevent this. The minister confirmed eight adult dogs were found and seized, admitted it could not be fully excluded the breeder moved dogs at night during an earlier inspection, said the business was closed and a breeding ban applies, and that ongoing administrative and criminal procedures prevent further comment.
No statements can be made about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over de voorwaarden van de stilligregeling visserij

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about newly built fishing vessels cut from their quotas after Brexit that cannot qualify for the laying-up scheme because they did not fish in the reference years, and whether the scheme could be changed. The minister replied that the reference-year rules stand, that only a narrow case-by-case exception was found, that the scheme will not be amended or reopened given the BAR deadline, and pointed to other support schemes.
Therefore I will not be able to amend or reopen the scheme.
Daarom zal ik de regeling niet kunnen wijzigen of opnieuw openstellen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vedder over de uitzending van EenVandaag (d.d. 4 sept 2023) 'Fors financieel tekort dwingt NVWA tot bezuinigingen en personeelsstop, Kamerleden bezorgd: Wat betekent dit voor al die belangr

An MP asks the minister about reports that the NVWA food safety authority faces a financial shortfall, prompting spending cuts and a hiring freeze, and what this means for its duties and staff. The minister confirms a projected negative 2023 result due to inflation, new pay agreements and lower fee income, and says mitigation measures will close the gap without reducing supervision quality.
The financial situation of the NVWA is not a secret.
De financiële situatie van de NVWA is geen geheim.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de uitzending van EenVandaag (d.d.4 sept 2023) 'Fors financieel tekort dwingt NVWA tot bezuinigingen en personeelsstop, Kamerleden bezorgd: 'Wat betekent dit voor al die belan

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the NVWA food and product safety inspectorate's financial shortfall, a hiring slowdown, and possible cuts to veterinary outsourcing and inspection quality. The Minister acknowledged the deficit from inflation, wage agreements and lower fee income, denied a full hiring freeze, and said inspection quality and slaughterhouse oversight would be maintained with mitigating measures.
There is no hiring freeze, but the opening of new vacancies until the end of 2023 is limited.
Er is geen sprake van een vacaturestop, wel vindt de openstelling van nieuwe vacatures tot ultimo 2023 beperkt plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over bezorgdheid en onzekerheid bij de inbeslagname van een bejaarde pony

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about the seizure of an elderly pony, the delayed return after a court ruling, and whether owners should be better informed. The Justice Minister declined to discuss the ongoing case, said the public prosecutor should act promptly on court rulings, and noted talks with the prosecution about separate rules for seized animals.
In the interest of the ongoing investigation and to prevent influence on the public prosecution service and/or the judiciary, I cannot, as usual, make substantive statements on ongoing cases.

In het belang van het lopende onderzoek en teneinde beïnvloeding van het openbaar ministerie en/of de rechterlijke macht te voorkomen, kan ik over lopende zaken, zoals gebruikelijk, geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Bisschop over het vaccin voor blauwtong

MPs Van der Plas and Bisschop asked the minister about the bluetongue vaccine timeline, the South African Blu-Vax vaccine, possible links to water management, farmers' financial risk, producers, wildlife and reporting of cases. The minister said no suitable vaccine is yet available, declined to grant an exemption for Blu-Vax on safety and efficacy grounds, and said farmers bear the financial risk while the government engages with producers and neighbouring countries.
I decide not to grant an exemption at this time to allow this vaccine to be used in the Netherlands.
besluit ik om op dit moment geen vrijstelling te verlenen dit vaccin in Nederland toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over biostimulanten
