An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the use of biostimulants, including legal uncertainties, the expansion of the EU list of micro-organisms and a national assessment framework for products without CE marking. The minister answered that the EU fertiliser regulation has clarified boundaries, that expanding the EU micro-organism list will take time, and that no national assessment framework exists yet, to be considered when the fertiliser rules are revised.

It is my aim to expand the possibilities for biostimulants under the European Fertilising Products Regulation (EU 2019/1009) and to extend the group of micro-organisms listed in annex II of this regulation.

Het is mijn inzet om de mogelijkheden voor biostimulanten onder Europese Meststoffenverordening (EU 2019/1009) te vergroten, en de groep van micro-organismen, die worden benoemd onder bijlage II van deze verordening uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Van Campen over het artikel «Rekenfout in groengas-subsidie absurd: honderd Overijsselse boeren missen nu smak geld»

MPs Erkens and Van Campen (VVD) asked the Climate and Energy and Agriculture ministers about a calculation error that lowered SDE++ subsidy base amounts for green gas projects by 20-25%, affecting farmers' planning. Minister Jetten answered that PBL corrected its advice, that the amounts remain higher than in prior years, that no specific project or volume expectations exist, and refused to restore the original amounts or compensate preparation costs, while promising PBL advice on small-scale digesters for SDE++ 2024.
I have asked PBL to provide advice on small-scale digesters so that they can be appropriately stimulated in SDE++ 2024.
Ik heb wel PBL gevraagd om advies uit te brengen voor kleinschalige vergisters, zodat ze in de SDE++ 2024 passend gestimuleerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk en het lid Vedder over het bericht ‘Voor boer Piet dreigt halvering van de veestapel, want er stroomt een beek door zijn weilanden’

MPs Boswijk and Vedder asked about wide buffer strips along streams (100-250 m) under the 7th Nitrates Action Programme, their evidence base, effects on farmland, compensation costs, and unequal treatment of agriculture versus recreation under nature and nitrogen rules. The minister answered that broad stream-valley restoration is a regional, model-based measure within provincial programmes, funded from a 811 million euro transition fund, and that nature permitting applies equally across sectors.
Question 10: Is it true that, unlike the agricultural sector, the recreation sector in the Netherlands experiences little or no hindrance from nature and nitrogen policy?
Vraag 10 Klopt het dat in tegenstelling tot de agrarische sector de recreatiesector in Nederland geen of nauwelijks hinder ondervindt van het natuur- en stikstofbeleid?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over over het bericht ‘Boerin Anje is piekbelaster en vreest toekomst’

An MP asks the minister about the nitrogen 'piekbelasting' approach that may force a dairy farmer to close, questioning fairness, banks' cooperation, the reliability of the AERIUS model after a reported factor-200 error, and whether the EU buyout scheme is correctly applied. The minister answers that participation is voluntary, the methodology is internationally leading and maintained, the scheme is state-aid approved, and withdrawal-related reimbursement only applies if conditions are breached, while refusing to comment on controversy designation.
I wish to emphasise that participation in the peak-load approach is voluntary.
Ik hecht eraan te benadrukken dat deelname aan de aanpak piekbelasting vrijwillig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over knelpunten voor (mono)mestvergisting

CDA MPs asked the ministers for an update on steps to expand green gas from manure digestion, including zoning, permitting, manure transport rules and additive innovations. The government answered that it is working with local authorities on faster permitting and a CO2-based blending obligation, but declined to set a sub-target for manure digestion and deferred most issues to local authorities and further research.
The cabinet is not responsible for the requirements in zoning plans; that is up to the local competent authorities.
Het kabinet gaat niet over de eisen in bestemmingsplannen, dat is aan de lokale bevoegd gezagen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van der Plas over impregneermiddelen die gebruikt worden in moestuinbakken en plantenbakken

An MP asked whether treated wood in vegetable and plant boxes poses risks to food crops, health and consumers, and whether the government will investigate and ban such products. The government explained the EU biocide approval system, said it knew of no studies on uptake into crops or health effects, and agreed to ask RIVM for an exploratory review of the literature, with bans to follow only if unacceptable risks are found.

Yes, I am willing to ask RIVM to carry out an exploratory study of what is known in the international literature about the transfer of substances from treated vegetable boxes via the soil to plants and about the risk of health effects.

Ja, ik ben bereid om het RIVM te vragen een verkennend onderzoek uit te voeren naar wat er in de internationale literatuur bekend is over de overdracht van stoffen uit geïmpregneerde moestuinbakken via de grond naar planten en naar (het risico op) gezondheidseffecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de onwenselijke inzet en dieronvriendelijke training van politiehonden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Justice and Agriculture ministers about police dog training methods, the KNPV's role, and whether police dogs should be restricted from indoor, child and non-violent use. The minister answers that stun-collar and stick exercises have been removed from certification, that police buy dogs from private trainers and cut ties with trainers who mistreat animals, and that existing rules are sufficient.
I do not share the concerns about the lack of rules.
De zorgen over het gebrek aan regels deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over (het toelatingsbeleid van) gewasbeschermingsmiddelen

An MP from D66 asked the ministers whether the Ctgb's pesticide approval practice adequately addresses cocktail and cumulative environmental effects, neurotoxicity, Parkinson's as an occupational disease, buffer zones near residences and alignment with the Water Framework Directive, following a court ruling. The minister answered that the Ctgb assesses risks within the EU framework, that cumulative assessment methods are still being developed at EU level, that RIVM will study exposure and health effects, and that the government is exploring legal options on the Water Framework Directive.
I have asked the European Commission to take up the development of such a methodology.
Ik heb daarom de Europese Commissie gevraagd de ontwikkeling van zo’n methodiek op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over het bericht dat de export van biggen naar Spanje en dus het aantal langeafstandstransporten met biggen naar Spanje opnieuw extreem is gestegen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the sharp rise in long-distance transport of piglets from the Netherlands to Spain and about animal welfare and enforcement. The minister said the transports are legal under current EU rules, that NVWA checks transport plans and journals, and that the government is pushing for an EU-wide revision of the transport regulation, while stating that responsibility for control posts in other member states lies with those states.
It is up to the competent authority of the relevant member state to supervise the control posts on its own territory and take measures where necessary.
Het is aan de Competente Autoriteit van de desbetreffende lidstaat om toezicht te houden op de controleposten op het eigen grondgebied en maatregelen te treffen indien nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat asiels een explosieve toename zien van het aantal gedumpte huisdieren

Rep. Wassenberg asked the minister about reports of shelters overwhelmed by dumped pets and about a motion requiring research into a mandatory cooling-off period for pet purchases. The minister said the broader research already underway (including on motives for buying flat-faced dogs) covers this question, with a report expected in Q2 2024, and that shelter care is a municipal responsibility.
I can confirm that a study has been commissioned aimed at gaining insight into people's behaviour when acquiring and keeping brachycephalic dogs.
Ik kan bevestigen dat er opdracht is gegeven tot een onderzoek dat als doel heeft om inzicht te krijgen in het gedrag van mensen bij de aanschaf en het houden van kortsnuitige honden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat Syngenta een studie naar glyfosaat en hersenschade meer dan twintig jaar achterhield

An SP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about reports that Syngenta withheld a neurotoxicity study on a glyphosate salt form and about the EU renewal of glyphosate, and whether the minister would take further steps such as fines. The minister answered that the study concerned a different substance (glyphosate-trimesium), that EFSA nonetheless included it and found no indication of neurotoxic effects, that the Commission plans a ten-year renewal which the Netherlands will oppose per a parliamentary motion, and that research into neurotoxicity testing is under way.
Every marketing authorisation holder of an active substance is obliged to submit all new relevant scientific information to the licensing authorities.
Iedere toelatingshouder van een werkzame stof heeft de verplichting om alle nieuwe relevante wetenschappelijke informatie aan te leveren bij de toelatingsautoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de effectiviteit van het afschaffen van de btw op groente en fruit in landen waar dit al is toegepast

An MP asked the government about the effectiveness of abolishing VAT on fruit and vegetables in countries where this was done, including health and purchasing-power effects, and whether the OECD should study it. The government answered that no decision has been taken, that information on other countries' measures is limited, and that the decision is for a next cabinet.
No decision has yet been taken on whether to introduce a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables and/or alternative health measures.
Er heeft nog geen besluitvorming plaatsgevonden over het al dan niet invoeren van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit en/of alternatieve gezondheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het onvolledig informeren van de Kamer over het doodschieten van twee chimpansees door Dierenpark Amersfoort

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister why parliament was not told that the two escaped chimpanzees were shot because no vet was present to sedate them, and whether the zoo's handling was acceptable. The minister replied that a vet's presence would not have changed the outcome, that the zoo followed its safety protocols and an independent review found its conduct sound, and that the zoo's licence would not be withdrawn despite further incidents.
The presence of a veterinarian would, however, not have led to a different outcome in the situation as it occurred, as described in the answer to question 2.
De aanwezigheid van een dierenarts had in de situatie zoals die zich voordeed echter niet tot een andere uitkomst geleid, zoals beschreven bij het antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het bericht ‘Verguisde stalvloer tegen stikstofuitstoot kan stoppende boer in de weg zitten’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister about reports that emission-reducing cattle-barn floors do not work as calculated, meaning some farmers who appear below the peak-load threshold may not qualify for the buy-out scheme and that permits were granted on the basis of inflated emission factors. The Minister answered that the emission factors have not yet been adjusted, that the government is examining options for a short-term clarification before the scheme closes, and that liability for manufacturers is a matter for buyers to pursue.
I am currently examining whether there are options to provide clarity to the entrepreneurs concerned in the short term.
Ik onderzoek momenteel of er mogelijkheden zijn om op korte termijn duidelijkheid te bieden aan de ondernemers die het betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder, Valstar, Bisschop en Grinwis ten aanzien van de garnalenvissers die per 1 oktober een nieuwe vergunning op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming nodig hebben

MPs from CDA, ChristenUnie, SGP and VVD asked about the shrimp fishing fleet needing new Wet natuurbescherming permits from 1 October, including catalyst subsidy uptake, the code of conduct, the nitrogen assessment model and a possible extension of the tolerance period. The minister answered that installation numbers are unknown, that a tolerance extension to permit issuance is planned, that a 15-month extension to 2025 is refused, and that talks with the sector on the model and permits are ongoing.
I intend to extend the existing tolerance period until the permit is issued and, within those permits, to give all permit applicants nitrogen space up to a specific date to be fixed.

Ik ben voornemens de bestaande gedoogperiode te verlengen tot de vergunning is afgegeven en binnen die vergunningen alle vergunningaanvragers tot een specifiek vast te leggen datum de stikstofruimte te bieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Boswijk en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Ruim 200 boeren met bos krijgen onverwachts megaclaims van fiscus’

MPs from CDA and BBB asked whether the Ministry of Agriculture gave farmers who converted land to fast-growing forest under the set-aside scheme a promise that the land would remain agricultural, and why the Tax Authority now taxes capital gains on that land. The minister answers that the ministry only commented on the planning designation, which stayed agricultural, while the tax authority applies the agricultural exemption only to periods when land was used within a farm business, so the case is pending before the Supreme Court and no concrete remedy is offered.
Because the case is still before the courts, we follow the line of recent court rulings in this answer and await the Supreme Court's judgment.
Omdat de zaak nog onder de rechter is volgen we de lijn van de recente rechterlijke uitspraken in deze beantwoording en wachten we het oordeel van de Hoge Raad af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de wolf

An MP asked the ministers about a wolf shot in Wapse, including whether the fence was wolf-proof, whether the shooting met the protocol, and whether the mayor or police should face prosecution. The minister said a criminal complaint is under investigation and that the matter cannot be judged until then, while stating enforcement of livestock protection duties awaits clarification of the norm.
A criminal complaint has been filed about the incident and the exact circumstances are therefore part of a criminal investigation.
Er is strafrechtelijke aangifte gedaan over het incident en de exacte toedracht vormt daarmee onderdeel van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over de terugkeer en de gevaren van de wolf in Nederland

An MP from Groep Van Haga asks the minister whether the wolf should be classed as a problem animal after a wolf attacked a farmer, whether prevention is adequate, whether hybrid wolves are excluded, and about aid for affected farmers. The minister acknowledges the incident, refers to the Raad voor Dierenaangelegenheden advice and existing provincial measures, and declines to create new protocols or a separate aid desk.
I have asked the Advisory Council on Animal Affairs, as an independent and expert party, to advise me on coexistence with the wolf.
Ik heb de Raad voor Dierenaangelegenheden, als onafhankelijke en deskundige partij, gevraagd om mij te adviseren over het samenleven met de wolf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de parlementaire BBQ

An MP asked ministers about the parliamentary BBQ, renamed NLvoedt, and whether its meat, fish and dairy industry organisers, including a sitting senator, give disproportionate lobbying influence, and whether ministers should attend. The government replied that lobbying is a legitimate part of democracy, that the event's partners are publicly listed, that attendance is a matter for individual politicians, and that it sees no ground to exclude such events, while committing to an evaluation of agenda and lobby-paragraph transparency tools.
To improve transparency and accountability, the guideline on transparency of ministers' agendas has been tightened in line with the Van Baarle-Dassen motion.
Om transparantie en verantwoording te verbeteren is de «Uitvoeringsrichtlijn transparantie agenda’s bewindslieden» aangescherpt in lijn met de motie Van Baarle-Dassen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het openbaarmaken van de brief van de Europese Commissie van 24 oktober 2000

An MP from FvD asked why a 2000 European Commission letter referred to in a 2001 parliamentary document is not public, and whether the minister will publish and share it with the House. The minister confirmed knowledge of the letter, explained it is released only on request and with Commission consent, and said it will be sent to the House once the Commission agrees, with the request already in progress.
I am willing to make the letter public as soon as the European Commission agrees to this.
Ik ben bereid de brief openbaar te maken zodra de Europese Commissie daarmee instemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de massale vogelsterfte op broedeilanden door vogelgriep

An MP asked the minister about bird flu causing mass seabird deaths on breeding islands, the lack of support and funding for clearing carcasses, and the Audit Office findings on fragmented responsibility. The minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to a national platform, protocols and a planned exploration of bottlenecks, but said carcass removal is primarily the landowner's responsibility and that the poultry compensation convenant talks will not cover wild bird costs.
I expect to inform the House further about this exploration before the end of the year.
Ik verwacht de Kamer voor het einde van het jaar nader te informeren over deze verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de voortdurende mishandeling van piepjonge kalfjes tijdens langeafstandstransporten uit Ierland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about recurring mistreatment and legal violations in long-distance transports of very young calves from Ireland to Dutch veal farms, and what the Minister will do to stop it. The Minister condemns the abuse, says enforcement lies with the Irish and French competent authorities and that the NVWA inspects in the Netherlands, supports an EU-level ban on long transports of unweaned animals, but states she cannot ban the trade herself due to EU free movement rules and will await the Commission's revision of the Transport Regulation.
Due to the EU rules on free movement of goods, I cannot prohibit these transports.
Vanwege de regels omtrent vrij verkeer van goederen in de EU kan ik deze transporten niet verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ‘de snel stijgende dierenartskosten, waardoor essentiële dierkundige zorg voor velen onbetaalbaar wordt’

MP Wassenberg asks the government about rising veterinary costs that may make animal care unaffordable, linking this to the duty of care in the Animal Welfare Act, the 21% VAT rate, takeovers of clinics by foreign chains, and possible regulation. The minister acknowledges the concerns, announces a study of price increases, states VAT rules and competition law limits, and rejects intervention in the free market for now.
I want to set up this study carefully, which requires the cooperation of many parties and takes time.
Ik wil dit onderzoek gedegen opzetten waarbij de medewerking van vele partijen nodig is, wat tijd kost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Wassenberg over de risico’s van het vogelgriepvirus dat is aangetroffen bij tientallen katten in Polen en in vijf bontfokkerijen in Finland

Two PvdD MPs asked the ministers of Health and of Agriculture about bird flu infections in cats in Poland and in fur-farmed foxes in Finland, including risks to humans and whether the government would push for a fur farming ban. The government answered that it monitors Poland closely, sees no need to test meat from slaughterhouses beyond EU rules, will commission research into bird flu in pet cats, and has repeatedly argued in EU bodies for ending fur farming, but did not answer all questions within the deadline.
Yes, the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport and I are jointly giving the order as soon as possible for further research into the presence of bird flu in cats with an owner.
Ja, de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en ik geven samen zo snel mogelijk opdracht voor nader onderzoek naar de aanwezigheid van vogelgriep bij katten met een eigenaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vedder en Van Campen over het bericht 'Uitspraak gebruik pesticiden bij lelieteelt slaat in als een bom'

MPs Vedder and Van Campen asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a court ruling restricting pesticide use at a lily farm near residents in Dwingeloo, and whether it undermines the Ctgb's authority. The minister answered that the appeal court overturned the injunction, that the precautionary principle leaves room for case-by-case restrictions, that the Ctgb remains a reputable authority, and that a brochure on good neighbourliness was sent to the House.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de verkoop van rauwe melk

A MP asked why direct sale of raw milk to consumers is limited to the farm where it is produced, and about food safety risks of selling milk from neighbouring farms. The Minister cites pathogen and outbreak risks, confirms transport and sale risks, and announces a draft amendment allowing frozen raw milk to be sold locally and shipped, with publication expected in early 2024.
Based on the Buro report and a supplementary 2022 advice, an amendment to the legal provisions on raw milk is being prepared.
Op basis van het Buro-rapport en een aanvullende advies uit 2022 4 is een wijziging van de wettelijke bepalingen over rauwe melk in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de verkoop van rauwe melk

An MP asked the ministers whether raw milk sold at farm shops could come from neighbouring dairy farms rather than only the seller's own farm, while keeping other hygiene conditions. The minister answered yes in principle, announcing a planned amendment allowing sale and delivery of frozen raw milk in local shops and farm shops, with rules expected to be published in early 2024.
Yes, I do see those possibilities.
Ja, die mogelijkheden zie ik wel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over verboden bijengif dat via huisdieren in de natuur komt

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about veterinary flea and tick products containing banned neonicotinoids (fipronil, imidacloprid) that reach nature via pet dogs, and whether these products should be banned or restricted. The minister answers that the EMA is revising its environmental risk assessment, the Netherlands will push for stronger EU action and explore national options, but that ectoparasiticides remain necessary for animal and public health.
The Netherlands will strongly commit to this topic within the EU and also nationally inventory the possibilities to establish a policy direction.
Nederland zal zich krachtig inzetten voor dit onderwerp binnen de EU en tevens nationaal de mogelijkheden inventariseren om een beleidsrichting vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de toelating van een nieuw bijengif in de landbouw: de pesticide flupyradifurone

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about the pesticide flupyradifurone, its permitted uses, its similarity to neonicotinoids, and whether it should be reassessed or banned in open crops given insect decline. The minister answers that the EU is reviewing the substance under Article 21 and that the Ctgb will act if unacceptable risks are shown, but declines to ban it in the interim.
However, should it turn out that there are direct unacceptable risks from the use of flupyradifurone, the Ctgb will intervene directly on the existing authorisations.
Mocht echter blijken dat er directe onaanvaardbare risico’s zijn bij het gebruik van flupyradifurone, dan zal het Ctgb direct ingrijpen op de bestaande toelatingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Waterschappen helpen boeren met 'onverbloemde greenwashing' voor EU-subsidie'

A D66 MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether allowing farmers to count water board ditches toward the four-percent landscape-element requirement for EU subsidies undermines genuine biodiversity gains, and whether the Commission was informed. The minister rejected that view, said the rules are unchanged and approved in the national strategic plan, but admitted the choice was not explicitly submitted to the Commission and committed to no new action.
The choices referred to in these written questions were not explicitly submitted to the European Commission for approval.
De gemaakte keuzes waarop in deze schriftelijke vragen wordt gedoeld, is niet expliciet voorgelegd aan de Europese Commissie voor goedkeuring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over het toezicht en de handhaving op de eco-regeling van de Europese landbouwsubsidies

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether farmers can claim water board ditches and managed-by-others landscape elements to meet the 4% non-productive land requirement and the eco-scheme, and how the government supervises and enforces against such accounting tricks. The minister said the rules allow landscape elements under lease or agreement to count, that administrative and on-site checks against double claims and erroneous declarations exist, and that subsidies can be reclaimed, without committing to new measures.
If there is an incorrect declaration, the subsidy-granting organisation can take action against it and, for example, reclaim the subsidy.
Indien er sprake is van een foutieve opgave, kan de subsidieverstrekkende organisatie hiertegen optreden en bijvoorbeeld de subsidie terugvorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht 'Boerenorganisatie LTO wil dat dierenextremisten worden gestraft: 'Bijna elke dag insluipingen''

MPs Van Campen and Michon-Derkzen (VVD) asked about reports that farm organisation LTO wants animal-rights extremists punished for stable occupations and break-ins, and whether current law and police registration are adequate. The Minister of Justice answered that existing offences (trespass and unlawful entry) can be prosecuted, that a separate police classification for such incidents is currently undesirable, and that follow-up steps such as talks with the sector and a review of earlier agreements are being considered.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Van Esch over het gat in de voedselkringloop: menselijke mest

MPs Akerboom and Van Esch asked the minister whether human excrement could be used as fertiliser to close the nutrient cycle, why it is classed as waste, the medicine-residue risks, and whether farmers could get experimental room. The minister answered that direct use carries risks, that phosphate recovery and a public-private research project are under way, and that no short-term experimental room will be created, though controlled trials may be considered.

Given the current uncertainties about the risks of directly using human excrement as fertiliser in agriculture, I do not intend to create experimental space for field trials on farms in the short term.

Gezien de onzekerheden die er momenteel zijn met betrekking tot de risico's van het direct gebruik van menselijke uitwerpselen als meststof in de landbouw ben ik niet voornemens om op korte termijn experimenteerruimte voor praktijkproeven bij boeren te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over zoönoserisico’s en vogelgriep bij mensen

MPs Westerveld and Bromet asked about bird flu transmission risks to humans, testing of exposed workers, mixed pig-poultry farms, and the adequacy of voluntary spatial measures under the NPLG. The minister answered that no human infections have been found in the Netherlands, that proactive surveillance of exposed workers starts in summer 2023, and that further research and a plan on mixed farms are under way, with spatial rules being explored rather than binding now.
Surveillance in this group is expected to be operational from summer 2023.
Naar verwachting is deze surveillance vanaf de zomer van 2023 operationeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de aankomende hitte en de gevolgen voor dieren

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about heat stress risks to farm animals, shelter in pastures, transport temperature limits, and NVWA enforcement capacity. The Minister answered that heat stress is a welfare harm, that the legal duty to protect outdoor animals is an open norm, that a handreiking for municipalities is being prepared, and that transport temperature limits will be lowered after an impact analysis due in September.
The NVWA checks compliance with the statutory provisions.
De NVWA controleert op de wettelijke bepalingen.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Hans en Amarjit zouden 2,5 ton subsidie krijgen, tot ze één foutje maken: provincie is onverbiddelijk’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether a subsidy refusal for an innovative farm project that started a few days before the application, self-reported by the applicants, is proportionate, and why no hardship clause was used as in a Zuid-Holland case. The minister answers that the early start rule is binding under EU and provincial rules, that the province and RVO explored alternatives without success, that the case is pending objection, and that no change to rules is planned beyond general encouragement of innovation.
The case is currently in the objection phase. I do not wish to anticipate its outcome.
Momenteel bevindt de casus zich in de fase van bezwaar. Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomst daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Boswijk over het bericht ‘Het geheim van Brabant: hoe criminelen azen op boerenstallen’

The CDA MPs Kuik and Boswijk asked whether the voluntary livestock buy-out scheme accounts for the risk that criminals use vacated farm buildings for drug production and whether farmers can be protected and helped. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that demolition obligations and supervision by municipalities limit this risk, that farmers can report suspected criminal use to the police, and that a national resilience approach and a possible 'flying brigade' for drug waste are being explored, with updates promised later this autumn.
Supervision of timely demolition of the production capacity lies with the municipalities, which are informed about who has applied for a subsidy.
Toezicht op tijdige sloop van de productiecapaciteit ligt bij gemeenten, die geïnformeerd worden over wie een subsidie heeft aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Nederlandse vissers gebruiken illegale netten om extra sliptong te vangen'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how the government will stop Dutch fishers using illegal nets (binnenkuilen) to catch extra sole, and what steps it takes to strengthen enforcement with the NVWA. The minister acknowledges illegal fishing is unacceptable, points to a third NVWA inspection team, EU cooperation, and new control measures, but admits heterdaad detection is difficult and that no integrated enforcement strategy will be drawn up, with progress to be reported by year end.
Due to the necessary coordination, answering these questions within the requested deadline unfortunately was not achieved.
Vanwege de benodigde afstemming is de beantwoording van deze vragen binnen de gevraagde termijn helaas niet gehaald.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de antwoorden van 14 februari 2023 op de op 10 november 2022 ingezonden vragen over het verzoek in de commissie-Regeling van Werkzaamheden van de procedurevergadering van

An MP asks the minister why production volumes of the tilapia subsidy project were not tracked, why a second inspection and clawback were not carried out, and why the EU correction and the stopped eel-farmers' complaints were not pursued. The minister answers by referring to the final report, stating the volume target was not met but reporting was not a subsidy requirement, and that the subsidy rules were applied lawfully as confirmed by courts.
It was not a requirement of the FIOV subsidy that it had to be reported how many tonnes of tilapia were farmed.
Het was geen eis van de FIOV (Financieringsinstrument voor de oriëntatie voor de Visserij)-subsidie dat er gerapporteerd moest worden hoeveel ton tilapia is gekweekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Akerboom over de gezondheidskosten van het eten van vlees

MPs Van Esch and Akerboom asked the government about health costs of meat consumption, true pricing, and a meat levy. The government acknowledged the health costs, said it is studying true pricing and a sugar-based beverage tax review, but declined to commit to a meat levy given parliament's prior rejection of one.
Setting prices in supermarkets is the responsibility of the supermarkets themselves.
Het stellen van prijzen in de supermarkten is de verantwoordelijkheid van de supermarkten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid lid Akerboom over het illegaal mengen van varkens in slachthuizen, met gevechten en verwondingen als gevolg

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about pigs from different groups being mixed in slaughterhouse holding pens, causing fights and injuries, and about the NVWA's delayed enforcement after an animal-welfare organisation's request. The minister acknowledged the violations, said enforcement will apply from 15 August 2024 under a compliance period it calls a deadline, and urged slaughterhouses to act sooner.
The term 'eindlijner' means these animals are slaughtered separately from groups of animals without any noted abnormalities.
Het woord «eindlijner» houdt in, dat deze dieren apart van de groepen dieren zonder geconstateerde bijzonderheden geslacht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Boer Erik Jan doelwit criminele bendes:” Ze hebben alles gesloopt”

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van Campen (VVD) asked whether GPS theft from farm vehicles by organised, mostly Eastern European gangs is rising, where it occurs, what police and the ministers are doing about it, and how agricultural areas are protected against criminal takeover. The government answered that GPS thefts have risen slightly, concentrated in four regions, and described police prevention, cross-border information exchange, registration databases and ongoing public-private cooperation, while stating these thefts do not qualify as high impact crimes.
In 2023, up to 30 May, around 50 reports or complaints were received of GPS theft from barns, stables or a farmyard.
In 2023 zijn er tot 30 mei ongeveer 50 meldingen of aangiftes ontvangen van diefstal van GPS uit schuren, stallen of van een erf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'RVO maakt dieraantallen en adressen veehouderijen toch openbaar'

An MP asked ministers whether RVO's public release of livestock numbers and farm addresses, which are business data, undermines trust in confidential data provided to government and whether the Woo rules should be clarified. The minister answered that such data counts as emission-related environmental information that must be disclosed under the Woo, that the requester's identity is not disclosed, and that no regulatory change is planned.
Information on numbers of animals and on locations where animals are kept must be regarded as information on emissions into the environment.
Informatie over aantallen dieren en over locaties waar dieren worden gehouden moet worden gezien als informatie over emissies in het milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Weer een tegenvaller bij Gecombineerde opgave’

MPs Boswijk and Van Campen asked the Minister of Agriculture about a system error in the Gecombineerde opgave that forced farmers to re-confirm their parcels, and about compensation, deadlines and support. The Minister acknowledged the error and its burden on farmers, but ruled out compensation or a general deadline extension, offering only two extra weeks to add eco-activities and extended helpdesk hours.

I have decided that farmers who indicated in the Gecombineerde opgave that they participate in the eco-scheme have until 30 June, after the closing of the Gecombineerde opgave, to make adjustments and add eco-activities.

Ik heb besloten dat boeren die in de Gecombineerde opgave hebben aangegeven dat ze aan de eco-regeling deelnemen, na de sluiting van de Gecombineerde opgave tot 30 juni hebben om aanpassingen te doen en eco-activiteiten toe te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over juridische belemmeringen voor composteren gft met wormen

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality when the promised exploration of allowing hygienised kitchen waste on the same site as composting worms would be concluded, and for its outcome. The Minister replied that the exploration is complete: a permit under the Regeling dierlijke producten can be requested from the NVWA, with a 70°C for 60 minutes hygienisation condition, which is considered workable.
This exploration has already been completed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over de rol van het Didam-arrest op eerlijke pachtovereenkomsten tussen pachters en Staatsbosbeheer en het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Agriculture how the Didam ruling, which requires public tendering of leases, affects tenant security, sustainability, and the conduct of Staatsbosbeheer and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, and how the government will protect farmers. The Minister acknowledges the ruling weakens existing tenants' security, points to lease reform and sustainability criteria in tenders, and rejects the claim that public landlords prioritise short-term profit.
My objective is to encourage long-term lease contracts through amendment of the lease legislation; this will partly solve the problem.
Mijn doelstelling is om door wijziging van de pachtwetgeving langlopende pachtcontracten te stimuleren, dit zal het probleem deels verhelpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over een restaurant waar mensen zelf een kip slachten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a restaurant in Arnhem where guests slaughter their own chicken, asking whether this is acceptable as a marketing stunt and how compliance with animal welfare rules is guaranteed. The minister answered that the owner, not guests, performs the stunning and killing with the required knowledge, that inspection of the footage and a phone call found no violations, and that no further action is planned.
Supervision of the (home) slaughter of poultry outside a slaughterhouse takes place on the basis of reports.
Het toezicht op de (thuis)slacht van pluimvee buiten een slachthuis vindt plaats op basis van meldingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Boswijk en Krul over het bericht 'Nieuw probleem bij zoeken opvangplekken: ‘Dassen blokkeren opvang 800 asielzoekers’'

CDA MPs asked whether the government will act urgently to grant general exemptions under the Nature Protection Act so badgers blocking reception locations for 800 asylum seekers can be removed. The minister answered that exemptions are case-specific, the province is the competent authority, a general exemption is being explored with care, and ProRail has a code since January 2023.
As indicated, the province is the competent authority under the Nature Protection Act and it is up to the province to make that assessment.
Zoals aangegeven is de provincie bevoegd gezag op grond van de Wnb en is het het aan de provincie om die afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Haga over strengere regelgeving voor attractietoestellen

An MP asked whether strict safety rules halting steam trains in Zuiderpark amount to overregulation and asked for an exemption. The minister replied that the existing Warenwetbesluit already covers such trains as attractions, that the rules have not become stricter, and that no exemption will be granted.
No, there is no question of overregulation; this rests on a misconception.
Nee, er is hier geen sprake van overregulering, dit berust op een misvatting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de antwoorden op eerder gestelde vragen omtrent de risico´s van insectenconsumptie

An MP asked the ministers about labelling rules for insects in food, EFSA independence, subsidies to insect farms, the Protifarm closure, protein transition targets and insect welfare. The minister replied that novel-food labelling rules apply and NVWA enforces them, that EFSA opinions are the basis for approval, that subsidy data is not centrally kept, and that the Health Council advice on protein transition is expected in autumn 2023.
From the ministries of LNV and VWS no subsidies are granted to individual insect farmers.
Vanuit de ministeries van LNV en VWS worden geen subsidies verstrekt aan individuele insectenkwekers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het in de problemen komen van de teelt van frietaardappelen door nieuwe Haagse regels

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about farmers being penalised with reduced nitrogen allowances for sowing cover crops after 1 October, which hurts potato growers after a cold, wet spring, and whether the rules were consulted with the sector. The Minister defends the rule as needed for water quality, notes flexibility and the possibility of a later sowing with a penalty, and does not commit to changes.
I do not intend to make changes to the measure promoting cover crop cultivation that follows from the 7th Nitrates Directive Action Programme.
Ik ben niet voornemens wijzigingen aan te brengen in de maatregel ter stimulering van de teelt van vanggewassen die volgt uit het 7e Actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over de fiscale maatregelen voor de glastuinbouw

CDA MPs asked the government about the impact of planned energy tax changes on greenhouse growers, the feasibility of transition timelines, the treatment of combined heat and power plants, and fairness between small and large growers. The government acknowledges the strong impact, points to a combined package of measures and a possible phase-in path decided in August 2023, and says it will consider a revised proposal pending EU state aid approval.
The cabinet will decide in August 2023, based on an impact analysis yet to be published, whether to possibly adopt a phase-in path with substantial steps from 2025.
Het kabinet besluit in augustus 2023 op basis van een nog te verschijnen impactanalyse eventueel tot een ingroeipad met substantiële stappen vanaf 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over verslechtering van de Nederlandse waterkwaliteit in EU-rapportages terwijl de waterkwaliteit in Nederland verbetert

An MP asked the minister whether Dutch water quality is declining in EU reports while improving domestically, and why measurement methods may explain the discrepancy. The minister answered that Dutch water quality has improved under the Water Framework Directive, that nitrate leaching rose again since 2018 partly due to drought, and that the EU report differences stem from unit errors in 2008–2011 data and depth-category differences, while refusing to reduce monitoring points.
I am currently in discussion with the European Commission to see how this discrepancy can be prevented in the future.
Ik ben momenteel in gesprek met de Europese Commissie om te kijken hoe deze discrepantie in de toekomst voorkomen kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het weigeren van een journalist die het lijden van dieren bij ‘ruimingen’ in beeld wil brengen

The MP Ouwehand asks why the minister refused a photographer access to bird-flu culls to document animal suffering, and whether this conflicts with transparency and press freedom. The minister defends the refusal on zoonotic risk and the principle that non-essential persons are excluded, while promising an NVWA-produced public imagery report on bird-flu control.
Allowing people who are not strictly necessary for the cull onto sites where a (potentially) zoonotic animal disease has broken out is not something I consider desirable.
Het toelaten van mensen die niet strikt noodzakelijk zijn voor de ruiming, tot plekken waar een (potentieel) zoönotische dierziekte is uitgebroken, acht ik niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over een artikel waarin wordt gesteld dat het mestbeleid een opeenstapeling is van verkeerd beleid sinds de jaren negentig

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether mandatory manure injection harms soil life and leaches more nutrients, whether research was dropped, and which EU countries mandate injection. The minister denied the core claims, pointed to PBL and expert-committee reports, and said the former minister's research assignment could not be identified.
It is not known which research assignment is being referred to.
Niet bekend is aan welke onderzoeksopdracht gerefereerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Boswijk en Van Campen over het ontbreken van consumptieaardappelen op de lijst met winterteelten

MPs Bisschop, Boswijk and Van Campen asked why late-harvested consumption potatoes were left off the winter-crop list, which exempts fields from the cover-crop rule and the nitrogen-norm cut, and whether exceptions could be granted based on residue measurements or sustainability scores. The minister answers that potatoes fail all three winter-crop criteria, that the 1 October cover-crop deadline and the reduced nitrogen norm are required under the 7th Nitrates Directive action programme, and that no exceptions are possible for now.
There is therefore no room for alternatives that are less effective at improving water quality.
Er is dan ook geen ruimte voor alternatieven die minder effectief zijn voor het verbeteren van de waterkwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over overtredingen in slachthuizen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about repeated animal welfare violations in slaughterhouses, including animals stuck or bled while conscious and placed live in scalding tanks, and whether slaughter speeds should be lowered and camera monitoring expanded. The minister acknowledged the violations as unacceptable, explained that slaughter-speed reduction is an available NVWA intervention already in policy, deferred on camera-technology and criminal prosecution questions, and declined to provide some data (e.g., share of pigs stuck while conscious observed by inspectors) because it is not recorded.
Lowering the slaughter speed is one of the most important corrective instruments the NVWA has when things go wrong in a slaughterhouse.
Het verlagen van de slachtsnelheid is een van de belangrijkste corrigende instrumenten die de NVWA heeft als het misgaat in een slachthuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Grote stalbrand in Sint Oedenrode, 9000 varkens omgekomen'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a barn fire in Sint Oedenrode that killed 9,000 pigs, and about measures against fatal barn fires, escape routes for animals, municipal and provincial fire-safety powers, and an advisory body's recommendation. The minister says a reinforced approach aims to halve fatal barn fires by 2026, a draft decree on fire-safety rules is in consultation, and an amendment created a statutory basis in the Animal Welfare Act for fire-safety requirements.
I am therefore committed to a reinforced approach to barn fires with the aim of halving the number of fatal barn fires and fatal animal victims by 2026.
Ik zet mij daarom in voor een verstevigde aanpak voor stalbranden met als doel een halvering van het aantal dodelijke stalbranden en het aantal dodelijke dierlijke slachtoffers in 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het niet controleren op het verdoven van paling voor de slacht

An MP asked why the NVWA performed no inspections in 2021 and 2022 on compulsory stunning of eels before slaughter, and whether it will resume such checks. The minister confirmed no inspections took place due to risk-based prioritisation, but committed to resuming checks from next year and to renewed notice to firms.

Despite the earlier risk analysis in which it was decided not to carry out explicit inspections on this regulation in recent years, I consider it important to resume checking the companies from next year.

Ondanks de eerdere risicoanalyse waarin de afweging dus is gemaakt om in de afgelopen jaren geen expliciete inspecties op de regelgeving uit te voeren, vind ik het van belang om met ingang van volgend jaar hier wel weer bij de bedrijven op te gaan controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Five MPs asked the government about progress toward its 2030 targets, including a halving of nitrogen emissions and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that the nitrogen target is set as deposition thresholds rather than halving, that the latest projection shows only 43% of nature area meeting the norm with a risk of missing the target, and that a new projection will follow in late 2023 with additional measures and a 15% organic farmland plan under monitoring.
The cabinet indicated in 2021 that it wanted to respond to the call.
Het kabinet heeft in 2021 aangegeven gehoor te willen geven aan de oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'NEPG maakt zich zorgen over pootgoedproductie’

An MP asked the agriculture minister whether the NEPG's concern about falling Dutch seed potato production, linked to growers switching to processing potatoes and to stricter pesticide rules, is justified and whether production should be stimulated. The minister replied that no major shift is visible, the seed potato area is expected to fall only 3-5%, and no government stimulus is needed since market prices will drive planting decisions.
However, I have no signals that this year there is a major shift in the Netherlands from growing seed potatoes to growing potatoes for the processing industry.
Ik heb echter geen signalen dat er dit jaar in Nederland een grote verschuiving plaatst vindt van de teelt van pootaardappelen naar de teelt van aardappelen voor de verwerkende industrie.
Antwoord op van de leden Valstar, Van Campen, Bisschop, Grinwis en Boswijk over ‘bestaand gebruik’ in relatie tot de toetsing van de garnalenvisserij aan de Wet natuurbescherming

MPs from VVD, SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the ministers about the Landsadvocaat's advice on whether shrimp fishing licences under the Visserijwet can count as existing use (bestaand gebruik) for Wet natuurbescherming permits, and whether the 1994 licences should be investigated. The minister answered that the legal route is highly complex, that the sector must itself reconstruct licence and emission data via AIS and logbooks, and that the sector remains responsible for the nitrogen deposition calculations.
I share that observation and gladly give these fishers the opportunity and room to demonstrate this.
Ik deel die constatering en biedt deze vissers graag de kans en ruimte om dit aan te tonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Six opposition MPs asked the cabinet for the latest 2030 forecasts on its policy targets, including road-death halving, and whether each target will be met. The minister answers only the road-safety item, citing SWOV research that halving serious injuries is likely too ambitious, and gives no answers on the other targets, apologising for the delay.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer within the three-week period.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording binnen de termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Valstar over de bedreiging van de inheemse natuur door het rode gevaar: ‘de Amerikaanse rivierkreeft’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the threat posed by the American crayfish to native nature, including the status of a strategy and pilots, the feasibility of large-scale culling, dike safety, and the legal framework for fishing gear. The minister answered that the strategy is still being developed, large-scale eradication in open waters is not feasible, pilots and a new selective trap are underway, and broader non-professional fishing would need careful weighing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over enkele berichten over de voorkeurslocatie van een militaire kazerne in Zeewolde

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports on the preferred location of a military barracks in Zeewolde, including nitrogen space, PAS-melders, farmland, flood risk and nature impacts. The government answered that the Zeewolde site is only a provisional preferred location, no permit has been filed, nitrogen needs are not yet calculated, and the final choice will be communicated to parliament later.
Once a final location choice is made, Defence will inform your House of Representatives about it.
Zodra er een definitieve locatiekeuze is, wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd door Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Geurts over het bericht 'Nederlands beste boerengrond – in Flevoland – maakt plaats voor woningen en natuur: ‘Maar bos kweken werkt hier niet’'

MPs Boswijk and Geurts asked about a newspaper report that the most fertile farmland in Flevoland is being converted to housing and nature, and about how such land is protected. The government replied that a 'right function in the right place' principle applies, that a framework for land-use changes on farmland is being developed within the National Programme Rural Area, and that provinces and municipalities hold the decisive powers.
The national government has a broad coordinating role to ensure all spatial tasks find a place and to prevent agriculture from being the last resort in the spatial debate.
Het Rijk heeft een brede regiefunctie om ervoor te zorgen dat alle ruimtelijke opgaven een plek krijgen en om te voorkomen dat landbouw het sluitstuk is in de discussie rondom ruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Campen en Michon-Derkzen over bescherming van boeren tegen drugscriminaliteit en het tegengaan van ondermijning in het buitengebied.

Two VVD MPs asked how farmers can be protected against drug crime and undermining activity in rural areas, including whether a Brabant model rental contract could be rolled out nationally and how it relates to mayors' powers under Article 13b of the Opium Act. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the risk is real nationwide, describes existing pilots and a model contract, says municipalities should decide how to apply it, and declines to consult the VNG and IPO.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I want to encourage such initiatives and take them further.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid wil ik dergelijke initiatieven stimuleren en verder brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haverkort over de berichtgeving in diverse media inzake het potentieel sluiten van hertenkampen

Haverkort (VVD) asked the minister about media reports that deer parks may be closed under the new house and hobby animal list, covering heritage status, consequences, consultation, transition rules, and whether the list can be amended. Minister Adema answered that the ban follows from objective criteria, transition rules let existing deer be kept until death, heritage protection covers structures rather than animals, and objections or change requests are possible after six weeks.
I do not have figures on the number of fallow deer in the state-protected deer parks.
Ik beschik niet over de aantallen damherten die in de rijksbeschermde hertenkampen staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het artikel 'Pesticide use and incident Parkinson's disease in a cohort of farmers and their spouses'

MP Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a study linking pesticide use to Parkinson's disease in farmers, and about glyphosate reduction, authorisation rules and the Landbouwakkoord. The minister answered that RIVM will start a long-term health study, that a glyphosate-substitution obligation is being prepared for 2025, and that authorisation frameworks will be improved, while stressing the independence of Ctgb and EFSA.

To interpret the scientific signals in Dutch practice, I have asked RIVM to start as soon as possible a long-term study into possible health effects of exposure to crop protection products for farmers and residents.

Om de wetenschappelijke signalen te duiden in de Nederlandse praktijk heb ik het RIVM verzocht om zo spoedig mogelijk een lange termijn studie te starten naar mogelijke gezondheidseffecten van de blootstelling aan gewasbeschermingsmiddelen van agrariërs en omwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van Campen en Sahla over het bericht “Veel vraag naar kinderopvang bij boer, maar regels belemmeren uitbreiding”

MPs Van den Hil, Van Campen and Sahla asked about reports that rules hinder agricultural childcare on farms, and about the obstacles raised by sector bodies, municipal zoning tied to farm turnover, staffing, health effects and next steps. The ministers answered that a 'Life event' regulatory review with VNG, LTO and the Chamber of Commerce is underway, that the Multifunctional Agriculture and Spatial Planning guidance is being updated, and that they see no evidence that agricultural childcare is disadvantaged on quality or staffing.
We are in discussion with the parties involved about the obstacles that have been raised.
Met de betrokken partijen zijn we in gesprek over de belemmeringen die zijn aangekaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over een plan om 1600 kalveren vanuit Ierland met het vliegtuig vermoedelijk naar Nederland te transporteren

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about a reported plan to fly about 1,600 young Irish calves to mainland Europe, possibly to Dutch veal farms, and what the government will do to stop it, including the abuse shown in footage from Cherbourg. The minister replies that no concrete plan is known to the government or Irish authorities, that EU intra-community rules do not allow banning such transports, and that the government supports an EU-wide ban on long-distance transport of unweaned animals while negotiating with the sector.
No concrete plan is known to me to transport 1,600 calves by plane from Ireland to the European mainland.
Er is bij mij geen concreet plan bekend om 1600 kalveren per vliegtuig vanuit Ierland naar het vasteland van Europa te transporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over berichten over export van goedkoop vlees en melkpoeder naar Ghana en Kenia

An MP asked the trade and development minister, with agriculture, whether Dutch exports of cheap meat and milk powder to Ghana and Kenya undermine local food security and whether trade policy conflicts with development goals. The minister denied an active export-promotion policy, said trade is compatible with local food systems, and argued the EPA would not affect tariffs on dairy.
The cabinet has no policy intention to actively stimulate the export of meat and milk powder to developing countries in the coming years.
Het kabinet heeft geen beleidsvoornemen om de export van vlees en melkpoeder naar ontwikkelingslanden de komende jaren actief te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het alleen voor Chinees riet aanvragen van subsidie

MPs Kröger and Bromet asked why the ISDE insulation subsidy's product listing covered Chinese reed but not Dutch reed, raising level-playing-field, sustainability and EU state-aid concerns. The minister answered that a registration code was granted only because Chinese reed met the insulation threshold, that Dutch reed can apply once its performance declaration is ready, and that sustainability criteria for bio-based inputs are being developed.
It is correct that a registration code was requested and granted for Chinese reed and not yet for Dutch reed.
Het klopt dat er een meldcode is aangevraagd en verleend voor Chinees riet en nog niet voor Nederlands riet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de derogatieregeling

MP Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the nitrates derogation: enforcement against manure fraud, dam-ditch enforcement by water boards, the late 1 March 2023 start of buffer-strip rules and its consequences, and whether this conflicts with the derogation decision. The minister answered that the VHS Mest enforcement strategy continues, that the late buffer-strip implementation has negligible effects, and that the Commission was informed but the derogation conditions are not fully met.
Before the summer I will inform the House further about the progress of the VHS Mest and my efforts to strengthen it in the coming years.
Voor de zomer zal ik uw Kamer verder informeren over de voortgang van de VHS Mest en mijn inzet op de versterking die ik in de VHS Mest de komende jaren wil doorvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Zonvarken experimenteert met diervriendelijke stallen’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how innovative animal-friendly pig housing (Zonvarken) without official ammonia emission factors can be credited in farm nitrogen obligations and PAS-melder legalisation, and whether the lack of assessment hinders sustainability. The minister explained the proefstal route, that such emission reductions cannot yet be counted for PAS-melders, and promised further work on Wnb assessment and innovation barriers by mid-June 2023.
The aim is to have first insights by mid-June 2023 into what an alternative framework for Wnb permit approval for low-emission stables could look like.
Het streven is om medio juni 2023 de eerste inzichten te hebben hoe een alternatief kader voor Wnb-toestemmingverlening voor emissiearme stallen eruit kan zien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Campen over een Agro E-label

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture about the Agro E-label, a digital label for plant protection product barcodes, and whether labels could be digitised and integrated with location and weather data. The minister answered that physical labels are required by EU law, that digital labelling depends on pending EU amendments, and that she is favourably disposed to allowing digital labels in principle.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over bedrijfsmatige  houders van dieren die telkens opnieuw dieren mishandelen of verwaarlozen

MPs Wassenberg asked the ministers about a dog breeder in Deurne who keeps neglected dogs, including why 80 dogs were left after 21 were seized, and whether the breeder could restart elsewhere. The minister said 21 dogs were taken into custody, the rest were given remediation orders, prior breeding activity in other municipalities is noted, and the Wet aanpak dierenmishandeling en dierverwaarlozing will add tools to close businesses and impose longer animal-keeping bans.
I cannot go into the details of these cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de details van deze casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch, Vestering en Van Raan over het bericht 'Havermelk duurder door 'limonadebelasting''

Three PvdD MPs asked whether the planned increase in the beverage consumption tax, which exempts dairy drinks but taxes most plant-based milk drinks, is consistent with health and protein policy, and whether the exemption for sugary dairy drinks will be removed. The government confirmed the budget-driven increase, defended the dairy exemption on nutritional grounds, and said a study on sugar taxation is ongoing with results due in 2023, without committing to specific changes.
It is correct that the consumption tax on non-alcoholic drinks (hereinafter: consumption tax) is being increased.
Het klopt dat de verbruiksbelasting van alcoholvrije dranken (hierna: verbruiksbelasting) wordt verhoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over juridische belemmeringen voor composteren gft met wormen

An SGP MP asked why worms are excluded from the definition of farm animals in environmental rules but included under animal welfare rules, and whether worms used for vermicomposting could be exempted from the ban on feeding kitchen waste. The minister replied that the definitions serve different purposes, that EU rules classify compost worms as farm animals so the ban cannot be lifted, and that a hygienisation-based exemption is being explored with a focus on short-term practical solutions.
I am currently also exploring the possibilities of allowing the hygienisation of kitchen waste and food residues at the same location where the worms are kept.
Ik verken op dit moment ook de mogelijkheden om het hygiëniseren van keukenafval en etensresten toe te staan op dezelfde locatie als waar de wormen gehouden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Bromet over de bijdrage van de sector aan verduurzaming van de landbouw

MPs Thijssen and Bromet ask the Minister of Agriculture whether the government will make banks, suppliers, processors and retailers contribute to the agricultural sustainability transition, and whether the polluter-pays principle applies. The Minister answers that binding but non-voluntary contributions from supply-chain parties will be agreed in the Landbouwakkoord, and that the government is studying policy options such as this, without committing to a specific measure yet.
The coalition agreement announced that the government will make binding agreements with supply-chain parties to strengthen the position of the farmer in the chain.
In het coalitieakkoord is aangekondigd dat de overheid bindende afspraken met ketenpartijen maakt om de positie van de boer in de keten te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een voor de garnalenvissers desastreus plan vanuit Brussel

An MP asks the Minister whether the EU Commission's marine ecosystem action plan, which would phase out bottom-trawling in protected areas by 2030, will end the Dutch shrimp fishery, and whether the Minister will oppose such EU measures. The Minister says the plan is being analysed, a cabinet position will be sent to parliament within six weeks, and the government will work with the sector and nature organisations; it does not share the view that EU cooperation should end.
Within six weeks of publication of the action plan, the cabinet position will be shared with the House of Representatives via a BNC fiche.
Binnen zes weken na publicatie van het actieplan wordt het kabinetsstandpunt via een BNC-fiche met de Tweede Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de wolf

Van Haga asked whether the government will declare the wolf unprotected because of livestock attacks despite European rules, and asked how it responds to three provinces calling for an end to the wolf's protected status. The minister answered that she wants a broad societal dialogue and an RDA advisory report first, and will keep existing policy and law meanwhile, referring the provincial letter to a separate reply.
That is why I have asked the Council for Animal Affairs (RDA) to organise a broad societal dialogue on the position of the wolf in the Netherlands.
Daarom heb ik de Raad voor de Dierenaangelegenheden (RDA) gevraagd om een brede maatschappelijke dialoog te organiseren over de positie van de wolf in Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over de ernstige verwaarlozing van tientallen dieren bij een bedrijf dat in het verleden ook al herhaaldelijk in de fout ging en al onder verscherpt toezicht stond

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers of Agriculture and Justice about severe neglect of dozens of cattle at a farm already under intensified supervision, and how inspection and enforcement failed. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, explained the intensified supervision regime and its limits, and said a bill on animal-keeping bans and farm closures is pending, while declining to discuss individual criminal cases or share inspection reports.
It is standing policy of the Minister of Justice and Security and the Public Prosecution Service not to make statements about individual criminal cases.
Het is staand beleid van de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid en het OM om geen uitspraken te doen over individuele zaken in het strafrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over onjuiste beantwoording van Kamervragen over het gebrek aan ventilatie in varkensstallen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether she had wrongly answered earlier questions about low ventilation and dangerous ammonia and CO2 levels in pig barns, and why she had refused to measure ammonia concentrations. The minister acknowledged the warning, defended her earlier answers as based on available information without concrete cases of under-ventilation, declined to measure ammonia levels as costly and of uncertain added value, and pointed to an open-norm and enforcement protocol revision expected by Q1.
Measuring the level of ammonia concentrations in Dutch pig barns is a costly and time-consuming process.
Het in kaart laten brengen van de hoogte van ammoniakconcentraties bij Nederlandse varkensstallen is een kostbaar en tijdrovend proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitvoering van de derogatiebeschikking en het Zevende Actieprogramma Nitraat

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the timing and implementation of the derogation decision and the Seventh Nitrates Action Programme, including buffer strips, compensation, proportionality and the designation of vulnerable zones. The minister gave schedules, said no compensation will be paid for buffer strips beyond a temporary grassland subsidy, and defended the nationwide vulnerable-zone designation.
The measures from the addendum to the 7th Nitrates Action Programme will be implemented as far as possible according to the schedule included in the addendum.
De maatregelen uit het addendum van het 7e AP worden zo veel als mogelijk ingevoerd volgens de planning die in het addendum is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over de rol van notarissen bij dubieuze grondhandel

MPs Boulakjar asked the ministers about notaries' role in dubious land speculation, including duty of care, use of powers of attorney, disciplinary rulings, and ACM/AFM oversight. Minister De Jonge answered that the notarial disciplinary judge assesses duty of care case by case, that the existing framework is sufficient without legal change, and that regulators receive few reports but will act in individual cases.
The assessment of the role of notaries and the associated duty of care in light of land trading is reserved for the notarial disciplinary judge.
De beoordeling van de rol van notarissen en de daarbij behorende zorgplicht in het licht van grondhandel is voorbehouden aan de notariële tuchtrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Meerderheid boeren wil sloten dempen'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a poll showing farmers want to fill in ditches, and the risks for biodiversity, climate resilience, and nature and nitrogen targets. The minister answered that ditch-filling requires permission from water boards, that ditches matter for biodiversity and water systems, and that no steps need reversing, though the answers to some questions were delayed.
It is therefore important that farmers always first consult the relevant water board to request permission to fill in a ditch.
Het is dan ook van belang dat landbouwers altijd eerst in overleg treden met het desbetreffende waterschap om toestemming te vragen voor het dempen van een sloot
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ‘De latente stikstofruimte en extern salderen’

An MP (Omtzigt) asked the ministers about buy-outs of farms for nitrogen permit space, unregistered latent permit capacity, the unrecorded 30% deduction in external netting, and the AERIUS model update, requesting lists and data. The minister answered that the external netting evaluation is ongoing with results expected mid-2023, that stricter external netting rules and registration of freed space are being pursued, and that a complete picture of latent space cannot be obtained.
I expect to be able to share the results of the evaluation with the House around mid-2023.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van de evaluatie medio 2023 met de Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Adviseurs: fouten op RVO-kaarten met sloten en bufferstroken'

An MP from the CDA asked the agriculture minister about errors in RVO's buffer-strip map showing ditches, and about the resulting confusion for farmers. The minister acknowledged that the map inherits inaccuracies from the BGT base registry, that farmers can correct buffer strips in the Gecombineerde Opgave, and that RVO is working on an improvement plan with water boards and other source holders.
RVO is working on an improvement plan to align the BGT base information with the classifications of ditches and watercourses.
RVO werkt aan een verbeterplan om de basisinformatie van de BGT te laten aansluiten bij de typeringen van sloten en waterlopen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Uren vergaderd, maar bespreken Landbouwakkoord moet nog beginnen'

An MP asked the agriculture minister whether the Landbouwakkoord (agricultural agreement) will be finished by April 2023, how the process and the reflection table's membership and independence are safeguarded, and how nitrogen, climate and water targets are secured. The minister answered that work is on track for an April agreement, described the process and reflection table composition, and said the targets and coalition agreement frame the talks.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Haga over de risico’s van insectenconsumptie

An MP asked the ministers about EU approval of insects as human food, the safety research behind it, state financial support for insect farms including Protix, chitin and parasite risks, and labelling. The minister answered that the EU novel food procedure with EFSA risk assessments applies, that the state has no stake in Protix and does not centrally register support to insect farmers, and that labelling requirements apply.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het aanscherpen van regels in natuurgebieden

An MP asks whether the government's correction of incomplete Natura 2000 designations, which expands nitrogen-sensitive habitat and tightens permit assessment near nature areas, unfairly burdens farmers. The minister denies that rules are being tightened, says the impact is limited, applies only to new permits, and notes the correction is required by case law.
I do not share that view. There is no question of tightening the rules.
Die mening deel ik niet. Van aanscherpen van de regels is geen sprake.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het verzoek in de commissie-Regeling van Werkzaamheden van de procedurevergadering van de commissie LNV van 19 oktober 2022 waarbij een verzoek tot een onafhankelijk onder

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the Minister of LNV about the tilapia/meerval subsidy project in the Peel, including its outcomes, EU correction, rebranding as Claresse, a promotion subsidy, harm to existing catfish farmers and a request for an independent investigation. The minister answered that the project was lawful, courts found no causal link, no new independent investigation or compensation will be provided, and that some documents were already released under freedom of information rules.
Based on the proceedings and rulings so far, I see no reason to initiate a new investigation into this case.
Op basis van de gelopen procedures en uitspraken, zie ik geen aanleiding om een nieuw onderzoek naar deze casus in te stellen.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Garnalenvloot moet binnen 9 maanden aan stikstofnorm voldoen, 'te snel'’

MP Van der Plas asks why shrimp trawlers must meet a nitrogen standard within nine months, questioning whether they are existing use, the fleet's share of emissions, the fairness versus container ships, and feasibility. The minister replies that shrimp fishing is not treated as existing use, that the fleet's share cannot be given exactly, that the nine-month period is realistic, and that a catalyst is a voluntary option with a fallback permit.
No exact figure can be given for the contribution of the entire shrimp fleet.
Er kan geen exact getal worden gegeven voor de bijdrage van de gehele garnalenvloot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het artikel ‘Landbouw ook aan de lat voor nitraat uit de stad'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether groundwater monitoring points outside agricultural areas are counted in the Nitrates Directive assessment reported to the EU, and how many there are. The minister answered that these points are excluded from the Dutch agricultural assessment but included in the dataset sent to the EU, and that they do not add to exceedances.

No, this is not correct. The results for measuring points in other types of areas (nature and other) are not included in the Dutch assessment of groundwater quality in the agriculture category reported to the EU.

Nee, dit klopt niet. De resultaten voor de meetpunten in andere typen gebieden (natuur en overig) worden niet meegewogen in de Nederlandse beoordeling van de grondwaterkwaliteit in de categorie landbouw die naar de EU gerapporteerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het voorop stellen van het bedrijfsbelang van slachthuizen

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about repeated serious animal welfare violations at a slaughterhouse in Twello, including inspection failures, leniency in enforcement, and why the plant has not been closed and transparency about violations is limited.
