The Minister acknowledges the violations, describes the NVWA's intervention and fine policy, defends the appeal against publication of slaughterhouse names, and promises to inform parliament on an ongoing sanctions evaluation and a forthcoming food policy letter.
I support the NVWA's ambition to pursue strict enforcement when the situation calls for it.
Ik steun de ambitie van de NVWA die gericht is op strikte handhaving als de situatie daarom vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over giftige ammoniakdampen in varkensstallen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether ventilation in pig barns falls in winter and whether ammonia levels are dangerously high, and whether enforcement has failed under an open legal norm. The minister denied less ventilation is typical, acknowledged NVWA inspections found high ammonia levels, and said a WUR study due early 2023 will sharpen the enforcement protocol, while leaving open binding numerical limits but declining extra inspections.
That is why the NVWA and LNV have set up a working group to further specify this norm (whether or not through regulation), in order to make effective supervision possible.
Daarom zijn de NVWA en LNV een werkgroep gestart om deze norm nader in te vullen (al dan niet middels regelgeving), om zo effectief toezicht beter mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over het vangen van kippen

MP Tjeerd de Groot asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a court ruling requiring the NVWA to enforce the ban on catching chickens by the legs, and about the government's position on animal welfare and enforcement. The minister acknowledged the ruling, said catching by the legs is not animal-friendly, outlined re-inspections and possible enforcement with penalties, and stated her opposition to exempting poultry from the ban on EU level.
Following the ruling, the NVWA will first carry out re-inspections at those companies that were visited under the original enforcement request.
Naar aanleiding van de uitspraak zal de NVWA eerst herinspecties doen bij die bedrijven die in het kader van het oorspronkelijke handhavingsverzoek zijn bezocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over (onder andere) het bericht ‘Belgische garnalenvissers leveren vergunning in, Waddenvereniging wil rechtspraak'

An MP asked why Belgian shrimp fishers surrendered their Nature Conservation Act permit two months early, whether they may reapply, how the government will prevent harm to nature, and whether the assessment should be independently reviewed, and asked about fishing after the permits expire. The minister answered that the permit was withdrawn to avoid litigation costs, reapplication is allowed, the government will assess applications under existing law, declined an independent review, and granted a limited tolerance period with conditions.
The Minister for Nature and Nitrogen sees no reason to do this.
De Minister voor Natuur en Stikstof ziet geen aanleiding om dit te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van Boswijk en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Steunmaatregelen 'zeer teleurstellend' voor glastuinbouw: 'Dit gaat tuinders niet helpen"

MPs Boswijk and Bontenbal asked the ministers of Agriculture and Economic Affairs about reports that support measures for greenhouse horticulture were insufficient, and about the sector's energy costs, its classification, and EU support options. The government disagrees that the measures do not help, points to raised compensation ceilings and a generic SME scheme, and says it sees no need for additional EU-based support for the sector.
I do not agree with the statement that the measures taken do not help the growers.
Ik ben het niet eens met de uitspraak dat de maatregelen die zijn genomen de tuinders niet helpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Raan over de slinkse vertragingspogingen van de Raad van de Europese Unie inzake de Verordening Duurzaam gebruik pesticiden

MPs Vestering and Van Raan ask why an EU Council request for an additional impact assessment of the Sustainable Use of Pesticides Regulation was placed as an A-item on the Energy Council agenda, and why the Netherlands' earlier opposition appeared to shift. Minister Adema explains the Czech presidency placed it as an A-item after a majority of member states supported it, that the Netherlands opposed it, and that the Netherlands will run its own impact study with results expected in Q1 2023.
I will inform the Chamber about this.
Ik zal de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over stalbezettingen

Bromet (GroenLinks) asked how many stable occupations by animal activists took place in 2021 and 2022. The minister answered that none are known to have occurred in those years, noting police cannot retrieve such figures because a stable occupation is not a separate offence, though one occupation of a calf farm in Apeldoorn in September 2021 led to 84 arrests.
A stable occupation is not a separate criminal offence and is therefore not registered in a uniform way.
Een stalbezetting is geen apart strafbaar feit en wordt dus niet op een eenduidige wijze geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over de subsidieregeling Energie-efficiëntie Glastuinbouw

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the Energy Efficiency in Greenhouse Horticulture subsidy: why no new applications are possible in 2022, and why the maximum LED lighting wattage requirement exists and should be relaxed. The minister said the 2022 budget is exhausted, the scheme will reopen in 2023, and the wattage cap is needed to ensure energy savings, rejecting any relaxation.
I intend to reopen the EG subsidy scheme in 2023.
Ik ben voornemens om de subsidieregeling EG in 2023 opnieuw open te stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de publicatie van de undercoverbeelden van House of Animals over een illegale puppyfabriek in Eersel, waar het welzijn van honderden honden ernstig wordt geschaad

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about undercover footage of an illegal puppy farm in Eersel, covering animal welfare breaches, enforcement by the NVWA, zoning and the number of inspections. The Minister called the conditions unacceptable, said the NVWA has repeatedly enforced and is pursuing a bill to allow wider closure powers, but answered that the enforcement delay reflects the need for a thorough file.

At the request of the IG, I want to examine with the NVWA whether and how heavier interventions such as suspending and halting business operations can be added to the existing enforcement instruments for animal welfare violations by breeders.

Op verzoek van de IG wil ik samen met de NVWA onderzoeken of en hoe aan het bestaande handhavingsinstrumentarium bij dierenwelzijnsovertredingen door fokkers ook zwaardere interventies als schorsen en stilleggen van bedrijfsvoering kunnen worden toegevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Graus over zware mishandeling en wurging van katten in Gouda

PVV MPs Wilders and Graus asked whether an investigation would be launched into the cat strangulations in Gouda, whether the carcasses were sent to the Veterinary Forensic Team, whether animal abusers could face much harsher penalties, and what would be done to prevent such cases and ensure enough capacity. The Minister said investigations are a matter for the police and prosecutors, pointed to existing maximum penalties and a pending bill allowing an independent animal-keeping ban, and said there was no evidence of insufficient capacity.
It is not for the Minister to decide whether to launch a criminal investigation.
Het is niet aan de Minister om te besluiten over het instellen van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de zestien koeien die vermoedelijk zijn geëlektrocuteerd door een mestschuifsysteem

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about sixteen cows reportedly electrocuted by a manure-scraper system, including causes, risks of emission-low floors, subsidies, and the Raad van State ruling on emission-reducing stalls. The minister says the cause investigation is ongoing, sees no reason yet for a warning, reports no known similar cases, notes fiscal schemes but no subsidies, and points to existing electrical inspection measures.
Once the results of the investigation are known, the House will be informed about this.
Zodra de uitkomsten van het onderzoek bekend zijn, wordt de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de belemmerende regels voor multifunctionele landbouw

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about regulatory obstacles for multifunctional farming, including zoning permits, the 50 percent turnover rule and the Wtza law affecting care farms, and what the government would do about them. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to joint work with the VNG and the sector on a revised handbook, reviewing municipal rules, and more key figures, while offering no firm timetable or binding commitments.
Yes, I am willing to do that. I have contacted the VNG about this, and a proposal is currently being prepared to update the 2011 'Handreiking Multifunctionele Landbouw en Ruimtelijke Ordening'.
Ik heb contact gelegd met de VNG hierover, en op dit moment wordt er aan een voorstel gewerkt om de «Handreiking Multifunctionele Landbouw en Ruimtelijke Ordening» uit 2011 4 te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over wildopvangcentra die noodgedwongen moeten sluiten vanwege financiële problemen

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about wildlife shelters forced to close due to financial problems, including the closure of Wildopvang Zuid-Holland, and whether the government will provide structural financial support. The minister acknowledges the cost pressures but declines direct national financial aid, referring to provinces, municipalities and donations, while promising communication to the public, dialogue with provinces and a possible review of veterinary competences.
My ministry has periodic contact with individual wildlife shelters, but I do not have this information because these are independent organisations.
Mijn ministerie heeft periodiek contact met individuele wildopvangcentra, maar ik beschik niet over deze informatie omdat dit zelfstandige organisaties zijn.
Antwoord op vragen Van den Hil en Van Campen over het artikel ‘Populaire kinderopvang bij de boer gehinderd door starre regels’

Two VVD MPs asked whether rules hinder agricultural childcare (kinderopvang bij de boer), including limits on the side branch, fine-particulate norms, procedures, and relaxed staffing rules. The ministers answered that they are in talks with LTO, VAK and VNG about local permitting obstacles, but gave no concrete list of rules or a coulance scheme.
Unfortunately it was not possible to send the answers before the committee debate, because coordination with the various parties took more time.
Het is helaas niet gelukt de antwoorden voor het commissiedebat te versturen, omdat de afstemming met de verschillende partijen meer tijd vergde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over het stoppen met gedogen van het veel te vroeg weghalen van biggen bij hun moeder

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the NVWA allegedly tolerating premature weaning of piglets, the scale of breeding for large litters, and enforcement against moederloze opfok. The minister confirmed the legal 21/28-day minimum weaning age and limited enforcement history, noted that enforcement was partly complaint-driven and resulted in warnings, and promised dialogue with the sector rather than new enforcement measures.
The two companies where enforcement was taken are companies where Stichting Wakker Dier requested enforcement.
Antwoord 11 De twee bedrijven waar handhavend is opgetreden zijn bedrijven waar Stichting Wakker Dier heeft verzocht om handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het sombere toekomstperspectief voor de slateelt

An SGP MP asked the minister about the bleak future for Dutch endive (slateelt) growers after loss of pest-control products, including the seed coating and spirotetramat, and whether a temporary exemption could be granted and quality demands adjusted. The minister said the sector must apply for any exemption, that Dutch restrictions on neonicotinoids will be respected so a temporary exemption does not fit, and that the landbouwakkoord will address grower expertise and chain partners.
The sector is free to submit an application for a temporary exemption.
Het staat de sector vrij een aanvraag voor een tijdelijke vrijstelling in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Haga over ‘het kapot maken van de visserij’

An MP asked the agriculture minister about reports that the demersal fishing sector is collapsing, with fishers making heavy losses and signing up for a decommissioning scheme, and whether innovation funds and a future perspective would be provided. The minister acknowledged the losses and the scheme sign-ups, described a socio-economic impact analysis due in early 2023, said the innovation network was starting up, and stated her mission is supporting a smaller, sustainable fleet without offering guarantees.
At present I am having a socio-economic impact analysis carried out to map the relationship between the primary sector, the chain and communities.
Op dit moment laat ik een sociaaleconomische impactanalyse uitvoeren om de relatie tussen de primaire sector en de keten en gemeenschappen in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Tweede pony in korte tijd aangevallen in Wittelte'

An MP asked the minister about wolf-attack reporting, BIJ12 procedures for rejecting reports without on-site inspection, the lack of objection rights, contra-expertise, compensation conditions and environmental assessment for fencing. The minister answered that BIJ12 publishes reports, that objection rights may be explored with the provinces, and that compensation and monitoring are provincial responsibilities.
The member Van der Plas rightly points to this gap, and I agree that it would be good if damage reporters could take action against a decision of BIJ12
Het lid Van der Plas wijst, mijn inziens terecht, op deze lacune en ik ben het met haar eens dat het goed zou zijn indien schademelders tegen een beslissing van BIJ12 in het geweer kunnen komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Edgar Mulder over het bericht dat mogelijk 90 procent van de Urker vissersvloot de kerst niet haalt zonder compensatie voor de gestegen brandstofprijzen

An MP asked the minister about reports that most of Urk's fishing fleet may not survive to Christmas without compensation for fuel price rises, and about the lack of support compared with other EU countries. The minister acknowledged the hardship, pointed to the decommissioning scheme, bridging and liquidity schemes and innovation subsidies, and committed to further schemes and an impact analysis.
I will support them by, alongside the decommissioning scheme, further developing the bridging scheme, about which I informed the House on 15 November, and opening it early next year.
Ik ga hen ondersteunen door naast de saneringsregeling de overbruggingsregeling, waar ik de Kamer op 15 november jl. over heb geïnformeerd, verder uit te werken en begin volgend jaar open te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de brief van 25 mei 2021 waarin de minister toezeggingen doet over de opvolging van de motie van het lid Von Martels over rondzwervende wolven

An MP asks whether the evaluation of the current interprovincial wolf plan is complete, what the status of the new wolf plan is, which measures to limit damage are included, and for minutes and participant lists of the Landelijk Overleg Wolf. The minister says no evaluation documents exist, the new plan is delayed to mid-2023 with a concept attached, damage-prevention measures are not yet decided, and the LOW minutes are not public under Chatham House rules.
The LOW is an independent consultation body that does not fall under the responsibility of my ministry or the provinces.
Het LOW is een onafhankelijke overlegvorm die niet onder verantwoordelijkheid van mijn ministerie of van de provincies valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over ‘de afgezwakte Nederlandse inzet voor de nieuwe Europese landbouwgifverordening’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the Dutch position in EU negotiations on the pesticide regulation weakens the earlier BNC commitments on bans in sensitive areas, buffer zones and integrated pest management. The Minister answers that the Dutch position is consistent with the BNC memorandum, that buffer zones would get the same ban as sensitive areas, and that some flexibility in the IPM sequence is needed.

As I committed to your House in the Commissiedebat gewasbescherming on 20 October, I will inform you before and after these discussions about the anticipated discussion points and the outcomes, respectively.

Zoals ik uw Kamer heb toegezegd in het Commissiedebat gewasbescherming op 20 oktober jl., informeer ik u voorafgaand en na afloop van deze besprekingen over de voorziene bespreekpunten respectievelijk de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Esch over de escalatie van het vogelgriepvirus en nieuwe besmettingen onder zoogdieren

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked the government about avian flu spreading in dense poultry areas, the gassing of 300,000 hens, repeat outbreaks, and risks from mink infections. The minister acknowledged the concern, said preventive measures and a reduction of poultry density are being pursued, described the gassing procedure and CO2 supply logistics, and stated that the public health risks are monitored through established surveillance structures.
In doing so we focus, among other things, on accelerating the vaccination process and further strengthening biosecurity with a mandatory biosecurity plan for all poultry farms.
Daarbij zetten wij onder andere in op versnelling van het vaccinatietraject en verdere versterking van de bioveiligheid met een verplicht bioveiligheidsplan voor alle pluimveebedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Beckerman over lozingen op de Waddenzee

MPs Nijboer and Beckerman asked about FrieslandCampina's discharges of nitrogen and phosphate into the Wadden Sea, the adequacy of its permit and supervision, and the lack of a water permit for the HoWa pipeline. The minister answered that the Omgevingsdienst Groningen judged the permit compliant, that supervision occurred annually, that a water permit was being processed by Rijkswaterstaat, and that no illegal discharge exists, though some questions were not answered in time.
There is no question of an illegal discharge via the HoWa pipeline by FrieslandCampina.
Er is geen sprake van een illegale lozing op de HoWa-leiding door FrieslandCampina.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'NVWA-retributies, een hoge kostenpost die maar doorstijgt'

An MP from BBB asks the Minister of Agriculture about reports that NVWA fees keep rising, that industry was not answered on its calls to delay new 2023 tariffs, that the consultation was boycotted, and that the agreed tariff reform and efficiency incentives have not been delivered. The Minister replies that consultation with industry took place, that the tariffs are cost-covering under the coalition agreement, that the 'reistijd = werktijd' dampening will continue in 2023, and that tariffs will not be set until Parliament has had the chance to respond.
At this moment the new NVWA tariffs have not yet been set and published.
Op dit moment zijn de nieuwe NVWA-tarieven nog niet vastgesteld en gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het uitsteken van ogen bij levende vrouwelijke garnalen

MP Wassenberg asked the minister about reports that eyestalks of female shrimp are cut to stimulate reproduction, asking whether this causes disorientation, suffering and shorter lifespan, whether crustacean sentience is reflected in EU aquaculture guidelines, and whether the practice will be stopped. The minister acknowledged the welfare concerns, said scientific knowledge is limited, and declined further action because the practice does not occur in the Netherlands, while committing to continue advocating for shellfish welfare knowledge in Europe.
No shrimp for consumption are farmed in the Netherlands.
In Nederland worden geen garnalen voor consumptie gekweekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over 645.000 geiten in de Nederlandse geitenhouderij

MP Vestering (PvdD) asked the minister about welfare conditions for about 645,000 goats in Dutch farms, including confinement, the culling of kid goats, and whether the minister would weigh animal interests in decisions. Minister Adema answered that animals have intrinsic value under the Wet dieren, described existing rules and NVWA supervision, announced a study on goat housing and kid-rearing obligations from 2023, and committed to weigh animal interests in future decisions.
Yes, under the Wet dieren the government must explicitly weigh the interest of the animal when setting rules and taking decisions based on those rules

Ja, op grond van de Wet dieren dient de overheid bij het stellen van regels bij of krachtens de wet en bij het nemen van op die regels gebaseerde besluiten het belang van het dier expliciet mee te wegen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de toekomst van de eendenhouderij in Nederland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the agriculture minister about avian flu outbreaks in duck farming, the welfare and slaughter of ducks, public health risks, and the allocation of nitrogen space to duck farming. The minister acknowledges the outbreaks, says a flu intensification plan is being prepared, and states that slaughter methods are governed by EU rules and that nitrogen space is not reserved for duck farming.
That is why I am working on an intensification plan for avian flu, as also discussed with you during the debate on 13 October.
Daarom werk ik aan een intensiveringsplan voor vogelgriep, zoals ook met u besproken tijdens het debat op 13 oktober jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over hoe we een wereld van verschil kunnen maken voor de ruim 520 miljoen kippen die jaarlijks worden geslacht in de pluimvee-industrie

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality how to improve conditions for the over 520 million chickens slaughtered yearly in the Dutch poultry industry, citing cage housing, animal deaths and bird flu culling. The minister acknowledged animal welfare concerns, committed to ending cage housing through EU revision of welfare rules, and pledged to weigh animals' interests in future decisions, without announcing new domestic binding measures.
I think an end must come to that.
Ik vind dat daar een einde aan moet komen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over hoe we een wereld van verschil kunnen maken voor de 2,6 miljoen konijnen die jaarlijks worden gefokt, gebruikt en gedood in de Nederlandse konijnenhouderij

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about welfare problems for the roughly 2.6 million rabbits bred and slaughtered yearly in the Dutch rabbit sector, including high mortality, ammonia air, solitary housing of breeding does, and cage conditions. The minister answered that animals have intrinsic value under the Animal Welfare Act, pointed to inspection, a public-private study on young rabbit mortality, a sector plan to move breeding does to group or combi housing by 2030, and EU welfare regulation reform, and committed to weigh animal interests in future decisions.
I believe animals are more than an object or property; they are living beings with their own value, separate from the use value humans assign to them.
Ik vind dat dieren meer zijn dan een object of eigendom, het zijn levende wezens met een eigen waarde, los van de (gebruiks)waarde die de mens er aan toekent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over hoe we een wereld van verschil kunnen maken voor de 17,2 miljoen varkens die jaarlijks worden geslacht in de varkenshouderij

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about welfare conditions for pigs in Dutch farming, including tail docking, housing, air quality, daylight and behavioural needs, and what she would do as minister responsible for animal welfare. The minister answered that animals have intrinsic value under the Animal Welfare Act, pointed to existing rules, NVWA enforcement, a review of EU welfare rules, and that she would weigh animal interests in her decisions.

Yes, under the Animal Welfare Act the government must explicitly weigh the interest of the animal when setting rules under that act and when taking decisions based on those rules, without prejudice to other justified interests.

Ja, op grond van de Wet dieren dient de overheid bij het stellen van regels bij of krachtens die wet en bij het nemen van op die regels gebaseerde besluiten het belang van het dier expliciet mee te wegen, onverminderd andere gerechtvaardigde belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over hoe we een wereld van verschil kunnen maken voor de 848.000 schapen in de Nederlandse schapenhouderij

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the welfare of the roughly 848,000 sheep in Dutch sheep farming, including slaughter of lambs, live exports, heat stress, hormonal breeding and grazing-based schemes. The minister answers that animals may legally be kept for production, outlines existing enforcement by the NVWA, and pledges action on EU animal welfare rules and a sector-wide dierwaardige veehouderij approach.
Last year the Netherlands, together with the so-called Vught group of countries, drew up a position paper as input for the revision of the EU animal welfare regulation.
Nederland heeft vorig jaar samen met de zogenaamde Vughtgroeplanden een position paper opgesteld, als input voor het traject van de herziening van de EU dierenwelzijnsregelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over hoe we een wereld van verschil kunnen maken voor de ruim twee miljoen koeien, stieren en kalfjes die jaarlijks worden geslacht in de veehouderij

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture how the government will improve the welfare of millions of cattle and calves slaughtered yearly in Dutch livestock farming, citing lameness, udder infections, respiratory disease and social behaviour. The minister answered that animals have intrinsic value under the Wet dieren, pointed to sector initiatives, monitoring, pilots and EU welfare revision, and committed to weighing animal interests in future decisions.

Yes, under the Wet dieren the government must explicitly weigh the interest of the animal when setting rules under that law and when taking decisions based on those rules, without prejudice to other justified interests.

Ja, op grond van de Wet dieren dient de overheid bij het stellen van regels bij of krachtens die wet en bij het nemen van op die regels gebaseerde besluiten het belang van het dier expliciet mee te wegen, onverminderd andere gerechtvaardigde belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over stalbranden

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about a barn fire in Assen that killed 28,500 hens, the fire-prevention measures in place, the compartmentalisation of the barn, and progress on fire-safety regulation following the Safety Board report. The minister answered that existing Building Decree rules apply, that the two barns formed one fire compartment, that the fire-safety regulation is still being drafted with a parliamentary submission expected in Q2 2023, and that the Animal Act amendment is not yet signed.
I intend to put the draft general administrative order into procedure at the end of this year.
Ik ben voornemens om de ontwerp algemene maatregel van bestuur eind dit jaar in procedure te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Van Campen en Bisschop over het bericht 'Wolf blijft zorgen voor problemen: ook kalveren en pony’s slachtoffer'

Three MPs (Boswijk, Van Campen, Bisschop) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about rising wolf attacks on livestock, the handling of damage compensation, the legal status and management options for the wolf, and related policy. The minister replied that the issues are known, that prevention measures under the Interprovincial Wolf Plan are considered adequate, that management is not currently permitted because no favourable conservation status has been reached, and that an international wolf plan with Germany is in preparation.
That is why I, together with the provinces, am committed to properly protecting livestock and hobby animals in order to prevent animal suffering.
Daarom zet ik, samen met de provincies, in op het goed beschermen van vee en hobbydieren om daarmee het dierenleed te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over een lijst van 500–600 piekbelasters

An MP asked how the claimed list of 500–600 peak nitrogen polluters arose, what earlier studies say about targeting such emitters, and how the government will handle buyouts, PAS-notifier priority and zoning. The minister replied that the analysis was based on anonymised data rather than a list of companies, that a gradual approach with provinces is being developed, and that no zone classification or list of PAS-notifiers in zones exists yet.
At this moment there is no list of peak polluters, compiled for the approach to apply to.
Op dit moment is er geen lijst met piekbelasters waar de aanpak op zal zien, samengesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over dwangsommen voor Overijsselse boeren

An MP asks the minister about enforcement penalties (dwangsommen) threatened against Overijssel farms that operated legally under the PAS until the Council of State struck it down in 2019, and whether the minister will act to prevent them. The minister confirms the province must enforce after a court ruling, says the cabinet continues the legalisation programme with extra funding, but gives no specific step toward the province.
I am not aware of the content of the imposed burdens.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de inhoud van de opgelegde lasten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en Helder over het artikel waarin gesteld wordt dat het Kamerlid Van Ginneken van de D66-fractie eist dat u uw principiële mening ten aanzien van de transgenderwet herzie

PVV MPs asked Minister Adema whether she accepts that an MP's public demand that she retract her earlier personal opposition to the transgender law undermines her credibility and coalition relations. The minister replied she signed the manifesto in a personal capacity before becoming minister, accepts full cabinet responsibility, and does not see the MP's questions as harming coalition relations.
A minister bears responsibility for the entire cabinet policy, and that is how I will conduct myself.
Een Minister draagt verantwoordelijkheid voor het gehele kabinetsbeleid, en zo zal ik mij dus ook opstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vestering over de procedurele verlenging van de werkzame stof glyfosaat

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks whether the Netherlands will vote for a one-year procedural extension of glyphosate's approval before safety assessments are complete, and questions cancer, neurological, water and bee risks, Monsanto lobbying and the precautionary principle. The Minister confirms the Dutch vote, says the extension is needed because the reassessment is delayed by public consultation responses, rejects economic considerations, and answers most questions by citing ongoing EU reassessment and EFSA/ECHA findings, while promising to raise a bee study with EFSA.

I attach importance to all scientific insights, including those reaching a different conclusion, being taken into account, because this makes the weighing of whether to renew approval better possible.

Ik hecht eraan dat alle wetenschappelijke inzichten, ook die tot een andere conclusie komen, worden betrokken, omdat dit de afweging voor het al dan niet hernieuwen van de goedkeuring beter mogelijk maakt.
